text:
Huroof-e-Muqatta'at aur un ke ma'ani: Alif-Laam-Meem jaise huroof-e-muqatta'at hain jo suraton ke awwal mein aaye hain, in ki tafsir mein mufassireen ka ikhtilaf hai. Ba'az toh kehte hain in ke ma'ani sirf Allah Ta'ala hi ko maloom hain aur kisi ko maloom nahin. Is liye woh in huroof ki koi tafsir nahin karte. Qurtubi ne Hazrat Abu Bakr, Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Usman, Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) se yahi naqal kiya hai. Aamir, Sha'bi, Sufyan Thauri, Rabi bin Khuthaim (Rahimahumullah) bhi yahi kehte hain, Abu Hatim bin Hibban ko bhi isi se ittefaq hai. Ba'az log in huroof ki tafsir bhi karte hain lekin in ki tafsir mein bahut kuch ikhtilaf hai. Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain yeh suraton ke naam hain. Allama Abu Qasim Mahmood bin Umar Zamakhshari apni tafsir mein likhte hain aksar logon ka isi par ittefaq hai. Sibawaih ne bhi yahi kaha hai aur is ki daleel Bukhari-o-Muslim ki woh hadith hai jis mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Jumma ke din subah ki namaz mein Alif-Laam-Meem As-Sajdah aur Hal Ata 'Alal Insani parhte the. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain Alif-Laam-Meem aur Ha-Meem aur Alif-Laam-Meem-Saad aur Saad yeh sab suraton ki ibtida hai jin se yeh suratein shuru hoti hain. Inhi se yeh bhi manqool hai ke Alif-Laam-Meem Quran ke naamon mein se ek naam hai. Hazrat Qatada aur Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam ka qaul bhi yahi hai aur shayad is qaul ka matlab bhi wahi hai jo Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Zaid Aslam farmate hain ke yeh suraton ke naam hain, is liye ke har surat ko Quran keh sakte hain aur yeh nahin ho sakta ke saare Quran ka naam Alif-Laam-Meem-Saad ho kyunke jab koi shakhs kahe ke main ne Surah Alif-Laam-Meem-Saad parhi toh zahir yahi samjha jata hai ke us ne Surah A'raf parhi na ke poora Quran, Wallahu A'lam. Ba'az mufassireen kehte hain ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ke naam hain. Hazrat Sha'b, Salim bin Abdullah, Ismail bin Abdur Rahman Suddi Kabeer yahi kehte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se riwayat hai ke Alif-Laam-Meem Allah Ta'ala ka bada naam hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Ha-Meem, Ta-Seen aur Alif-Laam-Meem yeh sab Allah Ta'ala ke bade naam hain. Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas dono se yeh marwi hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai yeh Allah Ta'ala ki qasam hai aur is ka naam bhi hai. Hazrat Ikrama farmate hain yeh qasam hai. Ibn-e-Abbas se yeh bhi marwi hai ke is ke ma'ani 'Ana Allah A'lam' hain yani main hi hoon Allah zyada janne wala. Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair se marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas, Ibn-e-Mas'ood aur ba'az deegar sahaba se riwayat hai ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ke naamon ke alag alag huroof hain. Abu Al-Aliyah farmate hain ke yeh teen harf Alif aur Laam aur Meem untees harfon mein se hain jo tamam zabanon mein aate hain. In mein se har har harf Allah Ta'ala ki ne'mat aur us ki bala ka hai aur is mein qawmon ki muddat aur un ke waqt ka bayan hai. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke ta'ajjub karne par kaha gaya tha ke woh log kaise kufr karenge un ki zabanon par Allah Ta'ala ke naam hain. Is ki roziyon par woh palte hain.

Alif se Allah ka naam Allah shuru hota hai aur Laam se iska naam Lateef shuru hota hai aur Meem se iska naam Majeed shuru hota hai aur Alif se muraad Aala yani ne'matein hain aur Laam se muraad Allah Ta'ala ka lutf hai aur Meem se muraad Allah Ta'ala ka majd yani buzurgi hai. Alif se muraad ek saal hai, Laam se tees saal aur Meem se chalees saal (Ibn Abi Hatim). Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ne in sab mukhtalif aqwaal mein tatbiq di hai yani saabit kiya hai ke in mein aisa ikhtilaf nahin jo ek dusre ke khilaf ho. Ho sakta hai yeh suraton ke naam bhi hon aur Allah Ta'ala ke naam bhi, suraton ke shuru ke alfaaz bhi hon aur in mein se har har harf se Allah Ta'ala ke ek-ek naam ki taraf ishara, aur uski sifaton ki taraf aur muddat waghera ki taraf bhi ho. Ek-ek lafz kayi-kayi ma'ani mein aata hai. Jaise lafz 'Ummah' ke iske ek ma'ani hain deen, jaise Quran mein hai aayat (Inna wajadna aaba'ana 'ala ummatin wa inna 'ala aatharihim muhtadun) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 22) hum ne apne baap dadon ko isi deen par paaya. Dusre ma'ani hain Allah ka ita'at guzaar banda. Jaise farmaya aayat (Inna Ibrahima kana ummatan qanital-lillahi hanifa) (Surah An-Nahl: 120) yani Hazrat Ibrahim A.S Allah Ta'ala ke muti' aur farmanbardar aur mukhlis bande thay aur woh mushrikon mein se na thay. Teesre ma'ani hain jama'at, jaise farmaya aayat (Wajada 'alaihi ummatan minan-nasi yasqun) (Surah Al-Qasas: 23) yani ek jama'at ko is kunwein par paani pilate hue paaya. Aur jagah hai aayat (Walaqad ba'athna fi kulli ummatin rasula) (Surah An-Nahl: 36) yani hum ne har jama'at mein koi rasool yaqeenan bheja. Chauthe ma'ani hain muddat aur zamana. Farman hai aayat (Wadakkara ba'da ummah) (Surah Yusuf: 45) yani ek muddat ke baad use yaad aaya. Pas jis tarah yahan ek lafz ke kayi ma'ani hue isi tarah mumkin hai ke in huroof-e-muqatta'at ke bhi kayi ma'ani hon. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ke is farman par hum keh sakte hain ke Abu Al-Aliyah ne jo tafseer ki hai uska matlab to yeh hai ke yeh ek lafz, ek saath, ek hi jagah in sab ma'ani mein hai aur lafz 'Ummah' waghera jo kayi-kayi ma'ani mein aaye hain jinhein istilah mein alfaaz-e-mushtaraka kehte hain. Inke ma'ani hote hain jo ibarat ke qareene se maloom ho jaate hain, ek hi jagah sab ke sab ma'ani muraad nahin hote aur sab ko ek hi jagah mahmool karne ke mas'ala mein ulama-e-usool ka bada ikhtilaf hai aur hamare tafseeri mauzoo se iska bayan kharij hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Doosre yeh ke ummat waghera alfaaz ke ma'ani hi bahut saare hain aur yeh alfaaz isi liye banaye gaye hain ke bandish-e-kalam aur nashist-e-alfaaz se ek ma'ani theek baith jaate hain. Ek harf ki dalalat ek aise naam par mumkin hai jo doosre aise naam par bhi dalalat karta ho aur ek ko doosre par koi fazeelat na ho to muqaddar maanne se, na zameer dene se, na waza ke aitbaar se aur na kisi aur aitbaar se aisi baat ilmi taur par to nahin samjhi ja sakti, albatta agar manqool ho to aur baat hai lekin yahan ikhtilaf hai ijma nahin hai is liye yeh faisla qabil-e-ghaur hai. Ab ba'az ashaar-e-Arab ke jo is baat ki daleel mein pesh kiye jaate hain ek kalma ko bayan karne ke liye sirf uska pehla harf bol dete hain. Yeh theek hai lekin un sher'on mein khud ibarat aisi hoti hai jo is par dalalat karti hai. Ek harf ke bolte hi poora kalma samajh mein aa jaata hai lekin yahan aisa bhi nahin, wallahu a'alam. Qurtubi kehte hain ek hadith mein hai ke jo musalman qatl par aadhe kalma se bhi madad kare, matlab yeh hai ke 'uqtul' poora na kahe balki sirf 'uq' kahe. Mujahid kehte hain: Suraton ke shuru mein jo huroof hain maslan Qaf, Saad, Ha-Meem, Ta-Seen-Meem, Alif-Laam-Ra waghera yeh sab huroof-e-hija hain. Ba'az Arabi daan kehte hain ke yeh huroof alag alag jo athais (28) hain in mein se chand zikr kar ke baqi ko chhod diya gaya hai, jaise koi kahe ke mera beta Alif, Ba, Ta, Tha likhta hai to matlab yeh hota hai ke yeh tamam athais huroof likhta hai lekin ibtida ke chand huroof zikr kar diye aur baqi ko chhod diya. Suraton ke shuru mein is tarah ke kul chaudah (14) huroof aaye hain: Alif, Laam, Meem, Saad, Ra, Kaf, Ha, Ya, Ain, Ta, Seen, Ha, Qaf, Noon. In sab ko agar mila liya jaye to yeh ibarat banti hai: "Nass-e-Hakeem Qati'un Lahu Sir". Tadaad ke lihaz se yeh huroof chaudah hain aur jumla huroof athais hain is liye yeh aadhe huye. Baqiya jin huroof ka zikr nahin kiya gaya un ke muqable mein yeh huroof un se zyada fazeelat wale hain aur yeh sana'at-e-tasreef hai. Ek hikmat is mein yeh bhi hai ke jitni qisam ke huroof thay utni qismein ba'aitbar-e-aksariyat ke in mein aa gayin yani mahmoosa, majhoora waghera. SubhanAllah, har cheez mein us Malik ki hikmat nazar aati hai. Yeh yaqeeni baat hai ke Allah ka kalam laghw, behooda, bekar, be-ma'ani alfaaz se paak hai. Jo jahil log kehte hain ke sire se in huroof ke kuch ma'ani hi nahin woh bilkul khata par hain. Is ke kuch na kuch ma'ani yaqeenan hain, agar Nabi-e-Ma'soom (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ke ma'ani kuch sabit hon to hum woh ma'ani karenge aur samjhenge, warna jahan kahin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuch ma'ani bayan nahin kiye hum bhi na karenge aur imaan layenge ke yeh Allah ki taraf se hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se to is baare mein hamein kuch nahin mila aur ulama ka bhi is mein behad ikhtilaf hai. Agar kisi par kisi qaul ki daleel khul jaye to khair woh ise maan le warna behtar yeh hai ke in huroof ke Kalam-e-Allah hone par imaan laye aur yeh jaane ke is ke ma'ani zaroor hain jo Allah hi ko maloom hain aur hamein maloom nahin huye.

Doosri hikmat in huroof ke laane mein yeh bhi hai ke in se suraton ki ibtida maloom ho jaye lekin yeh wajah zaeef hai is liye ke is ke baghair hi suraton ki judai maloom ho jati hai. Jin suraton mein aise huroof hi nahin kya un ki ibtida inteha maloom nahin? Phir suraton se pehle Bismillah ka parhne aur likhne ke aitbar se majood hona kya ek surat ko doosri se juda nahin karta? Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne is ki hikmat yeh bhi bayan ki hai ke chunke mushrikeen Kitabullah ko sunte hi na thay is liye unhein sunane ke liye aise huroof laye gaye taake jab un ka dhyan kaan lag jaye to baqaida tilawat shuru ho lekin yeh wajah bhi bodi hai is liye agar aisa hota to tamam suraton ki ibtida inhi huroof se ki jati halankeh aisa nahin hua. Balkeh aksar suratein is se khali hain phir jab kabhi mushrikeen se kalam shuru ho yahi huroof chahiyen, na ke sirf suraton ke shuru mein hi yeh huroof hon. Phir is par bhi gaur kar lijiye ke yeh surat yani Surah Al-Baqarah aur is ke baad ki surat yani Surah Aal-e-Imran yeh to Madina Sharif mein nazil hoti hain aur mushrikeen-e-Makkah in ke utarne ke waqt wahan thay hi nahin phir in mein yeh huroof kyun aaye? Haan yahan par ek aur hikmat bhi bayan ki gayi hai ke in huroof ke laane mein Quran-e-Karim ka ek mojiza hai jis se tamam makhlooq aajiz hai bawajood yeh ke yeh huroof bhi rozmarra ke istemali huroof se tarkeeb diye gaye hain lekin makhlooq ke kalam se bilkul nirale hain. Mubarrad aur muhaqqiqeen ki ek jamaat aur Farra aur Qutrub se bhi yahi manqool hai. Zamakhshari ne Tafsir-e-Kashaf mein is qaul ko naqal kar ke is ki bohat kuch taeed ki hai. Sheikh Imam Allama Abu-al-Abbas Hazrat Ibn-e-Taimiyah (R.H) aur Hafiz Mujtahid Abu-al-Hajjaj Mizzi ne bhi yahi hikmat bayan ki hai. Zamakhshari farmate hain yahi wajah hai ke tamam huroof ikathay nahin aaye. Haan in huroof ko mukarrar laane ki yeh wajah hai ke baar baar mushrikeen ko aajiz aur lajawab kiya jaye aur unhein danta aur dhamkaya jaye jis tarah Quran-e-Karim mein aksar qissay kayi kayi martaba laye gaye hain aur baar baar khulay alfaaz mein bhi Quran ke misl laane mein un ki aajizi ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Baaz jagah to sirf ek harf aaya hai jaise Sad, Noon, Qaf, kahin do huroof aaye hain jaise Ha-Meem, kahin teen huroof aaye hain jaise Alif-Laam-Meem, kahin chaar aaye hain jaise Alif-Laam-Meem-Ra aur Alif-Laam-Meem-Sad aur kahin paanch aaye hain jaise Kaaf-Ha-Ya-Ain-Saad aur Ha-Meem-Ain-Seen-Qaf, is liye ke kalimaat-e-Arab ke kul ke kul isi tarah par hain ya to un mein ek harfi lafz hain ya do harfi ya seh harfi ya chaar harfi ya paanch harfi ke paanch harf se zyada ke kalimaat nahin.

Jab yeh baat hai ke yeh huroof Quran-e-Sharif mein bator-e-mojze ke aaye hain toh zaroori tha ke jin suraton ke shuru mein yeh huroof aaye hain wahan zikr bhi Quran-e-Kareem ka ho aur Quran ki buzurgi aur badai bayan ho, chunancha aisa hi untees suraton mein yeh waqay hua hai. Suniye farman hai aayat (Alif-Laam-Meem. Zaalikal-Kitabu la raiba feehi hudan-lil-muttaqeen) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 1-2). Yahan bhi in huroof ke baad zikr hai ke is Quran ke Allah Jalla Shanuhu ka kalam hone mein koi shak nahin. Aur jagah farmaya aayat (Alif-Laam-Meem. Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum. Nazzala alaikal-kitaba bil-haqqi musaddiqal-lima baina yadihi wa anzalat-tawrata wal-injeel) (Surah Al-Imran: 1-3). Woh Allah jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin jo zinda aur daim qaim hai jis ne tum par haq ke sath yeh kitab thodi thodi nazil farmayi hai jo pehle ki kitabon ki bhi tasdeeq karti hai, yahan bhi in huroof ke baad Quran-e-Kareem ki azmat ka izhar kiya gaya. Aur jagah farmaya aayat (Alif-Laam-Meem-Saad. Kitabun unzila ilaika fala yakun fee sadrika harajum-minhu litunzira bihi wa zikra lil-mu'mineen) (Surah Al-A'raf: 1-2). Ya'ni yeh kitab teri taraf utari gayi hai toh apna dil tang na rakh. Aur jagah farmaya aayat (Alif-Laam-Ra. Kitabun anzalnahu ilaika) ilakh, yeh kitab hum ne teri taraf nazil ki taake tu logon ko apne Rabb ke hukum se andheron se nikal kar ujale mein laye. Irshad hota hai aayat (Alif-Laam-Meem. Tanzeelul-kitabi la raiba feehi mir-Rabbil-alameen) (Surah As-Sajdah: 1-2). Is kitab ke Rabb-ul-Alameen ki taraf se nazil shuda hone mein koi shak-o-shuba nahin. Farmata hai aayat (Ha-Meem. Tanzeelum-mir-Rahmanir-Raheem) (Surah Fussilat: 1-2). Bakhshishon aur meherbaniyon wale Allah ne ise nazil farmaya hai. Aayat (Ha-Meem-Ain-Seen-Qaf. Kazalika yoohee ilaika) ilakh, ya'ni isi tarah wahi karta hai Allah Ta'ala Ghalib Hikmaton wala teri taraf aur un nabiyon ki taraf jo tujh se pehle the. Isi tarah aur aisi suraton ke shuru ko ba-ghaur dekhiye toh maloom hota hai ke in huroof ke baad kalam-e-pak ki azmat-o-izzat ka zikr hai jis se yeh baat qawi maloom hoti hai ke yeh huroof is liye laye gaye hain ke log is ke liye mu'arze aur muqable mein aajiz hain. Wallahu A'lam. Ba'z logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke in huroof se muddat maloom karayi gayi hai aur fitnon, ladaiyon aur dusre aise hi kamon ke auqat bataye gaye hain. Lekin yeh qaul bhi bilkul za'eef maloom hota hai, is ki daleel mein ek hadith bhi bayan ki jati hai. Lekin awwal toh woh za'eef hai, dusre is hadith se is qaul ki pukhtagi ka ek taraf is ka batil hona zyada sabit hota hai. Woh hadith Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar ne naqal ki hai jo tareekh ke musannif hain.

Is hadith mein hai ke Abu Yasir bin Akhtab Yahudi apne chand sathiyon ko le kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua. Aap us waqt Surah Al-Baqarah ki shuru ki aayat (Alif-Laam-Meem. Zalikal-Kitabu La Raiba Feehi Hudan-Lil-Muttaqeen) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 1-2) tilawat farma rahe thay. Woh ise sun kar apne bhai Huyay bin Akhtab ke paas aaya aur kaha main ne aaj Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is aayat ki tilawat karte hue suna hai. Woh puchta hai tu ne khud suna? Us ne kaha haan main ne khud suna hai. Huyay un sab Yahudiyon ko le kar phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aata hai aur kehta hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya yeh sach hai ke aap is aayat ko parh rahe thay? Aap ne farmaya haan sach hai. Us ne kaha suniye! Aap se pehle jitne Nabi aaye kisi ko bhi nahin bataya gaya tha ke us ka mulk aur mazhab kab tak rahe ga lekin aap ko bata diya gaya. Phir khara ho kar logon se kehne laga suno! Alif ka adad hua ek, Laam ke tees, Meem ke chalees. Kul ikhattar (71) hue. Kya tum is Nabi ki tabedari karna chahte ho jis ke mulk aur ummat ki muddat kul ikhattar saal ho? Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf mutawajja ho kar daryaft kiya ke kya koi aur aayat bhi aisi hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, Alif-Laam-Meem-Saad. Kehne laga yeh bari bhari aur bohat lambi hai. Alif ka ek, Laam ke tees, Meem ke chalees, Saad ke nawway (90) yeh sab ek sau iksath (161) saal hue. Kaha aur koi bhi aisi aayat hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, Alif-Laam-Ra. Kehne laga yeh bhi bohat bhari aur lambi hai. Alif ka ek, Laam ke tees aur Ra ke do sau. Jumla do sau iktis (231) baras hue. Kya is ke sath koi aur bhi aisi hai? Aap ne farmaya Alif-Laam-Meem-Ra hai. Kaha yeh to bohat hi bhari hai, Alif ka ek, Laam ke tees, Meem ke chalees, Ra ke do sau, sab mil kar do sau ikhattar (271) ho gaye. Ab to kaam mushkil ho gaya aur baat khalt-malt ho gayi. Logo utho! Abu Yasir ne apne bhai se aur dusre ulama-e-Yahood se kaha, "Kya ajab ke in sab huroof-e-majmua ki muddat Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mila ho, ikhattar, ek sau iksath, do sau iktis, do sau ikhattar, yeh sab mil kar saat sau chaar (704) baras hue." Unhon ne kaha ab kaam khalt-malt ho gaya. Baaz logon ka khayal hai ke yeh aayatein inhi logon ke haq mein nazil huin, aayat (Huwallazi Anzala Alaikal-Kitaba Minhu Aayatun-Muhkamatun Hunna Ummul-Kitabi Wa Ukhara Mutashabihat) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 7) yani wohi Allah jis ne tujh par yeh kitab nazil farmayi jis mein muhkam aayatein hain jo asal kitab hain aur dusri aayatein mushabahat wali bhi hain. Is hadith ka daromadar Muhammad bin Saib Kalbi par hai aur jis hadith ka yeh akela rawi ho muhaddiseen us se hujjat nahin pakarte aur phir is tarah agar maan liya jaye aur har aise harf ke adad nikale jayen to jin par chaudah (14) huroof ko hum ne bayan kiya un ke adad bohat ho jayenge aur jo huroof in mein se kayi kayi baar aaye hain agar un ke adad ka shumar bhi kayi kayi baar lagaya jaye to bohat hi bari ginti ho jayegi. Wallahu A'lam.

Tahqiqat-e-Kitab: Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yahan 'Zalika' ma'ani mein 'Haza' ke hain. Mujahid, Ikrama, Saeed, Jubair, Suddi, Muqatil bin Hayyan, Zaid bin Aslam aur Ibn-e-Jurayj ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Yeh dono lafz ek dusre ke qaim-maqam Arabi zaban mein aksar aate rehte hain. Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne Abu Ubaida se bhi yahi naqal kiya hai. Matlab yeh hai ke 'Zalika' asal mein hai toh door ke ishare ke liye jiske ma'ani hain "woh", lekin kabhi nazdeek ke liye bhi late hain, us waqt iske ma'ani hote hain "yeh", yahan bhi is ma'ani mein hai. Zamakhshari kehte hain is se ishara 'Alif-Laam-Meem' ki taraf hai. Jaise is aayat mein hai: (Qala innahu yaqulu innaha baqaratul la faridun wa la bikrun awanum baina zalika, faf'alu ma tu'marun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 68), ya'ni na toh woh gaye burhiya hai na bacha hai balkeh uske darmiyani umar ki jawan hai. Dusri jagah farmaya: (Zalikum hukmullahi yahkumu bainakum, wallahu Alimun Hakim) (Surah Al-Mumtahanah: 10), yeh hi hai Allah ka hukum jo tumhare darmiyan hukum karta hai. Aur jagah farmaya: (Zalikumullahu), yeh hi hai Allah Ta'ala aur iski misaal aur mawaqe pehle guzar chuke. Wallahu A'lam. Ba'az mufassireen ne kaha hai ke yeh ishara Quran-e-Kareem ki taraf hai jiske utarne ka wa'da Rasoolullah (ﷺ) se hua tha. Ba'az ne Taurat ki taraf, kisi ne Injeel ki taraf bhi ishara bataya hai aur isi tarah ke das qaul hain lekin unko aksar mufassireen ne za'eef kaha hai. Wallahu A'lam. Kitab se murad Quran-e-Kareem hai. Jin logon ne kaha hai ke aayat (Zalikal Kitabu) ka ishara Taurat aur Injeel ki taraf hai, unhone intehai bhool-bhulaiyon ka rasta ikhtiyar kiya, badi takleef uthai aur khwah-makhwah bila-wajah woh baat kahi jiska unhein ilm nahin. Raib ke ma'ani hain shak-o-shuba. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) aur kai ek sahaba se yahi ma'ani marwi hain. Abu Darda (R.A), Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Mujahid, Saeed bin Jubair, Abu Malik, Nafi' jo Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ke maula hain, Ata, Abu Al-Aliyah, Rabi' bin Anas, Muqatil bin Hayyan, Suddi, Qatada, Ismail bin Abu Khalid se bhi yahi marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim farmate hain mufassireen mein is mein ikhtilaf nahin. Raib ka lafz Arab shairon ke sheron mein tohmat ke ma'ani mein bhi aaya hai aur haajat ke ma'ani mein bhi iska istemaal hua hai. Is jumla ke ma'ani yeh hue ke is Quran ko Allah ki taraf se nazil-shuda hone mein kuch shak nahin. Jaise Surah Sajdah mein hai: (Alif-Laam-Meem, Tanzeelul Kitabi la raiba fihi mir Rabbil 'Alameen) (Surah As-Sajdah: 1-2), ya'ni beshak yeh Quran-e-Kareem tamam jahanon ke palne wale Allah ki taraf se hai, ya'ni is mein shak na karo. Ba'az qari 'La Raiba' par waqf karte hain aur aayat (Fihi hudallil muttaqeen) ko alag jumla padhte hain. Lekin aayat (La raiba fihi) par theharna bahut behtar hai kyunke yahi mazmoon isi tarah Surah Sajdah ki aayat mein maujood hai aur is mein ba-nisbat 'Fihi huda' ke zyada mubalagha hai.

Hudan nahwi aitbar se sifat ho kar marfoo ho sakta hai aur haal ki bina par mansoob bhi ho sakta hai. Is jagah hidayat ko muttaqiyon ke sath makhsoos kiya gaya jaise dusri jagah farmaya aayat (QUL HUWA LILLAZINA AAMANU HUDAN WA SHIFA'UN, WALLAZINA LA YU'MINUNA FI A'ZANIHIM WAQRUN WA HUWA ALAIHIM 'AMAN, ULA'IKA YUNADAUNA MIN MAKANIN BA'ID) (Surah Fussilat: 44) yani yeh Quran hidayat aur shifa hai iman walon ke liye aur be-imanon ke kaan bojhal hain aur aankhein andhi hain, yeh bahut door se pukarte hain aur farmaya aayat (WA NUNAZZILU MINAL QUR'ANI MA HUWA SHIFA'UN WA RAHMATUN LIL MU'MININ) (Surah Al-Isra: 82) yani yeh Quran imandaron ke liye shifa aur rahmat hai aur zalim log toh apne khasare mein hi barhte jate hain. Isi mazmoon ki aur aayatein bhi hain, un sab ka matlab yeh hai ke go Quran-e-Kareem khud hidayat aur mahz hidayat hai aur sab ke liye hai lekin is hidayat se nafa uthane wale sirf nek-bakht log hain. Jaise farmaya aayat (YA AYYUHAN-NASU QAD JA'ATKUM MAW'IZATUN MIR-RABBIKUM WA SHIFA'UN LIMA FIS-SUDURI WA HUDAN WA RAHMATUN LIL MU'MININ) (Surah Yunus: 57) tumhare paas Allah Ta'ala ki nasihat aur seene ki bimariyon ki shifa aa chuki jo mominon ke liye shifa aur rahmat hai. Aur Ibn Abbas, Ibn Mas'ood aur ba'az deegar sahaba se marwi hai ke hidayat se murad noor hai. Ibn Abbas farmate hain: Muttaqeen ki tareef: Muttaqi woh hain jo iman la kar shirk se door reh kar Allah Ta'ala ke ahkaam baja layein. Ek aur riwayat mein hai muttaqi woh log hain jo Allah Ta'ala ke azabon se dar kar hidayat ko nahin chorte aur uski rahmat ki umeed rakh kar uski taraf se jo nazil hua use sacha jante hain. Hazrat Hasan Basri farmate hain: "Muttaqi woh hai jo haram se bache aur faraiz baja laye." Hazrat A'mash, Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Ayyash se sawal karte hain: "Muttaqi kaun hai?" Aap yahi jawab dete hain, phir main ne kaha "Zara Hazrat Kalbi se bhi toh daryaft kar lo!" Woh kehte hain muttaqi woh hain jo kabeera gunahon se bachein. Is par donon ka ittefaq hota hai. Qatada farmate hain muttaqi woh hai jis ka wasf Allah Ta'ala ne khud is aayat ke baad bayan farmaya ke aayat (ALLAZINA YU'MINUNA BIL-GHAIBI WA YUQIMUNAS-SALATA WA MIMMA RAZAQNAHUM YUNFIQUN) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 3). Imam Ibn Jareer farmate hain ke yeh sab ausaf muttaqiyon mein jama hote hain. Tirmidhi aur Ibn Majah ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Banda haqeeqi muttaqi nahin ho sakta jab tak ke un cheezon ko na chor de jin mein haraj nahin, is khauf se ke kahin woh haraj mein giraftar na ho jaye. Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Ghareeb kehte hain. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai.

Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) farmate hain jabke log ek maidan mein Qayamat ke din rok liye jayenge, us waqt ek pukarne wala pukarega ke Muttaqi kahan hain? Is aawaz par woh khade honge aur Allah Ta'ala apne bazu mein le lega aur be-hijab unhein apne deedar se musharraf farmayega. Abu Afif ne poocha Hazrat Muttaqi kaun log hain? Aap ne farmaya jo log shirk aur but-parasti se bachein aur Allah ki khalis ibadat karein woh isi izzat ke sath Jannat mein pahunchaye jayenge.

Hidayat ki wazahat: Hidayat ke ma'ani kabhi toh dil mein imaan paiwast hojane ke aate hain, aisi hidayat par toh siwaye Allah Jalla Wa 'Ala ki meharbani ke koi qudrat nahin rakhta. Farman hai: Ayat (Innaka la tahdi man ahbabta wa lakinnal-laha yahdi man yasha'u wa huwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen) (Surah Al-Qasas: 56) yani ae Nabi! Jise tu chahe hidayat nahin de sakta. Farmata hai: Ayat (Laisa 'alaika hudahum) tujh par un ki hidayat lazim nahin. Farmata hai: Ayat (Man yudlilillahu fala hadiya lahu) (Surah Al-A'raf: 186) jise Allah gumrah kare use koi hidayat par lane wala nahin. Farmaya: Ayat (Man yahdillahu fahuwal-muhtadi) (Surah Al-A'raf: 178) yani jise Allah hidayat de wahi hidayat wala hai aur jise woh gumrah kare tum hargiz us ka na koi wali paoge na murshid. Is qisam ki aur aayatein bhi hain aur hidayat ke ma'ani kabhi haq ke aur haq ko wazeh kar dene ke aur haq par dalalat karne aur haq ki taraf raah dikhane ke bhi aate hain. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Ayat (Wa innaka la-tahdi ila siratim-mustaqeem) (Surah Ash-Shura: 52) yani tu yaqeenan seedhi raah ki rahbari karta hai. Aur farmaya: Ayat (Innama anta munzirun wa likulli qawmin had) (Surah Ar-Ra'd: 7) yani tu sirf darane wala hai aur har qoum ke liye koi hadi hai. Aur jagah farman hai: Ayat (Wa amma Thamudu fahadainahum) (Surah Fussilat: 17) yani hum ne Thamudiyon ko hidayat dikhayi lekin unhon ne andhe pan ko hidayat par tarjeeh de kar. Farmata hai: Ayat (Wa hadainahun-najdain) (Surah Al-Balad: 10) hum ne use dono raahein dikhayin yani bhalayi aur burayi ki.

Taqwa ke asli ma'ani buri cheezon se bachne ke hain. Asal mein yeh "Waqwi" hai, Waqayat se ma'akhuz hai, Nabigha waghera ke ash'aar mein bhi aaya hai. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) se Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne poocha ke Taqwa kya hai? Unhon ne kaha kabhi kante-dar raaste mein chale ho? Jaise wahan kapdon ko aur jism ko bachate ho aise hi gunahon se baal-baal bachne ka naam Taqwa hai. Ibn-e-Mu'taz shayar ka qaul hai:

Khalli-z-zunuba saghiraha wa kabiraha,
Zakal-tuqa wasna' kamashin fawqa ardi-sh-shawki yahzaru ma yara,
La tahqiranna saghiratan,
Innal-jibala minal-hasa.

Yani chhote aur bade aur sab gunahon ko chhod do, yahi Taqwa hai. Aise raho jaise kanton wali raah par chalne wala insaan. Chhote gunah ko bhi halka na jaano. Dekho pahad kankaron se hi ban jate hain.

Abu Darda R.A apne ashaar mein farmate hain, insaan apni tamannaon ka pura hona chahta hai aur Allah ke iradon par nigah nahin rakhta, halankeh hota wahi hai jo Allah ka irada ho. Woh apne dunyawi faide aur maal ke peeche para hua hai, halankeh iska behtareen faida aur umdah maal Allah se taqwa hai. Ibn-e-Majah ki hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Sab se umdah faida jo insaan hasil kar sakta hai woh Allah ka dar hai. Is ke baad nek biwi hai keh khawand jab us ki taraf dekhe woh use khush kar de aur jo hukum de use baja laye aur agar qasam de de to puri kar dikhaye aur jab woh maujood na ho to us ke maal ki aur apne nafs ki hifazat kare.

Iman ki tareef: Hazrat Abdullah R.A farmate hain, Iman kisi cheez ki tasdeeq karne ka naam hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A bhi yahi farmate hain. Hazrat Zuhri R.H farmate hain, "Iman kehte hain amal ko." Rabee bin Anas R.H kehte hain, yahan iman lane se murad darna hai. Ibn-e-Jareer R.H farmate hain, yeh sab aqwal mil jayen toh matlab yeh hoga ke zaban se, dil se, amal se, ghaib par iman lana aur Allah se darna. Iman ke mafhoom mein Allah Ta'ala par, uski kitabon par, uske usoolon par, iman lana shamil hai aur is iqrar ki tasdeeq amal ke sath bhi karna lazim hai. Main kehta hoon lughat mein iman kehte hain sirf saccha maan lene ko, Quran mein bhi iman is ma'ani mein istemal hua hai. Jaise farmaya (Yuminu billahi wa yuminu lil-mu'mineen) yani Allah ko mante hain aur iman walon ko saccha jante hain. Yusuf A.S ke bhaiyon ne apne baap se kaha tha, Ayat (Wa ma anta bi-mu'minin lana wa law kunna sadiqin) (Surah Yusuf: 17) yani tu hamara yaqeen nahin karega agarche hum sacche hon. Is tarah iman yaqeen ke ma'ani mein aata hai jab a'maal ke zikr ke sath mila hua ho. Jaise farmaya Ayat (Illal-lazina amanu wa amilus-salihat) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 227). Haan jis waqt iska istemal mutlaq ho toh iman-e-shar'i jo Allah ke han maqbool hai woh e'tiqad, qaul aur amal ke majmoo'a ka naam hai. Aksar aimma ka yahi mazhab hai, balkay Imam Shafi'i R.H, Imam Ahmad R.H aur Imam Abu Ubaidah R.H waghera ne is par ijma naqal kiya hai ke iman naam hai zaban se kehne aur amal karne ka. Iman barhta ghat-ta rehta hai aur iske suboot mein bohat se aasar aur hadeesein bhi aayi hain jo hum ne Bukhari Sharif ki sharah mein naqal kar di hain. Falhamdulillah. Ba'az ne iman ke ma'ani Allah se dar-o-khauf ke bhi kiye hain. Jaise farman hai Ayat (Innal-lazina yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaibi lahum maghfiratun wa ajrun kabir) (Surah Al-Mulk: 12) jo log apne Rab se dar-parda darte rehte hain. Aur jagah farmaya Ayat (Man khashiyar-Rahmana bil-ghaibi) al-kh, yani jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala se bin dekhe dare aur jhukne wala dil le kar aaye. Haqeeqat mein Allah ka khauf iman ka aur ilm ka khulasa hai. Jaise farmaya Ayat (Innama yakhshallaha min ibadihil-ulama) (Surah Fatir: 28) jo banday zi-ilm hain sirf Allah se hi darte hain. Ba'az kehte hain woh ghaib par bhi aisa hi iman rakhte hain jaisa hazir par aur unka haal munafiqon jaisa nahin ke jab iman walon ke samne hon toh apna imandar hona zahir karein lekin jab apne walon mein hote hain toh un se kehte hain hum tumhare sath hain hum toh unka mazaq urate hain. In munafiqeen ka haal aur jagah is tarah bayan hua hai Ayat (Iza ja'akal-munafiquna qalu nash-hadu innaka la-Rasulullah) (Surah Al-Munafiqun: 1).

(Surah Al-Munafiqun: 1) Ya'ni munafiq jab tere paas aayenge toh kahenge ke hamari teh-e-dil se shahadat hai ke tu Allah ka Rasool hai. Allah khoob jaanta hai ke tu uska Rasool hai lekin Allah ki gawahi hai ke yeh munafiq tujhse jhoot kehte hain. Is ma'ni ke aitbar se bil-ghaib haal thehre ga, ya'ni woh imaan laate hain dar-aan-haal-e-ke logon se posheeda hote hain. Ghaib ka lafz jo yahan hai, uske ma'ni mein bhi mufassireen ke bahut se aqwaal hain aur woh sab sahih hain aur jama ho sakte hain. Abu Al-Aliyah farmate hain is se muraad Allah Ta'ala par, farishton par, kitabon par, Rasoolon par, Qayamat par, Jannat Dozakh par, mulaqat-e-Allah par, marne ke baad jee uthne par, imaan lana hai. Qatadah bin Da'amah ka yahi qaul hai. Ibn Abbas, Ibn Mas'ood aur ba'az deegar as-haab se marwi hai ke is se muraad woh posheeda cheezein hain jo nazron se ojhal hain jaise Jannat, Dozakh waghera. Woh umoor jo Quran mein mazkoor hain. Ibn Abbas farmate hain Allah ki taraf se jo kuch aaya hai woh sab ghaib mein daakhil hai. Hazrat Abu Zar farmate hain is se muraad Quran hai. Ata bin Abu Rabah farmate hain Allah par imaan laane wala, ghaib par imaan laane wala hai. Ismail bin Abu Khalid farmate hain Islam ki tamam posheeda cheezein muraad hain. Zaid bin Aslam kehte hain muraad taqdeer par imaan lana hai. Pas yeh tamam aqwaal ma'ni ki roo se ek hi hain is liye ke sab cheezein posheeda hain aur ghaib ki tafseer in sab par mushtamil hai aur in sab par imaan lana wajib hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood ki majlis mein ek martaba sahaba ke faza'il bayan ho rahe hote hain toh aap farmate hain "Huzoor ﷺ ke dekhne walon ko toh aap ﷺ par imaan lana hi tha lekin Allah ki qasam imani haisiyat se woh log afzal hain jo baghair dekhe imaan laate hain." Phir aap ne Alif-Laam-Meem se le kar Muflihoon tak aayatein parhein. (Ibn Abi Hatim. Ibn Marduyah. Mustadrak. Hakim). Imam Hakim is riwayat ko sahih batate hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi is mazmoon ki ek hadees hai. Abu Jum'ah sahabi se Ibn Muhairiz ne kaha ke koi aisi hadees sunao jo tumne khud Rasool Allah ﷺ se suni ho. Farmaya main tumhe ek bahut hi umdah hadees sunata hoon, humne Huzoor ﷺ ke saath ek martaba nashta kiya, hamare saath Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah R.A bhi the, unhone kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Kya hum se behtar bhi koi aur hai? Hum aap par Islam laye, aap ke saath jihad kiya. Aap ne farmaya haan woh log jo tumhare baad aayenge, mujh par imaan layenge halankeh unhone mujhe dekha bhi na hoga. Tafseer-e-Ibn Marduyah mein hai. Saleh bin Jubair kehte hain ke Abu Jum'ah Ansari R.A hamare paas Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein aaye. Raja bin Haiwah R.A bhi hamare saath hi the, jab woh wapas jaane lage toh hum unhein chhodne ko saath chale, jab alag hone lage toh farmaya tumhari in meherbaniyon ka badla aur haq mujhe ada karna chahiye. Suno! Main tumhe ek hadees sunata hoon jo main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suni hai. Hum ne kaha Allah Ta'ala tum par reham kare zaroor sunao.

Kaha suno! Hum Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath thay, hum das aadmi thay, Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) bhi un mein thay, hum ne kaha ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya hum se baray ajar ka mustahiq bhi koi hoga? Hum Allah Ta'ala par imaan laye aur aap ki tabedari ki. Aap ne farmaya tum aisa kyun na karte? Allah ka Rasool tum mein majood hai, Wahi-e-Ilahi aasman se tumhare samne nazil ho rahi hai. Imaan toh un logon ka afzal hoga jo tumhare baad aayenge, do gutton ke darmiyan yeh kitab payenge, is par imaan layenge aur is par amal karenge, yeh log ajar mein tum se gunay honge. Is hadith mein "Wujuh" ki qabooliyat ki daleel hai jis mein muhaddiseen ka ikhtilaf hai. Main ne is maslay ko Bukhari Sharif mein khoob wazeh kar diya hai, baad walon ki tareef isi bina par ho rahi hai aur un ka baray ajar wala hona isi haisiyat ki wajah se hai warna ala-al-itlaq har tarah se behtar aur afzal toh Sahaba (R.A) hi hain. Ek aur hadith mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba Sahaba se poocha, tumhare nazdeek imaan lane mein kaun zyada afzal hai, unhon ne kaha, farishtay. Farmaya woh imaan kyun na layen woh toh apne Rabb ke paas hi hain, logon ne phir kaha Anbiya, farmaya woh imaan kyun na layen un par toh wahi nazil hoti hai. Kaha phir hum. Farmaya tum imaan ko qabool kyun na karte? Jab ke main tum mein majood hoon suno! Mere nazdeek sab se zyada afzal imaan wale woh log honge jo tumhare baad aayenge. Sahifon mein likhi hui kitab payenge is par imaan layenge. Is ki sanad mein Mughira bin Qais hain. Abu Hatim Razi unhein Munkar-ul-Hadith batate hain lekin isi ke misl ek aur hadith za'eef sanad hai. Musnad Abu Ya'la, Tafsir Ibn Marduyah, Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi marwi hai aur Hakim isay sahih batate hain. Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A) se bhi isi ke misl marfu'an marwi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Badilah bint Aslam (R.A) farmati hain. Banu Haritha ki masjid mein hum Zuhr ya Asr ki namaz mein thay aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf hamara munh tha, do rakat ada kar chuke thay ke kisi ne aa kar khabar di ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Baitullah Sharif ki taraf munh kar liya hai, hum suntay hi ghoom gaye. Auratein mardon ki jagah aa gayin aur mard aurton ki jagah chale gaye aur baqi ki do rakatein hum ne Baitullah Sharif ki taraf ada keen. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh khabar pahunchi toh aap ne farmaya yeh log hain jo ghaib par imaan rakhte hain. Yeh hadith is asnad se ghareeb hai. Qayam-e-Salat kya hai? Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain faraiz-e-namaz baja lana. Ruku, sajdah, tilawat, khushoo aur tawajjo ko qaim rakhna namaz ko qaim rakhna hai. Qatadah kehte hain waqton ka khayal rakhna, wuzu achi tarah karna, ruku, sajdah poori tarah karna, iqamat-e-salat hai. Muqatil kehte hain waqt ki nigahbani karna, mukammal taharat karna, ruku, sajdah poora karna, tilawat achi tarah karna, at-tahiyat aur durood parhna iqamat-e-salat hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain aayat (وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ يُنْفِقُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Anfal: 3) ke ma'ani Zakat ada karne ke hain.

Ibn Abbas, Ibn Mas'ud aur ba'az Sahaba (R.A) ne kaha hai is se murad aadmi ka apne baal bachon ko khilana pilana hai. Kharch mein qurbani dena jo qurb-e-Ilahi hasil karne ke liye di jati hai, apni istedaad ke mutabiq bhi shamil hai jo Zakat ke hukm se pehle ki ayat hai. Hazrat Zahhak farmate hain ke Zakat ki saat ayatein jo Surah Bara'at mein hain un ke nazil hone se pehle yeh hukm tha ke apni apni taqat ke mutabiq thoda bahut jo mayassar ho dete rahein. Qatada farmate hain yeh maal tumhare paas Allah ki amanat hai, anqareeb tum se juda ho jayega. Apni zindagi mein ise Allah ki rah mein laga do. Imam Ibn Jarir farmate hain ke yeh ayat aam hai, Zakat mein ahl-o-ayal ka kharch aur jin logon ko dena zaroori hai un sab ko dena bhi shamil hai is liye ke Parwardigar ne ek aam wasf bayan farmaya aur aam tareef ki hai. Lehaza har tarah ka kharch shamil hoga. Main kehta hoon Quran-e-Kareem mein aksar jagah namaz ka aur maal kharch karne ka zikr mila jula aata hai is liye ke namaz Allah ka haq aur us ki ibadat hai jo us ki tauheed, us ki sana, us ki buzurgi, us ki taraf jhukne, us par tawakkul karne, us se dua karne ka naam hai aur kharch karna makhlooq ki taraf ehsan karna hai jis se unhein nafa pahunche. Is ke zyada haqdar ahl-o-ayal aur ghulam hain, phir door wale ajnabi. Lehaza tamam wajib akhrajat aur farz Zakat is mein dakhil hain. Sahihain mein Hazrat Ibn Umar (R.A) se riwayat hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Islam ki bunyadein paanch hain. Allah Ta'ala ki tauheed aur Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ki gawahi dena. Namaz qaim rakhna, Zakat dena, Ramzan ke rozay rakhna aur Baitullah ka Hajj karna, is bare mein aur bhi bahut si hadeesein hain. Arabi lughat mein Salat ke ma'ani dua ke hain. Arab shairon ke sher is par shahid hain. Phir shariyat mein is lafz ka istemal namaz ke liye hone laga jo rukoo, sujood aur dusre khas af'aal ka naam hai jo makhsoos auqat mein jumla sharait, sifat aur aqsam ke sath baja layi jati hai. Ibn Jarir farmate hain, Salat ko namaz is liye kaha jata hai ke namazi Allah Ta'ala se apne amal ka sawab talab karta hai aur apni hajatein Allah Ta'ala se mangta hai. Ba'az ne kaha hai ke jo do ragein peeth se le kar reedh ki haddi ki dono taraf aati hain unhein arabi mein salwain kehte hain, chunke Salat mein yeh hilti hain is liye ise Salat kaha gaya hai. Lekin yeh qaul theek nahin. Ba'az ne kaha yeh makhooz hai salla se, jis ke ma'ani hain jhuk jana aur lazim ho jana. Jaise Quran mein ayat (La yaslaha) (92. Al-Lail: 15) yani jahannam mein hamesha na rahega magar badbakht. Ba'az ulama ka qaul hai ke jab lakdi ko durust karne ke liye aag par rakhte hain to Arab tasliya kehte hain, chunke musalli bhi apne nafs ki kaji ko namaz se durust karta hai is liye ise Salat kehte hain. Jaise Quran mein hai ayat (Innas-salata tanha 'anil fahsha'i wal munkari wa la zikrullahi akbar) (29. Al-Ankabut: 45).

(Al-Ankabut: 45) Ya'ni namaz har be-hayai aur burai se rokti hai lekin is ka dua ke ma'ni mein hona hi zyada sahih aur zyada mashhoor hai wallahu a'lam. Lafz-e-Zakat ki behas Insha'Allah aur jagah aayegi.

A'maal-e-Momin: Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke jo kuch Allah ki taraf se tum par nazil hua aur tujh se pehle ke ambiya par nazil hua woh un sab ki tasdeeq karte hain, aisa nahin ke woh kisi ko maanein aur kisi se inkaar karein, balkay apne Rab ki sab baaton ko maante hain aur aakhirat par bhi imaan rakhte hain, yani ba'as-o-qayamat, jannat-o-dozakh, hisab-o-mizan sab ko maante hain. Qayamat chunke duniya ke fana hone ke baad aayegi is liye ise aakhirat kehte hain. Ba'az mufassireen ne kaha hai ke jin ki pehle imaan bil-ghaib waghera ke saath sifat bayan ki gayi thi unhi ki dobara yeh sifatein bayan ki gayi hain. Yani imandaar khwah Arab momin hon khwah Ahl-e-Kitab waghera. Mujahid, Abu Al-Aliyah, Rabee bin Anas aur Qatadah ka yahi qaul hai. Ba'az ne kaha hai yeh dono hain toh ek magar muraad is se sirf Ahl-e-Kitab hi nahin. In dono suraton mein 'Wao' atf ka hoga aur sifaton ka atf sifaton par hoga jaise 'Sabbihisma' waghera mein sifaton ka atf sifaton par hai aur shu'ara ke sher mein bhi aaya hai. Teesra qaul yeh hai ke pehli sifatein toh hain Arab mominon ki aur aayat (وَ الَّذِيْنَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِمَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكَ وَمَآ اُنْزِلَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ ۚ وَبِالْاٰخِرَةِ ھُمْ يُوْقِنُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 4) se muraad Ahl-e-Kitab mominon ki sifatein hain. Suddi ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas, Ibn-e-Masood aur ba'az deegar sahaba Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een se naqal kiya hai aur Ibn-e-Jareer ne bhi isi se ittefaq kiya hai aur is ki shahadat mein yeh aayat laye hain aayat (وَاِنَّ مِنْ اَھْلِ الْكِتٰبِ لَمَنْ يُّؤْمِنُ باللّٰهِ وَمَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْھِمْ خٰشِعِيْنَ لِلّٰهِ ۙ لَا يَشْتَرُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ ثَـمَنًا قَلِيْلًا) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 199) yani Ahl-e-Kitab mein aise log bhi hain jo Allah Ta'ala par aur us wahi par jo tumhari taraf nazil hui aur us wahi par jo is se pehle un ki taraf utari gayi imaan laate hain aur Allah Ta'ala se darte rehte hain. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (اَلَّذِيْنَ اٰتَيْنٰهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ مِنْ قَبْلِهٖ هُمْ بِهٖ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Qasas: 52) yani jinhein is se pehle hum ne kitab di thi woh is ke saath imaan rakhte hain aur jab un ko (yeh Quran) parh kar sunaya jata hai toh kehte hain, hum is par bhi imaan laye aur ise apne Rab ki taraf se haq jana, hum toh is se pehle hi musalman thay. Unhein un ke sabr karne aur burai ke badle bhalai karne aur Allah ki raah mein kharch karne ki wajah se dohra ajar milega. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Teen shakhson ko dohra ajar milega, ek Ahl-e-Kitab jo apne nabi par imaan layein aur mujh par imaan rakhein. Doosra woh ghulam jo Allah Ta'ala ka haq ada kare aur apne maalik ka bhi. Teesra woh shakhs jo apni laundi ko achha adab sikhaye phir use azaad kar ke us se nikah kar le.

Imam Jarir R.H ke is farq ki munasibat is se bhi maloom hoti hai ke surat ke shuru mein mominon aur kafiron ka bayan hua hai toh jis tarah kuffar ki do qismein hain kafir aur munafiq. Isi tarah mominon ki bhi do qismein hain. Arabi momin aur kitabi momin. Main kehta hoon zahiran yeh hai ke Hazrat Mujahid R.H ka yeh qaul theek hai ke Surah Al-Baqarah ki awwal char ayatein mominon ke ausaf ke bayan mein hain aur do ayatein us ke baad ki kafiron ke bare mein hain aur un ke baad ki terah ayatein munafiqon se mutaliq hain. Pas yeh charon ayatein har momin ke haq mein aam hain. Arabi ho ya ajami, kitabi ho ya ghair kitabi, insanon mein se ho ya jinnat mein se. Is liye ke in mein se har ek wasf dusre ko lazim aur shart hai, ek baghair dusre ke nahin ho sakta. Ghaib par iman lana, namaz qaim karna, aur zakat dena us waqt tak sahih nahin jab tak ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par aur agle ambiya par jo kitabein utri hain, un par iman na ho aur sath hi akhirat ka yaqeen-e-kamil na ho. Jis tarah pehli teen cheezein baghair pichli teen cheezon ke ghair motabar hain, isi tarah pichli teenon baghair pehli teenon ke sahih nahin. Isi liye iman walon ko hukm-e-Ilahi hai ayat (Yaa Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Aaminoo Billahi Wa Rasoolihi Wal Kitabillazi Nazzala Ala Rasoolihi Wal Kitabillazi Anzala Min Qabl) (Surah An-Nisa: 136) yani iman walo Allah par, us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par aur jo kitab us par utri hai us par aur jo kitabein un se pehle utri hain un par iman lao. Aur farmaya ayat (Wala Tujahidul Ahlal Kitabi Illa Billati Hiya Ahsan) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 46) yani Ahl-e-Kitab se jhagadne mein behtareen tariqa barto aur kaho ke hum iman laye hain us par jo hum par nazil kiya gaya aur jo tumhari taraf utara gaya hai hamara aur tumhara mabood ek hi hai. Irshad hai ae Ahl-e-Kitab jo hum ne utara hai us par iman lao, is ko saccha karne wala hai jo tumhare paas hai. Aur jagah farmaya, ae Ahl-e-Kitab tum kisi cheez par nahin ho jab tak Taurat, Injeel aur jo kuch tumhari taraf tumhare Rabb ki janib se utara gaya hai, qaim na rakho. Dusri jagah tamam iman walon ki taraf se khabar dete hue Quran-e-Pak ne farmaya ayat (Amanar Rasoolu Bima Unzila Ilaihi Mir Rabbihi Wal Mu'minoon) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 285) yani hamare Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) iman laye us par jo un ki taraf un ke Rabb ki taraf se nazil hua aur tamam iman wale bhi, har ek iman laya Allah Ta'ala par, us ke farishton par, us ki kitabon par aur us ke rasoolon par. Hum rasoolon mein farq aur judai nahin karte. Isi tarah irshad hota hai ke jo log Allah Ta'ala par aur us ke rasoolon par iman late hain aur rasoolon mein se kisi mein tafreeq nahin karte. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si ayatein hain jin mein iman walon ka Allah Ta'ala par, us ke tamam rasoolon aur sab kitabon par iman lane ka zikr kiya gaya hai.

Aur yeh baat hai ke Ahl-e-Kitab ke iman walon ki ek khaas khusoosiyat hai kyunke unka iman apne haan kitabon mein tafseel ke sath hota hai aur phir jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hath par woh Islam qabool karte hain toh Quran-e-Kareem par bhi tafseel ke sath iman late hain. Isi liye unko dohra ajar milta hai aur is ummat ke log bhi agli kitabon par iman late hain lekin unka iman ijmali taur par hota hai. Jaise sahih hadith mein hai ke jab tum se Ahl-e-Kitab koi baat karein toh tum na use sach kaho na jhoot balkeh keh diya karo ke hum toh jo kuch hum par utra use bhi mante hain aur jo kuch tum par utra us par bhi iman rakhte hain. Baaz mauqe par aisa bhi hota hai ke jo log Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par iman late hain unka iman ba-nisbat Ahl-e-Kitab ke zyada poora, zyada kamaal wala, zyada rasikh aur zyada mazboot hota hai. Is haisiyat se mumkin hai ke unhein Ahl-e-Kitab se bhi zyada ajar mile, chahe woh apne paighambar aur Paighambar-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par iman lane ke sabab dohra ajar payein lekin yeh log kamaal-e-iman ke sabab ajar mein un se bhi barh jayein. Wallahu A'lam.

Hidayat yafta log yani woh log jin ke ausaf pehle bayan hue maslan ghaib par iman lana, namaz qaim rakhna, Allah ke diye hue se dena. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jo utra us par iman lana, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se pehle jo kitabein utrin un ko manna, dar-e-akhirat par yaqeen rakh kar wahan kaam aane ke liye nek aamal karna. Buraiyon aur haram kariyon se bachna. Yehi log hidayat yafta hain jinhein Allah ki taraf se noor mila, aur bayan-o-baseerat hasil hua aur inhi logon ke liye duniya aur akhirat mein falah-o-najat hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne hidayat ki tafseer "noor" aur "istaqamat" se ki hai aur "falah" ki tafseer apni chahat ko pa lene aur buraiyon se bach jane ki hai. Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) farmate hain ke ye log apne Rab ki taraf se noor, daleel, sabit qadmi, sachai aur taufeeq mein haq par hain aur yehi log apne in pakeeza aamal ki wajah se najat, sawab aur daimi jannat pane ke mustahiq hain aur azab se mehfooz hain. Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) yeh bhi farmate hain ke dusre 'Ulaika' ka ishara Ahl-e-Kitab ki taraf hai jin ki sifat is se pehle bayan ho chuki hai jaise pehle guzar chuka. Is aitibar se ayat (Wallazeena yu'minoona bima unzila ilaika) ilakh pehle ki ayat se juda hoga aur mubtada ban kar marfoo hoga aur is ki khabar ayat (Ulaika humul muflihoon) hogi lekin pasandeeda qaul yehi hai ke is ka ishara pehle ke sab ausaf walon ki taraf hai Ahl-e-Kitab hon ya Arab hon. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) aur baaz sahaba se marwi hai ke ayat (Yu'minoona bil ghaib) se murad Arab imandar hain is ke baad ke jumla se murad Ahl-e-Kitab imandar hain. Phir dono ke liye yeh basharat hai ke ye log hidayat aur falah wale hain. Aur yeh pehle bayan ho chuka hai ke ye ayatein aam hain aur yeh ishara bhi aam hai wallahu a'lam. Mujahid (R.H), Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H), Rabee bin Anas (R.H), aur Qatadah (R.H) se yehi marwi hai. Ek martaba Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke Huzoor Quran-e-Pak ki baaz ayatein to hamein dhars deti hain aur umeed qaim kara deti hain aur baaz ayatein kamar tod deti hain aur qareeb hota hai ke hum na-umeed ho jayen. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya lo main tumhein jannati aur jahannami ki pehchan saaf saaf bata doon. Phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne 'Alif-Laam-Meem' se 'Muflihoon' tak parh kar farmaya ye to jannati hain. Sahaba ne khush ho kar farmaya "Alhamdulillah hamein umeed hai ke hum inhi mein se hon" phir ayat (Innal-lazeena kafaru) se 'Azeem' tak tilawat ki aur farmaya ye jahannami hain. Unhon ne kaha hum aise nahin, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim)

Bad-qismat log yani jo log haq ko posheeda karne ya chupa lene ke aadi hain aur unki qismat mein yahi hai ke unhein aap ka darana sood-mand hai aur na hi na darana. Yeh kabhi Allah Ta'ala ki us wahi ki tasdeeq nahin karenge jo aap par nazil hui hai. Jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (INNAL-LAZEENA HAQQAT 'ALAIHIM KALIMATU RABBIKA LA YU'MINOON. WA LAU JAA'ATHUM KULLU AAYATIN HATTA YARAWUL-'AZABAL-ALEEM) (Surah Yunus: 96-97) yani jin logon par Allah ki baat sabit ho chuki hai woh imaan na layenge agarche tamam aayatein dekh lein yahan tak ke dard-naak azab dekh lein. Aise hi sarkash Ahl-e-Kitab ki nisbat farmaya aayat (WA LA'IN ATAITAL-LAZEENA UUTUL-KITABA BIKULLI AAYATIM-MA TABI'U QIBLATAK) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 145) yani in Ahl-e-Kitab ke paas agarche tamam dalail le aao taham woh tumhare qibla ko nahin manenge. Yani in bad-naseebon ko sa'adat hasil hi nahin hogi. In gumrahon ko hidayat kahan? To aye Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in par afsos na kar, tera kaam sirf risalat ka haq ada kar dena aur pahuncha dena hai. Manne wale naseeb-war hain woh mala-maal ho jayenge aur agar koi na mane to na sahi. Tera farz ada ho gaya hum khud in se hisab le lenge. Tu sirf darane wala hai. Har cheez par Allah Ta'ala hi wakeel hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is baat ki badi hi hirs thi ke tamam log imaan-dar ho jayen aur hidayat qabool kar lein lekin Parwardigar ne farmaya ke yeh sa'adat har ek ke hisse nahin. Yeh ne'amat bat chuki hai jis ke hisse mein aayi hai woh aap ki mane ga aur jo bad-qismat hain woh hargiz hargiz ita'at ki taraf nahin jhukenge. Pas matlab yeh hai ke jo Quran ko tasleem nahin karte aur kehte hain ke hum agli kitabon ko mante hain unhein darane ka koi faida nahin. Is liye ke woh to khud apni kitab ko bhi haqeeqatan nahin mante kyunke is mein tere manne ka ahd majood hai to jab woh is kitab ko aur is Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki naseehat ko nahin mante jis ke manne ka iqrar kar chuke to bhala woh tumhari baton ko kya manenge? Abu Al-Aliyah ka qaul hai ke yeh aayat Jang-e-Ahzab ke un sardaron ke bare mein utri hai jin ki nisbat farman-e-Bari hai aayat (ALAM TARA ILAL-LAZEENA BADDALU NI'MATALLAHI KUFRAW-WA AHALLU QAWAHUM DARAL-BAWAR) (Surah Ibrahim: 28) lekin jo ma'ani hum ne pehle bayan kiye hain woh zyada wazeh hain aur dusri aayaton ke mutabiq hain. Wallahu A'lam. Is hadees par jo Ibn Abi Hatim ke hawale se abhi bayan hui hai dobara nazar daal jaiye. La yu'minoon pehle jumla ki takeed hai yani darana na darana dono barabar hain, dono halaton mein un ka kufr na tootega. Yeh bhi mumkin hai ke la yu'minoon khabar ho is liye ke taqdeer-e-kalam aayat (Innal-lazeena kafaroo la yu'minoon) hai aur aayat (Sawa'un 'alaihim) jumla-e-mu'tariza ho jayega. Wallahu A'lam.

Mohar kyun laga di gayi? Hazrat Suddi farmate hain khatm se murad tab'a hai yani mohar laga di. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain yani un par Shaitan ghalib aa gaya, woh usi ki mat-huti mein lag gaye yahan tak ke mohar-e-Ilahi un ke dilon par aur un ke kanon par lag gayi aur ankhon par parda pad gaya. Hidayat ko na dekh sakte hain, na sun sakte hain, na samajh sakte hain. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain ke gunah logon ke dilon mein baste jate hain aur unhein har taraf se gher lete hain. Bas yahi tab'a aur khatm yani mohar hai. Dil aur kan ke liye muhawaray mein mohar aati hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain Quran mein 'ran' ka lafz hai, 'tab'a' ka lafz hai aur 'aqfal' ka lafz hai. 'Ran' tab'a se kam hai aur tab'a aqfal se kam hai, aqfal sab se zyada hai. Hazrat Mujahid ne apna hath dikha kar kaha ke dil hatheli ki tarah hai aur banday ke gunah ki wajah se woh simat jata hai aur band ho jata hai. Is tarah ke ek gunah kiya to goya chhangliya band ho gayi, phir dusra gunah kiya dusri ungli band ho gayi yahan tak ke tamam ungliyan band ho gayin aur ab mutthi bilkul band ho gayi jis mein koi cheez dakhil nahin ho sakti. Isi tarah gunahon se dil par parday pad jate hain, mohar lag jati hai, phir is par kisi tarah haq asar nahin karta. Isay 'zain' bhi kehte hain. Matlab yeh hua ke takabbur ki wajah se un ka haq se munh pher lena bayan kiya ja raha hai, jaise kaha jata hai ke falan shakhs is baat ke sunne se behra ban gaya. Matlab yeh hota hai ke takabbur aur be-parwahi kar ke us ne is baat ki taraf dhyan nahin diya. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain yeh matlab theek nahin is liye ke yahan to khud Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke us ne un ke dilon par mohar laga di. Zamakhshari ne is ki tardeed ki hai aur panch taweelein ki hain lekin sab ki sab bilkul be-ma'ni aur fazool hain aur sirf apne Mu'tazili hone ki wajah se usay yeh takallufat karne pade hain kyunke us ke nazdeek yeh baat bahut buri hai ke kisi ke dil par Allah Quddus mohar laga de, lekin afsos us ne dusri saaf aur sarih ayaton par gaur nahin kiya. Ek jagah irshad hai: (Falam-ma zaghu azaghallahu qulubuhum, wallahu la yahdil qawmal fasiqin) (Surah As-Saff: 5) yani jab woh tedhay ho gaye to Allah ne un ke dil tedhay kar diye aur farmaya: (Wa nuqallibu af'idatahum wa absarahum kama lam yu'minu bihi awwala marratin wa nadaruhum fi tughyanihim ya'mahun) (Surah Al-An'am: 110) hum un ke dilon ko aur un ki nigahon ko ulat dete hain goya ke woh saray se iman hi na laye thay aur hum unhein un ki sarkashi mein bhatakte hue hi chhod dete hain. Is qisam ki aur ayatein bhi hain. Jo saaf batati hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne un ke dilon par mohar laga di hai aur hidayat ko un se door kar diya hai. Haq ko tark karne aur batil par jamay rehne ki wajah se jo yeh sarasar adl-o-insaf hai aur adl achi cheez hai na ke buri.

Agar Zamakhshari bhi baghaur in aayat par nazar daalte toh taweel na karte. Wallahu A'lam. Qurtubi farmate hain, ummat ka ijma hai ke Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ne apni ek sifat mohar lagana bhi bayan ki hai jo kuffar ke kufr ke badle hai. Farmaya hai aayat (Bal taba'allahu 'alaiha bikufrihim fala yu'minuna illa qalila) (Surah An-Nisa: 155) balkeh unke kufr ki wajah se Allah ne un par mohar laga di. Hadith mein bhi hai ke Allah Ta'ala dilon ko ulat pulat karta hai. Dua mein hai hadith (Ya Muqallibal Qulubi thabbit qulubana 'ala deenik) yani ae dilon ke pherne wale hamare dilon ko apne deen par qaim rakh. Hazrat Huzaifa R.A wali hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya dilon par fitne is tarah pesh hote hain jaise toote hue bore ka ek ek tinka, jo dil unhein qabool kar leta hai us mein ek siyah nukta ho jata hai aur jis dil mein ye fitne asar nahin karte, us mein ek safed nukta ho jata hai jis ki safedi barhte barhte bilkul saaf safed ho kar saare dil ko munawwar kar deti hai. Phir use kabhi koi fitna nuqsan nahin pahuncha sakta, isi tarah dusre dil ki siyahi (jo haq qabool nahin karta) phailti jati hai yahan tak ke sara dil siyah ho jata hai. Ab woh ulte koze ki tarah ho jata hai. Na achi baat use achi lagti hai na burai buri maloom hoti hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ka faisla wahi hai jo hadith mein aa chuka hai ke momin jab gunah karta hai uske dil mein ek siyah nukta ho jata hai agar woh baaz aa jaye tauba kar le aur ruk jaye toh woh nukta mit jata hai aur uska dil saaf ho jata hai aur agar woh gunah mein barh jaye toh woh siyahi bhi phailti jati hai yahan tak ke saare dil par chha jati hai, yahi woh 'Raan' hai jiska zikr is aayat mein hai aayat (Kalla bal rana 'ala qulubihim ma kanu yaksibun) (Surah Al-Mutaffifin: 14) yani yaqeenan unke dilon par raan hai, unki bad-a'maliyon ki wajah se (Tirmidhi, Nasai, Ibn-e-Jarir). Imam Tirmidhi R.H ne is hadith ko Hasan Sahih kaha hai toh maloom hua ke gunahon ki ziyadati dilon par ghilaf daal deti hai aur uske baad mohar-e-Ilahi lag jati hai jise khatm aur tab'a kaha jata hai. Ab is dil mein iman ke jaane aur kufr ke nikalne ki koi raah baqi nahin rehti. Isi mohar ka zikr is aayat (Khatamallahu) al-kh mein hai, woh hamari aankhon dekhi haqeeqat hai ke jab kisi cheez ka munh band kar ke us par mohar laga di jaye toh jab tak woh mohar na toote na us mein kuch ja sakta hai na us se koi cheez nikal sakti hai. Isi tarah jin kuffar ke dilon aur kanon par mohar-e-Ilahi lag chuki hai un mein bhi baghair uske hate aur toote na hidayat aaye, na kufr jaye. Sam'ihim par poora waqf hai aur aayat (Ala absarihim ghishawah) alag poora jumla hai. Khatm aur tab'a dilon aur kanon par hoti hai aur ghishawat yani parda aankhon par parta hai. Jaise ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud aur dusre Sahaba R.A se marwi hai.

Quran mein hai aayat (Fa-in yasha-illahu yakhtim 'ala qalbika, wa yam-hullahu-l-batila wa yuhiqqu-l-haqqa bi-kalimatihi) (Surah Ash-Shura: 24) aur jagah hai aayat (Wa khatama 'ala sam'ihi wa qalbihi wa ja'ala 'ala basarihi ghishawatan). In aayaton mein dil aur kaan par khatm ka zikr hai aur aankh par parde ka. Ba'az ne yahan ghishawatan zabar ke saath bhi padha hai, toh mumkin hai ke unke nazdeek fe'l ja'ala maqsood ho aur mumkin hai ke nasb mahall ki itteba se ho, jaise aayat (Wa hurun 'een) mein. Shuru surat ki chaar aayaton mein momineen ke ausaf bayan hue, phir in do aayaton mein kuffar ka haal bayan hua. Ab munafiqon ka zikr hota hai jo bazahir imandar bante hain lekin haqeeqat mein kafir hain. Chunki in logon ki chalakiyan umooman posheeda reh jati hain, is liye inka bayan zara tafseel se kiya gaya aur bahut kuch inki nishaniyan bayan ki gayin. Inhi ke bare mein Surah Bara'at utri aur inhi ka zikr Surah Noor waghera mein kiya gaya taake inse poora bachao ho aur inki mazmoom khaslaton se musalman door rahein. Pas farmaya.

Munafiqat ki qismein. Darasal nifaq kehte hain bhalai zahir karne aur burai posheeda rakhne ko. Nifaq ki do qismein hain: etiqadi aur amali. Pehli qism ke munafiq toh abadi jahannami hain aur dusri qism ke badtareen mujrim hain. Is ka bayan tafseel ke sath Insha'Allah kisi munasib jagah hoga. Imam Ibn-e-Jurayj farmate hain, "Munafiq ka qaul us ke fe'l ke khilaf, us ka batin zahir ke khilaf, us ka aana jaane ke khilaf aur us ki maujoodgi adam-e-maujoodgi hua karti hai." Nifaq Makkah Shareef mein toh tha hi nahin balkay is ke ulat tha, yani ba'az log aise thay jo zabardasti ba-zahir kafiron ka sath dete thay magar dil mein musalman hote thay. Jab An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hijrat kar ke Makkah chhor kar Madina tashreef laye aur yahan par Aus aur Khazraj ke qabail ne Ansar ban kar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka sath diya aur jahiliyat ke zamana ki mushrikana but-parasti tark kar di aur dono qabilo mein se khush-naseeb log musharraf-ba-Islam ho gaye lekin Yahudi ab tak Allah Ta'ala ki is ne'mat se mehroom thay. Un mein se sirf Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A) ne is sachay deen ko qabool kiya, tab tak bhi munafiqon ka khabeeth garoh qaim na hua tha aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un Yahudiyon aur Arab ke ba'az qabail se sulah kar li thi. Garz is jama'at ke qayam ki ibtida yun hui ke Madina Shareef ke Yahudiyon ke teen qabilay thay: Banu Qainuqa, Banu Nazeer aur Banu Quraiza. Banu Qainuqa toh Khazraj ke haleef aur bhai-band bane hue thay aur baqi do qabilo ka bhai-chara Aus se tha. Jab Jang-e-Badr hui aur is mein Parwardigar ne apne deen walon ko ghalib kiya, shaukat-o-shan-e-Islam zahir hui, musalmanon ka sikka jam gaya aur kufr ka zor toot gaya, tab yeh napak garoh qaim hua. Chunancha Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool tha toh Khazraj ke qabilay se lekin Aus aur Khazraj dono usay apna bara maante thay, balkay us ki baqaida sardari aur badshahat ke elaan ka pukhta irada kar chuke thay ke in dono qabilo ka rukh Islam ki taraf phir gaya aur us ki sardari yunhi reh gayi. Yeh khaar toh us ke dil mein tha hi, Islam ki roz-afzoon taraqqi mein larai aur kamyabi ne usay makhboot-ul-hawas bana diya. Ab us ne dekha ke yun kaam nahin chalay ga, us ne ba-zahir Islam qabool kar lene aur batin mein kafir rehne ki thani aur jis qadar jama'at us ke zer-e-asar thi sab ko yahi hidayat ki, is tarah munafiqeen ki aik jam'iyat Madina ke aas-paas qaim ho gayi. In munafiqeen mein bi-hamdillah Makki Muhajir aik bhi na tha balkay yeh buzurg toh apne ahl-o-ayal, maal-o-mata' ko naam-e-haq par qurban kar ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka sath de kar aaye thay (Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een). Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain, "Yeh munafiq Aus aur Khazraj ke qabilo mein se thay aur Yahudi bhi jo un ke tareeqay par thay." Qabila Aus aur Khazraj ke nifaq ka in aayaton mein bayan hai. Abul Aliyah, Hazrat Hasan, Qatadah, Suddi ne yahi bayan kiya hai. Parwardigar-e-Aalam ne munafiqon ki bohat si bad-khaslaton ka yahan bayan farmaya.

Taake un ke zahir-e-haal se Musalman dhoka mein na aa jayen aur unhein Musalman khayal kar ke apna na samajh baithain. Jis ki wajah se koi bada fasad phail jaye. Yeh yaad rahe ke badkaron ko nek samajhna bhi bajaye khud bahut bura aur nihayat khaufnak amr hai jis tarah is ayat mein farmaya gaya hai ke yeh log zabani iqrar to zaroor karte hain magar un ke dil mein iman nahin hota. Isi tarah Surah Munafiqun mein bhi kaha gaya hai ke ayat (اِذَا جَاۗءَكَ الْمُنٰفِقُوْنَ قَالُوْا نَشْهَدُ اِنَّكَ لَرَسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ ۘ وَاللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ اِنَّكَ لَرَسُوْلُهٗ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ يَشْهَدُ اِنَّ الْمُنٰفِقِيْنَ لَكٰذِبُوْنَ) (63۔ Al-Munafiqun: 1) yani munafiq tere paas aa kar kehte hain ke hamari gawahi hai ke aap Rasool-e-Allah hain aur Allah Ta'ala jaanta hai ke tu us ka Rasool hai lekin chunke haqeeqat mein munafiqon ka qaul un ke aqeeday ke mutabiq na tha is liye un logon ke shandaar aur takeedi alfaaz ke bawajood Allah Ta'ala ne unhein jhutla diya. Aur Surah Munafiqun mein farmaya ayat (وَاللّٰهُ يَشْهَدُ اِنَّ الْمُنٰفِقِيْنَ لَكٰذِبُوْنَ) (63۔ Al-Munafiqun: 1) yani Allah Ta'ala gawahi deta hai ke bil-yaqeen munafiq jhootay hain aur yahan bhi farmaya ayat (وَمَا هُمْ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ) yani darasal woh imandar nahin woh apne iman ko zahir kar ke aur apne kufr ko chhupa kar apni jahalat se Allah Ta'ala ko dhoka dete hain aur usay nafa dene wali aur Allah ke haan chal jaane wali karigari khayal karte hain. Jaise ke ba'az mominon par un ka yeh makr chal jaata hai. Quran mein aur jagah hai ayat (يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللّٰهُ جَمِيْعًا فَيَحْلِفُوْنَ لَهٗ كَمَا يَحْلِفُوْنَ لَكُمْ وَيَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّهُمْ عَلٰي شَيْءٍ ۭ اَلَآ اِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْكٰذِبُوْنَ) (58۔ Al-Mujadila: 18) yani Qayamat ke din jabke Allah Ta'ala un sab ko khada kare ga to jis tarah woh yahan iman walon ke saamne qasmein khaate hain. Allah Ta'ala ke saamne bhi qasmein khayenge aur samajhte hain ke woh bhi kuch hain. Khabardar yaqeenan woh jhootay hain. Yahan bhi un ke is ghalat aqeeday ki wazahat mein farmaya ke darasal woh apne is kaam ki burai ko jaante hi nahin. Yeh dhoka khud apni jaanon ko de rahe hain. Jaise ke aur jagah irshad hua ayat (اِنَّ الْمُنٰفِقِيْنَ يُخٰدِعُوْنَ اللّٰهَ وَھُوَ خَادِعُھُمْ) (4۔ An-Nisa: 142) yani munafiq Allah ko dhoka dete hain halankeh woh unhein ko dhoka mein rakhne wala hai. Ba'az qariyon ne yakhda'oona padha hai aur ba'az yukhadi'oona magar dono qiraton ke ma'ani ka matlab ek hi hota hai.

Ibn-e-Jarir ne kaha ke Allah Ta'ala ko aur imaan walon ko munafiq dhoka kaise denge? Woh jo apne dil ke khilaf izhar karte hain woh toh sirf bachao ke liye hota hai toh jawaban kaha jayega ke is tarah ki baat karne wale ko bhi jo kisi khatra se bachna chahta hai Arabi zaban mein mukhaday kaha jata hai. Chunke munafiq bhi qatl, qaid aur dunyawi azabon se mehfooz rehne ke liye yeh chaal chalte the aur apne batin ke khilaf izhar karte the is liye unhein dhoka baz kaha gaya. Kyunke woh isi mein apni bhalai aur kamyabi jante hain aur darasal yeh sab unke liye intehai bura azab aur ghazab-e-Ilahi hoga jiske sehne ki un mein taqat nahin hogi, pas yeh dhoka haqiqatan un par khud wabaal hoga. Woh jis kaam ke anjam ko achha jante hain woh unke haq mein bura aur bahut bura hoga. Unke kufr, shak aur takzeeb ki wajah se unka Rab unse naraz hoga lekin afsos unhein iska shaoor hi nahin aur yeh apne andhe pan mein hi mast hain. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain munafiqon ki yahi halat hai ke zaban par kuch, dil mein kuch, amal kuch, aqeeda kuch, subh kuch aur sham kuch, kashti ki tarah jo hawa ke jhonke se kabhi idhar ho jati hai kabhi udhar.

Shak-o-shuba bimari hai. Bimari se murad yahan shak-o-shuba hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A aur chand sahaba se yahi marwi hai. Hazrat Mujahid, Ikrama, Hasan Basri, Abul Aliyah, Rabee bin Anas, Qatada ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Hazrat Ikrama aur Tawoos ne is ki tafsir se riya aur Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se is ki tafsir nifaq bhi marwi hai. Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain yahan deeni bimari murad hai na ke jismani. Unhein Islam mein shak ki bimari thi aur un ki napaki mein Allah Ta'ala ne aur izafa kardiya. Jaise Quran mein is ka zikr ek aur jagah Allah Ta'ala hai. Ayat (Fa-ammallazina amanu fazadathum imananw-wa hum yastabshirun. Wa ammallazina fi qulubihim maradun fazadathum rijsan ila rijsihim wa matu wa hum kafirun) (Surah At-Tawbah: 124-125) yani iman walon ke iman ko taqwiyat pahunchati aur woh khushiyan manate hain lekin bimari walon ki napaki aur paleedi ko aur zyada kardeti hai yani us ki abadi aur gumrahi barh jati hai, yeh badla bilkul un ke amal ke mutabiq hai. Yeh tafsir hi durust hai, theek isi ke misl yeh farman bhi hai Ayat (Wallazina-htadaw zadahum hudanw-wa atahum taqwahum) (Surah Muhammad: 17) yani hidayat walon ko hidayat mein barha deta hai aur un ko taqwa ata farmata hai. Ayat (Yukazzibuna ko Yakzibuna) bhi qariyon ne parha hai yeh dono khaslatein un mein thin jhutlate bhi the aur jhoote bhi the. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ba'az munafiqon ko achi tarah janne ke bawajood bhi qatl na karne ki wajah wahi hai jo Bukhari-o-Muslim ki riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Umar R.A se farmaya main is baat ko napasand karta hoon ke logon mein yeh charche hon ke Muhammad Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne sathiyon ko qatl kardete hain, matlab yeh hai ke jo a'arabi aas paas hain unhein yeh to maloom na hoga ke in munafiqon ke posheeda kufr ki bina par unhein qatl kiya gaya hai un ki nazrein to sirf zahirdari par hongi jab un mein yeh baat mashhoor hojayegi ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne sathiyon ko qatl kardete hain to khauf hai ke kahin woh Islam ke qabool karne se ruk na jayen. Qurtubi farmate hain hamare ulama waghera ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Theek isi tarah An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Ayat (Muallafatul Quloob) ko jin ke dil Islam ki janib mail kiye jate the, maal ata farmaya karte the halankeh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jante the ke un ke etiqad bad hain. Hazrat Imam Malik R.H bhi munafiqon ko qatl na karne ki yahi wajah bayan farmate hain jaise Muhammad bin Jahm, Qazi Ismail aur Abhari ne naqal kiya hai. Hazrat Imam Malik R.H se ba-qaul Ibn-e-Majishoon ek wajah yeh bhi naqal ki gayi hai ke yeh is liye tha ke Aap ki ummat ko maloom hojaye ke hakim sirf apne ilm ki bina par faisla nahin karsakta. Qurtubi farmate hain go ulama ka tamam masail mein ikhtilaf ho lekin is masla mein sab ka ittefaq hai ke qazi sirf apni zati maloomat ki bina par kisi ko qatl nahin karsakta. Hazrat Imam Shafi'i R.H ne ek aur wajah bhi bayan ki hai.

Aap farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka munafiqeen ko qatl karne se rukne ka sabab un ka apni zaban se Islam ko zahir karna tha, go Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is ka ilm tha ke un ke dil is ke ulat hain lekin zahiri kalma is pehli baat ki tardeed karta tha jis ki ta'eed mein Bukhari, Muslim waghera ki yeh hadith bhi pesh ki ja sakti hai jis mein kaha gaya hai ke mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main logon se ladun yahan tak ke woh La ilaha illallah kahein, jab woh ise keh dein to woh mujh se apni jaan aur maal ki amaan pa lenge aur un ka hisab Allah Azza-wa-Jal par hai. Matlab yeh hai ke is kalma-e-shareef ke kehte hi zahiri ahkaam-e-Islam un par jari ho jayenge. Ab agar un ka aqeeda bhi is ke mutabiq hai to aakhirat wale din najaat ka sabab hoga warna wahan kuch bhi nafa na hoga lekin duniya mein to musalmanon ke ahkaam un par jari rahenge, go yeh log yahan musalmanon ki safon mein aur un ki fehrist mein nazar aayenge lekin aakhirat mein ain Pul-e-Sirat par un se door kar diye jayenge aur andheron mein hairan-o-pareshan hote hue ba-awaz-e-buland musalmanon ko pukar kar kahenge ke kya hum tumhare sath na thay? Lekin unhein jawab milega ke thay to sahi magar tum fitnon mein pad gaye aur intezar mein hi reh gaye aur apni man-mani khwahishon ke chakkar mein pad gaye yahan tak ke hukum-e-Ilahi aa pohancha. Garz daar-e-aakhirat mein bhi musalmanon ke peeche pade lipte rahenge lekin bil-aakhir un se alag kar diye jayenge aur un ki ummeedon par pani phir jayega, woh chahenge ke musalmanon ke sath sajde mein gir padein lekin sajda nahin kar sakenge, jaise ke ahadees mein mufassal bayan aa chuka hai. Ba'az muhaqqiqeen ne kaha hai ke un ke qatl na kiye jaane ki yeh wajah thi ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maujoodgi mein un ki shararatein chal nahin sakti thin. Musalmanon ko Bari Ta'ala apni wahi ke zariye un ki buraiyon se mehfooz kar leta tha lekin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad agar Allah na kare aise log honge un ka nifaq khul jaye aur musalman bakhoobi maloom kar lein to woh qatl kar diye jayenge. Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) ka fatwa hai ke nifaq Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein tha lekin aaj kal woh bedini aur zindiqiyat hai. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke zindiq jo logon ko bhi is ki taleem deta ho aur woh zindiq jo muallim na ho un donon mein farq kiya jayega ya nahin? Aur yeh irtidad kayi kayi martaba hua tab yeh hukum hai ya sirf ek martaba hone par hi? Phir is mein bhi ikhtilaf hai ke Islam lana aur ruju karna khud us ki apni taraf se ho ya us par ghalba pa lene ke baad bhi yahi hukum hai? Garz in baton mein ikhtilaf hai lekin is ke bayan ki jagah ahkaam ki kitabein hain na ke tafseerein.

Chaudah shakhson ke nifaq ka toh Aap ﷺ ko qat'i ilm tha, yeh woh bad-batin log thay jinhon ne Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein mashwara kar ke yeh amr-e-tay kar liya tha ke Huzoor ﷺ ke sath daghabazi karein aur Aap ﷺ ke qatl ki poori sazish kar chuke thay. Tay hua tha ke raat ke andhere mein jab Huzoor ﷺ fulan ghati ke qareeb pahunchein toh Aap ﷺ ki oontni ko badka dein aur bhadak kar bhagegi toh Huzoor ﷺ ghati mein gir padenge. Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ki taraf usi waqt wahi bhej kar in ki is napak sazish ka ilm ata kar diya. Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Huzaifa R.A ko bula kar is waqia ki khabar di aur in ghaddaron ke naam bhi batla diye, phir bhi Aap ﷺ ne in ke qatl ke ahkam sadir na farmaye. In ke siwa aur munafiqon ke namon ka Aap ﷺ ko ilm na tha. Chunancha Quran kehta hai ayat: (Wa mimman haulakum minal-a'rabi munafiqun, wa min ahlil-madinati maraddu alan-nifaqi, la ta'lamuhum, nahnu na'lamuhum, sanu'azzibuhum marrataini thumma yuradduna ila azabin azim) (Surah At-Tawbah: 101). Yani tumhare aas paas ke ba'az a'rabi munafiq hain aur ba'az sarkash munafiq Madina mein bhi hain, tum unhein nahin jante lekin hum jante hain. Aur dusri jagah farmaya ayat: (La'il-lam yantahil-munafiquna wallazina fi qulubihim maradun wal-murjifuna fil-madinati lanughriyannaka bihim thumma la yujawirunaka fiha illa qalila) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 60). Agarche munafiq gande dil wale aur fasad-o-takabbur wale apni shararton se baaz na aaye toh hum bhi unhein na chhodenge aur Madina mein bahut kam baqi reh sakenge, balkeh un par la'nat ki jayegi, jahan paye jayenge, pakde jayenge aur tukde tukde kar diye jayenge. In ayaton se maloom hua ke Huzoor ﷺ ko in munafiqon ka ilm na tha ke kaun kaun hai? Haan in ki mazmoom khaslatain jo bayan hui thin, yeh jis mein payi jati thin us par nifaq sadiq aata tha. Jaise aur jagah irshad farmaya ayat: (Wa lau nasha'u la-araynakahum fala'araftahum bisimahum) (Surah Muhammad: 30). Yani agar hum chahein toh hum tumhein un ko dikha dein lekin tum un ki nishaniyon aur un ki dabi bachi zaban se hi unhein pehchan loge. In munafiqon mein sab se zyada mashhoor Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool tha. Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.A ne is ki munafiqana khaslaton par Huzoor ﷺ ke samne gawahi bhi di thi, bawajood is ke jab woh mar gaya toh Huzoor ﷺ ne is ke janaze ki namaz padhayi aur is ke dafn mein shirkat ki. Theek isi tarah aur musalman sahabiyon ke sath, balkeh Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne jab Huzoor ﷺ ko zara zor se yaad dilaya toh Aap ﷺ ne farmaya main nahin chahta ke log che-migoiyaan karein ke Muhammad ﷺ apne sahabiyon ko maar dala karte hain. Aur ek sahih riwayat mein hai istighfar karne ya na karne ka mujhe ikhtiyar diya gaya, toh main ne istighfar ko pasand kiya.

Ek aur riwayat mein hai "Agar sattar martaba se zyada istighfar karne mein bhi uski bakhshish jaanta toh yaqeenan us se zyada martaba istighfar karta."

Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) aur Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ba'az aur Sahaba (R.A) se marvi hai ke yeh bayan bhi munafiqon se hi mutaliq hai. Un ka fasad, kufr aur Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani thi. Matlab yeh hai ke zameen mein Allah ki nafarmani karna ya nafarmani ka hukum dena zameen mein fasad karna hai aur zameen-o-aasman mein islah se murad Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke unhein jab Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani se roka jata hai to kehte hain ke hum to hidayat-o-islah par hain. Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) farmate hain is khaslat ke log ab tak nahin aaye. Matlab yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein yeh bad-khaslat log thay to sahi lekin ab jo aayenge woh un se bhi badtar honge. Yeh na samajhna chahiye ke woh yeh kehte hain ke is wasf ka koi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein tha hi nahin. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain in munafiqon ka fasad barpa karna yeh tha ke Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmaniyan karte thay, jis kaam se Allah Ta'ala mana farmata tha, use karte thay. Faraiz-e-Rabbani zaya karte thay. Allah Ta'ala ke sachay deen mein shak-o-shuba karte thay. Is ki haqeeqat aur sadaqat par yaqeen-e-kamil nahin rakhte thay. Mominon ke paas aa kar apni imandari ki deengein maarte thay halankeh dilon mein tarah tarah ke waswasay hote thay. Mauqa pa kar Allah ke dushmanon ki imdad-o-i'anat karte thay aur Allah ke nek bandon ke muqabla mein un ki pasdari karte thay aur bawajood is makkari aur mufsidana chalan ke apne aap ko musleh aur sulh-e-kul ke hami jante thay. Quran-e-Kareem ne kuffar se muwalat aur dosti rakhne ko bhi zameen mein fasad hone se ta'beer kiya hai. Irshad hota hai aayat (وَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلِيَاۗءُ بَعْضٍ ۭاِلَّا تَفْعَلُوْهُ تَكُنْ فِتْنَةٌ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيْرٌ) (Surah Al-Anfal: 73) yani kuffar aapas mein ek dusre ke dost hain agar tum aisa na karoge yani aapas mein dosti na karoge to is zameen mein bhari fitna aur bada fasad phail jayega. Is aayat ne musalman aur kuffar ke dostana ta'alluqat munqata kar diye aur jagah farmaya ae iman walo! Mominon ko chhod kar kafiron ko dost na banao, kya tum chahte ho ke Allah Ta'ala ki tum par khuli hujjat ho jaye yani tumhari daleel-e-najat kat jaye. Phir farmaya munafiq log to jahannam ke nichle tabqe mein honge aur hargiz tum un ke liye koi madadgar na paoge. Chunkeh munafiqon ka zahir achha hota hai, is liye musalmanon se haqeeqat posheeda reh jati hai. Woh imandaron ko apni chikni chupri baton se dhoka de dete hain aur un ke be-haqeeqat kalmaat aur kuffar se posheeda dosti se musalmanon ko khatarnak masaib jhelne padte hain, pas bani-e-fasad yeh munafiqeen huye.

Agar yeh apne kufr par hi rehte toh in ki khaufnak sazishon aur gehri chalon se musalmanon ko itna nuqsan hargiz na pahunchta aur agar poore musalman ho jate aur zahir batin yaksan kar lete tab toh duniya ke aman-o-aman ke sath aakhirat ki nijat-o-falah bhi pa lete. Bawajood is khatarnak policy ke jab unhein yaksooi ki nasihat ki jati toh jhat keh uthte ke hum toh sulh-e-kul hain, hum kisi se bigadna nahin chahte, hum fareeqain ke sath ittefaq rakhte hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke woh kehte the "Hum in dono jamaton yani mominon aur Ahl-e-Kitab ke darmiyan sulh karane wale hain." Lekin Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke yeh in ki niri jahalat hai, jise yeh sulh samajhte hain woh ain fasad hai lekin unhein shaoor hi nahin.
