Khud-farebi ke shikar log. Matlab yeh hai ke jab in munafiqon ko Sahaba ki tarah Allah Ta'ala par, uske farishton, kitabon aur Rasoolon (ﷺ) par iman lane, maut ke baad jee uthne, jannat dozakh ki haqaniyat ke tasleem karne, Allah aur Rasool (ﷺ) ki tabedari kar ke nek aamal baja lane aur buraiyon se ruke rehne ko kaha jata hai to yeh firqa aise iman walon ko bewaqoof qarar deta hai. Ibn Abbas, Ibn Masood aur baaz deegar Sahaba, Rabee, Anas, Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam waghera ne yahi tafsir bayan ki hai. Sufaha, Safih ki jama hai jaise Hukama, Hakim ki aur Hulama, Halim ki. Jahil, kam-aql aur nafa-nuqsan ke poori tarah na janne wale ko Safih kehte hain. Quran mein aur jagah hai ayat: (Wala tu'tus-sufaha'a amwalakumullati ja'alallahu lakum qiyaman warzuquhum fiha waksuhum wa qulu lahum qawlan ma'rufa) (Surah An-Nisa: 5). Bewaqoofon ko apne woh maal na de baitho jo tumhare qayam ka sabab hain. Aam mufassireen ka qaul hai ke is ayat mein sufaha se murad auratein aur bachche hain. In munafiqeen ke jawab mein yahan bhi khud Parwardigar-e-Alam ne jawab diya aur takeedan hasr ke sath farmaya ke bewaqoof to yahi hain lekin sath hi jahil bhi aise hain ke apni bewaqoofi ko jaan bhi nahin sakte. Na apni jahalat-o-zalalat ko samajh sakte hain, is se zyada inki burai aur kamal andha-pan aur hidayat se doori aur kya hogi?

Fareb zada log matlab yeh hai ke yeh bad-batin musalmanon ke paas aa kar apni iman dosti aur khair-khwahi zahir kar ke unhein dhoke mein dalna chahte hain taake maal-o-jaan ka bachao bhi ho jaye, bhalai aur ghanimat ke maal mein hissa bhi qaim ho jaye. Aur jab apne ham-mashrabon mein hote hain to un hi ki si kehne lagte hain. Khalau ke ma'ani yahan hain insarafu, izhabu, khalasu aur mazu yani laut-te hain aur pahunchte hain aur tanhai mein hote hain. Aur jate hain pas khalau jo ke ila ke sath muta'addi hai us ke ma'ani laut jane ke hain. Fe'l muzmar aur malfooz dono par yeh dalalat karta hai. Ba'az kehte hain ila ma'ani mein ma'a ke mutaradif hai magar awwal hi theek hai, Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ke kalam ka khulasa bhi yeh hai ke shayateen se murad ru'asa bade aur sardar hain jaise Yahood ulama aur sardaran-e-kuffar-e-Quraish-o-munafiqeen. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A aur Ibn-e-Mas'ood R.A aur deegar sahaba ka qaul hai ke yeh shayateen un ke ameer umara aur sardaran-e-kufr the aur un ke ham-aqeeda log bhi. Shayateen-e-Yahood bhi unhein paighambari ke jhutlane aur Quran ki takzeeb karne ka mashwara diya karte the. Mujahid R.H kehte hain shayateen se murad un ke woh sathi hain jo ya to mushrik the ya munafiq. Qatada R.H farmate hain, is se murad woh log hain jo buraiyon mein aur shirk mein un ke sardar the. Abu Al-Aliya R.H, Suddi R.H, Rabee bin Anas R.H bhi yahi tafseer karte hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain "Har behkane aur sarkashi karne wale ko shaitan kehte hain, jinnon mein se ho ya insanon mein se." Quran mein bhi ayat (Shayateen-ul-Insi wal-Jinn) aaya hai. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke "Hum jinnon aur insanon ke shayateen se Allah Ta'ala ki panah mangte hain." Abu Zar R.A ne poocha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya insan ke shaitan bhi hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan. Jab yeh munafiq musalman se milte to kehte hain "Hum tumhare sath hain" yani jaise tum ho waise hi hum hain. Aur apnon se kehte hain ke hum to in ke sath hansi khel karte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A, Rabee bin Anas R.H aur Qatada R.H ki yahi tafseer hai. Allah Ta'ala un ko jawab dete hue un ke is makrooh fe'l ke muqable mein farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala bhi un se thutha karega aur unhein un ki sarkashi mein behkne dega jaise dusri jagah hai, ke Qayamat ke roz munafiq mard-o-aurat iman walon se kahenge zara thehar jao hum bhi tumhare noor se faida uthayen. Kaha jayega apne peeche laut jao aur noor ki talash karo. Is ke laut-te hi darmiyan mein ek unchi deewar hail kar di jayegi jis mein darwaza hoga, is taraf to rahmat hogi aur dusri taraf azab hoga. Farman-e-Ilahi hai kafir hamari dheel ko apne haq mein behtar na janen. Is takheer mein woh apni bad-kirdariyon mein aur badh jate hain. Pas Quran mein jahan istihza, maskhariyat yani mazaq, makr, khade'at yani dhoka ke alfaz aaye hain wahan yahi murad hai. Ek aur jama'at kehti hai ke yeh alfaz sirf daant-dupat aur tanbeeh ke taur par istemal kiye gaye hain un ki bad-kirdariyon aur kufr-o-shirk par unhein malamat ki gayi hai.

Aur mufassireen kehte hain yeh alfaaz sirf jawab mein laye gaye hain jaise koi bhala aadmi kisi makkar ke fareb se bach kar us par ghalib aa kar kehta hai kaho main ne kaisa fareb diya halankeh us ki taraf se fareb nahin hota. Isi tarah yeh farman-e-Ilahi hai keh aayat (وَمَكَرُوْا وَمَكَرَ اللّٰهُ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ خَيْرُ الْمٰكِرِيْنَ) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 54) aur aayat (اَللّٰهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّھُمْ فِىْ طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَھُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 15) warna Allah ki zaat makr aur mazaq se pak hai matlab yeh hai keh un ka fan-e-fareb inhi ko barbad karta hai. In alfaaz ka yeh bhi matlab bayan kiya gaya hai keh Allah un ki hansi, dhoka, tamsukhur aur bhool ka un ko badla dega to badle mein bhi wahi alfaaz istemaal kiye gaye dono lafzon ke dono jagah ma'ani juda juda hain. Dekhiye Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (جَزَاۗءُ سَـيِّئَةٍۢ بِمِثْلِهَا) (Surah Yunus: 27) yani burai ka badla waisi hi burai hai aayat (فمن اعتدی علیکم فاعتدوا علیہ) jo tum par ziyadati kare tum bhi us par ziyadati karo to zahir hai keh burai ka badla lena haqeeqatan burai nahin. Ziyadati ke muqable mein badla lena ziyadati nahin. Lekin lafz dono jagah ek hi hai halankeh pehli burai aur ziyadati "zulm" hai aur dusri burai aur ziyadati "adl" hai lekin lafz dono jagah ek hi hai. Isi tarah jahan jahan Kalam-e-Allah mein aisi ibaratein hain wahan yahi matlab hai. Ek aur matlab bhi suniye duniya mein yeh munafiq apni is napak policy se musalmanon ke sath mazaq karte thay Allah ne bhi un ke sath yahi kiya keh duniya mein unhein aman-o-aman mil gaya aur yeh mast ho gaye halankeh yeh aarzi aman hai, Qayamat wale din unhein koi aman nahin milega go yahan un ke maal aur jaanein bach gayin lekin Allah ke han yeh dardnak azab ka shikar banenge. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne isi qaul ko tarjeeh di hai aur is ki bohat tayeed ki hai is liye keh makr, dhoka aur mazaq jo bila-wajah ho us se to Allah ki zaat pak hai han inteqam, muqable aur badle ke taur par yeh alfaaz Allah ki nisbat kehne mein koi harj nahin. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) bhi yahi farmate hain keh yeh un ka badla aur saza hai. Yumidduhum ka matlab dheel dena aur barhana bayan kiya gaya hai. Jaise farmaya aayat (اَيَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهٖ مِنْ مَّالٍ وَّبَنِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 55) yani kya yeh yun samajh baithe hain keh un ke maal aur aulad ki kasrat un ke liye ba'is-e-khair hai nahin! nahin! nahin! sahih shaoor hi nahin aur aayat (سَنَسْـتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 182) is tarah hum unhein ahista ahista pakrenge keh unhein pata bhi na chale gharz keh idhar yeh gunah karte hain idhar dunyawi ne'matein zyada hoti hain jin par yeh phule nahin samate halankeh woh haqeeqat mein azab hi ki ek surat hoti hai.

Quran-e-Pak ne aur jagah farmaya aayat (Falammanasu ma zukkiru bihi fatahna alaihim abwaba kulli shai'in hatta iza farihu bima utu akhaznahum baghtatan fa-iza hum mublisun. Faquti'a dabirul qaumillazina zalamu walhamdu lillahi rabbil alamin) (Surah Al-An'am: 44-45) yani jab logon ne nasihat bhula di hum ne un par tamam cheezon ke darwaze khol diye yahan tak ke woh apni cheezon par utrane lage to hum ne unhein achanak pakad liya, ab ghabra gaye, zalimon ki barbadi hui aur keh diya gaya ke tareefein Rabb-ul-Alamin ke liye hi hain. Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain ke unhein dheel dene aur unhein apni sarkashi aur baghawat mein badhne ke liye un ko mohlat di jati hai. Jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wanuqallibu af'idatahum wa-absarahum kama lam yu'minu bihi awwala marratin wanazaruhum fi tughyanihim ya'mahun) (Surah Al-An'am: 110). Tughyan kehte hain kisi cheez mein ghus jaane ko. Jaise farmaya aayat (Inna lamma taghal ma'u hamalnakum fil jariyati) (Surah Al-Haqqah: 11). Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain woh apne kufr mein gire jate hain. 'Ama kehte hain gumrahi ko. To is ka matlab yeh hua ke woh zalalat-o-kufr mein doob gaye aur is napaki ne unhein gher liya ab yeh isi daldal mein utarte jate hain, isi napaki mein phanse jate hain aur is se nijat ki tamam raahein un par band ho jati hain. Bhala aisi daldal mein jo ho aur phir andha behra aur bewaqoof ho woh kaise nijat pa sakta hai. Aankhon ke andhe pan ke liye Arabi mein "Ami" ka lafz aata hai aur dil ke andhape ke liye "Ama" ka lekin kabhi dil ke andhe pan ke liye bhi "Ami" ka lafz aata hai jaise Quran mein hai aayat (Wa lakin ta'mal qulubullati fissudur) (Surah Al-Hajj: 46).

Fareb zada log matlab yeh hai ke yeh bad-batin musalmanon ke paas aa kar apni iman dosti aur khair-khwahi zahir kar ke unhein dhoke mein dalna chahte hain taake maal-o-jaan ka bachao bhi ho jaye, bhalai aur ghanimat ke maal mein hissa bhi qaim ho jaye. Aur jab apne ham-mashrabon mein hote hain to un hi ki si kehne lagte hain. Khalau ke ma'ani yahan hain insarafu, izhabu, khalasu aur mazu yani laut-te hain aur pahunchte hain aur tanhai mein hote hain. Aur jate hain pas khalau jo ke ila ke sath muta'addi hai us ke ma'ani laut jane ke hain. Fe'l muzmar aur malfooz dono par yeh dalalat karta hai. Ba'az kehte hain ila ma'ani mein ma'a ke mutaradif hai magar awwal hi theek hai, Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ke kalam ka khulasa bhi yeh hai ke shayateen se murad ru'asa bade aur sardar hain jaise Yahood ulama aur sardaran-e-kuffar-e-Quraish-o-munafiqeen. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A aur Ibn-e-Mas'ood R.A aur deegar sahaba ka qaul hai ke yeh shayateen un ke ameer umara aur sardaran-e-kufr the aur un ke ham-aqeeda log bhi. Shayateen-e-Yahood bhi unhein paighambari ke jhutlane aur Quran ki takzeeb karne ka mashwara diya karte the. Mujahid R.H kehte hain shayateen se murad un ke woh sathi hain jo ya to mushrik the ya munafiq. Qatada R.H farmate hain, is se murad woh log hain jo buraiyon mein aur shirk mein un ke sardar the. Abu Al-Aliya R.H, Suddi R.H, Rabee bin Anas R.H bhi yahi tafseer karte hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain "Har behkane aur sarkashi karne wale ko shaitan kehte hain, jinnon mein se ho ya insanon mein se." Quran mein bhi ayat (Shayateen-ul-Insi wal-Jinn) aaya hai. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke "Hum jinnon aur insanon ke shayateen se Allah Ta'ala ki panah mangte hain." Abu Zar R.A ne poocha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya insan ke shaitan bhi hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan. Jab yeh munafiq musalman se milte to kehte hain "Hum tumhare sath hain" yani jaise tum ho waise hi hum hain. Aur apnon se kehte hain ke hum to in ke sath hansi khel karte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A, Rabee bin Anas R.H aur Qatada R.H ki yahi tafseer hai. Allah Ta'ala un ko jawab dete hue un ke is makrooh fe'l ke muqable mein farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala bhi un se thutha karega aur unhein un ki sarkashi mein behkne dega jaise dusri jagah hai, ke Qayamat ke roz munafiq mard-o-aurat iman walon se kahenge zara thehar jao hum bhi tumhare noor se faida uthayen. Kaha jayega apne peeche laut jao aur noor ki talash karo. Is ke laut-te hi darmiyan mein ek unchi deewar hail kar di jayegi jis mein darwaza hoga, is taraf to rahmat hogi aur dusri taraf azab hoga. Farman-e-Ilahi hai kafir hamari dheel ko apne haq mein behtar na janen. Is takheer mein woh apni bad-kirdariyon mein aur badh jate hain. Pas Quran mein jahan istihza, maskhariyat yani mazaq, makr, khade'at yani dhoka ke alfaz aaye hain wahan yahi murad hai. Ek aur jama'at kehti hai ke yeh alfaz sirf daant-dupat aur tanbeeh ke taur par istemal kiye gaye hain un ki bad-kirdariyon aur kufr-o-shirk par unhein malamat ki gayi hai.

Aur mufassireen kehte hain yeh alfaaz sirf jawab mein laye gaye hain jaise koi bhala aadmi kisi makkar ke fareb se bach kar us par ghalib aa kar kehta hai kaho main ne kaisa fareb diya halankeh us ki taraf se fareb nahin hota. Isi tarah yeh farman-e-Ilahi hai keh aayat (وَمَكَرُوْا وَمَكَرَ اللّٰهُ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ خَيْرُ الْمٰكِرِيْنَ) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 54) aur aayat (اَللّٰهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّھُمْ فِىْ طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَھُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 15) warna Allah ki zaat makr aur mazaq se pak hai matlab yeh hai keh un ka fan-e-fareb inhi ko barbad karta hai. In alfaaz ka yeh bhi matlab bayan kiya gaya hai keh Allah un ki hansi, dhoka, tamsukhur aur bhool ka un ko badla dega to badle mein bhi wahi alfaaz istemaal kiye gaye dono lafzon ke dono jagah ma'ani juda juda hain. Dekhiye Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (جَزَاۗءُ سَـيِّئَةٍۢ بِمِثْلِهَا) (Surah Yunus: 27) yani burai ka badla waisi hi burai hai aayat (فمن اعتدی علیکم فاعتدوا علیہ) jo tum par ziyadati kare tum bhi us par ziyadati karo to zahir hai keh burai ka badla lena haqeeqatan burai nahin. Ziyadati ke muqable mein badla lena ziyadati nahin. Lekin lafz dono jagah ek hi hai halankeh pehli burai aur ziyadati "zulm" hai aur dusri burai aur ziyadati "adl" hai lekin lafz dono jagah ek hi hai. Isi tarah jahan jahan Kalam-e-Allah mein aisi ibaratein hain wahan yahi matlab hai. Ek aur matlab bhi suniye duniya mein yeh munafiq apni is napak policy se musalmanon ke sath mazaq karte thay Allah ne bhi un ke sath yahi kiya keh duniya mein unhein aman-o-aman mil gaya aur yeh mast ho gaye halankeh yeh aarzi aman hai, Qayamat wale din unhein koi aman nahin milega go yahan un ke maal aur jaanein bach gayin lekin Allah ke han yeh dardnak azab ka shikar banenge. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne isi qaul ko tarjeeh di hai aur is ki bohat tayeed ki hai is liye keh makr, dhoka aur mazaq jo bila-wajah ho us se to Allah ki zaat pak hai han inteqam, muqable aur badle ke taur par yeh alfaaz Allah ki nisbat kehne mein koi harj nahin. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) bhi yahi farmate hain keh yeh un ka badla aur saza hai. Yumidduhum ka matlab dheel dena aur barhana bayan kiya gaya hai. Jaise farmaya aayat (اَيَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهٖ مِنْ مَّالٍ وَّبَنِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 55) yani kya yeh yun samajh baithe hain keh un ke maal aur aulad ki kasrat un ke liye ba'is-e-khair hai nahin! nahin! nahin! sahih shaoor hi nahin aur aayat (سَنَسْـتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 182) is tarah hum unhein ahista ahista pakrenge keh unhein pata bhi na chale gharz keh idhar yeh gunah karte hain idhar dunyawi ne'matein zyada hoti hain jin par yeh phule nahin samate halankeh woh haqeeqat mein azab hi ki ek surat hoti hai.

Quran-e-Pak ne aur jagah farmaya aayat (Falammanasu ma zukkiru bihi fatahna alaihim abwaba kulli shai'in hatta iza farihu bima utu akhaznahum baghtatan fa-iza hum mublisun. Faquti'a dabirul qaumillazina zalamu walhamdu lillahi rabbil alamin) (Surah Al-An'am: 44-45) yani jab logon ne nasihat bhula di hum ne un par tamam cheezon ke darwaze khol diye yahan tak ke woh apni cheezon par utrane lage to hum ne unhein achanak pakad liya, ab ghabra gaye, zalimon ki barbadi hui aur keh diya gaya ke tareefein Rabb-ul-Alamin ke liye hi hain. Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain ke unhein dheel dene aur unhein apni sarkashi aur baghawat mein badhne ke liye un ko mohlat di jati hai. Jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wanuqallibu af'idatahum wa-absarahum kama lam yu'minu bihi awwala marratin wanazaruhum fi tughyanihim ya'mahun) (Surah Al-An'am: 110). Tughyan kehte hain kisi cheez mein ghus jaane ko. Jaise farmaya aayat (Inna lamma taghal ma'u hamalnakum fil jariyati) (Surah Al-Haqqah: 11). Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain woh apne kufr mein gire jate hain. 'Ama kehte hain gumrahi ko. To is ka matlab yeh hua ke woh zalalat-o-kufr mein doob gaye aur is napaki ne unhein gher liya ab yeh isi daldal mein utarte jate hain, isi napaki mein phanse jate hain aur is se nijat ki tamam raahein un par band ho jati hain. Bhala aisi daldal mein jo ho aur phir andha behra aur bewaqoof ho woh kaise nijat pa sakta hai. Aankhon ke andhe pan ke liye Arabi mein "Ami" ka lafz aata hai aur dil ke andhape ke liye "Ama" ka lekin kabhi dil ke andhe pan ke liye bhi "Ami" ka lafz aata hai jaise Quran mein hai aayat (Wa lakin ta'mal qulubullati fissudur) (Surah Al-Hajj: 46).

Iman farosh log: Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas, Ibn-e-Masood aur ba'az deegar Sahaba Razi Allahu Anhum se marwi hai ke unhon ne hidayat chhor di aur gumrahi le li. Hazrat Abdullah farmate hain unhon ne iman ke badle kufr qabool kiya. Mujahid farmate hain iman laye phir kafir ho gaye. Qatada farmate hain "hidayat par gumrahi ko pasand karte hain." Jaise aur jagah qoum-e-Samood ke bare mein hai ayat (Wa amma Samoodu fahadainahum fastahabbul 'ama 'alal huda fa-akhazathum sa'iqatul 'azabil hauni bima kanu yaksibun) (Surah Fussilat: 17) yani bawajood is ke ke hum ne qoum-e-Samood ko hidayat se roshnas kar diya magar phir bhi unhon ne is rehnumai ki jagah andhe pan ko pasand kiya. Matlab yeh hua ke munafiqeen hidayat se hat kar gumrahi par aa gaye aur hidayat ke badle gumrahi le li goya hidayat ko bech kar gumrahi khareed li. Ab iman la kar phir kafir huye hon khwah sire se iman hi naseeb na hua ho aur in munafiqeen mein dono qisam ke log thay. Chunancha Quran mein hai ayat (Zalika bi-annahum amanu summa kafaru fatubi'a 'ala qulubihim fahum la yafqahun) (Surah Al-Munafiqoon: 3) yeh is liye hai ke yeh log iman la kar phir kafir ho gaye pas un ke dilon par mohar laga di gayi aur aise bhi munafiq thay jinhein iman naseeb hi na hua pas na to unhein is saude mein faida hua, na raah mili, balkay hidayat ke chamistan se nikal kar gumrahi ke kharzar mein, jama'at ke mazboot qila se nikal kar tanhaiyon ki tang jail mein, aman ke wasee maidan se nikal kar khauf ki andheri kothri mein aur sunnat ke pakeeza gulshan se nikal kar bid'at ke sunsan jungle mein aa gaye.

Shak, kufr aur nifaq kya hai? Misaal ko Arabi mein maseel bhi kehte hain is ki jama amsaal aati hai. Jaise Quran mein hai aayat (Wa tilkal-amsalu nadribuha lin-nasi wa ma ya'qiluha illal-alimun) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 43) yani yeh misalein hum logon ke liye bayan karte hain jinhein sirf aalim hi samajhte hain. Is aayat-e-sharifa ka matlab yeh hai ke jo munafiq gumrahi ko hidayat ke badle aur andhe-pan ko beenai ke badle mol lete hain un ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jis ne andhere mein aag jalai us ke dayen bayen ki cheezein use nazar aane lagin, us ki pareshani door ho gayi aur fayde ki umeed bandhi ke daf'atan aag bujh gayi aur sakht andhera chha gaya na to nigah kaam kar sake, na rasta maloom ho sake aur bawajood is ke woh shakhs khud behra ho. Kisi ki baat ko na sun sakta ho. Gunga ho kisi se daryaft na kar sakta ho, andha ho jo roshni se kaam na chala sakta ho. Ab bhala yeh raah kaise pa sake ga? Theek isi tarah yeh munafiq bhi hain ke hidayat chhod kar raah gum kar baithe aur bhalai chhod kar burai ko chahne lage. Is misaal se pata chalta hai ke in logon ne imaan qabool kar ke kufr kiya tha. Jaise Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah yeh sarahat majood hai wallahu a'lam. Imam Razi ne apni tafsir mein Suddi se yahi naqal kiya hai. Phir kaha hai ke yeh tashbeeh bahut hi durust aur sahih hai, is liye ke awwalan to in munafiqon ko noor-e-imaan hasil hua phir un ke nifaq ki wajah se woh chhin gaya aur yeh hairat mein pad gaye aur deen gum ho jane ki hairat se badi hairat aur kya hogi? Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain ke jin ki yeh misaal bayan ki gayi hai unhein kisi waqt bhi imaan naseeb hi na hua tha kyunke pehle farman-e-Ilahi guzar chuka hai ke aayat (Wa ma hum bi-mu'mineen) yani go yeh zaban se Allah Ta'ala par aur qayamat par imaan lane ka iqrar karte hain magar haqeeqatan yeh imandar nahin. Darhaqeeqat is aayat-e-mubaraka mein un ke kufr-o-nifaq ke waqt ki khabar di gayi hai is se yeh baat sabit nahin hoti ke is halat-e-kufr-o-nifaq se pehle kabhi unhein imaan hasil hi na hua ho. Mumkin hai imaan laye hon, phir us se hat gaye hon aur ab dilon mein mohrein lag gayi hon dekhiye dusri jagah Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (Zalika bi-annahum amanu thumma kafaru fa tubi'a ala qulubihim fahum la yafqahun) (Surah Al-Munafiqun: 3) yeh is liye hai ke unhon ne imaan ke baad kufr kiya, phir un ke dilon par mohar lag gayi. Ab woh kuch nahin samajhte. Yahi wajah hai ke is misaal mein roshni aur andhere ka zikr hai yani kalma-e-imaan ke zahir karne ki wajah se duniya mein kuch noor ho gaya, kufr ke chhupane ki wajah se phir aakhirat ke andheron ne gher liya. Ek jamaat ki misaal shakhs-e-wahid se aksar di jati hai. Quran-e-Pak mein aur jagah hai aayat (Ra'aitahum yanzuruna ilaika taduru a'yunuhum kallazi yughsha alaihi minal-mauti fa iza zahabal-khaufu salaqukum bi-alsinatin hidadin ashihhatan alal-khair) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 19).

(Al-Ahzab: 19) Toh dekhe ga ke woh teri taraf aankhein pher pher kar is tarah dekhte hain jis tarah woh shakhs jo sakrat-e-maut mein ho. Aur is aayat ko bhi dekhiye aayat (Maa khalqukum wala ba'thukum illa kanafsin wahidah) (31. Luqman: 28) tum sab ka paida karna aur maar daalne ke baad phir zinda kar dena aisa hi hai jaise ek jaan ko dobara zinda karna. Teesri jagah Taurat seekh kar amli aqeeda is ke mutabiq na rakhne walon ki misaal mein kaha gaya hai aayat (Kamathalil himari yahmilu asfara) (62. Al-Jumu'ah: 5) gadhe ki manind hain jo kitabein lade hue ho. Sab aayaton mein jamaat ki misaal ek hi di gayi hai. Isi tarah mazkoora bala aayat mein munafiqon ki jamaat ki misaal ek shakhs se di gayi. Ba'az kehte hain taqdeer-e-kalam yun hai. Aayat (Mathalu qissatihim kamathali alladhina istawqadu nara) yani un ke waqiye ki misaal un logon ke waqiye ki tarah hai jo aag roshan karein. Ba'az kehte hain ke aag jalane wala toh ek hai. Lekin majmooi taur par poori jamaat is se mehzooz hoti hai jo is ke saath hai aur is qisam ka aur 'alladhi' yahan 'alladhina' ke ma'ani mein hai jaise ke shairon ke sheron mein bhi. Main kehta hoon is misaal mein bhi wahid ke seegha ke baad hi jama ke seegha bhi hain 'binoorihim' aur 'tarakahum' aur 'la yarji'oon' mulahiza hon. Is tarah kalam mein a'la fasahat aur behtareen khoobi bhi aa gayi hai. Allah Ta'ala un ki roshni le gaya is se matlab yeh hai ke jo noor nafa dene wala tha woh toh un se hata liya aur jis tarah aag ke bujh jaane ke baad tapish aur dhuan aur andhera reh jaata hai isi tarah un ke paas nuqsan pahunchane wali cheez yani shak-o-kufr-o-nifaq reh gaya toh rah-e-rast ko na khud dekh sakein na dusre ki bhali baat sun sakein na kisi se bhalai ka sawal kar sakein. Ab phir laut kar hidayat par aana muhaal ho gaya. Is ki ta'eed mein mufassireen ke aqwal suniye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas, Ibn-e-Mas'ood aur ba'az aur sahaba Razi Allahu Anhum farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Madina tashreef laane ke baad kuch log Islam le aaye magar phir munafiq ban gaye. Un ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jo andhere mein ho phir aag jala kar roshni hasil kare aur aas paas ki bhalai burai ko samajhne lage aur maloom kare ke kis raah mein kya hai? Ke achanak aag bujh jaaye roshni jaati rahe. Ab maloom nahin ho sakta ke kis raah mein kya kya hai? Isi tarah munafiq shirk-o-kufr ki zulmat mein the phir Islam la kar bhalai burai yani halal haram waghera samajhne lage magar phir kafir ho gaye aur haram-o-halal khair-o-shar mein kuch tameez na rahi. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas farmate hain noor se murad imaan aur zulmat se murad zalalat-o-kufr hai yeh log hidayat par the lekin phir sarkashi kar ke behak gaye. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain imandari aur hidayat ki taraf rukh karne ko is misaal mein aas paas ki cheez ke roshni karne se ta'beer kiya gaya hai. Hazrat Atta Khurasani ka qaul hai ke munafiq kabhi kabhi bhalai ko dekh leta hai aur pehchan bhi leta hai lekin phir is ke dil ki kor chashmi is par ghalib aa jaati hai.

Ikrama, Abdur Rahman, Hasan, Suddi aur Rabee se bhi yahi manqool hai. Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain munafiqon ki yahi halat hai ke iman late hain aur uski pakeeza roshni se unke dil jagmaga uthte hain jaise aag ke jalane se aas paas ki cheezein roshan hojati hain lekin phir kufr us roshni ko kho deta hai jis tarah aag ka bujh jana phir andhera kardeta hai. Mandarja bala aqwal toh hamari is tafseer ki ta'eed mein thay ke jin munafiqon ki yeh misaal bayan ki gayi hai woh iman la chuke thay phir kufr kiya. Ab Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ki ta'eed mein jo tafseer hai use bhi suniye. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke yeh misaal munafiqon ki hai ke woh Islam ki wajah se izzat pa lete hain. Musalmanon mein nikah, virsa aur taqseem-e-maal-e-ghaneemat mein shamil hote hain lekin marte hi yeh izzat chhin jati hai jis tarah aag ki roshni aag bujhte hi jati rehti hai. Abul Aliyah farmate hain jab munafiq ayat (La ilaha illallah) parhta hai toh dil mein noor paida hota hai phir jahan shak kiya woh noor gaya, jis tarah lakriyan jab tak jalti rahin roshni rahi, jahan bujh gayin noor gaya. Zahhak farmate hain noor se murad yahan iman hai jo unki zabanon par tha. Qatadah kehte hain ayat (La ilaha illallah) unke liye roshni kardeta tha amn-o-aman, khana peena, biwi bache sab mil jate thay lekin shak-o-nifaq unse yeh tamam rahatein chheen leta hai jis tarah aag ka bujhna roshni door kardeta hai. Hazrat Qatadah ka qaul hai ke ayat (La ilaha illallah) kehne se munafiq ko (dunyawi nafa maslan musalmanon mein larke larki ka len den, virsa ki taqseem, jaan-o-maal ki hifazat waghera) mil jata hai lekin chunke uske dil mein iman ki jar aur uske aamal mein khuloos nahin hota is liye maut ke waqt woh sab munafe salb hojate hain jaise aag ki roshni bujh jaye. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain andheron mein chhor dena se murad marne ke baad azab pana hai. Yeh log haq ko dekh kar zaban se uska iqrar karte hain aur zulmat-e-kufr se nikal jate hain lekin phir apne kufr-o-nifaq ki wajah se hidayat aur haq par qaim rehna unse chhin jata hai. Suddi ka qaul hai ke andhere se murad unka nifaq hai. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain maut ke waqt munafiqeen ki bad-aamaliyan andheron ki tarah un par chha jati hain aur kisi bhalai ki roshni unke liye baqi nahin rehti jis se unki tauheed ki tasdeeq ho. Woh behre hain, haq ke sunne aur rah-e-rast ko dekhne aur samajhne se andhe hain. Hidayat ki taraf laut nahin sakte. Na unhein tauba naseeb hoti hai na naseehat hasil karsakte hain.

Shak, kufr aur nifaq kya hai? Misaal ko Arabi mein maseel bhi kehte hain is ki jama amsaal aati hai. Jaise Quran mein hai aayat (Wa tilkal-amsalu nadribuha lin-nasi wa ma ya'qiluha illal-alimun) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 43) yani yeh misalein hum logon ke liye bayan karte hain jinhein sirf aalim hi samajhte hain. Is aayat-e-sharifa ka matlab yeh hai ke jo munafiq gumrahi ko hidayat ke badle aur andhe-pan ko beenai ke badle mol lete hain un ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jis ne andhere mein aag jalai us ke dayen bayen ki cheezein use nazar aane lagin, us ki pareshani door ho gayi aur fayde ki umeed bandhi ke daf'atan aag bujh gayi aur sakht andhera chha gaya na to nigah kaam kar sake, na rasta maloom ho sake aur bawajood is ke woh shakhs khud behra ho. Kisi ki baat ko na sun sakta ho. Gunga ho kisi se daryaft na kar sakta ho, andha ho jo roshni se kaam na chala sakta ho. Ab bhala yeh raah kaise pa sake ga? Theek isi tarah yeh munafiq bhi hain ke hidayat chhod kar raah gum kar baithe aur bhalai chhod kar burai ko chahne lage. Is misaal se pata chalta hai ke in logon ne imaan qabool kar ke kufr kiya tha. Jaise Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah yeh sarahat majood hai wallahu a'lam. Imam Razi ne apni tafsir mein Suddi se yahi naqal kiya hai. Phir kaha hai ke yeh tashbeeh bahut hi durust aur sahih hai, is liye ke awwalan to in munafiqon ko noor-e-imaan hasil hua phir un ke nifaq ki wajah se woh chhin gaya aur yeh hairat mein pad gaye aur deen gum ho jane ki hairat se badi hairat aur kya hogi? Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain ke jin ki yeh misaal bayan ki gayi hai unhein kisi waqt bhi imaan naseeb hi na hua tha kyunke pehle farman-e-Ilahi guzar chuka hai ke aayat (Wa ma hum bi-mu'mineen) yani go yeh zaban se Allah Ta'ala par aur qayamat par imaan lane ka iqrar karte hain magar haqeeqatan yeh imandar nahin. Darhaqeeqat is aayat-e-mubaraka mein un ke kufr-o-nifaq ke waqt ki khabar di gayi hai is se yeh baat sabit nahin hoti ke is halat-e-kufr-o-nifaq se pehle kabhi unhein imaan hasil hi na hua ho. Mumkin hai imaan laye hon, phir us se hat gaye hon aur ab dilon mein mohrein lag gayi hon dekhiye dusri jagah Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (Zalika bi-annahum amanu thumma kafaru fa tubi'a ala qulubihim fahum la yafqahun) (Surah Al-Munafiqun: 3) yeh is liye hai ke unhon ne imaan ke baad kufr kiya, phir un ke dilon par mohar lag gayi. Ab woh kuch nahin samajhte. Yahi wajah hai ke is misaal mein roshni aur andhere ka zikr hai yani kalma-e-imaan ke zahir karne ki wajah se duniya mein kuch noor ho gaya, kufr ke chhupane ki wajah se phir aakhirat ke andheron ne gher liya. Ek jamaat ki misaal shakhs-e-wahid se aksar di jati hai. Quran-e-Pak mein aur jagah hai aayat (Ra'aitahum yanzuruna ilaika taduru a'yunuhum kallazi yughsha alaihi minal-mauti fa iza zahabal-khaufu salaqukum bi-alsinatin hidadin ashihhatan alal-khair) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 19).

(Al-Ahzab: 19) Toh dekhe ga ke woh teri taraf aankhein pher pher kar is tarah dekhte hain jis tarah woh shakhs jo sakrat-e-maut mein ho. Aur is aayat ko bhi dekhiye aayat (Maa khalqukum wala ba'thukum illa kanafsin wahidah) (31. Luqman: 28) tum sab ka paida karna aur maar daalne ke baad phir zinda kar dena aisa hi hai jaise ek jaan ko dobara zinda karna. Teesri jagah Taurat seekh kar amli aqeeda is ke mutabiq na rakhne walon ki misaal mein kaha gaya hai aayat (Kamathalil himari yahmilu asfara) (62. Al-Jumu'ah: 5) gadhe ki manind hain jo kitabein lade hue ho. Sab aayaton mein jamaat ki misaal ek hi di gayi hai. Isi tarah mazkoora bala aayat mein munafiqon ki jamaat ki misaal ek shakhs se di gayi. Ba'az kehte hain taqdeer-e-kalam yun hai. Aayat (Mathalu qissatihim kamathali alladhina istawqadu nara) yani un ke waqiye ki misaal un logon ke waqiye ki tarah hai jo aag roshan karein. Ba'az kehte hain ke aag jalane wala toh ek hai. Lekin majmooi taur par poori jamaat is se mehzooz hoti hai jo is ke saath hai aur is qisam ka aur 'alladhi' yahan 'alladhina' ke ma'ani mein hai jaise ke shairon ke sheron mein bhi. Main kehta hoon is misaal mein bhi wahid ke seegha ke baad hi jama ke seegha bhi hain 'binoorihim' aur 'tarakahum' aur 'la yarji'oon' mulahiza hon. Is tarah kalam mein a'la fasahat aur behtareen khoobi bhi aa gayi hai. Allah Ta'ala un ki roshni le gaya is se matlab yeh hai ke jo noor nafa dene wala tha woh toh un se hata liya aur jis tarah aag ke bujh jaane ke baad tapish aur dhuan aur andhera reh jaata hai isi tarah un ke paas nuqsan pahunchane wali cheez yani shak-o-kufr-o-nifaq reh gaya toh rah-e-rast ko na khud dekh sakein na dusre ki bhali baat sun sakein na kisi se bhalai ka sawal kar sakein. Ab phir laut kar hidayat par aana muhaal ho gaya. Is ki ta'eed mein mufassireen ke aqwal suniye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas, Ibn-e-Mas'ood aur ba'az aur sahaba Razi Allahu Anhum farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Madina tashreef laane ke baad kuch log Islam le aaye magar phir munafiq ban gaye. Un ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jo andhere mein ho phir aag jala kar roshni hasil kare aur aas paas ki bhalai burai ko samajhne lage aur maloom kare ke kis raah mein kya hai? Ke achanak aag bujh jaaye roshni jaati rahe. Ab maloom nahin ho sakta ke kis raah mein kya kya hai? Isi tarah munafiq shirk-o-kufr ki zulmat mein the phir Islam la kar bhalai burai yani halal haram waghera samajhne lage magar phir kafir ho gaye aur haram-o-halal khair-o-shar mein kuch tameez na rahi. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas farmate hain noor se murad imaan aur zulmat se murad zalalat-o-kufr hai yeh log hidayat par the lekin phir sarkashi kar ke behak gaye. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain imandari aur hidayat ki taraf rukh karne ko is misaal mein aas paas ki cheez ke roshni karne se ta'beer kiya gaya hai. Hazrat Atta Khurasani ka qaul hai ke munafiq kabhi kabhi bhalai ko dekh leta hai aur pehchan bhi leta hai lekin phir is ke dil ki kor chashmi is par ghalib aa jaati hai.

Ikrama, Abdur Rahman, Hasan, Suddi aur Rabee se bhi yahi manqool hai. Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain munafiqon ki yahi halat hai ke iman late hain aur uski pakeeza roshni se unke dil jagmaga uthte hain jaise aag ke jalane se aas paas ki cheezein roshan hojati hain lekin phir kufr us roshni ko kho deta hai jis tarah aag ka bujh jana phir andhera kardeta hai. Mandarja bala aqwal toh hamari is tafseer ki ta'eed mein thay ke jin munafiqon ki yeh misaal bayan ki gayi hai woh iman la chuke thay phir kufr kiya. Ab Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ki ta'eed mein jo tafseer hai use bhi suniye. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke yeh misaal munafiqon ki hai ke woh Islam ki wajah se izzat pa lete hain. Musalmanon mein nikah, virsa aur taqseem-e-maal-e-ghaneemat mein shamil hote hain lekin marte hi yeh izzat chhin jati hai jis tarah aag ki roshni aag bujhte hi jati rehti hai. Abul Aliyah farmate hain jab munafiq ayat (La ilaha illallah) parhta hai toh dil mein noor paida hota hai phir jahan shak kiya woh noor gaya, jis tarah lakriyan jab tak jalti rahin roshni rahi, jahan bujh gayin noor gaya. Zahhak farmate hain noor se murad yahan iman hai jo unki zabanon par tha. Qatadah kehte hain ayat (La ilaha illallah) unke liye roshni kardeta tha amn-o-aman, khana peena, biwi bache sab mil jate thay lekin shak-o-nifaq unse yeh tamam rahatein chheen leta hai jis tarah aag ka bujhna roshni door kardeta hai. Hazrat Qatadah ka qaul hai ke ayat (La ilaha illallah) kehne se munafiq ko (dunyawi nafa maslan musalmanon mein larke larki ka len den, virsa ki taqseem, jaan-o-maal ki hifazat waghera) mil jata hai lekin chunke uske dil mein iman ki jar aur uske aamal mein khuloos nahin hota is liye maut ke waqt woh sab munafe salb hojate hain jaise aag ki roshni bujh jaye. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain andheron mein chhor dena se murad marne ke baad azab pana hai. Yeh log haq ko dekh kar zaban se uska iqrar karte hain aur zulmat-e-kufr se nikal jate hain lekin phir apne kufr-o-nifaq ki wajah se hidayat aur haq par qaim rehna unse chhin jata hai. Suddi ka qaul hai ke andhere se murad unka nifaq hai. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain maut ke waqt munafiqeen ki bad-aamaliyan andheron ki tarah un par chha jati hain aur kisi bhalai ki roshni unke liye baqi nahin rehti jis se unki tauheed ki tasdeeq ho. Woh behre hain, haq ke sunne aur rah-e-rast ko dekhne aur samajhne se andhe hain. Hidayat ki taraf laut nahin sakte. Na unhein tauba naseeb hoti hai na naseehat hasil karsakte hain.

Munafiqeen ki ek aur pehchan. Yeh dusri misaal hai jo dusri qisam ke munafiqon ke liye bayan ki gayi hai. Yeh woh qoum hai jin par kabhi haq zahir hojata hai aur kabhi phir shak mein pad jate hain to shak ke waqt un ki misaal barsaat ki si hai. Sayyib ke ma'ani meena aur barish ke hain. Ba'az ne badal ke ma'ani bhi bayan kiye hain lekin zyada mashhoor ma'ani barish ke hi hain jo andhere mein barse. Zulumaat se murad shak, kufr-o-nifaq hai aur ra'ad se murad ya'ni garaj hai jo apni khaufnak aawaz se dilon ko dehla deti hai. Yehi haal munafiq ka hai ke use har waqt dar, khauf, ghabrahat aur pareshani hi rehti hai. Jaise ke aur jagah farmaya aayat (Yahsaboona kulla saihatin alaihim) (63. Al-Munafiqoon: 4) ya'ni har aawaz ko apne upar hi samajhte hain. Ek aur jagah irshad hai ke yeh munafiqeen Allah ki qasmein kha kha kar kehte hain ke woh tum mein se hain darasal woh darpok log hain agar woh koi jaye panah ya rasta pa lein to yaqeenan us mein simat kar ghus jayen. Bijli ki misaal se murad woh noor-e-iman hai jo un ke dilon mein kisi waqt chamak uthta hai, us waqt woh apni ungliyan maut ke dar se kanon mein daal lete hain lekin aisa karna unhein koi nafa na de ga. Yeh Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat aur us ke irade ke matehat hain, yeh bach nahin sakte. Jaisa ke aur jagah farmaya aayat (Hal ataka hadithul junood. Fir'auna wa Thamood) (85. Al-Burooj: 17-18) ya'ni kya tumhein lashkar ki, Fir'aun aur Thamood ki riwayatein nahin pahunchin? Beshak pahunchi to hain lekin yeh kafir phir bhi takzeeb hi karte hain aur Allah Ta'ala bhi unhein un ke peeche se gher raha hai. Bijli ka aankhon ko uchak lena, us ki quwwat aur sakhti ka izhar hai aur munafiqeen ki beenai ki kamzori aur za'f-e-iman hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke Quran ki mazboot aayatein in munafiqon ki qal'i khol dein gi aur un ke chhupe hue aib zahir kar dein gi aur apni nooraniyat se unhein mabhoot kar dein gi. Jab un par andhera hojata hai to khade ho jate hain ya'ni jab iman un par zahir hojata hai to zara roshan dil ho kar pairwi bhi karne lagte hain lekin phir jahan shak-o-shuba aaya, dil mein kadoorat aur zulmat bhar gayi aur bhonchke ho kar khade reh gaye. Is ka yeh matlab bhi hai ke Islam ko zara urooj mila to un ke dil mein qadre itminan paida hua lekin jahan us ke khilaf nazar aaya yeh ulte pairon kufr ki taraf lautne lage. Jaise irshad-e-Bari Ta'ala hai aayat (Wa minan-nasi may ya'budullaha 'ala harfin) (22. Al-Hajj: 11) ya'ni ba'az log woh bhi hain jo kinare par thehar kar Allah ki ibadat karte hain agar bhalai mile to mutma'in ho jayen aur agar burai pahunche to usi waqt phir gaye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yehi farmate hain ke un ka roshni mein chalna haq ko jaan kar kalma-e-Islam padhna hai aur andhere mein thehar jana kufr ki taraf laut jana hai. Deegar bohat se mufassireen ka bhi yehi qaul hai aur zyada sahih aur zahir bhi yehi qaul hai, Wallahu A'alam.

Roz-e-Qayamat bhi un ka yahi haal rahe ga ke jab logon ko un ke imaan ke andazay ke mutabiq noor mile ga, baaz ko kayi kayi meelon tak ka, baaz ko us se bhi zyada, kisi ko us se kam, yahan tak ke kisi ko itna noor mile ga ke kabhi roshan ho aur kabhi andhera. Kuch log aisay bhi honge jo zara si door chal saken ge phir thehar jayen ge, phir zara si door ka noor mile ga phir bujh jaye ga aur baaz woh benaseeb bhi honge ke un ka noor bilkul bujh jaye ga. Yeh pooray munafiq honge jin ke baray mein farman-e-Ilahi hai, aayat (Yau-ma yaqoolul munafiqoona wal munafiqatu lillazeena amanoo unzuroona naqtabisu min noorikum) (Surah Al-Hadid: 13), yani jis din munafiq mard aur munafiq auratein imaan walon ko pukaren ge aur kahen ge zara ruko! Hamein bhi aa lene do taake hum bhi tumhare noor se faida uthayen, toh kaha jaye ga ke apne peechay laut jao aur noor dhoond lao. Mominon ke baray mein Allah Ta'ala farmata hai, aayat (Yau-ma taral mu'mineena wal mu'minati yas'a nooruhum baina aydeehim wa bi-aymanihim bushrakumul yauma jannatun tajree min tahtiha al-anharu khalideena feeha) (Surah Al-Hadid: 12), yani us din tu dekhay ga ke momin mard aur auraton ke aagay aagay aur dayin janib noor hoga aur kaha jaye ga tumhein aaj baghat ki khushkhabri di jati hai jin ke neechay neharein beh rahi hain. Aur farmaya jis din na ruswa kare ga Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ko aur un logon ko jo un ke sath imaan laye, un ka noor un ke aagay aur dayin hoga. Woh keh rahe honge ae hamaray Rab! Hamaray liye hamara noor poora kar aur hamein bakhash, yaqeenan tu har cheez par qadir hai. In aayaton ke baad ab is mazmoon ki hadeesein bhi suniye. Ahadis mein tazkira-e-noor: Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain "Baaz mominon ko Madina se le kar Adan tak noor mile ga. Baaz ko us se kam yahan tak ke baaz ko itna kam ke sirf paon rakhne ki jagah hi roshan hogi" (Ibn-e-Jareer). Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmatay hain "Imaan walon ko un ke a'maal ke mutabiq noor mile ga, baaz ko khajoor ke darakht jitna, kisi ko qad-e-adam jitna, kisi ko sirf itna hi ke us ka angootha hi roshan ho, kabhi bujh jata ho, kabhi roshan ho jata ho" (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmatay hain "Unhein noor mile ga un ke a'maal ke mutabiq jis ki roshni mein woh Pul-e-Sirat se guzren ge. Baaz logon ka noor pahar jitna hoga, baaz ka khajoor jitna aur sab se kam noor wala woh hoga jis ka noor us ke angoothay par hoga, kabhi chamak uthay ga aur kabhi bujh jaye ga" (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain "Ke tamam Ahl-e-Tauheed ko Qayamat ke din noor mile ga. Jab munafiqon ka noor bujh jaye ga toh muwahid dar kar kahen ge, aayat (Rabbana atmim lana noorana waghfir lana) (Surah At-Tahrim: 8), ya Rab hamaray noor ko poora kar" (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Zahhak bin Muzahim ka bhi yahi qaul hai.

In ahadees se maloom hua ke Qayamat wale din log kayi qisam ke honge. Khalis momin woh jin ka bayan agli chaar aayaton mein hua, khalis kuffar jin ka zikr is ke baad ki do aayaton mein hai aur munafiq jin ki do qismein hain. Ek toh khalis munafiq jin ki misaal aag ki roshni se di gayi. Dusre woh munafiq jo taraddud mein hain kabhi toh imaan chamak uthta hai kabhi bujh jata hai, in hi ki misaal barish se di gayi hai yeh pehli qisam ke munafiqon se kuch kam hain. Theek isi tarah Surah Noor mein bhi Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne momin ki aur us ke dil ke noor ki misaal is munawwar chiragh se di hai jo roshan fanoos mein ho aur khud fanoos bhi chamakte hue taare ki tarah ho. Chunancha imaan-dar ka ek toh khud dil roshan, dusre khalis shariat ki use imdad, bas roshni par roshni, noor par noor ho jata hai. Isi tarah dusri jagah kafiron ki misaal bhi bayan ki jo apni nadani ki wajah se apne aap ko kuch samajhte hain aur haqeeqat mein woh kuch nahin hote. Farmaya kafiron ke aamal ki misaal ret ke chamkeele teelon ki tarah hai jinhein pyasa pani samajhta hai yahan tak ke paas aa kar dekhta hai toh kuch bhi nahin pata. Ek aur jagah par in jahil kafiron ki misaal bayan ki jo jahl-e-baseet mein giraftar hain. Farmaya manind sakht aur andheron ke jo gehre samundar mein hon jo maujon par maujein maar raha ho phir abr se dhaka hua ho aur andheron par andhere chhaye hue hon, haath nikale toh dekh bhi nahin sakta. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jis ke liye Allah ki taraf bulane wale dusre un ki taqleed karne wale. Jaise Surah Hajj ke shuru mein hai aayat (Wa minan-nasi may-yujadilu fillahi bighairi ilm) ilakh. Baaz woh log hain jo Allah ke bare mein baghair ilm ke jhagadte hain aur har sarkash shaitan ki pairwi karte hain. Ek aur jagah farmaya aayat (وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُّجَادِلُ فِي اللّٰهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَّيَتَّبِـعُ كُلَّ شَيْطٰنٍ مَّرِيْدٍ) (22. Al-Hajj: 3) baaz log ilm-e-hidayat aur roshan kitab ke baghair Allah ke bare mein ladte jhagadte hain. Surah Waqi'ah ke shuru aur aakhir mein aur Surah Insan mein mominon ki bhi do qismein bayan ki hain. Sabiqeen aur Ashab-e-Yameen yani muqarrabeen-e-bargah-e-Rabbani aur parhezgar-o-nek-kar log. Pas in aayaton se maloom hua ke mominon ki do jamaatein hain muqarrab aur abrar. Aur kafiron ki bhi do qismein hain kufr ki taraf lane wale aur un ki taqleed karne wale. Munafiqon ki bhi do qismein hain khalis aur pakke munafiq aur woh munafiq jin mein nifaq ki ek aadh shakh hai. Sahihain mein hadees hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Teen khaslatein aisi hain jis mein yeh teenon hon woh pukhta munafiq hai aur jis mein ek ho us mein nifaq ki ek khaslat hai jab tak use na chhore. Baat karne mein jhoot bolna, wada khilafi karna, amanat mein khayanat karna." Is se sabit hua ke insaan mein kabhi nifaq ka kuch hissa hota hai khwah woh nifaq-e-amli ho khwah e'tiqadi jaise ke aayat-o-hadees se maloom hota hai.

Salaf ki ek jamaat aur ulama-e-kiram ke ek giroh ka yahi mazhab hai, is ka bayan pehle bhi guzar chuka hai aur aayinda bhi aayega. Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Dil char qisam ke hain; ek toh saaf dil jo roshan chiragh ki tarah chamak raha ho, dusre woh dil jo ghilaf-aalood hain, teesre woh dil jo ulte hain, chauthe woh dil jo makhlut hain. Pehla dil momin ka hai jo puri tarah noorani hai, dusra kafir ka dil hai jis par parde pade hue hain, teesra dil khalis munafiqon ka hai jo jaanta hai aur inkar karta hai, chautha dil us munafiq ka hai jis mein iman-o-nifaq dono jama hain. Iman ki misaal us sabze ki tarah hai jo pakeeza pani se badh raha ho aur nifaq ki misaal us phode ki tarah hai jis mein peep aur khoon badhta hi jaata ho, ab jo madda badh jaaye woh sire par ghalib aa jaata hai." Is hadith ki asnaad bahut hi umda hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain, agar Allah chahe toh un ke kaan aur aankhein barbad kar de. Matlab yeh hai ke jab unhon ne haq ko jaan kar use chhod diya toh Allah har cheez par qadir hai, yani agar chahe toh azab-o-saza de, chahe toh maaf kar de. Yahan qudrat ka bayan is liye kiya ke pehle munafiqon ko apne azab, apni jabroot se daraya aur keh diya ke woh unhein gher lene par qadir hai aur un ke kaanon ko behra karne aur aankhon ko andha karne par qadir hai. Qadeer ke ma'ani Qadir ke hain jaise Aleem ke ma'ani Aalim ke hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain yeh do misalein ek hi qisam ke munafiqon ki hain aur ma'ani mein 'au' (ya) ke hai, jaise farmaya aayat (Wala tuti' minhum asiman au kafoora) (Surah Al-Insan: 24) ya lafz 'au' ikhtiyar ke liye hai, yani khwah yeh misaal bayan karo, khwah woh misaal bayan karo ikhtiyar hai. Qurtubi farmate hain 'au' yahan par tasawi yani barabari ke liye hai, jaise Arabi zaban ka muhawara hai 'Jalis al-Hasan au Ibn-e-Sirin'. Zamakhshari bhi yahi taujeeh karte hain, toh matlab yeh hoga ke in dono misalon mein se jo misaal chaho bayan karo, dono un ke mutabiq hain. Main kehta hoon yeh ba'etibar-e-munafiqon ki aqsaam ke hai, un ke ahwal-o-sifaat tarah tarah ke hain. Jaise ke Surah Bara'at mein 'wa minhum, wa minhum, wa minhum' kar ke un ki bahut si qismein, bahut se af'aal aur bahut se aqwal bayan kiye hain. Toh yeh dono misalein do qisam ke munafiqon ki hain jo un ke ahwal aur sifaat se bilkul mushabah hain. Wallahu A'lam. Jaise ke Surah Noor mein do qisam ke kuffar ki misalein bayan keen. Ek kufr ki taraf bulane wale, dusre muqallid. Farmaya aayat (Wallazeena kafaroo a'maluhum kasurabin biqi'atin yahsabuhuz zam'anu ma'an) (Surah An-Noor: 39), phir farmaya aayat (Au kazolumaat). Pas pehli misaal yani ret ke toode ki kufr ki taraf bulane walon ki hai jo jahl-e-murakkab mein phanse hue hain. Dusri misaal muqallideen ki hai jo jahl-e-baseet mein mubtala hain. Wallahu A'lam.

Munafiqeen ki ek aur pehchan. Yeh dusri misaal hai jo dusri qisam ke munafiqon ke liye bayan ki gayi hai. Yeh woh qoum hai jin par kabhi haq zahir hojata hai aur kabhi phir shak mein pad jate hain to shak ke waqt un ki misaal barsaat ki si hai. Sayyib ke ma'ani meena aur barish ke hain. Ba'az ne badal ke ma'ani bhi bayan kiye hain lekin zyada mashhoor ma'ani barish ke hi hain jo andhere mein barse. Zulumaat se murad shak, kufr-o-nifaq hai aur ra'ad se murad ya'ni garaj hai jo apni khaufnak aawaz se dilon ko dehla deti hai. Yehi haal munafiq ka hai ke use har waqt dar, khauf, ghabrahat aur pareshani hi rehti hai. Jaise ke aur jagah farmaya aayat (Yahsaboona kulla saihatin alaihim) (63. Al-Munafiqoon: 4) ya'ni har aawaz ko apne upar hi samajhte hain. Ek aur jagah irshad hai ke yeh munafiqeen Allah ki qasmein kha kha kar kehte hain ke woh tum mein se hain darasal woh darpok log hain agar woh koi jaye panah ya rasta pa lein to yaqeenan us mein simat kar ghus jayen. Bijli ki misaal se murad woh noor-e-iman hai jo un ke dilon mein kisi waqt chamak uthta hai, us waqt woh apni ungliyan maut ke dar se kanon mein daal lete hain lekin aisa karna unhein koi nafa na de ga. Yeh Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat aur us ke irade ke matehat hain, yeh bach nahin sakte. Jaisa ke aur jagah farmaya aayat (Hal ataka hadithul junood. Fir'auna wa Thamood) (85. Al-Burooj: 17-18) ya'ni kya tumhein lashkar ki, Fir'aun aur Thamood ki riwayatein nahin pahunchin? Beshak pahunchi to hain lekin yeh kafir phir bhi takzeeb hi karte hain aur Allah Ta'ala bhi unhein un ke peeche se gher raha hai. Bijli ka aankhon ko uchak lena, us ki quwwat aur sakhti ka izhar hai aur munafiqeen ki beenai ki kamzori aur za'f-e-iman hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke Quran ki mazboot aayatein in munafiqon ki qal'i khol dein gi aur un ke chhupe hue aib zahir kar dein gi aur apni nooraniyat se unhein mabhoot kar dein gi. Jab un par andhera hojata hai to khade ho jate hain ya'ni jab iman un par zahir hojata hai to zara roshan dil ho kar pairwi bhi karne lagte hain lekin phir jahan shak-o-shuba aaya, dil mein kadoorat aur zulmat bhar gayi aur bhonchke ho kar khade reh gaye. Is ka yeh matlab bhi hai ke Islam ko zara urooj mila to un ke dil mein qadre itminan paida hua lekin jahan us ke khilaf nazar aaya yeh ulte pairon kufr ki taraf lautne lage. Jaise irshad-e-Bari Ta'ala hai aayat (Wa minan-nasi may ya'budullaha 'ala harfin) (22. Al-Hajj: 11) ya'ni ba'az log woh bhi hain jo kinare par thehar kar Allah ki ibadat karte hain agar bhalai mile to mutma'in ho jayen aur agar burai pahunche to usi waqt phir gaye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yehi farmate hain ke un ka roshni mein chalna haq ko jaan kar kalma-e-Islam padhna hai aur andhere mein thehar jana kufr ki taraf laut jana hai. Deegar bohat se mufassireen ka bhi yehi qaul hai aur zyada sahih aur zahir bhi yehi qaul hai, Wallahu A'alam.

Roz-e-Qayamat bhi un ka yahi haal rahe ga ke jab logon ko un ke imaan ke andazay ke mutabiq noor mile ga, baaz ko kayi kayi meelon tak ka, baaz ko us se bhi zyada, kisi ko us se kam, yahan tak ke kisi ko itna noor mile ga ke kabhi roshan ho aur kabhi andhera. Kuch log aisay bhi honge jo zara si door chal saken ge phir thehar jayen ge, phir zara si door ka noor mile ga phir bujh jaye ga aur baaz woh benaseeb bhi honge ke un ka noor bilkul bujh jaye ga. Yeh pooray munafiq honge jin ke baray mein farman-e-Ilahi hai, aayat (Yau-ma yaqoolul munafiqoona wal munafiqatu lillazeena amanoo unzuroona naqtabisu min noorikum) (Surah Al-Hadid: 13), yani jis din munafiq mard aur munafiq auratein imaan walon ko pukaren ge aur kahen ge zara ruko! Hamein bhi aa lene do taake hum bhi tumhare noor se faida uthayen, toh kaha jaye ga ke apne peechay laut jao aur noor dhoond lao. Mominon ke baray mein Allah Ta'ala farmata hai, aayat (Yau-ma taral mu'mineena wal mu'minati yas'a nooruhum baina aydeehim wa bi-aymanihim bushrakumul yauma jannatun tajree min tahtiha al-anharu khalideena feeha) (Surah Al-Hadid: 12), yani us din tu dekhay ga ke momin mard aur auraton ke aagay aagay aur dayin janib noor hoga aur kaha jaye ga tumhein aaj baghat ki khushkhabri di jati hai jin ke neechay neharein beh rahi hain. Aur farmaya jis din na ruswa kare ga Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ko aur un logon ko jo un ke sath imaan laye, un ka noor un ke aagay aur dayin hoga. Woh keh rahe honge ae hamaray Rab! Hamaray liye hamara noor poora kar aur hamein bakhash, yaqeenan tu har cheez par qadir hai. In aayaton ke baad ab is mazmoon ki hadeesein bhi suniye. Ahadis mein tazkira-e-noor: Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain "Baaz mominon ko Madina se le kar Adan tak noor mile ga. Baaz ko us se kam yahan tak ke baaz ko itna kam ke sirf paon rakhne ki jagah hi roshan hogi" (Ibn-e-Jareer). Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmatay hain "Imaan walon ko un ke a'maal ke mutabiq noor mile ga, baaz ko khajoor ke darakht jitna, kisi ko qad-e-adam jitna, kisi ko sirf itna hi ke us ka angootha hi roshan ho, kabhi bujh jata ho, kabhi roshan ho jata ho" (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmatay hain "Unhein noor mile ga un ke a'maal ke mutabiq jis ki roshni mein woh Pul-e-Sirat se guzren ge. Baaz logon ka noor pahar jitna hoga, baaz ka khajoor jitna aur sab se kam noor wala woh hoga jis ka noor us ke angoothay par hoga, kabhi chamak uthay ga aur kabhi bujh jaye ga" (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain "Ke tamam Ahl-e-Tauheed ko Qayamat ke din noor mile ga. Jab munafiqon ka noor bujh jaye ga toh muwahid dar kar kahen ge, aayat (Rabbana atmim lana noorana waghfir lana) (Surah At-Tahrim: 8), ya Rab hamaray noor ko poora kar" (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Zahhak bin Muzahim ka bhi yahi qaul hai.

In ahadees se maloom hua ke Qayamat wale din log kayi qisam ke honge. Khalis momin woh jin ka bayan agli chaar aayaton mein hua, khalis kuffar jin ka zikr is ke baad ki do aayaton mein hai aur munafiq jin ki do qismein hain. Ek toh khalis munafiq jin ki misaal aag ki roshni se di gayi. Dusre woh munafiq jo taraddud mein hain kabhi toh imaan chamak uthta hai kabhi bujh jata hai, in hi ki misaal barish se di gayi hai yeh pehli qisam ke munafiqon se kuch kam hain. Theek isi tarah Surah Noor mein bhi Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne momin ki aur us ke dil ke noor ki misaal is munawwar chiragh se di hai jo roshan fanoos mein ho aur khud fanoos bhi chamakte hue taare ki tarah ho. Chunancha imaan-dar ka ek toh khud dil roshan, dusre khalis shariat ki use imdad, bas roshni par roshni, noor par noor ho jata hai. Isi tarah dusri jagah kafiron ki misaal bhi bayan ki jo apni nadani ki wajah se apne aap ko kuch samajhte hain aur haqeeqat mein woh kuch nahin hote. Farmaya kafiron ke aamal ki misaal ret ke chamkeele teelon ki tarah hai jinhein pyasa pani samajhta hai yahan tak ke paas aa kar dekhta hai toh kuch bhi nahin pata. Ek aur jagah par in jahil kafiron ki misaal bayan ki jo jahl-e-baseet mein giraftar hain. Farmaya manind sakht aur andheron ke jo gehre samundar mein hon jo maujon par maujein maar raha ho phir abr se dhaka hua ho aur andheron par andhere chhaye hue hon, haath nikale toh dekh bhi nahin sakta. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jis ke liye Allah ki taraf bulane wale dusre un ki taqleed karne wale. Jaise Surah Hajj ke shuru mein hai aayat (Wa minan-nasi may-yujadilu fillahi bighairi ilm) ilakh. Baaz woh log hain jo Allah ke bare mein baghair ilm ke jhagadte hain aur har sarkash shaitan ki pairwi karte hain. Ek aur jagah farmaya aayat (وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُّجَادِلُ فِي اللّٰهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَّيَتَّبِـعُ كُلَّ شَيْطٰنٍ مَّرِيْدٍ) (22. Al-Hajj: 3) baaz log ilm-e-hidayat aur roshan kitab ke baghair Allah ke bare mein ladte jhagadte hain. Surah Waqi'ah ke shuru aur aakhir mein aur Surah Insan mein mominon ki bhi do qismein bayan ki hain. Sabiqeen aur Ashab-e-Yameen yani muqarrabeen-e-bargah-e-Rabbani aur parhezgar-o-nek-kar log. Pas in aayaton se maloom hua ke mominon ki do jamaatein hain muqarrab aur abrar. Aur kafiron ki bhi do qismein hain kufr ki taraf lane wale aur un ki taqleed karne wale. Munafiqon ki bhi do qismein hain khalis aur pakke munafiq aur woh munafiq jin mein nifaq ki ek aadh shakh hai. Sahihain mein hadees hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Teen khaslatein aisi hain jis mein yeh teenon hon woh pukhta munafiq hai aur jis mein ek ho us mein nifaq ki ek khaslat hai jab tak use na chhore. Baat karne mein jhoot bolna, wada khilafi karna, amanat mein khayanat karna." Is se sabit hua ke insaan mein kabhi nifaq ka kuch hissa hota hai khwah woh nifaq-e-amli ho khwah e'tiqadi jaise ke aayat-o-hadees se maloom hota hai.

Salaf ki ek jamaat aur ulama-e-kiram ke ek giroh ka yahi mazhab hai, is ka bayan pehle bhi guzar chuka hai aur aayinda bhi aayega. Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Ta'aruf-e-Allah bazuban-e-Allah. Yahan se Allah Ta'ala ki tauheed aur uski uluhiyat ka bayan shuru hota hai. Wohi apne bandon ko adam se wajood mein laya, usi ne har tarah ki zahiri-o-batini ne'matein ata farmayin, usi ne zameen ko farsh banaya aur is mein mazboot paharon ki meikhein gaar dein aur aasman ko chhat banaya. Jaise ke dusri aayat mein aaya ke aayat (وَجَعَلْنَا السَّمَاۗءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوْظًا ښ وَّهُمْ عَنْ اٰيٰـتِهَا مُعْرِضُوْنَ) (21-Al-Anbiya: 32) yani aasman ko mehfooz chhat banaya iske bawajood woh nishaniyon se munh mor lete hain, aasman se pani utarne ka matlab badal nazil farmana hai. Us waqt jabke log iske pooray mohtaj hon. Phir is pani se tarah tarah ke phal phool paida karna hai jis se log faida uthayen aur unke janwar bhi. Jaise ke Quran-e-Majeed mein jagah jagah iska bayan aaya hai. Ek jagah farmaya hai aayat (اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَّالسَّمَاۗءَ بِنَاۗءً وَّصَوَّرَكُمْ فَاَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ) (40-Ghafir: 64) Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare liye zameen ko farsh aur aasman ko chhat banaya aur tumhein pyari pyari soortein ata farmayin aur tarah tarah ki ghizayein pahunchayin. Yehi Allah hai jo barkaton wala aur tamam aalam ko palne wala hai, pas sab ka khaliq, sab ka raziq, sab ka malik Allah Ta'ala hi hai aur is liye shirk se mubarra har qisam ki ibadat ka wohi mustahiq hai. Aur farmaya "Allah Ta'ala ke shareek na thahrao jabke tum jante ho." Sahihain mein hadith hai "Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood R.A poochte hain Huzoor ﷺ sab se bada gunah kaunsa hai? Farmaya Allah Ta'ala ke sath jo tumhara khaliq hai kisi ko shareek thahrana." Hazrat Mu'az R.A wali hadith mein hai "Jante ho ke Allah ka haq bandon par kya hai? Yeh ke usi ki ibadat karein aur kisi ko uski ibadat mein shareek na karein." Dusri hadith mein hai "Tum mein se koi yeh na kahe ke jo Allah chahe aur falaan chahe balkay yun kahe jo kuch Allah akela chahe." Tufail bin Sanjara Hazrat Ayesha R.A ke sotayle bhai farmate hain main ne khwab mein chand yahudiyon ko dekha aur un se poocha tum kaun ho? Unhon ne kaha tum bhi achhay log ho lekin afsos tum kehte ho jo Allah chahe aur Muhammad ﷺ chahein. Phir main nasraniyon ki jamaat ke paas gaya aur un se bhi isi tarah poocha unhon ne bhi yehi jawab diya. Main ne un se kaha afsos tum bhi Maseeh A.S ko Allah ka beta mante ho. Unhon ne bhi yehi jawab diya. Main ne subah apne is khwab ka zikr kuch logon se kiya phir darbar-e-nabwi mein hazir ho kar Aap ﷺ se bhi yehi khwab bayan kiya.

Aap ne poocha kya kisi aur se bhi tum ne is ka zikr kiya hai? Main ne kaha haan Huzoor (ﷺ). Ab aap kharay ho gaye aur Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana bayan ki aur farmaya Tufail ne ek khwab dekha aur tum mein se baaz ko bayan bhi kiya, main chahta tha ke tumhein is kalma ke kehne se rok doon lekin falan falan kamon ki wajah se main ab tak na keh saka. Yaad rakho "ab hargiz hargiz Allah chahey aur us ka Rasool" kabhi na kehna balkay yun kaho ke sirf Allah Ta'ala akela jo chahey (Ibn Marduyah). Ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kaha jo Allah Ta'ala chahey aur aap chahein. Aap ne farmaya kya tu mujhe Allah Ta'ala ka shareek thehrata hai? Yun keh jo Allah Ta'ala akela chahey (Ibn Marduyah). Aise tamam kalmaat tauheed ke sarasar khilaf hain. Tauheed-e-Bari ki ahmiyat ke baray mein yeh sab ahadees bayan hui hain. Wallahu A'lam. Tamam kuffar aur munafiqon ko Allah Ta'ala ne apni ibadat ka hukum diya aur farmaya Allah ki ibadat karo yani us ki tauheed ke paband ho jao, us ke sath kisi ko shareek na karo jo na nafa de sakay na nuqsan pohancha sakay aur tum jantay ho ke us ke siwa koi Rabb nahin jo tumhein rozi pohancha sakay aur tum jantay ho ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) tumhein is tauheed ki taraf bula rahay hain jis ke haq aur sach honay mein koi shak nahin. Shirk is se bhi zyada posheeda hai jaise cheenti jo raat ke andheray mein kisi saaf patthar par chal rahi ho, qasam hai Allah ki aur qasam hai aap ki hayat ki, yeh bhi shirk hai insaan ka yeh kehna agar yeh kuttiya na hoti to chor raat ko hamaray ghar mein ghus aatay, yeh bhi shirk hai. Aadmi ka yeh qaul ke agar batakh ghar mein na hoti to chori ho jati yeh bhi shirk ka kalma hai, kisi ka yeh qaul ke jo Allah chahey aur aap, yeh bhi shirk hai, kisi ka yeh kehna ke agar Allah na hota aur falan na hota. Yeh sab kalmaat-e-shirk hain. Sahih hadees mein hai ke kisi ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kaha jo Allah chahey aur jo aap chahein to aap ne farmaya kya tu mujhe Allah Ta'ala ka shareek thehrata hai? Doosri hadees mein hai tum achay log hotay agar tum shirk na kartay, tum kehtay ho jo Allah chahey aur falan chahey. Abu Aliyah farmatay hain andad ke ma'ani shareek aur barabar ke hain. Mujahid farmatay hain tum Taurat-o-Injeel parhtay ho aur jantay ho ke Allah Ta'ala ek aur la-shareek hai, phir jantay huay kyun Allah Ta'ala ka shareek thehratay ho? Paanch Ahkaam: Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya Allah Azzawajal ne Hazrat Yahya (A.S) ko paanch cheezon ka hukum diya ke in par amal karo aur Bani Israel ko bhi in par amal karnay ka hukum do, qareeb tha ke woh is mein ghaflat karein to Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne unhein yaad dilaya ke aap ko Parwardigar-e-Aalam ka hukum tha ke in paanch cheezon par khud karband ho kar doosron ko bhi hukum do. Lehaza ya to aap keh dijiye ya main pohancha doon.

Hazrat Yahya A.S ne farmaya mujhe dar hai ke agar aap sabqat le gaye toh kahin mujhe azab na diya jaye ya zameen mein dhansa na diya jaun. Pas Yahya A.S ne Bani Israel ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki masjid mein jama kiya, jab masjid bhar gayi toh aap unchi jagah par baith gaye aur Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana bayan kar ke kaha Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe paanch baton ka hukum kiya hai ke khud bhi amal karun tum se bhi un par amal karaun. Ek yeh ke Allah ek ki ibadat karo us ke sath kisi ko shareek na thahrao, is ki misaal aisi hai jaise koi shakhs khaas apne maal se kisi ghulam ko khareede aur ghulam kaam-kaaj kare lekin jo kuch hasil hua hai use kisi aur ko de de. Kya tum mein se koi is baat ko pasand karta hai ke us ka ghulam aisa ho? Theek isi tarah tumhara paida karne wala, tumhein rozi dene wala, tumhara haqeeqi maalik Allah Ta'ala Wahdahu La Shareeka Lahu hai. Pas tum usi ki ibadat karo aur us ke sath kisi ko shareek na thahrao. Dusri yeh ke namaz ko ada karo, Allah Ta'ala ki nigah bande ki taraf hoti hai jab tak ke woh namaz mein idhar udhar munh na phere, jab tum namaz mein ho toh khabardar idhar udhar iltifat na karna. Teesra hukum yeh hai ke rozay rakha karo, is ki misaal aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ke paas mushk ki thaili bhari hui ho jis se us ke tamam sathiyon ke dimagh muattar rahein. Yaad rakho rozay-dar ke munh ki khushbu Allah Ta'ala ko mushk ki khushbu se bhi zyada pasand hai. Chautha hukum yeh hai ke sadqa dete raha karo, is ki misaal aisi hai jaise kisi shakhs ko dushmanon ne qaid kar liya aur gardan ke sath us ke hath bandh diye, gardan maarne ke liye le jaane lage toh woh kehne laga ke tum mujh se fidiya le lo aur mujhe chhod do, chunancha jo kuch tha kam zyada de kar apni jaan chuda li. Panchwan is ka hukum yeh hai ke ba-kasrat us ke naam ka zikr kiya karo, is ki misaal us shakhs ki tarah hai jis ke peeche tezi ke sath dushman daudta aata hai aur woh ek mazboot qila mein ghus jata hai aur wahan aman-o-aman pa leta hai, isi tarah banda Allah Ta'ala ke zikr ke waqt shaitan se bacha hua hota hai. Yeh farma kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya ab main bhi tumhein paanch baton ka hukum karta hun jin ka hukum Janab-e-Bari ne mujhe diya hai: Musalmanon ki jamaat ko lazim pakde rehna, Allah aur us ke Rasool aur musalman hakim-e-waqt ke ahkaam sunna aur manna, hijrat karna aur jihad karna. Jo shakhs jamaat se ek balisht bhar nikal jaye goya woh Islam ke patte ko apne gale se utaar phenke ga, haan yeh aur baat hai ke rujoo kar le. Jo shakhs jahiliyat ki pukaar pukare woh jahannam ka kooda-karkat hai. Logon ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ agarche woh rozay-dar aur namazi ho? Farmaya agarche namaz padhta ho aur rozay bhi rakhta ho aur apne aap ko musalman samajhta ho. Musalmanon ko un ke un namon ke sath pukarte raho jo khud Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne rakhe hain: Muslimeen, Momineen aur Ibaad-ullah. Yeh hadith hasan hai. Is aayat mein bhi yahi bayan hai ke Allah Ta'ala hi ne tumhein paida kiya hai, wahi tumhein rozi deta hai, pas ibadat bhi usi ki karo.

Is ke sath kisi ko shareek na karo. Is ayat se sabit hota hai ke ibadat mein Tauheed-e-Bari Ta'ala ka poora khayal rakhna chahiye, kisi aur ki ibadat na karni chahiye, har ek ibadat ke laiq sirf wahi hai. Isbat-e-Wujood-e-Ilah-ul-Alameen: Imam Razi (R.H) waghera ne Allah Ta'ala ke wujood par bhi is ayat se istidlal kiya hai. Aur filwaqia yeh ayat Allah Ta'ala ke wujood par bahut badi daleel hai. Zameen aur aasman ki mukhtalif shakal-o-surat, mukhtalif rang, mukhtalif mizaj aur mukhtalif nafa ki maujoodat, in mein se har ek ka nafa bakhsh hona aur khas hikmat ka hamil hona un ke Khaliq ke wujood ka aur us ki azeem-ush-shan qudrat, hikmat, zabardast satwat aur saltanat ka suboot hai. Kisi badwi se poocha gaya ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki maujoodgi ki kya daleel hai? To us ne kaha (SubhanAllah! Innal ba'ra layadullu alal ba'eer, wa asaral aqdami layadullu alal maseer, fasama'un zatu abrajin wa ardun zatu fijajin wa biharun zatu amwajin, ala yadullu zalika ala wujoodil Lateefil Khabeer). Yani mengni se oont maloom ho sake aur paon ke nishan zameen par dekh kar maloom ho jaye ke koi aadmi gaya hai, to kya yeh burjon wala aasman, yeh raston wali zameen, yeh maujein maarne wale samandar Allah Ta'ala Bareek-been aur Bakhabar ke wujood par daleel nahin ho sakte? Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) se Haroon Rasheed ne poocha ke Allah Ta'ala ke wujood par kya daleel hai? Aap ne farmaya: Zabanon ka mukhtalif hona, aawazon ka judagana hona, naghmon ka alag hona, sabit karta hai ke Allah Ta'ala hai. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) se bhi yahi sawal hota hai to aap jawab dete hain ke chhoro main kisi aur soch mein hoon. Logon ne mujh se kaha hai ke ek bahut badi kashti jis mein tarah tarah ki tijarati cheezein hain, na koi us ka nigahban hai na chalane wala hai, bawajood is ke woh barabar aa ja rahi hai aur badi badi maujon ko khud-ba-khud cheer-ti phaarti guzar jati hai, thaharne ki jagah par thahar jati hai, chalne ki jagah chalti rahti hai, na us ka koi mallah hai na muntazim. Sawal karne wale dahriyon ne kaha aap kis soch mein pad gaye? Koi aqalmand aisi baat kah sakta hai ke itni badi kashti itne bade nizam ke sath talatum wale samandar mein aaye jaye aur koi us ka chalane wala na ho? Aap ne farmaya afsos tumhari aqlon par! Ek kashti to baghair chalane wale ke na chal sake lekin yeh sari duniya, aasman-o-zameen ki sab cheezein theek apne kaam par lagi rahen aur un ka malik, hakim, khaliq koi na ho? Yeh jawab sun kar woh log hakka bakka ho gaye aur haq maloom kar ke musalman ho gaye. Hazrat Imam Shafi (R.H) se bhi yahi sawal hua to aap ne jawab diya ke toot ke patte ek hi hain, ek hi zaiqay ke hain, keede aur shahad ki makkhi aur gaayein, bakriyan, hiran waghera sab us ko chabate khate aur charte chugte hain, isi ko kha kar resham ka keeda resham tayar karta hai, makkhi shahad banati hai, hiran mein mushk paida hota hai aur gaayein bakriyan mengniyan deti hain.

Kya yeh us amr-e-ilahi ki saaf daleel nahin ke ek patte mein yeh mukhtalif khawas paida karne wala koi hai? Aur isi ko hum Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala maante hain, wahi maujid aur saani hai. Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) se bhi ek martaba wujood-e-bari Ta'ala par daleel talab ki gayi toh aap ne farmaya: Suno, yahan ek nihayat mazboot qila hai jis mein koi darwaza nahin, na koi rasta hai, balkeh soorakh tak nahin. Bahar se chandi ki tarah chamak raha hai aur andar se sone ki tarah damak raha hai, oopar neeche dayen bayen charon taraf se bilkul band hai, hawa tak is mein nahin ja sakti. Achanak is ki ek deewar girti hai aur ek jandar aankhon, kaanon wala khoobsurat shakal aur pyari boli wala chalta phirta nikal aata hai. Batao is band aur mehfooz makaan mein ise paida karne wala koi hai ya nahin? Aur woh hasti insani hastiyon se balatar aur us ki qudrat ghair mehdood hai ya nahin? Aap ka matlab yeh tha ke ande ko dekho, charon taraf se band hai, phir is mein parwardigar khaliq-e-yakta jandar bacha paida kar deta hai. Yehi daleel hai Allah ke wujood par aur us ki tauheed par. Hazrat Abu Nuwas se jab yeh masla poocha gaya toh aap ne farmaya: Aasman se barish barasna, us se darakhton ka paida hona aur in hari hari shakhon par khush-zaiqa mewon ka lagna hi Allah Ta'ala ke wujood aur us ki wahdaniyat ki kaafi daleel hai. Ibn-ul-Mu'taz farmate hain: Afsos! Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani aur us ki takzeeb par log kaise daleer ho jate hain, halankeh har cheez us parwardigar ke maujood aur la-shareek hone par gawah hai. Buzurgon ka maqoola hai ke aasmanon ko dekho, un ki bulandi, un ki wus'at, un ke chote bade chamkile aur roshan sitaron par nazrein daalo. Un ke chamakne damakne, un ke chalne phirne, thehar jaane, zahir hone aur chup jaane ka mutala'a karo. Samundaron ko dekho, jo maujein maarte hue zameen ko ghere hue hain. Oonche neeche mazboot pahadon ko dekho jo zameen mein gade hue hain aur ise hilne nahin dete, jin ke rang, jin ki soortein mukhtalif hain. Qism qism ki doosri makhlooqat par nazar daalo, idhar se udhar phir jaane wali khetiyon aur baghon ko shadab karne wali khush-numa nehron ko dekho. Kheeton, baghon ki sabziyon aur un ke tarah tarah ke phal phool, maze maze ke mewon par gaur karo. Zameen ek, pani ek, lekin shaklein, soortein, khushbooyen, rang, zaiqa, faida alag alag. Kya yeh tamam masnooaat tumhein nahin batatin ke in ka saani koi hai? Kya yeh tamam maujoodaat ba-awaz-e-buland nahin keh rahin ke in ka maujid koi hai? Kya yeh sari makhlooq apne khaliq ki hasti, us ki zaat aur us ki tauheed par dalalat nahin karti? Yeh hain woh zor-dar dalail jo Allah Jalla wa 'Ala ne apni zaat ke manwane ke liye har nigah ke samne pesh kar diye hain, jo us ki zabardast qudraton, us ki pur-zor hikmaton, us ki lasani rehmaton, us ke benazeer inaamon, us ke lazawal ehsanon par dalalat karne ke liye kaafi waafi hain.

Hum iqrar karte hain ke na is ka koi palne wala hai, na is ke siwa koi paida karne aur hifazat karne wala, na is ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq, na is ke siwa koi masjood-e-la-shak. Haan duniya ke logo! Sun lo mera tawakkul aur bharosa isi par hai, meri inabat aur iltija isi ki taraf hai, mera jhukna aur past hona isi ke samne hai, meri tamannaon ka markaz, meri ummidon ka aasra, mera mawa, malja wahi ek hai, is ke dast-e-rahmat ko takta hoon aur isi ka naam japta hoon.

Ta'aruf-e-Allah bazuban-e-Allah. Yahan se Allah Ta'ala ki tauheed aur uski uluhiyat ka bayan shuru hota hai. Wohi apne bandon ko adam se wajood mein laya, usi ne har tarah ki zahiri-o-batini ne'matein ata farmayin, usi ne zameen ko farsh banaya aur is mein mazboot paharon ki meikhein gaar dein aur aasman ko chhat banaya. Jaise ke dusri aayat mein aaya ke aayat (وَجَعَلْنَا السَّمَاۗءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوْظًا ښ وَّهُمْ عَنْ اٰيٰـتِهَا مُعْرِضُوْنَ) (21-Al-Anbiya: 32) yani aasman ko mehfooz chhat banaya iske bawajood woh nishaniyon se munh mor lete hain, aasman se pani utarne ka matlab badal nazil farmana hai. Us waqt jabke log iske pooray mohtaj hon. Phir is pani se tarah tarah ke phal phool paida karna hai jis se log faida uthayen aur unke janwar bhi. Jaise ke Quran-e-Majeed mein jagah jagah iska bayan aaya hai. Ek jagah farmaya hai aayat (اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَّالسَّمَاۗءَ بِنَاۗءً وَّصَوَّرَكُمْ فَاَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ) (40-Ghafir: 64) Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare liye zameen ko farsh aur aasman ko chhat banaya aur tumhein pyari pyari soortein ata farmayin aur tarah tarah ki ghizayein pahunchayin. Yehi Allah hai jo barkaton wala aur tamam aalam ko palne wala hai, pas sab ka khaliq, sab ka raziq, sab ka malik Allah Ta'ala hi hai aur is liye shirk se mubarra har qisam ki ibadat ka wohi mustahiq hai. Aur farmaya "Allah Ta'ala ke shareek na thahrao jabke tum jante ho." Sahihain mein hadith hai "Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood R.A poochte hain Huzoor ﷺ sab se bada gunah kaunsa hai? Farmaya Allah Ta'ala ke sath jo tumhara khaliq hai kisi ko shareek thahrana." Hazrat Mu'az R.A wali hadith mein hai "Jante ho ke Allah ka haq bandon par kya hai? Yeh ke usi ki ibadat karein aur kisi ko uski ibadat mein shareek na karein." Dusri hadith mein hai "Tum mein se koi yeh na kahe ke jo Allah chahe aur falaan chahe balkay yun kahe jo kuch Allah akela chahe." Tufail bin Sanjara Hazrat Ayesha R.A ke sotayle bhai farmate hain main ne khwab mein chand yahudiyon ko dekha aur un se poocha tum kaun ho? Unhon ne kaha tum bhi achhay log ho lekin afsos tum kehte ho jo Allah chahe aur Muhammad ﷺ chahein. Phir main nasraniyon ki jamaat ke paas gaya aur un se bhi isi tarah poocha unhon ne bhi yehi jawab diya. Main ne un se kaha afsos tum bhi Maseeh A.S ko Allah ka beta mante ho. Unhon ne bhi yehi jawab diya. Main ne subah apne is khwab ka zikr kuch logon se kiya phir darbar-e-nabwi mein hazir ho kar Aap ﷺ se bhi yehi khwab bayan kiya.

Aap ne poocha kya kisi aur se bhi tum ne is ka zikr kiya hai? Main ne kaha haan Huzoor (ﷺ). Ab aap kharay ho gaye aur Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana bayan ki aur farmaya Tufail ne ek khwab dekha aur tum mein se baaz ko bayan bhi kiya, main chahta tha ke tumhein is kalma ke kehne se rok doon lekin falan falan kamon ki wajah se main ab tak na keh saka. Yaad rakho "ab hargiz hargiz Allah chahey aur us ka Rasool" kabhi na kehna balkay yun kaho ke sirf Allah Ta'ala akela jo chahey (Ibn Marduyah). Ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kaha jo Allah Ta'ala chahey aur aap chahein. Aap ne farmaya kya tu mujhe Allah Ta'ala ka shareek thehrata hai? Yun keh jo Allah Ta'ala akela chahey (Ibn Marduyah). Aise tamam kalmaat tauheed ke sarasar khilaf hain. Tauheed-e-Bari ki ahmiyat ke baray mein yeh sab ahadees bayan hui hain. Wallahu A'lam. Tamam kuffar aur munafiqon ko Allah Ta'ala ne apni ibadat ka hukum diya aur farmaya Allah ki ibadat karo yani us ki tauheed ke paband ho jao, us ke sath kisi ko shareek na karo jo na nafa de sakay na nuqsan pohancha sakay aur tum jantay ho ke us ke siwa koi Rabb nahin jo tumhein rozi pohancha sakay aur tum jantay ho ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) tumhein is tauheed ki taraf bula rahay hain jis ke haq aur sach honay mein koi shak nahin. Shirk is se bhi zyada posheeda hai jaise cheenti jo raat ke andheray mein kisi saaf patthar par chal rahi ho, qasam hai Allah ki aur qasam hai aap ki hayat ki, yeh bhi shirk hai insaan ka yeh kehna agar yeh kuttiya na hoti to chor raat ko hamaray ghar mein ghus aatay, yeh bhi shirk hai. Aadmi ka yeh qaul ke agar batakh ghar mein na hoti to chori ho jati yeh bhi shirk ka kalma hai, kisi ka yeh qaul ke jo Allah chahey aur aap, yeh bhi shirk hai, kisi ka yeh kehna ke agar Allah na hota aur falan na hota. Yeh sab kalmaat-e-shirk hain. Sahih hadees mein hai ke kisi ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kaha jo Allah chahey aur jo aap chahein to aap ne farmaya kya tu mujhe Allah Ta'ala ka shareek thehrata hai?
