Yani mengni se oont maloom ho sake aur paon ke nishan zameen par dekh kar maloom ho jaye ke koi aadmi gaya hai, to kya yeh burjon wala aasman, yeh raston wali zameen, yeh maujein maarne wale samandar Allah Ta'ala Bareek-been aur Bakhabar ke wujood par daleel nahin ho sakte? Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) se Haroon Rasheed ne poocha ke Allah Ta'ala ke wujood par kya daleel hai? Aap ne farmaya: Zabanon ka mukhtalif hona, aawazon ka judagana hona, naghmon ka alag hona, sabit karta hai ke Allah Ta'ala hai. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) se bhi yahi sawal hota hai to aap jawab dete hain ke chhoro main kisi aur soch mein hoon. Logon ne mujh se kaha hai ke ek bahut badi kashti jis mein tarah tarah ki tijarati cheezein hain, na koi us ka nigahban hai na chalane wala hai, bawajood is ke woh barabar aa ja rahi hai aur badi badi maujon ko khud-ba-khud cheer-ti phaarti guzar jati hai, thaharne ki jagah par thahar jati hai, chalne ki jagah chalti rahti hai, na us ka koi mallah hai na muntazim. Sawal karne wale dahriyon ne kaha aap kis soch mein pad gaye? Koi aqalmand aisi baat kah sakta hai ke itni badi kashti itne bade nizam ke sath talatum wale samandar mein aaye jaye aur koi us ka chalane wala na ho? Aap ne farmaya afsos tumhari aqlon par! Ek kashti to baghair chalane wale ke na chal sake lekin yeh sari duniya, aasman-o-zameen ki sab cheezein theek apne kaam par lagi rahen aur un ka malik, hakim, khaliq koi na ho? Yeh jawab sun kar woh log hakka bakka ho gaye aur haq maloom kar ke musalman ho gaye. Hazrat Imam Shafi (R.H) se bhi yahi sawal hua to aap ne jawab diya ke toot ke patte ek hi hain, ek hi zaiqay ke hain, keede aur shahad ki makkhi aur gaayein, bakriyan, hiran waghera sab us ko chabate khate aur charte chugte hain, isi ko kha kar resham ka keeda resham tayar karta hai, makkhi shahad banati hai, hiran mein mushk paida hota hai aur gaayein bakriyan mengniyan deti hain.

Kya yeh us amr-e-ilahi ki saaf daleel nahin ke ek patte mein yeh mukhtalif khawas paida karne wala koi hai? Aur isi ko hum Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala maante hain, wahi maujid aur saani hai. Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) se bhi ek martaba wujood-e-bari Ta'ala par daleel talab ki gayi toh aap ne farmaya: Suno, yahan ek nihayat mazboot qila hai jis mein koi darwaza nahin, na koi rasta hai, balkeh soorakh tak nahin. Bahar se chandi ki tarah chamak raha hai aur andar se sone ki tarah damak raha hai, oopar neeche dayen bayen charon taraf se bilkul band hai, hawa tak is mein nahin ja sakti. Achanak is ki ek deewar girti hai aur ek jandar aankhon, kaanon wala khoobsurat shakal aur pyari boli wala chalta phirta nikal aata hai. Batao is band aur mehfooz makaan mein ise paida karne wala koi hai ya nahin? Aur woh hasti insani hastiyon se balatar aur us ki qudrat ghair mehdood hai ya nahin? Aap ka matlab yeh tha ke ande ko dekho, charon taraf se band hai, phir is mein parwardigar khaliq-e-yakta jandar bacha paida kar deta hai. Yehi daleel hai Allah ke wujood par aur us ki tauheed par. Hazrat Abu Nuwas se jab yeh masla poocha gaya toh aap ne farmaya: Aasman se barish barasna, us se darakhton ka paida hona aur in hari hari shakhon par khush-zaiqa mewon ka lagna hi Allah Ta'ala ke wujood aur us ki wahdaniyat ki kaafi daleel hai. Ibn-ul-Mu'taz farmate hain: Afsos! Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani aur us ki takzeeb par log kaise daleer ho jate hain, halankeh har cheez us parwardigar ke maujood aur la-shareek hone par gawah hai. Buzurgon ka maqoola hai ke aasmanon ko dekho, un ki bulandi, un ki wus'at, un ke chote bade chamkile aur roshan sitaron par nazrein daalo. Un ke chamakne damakne, un ke chalne phirne, thehar jaane, zahir hone aur chup jaane ka mutala'a karo. Samundaron ko dekho, jo maujein maarte hue zameen ko ghere hue hain. Oonche neeche mazboot pahadon ko dekho jo zameen mein gade hue hain aur ise hilne nahin dete, jin ke rang, jin ki soortein mukhtalif hain. Qism qism ki doosri makhlooqat par nazar daalo, idhar se udhar phir jaane wali khetiyon aur baghon ko shadab karne wali khush-numa nehron ko dekho. Kheeton, baghon ki sabziyon aur un ke tarah tarah ke phal phool, maze maze ke mewon par gaur karo. Zameen ek, pani ek, lekin shaklein, soortein, khushbooyen, rang, zaiqa, faida alag alag. Kya yeh tamam masnooaat tumhein nahin batatin ke in ka saani koi hai? Kya yeh tamam maujoodaat ba-awaz-e-buland nahin keh rahin ke in ka maujid koi hai? Kya yeh sari makhlooq apne khaliq ki hasti, us ki zaat aur us ki tauheed par dalalat nahin karti? Yeh hain woh zor-dar dalail jo Allah Jalla wa 'Ala ne apni zaat ke manwane ke liye har nigah ke samne pesh kar diye hain, jo us ki zabardast qudraton, us ki pur-zor hikmaton, us ki lasani rehmaton, us ke benazeer inaamon, us ke lazawal ehsanon par dalalat karne ke liye kaafi waafi hain.

Hum iqrar karte hain ke na is ka koi palne wala hai, na is ke siwa koi paida karne aur hifazat karne wala, na is ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq, na is ke siwa koi masjood-e-la-shak. Haan duniya ke logo! Sun lo mera tawakkul aur bharosa isi par hai, meri inabat aur iltija isi ki taraf hai, mera jhukna aur past hona isi ke samne hai, meri tamannaon ka markaz, meri ummidon ka aasra, mera mawa, malja wahi ek hai, is ke dast-e-rahmat ko takta hoon aur isi ka naam japta hoon.

Tasdeeq-e-Nabuwwat Aijaz-e-Quran. Tauheed ke baad ab Nabuwwat ki tasdeeq ki ja rahi hai. Kuffar-e-Makkah ko khitab kar ke farmaya ja raha hai ke hum ne jo Quran-e-Pak apne bande Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utara hai, ise agar tum hamara kalam nahin maante to tum aur tumhare madadgar sab mil kar poora Quran nahin, sirf ek surat to is jaisi bana lao. Jab tum aisa nahin kar sakte aur is se aajiz ho to phir is Quran ke Kalam-e-Allah hone mein kyun shak karte ho? Apne hum-fikr aur madadgar sab ko jama karo to bhi tum sab nakam rahoge. Matlab yeh hai ke jinhein tum ne apna mabood bana rakha hai unhein bhi bula lo aur un se bhi madad chaho, phir is jaisi ek surat hi to bana lao. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke tum apne hakimon aur apne zaban-dan faseeh-o-baleeg logon se bhi madad le lo. Quran-e-Pak ke is mojize ka izhar aur aisa andaz-e-khitab kayi jagah hai. Surah Qasas mein hai, aayat: (Qul fa'tu bi-kitabin min 'indillahi huwa ahda minhuma attabi'hu in kuntum sadiqin) (28. Al-Qasas: 49), yani agar tum sache ho to in dono se (yani Taurat-o-Quran se) zyada hidayat wali koi aur Allah ki kitab lao to main bhi is ki tabedari karunga. Surah Subhan (Bani Israel) mein farmaya, aayat: (Qul la'in ijtama'atil-insu wal-jinnu 'ala ay-ya'tu bi-mithli hadhal-qur'ani la ya'tuna bi-mithlihi wa law kana ba'duhum li-ba'din zahira) (17. Al-Isra: 88), yani agar tamam jinnat aur insaan jama ho kar aur har ek dusre ki madad ke sath yeh chahein ke is jaisa Quran banayein to bhi un ke imkan mein nahin. Surah Hud mein farmaya, aayat: (Am yaquluna-ftarahu, qul fa'tu bi-'ashri suwarim-mithlihi muftarayatin wad'u manistata'tum min dunillahi in kuntum sadiqin) (11. Hud: 13), yani kya yeh log yun kehte hain ke Quran ko khud is paighambar ne ghad liya? Tum kaho ke agar tum sache ho to tum sab mil kar aur Allah ke siwa jinhein tum bula sakte ho bula kar is jaisi das suratein hi bana lao. Surah Yunus mein hai, aayat: (Wa ma kana hadhal-qur'anu ay-yuftara min dunillahi wa lakin tasdiqalladhi baina yadayhi wa tafsilal-kitabi la raiba fihi mir-rabbil-'alamin) (10. Yunus: 37), yani yeh Quran Allah Ta'ala ke siwa aur kisi ki taraf se ghada hua nahin, balkeh yeh agli kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wala aur kitab-e-tafseel hai, jis ke Allah ka kalam hone mein koi shak nahin jo Rabb-ul-Alameen ki taraf se hai. Kya yeh log ise khud-sakhta kehte hain? In se kaho ke Allah ke siwa har shakhs ko bula kar is Quran ki saikdon suraton mein se ek chhoti si surat jaisi surat to bana lao taake tumhara sach zahir ho.

Yeh tamam aayatein Makkah Mukarramah mein nazil huin aur Ahl-e-Makkah ko is ke muqable mein aajiz sabit kar ke phir Madina Sharif mein bhi is mazmoon ko dohraya gaya. Upar ki aayat 'mislihi' ki zameer ko baaz ne Quran ki taraf lautaya hai, yani koi surat is Quran jaisi lao. Baaz ne yeh zameer Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf lautayi hai, yani aap jaisa koi ummi aisa ho hi nahin sakta hai ke kuch padha hua na hone ke bawajood woh kalam kahe jis ka misl kisi se na ban sake, lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai. Mujahid, Qatada, Amr bin Masood, Ibn Abbas, Hasan Basri aur aksar muhaqqiqeen ka yahi qaul hai. Imam Ibn Jarir Tabari, Zamakhshari, Razi ne bhi isi ko pasand kiya hai. Is ki tarjeeh ki wajoohaat bahut si hain. Ek to yeh ke is mein sab ko daant-dupat bhi hai, ijtima'i aur alag-alag bhi. Khwah woh ummi aur an-padh hon ya Ahl-e-Kitab aur padhe-likhe hon, is mein is mojize ka kamal hai aur ba-nisbat is ke ke sirf an-padh logon ko aajiz kiya jaye, is mein zyada mubalagha hai. Phir das suraton ka mutalba karna, is ki misl na la sakne ki pesh-goi karna bhi isi haqeeqat ko sabit karta hai ke is se murad Quran hai na ke zaat-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Pas is aam elaan se jo baar-baar kiya gaya aur sath hi pesh-goi bhi kar di gayi ke yeh log is par qadir nahin. Makkah mein aur Madina mein barha is ka i'ada kiya gaya aur woh log jin ki madri zaban Arabi thi, jinhein apni fasahat aur balaghat par naaz tha, jo log aap ki aur aap ke deen ki dushmani par udhaar kha baithe the, woh dar-haqeeqat is se aajiz aa gaye. Na poore Quran ka jawab de sake, na das suraton ka, na ek surat ka. Pas ek mojiza to yeh hai ke is jaisi ek chhoti si surat bhi woh na bana sake. Doosra mojiza yeh hai ke pesh-goi sach sabit hui ke yeh hargiz is jaisa nahin bana sakte chahe sab jama ho jayen aur Qayamat tak mehnat kar lein. Pas aisa hi hua, na to us zamane mein kisi ki yeh jurrat hui, na us ke baad se aaj tak aur na Qayamat tak kisi se yeh ho sake ga. Aur bhala kaise ho sakta? Jis tarah Allah Ta'ala ki zaat be-misl, usi tarah us ka kalam bhi. Haqeeqat bhi yeh hai ke Quran-e-Pak ko ba-ek nazar dekhne se hi is ke zahiri aur batini, lafzi aur manvi aise-aise kamalaat zahir hote hain jo makhlooq ke bas ke nahin. Khud Rabb-ul-Aalameen farmata hai aayat: (Alif-Laam-Raa, Kitabun uhkimat aayatuhu thumma fussilat min ladun Hakeemin Khabeer) (Surah Hud: 1). Yani is kitab ki aayatein jo hikmat wale, har tarah ki khabrein janne wale Allah ki taraf se nazil shuda hain, mohkam, mazboot aur mufassal alag-alag hain. Pas alfaaz mohkam aur ma'ani mufassal, ya alfaaz mufassal aur ma'ani mohkam. Pas Quran apne alfaaz mein aur apne mazameen mein be-nazeer hai jis ke muqable, mu'arize aur misl se duniya aajiz aur be-bas hai. Is pak kalam mein agli khabrein jo duniya se posheeda thin woh ho-ba-ho bayan ki gayin, aane wale umoor ke tazkire kiye gaye jo lafz-ba-lafz poore utre. Tamam bhalaiyon ka hukm, tamam buraiyon se muman'at is mein hai. Sach hai aayat: (Wa tammat kalimatu Rabbika sidqan wa adlan) (Surah Al-An'am: 115).

(Al-An'am: 115) Ya'ni khabaron mein sadaqat aur ahkam mein adl tere Rab ke kalam mein poora poora hai. Pakeeza Quran tamam-tar haq-o-sadaqat-o-hidayat se pur hai, na is mein wahi-tawahi baatein hain, na hansi mazak, na kizb-o-iftira jo shairon ke kalam mein umooman paya jata hai. Balkeh un ke ashaar ki qadr-o-qeemat hi isi par maqoola mashhoor hai ke "A'zhabuhu akzhabuhu" (jitna jhoot zyada utna hi mazeedar). Tum dekho ge ke lambe lambe pur-zor qaseeday mubaligha aur kizb-amez ya toh aurton ki tareef-o-tauseef mein hon ge, ya ghoron ki aur sharab ki sataish mein hon ge, ya kisi insaan ki barhi charhi madh-o-tareef mein hon ge, ya oontniyon ki aaraish-o-zebaish, ya bahaduri ke mubaligha-amez geet, ya laraiyon ki chaalbaziyon ya dar-khauf ke khayali manzaron ke bayan mein hon ge jin se koi faida nahin. Na deen ka na duniya ka, sirf shair ki zaban-dani aur us ki qudrat-e-kalam zahir hoti hai. Na akhlaq par un se koi umda asar, na a'maal par. Phir nafs-e-mazmoon ke sath pooray qaseeday mein bamushkil do ek shair hote hain. Baqi sab bharti ke aur idhar udhar ki layani aur fazool bakwas. Barkhilaf is ke Quran-e-Pak ke is par nazar dalo toh dekho ge ke is ka ek ek lafz fasahat-o-balaghat se, deen-o-duniya ke nafa se, khair-o-barkat se pur hai. Phir kalam ki tarteeb-o-tehzeeb, alfaaz ki bandish, ibarat ki rawani, ma'ani ki nooraniyat, mazmoon ki pakeezgi, sone par suhaga hai. Is ki khabaron ki halawat, is ke bayan karda waqiyat ki salasat, murda dilon ki zindagi hai. Is ka ikhtisar kamaal ka a'la namoona aur is ki tafseel mojze ki jaan hai. Is ka kisi cheez ka dohrana qand-e-mukarrar ka maza deta hai, aisa maloom hota hai goya sachay motiyon ki barish baras rahi hai. Bar bar parho dil na uktaye, mazay lete jao aur har waqt naya maza pao. Mazameen samajhte jao aur khatam na hon. Yeh Quran-e-Pak ka hi khasa hai. Is chashni ka zaiqa, is mithas ka maza koi us se pooche jinhein aql-o-hawas, ilm-o-fazl ka kuch hissa qudrat ne ata farmaya. Is ki tanzeer, dhamkawa, ta'zeeb aur pakar-dhakar ka bayan mazboot paharon ko hila de. Insani dil kya hain? Is ke wa'day aur khushkhabriyaan, ne'maton aur rehmaton ka bayan dilon ki pajmurda kali ko khila dene wala, shauq-o-tamanna ke dabay jazbaat ko ubhaar dene wala, jannaton aur rahaton ke pyare pyare manzaron ko aankhon ke samne lane wala hai. Dil khul jate hain, kaan lag jate hain aur aankhein khul jati hain. Raghibat dete hue woh farmata hai: Ayat (FALA TA'LAMU NAFSUM-MA UKHFIYA LAHUM MIN QURRAT-I-A'YUNIN JAZA'AM-BIMA KANU YA'MALUN) (As-Sajdah: 17). Is daimi jannat mein har woh cheez hai jo dil ko bhaye aur aankhon mein utar jaye. Darate aur dhamkate hue farmaya: Ayat (AFA-AMINTUM AY-YAKHSIFA BIKUM JANIBAL BARR) (17).

(Al-Isra: 68) Farmaya (A-amintum man fis-sama-i ay-yakhsifa bikumul-arda fa-iza hiya tamoor. Am amintum man fis-sama-i ay-yursila alaikum hasiban fasata'lamoona kaifa nazeer) (Al-Mulk: 16-17). Kya tum apne dhansaye jaane ya aasman se patthar barsaye jaane se nadar ho gaye ho? Kya aasmanon wala is par qadir nahin? Ise mehez dhamki hi na samjho balkay is ki haqeeqat anqareeb tum par khul jayegi. Zajr-o-taubeeh daant dapat karte hue irshad hota hai. Aayat (Fakullan akhazna bizanbih) (Al-Ankabut: 40). Ek ek ko hum ne is ki badkirdariyon mein pakad liya. Batour-e-wa'z-o-naseehat bayan hota hai aayat (Afara-aita im-matta'nahum sineen. Summa ja-ahum ma kanu yoo'adoon. Ma aghna anhum ma kanu yumatta'oon) (Ash-Shu'ara: 205-207). Agar hum ne kuch saal inhein faida nahin diya toh kya hua? Aakhir wa'day ki ghadi aa pahunchi aur is jaah-o-jalal ne koi nafa na bakhsha. Garaz koi kahan tak bayan kare jis mazmoon ka zikr kiya, ise kamal tak pahuncha kar choda aur tarah tarah ki fasahat-o-balaghat, halawat-o-hikmat se ma'moor kar diya. Ahkam ke hukm aur rok tok ko dekhiye har hukm achhai, bhalai, nafa aur pakeezgi ka jami' hai. Har muman'at qabahat, razalat aur khabasat ki qati' hai. Ibn-e-Masood R.A waghera aslaf-e-ummat ka qaul hai ke jab Quran mein aayat (Ya ayyuhallazeena amanu) aaye toh kaan laga do, ya toh kisi achhai ka hukm hoga ya kisi burai se mana kiya jayega. Khud Parwardigar-e-Aalam farmata hai aayat (Ya'muruhum bil-ma'roofi wa yan-hahum anil-munkari wa yuhillu lahumut-tayyibati wa yuharrimu alaihimul-khaba-isa wa yada'u anhum israhum wal-aghlallati kanat alaihim) (Al-A'raf: 157). Ya'ni bhalaiyon ka hukm deta hai, buraiyon se rokta hai, pakeeza cheezein halal qarar deta hai, khabees cheezein haram karta hai, woh bojh-tal bediyan jo paon mein thin, woh sakht tauq jo galon mein thay utaar phenkta hai. Qayamat ke bayan ki aayatein hain ke holnak manazir, jannat-o-dozakh ka bayan, rehmaton aur zehmaton ka poora poora wasf. Auliya-e-Allah ke liye tarah tarah ki ne'matein, dushmanan-e-Allah ke liye tarah tarah ke azaab. Kahin basharat hai, kahin darawa hai, kahin nekiyon ki taraf raghbat hai, kahin badkariyon se muman'at hai, kahin duniya ki taraf se zuhd karne ki, kahin aakhirat ki taraf raghbat karne ki ta'leem hai. Yehi woh tamam aayatein hain jo raah-e-raast dikhati hain aur behtar rehnumai karti hain, Allah ki pasandeeda shariat ki taraf jhukati hain aur dilon ko jala deti hain aur shaitani darwazon ko band kar deti hain aur buray asraat ko zail karti hain.

Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein barwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya har Nabi ko aise mojze diye gaye ke jinhein dekh kar log us par iman laye aur mera mojza Allah ki wahi yani Quran-e-Pak hai is liye mujhe umeed hai ke mere tabe-dar ba-nisbat aur nabiyon ke bahut zyada honge is liye ke aur ambiya ke mojze un ke sath chale gaye lekin Huzoor (ﷺ) ka yeh mojza Qayamat tak baqi rahe ga. Log ise dekhte jayenge aur Islam mein dakhil hote jayenge. Huzoor (ﷺ) ka yeh farman ke mera mojza wahi hai jo mujh ko di gayi hai ka matlab yeh hai ke mujh ko is ke sath makhsoos kiya gaya hai aur Quran-e-Kareem mujhi ko mila hai jo apne muarize aur muqable mein tamam duniya ko aajiz kar dene wala hai. Ba-khilaf dusri aasmani kitabon ke woh aksar ulama ke nazdeek is wasf se khali hain, wallahu a'lam. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ki nabuwat, aap ki sadaqat aur Deen-e-Islam ki haqaniyat par is mojze ke ilawa bhi is qadar dalail hain jo gine bhi nahin ja sakte. Lillahil hamdu wal minnah. Ba'az mutakallimeen ne Quran-e-Kareem ke i'jaz ko aise andaz se bayan kiya hai jo Ahl-e-Sunnat ke aur Mu'tazila ke qaul par mushtarak hai. Woh kehte hain ke ya to yeh Quran fi-nafsihi mojza hai jo insan ke imkan mein hi nahin ke is jaisa bana la sake, unhein is ka muariza karne ki qudrat-o-taqat hi nahin. Ya yeh ke go is ka muariza mumkin hai aur insani taqat se bahar nahin lekin bawajood is ke unhein muariza ka challenge diya jata hai is liye ke woh adawat aur dushmani mein barhe hue hain, Deen-e-Haq ko mitane, har waqt har taqat ke kharch karne aur har cheez ke barbad karne ke liye tayyar hain lekin taham Quran ka muariza aur muqabla un se nahin ho sakta. Yeh is baat ki daleel hai ke Quran Allah ki janib se hai agar qudrat-o-taqat ho bhi to bhi woh unhein rok deta hai aur woh Quran ki misl pesh karne se aajiz ho jate hain. Go yeh pichli wajah itni pasandida nahin taham agar ise bhi maan liya jaye to is se bhi Quran-e-Pak ka mojza hona sabit hota hai jo ba-tareeq-e-tanazzul himayat-e-haq aur munazre ki khatir salahiyat rakhta hai. Imam Razi ne bhi choti choti suraton ke sawal ke jawab mein yahi tareeqa ikhtiyar kiya hai. Jahannam ka indhan, waqood ke ma'ani indhan ke hain jis se aag jalayi jaye. Jaise chaptiyan, lakriyan waghera. Quran-e-Kareem mein ek jagah hai ayat (Wa ammal qasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataba) (Surah Al-Jinn: 15) zalim log jahannam ki lakriyan hain aur jagah farmaya tum aur tumhare mabood jo Allah ke siwa hain jahannam ki lakriyan hain tum sab is mein warid hoge agar woh sache mabood hote to wahan warid na hote darasal yeh sab ke sab is mein hamesha rehne wale hain aur hijara kehte hain patthar ko yahan murad gandhak ke sakht siyah aur bare bare aur bad-bu-dar patthar hain jin ki aag bahut tez hoti hai Allah Ta'ala hamein mehfooz rakhe. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain in pattharon ko zameen-o-aasman ki paidaish ke sath hi aasman-e-awwal par paida kiya gaya hai.

(Ibn-e-Jarir, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim, Mustadrak Hakim) Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A) aur chand aur Sahaba (R.A) se Suddi ne naqal kiya hai ke Jahannam mein yeh siyah gandhak ke patthar bhi hain jin ki sakht aag se kafiron ko azab kiya jaye ga. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain in pattharon ki badbu murdar ki bu se bhi zyada hai. Muhammad bin Ali (R.H) aur Ibn-e-Jurayj (R.H) bhi kehte hain ke murad gandhak ke bade bade aur sakht patthar hain. Ba'az ne kaha hai murad woh patthar jin ki murtiyan banayi jati hain aur phir un ki parastish ki jati thi, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (INNAKUM WAMA TA'BUDUNA MIN DUNILLAHI HASABU JAHANNAM, ANTUM LAHA WARIDUN) (21. Al-Anbiya: 98) tum aur tumhare woh ma'bud jo Allah ke siwa hain Jahannam ki lakriyan hain. Qurtubi (R.H) aur Razi (R.H) ne isi qaul ko tarjeeh di hai aur kaha hai ke gandhak ke patthar jo kisi shakal mein bhi Allah ke siwa pooje jate hon, lekin yeh wajah koi qawi wajah nahin is liye ke jab aag gandhak ke pattharon se sulgayi jaye to zahir hai ke us ki tezi aur hararat mamooli aag se bahut zyada hogi, us ka bhadakna, jalna, sozish aur sholay bhi bahut zyada honge. Alawa is ke phir Salaf se bhi is ki tafsir yahi marwi hai, isi tarah in pattharon mein aag ka lagna bhi zahir hai. Aur aayat ka maqsood aag ki aur us ki sozish ka bayan karna hai aur us ke bayan ke liye bhi yahan patthar se murad gandhak ke patthar lena zyada munasib hai taake woh aag tez ho aur us se bhi azab mein sakhti ho. Quran-e-Karim mein hai aayat (KULLAMA KHABAT ZIDNAHUM SA'IRA) (17. Al-Isra: 97) jahan sholay halkay hue ke hum ne aur bhadka diya. Ek hadith mein hai har moezi aag mein hai lekin yeh hadith mehfooz aur ma'roof nahin. Qurtubi (R.H) farmate hain is ke do ma'ni hain, ek yeh ke har woh shakhs jo dusron ko eiza de Jahannami hai, dusre yeh ke har eiza-dahinda cheez Jahannam ki aag mein majood hogi jo Jahannamiyon ko azab degi. A'iddat ya'ni tayyar ki gayi hai, murad bazahir yahi maloom hoti hai ke woh aag kafiron ke liye tayyar ki gayi hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke murad patthar hon ya'ni woh patthar jo kafiron ke liye tayyar kiye gaye hain. Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A) ka yahi qaul hai aur fil-haqiqat dono ma'ni mein koi ikhtilaf nahin is liye ke pattharon ka tayyar kiya jana aag ke jalane ke liye hai. Lehaza aag ki tayyari ke liye pattharon ka tayyar kiya jana zaroori hai. Pas dono ek dusre ke sath lazim-o-malzoom hain. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain har woh shakhs jo kufr par ho us ke liye woh aag tayyar hai. Is aayat se istidlal kiya gaya hai ke Jahannam ab majood aur paida shuda hai kyunke "A'iddat" ka lafz hi is ki daleel mein aaya hai. Bahut si hadithein bhi hain. Ek mutawwal hadith mein hai Jannat aur Dozakh mein jhagda hua, dusri hadith mein hai Jahannam ne Allah Ta'ala se do saans lene ki ijazat chahi aur usay sardi mein ek saans lene aur garmi mein dusra saans lene ki ijazat de di gayi.

Teesri hadith mein hai Sahaba kehte hain hum ne ek martaba bade zor ki ek aawaz suni, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha yeh kis cheez ki aawaz hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya sattar saal pehle ek patthar Jahannam mein phenka gaya tha aaj woh teh ko pahuncha. Chauthi hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne suraj grahan ki namaz padhte hue Jahannam ko dekha. Paanchvi hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Shab-e-Meraj mein Jahannam ko aur is mein azabon ke silsile ko mulahiza farmaya, isi tarah aur bahut si sahih mutawatir hadeesein marwi hain. Mu'tazila apni jahalat ki wajah se inhe nahin maante, Qazi-e-Andalus Munzir bin Saeed Balooti ne bhi un se ittefaq kiya hai. Magar yeh yaad rakhna chahiye ke yahan aur Surah Yunus mein jo kaha gaya hai ke ek hi Surah ke manind lao, is mein har chhoti badi aayat shamil hai. Is liye Arabiyat ke qa'ide ke mutabiq jo ism-e-nakira ho aur shart ke taur par laya gaya ho woh umoomiyat ka faida deta hai, jaise ke nakira nafi ki taht mein istighraq ka faida deta hai. Pas lambi suraton aur chhoti suraton sab mein i'jaz hai aur is baat par Salaf-o-Khalaf ka ittefaq hai. Imam Razi apni Tafsir mein likhte hain ke agar koi kahe ke Surah ka lafz Surah Al-Kauthar aur Surah Al-Asr aur Surah aayat (Qul ya ayyuhal kafiroon) jaisi chhoti suraton par bhi mushtamil hai aur yeh bhi yaqeen ho ke is jaisi ya is ke qareeb qareeb kisi Surah ka bana lena mumkin hai to ise insani taqat se kharij kehna niri hat-dharmi aur beja taraf-dari hai, to hum jawab denge ke hum ne is ke mo'jiz-numa hone ke do tareeqe bayan kar ke dusre tareeqe ko isi liye pasand kiya hai. Hum kehte hain ke agar yeh chhoti suratein bhi fasahat-o-balaghat mein isi paya ki hain ke woh mo'jiza kahi ja sakein aur inkar-e-ta'aruz mumkin na ho to maqsood hasil ho gaya aur agar yeh suratein aisi nahin to bhi hamara maqsood hasil hai, is liye ke in jaisi suraton ko banane ki insani qudrat hone par bhi sakht dushmani aur zabardast koshishon ke bawajood nakam rehna hai. Is baat ki saaf daleel hai ke yeh Quran ma' apni chhoti chhoti suraton ke sarasar mo'jiza hai. Yeh to Razi ka kehna hai. Lekin sahih qaul yeh hai ke Quran-e-Pak ki har badi chhoti Surah fil-waq'a mo'jiza hai aur insaan is ki manind banane se mahaz aajiz aur bilkul bebass hai. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain agar log ghaur-o-tadabbur se, aql-o-hosh se Surah Al-Asr ko samajh lein to intehai kaafi hai. Hazrat Amr bin Aas (R.A) jab wafd mein shamil Musailima Kazzab ke paas gaye (tab yeh khud bhi musalman nahin hue the) to Musailima ne un se poocha ke tum Makkah se aa rahe ho batao to aaj kal koi taza wahi bhi nazil hui hai? Unhone kaha abhi abhi ek mukhtasar si Surah nazil hui hai jo behad faseeh-o-baleeh aur jame' aur mani' hai, phir Surah Al-Asr padh kar sunayi to Musailima ne kuch der soch kar is ke muqable mein kaha.

Mujh par bhi ek aisi hi surat nazil hui hai. Unhon ne kaha haan tum bhi sunao, toh usne kaha: Yaubar, Yaubar, innama anta udhunan wa sadrun wa sa'iruka haqrun faqrun. Ya'ni: Ae jungli chuhe! Ae jungli chuhe! Tera wajood siwaye do kanon aur seene ke aur kuch bhi nahin, baqi toh sarasar bilkul na-cheez hai. Phir fakriya kehne laga: Kaho ae Amr! Kaisi kahi? Unhon ne kaha: Mujh se kya poochte ho? Tu khud jaanta hai ke yeh sarasar kizb-o-buhtan hai. Bhala kahan yeh fazool kalam aur kahan hikmaton se bharpoor woh kalam?

Tasdeeq-e-Nabuwwat Aijaz-e-Quran. Tauheed ke baad ab Nabuwwat ki tasdeeq ki ja rahi hai. Kuffar-e-Makkah ko khitab kar ke farmaya ja raha hai ke hum ne jo Quran-e-Pak apne bande Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utara hai, ise agar tum hamara kalam nahin maante to tum aur tumhare madadgar sab mil kar poora Quran nahin, sirf ek surat to is jaisi bana lao. Jab tum aisa nahin kar sakte aur is se aajiz ho to phir is Quran ke Kalam-e-Allah hone mein kyun shak karte ho? Apne hum-fikr aur madadgar sab ko jama karo to bhi tum sab nakam rahoge. Matlab yeh hai ke jinhein tum ne apna mabood bana rakha hai unhein bhi bula lo aur un se bhi madad chaho, phir is jaisi ek surat hi to bana lao. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke tum apne hakimon aur apne zaban-dan faseeh-o-baleeg logon se bhi madad le lo. Quran-e-Pak ke is mojize ka izhar aur aisa andaz-e-khitab kayi jagah hai. Surah Qasas mein hai, aayat: (Qul fa'tu bi-kitabin min 'indillahi huwa ahda minhuma attabi'hu in kuntum sadiqin) (28. Al-Qasas: 49), yani agar tum sache ho to in dono se (yani Taurat-o-Quran se) zyada hidayat wali koi aur Allah ki kitab lao to main bhi is ki tabedari karunga. Surah Subhan (Bani Israel) mein farmaya, aayat: (Qul la'in ijtama'atil-insu wal-jinnu 'ala ay-ya'tu bi-mithli hadhal-qur'ani la ya'tuna bi-mithlihi wa law kana ba'duhum li-ba'din zahira) (17. Al-Isra: 88), yani agar tamam jinnat aur insaan jama ho kar aur har ek dusre ki madad ke sath yeh chahein ke is jaisa Quran banayein to bhi un ke imkan mein nahin. Surah Hud mein farmaya, aayat: (Am yaquluna-ftarahu, qul fa'tu bi-'ashri suwarim-mithlihi muftarayatin wad'u manistata'tum min dunillahi in kuntum sadiqin) (11. Hud: 13), yani kya yeh log yun kehte hain ke Quran ko khud is paighambar ne ghad liya? Tum kaho ke agar tum sache ho to tum sab mil kar aur Allah ke siwa jinhein tum bula sakte ho bula kar is jaisi das suratein hi bana lao. Surah Yunus mein hai, aayat: (Wa ma kana hadhal-qur'anu ay-yuftara min dunillahi wa lakin tasdiqalladhi baina yadayhi wa tafsilal-kitabi la raiba fihi mir-rabbil-'alamin) (10. Yunus: 37), yani yeh Quran Allah Ta'ala ke siwa aur kisi ki taraf se ghada hua nahin, balkeh yeh agli kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wala aur kitab-e-tafseel hai, jis ke Allah ka kalam hone mein koi shak nahin jo Rabb-ul-Alameen ki taraf se hai. Kya yeh log ise khud-sakhta kehte hain? In se kaho ke Allah ke siwa har shakhs ko bula kar is Quran ki saikdon suraton mein se ek chhoti si surat jaisi surat to bana lao taake tumhara sach zahir ho.

Yeh tamam aayatein Makkah Mukarramah mein nazil huin aur Ahl-e-Makkah ko is ke muqable mein aajiz sabit kar ke phir Madina Sharif mein bhi is mazmoon ko dohraya gaya. Upar ki aayat 'mislihi' ki zameer ko baaz ne Quran ki taraf lautaya hai, yani koi surat is Quran jaisi lao. Baaz ne yeh zameer Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf lautayi hai, yani aap jaisa koi ummi aisa ho hi nahin sakta hai ke kuch padha hua na hone ke bawajood woh kalam kahe jis ka misl kisi se na ban sake, lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai. Mujahid, Qatada, Amr bin Masood, Ibn Abbas, Hasan Basri aur aksar muhaqqiqeen ka yahi qaul hai. Imam Ibn Jarir Tabari, Zamakhshari, Razi ne bhi isi ko pasand kiya hai. Is ki tarjeeh ki wajoohaat bahut si hain. Ek to yeh ke is mein sab ko daant-dupat bhi hai, ijtima'i aur alag-alag bhi. Khwah woh ummi aur an-padh hon ya Ahl-e-Kitab aur padhe-likhe hon, is mein is mojize ka kamal hai aur ba-nisbat is ke ke sirf an-padh logon ko aajiz kiya jaye, is mein zyada mubalagha hai. Phir das suraton ka mutalba karna, is ki misl na la sakne ki pesh-goi karna bhi isi haqeeqat ko sabit karta hai ke is se murad Quran hai na ke zaat-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Pas is aam elaan se jo baar-baar kiya gaya aur sath hi pesh-goi bhi kar di gayi ke yeh log is par qadir nahin. Makkah mein aur Madina mein barha is ka i'ada kiya gaya aur woh log jin ki madri zaban Arabi thi, jinhein apni fasahat aur balaghat par naaz tha, jo log aap ki aur aap ke deen ki dushmani par udhaar kha baithe the, woh dar-haqeeqat is se aajiz aa gaye. Na poore Quran ka jawab de sake, na das suraton ka, na ek surat ka. Pas ek mojiza to yeh hai ke is jaisi ek chhoti si surat bhi woh na bana sake. Doosra mojiza yeh hai ke pesh-goi sach sabit hui ke yeh hargiz is jaisa nahin bana sakte chahe sab jama ho jayen aur Qayamat tak mehnat kar lein. Pas aisa hi hua, na to us zamane mein kisi ki yeh jurrat hui, na us ke baad se aaj tak aur na Qayamat tak kisi se yeh ho sake ga. Aur bhala kaise ho sakta? Jis tarah Allah Ta'ala ki zaat be-misl, usi tarah us ka kalam bhi. Haqeeqat bhi yeh hai ke Quran-e-Pak ko ba-ek nazar dekhne se hi is ke zahiri aur batini, lafzi aur manvi aise-aise kamalaat zahir hote hain jo makhlooq ke bas ke nahin. Khud Rabb-ul-Aalameen farmata hai aayat: (Alif-Laam-Raa, Kitabun uhkimat aayatuhu thumma fussilat min ladun Hakeemin Khabeer) (Surah Hud: 1). Yani is kitab ki aayatein jo hikmat wale, har tarah ki khabrein janne wale Allah ki taraf se nazil shuda hain, mohkam, mazboot aur mufassal alag-alag hain. Pas alfaaz mohkam aur ma'ani mufassal, ya alfaaz mufassal aur ma'ani mohkam. Pas Quran apne alfaaz mein aur apne mazameen mein be-nazeer hai jis ke muqable, mu'arize aur misl se duniya aajiz aur be-bas hai. Is pak kalam mein agli khabrein jo duniya se posheeda thin woh ho-ba-ho bayan ki gayin, aane wale umoor ke tazkire kiye gaye jo lafz-ba-lafz poore utre. Tamam bhalaiyon ka hukm, tamam buraiyon se muman'at is mein hai. Sach hai aayat: (Wa tammat kalimatu Rabbika sidqan wa adlan) (Surah Al-An'am: 115).

(Al-An'am: 115) Ya'ni khabaron mein sadaqat aur ahkam mein adl tere Rab ke kalam mein poora poora hai. Pakeeza Quran tamam-tar haq-o-sadaqat-o-hidayat se pur hai, na is mein wahi-tawahi baatein hain, na hansi mazak, na kizb-o-iftira jo shairon ke kalam mein umooman paya jata hai. Balkeh un ke ashaar ki qadr-o-qeemat hi isi par maqoola mashhoor hai ke "A'zhabuhu akzhabuhu" (jitna jhoot zyada utna hi mazeedar). Tum dekho ge ke lambe lambe pur-zor qaseeday mubaligha aur kizb-amez ya toh aurton ki tareef-o-tauseef mein hon ge, ya ghoron ki aur sharab ki sataish mein hon ge, ya kisi insaan ki barhi charhi madh-o-tareef mein hon ge, ya oontniyon ki aaraish-o-zebaish, ya bahaduri ke mubaligha-amez geet, ya laraiyon ki chaalbaziyon ya dar-khauf ke khayali manzaron ke bayan mein hon ge jin se koi faida nahin. Na deen ka na duniya ka, sirf shair ki zaban-dani aur us ki qudrat-e-kalam zahir hoti hai. Na akhlaq par un se koi umda asar, na a'maal par. Phir nafs-e-mazmoon ke sath pooray qaseeday mein bamushkil do ek shair hote hain. Baqi sab bharti ke aur idhar udhar ki layani aur fazool bakwas. Barkhilaf is ke Quran-e-Pak ke is par nazar dalo toh dekho ge ke is ka ek ek lafz fasahat-o-balaghat se, deen-o-duniya ke nafa se, khair-o-barkat se pur hai. Phir kalam ki tarteeb-o-tehzeeb, alfaaz ki bandish, ibarat ki rawani, ma'ani ki nooraniyat, mazmoon ki pakeezgi, sone par suhaga hai. Is ki khabaron ki halawat, is ke bayan karda waqiyat ki salasat, murda dilon ki zindagi hai. Is ka ikhtisar kamaal ka a'la namoona aur is ki tafseel mojze ki jaan hai. Is ka kisi cheez ka dohrana qand-e-mukarrar ka maza deta hai, aisa maloom hota hai goya sachay motiyon ki barish baras rahi hai. Bar bar parho dil na uktaye, mazay lete jao aur har waqt naya maza pao. Mazameen samajhte jao aur khatam na hon. Yeh Quran-e-Pak ka hi khasa hai. Is chashni ka zaiqa, is mithas ka maza koi us se pooche jinhein aql-o-hawas, ilm-o-fazl ka kuch hissa qudrat ne ata farmaya. Is ki tanzeer, dhamkawa, ta'zeeb aur pakar-dhakar ka bayan mazboot paharon ko hila de. Insani dil kya hain? Is ke wa'day aur khushkhabriyaan, ne'maton aur rehmaton ka bayan dilon ki pajmurda kali ko khila dene wala, shauq-o-tamanna ke dabay jazbaat ko ubhaar dene wala, jannaton aur rahaton ke pyare pyare manzaron ko aankhon ke samne lane wala hai. Dil khul jate hain, kaan lag jate hain aur aankhein khul jati hain. Raghibat dete hue woh farmata hai: Ayat (FALA TA'LAMU NAFSUM-MA UKHFIYA LAHUM MIN QURRAT-I-A'YUNIN JAZA'AM-BIMA KANU YA'MALUN) (As-Sajdah: 17). Is daimi jannat mein har woh cheez hai jo dil ko bhaye aur aankhon mein utar jaye. Darate aur dhamkate hue farmaya: Ayat (AFA-AMINTUM AY-YAKHSIFA BIKUM JANIBAL BARR) (17).

(Al-Isra: 68) Farmaya (A-amintum man fis-sama-i ay-yakhsifa bikumul-arda fa-iza hiya tamoor. Am amintum man fis-sama-i ay-yursila alaikum hasiban fasata'lamoona kaifa nazeer) (Al-Mulk: 16-17). Kya tum apne dhansaye jaane ya aasman se patthar barsaye jaane se nadar ho gaye ho? Kya aasmanon wala is par qadir nahin? Ise mehez dhamki hi na samjho balkay is ki haqeeqat anqareeb tum par khul jayegi. Zajr-o-taubeeh daant dapat karte hue irshad hota hai. Aayat (Fakullan akhazna bizanbih) (Al-Ankabut: 40). Ek ek ko hum ne is ki badkirdariyon mein pakad liya. Batour-e-wa'z-o-naseehat bayan hota hai aayat (Afara-aita im-matta'nahum sineen. Summa ja-ahum ma kanu yoo'adoon. Ma aghna anhum ma kanu yumatta'oon) (Ash-Shu'ara: 205-207). Agar hum ne kuch saal inhein faida nahin diya toh kya hua? Aakhir wa'day ki ghadi aa pahunchi aur is jaah-o-jalal ne koi nafa na bakhsha. Garaz koi kahan tak bayan kare jis mazmoon ka zikr kiya, ise kamal tak pahuncha kar choda aur tarah tarah ki fasahat-o-balaghat, halawat-o-hikmat se ma'moor kar diya. Ahkam ke hukm aur rok tok ko dekhiye har hukm achhai, bhalai, nafa aur pakeezgi ka jami' hai. Har muman'at qabahat, razalat aur khabasat ki qati' hai. Ibn-e-Masood R.A waghera aslaf-e-ummat ka qaul hai ke jab Quran mein aayat (Ya ayyuhallazeena amanu) aaye toh kaan laga do, ya toh kisi achhai ka hukm hoga ya kisi burai se mana kiya jayega. Khud Parwardigar-e-Aalam farmata hai aayat (Ya'muruhum bil-ma'roofi wa yan-hahum anil-munkari wa yuhillu lahumut-tayyibati wa yuharrimu alaihimul-khaba-isa wa yada'u anhum israhum wal-aghlallati kanat alaihim) (Al-A'raf: 157). Ya'ni bhalaiyon ka hukm deta hai, buraiyon se rokta hai, pakeeza cheezein halal qarar deta hai, khabees cheezein haram karta hai, woh bojh-tal bediyan jo paon mein thin, woh sakht tauq jo galon mein thay utaar phenkta hai. Qayamat ke bayan ki aayatein hain ke holnak manazir, jannat-o-dozakh ka bayan, rehmaton aur zehmaton ka poora poora wasf. Auliya-e-Allah ke liye tarah tarah ki ne'matein, dushmanan-e-Allah ke liye tarah tarah ke azaab. Kahin basharat hai, kahin darawa hai, kahin nekiyon ki taraf raghbat hai, kahin badkariyon se muman'at hai, kahin duniya ki taraf se zuhd karne ki, kahin aakhirat ki taraf raghbat karne ki ta'leem hai. Yehi woh tamam aayatein hain jo raah-e-raast dikhati hain aur behtar rehnumai karti hain, Allah ki pasandeeda shariat ki taraf jhukati hain aur dilon ko jala deti hain aur shaitani darwazon ko band kar deti hain aur buray asraat ko zail karti hain.

Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein barwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya har Nabi ko aise mojze diye gaye ke jinhein dekh kar log us par iman laye aur mera mojza Allah ki wahi yani Quran-e-Pak hai is liye mujhe umeed hai ke mere tabe-dar ba-nisbat aur nabiyon ke bahut zyada honge is liye ke aur ambiya ke mojze un ke sath chale gaye lekin Huzoor (ﷺ) ka yeh mojza Qayamat tak baqi rahe ga. Log ise dekhte jayenge aur Islam mein dakhil hote jayenge. Huzoor (ﷺ) ka yeh farman ke mera mojza wahi hai jo mujh ko di gayi hai ka matlab yeh hai ke mujh ko is ke sath makhsoos kiya gaya hai aur Quran-e-Kareem mujhi ko mila hai jo apne muarize aur muqable mein tamam duniya ko aajiz kar dene wala hai. Ba-khilaf dusri aasmani kitabon ke woh aksar ulama ke nazdeek is wasf se khali hain, wallahu a'lam. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ki nabuwat, aap ki sadaqat aur Deen-e-Islam ki haqaniyat par is mojze ke ilawa bhi is qadar dalail hain jo gine bhi nahin ja sakte. Lillahil hamdu wal minnah. Ba'az mutakallimeen ne Quran-e-Kareem ke i'jaz ko aise andaz se bayan kiya hai jo Ahl-e-Sunnat ke aur Mu'tazila ke qaul par mushtarak hai. Woh kehte hain ke ya to yeh Quran fi-nafsihi mojza hai jo insan ke imkan mein hi nahin ke is jaisa bana la sake, unhein is ka muariza karne ki qudrat-o-taqat hi nahin. Ya yeh ke go is ka muariza mumkin hai aur insani taqat se bahar nahin lekin bawajood is ke unhein muariza ka challenge diya jata hai is liye ke woh adawat aur dushmani mein barhe hue hain, Deen-e-Haq ko mitane, har waqt har taqat ke kharch karne aur har cheez ke barbad karne ke liye tayyar hain lekin taham Quran ka muariza aur muqabla un se nahin ho sakta. Yeh is baat ki daleel hai ke Quran Allah ki janib se hai agar qudrat-o-taqat ho bhi to bhi woh unhein rok deta hai aur woh Quran ki misl pesh karne se aajiz ho jate hain. Go yeh pichli wajah itni pasandida nahin taham agar ise bhi maan liya jaye to is se bhi Quran-e-Pak ka mojza hona sabit hota hai jo ba-tareeq-e-tanazzul himayat-e-haq aur munazre ki khatir salahiyat rakhta hai. Imam Razi ne bhi choti choti suraton ke sawal ke jawab mein yahi tareeqa ikhtiyar kiya hai. Jahannam ka indhan, waqood ke ma'ani indhan ke hain jis se aag jalayi jaye. Jaise chaptiyan, lakriyan waghera. Quran-e-Kareem mein ek jagah hai ayat (Wa ammal qasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataba) (Surah Al-Jinn: 15) zalim log jahannam ki lakriyan hain aur jagah farmaya tum aur tumhare mabood jo Allah ke siwa hain jahannam ki lakriyan hain tum sab is mein warid hoge agar woh sache mabood hote to wahan warid na hote darasal yeh sab ke sab is mein hamesha rehne wale hain aur hijara kehte hain patthar ko yahan murad gandhak ke sakht siyah aur bare bare aur bad-bu-dar patthar hain jin ki aag bahut tez hoti hai Allah Ta'ala hamein mehfooz rakhe. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain in pattharon ko zameen-o-aasman ki paidaish ke sath hi aasman-e-awwal par paida kiya gaya hai.

(Ibn-e-Jarir, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim, Mustadrak Hakim) Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A) aur chand aur Sahaba (R.A) se Suddi ne naqal kiya hai ke Jahannam mein yeh siyah gandhak ke patthar bhi hain jin ki sakht aag se kafiron ko azab kiya jaye ga. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain in pattharon ki badbu murdar ki bu se bhi zyada hai. Muhammad bin Ali (R.H) aur Ibn-e-Jurayj (R.H) bhi kehte hain ke murad gandhak ke bade bade aur sakht patthar hain. Ba'az ne kaha hai murad woh patthar jin ki murtiyan banayi jati hain aur phir un ki parastish ki jati thi, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (INNAKUM WAMA TA'BUDUNA MIN DUNILLAHI HASABU JAHANNAM, ANTUM LAHA WARIDUN) (21. Al-Anbiya: 98) tum aur tumhare woh ma'bud jo Allah ke siwa hain Jahannam ki lakriyan hain. Qurtubi (R.H) aur Razi (R.H) ne isi qaul ko tarjeeh di hai aur kaha hai ke gandhak ke patthar jo kisi shakal mein bhi Allah ke siwa pooje jate hon, lekin yeh wajah koi qawi wajah nahin is liye ke jab aag gandhak ke pattharon se sulgayi jaye to zahir hai ke us ki tezi aur hararat mamooli aag se bahut zyada hogi, us ka bhadakna, jalna, sozish aur sholay bhi bahut zyada honge. Alawa is ke phir Salaf se bhi is ki tafsir yahi marwi hai, isi tarah in pattharon mein aag ka lagna bhi zahir hai. Aur aayat ka maqsood aag ki aur us ki sozish ka bayan karna hai aur us ke bayan ke liye bhi yahan patthar se murad gandhak ke patthar lena zyada munasib hai taake woh aag tez ho aur us se bhi azab mein sakhti ho. Quran-e-Karim mein hai aayat (KULLAMA KHABAT ZIDNAHUM SA'IRA) (17. Al-Isra: 97) jahan sholay halkay hue ke hum ne aur bhadka diya. Ek hadith mein hai har moezi aag mein hai lekin yeh hadith mehfooz aur ma'roof nahin. Qurtubi (R.H) farmate hain is ke do ma'ni hain, ek yeh ke har woh shakhs jo dusron ko eiza de Jahannami hai, dusre yeh ke har eiza-dahinda cheez Jahannam ki aag mein majood hogi jo Jahannamiyon ko azab degi. A'iddat ya'ni tayyar ki gayi hai, murad bazahir yahi maloom hoti hai ke woh aag kafiron ke liye tayyar ki gayi hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke murad patthar hon ya'ni woh patthar jo kafiron ke liye tayyar kiye gaye hain. Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A) ka yahi qaul hai aur fil-haqiqat dono ma'ni mein koi ikhtilaf nahin is liye ke pattharon ka tayyar kiya jana aag ke jalane ke liye hai. Lehaza aag ki tayyari ke liye pattharon ka tayyar kiya jana zaroori hai. Pas dono ek dusre ke sath lazim-o-malzoom hain. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain har woh shakhs jo kufr par ho us ke liye woh aag tayyar hai. Is aayat se istidlal kiya gaya hai ke Jahannam ab majood aur paida shuda hai kyunke "A'iddat" ka lafz hi is ki daleel mein aaya hai. Bahut si hadithein bhi hain. Ek mutawwal hadith mein hai Jannat aur Dozakh mein jhagda hua, dusri hadith mein hai Jahannam ne Allah Ta'ala se do saans lene ki ijazat chahi aur usay sardi mein ek saans lene aur garmi mein dusra saans lene ki ijazat de di gayi.

Teesri hadith mein hai Sahaba kehte hain hum ne ek martaba bade zor ki ek aawaz suni, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha yeh kis cheez ki aawaz hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya sattar saal pehle ek patthar Jahannam mein phenka gaya tha aaj woh teh ko pahuncha. Chauthi hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne suraj grahan ki namaz padhte hue Jahannam ko dekha. Paanchvi hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Shab-e-Meraj mein Jahannam ko aur is mein azabon ke silsile ko mulahiza farmaya, isi tarah aur bahut si sahih mutawatir hadeesein marwi hain. Mu'tazila apni jahalat ki wajah se inhe nahin maante, Qazi-e-Andalus Munzir bin Saeed Balooti ne bhi un se ittefaq kiya hai. Magar yeh yaad rakhna chahiye ke yahan aur Surah Yunus mein jo kaha gaya hai ke ek hi Surah ke manind lao, is mein har chhoti badi aayat shamil hai. Is liye Arabiyat ke qa'ide ke mutabiq jo ism-e-nakira ho aur shart ke taur par laya gaya ho woh umoomiyat ka faida deta hai, jaise ke nakira nafi ki taht mein istighraq ka faida deta hai. Pas lambi suraton aur chhoti suraton sab mein i'jaz hai aur is baat par Salaf-o-Khalaf ka ittefaq hai. Imam Razi apni Tafsir mein likhte hain ke agar koi kahe ke Surah ka lafz Surah Al-Kauthar aur Surah Al-Asr aur Surah aayat (Qul ya ayyuhal kafiroon) jaisi chhoti suraton par bhi mushtamil hai aur yeh bhi yaqeen ho ke is jaisi ya is ke qareeb qareeb kisi Surah ka bana lena mumkin hai to ise insani taqat se kharij kehna niri hat-dharmi aur beja taraf-dari hai, to hum jawab denge ke hum ne is ke mo'jiz-numa hone ke do tareeqe bayan kar ke dusre tareeqe ko isi liye pasand kiya hai. Hum kehte hain ke agar yeh chhoti suratein bhi fasahat-o-balaghat mein isi paya ki hain ke woh mo'jiza kahi ja sakein aur inkar-e-ta'aruz mumkin na ho to maqsood hasil ho gaya aur agar yeh suratein aisi nahin to bhi hamara maqsood hasil hai, is liye ke in jaisi suraton ko banane ki insani qudrat hone par bhi sakht dushmani aur zabardast koshishon ke bawajood nakam rehna hai. Is baat ki saaf daleel hai ke yeh Quran ma' apni chhoti chhoti suraton ke sarasar mo'jiza hai. Yeh to Razi ka kehna hai. Lekin sahih qaul yeh hai ke Quran-e-Pak ki har badi chhoti Surah fil-waq'a mo'jiza hai aur insaan is ki manind banane se mahaz aajiz aur bilkul bebass hai. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain agar log ghaur-o-tadabbur se, aql-o-hosh se Surah Al-Asr ko samajh lein to intehai kaafi hai. Hazrat Amr bin Aas (R.A) jab wafd mein shamil Musailima Kazzab ke paas gaye (tab yeh khud bhi musalman nahin hue the) to Musailima ne un se poocha ke tum Makkah se aa rahe ho batao to aaj kal koi taza wahi bhi nazil hui hai? Unhone kaha abhi abhi ek mukhtasar si Surah nazil hui hai jo behad faseeh-o-baleeh aur jame' aur mani' hai, phir Surah Al-Asr padh kar sunayi to Musailima ne kuch der soch kar is ke muqable mein kaha.

Mujh par bhi ek aisi hi surat nazil hui hai. Unhon ne kaha haan tum bhi sunao, toh usne kaha: Yaubar, Yaubar, innama anta udhunan wa sadrun wa sa'iruka haqrun faqrun. Ya'ni: Ae jungli chuhe! Ae jungli chuhe! Tera wajood siwaye do kanon aur seene ke aur kuch bhi nahin, baqi toh sarasar bilkul na-cheez hai. Phir fakriya kehne laga: Kaho ae Amr! Kaisi kahi? Unhon ne kaha: Mujh se kya poochte ho? Tu khud jaanta hai ke yeh sarasar kizb-o-buhtan hai. Bhala kahan yeh fazool kalam aur kahan hikmaton se bharpoor woh kalam?

A'maal-e-Wajah-e-Basharat: Chunki pehle kafiron aur dushmanan-e-Deen ki saza, azaab aur ruswai ka zikr hua tha, is liye yahan imandaron aur nek-o-saleh logon ki jaza, sawab aur surkhru'i ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Quran ke 'Masani' hone ke ek ma'ani yeh bhi hain, jo sahih-tar qaul bhi hai, ke is mein har mazmoon taqabuli ja'ize ke sath hua hai. Is ka mufassal bayan bhi kisi munasib jagah aayega. Matlab yeh hai ke iman ke sath hi kufr ka, kufr ke sath iman ka, nekon ke sath badon ka, aur badon ke sath nekon ka zikr zaroor aata hai. Jis cheez ka bayan hota hai, us ke muqable ki cheez ka bhi zikr kar diya jata hai, chahe ma'ani mein mutashabih hon. Yeh dono lafz Quran ke ausaf mein warid hue hain, ise 'Masani' bhi kaha gaya hai aur 'Mutashabih' bhi farmaya gaya hai.

Jannaton mein nahrein behna, is ke darakhton aur balakhano ke neeche behna hai. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke nahrein behti hain lekin garha nahin, aur hadith mein hai ke nehar-e-Kausar ke dono kinare sache motiyon ke qubbe hain, is ki mitti mushk-e-khalis hai aur is ki kankariyan lulu aur jawaher hain. Allah Ta'ala apne fazl-o-karam se hamein bhi yeh ne'matein ata farmaye, woh ehsan karne wala bada Rahim hai. Hadith mein hai, jannat ki nahrein mushki pahadon ke neeche se jaari hoti hain. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi hai.

Jannatiyon ka yeh qaul ke "Pehle bhi hum ko yeh meway diye gaye the", is se murad yeh hai ke duniya mein bhi yeh meway hamein mile the. Sahaba aur Ibn Jarir ne bhi is ki ta'eed ki hai. Ba'az kehte hain matlab yeh hai ke hum is se pehle yani sabqa kal bhi yahi diye gaye the. Yeh is liye kahenge ke zahiri surat-o-shakal mein woh bilkul mushabih honge. Yahya bin Kathir kehte hain ke ek pyala aayega, khayenge, phir dusra aayega to kahenge yeh to abhi khaya hai. Farishte kahenge khaiye, to agarche surat-o-shakal mein yaksan hain lekin maza aur hai. Farmate hain jannat ki ghaas zafran hai, is ke teele mushk ke hain. Chote chote khubsurat ghilman idhar udhar se meway la la kar pesh kar rahe hain, woh kha rahe hain, woh phir pesh karte hain to yeh kehte hain ise to abhi khaya hai. Woh jawab dete hain, Hazrat rang-roop ek hai lekin zaiqa aur hi hai, chakh kar dekhiye. Khate hain to aur hi lutf paate hain. Yehi ma'ani hain ke hum-shakal laye jayenge. Duniya ke mewon se bhi aur naam, shakal aur surat mein bhi milte julte honge lekin maza kuch dusra hi hoga. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke sirf naam mein mushabahat hai, warna kahan yahan ki cheez, kahan wahan ki? Yahan to faqat naam hi hai. Abdur Rahman ka qaul hai, duniya ke phalon jaise phal dekh kar keh denge ke yeh to duniya mein kha chuke hain, magar jab chakhenge to lazzat kuch aur hi hogi.

Wahan jo biwiyan unhein milengi woh gandagi, napaki, haiz-o-nifas, peshab, pakhana, thook, rent, mani waghera se pak saf hongi. Hazrat Hawa (Alaihimas Salam) bhi haiz se pak thin lekin nafarmani sarzad hote hi yeh bala aa gayi. Yeh qaul sanadan ghareeb hai. Ek ghareeb marfoo hadith mein hai ke haiz, pakhana, thook, rent se woh pak hain. Is hadith ke rawi Abdur Razzaq bin Umar Yazeeyi hain, Mustadrak Hakim mein bayan kiya jinhein Abu Hatim Al-Busti ne ehtijaj ke qabil nahin samjha. Bazahir yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh marfoo hadith nahin balki Hazrat Qatada ka qaul hai, Wallahu A'lam. In tamam ne'maton ke sath is zabardast ne'mat ko dekhiye ke na yeh ne'matein fana hon, na ne'maton wale fana hon, na ne'matein un se chheinein, na yeh ne'maton se alag kiye jayen. Na maut hai, na khatma hai, na aakhir hai, na tootna aur kam hona hai. Allah Rabbul Aalameen Jawad-o-Kareem, Barr-ur-Raheem se iltija hai ke woh Malik hamein bhi Ahl-e-Jannat ke zumre mein shamil kare aur unhin ke sath hamara hashr kare. Ameen.

Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki misalein aur duniya. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A) aur chand Sahaba (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jab oopar ki teen aayaton mein munafiqon ki do misalein bayan huin yani aag aur pani ki, toh woh kehne lage ke aisi aisi chhoti misalein Allah Ta'ala hargiz bayan nahin karta. Is par yeh dono aayatein nazil huin. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain jab Quran-e-Pak mein makri aur makkhi ki misal bayan hui toh mushrik kehne lage bhala aisi haqeer cheezon ke bayan ki Quran jaisi Allah ki kitab mein kya zaroorat, toh jawaban yeh aayatein utrein aur kaha gaya ke haq ke bayan se Allah Ta'ala nahin sharmata khwah woh kam ho ya zyada, lekin maloom hota hai ke yeh aayat Makkah mein utri halanke aisa nahin, Wallahu A'alam. Aur buzurgon se bhi is tarah ka shaan-e-nuzool marwi hai. Rabi bin Anas farmate hain yeh khud ek mustaqil misal hai jo duniya ke bare mein bayan ki gayi. Machhar jab tak bhooka hota hai zinda rehta hai, jahan mota taza hua mara. Isi tarah yeh log hain ke jab dunyawi ne'matein dil khol kar hasil kar lete hain wahin Allah ki pakad aa jati hai, jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Falammanasu ma zukkiru bihi fatahna alaihim abwaba kulli shai'in) (Surah Al-An'am: 44) jab yeh hamari nasihat bhool jate hain toh hum un par tamam cheezon ke darwaze khol dete hain yahan tak ke utrane lagte hain, ab daf'atan hum unhein pakad lete hain (Ibn-e-Jarir, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne pehle qaul ko pasand farmaya hai aur munasibat bhi isi ki zyada achi maloom hoti hai, Wallahu A'alam. Toh matlab yeh hua ke misal chhoti se chhoti ho ya badi se badi, bayan karne se Allah Ta'ala na rukta hai na jhijhakta hai. Lafz 'ma' yahan par kami ke ma'ani batane ke liye hai aur 'ba'uzatin' ka zer badliyat ki bina par Arabi qa'ide ke mutabiq hai jo adna se adna cheez par sadiq aa sakta hai, ya 'ma' nakira mausufa hai aur 'ba'uzatin' sifat hai. Ibn-e-Jarir 'ma' ka mausula hona aur 'ba'uzatin' ka isi e'rab se mu'rab hona pasand farmate hain aur kalam-e-Arab mein yeh bakasrat ra'ij hai ke woh 'ma' aur 'man' ke sila ko inhi donon ka e'rab diya karte hain is liye ke kabhi yeh nakira hote hain aur kabhi ma'arifa, jaise Hassan bin Sabit ke sheron mein hai: "Yakfi bina fadlan ala man ghairina, hubbun-nabi Muhammadan iyana" (Hamein ghairon par sirf yahi fazilat kafi hai ke hamare dil jab Nabi (ﷺ) se pur hain). Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke 'ba'uzatin' mansoob ho hazf-e-jar ki bina par aur is se pehle 'bain' ka lafz muqaddar mana jaye. Kisai aur Farra isi ko pasand karte hain, Zahhak aur Ibrahim bin Abla 'ba'uzatan' padhte hain. Ibn-e-Jinni kehte hain yeh 'ma' ka sila hoga aur a'id hazf mani jayegi jaise aayat (Tamaman alallazi ahsan) mein. 'Fama fauqaha' ke do ma'ani bayan kiye hain, ek toh yeh ke is se bhi halki aur radi cheez. Jaise kisi shakhs ki bakhili ka ek shakhs zikr kare toh doosra kehta hai woh is se bhi badh kar hai, toh murad yeh hoti hai ke woh is se bhi zyada gira hua hai. Kisai aur Abu Ubaida yahi kehte hain.

Ek hadith mein aata hai ke agar duniya ki qadr Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek ek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi hoti toh kisi kafir ko ek ghont pani bhi na pilata. Dusre yeh ma'ani hain ke is se zyada badi is liye ke bhala machhar se halki aur chhoti cheez aur kya hogi? Qatada bin Di'ama ka yahi qaul hai. Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. Sahih Muslim mein hadith hai ke jis kisi musalman ko kanta chubhe ya is se zyada toh is par bhi us ke darje badhte hain aur gunah mit-te hain, is hadith mein bhi yahi lafz 'fauqaha' hai toh matlab yeh hai ke jis tarah Allah Ta'ala in chhoti badi cheezon ke paida karne se sharmata nahin aur na rukta hai, isi tarah inhein misal ke taur par bayan karne se bhi use aar nahin. Ek jagah Quran mein kaha gaya hai ke ae logo! Ek misal bayan ki jati hai, kaan laga kar suno, jinhein Allah ke siwa pukar sakte ho woh sare ke sare jama ho jayen toh bhi ek makkhi bhi paida nahin kar sakte, balki makkhi agar un se kuch chheen le jaye toh yeh is se wapas nahin le sakte. Aabid aur ma'bood dono hi behad kamzor hain. Dusri jagah farmaya, un logon ki misal jo Allah Ta'ala ke siwa dusron ko madadgar banate hain, makdi ke jaale jaisi hai jis ka ghar tamam gharon se zyada bouda aur kamzor hai. Aur jagah farmaya, Allah Ta'ala ne Kalima-e-Tayyaba ki misal paak darakht se di jis ki jad mazboot ho aur jis ki shakhein aasman mein hon, jo ba-hukm-e-Allah har waqt phal deta ho. In misalon ko Allah Ta'ala logon ke ghaur-o-tadabbur ke liye bayan farmata hai aur na-paak kalam ki misal na-paak darakht jaisi hai jo zameen ke upar upar hi ho aur jadein mazboot na hon. Allah Ta'ala iman walon ko mazboot baat ke sath duniya aur aakhirat mein barqarar rakhta hai aur zalimon ko gumrah karta hai, Allah jo chahe kare. Dusri jagah farmaya, Allah Ta'ala is mamlook ghulam ki misal pesh karta hai jise kisi cheez par ikhtiyar nahin. Aur jagah farmaya, do shakhson ki misal Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai jin mein se ek toh gunga aur bilkul gira pada be-taqat hai jo apne aaqa par bojh hai, jahan jaye burai hi le kar aaye aur dusra woh jo adl-o-haq ka hukm kare, kya yeh dono barabar ho sakte hain? Dusri jagah hai, Allah Ta'ala tumhare liye khud tumhari misal bayan farmata hai, kya tum apni cheezon mein apne ghulamon ko bhi apna shareek aur barabar ka hissa-dar samajhte ho? Aur jagah irshad hai, in misalon ko hum logon ke liye bayan karte hain aur inhein (puri tarah) sirf ilm wale hi samajhte hain. In ke alawa aur bhi bahut si misalein Quran-e-Pak mein bayan hui hain. Ba'az Salaf-e-Saliheen farmate hain, jab main Quran ki kisi misal ko sunta hoon aur samajh nahin sakta toh mujhe rona aata hai kyunke Allah Ta'ala ne farma diya hai ke in misalon ko sirf aalim hi samajh sakte hain. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain, misalein khwah chhoti hon khwah badi, imandar in par iman late hain aur inhein haq jante hain aur in se hidayat pate hain. Qatada ka qaul hai ke woh inhein Allah ka kalam samajhte hain.

"Inna" ki zameer ka marja misaal hai yani momin is misaal ko Allah ki janib se aur haq samajhte hain aur kafir baatein banate hain jaise Surah Muddathir mein aayat (Wama ja'alna ashaban-nari illa mala'ikah) (74. Al-Muddathir: 31) yani hum ne aag wale farishton ki ginti ko kuffar ki aazmaish ka sabab banaya hai. Ahl-e-Kitab yaqeen karte hain aur imandar imaan mein barh jate hain. In dono jama'aton ko koi shak nahin rehta lekin bimar dil aur kafir keh uthte hain ke is misaal se kya murad? Isi tarah Allah jise chahta hai gumrah karta hai aur jise chahta hai hidayat deta hai. Tere Rab ke lashkaron ko us ke siwa koi nahin janta. Yahan bhi isi hidayat-o-zalalat ko bayan kiya. Ek hi misaal ke do rad-e-amal kyun? Sahaba-e-Kiram R.A se marwi hai ke is se gumrah munafiq hote hain aur momin raah paate hain. Gumrah apni gumrahi mein barh jate hain kyunke is misaal ke durust aur sahih hone ka ilm hone ke bawajood ise jhutlate hain aur momin iqrar kar ke hidayat-e-imaan ko barha lete hain. Fasiqeen se murad munafiq hain. Baaz ne kaha hai kafir murad hain jo pehchante hain aur inkar karte hain. Hazrat Sa'ad R.A kehte hain murad Khawarij hain. Agar is qaul ki sanad Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqas R.A tak sahih ho to matlab yeh hoga ke yeh tafseer-e-ma'anwi hai is se murad Khawarij nahin hain balkay yeh hai ke yeh firqa bhi fasiqon mein dakhil hai. Jinhon ne Nahrawan mein Hazrat Ali R.A par charhai ki thi to yeh log go nuzool-e-aayat ke waqt majood na thay lekin apne badtareen wasf ki wajah se ma'anan fasiqon mein dakhil hain. Inhein Khariji is liye kaha gaya hai ke Imam ki ita'at se nikal gaye thay aur shariat-e-Islam ki pabandi se azaad ho gaye thay. Lughat mein fasiq kehte hain ita'at aur farmanbardari se nikal jane ko. Jab chhalka hata kar khosha nikalta hai to Arab kehte hain fasaqat, chuhe ko bhi fuwaisiqah kehte hain kyunke woh apne bil se nikal kar fasad karta hai. Sahihain ki hadith hai Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya paanch janwar fasiq hain haram mein aur haram se bahar ke qatl kar diye jayen. Kawa, cheel, bichhoo, chuha aur kala kutta. Pas lafz-e-fasiq kafir ko aur har nafarman ko shamil hai lekin kafir ka fisq zyada sakht aur zyada bura hai aur aayat mein murad fasiq se kafir hai wallahu a'alam. Is ki bari daleel yeh hai ke baad mein un ka wasf yeh bayan farmaya hai ke woh Allah Ta'ala ka ahd torte hain. Us ke farman kaat-te hain aur zameen mein fasad phailate hain aur yeh sab ausaf kuffar ke hain. Mominon ke ausaf to is ke bar-khilaf hote hain jaise Surah Ra'ad mein bayan hai ke aayat (Afaman ya'lam) al-kh. Kya pas woh shakhs jo janta hai ke jo kuch tere Rab ki taraf se tujh par utra woh haq hai kya us shakhs jaisa ho sakta hai jo andha ho? Nasihat to sirf aqalmand hasil karte hain jo Allah ke wadon ko pura karte hain aur meesaq nahin torte aur Allah Ta'ala ne jin kamon ke jorne ka hukum diya hai unhein jorte hain apne Rab se darte rehte hain aur hisab ki burai se kanpte rehte hain. Aage chal kar farmaya.

Jo log Allah ke ahd ko us ki mazbooti ke baad tod dein aur jis cheez ko milane ka Allah ka hukum ho woh use na milayein aur zameen mein fasaad phailayein un ke liye la'natein hain aur un ke liye bura ghar hai. Yahan ahd se muraad woh wasiyat hai jo Allah ne bandon ko ki thi jo us ke tamam ahkaam baja lane aur tamam nafarmaniyon se bachne par mushtamil hai. Is ka tod dena is par amal na karna hai. Ba'az kehte hain ahd todne wale Ahl-e-Kitab ke kafir munafiq aur hain aur ahd woh hai jo un se Taurat mein liya gaya tha ke woh is ki tamam baaton par amal karein aur Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki itteba karein jab bhi aap tashreef le aayein aap ki nabuwat ka iqrar karein aur jo kuch aap Allah ki janib se le kar aayein us ki tasdeeq karein aur is ahd ko tod dena yeh hai ke unhon ne aap ki nabuwat ka ilm hone ke bawajood ulta ita'at se inkar kar diya aur bawajood ahd ka ilm hone ke use chupaya dunyawi maslahaton ki bina par is ka ulat kiya. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) is qaul ko pasand karte hain aur Muqatil bin Hayyan (R.H) ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Ba'az kehte hain ke is se muraad koi khaas jamaat nahin balkay shak-o-kufr-o-nifaq wale sab ke sab muraad hain. Ahd se muraad tauheed aur Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwat ka iqrar karana hai jin ki daleel mein khuli hui nishaniyan aur bade bade mo'jize maujood hain aur is ahd ko tod dena tauheed-o-sunnat se munh modna aur inkar karna hai yeh qaul achha hai Zamakhshari (R.H) ka mailan bhi isi tarah hai woh kehte hain ahd se muraad Allah Ta'ala ki tauheed manne ka iqrar hai jo fitrat-e-insan mein dakhil hone ke ilawa Roz-e-Misaq bhi manwaya gaya hai. Farmaya gaya tha ke aayat (Alastu bi Rabbikum) (Surah Al-A'raf: 172) kya main tumhara Rabb hoon? To sab ne jawab diya tha Bala beshak tu hamara Rabb hai. Phir woh kitabein di gayin un mein bhi iqrar karaya gaya jaise farmaya aayat (Wa aufu bi ahdi ufi bi ahdikum) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 40) mere ahd ko nibhao main bhi apne wade poore karunga. Ba'az kehte hain woh ahd muraad hai jo roohon se liya gaya tha jab woh Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki peeth se nikali gayi thin jaise farmata hai aayat (Wa iz akhaza Rabbuka mim bani Adama min zuhurihim zurriyyatahum wa ash-hadahum ala anfusihim) (Surah Al-A'raf: 172) jab tere Rabb ne aulad-e-Adam se wada liya ke main hi tumhara Rabb hoon aur un sab ne iqrar kiya. Aur is ka todna is se inhiraf hai. Yeh tamam aqwal Tafsir-e-Ibn-e-Jarir mein manqool hain. Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) farmate hain ahd-e-Allah ko todna munafiqon ka kaam hai jin mein yeh chhay khaslatein hoti hain. Baat karne mein jhoot bolna, wada khilafi karna, amanat mein khayanat karna, Allah ke ahd ko mazbooti ke baad tod dena, Allah Ta'ala ne jin rishton ke milane ka hukum diya hai, unhein na milana, zameen mein fasaad phailana. Yeh chhay khaslatein un ki us waqt zahir hoti hain jab ke un ka ghalba ho aur jab woh maghloob hote hain to teen aglay kaam karte hain.

Suddi farmate hain Quran ke ahkam ko parhna janna sach kehna phir na manna bhi ahd ko torna tha. Allah Ta'ala ne jin kamon ke jorne ka hukum diya hai un se murad sila-rehmi karna, qarabat ke huqooq ada karna waghera hai jaise aur jagah Quran Majeed mein hai ayat (Fahal asaytum in tawallaytum an tufsidu fil ardi wa tuqatti'u arhamakum) (47. Muhammad: 22) qareeb hai ke tum agar loto to zameen mein fasad karo aur rishte naate tor do. Ibn-e-Jarir isi ko tarjeeh dete hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke ayat aam hai yani jise milane aur ada karne ka hukum diya tha unhon ne use tora aur hukum-e-adooli ki. Khasiroon se murad aakhirat mein nuqsan uthane wale hain jaise farman-e-Bari hai. Ayat (Ula'ika lahumul la'natu wa lahum su'ud-dar) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 25) in logon ke liye la'nat hai aur un ke liye bura ghar hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka farman hai ke Ahl-e-Islam ke siwa jahan dusron ke liye yeh lafz aaya hai wahan murad gunahgar hain. Khasiroon jama hai khasir ki. Chunki in logon ne nafsiyati khwahishon aur dunyawi lazzaton mein par kar Rahmat-e-Allah se alaidgi karli is liye unhein nuqsan yafta kaha gaya jaise woh shakhs jise apni tijarat mein ghata aaye isi tarah yeh kafir-o-munafiq hain yani Qayamat wale din jab raham-o-karam ki bahut hi haajat hogi us din Rahmat-e-Ilahi se mehroom reh jayenge.

Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki misalein aur duniya. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A) aur chand Sahaba (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jab oopar ki teen aayaton mein munafiqon ki do misalein bayan huin yani aag aur pani ki, toh woh kehne lage ke aisi aisi chhoti misalein Allah Ta'ala hargiz bayan nahin karta. Is par yeh dono aayatein nazil huin. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain jab Quran-e-Pak mein makri aur makkhi ki misal bayan hui toh mushrik kehne lage bhala aisi haqeer cheezon ke bayan ki Quran jaisi Allah ki kitab mein kya zaroorat, toh jawaban yeh aayatein utrein aur kaha gaya ke haq ke bayan se Allah Ta'ala nahin sharmata khwah woh kam ho ya zyada, lekin maloom hota hai ke yeh aayat Makkah mein utri halanke aisa nahin, Wallahu A'alam. Aur buzurgon se bhi is tarah ka shaan-e-nuzool marwi hai. Rabi bin Anas farmate hain yeh khud ek mustaqil misal hai jo duniya ke bare mein bayan ki gayi. Machhar jab tak bhooka hota hai zinda rehta hai, jahan mota taza hua mara. Isi tarah yeh log hain ke jab dunyawi ne'matein dil khol kar hasil kar lete hain wahin Allah ki pakad aa jati hai, jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Falammanasu ma zukkiru bihi fatahna alaihim abwaba kulli shai'in) (Surah Al-An'am: 44) jab yeh hamari nasihat bhool jate hain toh hum un par tamam cheezon ke darwaze khol dete hain yahan tak ke utrane lagte hain, ab daf'atan hum unhein pakad lete hain (Ibn-e-Jarir, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne pehle qaul ko pasand farmaya hai aur munasibat bhi isi ki zyada achi maloom hoti hai, Wallahu A'alam. Toh matlab yeh hua ke misal chhoti se chhoti ho ya badi se badi, bayan karne se Allah Ta'ala na rukta hai na jhijhakta hai. Lafz 'ma' yahan par kami ke ma'ani batane ke liye hai aur 'ba'uzatin' ka zer badliyat ki bina par Arabi qa'ide ke mutabiq hai jo adna se adna cheez par sadiq aa sakta hai, ya 'ma' nakira mausufa hai aur 'ba'uzatin' sifat hai. Ibn-e-Jarir 'ma' ka mausula hona aur 'ba'uzatin' ka isi e'rab se mu'rab hona pasand farmate hain aur kalam-e-Arab mein yeh bakasrat ra'ij hai ke woh 'ma' aur 'man' ke sila ko inhi donon ka e'rab diya karte hain is liye ke kabhi yeh nakira hote hain aur kabhi ma'arifa, jaise Hassan bin Sabit ke sheron mein hai: "Yakfi bina fadlan ala man ghairina, hubbun-nabi Muhammadan iyana" (Hamein ghairon par sirf yahi fazilat kafi hai ke hamare dil jab Nabi (ﷺ) se pur hain). Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke 'ba'uzatin' mansoob ho hazf-e-jar ki bina par aur is se pehle 'bain' ka lafz muqaddar mana jaye. Kisai aur Farra isi ko pasand karte hain, Zahhak aur Ibrahim bin Abla 'ba'uzatan' padhte hain. Ibn-e-Jinni kehte hain yeh 'ma' ka sila hoga aur a'id hazf mani jayegi jaise aayat (Tamaman alallazi ahsan) mein. 'Fama fauqaha' ke do ma'ani bayan kiye hain, ek toh yeh ke is se bhi halki aur radi cheez. Jaise kisi shakhs ki bakhili ka ek shakhs zikr kare toh doosra kehta hai woh is se bhi badh kar hai, toh murad yeh hoti hai ke woh is se bhi zyada gira hua hai. Kisai aur Abu Ubaida yahi kehte hain.

Ek hadith mein aata hai ke agar duniya ki qadr Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek ek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi hoti toh kisi kafir ko ek ghont pani bhi na pilata. Dusre yeh ma'ani hain ke is se zyada badi is liye ke bhala machhar se halki aur chhoti cheez aur kya hogi? Qatada bin Di'ama ka yahi qaul hai. Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. Sahih Muslim mein hadith hai ke jis kisi musalman ko kanta chubhe ya is se zyada toh is par bhi us ke darje badhte hain aur gunah mit-te hain, is hadith mein bhi yahi lafz 'fauqaha' hai toh matlab yeh hai ke jis tarah Allah Ta'ala in chhoti badi cheezon ke paida karne se sharmata nahin aur na rukta hai, isi tarah inhein misal ke taur par bayan karne se bhi use aar nahin. Ek jagah Quran mein kaha gaya hai ke ae logo! Ek misal bayan ki jati hai, kaan laga kar suno, jinhein Allah ke siwa pukar sakte ho woh sare ke sare jama ho jayen toh bhi ek makkhi bhi paida nahin kar sakte, balki makkhi agar un se kuch chheen le jaye toh yeh is se wapas nahin le sakte. Aabid aur ma'bood dono hi behad kamzor hain. Dusri jagah farmaya, un logon ki misal jo Allah Ta'ala ke siwa dusron ko madadgar banate hain, makdi ke jaale jaisi hai jis ka ghar tamam gharon se zyada bouda aur kamzor hai. Aur jagah farmaya, Allah Ta'ala ne Kalima-e-Tayyaba ki misal paak darakht se di jis ki jad mazboot ho aur jis ki shakhein aasman mein hon, jo ba-hukm-e-Allah har waqt phal deta ho. In misalon ko Allah Ta'ala logon ke ghaur-o-tadabbur ke liye bayan farmata hai aur na-paak kalam ki misal na-paak darakht jaisi hai jo zameen ke upar upar hi ho aur jadein mazboot na hon. Allah Ta'ala iman walon ko mazboot baat ke sath duniya aur aakhirat mein barqarar rakhta hai aur zalimon ko gumrah karta hai, Allah jo chahe kare. Dusri jagah farmaya, Allah Ta'ala is mamlook ghulam ki misal pesh karta hai jise kisi cheez par ikhtiyar nahin. Aur jagah farmaya, do shakhson ki misal Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai jin mein se ek toh gunga aur bilkul gira pada be-taqat hai jo apne aaqa par bojh hai, jahan jaye burai hi le kar aaye aur dusra woh jo adl-o-haq ka hukm kare, kya yeh dono barabar ho sakte hain? Dusri jagah hai, Allah Ta'ala tumhare liye khud tumhari misal bayan farmata hai, kya tum apni cheezon mein apne ghulamon ko bhi apna shareek aur barabar ka hissa-dar samajhte ho? Aur jagah irshad hai, in misalon ko hum logon ke liye bayan karte hain aur inhein (puri tarah) sirf ilm wale hi samajhte hain. In ke alawa aur bhi bahut si misalein Quran-e-Pak mein bayan hui hain. Ba'az Salaf-e-Saliheen farmate hain, jab main Quran ki kisi misal ko sunta hoon aur samajh nahin sakta toh mujhe rona aata hai kyunke Allah Ta'ala ne farma diya hai ke in misalon ko sirf aalim hi samajh sakte hain. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain, misalein khwah chhoti hon khwah badi, imandar in par iman late hain aur inhein haq jante hain aur in se hidayat pate hain. Qatada ka qaul hai ke woh inhein Allah ka kalam samajhte hain.

"Inna" ki zameer ka marja misaal hai yani momin is misaal ko Allah ki janib se aur haq samajhte hain aur kafir baatein banate hain jaise Surah Muddathir mein aayat (Wama ja'alna ashaban-nari illa mala'ikah) (74. Al-Muddathir: 31) yani hum ne aag wale farishton ki ginti ko kuffar ki aazmaish ka sabab banaya hai. Ahl-e-Kitab yaqeen karte hain aur imandar imaan mein barh jate hain. In dono jama'aton ko koi shak nahin rehta lekin bimar dil aur kafir keh uthte hain ke is misaal se kya murad? Isi tarah Allah jise chahta hai gumrah karta hai aur jise chahta hai hidayat deta hai. Tere Rab ke lashkaron ko us ke siwa koi nahin janta. Yahan bhi isi hidayat-o-zalalat ko bayan kiya. Ek hi misaal ke do rad-e-amal kyun? Sahaba-e-Kiram R.A se marwi hai ke is se gumrah munafiq hote hain aur momin raah paate hain. Gumrah apni gumrahi mein barh jate hain kyunke is misaal ke durust aur sahih hone ka ilm hone ke bawajood ise jhutlate hain aur momin iqrar kar ke hidayat-e-imaan ko barha lete hain. Fasiqeen se murad munafiq hain. Baaz ne kaha hai kafir murad hain jo pehchante hain aur inkar karte hain. Hazrat Sa'ad R.A kehte hain murad Khawarij hain. Agar is qaul ki sanad Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqas R.A tak sahih ho to matlab yeh hoga ke yeh tafseer-e-ma'anwi hai is se murad Khawarij nahin hain balkay yeh hai ke yeh firqa bhi fasiqon mein dakhil hai. Jinhon ne Nahrawan mein Hazrat Ali R.A par charhai ki thi to yeh log go nuzool-e-aayat ke waqt majood na thay lekin apne badtareen wasf ki wajah se ma'anan fasiqon mein dakhil hain.
