Thos dalail par mabni dawat is baat ka suboot dete hue ke Allah Ta'ala maujood hai, woh qudraton wala hai. Wohi paida karne wala aur ikhtiyar wala hai. Is ayat mein farmaya tum Allah Ta'ala ke wujood se inkar kaise kar sakte ho? Ya us ke sath dusre ko ibadat mein shareek kaise kar sakte ho? Jabke tumhein adam se wujood mein lane wala ek wohi hai. Dusri jagah farmaya kya yeh baghair kisi cheez ke paida kiye gaye? Ya yeh khud paida karne wale hain? Unhon ne zameen-o-aasman bhi paida kiya hai? Hargiz nahin balkeh yeh be-yaqeen log hain. Aur jagah irshad hota hai ayat (Hal ata 'alal insani heenun minad dahri lam yakun shay'an mazkura) yaqeenan insan par woh zamana bhi aaya hai jis waqt yeh qabil-e-zikr cheez hi na tha. Aur bhi is tarah ki bahut si ayatein hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke kuffar jo kahenge ayat (Rabbana amattanal ithnataini) (40. Ghafir: 11) Aye Allah do dafa tu ne hamein mara aur do dafa jalaya hamein apne gunahon ka iqrar hai. Is se murad yahi hai jo is ayat (Wa kuntum amwatan fa-ahyakum) (2. Al-Baqarah: 28) mein hai. Matlab yeh hai ke tum apne baapon ki peeth mein murda thay yani kuch bhi na thay. Us ne tumhein zinda kiya yani paida kiya phir tumhein mare ga yani maut ek roz zaroor aaye gi phir tumhein qabron se uthaye ga. Pas ek halat murda pan ki duniya mein aane se pehle, phir dusri duniya mein marne aur qabron ki taraf jaane ki, phir Qayamat ke roz uth khade hone ki. Do zindagiyan aur do mautain. Abu Saleh farmate hain ke qabr mein insan ko zinda kar diya jata hai. Abdur Rahman bin Zaid ka bayan hai ke Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki peeth mein unhein paida kiya phir un se ahd-o-paiman le kar be-jaan kar diya phir maa ke pet mein unhein paida kiya phir dunyawi maut un par aayi phir Qayamat wale din unhein zinda kare ga lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Pehla qaul hi durust hai. Ibn Mas'ood, Ibn Abbas aur tabieen ki ek jamaat ka yahi qaul hai. Quran mein aur jagah hai ayat (Qulillahu yuhyikum thumma yumitukum thumma yajma'ukum ila yawmil qiyamati la rayba fihi wa lakinna aksaran nasi la ya'lamun) (45. Al-Jathiyah: 26) Allah hi tumhein paida karta hai phir marta hai phir tumhein Qayamat ke din jama kare ga. In pattharon aur tasweeron ko jinhein mushrikeen poojte thay Quran ne murda kaha. Farmaya amwatun ghayru ahya'in woh sab murda hain zinda nahin. Zameen ke bare mein farmaya ayat (Wa ayatullahumul ardul maytatu) (36. Yasin: 33) Un ke liye murda zameen bhi hamari sadaqat ki nishani hai jise hum zinda karte hain aur us se dane nikalte hain jise yeh khate hain.

Kuch aur dalail. Upar ki aayat mein un dalail-e-qudrat ka bayan tha jo khud insaan ke andar hain, ab is mubarak aayat mein un dalail ka bayan ho raha hai jo roz-marra aankhon ke samne hain. "Istawa" yahan qasd karne aur mutawajja hone ke ma'ani mein hai, is liye ke is ka sila "ila" hai. "Sawwahun" ke ma'ani durust karne aur saaton aasman banane ke hain, samaa ism-e-jins hai. Phir bayan farmaya ke us ka ilm muheet-e-kul hai, jaise irshad-e-aayat (Ala ya'lamu man khalaq) (67. Al-Mulk: 14). Woh be-ilm ho kaise sakta hai jo khaliq ho? Surah Sajdah ki aayat (A-innakum latakfuruna) goya is aayat ki tafseel hai jis mein farmaya hai: Kya tum us Allah ke sath kufr karte ho? Jis ne zameen ko sirf do din mein paida kiya, tum us ke liye shareek thahrate ho? Jo Rabb-ul-Aalameen hai, jis ne zameen mein mazboot pahar upar se gaar diye, jis ne zameen mein barkatein aur roziyan rakhein aur chaar din mein zameen ki sab cheezein durust kar dein, jis mein daryaft karne walon ki tashaffi hai. Phir aasmanon ki taraf mutawajja ho kar jo dhuwein ki shakal mein thay, farmaya ke ae zameeno aur aasmano khushi ya na-khushi se aao, toh dono ne kaha Bari Ta'ala hum toh baraza-o-khushi hazir hain. Do din mein in saaton aasmanon ko pura kar diya aur har aasman mein us ka kaam baant diya aur duniya ke aasman ko sitaron ke sath muzayyan kar diya aur unhein (shaitanon se) bachaon ka sabab banaya. Yeh hai andaza us Allah ka jo bahut bada ghalib aur bahut bade ilm wala hai. Is se maloom hua ke pehle zameen paida ki phir saaton aasman. Hum dekhte hain ke har imarat ka yahi qaida hai ke pehle neeche ka hissa banaya jaye phir upar ka, mufassireen ne bhi is ki tasreeh ki hai jis ka bayan bhi abhi aayega, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Lekin yeh samajh lena chahiye ke Quran-e-Kareem mein irshad hai: Aayat (A-antum ashaddu khalqan amissama-u banaha) (79. An-Nazi'at: 27). Tumhari paidaish mushkil hai ya aasmanon ki? Allah Ta'ala ne is ke khala ko buland kar ke use theek-thaak kiya aur in mein se raat din paida kiye, phir is ke baad zameen phailayi, is se pani aur chara nikala aur paharon ko gaara jo sab tumhare aur tumhare janwaron ke kaam ki cheezein hain. Is aayat mein yeh farmaya hai ke zameen ki paidaish aasman ke baad hai, toh ba'az buzurgon ne toh farmaya hai ke mandaraja-bala aayat mein "summa" sirf atf-e-khabar ke liye hai, atf-e-fe'l ke liye nahin, ya'ni yeh matlab nahin ke zameen ke baad aasman ki paidaish shuru ki, balkay sirf khabar dena maqsood hai ke aasmanon ko bhi paida kiya aur zameeno ko bhi. Arab shairon ke ashaar mein yeh majood hai ke kahin "summa" sirf khabar ka khabar par atf dalne ke liye hota hai, taqdeem-o-takheer murad nahin hoti. Aur ba'az buzurgon ne farmaya hai ke aayat "A-antum" mein aasmanon ki paidaish ke baad zameen ka phailana aur bichana wagaira bayan hua hai na ke paida karna. Toh theek yeh hai ke pehle zameen ko paida kiya phir aasman ko, phir zameen ko theek-thaak kiya, is tarah dono aayatein ek dusre ke mukhalif na rahengi.

Is aib se Allah ka kalam bilkul mehfooz hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne yahi ma'ani bayan farmaye hain (ya'ni pehle zameen ki durusti waghera yeh baad ki cheez hai). Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) aur deegar sahaba se marvi hai ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka Arsh pani par tha aur kisi cheez ko paida nahin kiya tha. Jab aur makhlooq ko paida karna chaha toh pani se dhuan buland kiya, woh ooncha charha aur us se aasman banaye, phir pani khushk ho gaya aur us ki zameen banayi, phir us ko alag alag kar ke saat zameenain banayin. Itwar aur Peer ke do din mein yeh saaton zameenain ban gayin. Zameen machli par hai aur machli woh hai jis ka zikr Quran-e-Majeed ki is aayat mein hai, aayat (Noon wal qalam), machli pani mein hai aur pani safaat par hai aur safaat farishtay par aur farishtay pathar par. Zameen kanpne lagi toh Allah Ta'ala ne paharon ko gaar diya aur woh thehar gayi. Yahi ma'ani hain Allah Ta'ala ke farman aayat (Wa ja'alna fil ardi rawasiya an tameeda bihim) (21. Al-Anbiya: 31) ke, zameen na hile is liye hum ne is mein pahar jama diye hain. Pahar, zameen ki paidawar, darakht waghera zameen ki kul cheezain Mangal aur Budh ke do dinon mein paida keen. Isi ka bayan aayat (Qul a-innakum latakfuroona billazi khalaqal arda fi yawmayn) (41. Fussilat: 9) wali aayat mein hai. Phir aasman ki taraf tawajjo farmayi jo dhuan tha, aasman banaya, phir isi mein saat aasman banaye Jumerat aur Jumma ke do dinon mein. Jumma ke din ko is liye Jumma kaha jata hai ke is mein zameen-o-aasman ki paidaish jama ho gayi. Har aasman mein us ne farishton ko paida kiya aur un cheezon ko jin ka ilm us ke siwa kisi ko nahin. Dunya ke aasman ko sitaron ke sath zeenat di aur unhein shaitan se hifazat ka sabab banaya. In tamam cheezon ko paida kar ke Parwardigar ne Arsh-e-Azeem par qarar pakra, jaisa farmata hai: Aayat (Khalaqas samawati wal arda fi sittati ayyamin summas tawa 'alal arsh) (7. Al-A'raf: 54), ya'ni chhay din mein aasmanon aur zameen ko paida kar ke phir Arsh par mustawi ho gaya. Aur jagah farmaya: Aayat (Kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma) (21. Al-Anbiya: 30), ya'ni yeh dono dhuan se thay, hum ne inhein phara aur pani se har cheez ko zindagi di (Tafsir-e-Suddi). Yeh mauqoof qaul jis mein kayi qisam ka ehtimal hai, bazahiran aisi ahem baat mein hujjat-e-tamma nahin ho sakta. Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Saeed (R.A) farmate hain ke Itwar se makhlooq ki paidaish shuru hui. Do din mein zameenain paida huin, do din mein un mein mojood tamam cheezain paida keen aur do din mein aasmanon ko paida kiya. Jumma ke din aakhri waqt un ki paidaish khatam hui aur isi waqt Hazrat Adam (A.S) ko paida kiya aur isi waqt mein Qayamat qaim hogi. Mujahid farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne zameen ko aasman se pehle paida kiya, is se jo dhuan oopar charha us ke aasman banaye jo ek par ek is tarah saat hain aur zameenain ek neeche ek oopar is tarah saat hain.

Is aayat se saaf maloom hota hai ke zameen ki paidaish aasmanon se pehle hai jaise Surah Sajdah ki aayat mein hai. Ulama ki is par ittefaq hai. Sirf Qatadah R.H farmate hain ke aasman zameen se pehle paida hue hain. Qurtubi is mein tawaqquf karte hain aayat (Wan-Nazi'at) ki aayat ki wajah se. Yeh log kehte hain ke yahan aasman ki paidaish ka zikr zameen se pehle hai. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se jab yeh sawal hua toh aap ne jawab diya ke zameen paida toh aasmanon se pehle ki gayi hai lekin baad mein phailayi gayi hai. Yehi jawab agle pichle ulama ka hai. Surah Nazi'at ki tafsir mein bhi is ka bayan aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Hasil-e-amr yeh hai ke zameen ka phailana aur bichana baad mein hai aur 'Dahaha' ka lafz Quran mein hai aur is ke baad jo pani, chara, pahar waghera ka zikr hai yeh goya is lafz ki tashreeh hai. Jin jin cheezon ki nashonuma ki quwwat is zameen mein rakhi thi un sab ko zahir kar diya aur zameen ki paidawar tarah tarah ki mukhtalif shaklon aur mukhtalif qismon mein nikal aayi. Isi tarah aasman mein bhi thehre rehne wale, chalne wale sitare waghera banaye. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Sahih Muslim aur Nasai mein hadith mein hai Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A farmate hain Rasool Allah ﷺ ne mera hath pakra aur farmaya mitti ko Allah Ta'ala ne hafta wale din paida kiya, paharon ko itwar ke din, darakhton ko peer ke din, buraiyon ko mangal ke din, noor ko budh ke din, janwaron ko jumeraat ke din, Adam A.S ko jumma ke din aur asr ke baad jumma ki aakhri sa'at mein asr ke baad se raat tak. Yeh hadith gharaib mein se hai. Imam Ibn Madini, Imam Bukhari waghera ne is par behas ki hai aur farmaya hai ke Ka'ab ka apna qaul aur Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ne Ka'ab ka yeh qaul suna hai aur ba'az rawiyon ne ise ghalti se marfoo hadith qarar de liya hai. Imam Baihaqi R.H kehte hain.

Khilafat-e-Adam ka mafhoom: Allah Ta'ala ke is ehsan ko dekho ke us ne Adam A.S ko paida karne se pehle farishton mein un ka zikr kiya jis ka bayan is ayat mein hai. Farmata hai ke ae Nabi tum yaad karo aur apni ummat ko yeh khabar pahunchao. Abu Ubaidah toh kehte hain ke lafz "iz" yahan zaid hai lekin Ibn-e-Jarir waghera mufassireen is ki tardeed karte hain. Khalifa se murad yeh hai ke un ke yakke baad deegre baaz ke baaz jansheen honge aur ek zamana ke baad dusre zamana mein yunhi sadiyon tak yeh silsila rahe ga. Jaise aur jagah irshad hai: Ayat (Huwal-lazi ja'alakum khala'ifa fil-ard) (Surah Fatir: 39). Dusri jagah farmaya: Ayat (Wa yaj'alukum khulafa'al-ard) (Surah An-Naml: 62) yani tumhein us ne zameen ka khalifa bana diya aur irshad hai ke un ke baad un ke khalifa yani jansheen bure log hue. Ek shaaz qira'at mein khalifa bhi hai. Baaz mufassireen kehte hain ke khalifa se murad sirf Hazrat Adam A.S hain lekin is bare mein Tafsir-e-Razi ke mufassir ne ikhtilaf ko zikr kiya hai. Bazahir yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh matlab nahin. Is ki ek daleel toh farishton ka yeh qaul hai ke woh zameen mein fasad karenge aur khoon bahayenge toh zahir hai ke unhon ne aulad-e-Adam ki nisbat yeh farmaya tha na ke khaas Hazrat Adam A.S ki nisbat. Yeh aur baat hai ke is ka ilm farishton ko kyonkar hua? Ya toh kisi khaas zariye se unhein yeh maloom hua ya bashari tabiyat ke iqtiza ko dekh kar unhon ne yeh faisla kiya hoga kyonke yeh farma diya gaya tha ke is ki paidaish mitti se hogi ya lafz-e-khalifa ke mafhoom se unhon ne samajh liya hoga ke woh faisle karne wala, mazalim ki rok-thaam karne wala aur haram kamon aur gunahon ki baton se rokne wala hoga ya unhon ne pehli makhlooq ko dekha tha isi bina par ise bhi qiyas kiya hoga. Yeh baat yaad rakhni chahiye ke farishton ki yeh arz bator-e-aitraz na thi na Bani Adam se hasad ke taur par thi. Jin logon ka yeh khayal hai woh qat'i ghalti kar rahe hain. Farishton ki shaan mein Quran farmata hai: Ayat (La yasbiqoona-hu bil-qauli wa hum bi-amrihi ya'maloon) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 27) yani jis baat ke daryaft karne ki unhein ijazat na ho us mein woh lab nahin hilate (aur yeh bhi zahir hai ke farishton ki tabiyat hasad se paak hai) balkeh sahih matlab yeh hai ke yeh sawal sirf is hikmat maloom karne ke liye aur is raaz ke zahir karane ke liye tha jo un ki samajh se balatar tha.

Yeh toh jaante thay ke is makhlooq mein fasadi log bhi honge toh ab ba-adab sawal kiya ke Parwardigar aisi makhlooq ke paida karne mein kaunsi hikmat hai? Agar ibadat maqsood hai toh ibadat toh hum karte hi hain, tasbeeh-o-taqdees-o-tahmeed har waqt hamari zabanon par hai aur phir fasad waghera se pak hain toh phir aur makhlooq jin mein fasadi aur khooni bhi honge kis maslahat par paida ki ja rahi hai? Toh Allah Ta'ala ne un ke sawal ka jawab diya ke bawajood is ke fasad ke ise jin maslahaton aur hikmaton ki bina par main paida kar raha hoon unhein main hi jaanta hoon tumhara ilm un tak hikmaton nahin pahunch sakta main jaanta hoon ke un mein ambiya aur rasool honge un mein siddiq aur shaheed honge. Un mein aabid, zahid, awliya, abrar, nekokar, muqarrab-e-bargah, ulama, sulaha, muttaqi, parhezgar, khauf-e-Ilahi, hub-e-Bari Ta'ala rakhne wale bhi honge. Mere ahkaam ki basar-o-chashm tameel karne wale, mere nabiyon ke irshad par labbaik pukarne wale bhi honge. Sahihain ki hadith mein hai ke din ke farishtay subh-e-sadiq ke waqt aate hain aur asr ko chale jaate hain. Tab raat ke farishtay aate hain aur subh ko jaate hain. Aane wale jab aate hain tab bhi aur jab jaate hain tab bhi subh ki aur asr ki namaz mein logon ko paate hain aur darbar-e-Ilahi mein Parwardigar ke sawal ke jawab mein dono jamaatein yahi kehti hain ke gaye toh namaz mein paya aur aaye toh namaz mein chhod kar aaye yahi woh maslahat-e-Allah hai jise farishton ko bataya gaya ke main jaanta hoon aur tum nahin jaante. In farishton ko isi cheez ko dekhne ke liye bheja jaata hai aur din ke aamal raat se pehle aur raat ke din se pehle Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki khidmat mein pesh kiye jaate hain. Gharz tafseeli hikmat jo paidaish-e-insan mein thi us ki nisbat farmaya ke yeh mere makhsoos ilm mein hai. Jo tumhein maloom nahin baaz kehte hain yeh jawab farishton ke is qaul ka hai ke hum teri tasbeeh waghera karte rehte hain toh unhein farmaya gaya ke main hi jaanta hoon tum jaisa sab ko yaksan samajhte ho aisa nahin balkay tum mein ek Iblees bhi hai. Ek teesra qaul yeh hai ke farishton ka yeh sab kehna darasal yeh matlab rakhta tha ke hamein zameen mein basaya jaaye toh jawaban kaha gaya ke tumhari aasmanon mein rehne ki maslahat main hi jaanta hoon aur mujhe ilm hai ke tumhare laiq jagah yahi hai wallahu aalam. Hasan, Qatada waghera kehte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne farishton ko khabar di. Suddi kehte hain mashwara liya. Lekin is ke ma'ani bhi khabar dene ke ho sakte hain. Agar na hon toh phir yeh baat be-wazan ho jaati hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke jab Makkah se zameen phailayi aur bichayi gayi toh Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf sab se pehle farishton ne kiya aur zameen mein khalifa banane se murad Makkah mein khalifa banana hai. Yeh hadith mursal hai phir is mein za'f hai aur mudraj hai yani zameen se murad Makkah lena rawi ka apna khayal hai wallahu aalam. Bazahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke zameen se saari zameen murad hai.

Farishton ne jab yeh suna toh poocha tha ke woh khalifa kya hoga? Aur jawab mein kaha gaya tha ke us ki aulad mein aise log bhi honge jo zameen mein fasad karein, hasad-o-bughz karein, qatl-o-khoon karein un mein woh adl-o-insaf karega aur mere ahkaam jaari karega toh is se murad Hazrat Adam A.S hain. Jo un ke qaim-maqam Allah Ta'ala ki itaat aur makhlooq mein adl-o-insaf karne ki bina par fasad phailane aur khoon bahane wale khalifa nahin. Lekin yeh yaad rahe ke yahan murad khilafat se ek zamana jo dusre zamana ke baad aata hai. Khalifa fa'eela ke wazan par hai. Jab ek ke baad dusra us ke qaim-maqam ho toh Arab kehte hain. Khalafa fulanun fulanan, falan shakhs ka khalifa hua jaise Quran mein hai ke hum un ke baad tumhein zameen ka khalifa bana kar dekhte hain ke tum kaise amal karte ho aur isi liye Sultan-e-Azam ko khalifa kehte hain is liye ke woh agle badshah ka janasheen hota hai. Muhammad bin Ishaq kehte hain murad yeh hai ke zameen ka sakin us ki abadi karne wala hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain pehle zameen mein jinnat baste the. Unhon ne is mein fasad kiya aur khoon bahaya aur qatl-o-gharat kiya, Iblees ko bheja gaya us ne aur us ke sathiyon ne unhein maar maar kar jazeeron aur paharon mein bhaga diya, Hazrat Adam A.S ko paida kar ke zameen mein basaya toh goya yeh un pehle walon ke khalifa aur janasheen hue. Pas farishton ke qaul se murad aulad-e-Adam hain jis waqt un se kaha gaya ke main zameen ko aur is mein basne wali makhlooq ko paida karna chahta hoon. Us waqt zameen thi lekin is mein abadi na thi. Ba'az sahaba se yeh bhi marwi hai ke chunke Allah Ta'ala ne unhein maloom karwa diya tha ke aulad-e-Adam aise aise kaam karegi toh unhon ne yeh poocha aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke jinnat ke fasad par unhon ne Bani Adam ke fasad ko qayas kar ke yeh sawal kiya. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr R.A se riwayat hai ke Adam A.S se do hazar saal pehle se jinnat zameen mein abad the. Abul Aliyah farmate hain farishte budh ke din paida hue aur jinnat ko jumerat ke din paida kiya aur jumma ke din Adam A.S paida hue. Hazrat Hassan aur Hazrat Qatadah ka qaul hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne unhein khabar di thi ke Ibn-e-Adam aisa aisa karenge is bina par unhon ne sawal kiya. Abu Jafar Muhammad bin Ali farmate hain Sajal nami ek farishta hai jis ke sathi Haroot Maroot the. Use har din teen martaba Lauh-e-Mahfooz par nazar dalne ki ijazat thi. Ek martaba us ne Adam A.S ki paidaish aur deegar umoor ka jab mutala kiya toh chupke se apne un dono sathiyon ko bhi ittila kardi. Ab jo Allah Ta'ala ne apna irada zahir farmaya toh un dono ne yeh sawal kiya lekin yeh riwayat ghareeb hai aur sabh maan lene par bhi mumkin hai ke Abu Jafar ne ise Ahl-e-Kitab Yahood-o-Nasara se akhaz kiya ho. Bahar-surat yeh ek wahi-tabahi riwayat hai aur qabil-e-tardeed hai. Wallahu A'alam. Phir is riwayat mein hai ke do farishton ne yeh sawal kiya. Yeh Quran ki rawani ibarat ke bhi khilaf hai.

Yeh bhi riwayat marwi hai ke yeh kehne wale farishtay das hazar thay aur woh sab ke sab jala diye gaye. Yeh bhi Bani Israeli riwayat hai aur bohat hi ghareeb hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain is sawal ki unhein ijazat di gayi thi aur yeh bhi maloom kara diya gaya tha ke yeh makhlooq nafarman bhi hogi to unhon ne nihayat ta'ajjub ke sath Allah ki maslahat maloom karne ke liye yeh sawal kiya na ke koi mashwara diya ya inkar kiya ya aitraz kiya ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke jab Adam A.S ki paidaish shuru hui to farishton ne kaha namumkin hai ke koi makhlooq hum se zyada buzurg aur aalim ho to is par yeh imtehan Allah ki taraf se aaya aur koi makhlooq imtehan se nahin chhooti. Zameen aur aasman par bhi imtehan aaya tha aur unhon ne sar-e-kham kar ke itaat-e-Ilahiya ke liye aamadgi zahir ki. Farishton ki tasbeeh-o-taqdees se murad Allah Ta'ala ki paki bayan karna, namaz parhna, be-adabi se bachna, barai aur azmat karna hai. Farman-bardari karna, Subooh-un-Quddus waghera parhna hai. Quds ke ma'ani pak ke hain. Pak zameen ko muqaddas kehte hain. Rasool Allah ﷺ se sawal hota hai ke kaunsa kalam afzal hai? Jawab dete hain woh jise Allah Ta'ala ne apne farishton ke liye pasand farmaya: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi (Sahih Muslim). Huzoor ﷺ ne me'raj wali raat aasmanon par farishton ki yeh tasbeeh suni: Subhanal Aliyyil A'la Subhanah.

Khalifa ke faraiz aur khilafat ki nau'iyat:
Imam Qurtubi waghera ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai ke Khalifa ka muqarrar karna wajib hai taake woh logon ke ikhtilafat ka faisla kare, un ke jhagray chukaye, mazloom ka badla zalim se le, haddein qaim kare, buraiyon ke murtakib logon ko daantay daptay waghera, woh baray baray kaam jo baghair Imam ke anjam nahin pa sakte. Chunke yeh kaam wajib hain aur yeh baghair Imam ke pooray nahin ho sakte aur jis cheez ke baghair wajib poora na ho woh bhi wajib ho jati hai lehaza Khalifa ka muqarrar karna wajib sabit hua. Imamat ya to Quran-o-Hadith ke zahiri lafzon se milegi jaise ke Ahl-e-Sunnat ki aik jamaat ka Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ki nisbat khayal hai ke un ka naam Huzoor ﷺ ne khilafat ke liye liya tha ya Quran-o-Hadith se is ki janib ishara ho. Jaise Ahl-e-Sunnat hi ki doosri jamaat ka Khalifa-e-Awwal ki babat yeh khayal hai ke isharatan un ka zikr Huzoor ﷺ ne khilafat ke liye kiya. Ya aik Khalifa apne baad doosre ko namzad kar jaye jaise Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ne Hazrat Umar R.A ko apna janasheen muqarrar kar diya tha. Ya woh saleh logon ki aik committee bana kar intekhab ka kaam un ke supurd kar jaye jaise ke Hazrat Umar R.A ne kiya tha ya Ahl-e-Hal-o-Aqd (yani ba-asar sardaran-e-lashkar, ulama-o-sulaha waghera) is ki bai'at par ijma kar lein ya un mein se koi is ki bai'at kar le to jamhoor ke nazdeek is ka lazim pakarna wajib ho jayega. Imam-ul-Harmain ne is par ijma naqal kiya hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Ya koi shakhs logon ko bazor-o-jabr apni matahti par bebas kar de toh bhi wajib hojata hai ke us ke haath par bai'at kar lein taake phoot aur ikhtilaf na phaile. Imam Shafi'i ne saaf lafzon mein faisla kiya hai. Is bai'at ke waqt gawahon ki maujoodgi ke wajib hone mein ikhtilafat hai, ba'az toh kehte hain yeh shart nahin, ba'az kehte hain shart hai aur do gawah kaafi hain. Jubba'i kehta hai bai'at karne wale aur jis ke haath par bai'at ho rahi hai un dono ke alawa chaar gawah chahiyein. Jaise ke Hazrat Umar R.A ne shura ke chhe arkaan muqarrar kiye the phir unhon ne Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf R.A ko mukhtar kar diya aur aap ne Hazrat Usman R.A ke haath par baqi charon ki maujoodgi mein bai'at ki lekin is istidlal mein ikhtilaf hai. Wallahu A'lam. Imam ka mard hona, azaad hona, baligh hona, aqalmand hona, musalman hona, aadil hona, mujtahid hona, aankhon wala hona, sahih salim a'za wala hona, funoon-e-jang se aur raye se khabardar hona, Quraishi hona wajib hai aur yahi sahih hai. Haan Hashmi hona aur khata se ma'soom hona shart nahin. Yeh dono shartein mutashaddid Rafzi lagate hain. Imam agar fasiq hojaye toh use ma'zool kar dena chahiye ya nahin? Is mein ikhtilaf hai aur sahih yeh hai ke ma'zool na kiya jaye kyunke hadith mein aa chuka hai ke jab tak aisa khula kufr na dekh lo jis ke kufr hone ki zahir daleel Allah ki taraf se tumhare paas ho. Isi tarah khud imam apne aap ma'zool ho sakta hai ya nahin? Is mein bhi ikhtilaf hai. Hazrat Hasan bin Ali R.A khud-ba-khud aap hi ma'zool hogaye the aur amr-e-imamat Hazrat Mu'awiyah R.A ko sonp diya tha lekin yeh uzr ke ba'is tha jis par un ki tareef ki gayi hai. Rooye zameen par ek se zyada imam ek waqt mein nahin ho sakte. Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ka farman hai ke jab tum mein ittefaq ho aur koi agar tum mein judai daalni chahe toh use qatl kar do khwah koi bhi ho. Jamhoor ka yahi mazhab hai aur bahut se buzurgon ne is par ijma naqal kiya hai jin mein se ek Imam-ul-Harmain hain. Karamiyah (Shia) ka qaul hai ke do aur zyada bhi ek waqt mein imam ho sakte hain jaise ke Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Mu'awiyah R.A dono ita'at ke laiq the. Yeh giroh kehta hai ke jab ek waqt mein do do aur zyada nabiyon ka hona jaiz hai toh imamon ka jaiz hona jaiz kyun na ho? Nabuwwat ka martaba toh yaqeenan imamat ke martabe se bahut zyada hai (lekin Sahih Muslim wali hadith aap abhi oopar parh chuke hain ke dusre ko qatl kar daalo. Is liye sahih mazhab wahi hai jo pehle bayan hua). Imam-ul-Harmain ne Ustad Abu Ishaq se bhi hikayat ki hai ke woh do aur zyada imamon ka muqarrar karna us waqt jaiz jante hain jab musalmanon ki saltanat bahut badi wasee ho aur charon taraf phaili hui ho aur do imamon ke darmiyan kayi mulkon ka fasla ho. Imam-ul-Harmain is mein taraddud mein hain, khulafa-e-Bani Abbas ka Iraq mein aur khulafa-e-Bani Fatimah ka Misr mein aur khandan-e-Bani Umayyah ka Maghrib mein mere khayal se yahi haal tha. Is ki bast-o-tafseel Insha'Allah Kitab-ul-Ahkaam ki kisi munasib jagah hum karenge.

Adam A.S ki wajah-e-fazeelat: Yahan se is baat ka bayan ho raha hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne ek khaas ilm mein Hazrat Adam A.S ko farishton par bhi fazeelat di. Yeh waqea farishton ke sajda karne ke baad ka hai lekin Allah ki jo hikmat aap ke paida karne mein thi aur jis ka ilm farishton ko na tha aur is ka ijmali bayan upar ki aayat mein guzra hai is ki munasibat ki wajah se is waqea ko pehle bayan kiya aur farishton ka sajda karna jo is se pehle waqea hua tha baad mein bayan kar diya taake khalifa ke paida karne ki maslahat aur hikmat zahir ho jaye aur yeh maloom ho jaye ke yeh sharafat aur fazeelat Hazrat Adam ko is liye mili ke unhein woh ilm hasil hai jis se farishte khaali hain, farmaya ke Hazrat Adam A.S ko tamam naam bataye yani un ki tamam aulad ke alawa sab janwaron, zameen, aasman, pahar, tari, khushki, ghore, gadhe, bartan, charind, farishte, taare waghera tamam choti bari cheezon ke naam bataye gaye. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer farmate hain ke farishton aur insaanon ke naam maloom karaye gaye thay kyunke is ke baad 'arzahum' aata hai aur yeh zi-aql logon ke liye aata hai. Lekin yeh koi aisi maqool wajah nahin jahan zi-aql aur ghair zi-aql jama hote hain wahan jo lafz laya jata hai woh aql-o-hosh rakhne walon ke liye hi laya jata hai jaise Quran mein hai aayat (وَاللّٰهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَاۗبَّةٍ مِّنْ مَّاۗءٍ) (24-An-Noor: 45) Allah Ta'ala ne tamam janwaron ko paani se paida kiya jin mein se baaz to pet ke bal ghasat-te hain baaz do pairon par chalte hain baaz chaar-paon par chalte hain. Allah Ta'ala jo chahta hai paida karta hai woh har cheez par qadir hai pas is aayat se zahir hai ke ghair zi-aql bhi dakhil hain magar seeghay sab zi-aql ke hain. Alawa azeen 'arzahun' bhi Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood ki qirat mein hai aur Hazrat Ubay bin Ka'ab ki qirat mein 'arzaha' bhi hai. Sahih qaul yahi hai ke tamam cheezon ke naam sikhaye thay zaati naam bhi, sifati naam bhi aur kaamon ke naam bhi, jaise ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul hai ke goz ka naam tak bhi bataya gaya tha. Sahih Bukhari Kitab-ut-Tafseer mein is aayat ki tafseer mein Hazrat Imam Bukhari R.H yeh hadees laye hain. Masla-e-Shafaat: Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke imandaar Qayamat ke din jama honge aur kahenge kya achha hoga agar kisi ko hum apna sifarishi bana kar Allah ke paas bhejein chunancha yeh sab ke sab Hazrat Adam A.S ke paas aayenge aur un se kahenge ke aap hum sab ke baap hain. Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko apne haath se paida kiya, apne farishton se aap ko sajda karaya, aap ko tamam cheezon ke naam sikhaye. Aap Allah Ta'ala ke samne hamari sifarish le jayen. Jo hum is se rahat payein. Hazrat Adam A.S yeh sun kar jawab denge ke main is qabil nahin. Unhein apna gunah yaad aa jayega. Tum Nooh A.S ke paas aayenge aap bhi yahi jawab denge aur Allah Ta'ala ki marzi ke khilaf apne bete ke liye apna dua mangna yaad kar ke sharma jayenge aur farmayenge tum Khaleel-ur-Rahman Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke paas jao.

Yeh sab aap ke paas aayenge lekin yahan se bhi yahi jawab payenge. Aap farmayenge tum Musa A.S ke paas jao jin se Allah ne kalam kiya aur jinhein Taurat inayat farmayi. Yeh sun kar sab ke sab Hazrat Musa A.S ke paas aayenge aur aap se bhi yahi darkhwast karenge lekin yahan se bhi jawab payenge, aap ko bhi ek shakhs ko baghair qasas ke maar dalna yaad aajayega aur sharminda hojayenge aur farmayenge tum Hazrat Isa A.S ke paas jao woh Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool aur Kalimatullah aur Roohullah hain. Yeh sab un ke paas bhi jayenge lekin yahan se bhi yahi jawab milega ke main is laiq nahin tum Muhammad Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas jao jin ke tamam agle pichle gunah bakhsh diye gaye hain. Ab woh saare ke saare mere paas aayenge main aamada hojaunga aur apne Rab se ijazat talab karunga. Mujhe ijazat de di jayegi main apne Rab ko dekhte hi sajde mein gir padunga jab tak Allah ko manzoor hoga sajde mein hi pada rahunga phir aawaz aayegi ke sar uthaiye sawal kijiye poora kiya jayega, kahiye suna jayega, shafa'at kijiye qabool ki jayegi. Ab main apna sar uthaunga aur Allah Ta'ala ki woh tareefein bayan karunga jo usi waqt Allah Ta'ala mujhe sikhayega phir main shafa'at karunga. Mere liye had muqarrar kar di jayegi main unhein jannat mein pahuncha kar phir aaunga. Phir apne Rab ko dekh kar isi tarah sajde mein gir padunga. Phir shafa'at karunga phir had muqarrar hogi unhein bhi jannat mein pahuncha kar teesri martaba aaunga phir chauthi baar zaroor hunga yahan tak ke jahannam mein sirf wohi reh jayenge jinhein Quran ne rok rakha ho aur jin ke liye jahannam ki mudawamat wajib ho gayi ho (yani shirk-o-kufr karne wale). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein, Nasai mein, Ibn Majah waghera mein yeh hadith-e-shafa'at majood hai. Yahan is ke warid karne se maqsood yeh hai ke is hadith mein yeh jumla bhi hai ke log Hazrat Adam A.S se kahenge ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko tamam cheezon ke naam sikhaye. Phir un cheezon ko farishton ke samne pesh kiya aur un se farmaya ke lao agar tum apne qaul mein sache ho ke tum saari makhlooq se zyada ilm wale ho ya apni is baat mein sache ho ke Allah Ta'ala zameen mein khalifa na banayega to in cheezon ke naam batao. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke agar tum apni is baat mein ke "Bani Adam fasad karenge aur khoon bahayenge" sache ho to in ke naam batao. Lekin qaul pehla hi hai. Goya is mein unhein danta gaya ke batao tumhara qaul ke tum hi zameen ki khilafat ke laiq ho aur insaan nahin. Tum hi mere tasbeeh khwan aur itaat guzar ho aur insaan nahin. Agar tum sahih ho to lao yeh cheezin jo tumhare samne majood hain. Inhi ke naam batao.

Aur agar tum nahin bata sakte toh samajh lo ke jab maujooda cheezon ke naam bhi tumhein maloom nahin toh aayinda aane wali cheezon ki nisbat tumhein ilm kaise hoga? Farishton ne yeh sunte hi Allah Ta'ala ki pakeezgi aur badai aur apne ilm ki kami bayan karna shuru kar di aur keh diya ke jise jitna kuch ae Allah tu ne sikha diya utna hi ilm use hasil hai, tamam cheezon par ihata rakhne wala ilm toh sirf tujhi ko hai, tu har cheez ka janne wala hai, apne tamam ahkaam mein hikmat rakhne wala hai, jise jo sikhaye woh bhi hikmat se aur jise na sikhaye woh bhi hikmat se, tu hikmaton wala aur adl wala hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain SubhanAllah ke ma'ani Allah Ta'ala ki pakeezgi ke hain ke woh har burai se munazza hai. Hazrat Umar R.A ne Hazrat Ali R.A aur apne paas ke dusre ashab se ek martaba sawal kiya ke aayat (La ilaha illallah) toh hum jante hain lekin dua (SubhanAllah) kya kalma hai? Toh Hazrat Ali R.A ne jawab diya ke is kalma ko Bari Ta'ala ne apne nafs ke liye pasand farmaya hai aur is se woh khush hota hai aur is ka kehna use mehboob hai. Hazrat Maimoon bin Mehran R.H farmate hain ke is mein Allah Ta'ala ki ta'zeem hai aur tamam buraiyon se pakeezgi ka bayan hai. Hazrat Adam A.S ne naam bata diye ke tumhara naam Jibraeel hai, tumhara naam Mikaeel hai, tum Israfeel ho, yahan tak ke cheel, kawaye waghera sab ke naam bhi jab un se puche gaye toh unhon ne bata diye. Jab Hazrat Adam A.S ki yeh fazeelat farishton ko maloom hui toh Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya dekho main ne tum se pehle na kaha tha ke main har posheeda aur zahir ka janne wala hoon, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa in tajhar bil-qawli fa-innahu ya'lamus-sirra wa akhfa) (Surah Taha: 7) tum buland aawaz se kaho (ya na kaho) Allah toh posheeda se posheeda cheez ko janta hai aur irshad farmaya aayat (Alla yasjudu) al-kh kyun yeh log is Allah Ta'ala ko sajda nahin karte jo aasmanon aur zameen ki chupi cheezon ko nikalta hai aur jo tumhare har batin aur zahir ko janta hai, Allah Ta'ala akela hi mabood hai aur wahi Arsh-e-Azeem ka Rabb hai. Jo tum zahir karte ho aur jo chupate thay use bhi main janta hoon. Matlab yeh hai ke Iblees ke dil mein jo takabbur aur ghuroor tha use main janta tha. Farishton ka yeh kehna ke zameen mein aisi shakhsiyat ko kyun paida karta hai jo fasad kare aur khoon bahaye yeh toh woh qaul tha jise unhon ne zahir kiya tha aur jo chupaya tha woh Iblees ke dil mein ghuroor aur takabbur tha. Ibn Abbas R.A, Ibn Masood R.A aur ba'az sahaba aur Saeed bin Jubair R.H aur Mujahid R.H aur Suddi R.H aur Zahhak R.H aur Thauri R.H ka yahi qaul hai. Ibn Jareer R.H bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain aur Abu Al-Aliyah R.H, Rabee bin Anas R.H, Hasan R.H aur Qatadah R.H ka qaul hai ke un ki batin baat un ka yeh kehna tha ke jis makhlooq ko Allah Ta'ala paida karega hum us se zyada aalim aur zyada buzurg honge lekin baad mein sabit ho gaya aur khud unhon ne bhi jaan liya ke Adam A.S ko ilm aur fazeelat dono mein un par fauqiyat hasil hai.

Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne farishton se farmaya jis tarah tum in cheezon ke namon se be-khabar ho isi tarah tum yeh bhi nahin jaan sakte ke in mein bhale bure har tarah ke honge. Farmanbardar bhi honge aur nafarman bhi. Aur main pehle hi likh chuka hoon ke mujhe Jannat Dozakh donon ko bharna hai lekin tumhein main ne is ki khabar nahin di. Ab jab ke farishton ne Hazrat Adam A.S ko diya hua ilm dekha to un ki bandagi ka iqrar kar liya. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain sab se awla qaul Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka hai ke aasman-o-zameen ke ghaib ka ilm tumhare zahir-o-batin ka ilm mujhe hai un ke zahiri qaul ko aur Iblees ke batini ajab-o-ghuroor ko bhi jaanta tha. Is mein chupane wala sirf ek Iblees hi tha lekin seegha-e-jama ka laya gaya hai is liye ke Arab mein yeh dastoor hai aur un ke kalam mein yeh baat payi jaati hai ke ek ke ya ba'az ke ek kaam ko sab ki taraf nisbat kar diya karte woh kehte hain ke lashkar maar dala gaya ya unhein shikast hui halankeh shikast aur qatl ek ka ya ba'az ka hota hai aur seegha-e-jama ka laate hain. Banu Tameem ke ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ko aap ke hujre ke aage se pukara tha lekin Quran mein is ka bayan in lafzon mein hai ke aayat (اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يُنَادُوْنَكَ مِنْ وَّرَاۗءِ الْحُـجُرٰتِ) (49. Al-Hujurat: 4) jo log tumhein ae Nabi ﷺ hujron ke aage se pukarte hain to dekhiye ke pukarne wala ek tha aur seegha-e-jama ka laya gaya. Isi tarah aayat (وَاللّٰهُ مُخْرِجٌ مَّا كُنْتُمْ تَكْتُمُوْنَ) (2. Al-Baqarah: 72) mein bhi apne dil mein badi ko chupane wala sirf ek Iblees hi tha lekin seegha-e-jama ka laya gaya.

Yeh bhi marwi hai ke agar tum apni is baat mein ke "Bani Adam fasad karenge aur khoon bahayenge" sache ho to in ke naam batao. Lekin qaul pehla hi hai. Goya is mein unhein danta gaya ke batao tumhara qaul ke tum hi zameen ki khilafat ke laiq ho aur insaan nahin. Tum hi mere tasbeeh khwan aur itaat guzar ho aur insaan nahin. Agar tum sahih ho to lao yeh cheezin jo tumhare samne majood hain. Inhi ke naam batao.

Aur agar tum nahin bata sakte toh samajh lo ke jab maujooda cheezon ke naam bhi tumhein maloom nahin toh aayinda aane wali cheezon ki nisbat tumhein ilm kaise hoga? Farishton ne yeh sunte hi Allah Ta'ala ki pakeezgi aur badai aur apne ilm ki kami bayan karna shuru kar di aur keh diya ke jise jitna kuch ae Allah tu ne sikha diya utna hi ilm use hasil hai, tamam cheezon par ihata rakhne wala ilm toh sirf tujhi ko hai, tu har cheez ka janne wala hai, apne tamam ahkaam mein hikmat rakhne wala hai, jise jo sikhaye woh bhi hikmat se aur jise na sikhaye woh bhi hikmat se, tu hikmaton wala aur adl wala hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain SubhanAllah ke ma'ani Allah Ta'ala ki pakeezgi ke hain ke woh har burai se munazza hai. Hazrat Umar R.A ne Hazrat Ali R.A aur apne paas ke dusre ashab se ek martaba sawal kiya ke aayat (La ilaha illallah) toh hum jante hain lekin dua (SubhanAllah) kya kalma hai? Toh Hazrat Ali R.A ne jawab diya ke is kalma ko Bari Ta'ala ne apne nafs ke liye pasand farmaya hai aur is se woh khush hota hai aur is ka kehna use mehboob hai. Hazrat Maimoon bin Mehran R.H farmate hain ke is mein Allah Ta'ala ki ta'zeem hai aur tamam buraiyon se pakeezgi ka bayan hai. Hazrat Adam A.S ne naam bata diye ke tumhara naam Jibraeel hai, tumhara naam Mikaeel hai, tum Israfeel ho, yahan tak ke cheel, kawaye waghera sab ke naam bhi jab un se puche gaye toh unhon ne bata diye. Jab Hazrat Adam A.S ki yeh fazeelat farishton ko maloom hui toh Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya dekho main ne tum se pehle na kaha tha ke main har posheeda aur zahir ka janne wala hoon, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa in tajhar bil-qawli fa-innahu ya'lamus-sirra wa akhfa) (Surah Taha: 7) tum buland aawaz se kaho (ya na kaho) Allah toh posheeda se posheeda cheez ko janta hai aur irshad farmaya aayat (Alla yasjudu) al-kh kyun yeh log is Allah Ta'ala ko sajda nahin karte jo aasmanon aur zameen ki chupi cheezon ko nikalta hai aur jo tumhare har batin aur zahir ko janta hai, Allah Ta'ala akela hi mabood hai aur wahi Arsh-e-Azeem ka Rabb hai. Jo tum zahir karte ho aur jo chupate thay use bhi main janta hoon. Matlab yeh hai ke Iblees ke dil mein jo takabbur aur ghuroor tha use main janta tha. Farishton ka yeh kehna ke zameen mein aisi shakhsiyat ko kyun paida karta hai jo fasad kare aur khoon bahaye yeh toh woh qaul tha jise unhon ne zahir kiya tha aur jo chupaya tha woh Iblees ke dil mein ghuroor aur takabbur tha. Ibn Abbas R.A, Ibn Masood R.A aur ba'az sahaba aur Saeed bin Jubair R.H aur Mujahid R.H aur Suddi R.H aur Zahhak R.H aur Thauri R.H ka yahi qaul hai. Ibn Jareer R.H bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain aur Abu Al-Aliyah R.H, Rabee bin Anas R.H, Hasan R.H aur Qatadah R.H ka qaul hai ke un ki batin baat un ka yeh kehna tha ke jis makhlooq ko Allah Ta'ala paida karega hum us se zyada aalim aur zyada buzurg honge lekin baad mein sabit ho gaya aur khud unhon ne bhi jaan liya ke Adam A.S ko ilm aur fazeelat dono mein un par fauqiyat hasil hai.

Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne farishton se farmaya jis tarah tum in cheezon ke namon se be-khabar ho isi tarah tum yeh bhi nahin jaan sakte ke in mein bhale bure har tarah ke honge. Farmanbardar bhi honge aur nafarman bhi. Aur main pehle hi likh chuka hoon ke mujhe Jannat Dozakh donon ko bharna hai lekin tumhein main ne is ki khabar nahin di. Ab jab ke farishton ne Hazrat Adam A.S ko diya hua ilm dekha to un ki bandagi ka iqrar kar liya. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain sab se awla qaul Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka hai ke aasman-o-zameen ke ghaib ka ilm tumhare zahir-o-batin ka ilm mujhe hai un ke zahiri qaul ko aur Iblees ke batini ajab-o-ghuroor ko bhi jaanta tha. Is mein chupane wala sirf ek Iblees hi tha lekin seegha-e-jama ka laya gaya hai is liye ke Arab mein yeh dastoor hai aur un ke kalam mein yeh baat payi jaati hai ke ek ke ya ba'az ke ek kaam ko sab ki taraf nisbat kar diya karte woh kehte hain ke lashkar maar dala gaya ya unhein shikast hui halankeh shikast aur qatl ek ka ya ba'az ka hota hai aur seegha-e-jama ka laate hain. Banu Tameem ke ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ko aap ke hujre ke aage se pukara tha lekin Quran mein is ka bayan in lafzon mein hai ke aayat (اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يُنَادُوْنَكَ مِنْ وَّرَاۗءِ الْحُـجُرٰتِ) (49. Al-Hujurat: 4) jo log tumhein ae Nabi ﷺ hujron ke aage se pukarte hain to dekhiye ke pukarne wala ek tha aur seegha-e-jama ka laya gaya. Isi tarah aayat (وَاللّٰهُ مُخْرِجٌ مَّا كُنْتُمْ تَكْتُمُوْنَ) (2. Al-Baqarah: 72) mein bhi apne dil mein badi ko chupane wala sirf ek Iblees hi tha lekin seegha-e-jama ka laya gaya.

Adam A.S ki wajah-e-fazeelat: Yahan se is baat ka bayan ho raha hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne ek khaas ilm mein Hazrat Adam A.S ko farishton par bhi fazeelat di. Yeh waqea farishton ke sajda karne ke baad ka hai lekin Allah ki jo hikmat aap ke paida karne mein thi aur jis ka ilm farishton ko na tha aur is ka ijmali bayan upar ki aayat mein guzra hai is ki munasibat ki wajah se is waqea ko pehle bayan kiya aur farishton ka sajda karna jo is se pehle waqea hua tha baad mein bayan kar diya taake khalifa ke paida karne ki maslahat aur hikmat zahir ho jaye aur yeh maloom ho jaye ke yeh sharafat aur fazeelat Hazrat Adam ko is liye mili ke unhein woh ilm hasil hai jis se farishte khaali hain, farmaya ke Hazrat Adam A.S ko tamam naam bataye yani un ki tamam aulad ke alawa sab janwaron, zameen, aasman, pahar, tari, khushki, ghore, gadhe, bartan, charind, farishte, taare waghera tamam choti bari cheezon ke naam bataye gaye. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer farmate hain ke farishton aur insaanon ke naam maloom karaye gaye thay kyunke is ke baad 'arzahum' aata hai aur yeh zi-aql logon ke liye aata hai. Lekin yeh koi aisi maqool wajah nahin jahan zi-aql aur ghair zi-aql jama hote hain wahan jo lafz laya jata hai woh aql-o-hosh rakhne walon ke liye hi laya jata hai jaise Quran mein hai aayat (وَاللّٰهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَاۗبَّةٍ مِّنْ مَّاۗءٍ) (24-An-Noor: 45) Allah Ta'ala ne tamam janwaron ko paani se paida kiya jin mein se baaz to pet ke bal ghasat-te hain baaz do pairon par chalte hain baaz chaar-paon par chalte hain. Allah Ta'ala jo chahta hai paida karta hai woh har cheez par qadir hai pas is aayat se zahir hai ke ghair zi-aql bhi dakhil hain magar seeghay sab zi-aql ke hain. Alawa azeen 'arzahun' bhi Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood ki qirat mein hai aur Hazrat Ubay bin Ka'ab ki qirat mein 'arzaha' bhi hai. Sahih qaul yahi hai ke tamam cheezon ke naam sikhaye thay zaati naam bhi, sifati naam bhi aur kaamon ke naam bhi, jaise ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul hai ke goz ka naam tak bhi bataya gaya tha. Sahih Bukhari Kitab-ut-Tafseer mein is aayat ki tafseer mein Hazrat Imam Bukhari R.H yeh hadees laye hain. Masla-e-Shafaat: Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke imandaar Qayamat ke din jama honge aur kahenge kya achha hoga agar kisi ko hum apna sifarishi bana kar Allah ke paas bhejein chunancha yeh sab ke sab Hazrat Adam A.S ke paas aayenge aur un se kahenge ke aap hum sab ke baap hain. Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko apne haath se paida kiya, apne farishton se aap ko sajda karaya, aap ko tamam cheezon ke naam sikhaye. Aap Allah Ta'ala ke samne hamari sifarish le jayen. Jo hum is se rahat payein. Hazrat Adam A.S yeh sun kar jawab denge ke main is qabil nahin. Unhein apna gunah yaad aa jayega. Tum Nooh A.S ke paas aayenge aap bhi yahi jawab denge aur Allah Ta'ala ki marzi ke khilaf apne bete ke liye apna dua mangna yaad kar ke sharma jayenge aur farmayenge tum Khaleel-ur-Rahman Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke paas jao.

Yeh sab aap ke paas aayenge lekin yahan se bhi yahi jawab payenge. Aap farmayenge tum Musa A.S ke paas jao jin se Allah ne kalam kiya aur jinhein Taurat inayat farmayi. Yeh sun kar sab ke sab Hazrat Musa A.S ke paas aayenge aur aap se bhi yahi darkhwast karenge lekin yahan se bhi jawab payenge, aap ko bhi ek shakhs ko baghair qasas ke maar dalna yaad aajayega aur sharminda hojayenge aur farmayenge tum Hazrat Isa A.S ke paas jao woh Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool aur Kalimatullah aur Roohullah hain. Yeh sab un ke paas bhi jayenge lekin yahan se bhi yahi jawab milega ke main is laiq nahin tum Muhammad Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas jao jin ke tamam agle pichle gunah bakhsh diye gaye hain. Ab woh saare ke saare mere paas aayenge main aamada hojaunga aur apne Rab se ijazat talab karunga. Mujhe ijazat de di jayegi main apne Rab ko dekhte hi sajde mein gir padunga jab tak Allah ko manzoor hoga sajde mein hi pada rahunga phir aawaz aayegi ke sar uthaiye sawal kijiye poora kiya jayega, kahiye suna jayega, shafa'at kijiye qabool ki jayegi. Ab main apna sar uthaunga aur Allah Ta'ala ki woh tareefein bayan karunga jo usi waqt Allah Ta'ala mujhe sikhayega phir main shafa'at karunga. Mere liye had muqarrar kar di jayegi main unhein jannat mein pahuncha kar phir aaunga. Phir apne Rab ko dekh kar isi tarah sajde mein gir padunga. Phir shafa'at karunga phir had muqarrar hogi unhein bhi jannat mein pahuncha kar teesri martaba aaunga phir chauthi baar zaroor hunga yahan tak ke jahannam mein sirf wohi reh jayenge jinhein Quran ne rok rakha ho aur jin ke liye jahannam ki mudawamat wajib ho gayi ho (yani shirk-o-kufr karne wale). Hazrat Adam A.S par Allah Ta'ala ke ehsanat. Hazrat Adam A.S ki is bahut badi buzurgi ka zikr kar ke Allah Ta'ala ne insanon par apna bahut bada ehsan farmaya aur khabar di ke us ne farishton ko hukum diya ke woh Hazrat Adam A.S ko sajda karein. Is ki tasdeeq mein bahut si hadeesein hain, ek toh hadees-e-shafa'at jo abhi bayan hui. Dusri hadees mein hai ke Musa A.S ne Allah Ta'ala se darkhwast ki ke meri mulaqat Hazrat Adam A.S se kara dijiye jo khud bhi jannat se nikle aur hum sab ko bhi nikala. Jab dono paighambar jama hue toh Musa A.S ne kaha ke tum woh Adam ho ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein apne hath se paida kiya aur apni rooh tum mein bhi phonki aur apne farishton se tumhein sajda karaya (aakhir tak) poori hadees anqareeb bayan hogi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Iblees farishton ke ek qabeela mein se tha jinhein jinn kehte the jo aag ke sholon se paida hue the. Is ka naam Haris tha aur jannat ka khazin tha. Is qabeele ke siwa aur farishte sab ke sab noori the. Quran ne bhi in jinnon ki paidaish ka zikr kiya hai aur farmaya hai aayat (وَخَلَقَ الْجَاۗنَّ مِنْ مَّارِجٍ مِّنْ نَّارٍ) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 15). Aag ke shole ki jo tezi se buland hote hain use maarij kehte hain jis se jinn paida kiye gaye the aur insaan mitti se paida kiya gaya. Zameen mein pehle jinn baste the. Unhon ne fasaad aur khoon-rezi shuru ki toh Allah Ta'ala ne Iblees ko farishton ka lashkar de kar bheja, inhi ko "jinn" kaha jata tha. Iblees ne lad-bhid kar marte aur qatl karte hue unhein samundar ke jazeeron aur pahadon ke damanon mein pahuncha diya aur Iblees ke dil mein yeh takabbur sama gaya ke main ne woh kaam kiya hai jo kisi aur se na ho saka. Chunke dil ki is badi aur is posheeda khudi ka ilm sirf Allah Ta'ala hi ko tha. Jab Parwardigar ne farmaya ke zameen mein khalifa paida karna chahta hoon toh in farishton ne arz kiya ke aise ko kyun paida karta hai jo agli qoum ki tarah fasaad-o-khoon-rezi karein toh unhein jawab diya gaya ke main woh jaanta hoon jo tum nahin jaante, yani Iblees ke dil mein jo kibr-o-ghuroor hai us ka mujhi ko ilm hai tumhein khabar nahin. Phir Adam A.S ki mitti uthai gayi jo chikni aur achi thi. Jab is ka khameer utha tab is se Hazrat Adam A.S ko Allah Ta'ala ne apne hath se paida kiya aur chalees din tak woh yunhi putle ki shakal mein rahe. Iblees aata tha aur is par laat maar kar dekhta tha toh woh bajti mitti hoti jaise koi khokhli cheez ho, phir munh ke surakh se ghus kar peeche ke surakh se aur is ke khilaf aata jaata raha aur kehta raha ke darhaqeeqat yeh koi cheez nahin aur agar main is par musallat kiya gaya toh ise barbad kar ke chhod doonga aur ise mujh par musallat kiya gaya toh main hargiz tasleem na karunga. Phir jab Allah Ta'ala ne in mein rooh phonki aur woh sar ki taraf se neeche ki taraf aayi toh jahan jahan tak pahunchti gayi khoon gosht banta gaya.

Jab naaf tak rooh pahunchi toh apne jism ko dekh kar khush hue aur foran uthna chaha lekin neeche ke dhad mein rooh nahin pahunchti thi is liye uth na sake isi jaldi ka bayan is aayat mein hai aayat (Wa kaanal insaanu ajoola) (17. Al-Isra: 11) yani insaan besabra aur jald baaz hai na toh khushi na ranj mein. Jab rooh jism mein pahunchi aur chheenk aayi toh kaha aayat (Alhamdulillah-e-Rabbil Aalameen) Allah Ta'ala ne jawab diya dua (Yarhamukallah) phir sirf Iblees ke saathi farishton se farmaya ke Aadam ke saamne sajda karo toh un sab ne sajda kiya lekin Iblees ka woh ghuroor-o-takabbur zahir ho gaya usne na maana aur sajde se inkaar kar diya aur kehne laga main is se behtar hoon is se badi umr wala hoon aur is se qawi aur mazboot hoon. Yeh mitti se paida kiya gaya hai aur main aag se bana hoon aur aag mitti se qawi hai. Is ke inkaar par Allah Ta'ala ne use apni rahmat se na-umeed kar diya aur isi liye use Iblees kaha jata hai. Is ki nafarmani ki saza mein use raanda-e-dargah Shaitan bana diya phir Hazrat Aadam A.S ko insaan, janwar, zameen, samundar, pahad waghera ke naam bata kar un ko un farishton ke saamne pesh kiya jo Iblees ke saathi the aur aag se paida shuda the aur un se farmaya ke agar tum is baat mein sache ho ke main zameen mein ise khalifa na banaun toh zara mujhe in cheezon ke naam toh bata do. Jab un farishton ne dekha ke hamari agli baat se Ilahul Aalameen naraz hai toh woh kehne lage ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal toh is baat se paak hai ke tere siwa koi aur ghaib ko jaane hamari tauba hai aur iqrar hai ke hum ghaib daan nahin. Hum toh sirf wahi jaan sakte hain jis ka ilm tu hamein de de. Jaise tu ne in ke naam sirf Hazrat Aadam A.S ko hi sikhaye hain. Ab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Aadam A.S se farmaya ke tum inhe in tamam cheezon ke naam bata do chunancha unhon ne bata diye toh farmaya ae farishto! Kya main ne tum se nahin kaha tha ke aasman-o-zameen ke ghaib ka jaanne wala sirf main akela hi hoon aur koi nahin. Main har posheeda cheez ko bhi waisa hi jaanta hoon jaise zahir ko aur tum sab is se be-khabar ho lekin yeh qaul bhi ghareeb hai aur is mein bahut si baatein aisi hain jin mein khamiyan hain hum agar inhe alag alag bayan karein toh mazmoon bahut badh jayega aur Ibn Abbas R.A tak is asar ki sanad bhi wahi hai jis se un ki mashhoor tafseer marwi hai. Ek aur hadees mein bhi isi tarah marwi hai jis ke matan mein kuch kami ziyadati bhi hai aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke zameen ki mitti lene ke liye jab Hazrat Jibraeel A.S gaye toh zameen ne kaha ke main Allah Ta'ala ki panah maangti hoon ke tu mujh mein se kuch ghataye woh wapas chale gaye phir Malakul Maut ko bheja. Zameen ne un se bhi yahi kaha lekin unhon ne jawab diya ke main bhi Allah Ta'ala ki panah mein aata hoon ke main Allah ka hukm poora kiye baghair wapas chala jaun chunancha unhon ne tamam roo-e-zameen se ek ek mutthi mitti li.

Chunki mitti ka rang kahin surkh tha kahin safaid kahin siyah isi wajah se insanon ki rangatein bhi tarah tarah ki huin lekin yeh riwayat bhi Bani Israel ki riwayaton se maakhuz hai ghaliban is mein bahut si baatein neeche ke logon ki milayi gayi hain. Sahabi ka bayan hi nahin agar Sahabi ka qaul bhi ho toh bhi unhon ne baaz agli kitabon se liya hoga wallahu aalam. Ta'aruf-e-Iblees: Hakim apni Mustadrak mein bahut si aisi riwayatein laye hain aur un ki sanad ko Bukhari se mashroot kiya hai. Maqsad yeh hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne farishton ko hukum diya ke tum Hazrat Adam A.S ko sajda karo toh is khitab mein Iblees bhi dakhil tha is liye ke go woh un mein se na tha lekin un hi jaisa aur un hi jaise kaam karne wala tha is liye is khitab mein dakhil tha aur phir nafarmani ki saza bhugti. Is ki tafseel Insha'Allah Ta'ala aayat (Kana minal jinn) ki tafseer mein aayegi. Ibn Abbas R.A kehte hain nafarmani se pehle woh farishton mein tha. Azazeel is ka naam tha zameen par is ki rihayish thi ijtihad aur ilm mein bahut bada tha aur isi wajah se dimagh mein ra'oonat thi aur is ki jamaat ka aur is ka talluq jinnon se tha. Is ke chaar par thay. Jannat ka khazin tha zameen aur aasman dono ka sultan tha. Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain, Iblees kabhi farishta na tha is ki asal jinnat se hai jaise ke Adam A.S ki asal ins se hai is ki asnaad sahih hai. Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam aur Shahr bin Haushab ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Saad bin Masood R.A kehte hain ke farishton ne jinnat ko jab maara tab ise qaid kiya tha aur aasman par le gaye thay wahan ki ibadat ki wajah se reh pada. Ibn Abbas R.A se yeh bhi marwi hai ke pehle ek makhlooq ko Allah Ta'ala ne paida kiya unhein Hazrat Adam A.S ko sajda karne ko kaha. Unhon ne inkar kiya jis par woh jala diye gaye phir dusri makhlooq paida ki un ka bhi yahi hashr hua phir teesri makhlooq paida ki unhon ne tameel-e-irshad ki lekin yeh asar bhi ghareeb hai aur is ki asnaad bhi taqreeban ghair sahih hai. Is mein ek rawi mubham hai is wajah se yeh riwayat qabil-e-hujjat nahin. Kafireen se murad nafarman hai. Iblees ki ibtida-e-aafarinesh hi kufr-o-zalalat par thi kuch din theek thaak raha lekin phir apni asliyat par aa gaya. Sajda karne ka hukum baja lana Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at aur Adam A.S ka ikram tha. Baaz logon ka qaul hai ke yeh sajda salam aur izzat-o-ikram ka tha jaise ke Hazrat Yusuf A.S ke bare mein farman hai, ke unhon ne apne maa baap ko takht par bitha liya aur sab ke sab sajde mein gir pade aur Hazrat Yusuf A.S ne farmaya abba yahi mere is khwab ki ta'beer hai jise mere Rab ne saccha kar dikhaya. Agli ummaton mein sajda-e-ta'zeem jaiz tha lekin hamare deen mein yeh mansookh ho gaya.

Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) farmate hain ke main ne shamiyon ko apne sardaron aur ulama ke samne sajda karte hue dekha tha toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se guzarish ki ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap is ke zyada haqdar hain ke aap ko sajda kiya jaye toh aap ne farmaya ke agar main kisi insan ko kisi insan ke samne sajda karne ki ijazat dene wala hota toh auraton ko hukum deta ke woh apne khawandon ko sajda karein kyunke un ka un par bahut bada haq hai. Imam Razi ne isi ko tarjeeh di hai. Baaz kehte hain ke sajda Allah Ta'ala hi ke liye tha. Hazrat Adam (A.S) bator-e-qibla (yani simt) ke thay jaise Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (Aqimis-salata lidulukish-shamsi ila ghasaqil-laili wa qur'anal-fajri) (17. Al-Isra: 78) lekin is mein bhi ikhtilaf hai aur pehle hi qaul ka zyada sahih hona achha maloom hota hai. Yeh sajda Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke ikram, badai, ehtram aur salam ke taur par tha aur Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at ke matehat tha kyunke is ka hukum tha jis ki baja-awari zaroori thi. Imam Razi ne bhi isi qaul ko qawi qarar diya hai aur is ke siwa dusre aqwal ko za'eef qarar diya hai. Ek toh Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka bator-e-qibla ke hona jis mein koi bada sharaf zahir nahin hota. Dusre sajde se murad past aajiz hona na ke zameen mein matha tika kar haqiqi sajda karna lekin yeh dono ta'weelein za'eef hain. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain sab se pehla gunah yahi takabbur hai jo Iblees se sarzad hua. Sahih hadith mein hai jis ke dil mein rai ke dane ke barabar takabbur hoga woh jannat mein dakhil na hoga. Isi takabbur, kufr-o-inaad ki wajah se Iblees ke gale mein tauq-e-la'nat pada aur rahmat se mayoos ho kar janab-e-bari se dhutkara gaya. Yahan "kana" "sara" ke ma'ani mein batlaya gaya hai jaise ke aayat (Fakana minal-mughraqin) (11. Hud: 43) aur aayat (Fatakuna minaz-zalimin) (7. Al-A'raf: 19). Shairon ke shairon mein bhi is ka suboot hai toh ma'ani yeh hue ke woh kafir ho gaya. Ibn-e-Furak kehte hain ke woh Allah Ta'ala ke ilm mein kafiron mein se tha. Qurtubi (R.H) isi ko tarjeeh dete hain aur yahan ek masla bayan farmate hain ke kisi shakhs ke hath se kuch karamatein sarzad ho jana us ke wali-ullah hone ki daleel nahin, go baaz soofi aur raafzi is ke khilaf bhi kehte hain, is liye ke hum is baat ka kisi ke liye faisla nahin kar sakte ke woh iman hi ki halat mein Allah se ja milega. Isi shaitan ko dekhiye wali hi nahin balkay farishta bana hua tha lekin aakhir sardar-e-kufr-o-kuffar ho gaya. Alawa azeen aisi khilaf-e-adat-o-aql baatein jo bazahir karamat nazar aati hain, auliya-ullah ke siwa aur logon ke hathon se bhi sarzad hoti hain balkay fasiq, fajir, mushrik, kafir se bhi zahir ho jati hain. Maslan Rasool-ullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aayat (Fartaqib yauma ta'tis-sama'u bidukhanim-mubin) (44. Ad-Dukhan: 10) ki aayat dil mein soch kar jab Ibn-e-Sayyad kafir se poocha ke main ne kya socha hai toh us ne kaha tha: Dukh.

Ba'az riwayaton mein hai ke gussa ke waqt woh itna phool jata ke us ke jism se tamam rasta ruk jata tha. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ne use mara. Dajjal ki toh aisi bahut si baatein ahadees mein warid hain maslan us ka aasman se barish barsana, zameen se paidawar ugana, zameen ke khazanon ka us ke peeche lagna, ek naujawan ko qatl kar ke phir jilana waghera waghera. Hazrat Laith bin Sa'ad aur Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain agar tum kisi ko pani par chalte hue aur hawaon mein urte hue dekho toh use wali na samajh baitho jab tak ke us ke tamam a'maal-o-af'aal Quran-o-Hadith ke mutabiq na pao. Is sajde ka hukum zameen-o-aasman ke tamam farishton ko tha go ek jama'at ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke sirf zameen ke farishton ko yeh hukum tha lekin yeh theek nahin. Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (Fasajadal mala'ikatu kulluhum ajma'un. Illa Iblis) (Surah Al-Hijr: 30-31) yani Iblis ke siwa tamam farishton ne sajda kiya. Pas awwal toh jama' ka seegha lana phir "kulluhum" se takeed karna phir "ajma'un" kehna us ke baad sirf Iblis ka istisna karna, in charon wajohat se saaf zahir hai ke yeh hukum aam tha, Wallahu A'lam.

Aizaz-e-Adam A.S: Hazrat Adam A.S ki yeh aur buzurgi bayan ho rahi hai ke farishton se sajda karane ke baad unhein jannat mein rakha aur har cheez ki rukhsat de di. Ibn Marduyah ki riwayat karda hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar R.A ne ek martaba Huzoor ﷺ se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ kya Hazrat Adam nabi thay? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya haan! Nabi bhi, Rasool bhi, balkeh Allah Ta'ala ne un se aamne saamne baat cheet ki aur unhein farmaya ke tum aur tumhari biwi jannat mein raho. Aam mufassireen ka bayan hai ke aasmani jannat mein unhein basaya gaya tha lekin Mu'tazila aur Qadriya kehte hain ke yeh jannat zameen par thi. Surah A'raf mein is ka bayan aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Is ibarat-e-Qurani se yeh bhi maloom hota hai ke jannat mein rehne se pehle Hazrat Hawa paida ki gayi thin. Muhammad bin Ishaq farmate hain ke Ahl-e-Kitab waghera ke ulama se barwayat Ibn Abbas R.A marwi hai ke Iblees ke mardood qarar dene ke baad Hazrat Adam A.S ke ilm ko zahir kar ke phir un par oongh ki fauqiyat tari kar di gayi aur un ki baayin pasli se Hazrat Hawa ko paida kiya. Jab aankh khol kar Hazrat Adam A.S ne unhein dekha to apne khoon aur gosht ki wajah se un mein uns-o-mohabbat un ke dilon mein paida hui. Phir Parwardigar ne unhein un ke nikah mein diya aur jannat mein rahaish ka hukum ata farmaya. Baaz kehte hain ke Adam A.S ke jannat mein dakhil ho jane ke baad Hazrat Hawa paida ki gayin. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A, Ibn Masood R.A waghera sahaba se marwi hai ke Iblees ko jannat se nikalne ke baad Hazrat Adam A.S ko jannat mein jagah di gayi. Lekin tan tanha thay is wajah se un ki neend mein Hazrat Hawa ko un ki pasli se paida kiya gaya. Jaage, unhein dekha to poocha tum kaun ho aur kyun paida ki gayi ho? Hazrat Hawa ne farmaya main ek aurat hoon aur aap ke sath rehne aur taskeen ka sabab banne ke liye paida ki gayi hoon to foran farishton ne poocha farmayiye in ka naam kya hai? Hazrat Adam A.S ne kaha "Hawa". Unhon ne kaha is naam ki wajah-e-tasmiya kya hai? Farmaya is liye ke yeh ek zinda se paida ki gayi hain. Isi waqt Allah Ta'ala ki aawaz aayi, ae Adam ab tum aur tumhari biwi jannat mein ba-aaram-o-itminan raho aur jo chaho khao. Lekin ek khaas darakht se rokna darasal imtehan tha. Baaz kehte hain yeh angoor ki bail thi. Koi kehta hai gehoon ka darakht tha. Kisi ne sunbula kaha hai. Kisi ne khajoor, kisi ne anjeer kaha hai. Kisi ne kaha hai is darakht ke khane se insani haajat hoti thi jo jannat ke laiq nahin. Kisi ne kaha hai, is darakht ka phal kha kar farishte hamesha ki zindagi pa gaye hain. Imam Ibn Jareer R.H farmate hain koi ek darakht tha jis se Allah ne rok diya. Na Quran se is ka ta'ayyun sabit hota hai na kisi sahih hadith se. Mufassireen mein ikhtilaf hai aur is ke maloom hone se koi ahem faida aur na maloom hone se koi nuqsan nahin. Lehaza is ki justuju ki kya zaroorat? Allah hi ko is ka behtar ilm hai. Imam Razi R.H waghera ne bhi yahi faisla kiya hai aur theek baat bhi yahi maloom hoti hai.

Anha ki zameer ka marja baaz ne jannat kaha hai aur baaz ne shajra. Ek qirat 'fazallahuma' bhi hai to ma'ani yeh hue ke us jannat se un dono ko be-ta'alluq aur alag kar diya aur dusre ma'ani yeh bhi hue ke isi darakht ke sabab shaitan ne unhein behka diya. Safar-e-arzi ka aaghaz, lafz 'an' sabab ke ma'ani mein bhi aaya hai aayat (Yufaku anhu) mein. Is nafarmani ki wajah se jannati libas aur woh pak makan, nafees rozi waghera sab chhin gayi aur duniya mein utaar diye gaye aur keh diya gaya ke ab to zameen mein hi tumhara rizq hai, qayamat tak yahin pade rahoge aur is se faida hasil karte rahoge. Saanp aur Iblees ka qissa, ya'ni Iblees kis tarah jannat mein pahuncha, kis tarah waswasa dala waghera, is ke bare mein lambe chaude qisse mufassireen ne likhe hain lekin woh sab Bani Israel ke haan ka khazana hai, taham hum unhein Surah A'raf mein bayan karenge kyunke is waqiye ka bayan wahan kisi qadar tafseel ke sath hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek hadith mein hai ke darakht ka phal chakhte hi jannati libas utar gaya. Apne tayin nanga dekh kar idhar udhar daurne lage lekin chunke qad taweel tha aur sar ke baal lambe the, woh ek darakht mein atak gaye. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ae Adam kya mujh se bhagte ho? Arz kiya nahin Ilahi main to sharmindagi se munh chupaye phirta hoon. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ae Adam! Mere paas se chale jao, mujhe meri izzat ki qasam mere paas mere nafarman nahin reh sakte, agar itni makhlooq tum mein paida karoon ke zameen bhar jaye aur phir woh meri nafarmani kare to yaqeenan main use bhi nafarmanon ke ghar mein pahuncha doon. Yeh riwayat ghareeb hai aur sath hi is mein inqita' balkay a'zal bhi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S namaz-e-asr ke baad se lekar suraj ke ghuroob hone tak ki ek sa'at hi jannat mein rahe. Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain yeh ek sa'at ek sau tees saal ki thi. Rabee bin Anas R.H farmate hain nawin ya daswin sa'at mein Hazrat Adam A.S ka ikhraj hua. Un ke sath jannat ki ek shakh thi aur jannat ke darakht ka ek taj sar par tha. Suddi ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S Hind mein utre, aap ke sath Hajar-e-Aswad tha aur jannati darakht ke patte jo Hind mein phaila diye aur is se khushbudar darakht paida hue. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Hind ke shehar "Dahna" mein utre the. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Makkah aur Taif ke darmiyan utre the. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain Hazrat Adam A.S Hind mein aur Mai Hawa R.A Jeddah mein utrein aur Iblees Basra se chand meel ke fasla par Dast-e-Maysan mein phenka gaya aur saanp Isfahan mein. Ibn-e-Umar R.A ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S Safa par aur Hazrat Hawa R.A Marwah par utrein. Utarte waqt dono hath ghutnon par the aur sar jhuka hua tha aur Iblees ungliyon mein ungliyan dale aasman ki taraf nazrein jamaye utra. Hazrat Abu Musa R.A farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne unhein tamam sifatein sikha dein aur phalon ka tosha diya. Ek hadith mein hai ke tamam dinon mein behtar din Jumma ka din hai, isi mein Hazrat Adam A.S paida kiye gaye, isi mein jannat mein dakhil kiye gaye.

Aur isi din nikale gaye mulahiza ho Sahih Muslim aur Nasai. Imam Razi farmate hain is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ki narazgi ki wajoohaat muzmar hain. Awwal toh yeh sochna chahiye ke zara si laghzish par Hazrat Adam (A.S) ko kis qadar saza hui. Kisi shayar ne kya khoob kaha hai ke tum gunahon par gunah kiye jate ho aur jannat ke talib ho, kya tum bhool gaye ke tumhare baap Adam (A.S) ko mehez ek halkay se gunah par jannat se nikal diya gaya. Hum toh yahan dushman ki qaid mein hain, dekhiye! kab sehat-o-salamti ke sath apne watan pahunchein. Fatah Mosuli kehte hain hum jannati thay, Iblees ke behkane mein aa kar duniya ki qaid mein aa phanse, ab siwaye gham-o-ranj ke yahan kya rakha hai? Yeh qaid-o-band isi waqt tootay gi jab hum wahin pahunch jayen jahan se nikale gaye hain. Agar koi mo'tariz aitraz kare ke jab Adam (A.S) aasmani jannat mein thay aur Iblees randah-e-dargah ho chuka tha toh phir woh wahan kaise pahuncha? Toh is ka ek jawab toh yeh hai ke woh jannat zameen mein thi lekin is ke ilawa aur bhi bohat se jawab hain ke bator-e-ikram ke us ka dakhil hona mana tha na ke bator-e-ihanat aur chori ke. Chunancha Taurat mein hai ke saanp ke munh mein baith kar jannat mein gaya aur yeh bhi jawab hai ke woh jannat mein nahin gaya tha balkay bahar hi se us ne waswasa un ke dil mein dala tha. Aur baaz ne kaha hai ke zameen se hi waswasa un ke dil mein dala. Qurtubi ne yahan par saanpon ke bare mein aur un ke maar dalne ke hukm se mutaliq hadeesein bhi tehreer ki hain jo bohat mufeed aur ba-mauqa hain.

Ek qirat 'fazallahuma' bhi hai to ma'ani yeh hue ke us jannat se un dono ko be-ta'alluq aur alag kar diya aur dusre ma'ani yeh bhi hue ke isi darakht ke sabab shaitan ne unhein behka diya. Safar-e-arzi ka aaghaz, lafz 'an' sabab ke ma'ani mein bhi aaya hai aayat (Yufaku anhu) mein. Is nafarmani ki wajah se jannati libas aur woh pak makan, nafees rozi waghera sab chhin gayi aur duniya mein utaar diye gaye aur keh diya gaya ke ab to zameen mein hi tumhara rizq hai, qayamat tak yahin pade rahoge aur is se faida hasil karte rahoge. Saanp aur Iblees ka qissa, ya'ni Iblees kis tarah jannat mein pahuncha, kis tarah waswasa dala waghera, is ke bare mein lambe chaude qisse mufassireen ne likhe hain lekin woh sab Bani Israel ke haan ka khazana hai, taham hum unhein Surah A'raf mein bayan karenge kyunke is waqiye ka bayan wahan kisi qadar tafseel ke sath hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek hadith mein hai ke darakht ka phal chakhte hi jannati libas utar gaya. Apne tayin nanga dekh kar idhar udhar daurne lage lekin chunke qad taweel tha aur sar ke baal lambe the, woh ek darakht mein atak gaye. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ae Adam kya mujh se bhagte ho? Arz kiya nahin Ilahi main to sharmindagi se munh chupaye phirta hoon. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ae Adam! Mere paas se chale jao, mujhe meri izzat ki qasam mere paas mere nafarman nahin reh sakte, agar itni makhlooq tum mein paida karoon ke zameen bhar jaye aur phir woh meri nafarmani kare to yaqeenan main use bhi nafarmanon ke ghar mein pahuncha doon. Yeh riwayat ghareeb hai aur sath hi is mein inqita' balkay a'zal bhi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S namaz-e-asr ke baad se lekar suraj ke ghuroob hone tak ki ek sa'at hi jannat mein rahe. Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain yeh ek sa'at ek sau tees saal ki thi. Rabee bin Anas R.H farmate hain nawin ya daswin sa'at mein Hazrat Adam A.S ka ikhraj hua. Un ke sath jannat ki ek shakh thi aur jannat ke darakht ka ek taj sar par tha. Suddi ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S Hind mein utre, aap ke sath Hajar-e-Aswad tha aur jannati darakht ke patte jo Hind mein phaila diye aur is se khushbudar darakht paida hue. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Hind ke shehar "Dahna" mein utre the. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Makkah aur Taif ke darmiyan utre the. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain Hazrat Adam A.S Hind mein aur Mai Hawa R.A Jeddah mein utrein aur Iblees Basra se chand meel ke fasla par Dast-e-Maysan mein phenka gaya aur saanp Isfahan mein. Ibn-e-Umar R.A ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S Safa par aur Hazrat Hawa R.A Marwah par utrein. Utarte waqt dono hath ghutnon par the aur sar jhuka hua tha aur Iblees ungliyon mein ungliyan dale aasman ki taraf nazrein jamaye utra. Hazrat Abu Musa R.A farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne unhein tamam sifatein sikha dein aur phalon ka tosha diya. Ek hadith mein hai ke tamam dinon mein behtar din Jumma ka din hai, isi mein Hazrat Adam A.S paida kiye gaye, isi mein jannat mein dakhil kiye gaye.

Aur isi din nikale gaye mulahiza ho Sahih Muslim aur Nasai. Imam Razi farmate hain is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ki narazgi ki wajoohaat muzmar hain. Awwal toh yeh sochna chahiye ke zara si laghzish par Hazrat Adam (A.S) ko kis qadar saza hui. Kisi shayar ne kya khoob kaha hai ke tum gunahon par gunah kiye jate ho aur jannat ke talib ho, kya tum bhool gaye ke tumhare baap Adam (A.S) ko mehez ek halkay se gunah par jannat se nikal diya gaya. Hum toh yahan dushman ki qaid mein hain, dekhiye! kab sehat-o-salamti ke sath apne watan pahunchein. Fatah Mosuli kehte hain hum jannati thay, Iblees ke behkane mein aa kar duniya ki qaid mein aa phanse, ab siwaye gham-o-ranj ke yahan kya rakha hai? Yeh qaid-o-band isi waqt tootay gi jab hum wahin pahunch jayen jahan se nikale gaye hain. Agar koi mo'tariz aitraz kare ke jab Adam (A.S) aasmani jannat mein thay aur Iblees randah-e-dargah ho chuka tha toh phir woh wahan kaise pahuncha? Toh is ka ek jawab toh yeh hai ke woh jannat zameen mein thi lekin is ke ilawa aur bhi bohat se jawab hain ke bator-e-ikram ke us ka dakhil hona mana tha na ke bator-e-ihanat aur chori ke. Chunancha Taurat mein hai ke saanp ke munh mein baith kar jannat mein gaya aur yeh bhi jawab hai ke woh jannat mein nahin gaya tha balkay bahar hi se us ne waswasa un ke dil mein dala tha. Aur baaz ne kaha hai ke zameen se hi waswasa un ke dil mein dala. Qurtubi ne yahan par saanpon ke bare mein aur un ke maar dalne ke hukm se mutaliq hadeesein bhi tehreer ki hain jo bohat mufeed aur ba-mauqa hain.

Allah Ta'ala ke ata karda ma'afi nama ka matn jo kalimat Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne seekhay thay un ka bayan khud Quran mein majood hai. Ayat (QALA RABBANA ZALAMNA ANFUSANA WA ILLAM TAGHFIR LANA WATARHAMNA LANAKUNANNA MINAL KHASIREEN) (Surah Al-A'raf: 23) yani un dono ne kaha ae hamaray Rab hum ne apni janon par zulm kiya agar tu hamain na bakhshay ga aur hum par raham na karay ga to yaqeenan hum nuqsan walay ho jayain gay. Aksar buzurgon ka yahi qaul hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se ahkam-e-Hajj seekhna bhi marwi hai. Ubaid bin Umair kehtay hain woh kalimat yeh thay ke unhon ne kaha Ilahi jo khata main ne ki kya usay meray paida karnay se pehlay meri taqdeer mein likh diya gaya tha? Ya main ne khud is ki ijad ki? Jawab mila ke ijad nahin balkay pehlay hi likh diya gaya usay sun kar aap ne kaha phir ae Allah mujhay bakhshish aur ma'afi mil jaye. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh bhi riwayat hai ke Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne kaha Ilahi kya tu ne mujhay apnay hath se paida nahin kiya? Aur mujh mein apni rooh nahin phonki? Meray chheenkne par YarhamukAllah nahin kaha? Kya teri rahmat ghazab par sabqat nahin kar gayi? Kya meri paidaish se pehlay yeh khata meri taqdeer mein nahin likhi thi? Jawab mila ke haan. Yeh sab main ne kiya hai to kaha phir ya Allah meri tauba qabool kar ke mujhay phir jannat mil sakti hai ya nahin? Jawab mila ke haan. Yeh kalimat yani chand batain thin jo aap ne Allah se seekh lein. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki aik marfoo riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne kaha Ilahi agar main tauba karoon aur ruju karoon to kya jannat mein phir bhi ja sakta hoon? Jawab mila ke haan. Allah se kalimat ki talqeen hasil karnay ke yahi ma'ani hain. Lekin yeh hadith ghareeb honay ke ilawa munqata bhi hai. Ba'az buzurgon se marwi hai ke kalimat ki tafseer Rabbana Zalamna aur in sab baton par mushtamil hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se marwi hai ke woh kalimat yeh hain dua: (Allahumma la ilaha illa anta subhanaka wa bihamdika rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi faghfirli innaka khairul ghafireen, Allahumma la ilaha illa anta subhanaka wa bihamdika rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi farhamni innaka khairur rahimin, Allahumma la ilaha illa anta subhanaka wa bihamdika rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi fatub alayya innaka antat tawwabur raheem). Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah hai kya log nahin jantay ke Allah Ta'ala apnay bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai? Aur jagah hai jo shakhs koi bura kaam kar guzray ya apni jaan par zulm kar baithay phir tauba istighfar karay to woh dekh lay ga ke Allah us ki tauba qabool kar lay ga aur usay apnay raham-o-karam mein lay lay ga. Aur jagah hai ayat (WA MAN TABA WA AMILA SALIHAN FA INNAHU YATUBU ILALLAHI MATABA) (Surah Al-Furqan: 71). In sab ayaton mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala bandon ki tauba qabool karta hai, isi tarah yahan bhi yahi farman hai ke woh Allah tauba karnay walon ki tauba qabool karnay wala aur bohat baray raham-o-karam wala hai. Allah Ta'ala ke is aam lutf-o-karam, us ke is fazl-o-raham ko dekho ke woh apnay gunahgar bandon ko bhi apnay dar se mehroom nahin karta.

Sach hai us ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq nahin, na us se zyada koi mehar-o-karam wala na us se zyada koi khata bakhshne wala aur rahm-o-bakhshish ata farmane wala.

Jannat ke husool ki sharait. Jannat se nikalte hue jo hidayat Hazrat Adam A.S, Hazrat Hawa R.A aur Iblees ko di gayi us ka bayan yahan ho raha hai ke hamari taraf se kitabein, ambiya aur rasool bheje jayenge, mojzat zahir kiye jayenge, dalail bayan farmaye jayenge, rah-e-haq wazeh kar di jayegi, An-Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ bhi aayenge, aap par Quran-e-Kareem bhi nazil farmaya jayega, jo bhi apne zamane ki kitab aur nabi ki tabedari karega use aakhirat ke maidan mein koi khauf na hoga aur na hi duniya ke kho jane par koi gham hoga. Surah Taha mein bhi yahi farmaya gaya hai ke meri hidayat ki pairwi karne wale na gumrah honge, na badbakht-o-benaseeb. Magar meri yaad se munh modne wale duniya ki tangi aur aakhirat ke andhe pan ke azab mein giraftar honge. Yahan bhi farmaya ke inkar aur takzeeb karne wale hamesha jahannam mein rahenge. Ibn-e-Jareer ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke jo asli jahannami hain unhein to jahannam mein na maut aayegi, na hi khushgawar zindagi milegi, haan jin muwahid, muttabi-e-sunnat logon ko un ki baaz khataon par jahannam mein dala jayega yeh jal kar koyle ho ho kar mar jayenge aur phir shafa'at ki wajah se nikal liye jayenge. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein bhi yeh hadith hai ke baaz to kehte hain dusri dafa jannat se nikal jane ke hukum ko zikr is liye kiya gaya hai ke yahan dusre ahkaam bayan karna the aur baaz kehte hain pehli martaba jannat se aasman-e-awwal utar diya gaya tha dobara aasman-e-awwal se zameen ki taraf utara gaya lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai Wallahu A'lam.

Jannat se nikalte hue jo hidayat Hazrat Adam A.S, Hazrat Hawa R.A aur Iblees ko di gayi us ka bayan yahan ho raha hai ke hamari taraf se kitabein, ambiya aur rasool bheje jayenge, mojzat zahir kiye jayenge, dalail bayan farmaye jayenge, rah-e-haq wazeh kar di jayegi, An-Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ bhi aayenge, aap par Quran-e-Kareem bhi nazil farmaya jayega, jo bhi apne zamane ki kitab aur nabi ki tabedari karega use aakhirat ke maidan mein koi khauf na hoga aur na hi duniya ke kho jane par koi gham hoga.
