Bani Israel se khitab. In ayaton mein Bani Israel ko Islam qabool karne aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari karne ka hukum diya gaya hai aur intehai lateef pairaye mein unhein samjhaya gaya hai ke tum ek paighambar ki aulad mein se ho, tumhare hathon mein Kitabullah majood hai aur Quran is ki tasdeeq kar raha hai, phir tumhein nahin chahiye ke sab se pehle inkar tumhein se shuru ho. Israel Hazrat Yaqub (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ka naam tha, toh goya un se kaha jata hai ke tum mere saleh aur farmanbardar bande ki aulad ho. Tumhein chahiye ke apne jadd-e-amjad ki tarah haq ki tabedari mein lag jao. Jaise kaha jata hai ke tum sakhi ke ladke ho, sakhawat mein aage badho, tum pehlwan ki aulad ho, dad-e-shujaat do. Tum aalim ke bache ho, ilm mein kamal paida karo. Dusri jagah isi tarz-e-kalam ko isi tarah ada kiya gaya hai. Ayat (Zurriyata man hamalna ma'a Nuhin, innahu kana 'abdan shakura) (17. Al-Isra: 3) yani hamare shukarguzar bande Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ke sath jinhein hum ne ek alamgir toofan se bachaya tha, yeh un ki aulad hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke Yahudiyon ki ek jamaat se Huzoor (ﷺ) ne daryaft kiya ke kya tum nahin jante ke Israel Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ka naam tha? Woh sab qasam kha kar kehte hain ke wallah yeh sach hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Tu gawah reh." Israel ke lafzi ma'ani Abdullah ke hain. In ne'amaton ko yaad dilaya jata hai jo qudrat-e-kamilah ki badi badi nishaniyan thin. Maslan patthar se nehron ko jaari karna, Mann-o-Salwa utarna, Firauniyon se azad karna, inhi mein se ambiya aur rasoolon ko mab'oos karna, in mein saltanat aur badshahi ata farmana waghera. In ko hidayat di jati hai, "Mere wadon ko pura karo," yani main ne jo ahd tum se liya tha ke jab Muhammad (ﷺ) tumhare paas aayen aur un par meri kitab Quran-e-Kareem nazil ho, toh tum is par aur Aap (ﷺ) ki zaat par iman lana. Woh tumhare bojh halke karenge aur tumhari zanjeerein tod denge aur tumhare tauq utaar denge aur mera wada bhi pura ho jayega ke main tumhein is deen ke sakht ahkaam ke mutabadil aasaan deen dunga. Dusri jagah is ka bayan is tarah hota hai, Ayat (Wa qala Allahu inni ma'akum, la'in aqamtumus-salata wa ataitumuz-zakata wa amantum bi-rusuli wa azzartumuhum wa aqradtumullaha qardan hasana) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 12) yani agar tum namazon ko qaim karoge, zakat dete rahoge, mere rasoolon ki hidayat mante rahoge, mujhe achha qarza dete rahoge, toh main tumhari buraiyan door kar dunga aur tumhein behti hui nehron wali jannat mein dakhil karunga. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke Taurat mein wada kiya gaya tha ke main Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ki aulad mein se ek itna bada azeem-ush-shan paighambar paida kar dunga jis ki tabedari tamam makhlooq par farz hogi, un ke tabedaron ko bakhshunga, unhein jannat mein dakhil karunga aur dohra ajar dunga.

Hazrat Imam Razi (R.H) ne apni tafsir mein bade bade ambiya (Alaihimas Salam) se aap ki babat peshgoi naqal ki hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Allah ka ahd Islam ko manna aur us par amal karna tha. Allah ka apne ahd ko pura karna un se khush hona aur jannat ata farmana hai. Mazeed farmaya mujh se daro aisa na ho jo azab tum se pehle logon par nazil hue kahin tum par bhi na aa jayen. Is latif pairaye ko bhi mulahiza farmaiye ke targhib ke bayan ke sath hi kis tarah tarhib ke bayan ko mulhaq kar diya gaya hai. Raghbat-o-rahbat dono jama kar ke itteba-e-haq aur nabuwwat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dawat di gayi. Quran ke sath nasihat hasil karne, is ke batlaye hue ahkam ko manne aur is ke roke hue kamon se ruk jaane ki hidayat ki gayi. Isi liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke tum is Quran-e-Hakim par iman lao jo tumhari kitab ki bhi tasdeeq aur ta'eed karta hai jise le kar woh Nabi aaye hain jo ummi hain, arabi hain, jo bashir hain, jo nazir hain, jo siraj-e-munir hain jin ka ism-e-sharif Muhammad hai (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Jo Taurat ki sachai ki daleel thi is liye kaha gaya ke woh tumhare hathon mein majood kitabon ki tasdeeq karte hain. Ilm hone ke bawajood tum hi sab se pehle inkar na karo. Baaz kehte hain "biha" ki zameer ka marja Quran hai aur pehle aa bhi chuka hai "bima anzalta" aur dono qaul darhaqiqat sache aur ek hi hain. Quran ko manna Rasool ko manna hai aur Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq Quran ki tasdeeq hai. Awwal kafir se murad Bani Israel ke awwaleen munkir hain kyunke kuffar-e-Quraish bhi inkar aur kufr kar chuke thay. Lehaza Bani Israel ka inkar Ahl-e-Kitab mein se pehli jamaat ka inkar tha is liye unhein awwal kafir kaha gaya. Un ke paas woh ilm tha jo dusron ke paas na tha. Meri aayaton ke badle thoda mol na lo yani duniya ke badle jo qaleel aur fani hai meri aayat par iman lana aur mere Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq karna na chhodo agarche duniya sari ki sari bhi mil jaye jab bhi woh aakhirat ke muqable mein thodi bahut thodi hai aur yeh khud un ki kitabon mein bhi majood hai. Sunan Abu Dawood mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs is ilm ko jis se Allah ki razamandi hasil hui hai is liye seekhe ke is se duniya kamaye woh qayamat ke roz jannat ki khushbu tak na payega. Ilm sikhane ki ujrat baghair muqarrar kiye hue lena jaiz hai isi tarah ilm sikhane wale ulama ko Bait-ul-Maal se lena bhi jaiz hai taake woh khush-haal reh sakein aur apni zarooriyaat puri kar sakein.

Agar Bait-ul-Maal se kuch maal na milta ho aur ilm sikhane ki wajah se koi kaam dhanda bhi na kar sakte hon toh phir ujrat muqarrar kar ke lena bhi jaiz hai aur Imam Malik, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad aur jamhoor-e-ulama ka yahi mazhab hai. Is ki daleel woh hadith bhi hai jo Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ki riwayat se hai ke unhon ne ujrat muqarrar kar li aur ek saanp ke kaate hue shakhs par Quran parh kar dam kiya. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne yeh qissa pesh hua toh aap ne farmaya: Hadith (Inna ahaqqa ma akhaztum alaihi ajran Kitabullah) yani jin cheezon par tum ujrat le sakte ho un sab mein zyada haqdar Kitabullah hai. Dusri mutawwal hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs ka nikah ek aurat se aap kar dete hain aur farmate hain: Hadith (Zawwajtuka bima ma'aka minal Quran) main ne is ko teri zaujiyat mein diya aur tu ise Quran-e-Hakim jo tujhe yaad hai ise bator-e-haq-e-mahr yaad kara de. Abu Dawood ki ek hadith mein hai ek shakhs ne Ahl-e-Suffa mein se kisi ko kuch Quran sikhaya, us ne use ek kamaan bator-e-hadiya di. Us ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se masla pucha. Aap ne farmaya agar tujhe aag ki kamaan leni hai toh ise le, chunancha us ne ise chor diya. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) se bhi aisi hi ek marfoo hadith marwi hai. In dono ahadith ka matlab yeh hai ke jab us ne khalis Allah ke waste ki niyat se sikhaya phir us par tohfa aur hadiya le kar apne sawab ko khone ki kya zaroorat hai? Aur jabke shuru hi se ujrat par taleem di hai toh phir bila-shak-o-shubha jaiz hai jaise upar ki dono ahadith mein bayan ho chuka hai. Wallahu A'lam. Sirf Allah hi se darne ke yeh ma'ani hain ke Allah ki rahmat ki umeed par us ki ibadat-o-ita'at mein laga rahe aur us ke azabon se dar kar us ki nafarmaniyon ko chor de aur dono halaton mein apne Rab ki taraf se diye gaye noor par gamzan rahe. Garz is jumla se unhein khauf dilaya gaya ke woh dunyawi lalach mein aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat ki tasdeeq ko jo us ki kitabon mein hai na chupayein aur dunyawi riyasat ki tama' par aap ki mukhalifat par amada na hon balkeh Rab se dar kar izhar-e-haq karte rahein.

Ek hadith mein hai ke Yahudiyon ki ek jamaat se Huzoor (ﷺ) ne daryaft kiya ke kya tum nahin jante ke Israel Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ka naam tha? Woh sab qasam kha kar kehte hain ke wallah yeh sach hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Tu gawah reh." Israel ke lafzi ma'ani Abdullah ke hain. In ne'amaton ko yaad dilaya jata hai jo qudrat-e-kamilah ki badi badi nishaniyan thin. Maslan patthar se nehron ko jaari karna, Mann-o-Salwa utarna, Firauniyon se azad karna, inhi mein se ambiya aur rasoolon ko mab'oos karna, in mein saltanat aur badshahi ata farmana waghera. In ko hidayat di jati hai, "Mere wadon ko pura karo," yani main ne jo ahd tum se liya tha ke jab Muhammad (ﷺ) tumhare paas aayen aur un par meri kitab Quran-e-Kareem nazil ho, toh tum is par aur Aap (ﷺ) ki zaat par iman lana. Woh tumhare bojh halke karenge aur tumhari zanjeerein tod denge aur tumhare tauq utaar denge aur mera wada bhi pura ho jayega ke main tumhein is deen ke sakht ahkaam ke mutabadil aasaan deen dunga. Dusri jagah is ka bayan is tarah hota hai, Ayat (Wa qala Allahu inni ma'akum, la'in aqamtumus-salata wa ataitumuz-zakata wa amantum bi-rusuli wa azzartumuhum wa aqradtumullaha qardan hasana) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 12) yani agar tum namazon ko qaim karoge, zakat dete rahoge, mere rasoolon ki hidayat mante rahoge, mujhe achha qarza dete rahoge, toh main tumhari buraiyan door kar dunga aur tumhein behti hui nehron wali jannat mein dakhil karunga. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke Taurat mein wada kiya gaya tha ke main Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ki aulad mein se ek itna bada azeem-ush-shan paighambar paida kar dunga jis ki tabedari tamam makhlooq par farz hogi, un ke tabedaron ko bakhshunga, unhein jannat mein dakhil karunga aur dohra ajar dunga.

Hazrat Imam Razi (R.H) ne apni tafsir mein bade bade ambiya (Alaihimas Salam) se aap ki babat peshgoi naqal ki hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Allah ka ahd Islam ko manna aur us par amal karna tha. Allah ka apne ahd ko pura karna un se khush hona aur jannat ata farmana hai. Mazeed farmaya mujh se daro aisa na ho jo azab tum se pehle logon par nazil hue kahin tum par bhi na aa jayen. Is latif pairaye ko bhi mulahiza farmaiye ke targhib ke bayan ke sath hi kis tarah tarhib ke bayan ko mulhaq kar diya gaya hai. Raghbat-o-rahbat dono jama kar ke itteba-e-haq aur nabuwwat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dawat di gayi. Quran ke sath nasihat hasil karne, is ke batlaye hue ahkam ko manne aur is ke roke hue kamon se ruk jaane ki hidayat ki gayi. Isi liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke tum is Quran-e-Hakim par iman lao jo tumhari kitab ki bhi tasdeeq aur ta'eed karta hai jise le kar woh Nabi aaye hain jo ummi hain, arabi hain, jo bashir hain, jo nazir hain, jo siraj-e-munir hain jin ka ism-e-sharif Muhammad hai (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Jo Taurat ki sachai ki daleel thi is liye kaha gaya ke woh tumhare hathon mein majood kitabon ki tasdeeq karte hain. Ilm hone ke bawajood tum hi sab se pehle inkar na karo. Baaz kehte hain "biha" ki zameer ka marja Quran hai aur pehle aa bhi chuka hai "bima anzalta" aur dono qaul darhaqiqat sache aur ek hi hain. Quran ko manna Rasool ko manna hai aur Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq Quran ki tasdeeq hai. Awwal kafir se murad Bani Israel ke awwaleen munkir hain kyunke kuffar-e-Quraish bhi inkar aur kufr kar chuke thay. Lehaza Bani Israel ka inkar Ahl-e-Kitab mein se pehli jamaat ka inkar tha is liye unhein awwal kafir kaha gaya. Un ke paas woh ilm tha jo dusron ke paas na tha. Meri aayaton ke badle thoda mol na lo yani duniya ke badle jo qaleel aur fani hai meri aayat par iman lana aur mere Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq karna na chhodo agarche duniya sari ki sari bhi mil jaye jab bhi woh aakhirat ke muqable mein thodi bahut thodi hai aur yeh khud un ki kitabon mein bhi majood hai. Sunan Abu Dawood mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs is ilm ko jis se Allah ki razamandi hasil hui hai is liye seekhe ke is se duniya kamaye woh qayamat ke roz jannat ki khushbu tak na payega. Ilm sikhane ki ujrat baghair muqarrar kiye hue lena jaiz hai isi tarah ilm sikhane wale ulama ko Bait-ul-Maal se lena bhi jaiz hai taake woh khush-haal reh sakein aur apni zarooriyaat puri kar sakein.

Agar Bait-ul-Maal se kuch maal na milta ho aur ilm sikhane ki wajah se koi kaam dhanda bhi na kar sakte hon toh phir ujrat muqarrar kar ke lena bhi jaiz hai aur Imam Malik, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad aur jamhoor-e-ulama ka yahi mazhab hai. Is ki daleel woh hadith bhi hai jo Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ki riwayat se hai ke unhon ne ujrat muqarrar kar li aur ek saanp ke kaate hue shakhs par Quran parh kar dam kiya. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne yeh qissa pesh hua toh aap ne farmaya: Hadith (Inna ahaqqa ma akhaztum alaihi ajran Kitabullah) yani jin cheezon par tum ujrat le sakte ho un sab mein zyada haqdar Kitabullah hai. Dusri mutawwal hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs ka nikah ek aurat se aap kar dete hain aur farmate hain: Hadith (Zawwajtuka bima ma'aka minal Quran) main ne is ko teri zaujiyat mein diya aur tu ise Quran-e-Hakim jo tujhe yaad hai ise bator-e-haq-e-mahr yaad kara de. Abu Dawood ki ek hadith mein hai ek shakhs ne Ahl-e-Suffa mein se kisi ko kuch Quran sikhaya, us ne use ek kamaan bator-e-hadiya di. Us ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se masla pucha. Aap ne farmaya agar tujhe aag ki kamaan leni hai toh ise le, chunancha us ne ise chor diya. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) se bhi aisi hi ek marfoo hadith marwi hai. In dono ahadith ka matlab yeh hai ke jab us ne khalis Allah ke waste ki niyat se sikhaya phir us par tohfa aur hadiya le kar apne sawab ko khone ki kya zaroorat hai? Aur jabke shuru hi se ujrat par taleem di hai toh phir bila-shak-o-shubha jaiz hai jaise upar ki dono ahadith mein bayan ho chuka hai. Wallahu A'lam. Sirf Allah hi se darne ke yeh ma'ani hain ke Allah ki rahmat ki umeed par us ki ibadat-o-ita'at mein laga rahe aur us ke azabon se dar kar us ki nafarmaniyon ko chor de aur dono halaton mein apne Rab ki taraf se diye gaye noor par gamzan rahe. Garz is jumla se unhein khauf dilaya gaya ke woh dunyawi lalach mein aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat ki tasdeeq ko jo us ki kitabon mein hai na chupayein aur dunyawi riyasat ki tama' par aap ki mukhalifat par amada na hon balkeh Rab se dar kar izhar-e-haq karte rahein.

Bad-khu Yahudi, Yahudiyon ki is bad-khaslat par un ko tanbeeh ki ja rahi hai kyunke woh jaanne ke bawajood kabhi toh haq-o-batil ko khalt-malt kar diya karte thay, kabhi haq ko chupa liya karte thay, kabhi batil ko zahir karte thay. Lehaza unhein in napak aadaton ke chhorne ko kaha gaya hai aur haq ko zahir karne aur use khol-khol kar bayan karne ki hidayat ki. Haq-o-batil, sach-jhoot ko aapas mein na milao, Allah ke bandon ki khair-khwahi karo. Yahudiyat-o-Nasraniyat ki bid'aton ko Islam ki taleem ke sath na milao. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki babat peshgoiyan jo tumhari kitabon mein paate ho unhein awam-un-nas se na chupao. Taktumu majzoom bhi ho sakta hai aur mansoob bhi, yani ise aur ise jama na karo. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki qirat mein taktumoona bhi hai. Yeh haal hoga aur is ke baad ka jumla bhi haal hai, ma'ni yeh hue ke haq ko haq jaante hue aisi behayai na karo. Aur yeh bhi ma'ni hain ke ilm ke bawajood ise chupane aur milawat karne ka kaisa azab hoga. Is ka ilm ho kar bhi afsos ke tum bad-kirdari par aamada nazar aate ho. Phir unhein hukm diya jata hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath namazein parho, zakat do aur Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath ruku-o-sujood mein shamil raha karo, inhein mein mil jao aur khud bhi aap hi ummat ban jao, itaat-o-ikhlas ko bhi zakat kehte hain. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ayat ki tafsir mein yahi farmate hain, zakat do sau dirham par, phir is se zyada raqam par wajib hoti hai, namaz-o-zakat farz-o-wajib hai. Is ke baghair sabhi a'maal gharat hain. Zakat se ba'z logon ne fitra bhi murad liya hai. Ruku karne walon ke sath ruku karo se murad yeh hai ke achhe a'maal mein imandaron ka sath do aur in mein behtareen cheez namaz hai. Is ayat se aksar ulama ne namaz-e-ba-jamaat ke farz hone par bhi istidlal kiya hai aur yahan par Imam Qurtubi (R.H) ne masail-e-jamaat ko bast se bayan farmaya hai.

Doghlapan aur Yahudi yani Ahl-e-Kitab is ilm ke bawajood jo kahe aur na kare "is par kitna azab nazil hota hai phir tum khud aisa karne lage ho?" Jaisa dusron ko taqwa, taharat aur pakeezgi sikhate ho khud bhi toh is ke aamil ban jao. Logon ko rozay, namaz ka hukum dena aur khud is ke paband na hona yeh toh bari sharm ki baat hai. Dusron ko kehne se pehle insaan ko khud aamil hona zaroori hai. Apni kitab ke sath kufr karne se logon ko rokte ho lekin Allah ke is Nabi (ﷺ) ko jhutla kar tum khud apni hi kitab ke sath kufr kyun karte ho? Yeh bhi matlab hai ke dusron ko is Deen-e-Islam ko qabool karne ke liye kehte ho magar dunyawi dar-o-khauf se khud qabool nahin karte. Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain aur apne nafs ka in se bhi zyada. In logon ko agar rishwat waghera na milti toh haq bata dete lekin khud aamil na thay jis ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne in ki muzammat ki.

Muballigheen ke liye khusoosi hidayat: Yahan par yeh baat yaad rakhni chahiye ke achi cheez ka hukum dene par in ki burai nahin ki gayi balkay khud na karne par burai bayan ki gayi hai. Achi baat ko kehna toh khud achai hai balkay yeh toh wajib hai lekin is ke sath hi sath insaan ko khud bhi is par amal karna chahiye. Jaise Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) ne farmaya tha, aayat: (Wama ureedu an ukhalifakum ila ma anhakum anhu, in ureedu illal-islaha mastata'tu, wama tawfeeqi illa billahi, alaihi tawakkaltu wa ilaihi uneeb) (Surah Hud: 88). Yani main aisa nahin hoon ke tumhein jis kaam se rokun woh khud karoon, mera irada toh apni taqat ke mutabiq islah ka hai, meri tawfeeq Allah ki madad se hai, mera bharosa usi par hai aur meri raghbat-o-rujoo bhi usi ki taraf hai. Pas nek kaamon ke karne ke liye kehna bhi wajib hai aur khud karna bhi. Ek wajib ko na karne se dusra bhi chor dena nahin chahiye. Ulama-e-Salaf-o-Khalaf ka qaul yahi hai, go baaz ka ek zaeef qaul yeh bhi hai ke buraiyon wala dusron ko achaiyon ka hukum na de lekin yeh qaul theek nahin. Phir in hazraat ka is aayat se daleel pakarna toh bilkul hi theek nahin balkay sahih yahi hai ke bhalai ka hukum kare aur burai se roke aur khud bhi bhalai kare aur burai se ruke. Agar dono chore ga toh dohra gunahgar hoga, ek ke tark par ikahra.

Tabrani ki Mu'jam-e-Kabeer mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Jo aalim logon ko bhalai sikhaye aur khud amal na kare us ki misaal charagh jaisi hai ke log usi ki roshni se faida utha rahe hain lekin woh khud jal raha hai. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Me'raj wali raat main ne dekha ke kuch logon ke hont aag ki qainchiyon se kaatay ja rahe hain, main ne poocha yeh kaun log hain? Toh kaha gaya ke yeh aap ki ummat ke khateeb aur waiz aur aalim hain jo logon ko bhalai sikhate thay magar khud nahin karte thay, ilm ke bawajood samajhte nahin thay.

Dusri hadith mein hai ke un ki zabanain aur hont dono kaatay ja rahe thay yeh hadith sahih hai Ibn-e-Hibban, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim, Ibn-e-Marduyah waghera mein majood hai. Abu Wail farmate hain ek martaba Hazrat Usama se kaha gaya ke aap Hazrat Usman se kuch nahin kehte? Aap ne jawab diya ke tumhein suna kar hi kahun toh hi kehna hoga? Main toh unhein posheeda taur par har waqt kehta rehta hun lekin main kisi baat ko phailana nahin chahta. Allah ki qasam main kisi shakhs ko sab se afzal nahin kahun ga is liye ke main ne Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke ek shakhs ko Qayamat ke din laya jaye ga aur usey Jahannam mein dala jaye ga, us ki aantain nikal aayengi aur woh us ke gird-o-pesh chakkar khata rahe ga. Jahannami jama ho kar us se poochenge ke Hazrat aap toh hamein achi baton ka hukum karne wale aur buraiyon se rokne wale thay, yeh aap ki kya halat hai? Woh kahe ga afsos main tumhein kehta tha lekin khud nahin karta tha, main tumhein rokta tha lekin khud nahin rukta tha (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Bukhari, Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala anparh logon se itna darguzar kare ga jitna janne walon se nahin kare ga. Baaz aasar mein yeh bhi warid hai ke aalim ko ek dafa bakhsha jaye toh aam aadmi ko sattar dafa bakhsha jata hai. Aalim, jahil yaksan nahin ho sakte. Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat: (Hal yastawillazina ya'lamuna wallazina la ya'lamun, innama yatazzakkaru ulul-albab) (Surah Az-Zumar: 9). Janne wale aur anjaan barabar nahin, nasihat sirf aqalmand log hi hasil kar sakte hain. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Jannati log jahannamiyon ko dekh kar kahenge ke tumhari nasihatain sun sun kar hum toh jannati ban gaye magar tum Jahannam mein kyun aa pare? Woh kahenge afsos hum tumhein kehte thay lekin khud nahin karte thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se ek shakhs ne kaha Hazrat main bhalaiyon ka hukum karna aur buraiyon se logon ko rokna chahta hun. Aap ne farmaya kya tum is darja tak pahunch gaye ho? Us ne kaha haan. Aap ne farmaya agar tum in teenon aayaton ki fazihat se nadar ho gaye ho toh shauq se wa'z shuru karo. Us ne poocha woh teen aayatein kya hain? Aap ne farmaya ek toh aayat: (Ata'murunannasi bil-birri wa tansawna anfusakum wa antum tatlunal-kitab, afala ta'qilun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 44). Kya tum logon ko bhalaiyon ka hukum dete ho aur khud apne tayin bhoole ja rahe ho? Dusri aayat: (Lima taquluna ma la taf'alun, kabura maqtan indallahi an taqulu ma la taf'alun) (Surah As-Saff: 2-3). Kyun tum woh kehte ho jo khud nahin karte? Allah ke nazdeek yeh bari napasandida baat hai ke tum woh kaho jo khud na karo.

Teesri aayat Hazrat Shuaib A.S ka farman aayat (وَمَآ اُرِيْدُ اَنْ اُخَالِفَكُمْ اِلٰي مَآ اَنْهٰىكُمْ عَنْهُ ۭ اِنْ اُرِيْدُ اِلَّا الْاِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ ۭ وَمَا تَوْفِيْقِيْٓ اِلَّا باللّٰهِ ۭ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَاِلَيْهِ اُنِيْبُ) (Surah Hud: 88) yani main jin kamon se tumhein mana karta hoon un mein tumhari mukhalifat karna nahin chahta, mera irada sirf apni taqat bhar islah karna hai. Kaho tum in teenon aayaton se be-khauf ho? Usne kaha nahin. Farmaya phir tum apne nafs se shuru karo. (Tafsir Marduyah). Ek zaeef hadith Tabrani mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo logon ko kisi qaul-o-fel ki taraf bulaye aur khud na kare to Allah Ta'ala ke ghazab-o-ghussa mein rehta hai yahan tak ke woh khud aap amal karne lag jaye. Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H) ne bhi Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) wali teenon aayatein pesh kar ke farmaya hai ke main in ki wajah se qissa-goi pasand nahin karta.

Sabr ka mafhoom: Is aayat mein hukum farmaya jata hai ke tum duniya aur aakhirat ke kaamon par namaz aur sabr ke sath madad talab kiya karo, faraiz baja lao aur namaz ko ada karte raho. Roza rakhna bhi sabr karna hai aur isi liye Ramzan ko sabr ka mahina kaha gaya hai. Huzoor ﷺ (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain roza aadha sabr hai. Sabr se murad gunahon se ruk jana bhi hai. Is aayat mein agar sabr se yeh murad li jaye to buraiyon se rukna aur nekiyan karna donon ka bayan ho gaya, nekiyon mein sab se aala cheez namaz hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) farmate hain sabr ki do qismein hain: museebat ke waqt sabr aur gunahon ke irtikab se sabr, aur yeh sabr pehle se zyada achha hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain insaan ka har cheez ka Allah ki taraf se hone ka iqrar karna, sawab ka talab karna, Allah ke paas museebaton ke ajar ka zakhira samajhna yeh sabr hai. Allah Ta'ala ki marzi ke kaam par sabr karo aur ise bhi Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at samjho. Neki ke kaamon par namaz se badi madad milti hai, khud Quran mein hai aayat: (As-Salata inna-s-salata tanha 'anil-fahsha'i wal-munkar, wa la-dhikru-llahi akbar) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 45). Namaz ko qaim rakh, yeh tamam buraiyon aur badiyon se rokne wali hai aur yaqeenan Allah ka zikr bahut badi cheez hai. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) farmate hain jab Rasool Allah ﷺ (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko koi kaam mushkil aur gham mein daal deta to aap namaz padha karte, foran namaz mein lag jate. Chunancha jang-e-Khandaq ke mauqe par raat ke waqt jab Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) khidmat-e-Nabwi mein hazir hote hain, to aap ﷺ (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko namaz mein pate hain. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke Badr ki ladai ki raat maine dekha ke hum sab so gaye the magar Allah ke Rasool (Allahumma Salli wa Sallim Alaihi) sari raat namaz mein mashghool rahe, subah tak namaz mein aur dua mein lage rahe. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Nabi ﷺ (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ko dekha ke bhook ke mare pet ke dard se betab ho rahe hain, aap ne un se (Farsi zaban mein) daryaft farmaya ke "Dard-e-shikam dari?" Kya tumhare pet mein dard hai? Unhon ne kaha haan, aap ne farmaya utho namaz shuru kar do is mein shifa hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ko safar mein apne bhai Hazrat Qusam ke inteqal ki khabar milti hai to aap aayat (Inna lillahi...) al-kh padh kar rasta se ek taraf hat kar oont bitha kar namaz shuru kar dete hain aur bahut lambi namaz ada karte hain, phir apni sawari ki taraf jate hain aur is aayat ko padhte hain. Gharz in donon cheezon sabr-o-salat se Allah ki rahmat mayassar aati hai. In ki zameer ka marja baaz logon ne to salat yani namaz ko kaha hai. Baaz kehte hain ke madlool-e-kalam yani wasiyat is ka marja hai, jaise Qaroon ke qissa mein "wa la yulqaha" ki zameer aur burai ke badle bhalai karne ke hukum mein "wa ma yulqaha" ki zameer.

Matlab yeh hai ke sabr-o-salat har shakhs ke bas ki cheez nahin, yeh hissa Allah ka khauf rakhne wali jamaat ka hai, yani Quran ke manne wale sache momin, kanpne wale, mutawaze, itaat ki taraf jhukne wale, wade-o-waeed ko sacha manne wale hain, is wasf se mausuf hote hain. Jaise hadith mein ek sail ke sawal par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tha: Yeh bari cheez hai lekin jis par Allah Ta'ala ki meherbani ho us par aasan hai. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne is ayat ke mani karte hue ise bhi Yahudiyon se hi khitab qarar diya hai lekin zahir baat yeh hai ke go yeh bayan unhi ke bare mein hai lekin hukm ke aitbar se aam hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Aage chal kar khashi'een ki sifat hai, is mein zann mani mein yaqeen ke hai, go zann shak ke mani mein bhi aata hai, jaise ke sadfah andhere ke mani mein bhi aata hai aur roshni ke mani mein bhi, aur sarih ka lafz bhi faryad-ras aur faryad-kun dono ke liye bola jata hai aur isi tarah ke bahut se naam hain jo aisi do mukhtalif cheezon par bole jate hain. Zann yaqeen ke mani mein Arab shu'ara ke sher-on mein bhi aaya hai. Khud Quran-e-Karim mein ayat (Wa ra-al mujrimuna-n-nara fazannu annahum muwaqi'uha) (Surah Al-Kahf: 53) yani gunahgar jahannam ko dekh kar yaqeen kar lenge ke ab hum is mein jhonk diye jayenge, yahan bhi zann yaqeen ke mani mein hai. Balkeh Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain Quran mein aisi jagah zann ka lafz yaqeen aur ilm ke mani mein hai. Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) bhi yahan zann ke mani yaqeen karte hain. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Suddi (R.H), Rabi bin Anas (R.H) aur Qatadah (R.H) ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Ibn-e-Jurayj (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain.

Quran mein dusri jagah hai ayat (Inni zanantu anni mulaqin hisabiyah) (Surah Al-Haqqah: 20) yani mujhe yaqeen tha ke mujhe hisab se do-char hona hai. Ek sahih hadith mein hai ke Qayamat ke din ek gunahgar bande se Allah Ta'ala farmayega: Kya main ne tujhe biwi bache nahin diye the? Kya tujh par tarah-tarah ke ikram nahin kiye the? Kya tere liye ghore aur oont musakhar nahin kiye the? Kya tujhe rahat-o-aram khana peena main ne nahin diya tha? Yeh kahega: Haan Parwardigar! Yeh sab kuch diya tha. Phir kya tera ilm-o-yaqeen is baat par na tha ke tu mujh se milne wala hai? Woh kahega: Haan. Allah Ta'ala use nahin manta tha. Allah Ta'ala farmayega: Bas tu jis tarah mujhe bhool gaya tha aaj main bhi tujhe bhula dunga. Is hadith mein bhi lafz zann ka hai aur mani mein yaqeen ke hain. Is ki mazeed tehqeeq-o-tafseel Insha'Allah Ta'ala ayat (Nasu-llaha fa-ansahum anfusahum) (Surah Al-Hashr: 19) ki tafseer mein aage aayegi.

Sabr ka mafhoom: Is aayat mein hukum farmaya jata hai ke tum duniya aur aakhirat ke kaamon par namaz aur sabr ke sath madad talab kiya karo, faraiz baja lao aur namaz ko ada karte raho. Roza rakhna bhi sabr karna hai aur isi liye Ramzan ko sabr ka mahina kaha gaya hai. Huzoor ﷺ (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain roza aadha sabr hai. Sabr se murad gunahon se ruk jana bhi hai. Is aayat mein agar sabr se yeh murad li jaye to buraiyon se rukna aur nekiyan karna donon ka bayan ho gaya, nekiyon mein sab se aala cheez namaz hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) farmate hain sabr ki do qismein hain: museebat ke waqt sabr aur gunahon ke irtikab se sabr, aur yeh sabr pehle se zyada achha hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain insaan ka har cheez ka Allah ki taraf se hone ka iqrar karna, sawab ka talab karna, Allah ke paas museebaton ke ajar ka zakhira samajhna yeh sabr hai. Allah Ta'ala ki marzi ke kaam par sabr karo aur ise bhi Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at samjho. Neki ke kaamon par namaz se badi madad milti hai, khud Quran mein hai aayat: (As-Salata inna-s-salata tanha 'anil-fahsha'i wal-munkar, wa la-dhikru-llahi akbar) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 45). Namaz ko qaim rakh, yeh tamam buraiyon aur badiyon se rokne wali hai aur yaqeenan Allah ka zikr bahut badi cheez hai. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) farmate hain jab Rasool Allah ﷺ (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko koi kaam mushkil aur gham mein daal deta to aap namaz padha karte, foran namaz mein lag jate. Chunancha jang-e-Khandaq ke mauqe par raat ke waqt jab Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) khidmat-e-Nabwi mein hazir hote hain, to aap ﷺ (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko namaz mein pate hain. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke Badr ki ladai ki raat maine dekha ke hum sab so gaye the magar Allah ke Rasool (Allahumma Salli wa Sallim Alaihi) sari raat namaz mein mashghool rahe, subah tak namaz mein aur dua mein lage rahe. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Nabi ﷺ (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ko dekha ke bhook ke mare pet ke dard se betab ho rahe hain, aap ne un se (Farsi zaban mein) daryaft farmaya ke "Dard-e-shikam dari?" Kya tumhare pet mein dard hai? Unhon ne kaha haan, aap ne farmaya utho namaz shuru kar do is mein shifa hai. Gharz in donon cheezon sabr-o-salat se Allah ki rahmat mayassar aati hai. In ki zameer ka marja baaz logon ne to salat yani namaz ko kaha hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Bani Israel ke aaba-o-ajdad par Allah Ta'ala ke inamaat. Bani Israel ke aaba-o-ajdad par jo Naimat-e-Ilahiya inaam ki gayi thi us ka zikr ho raha hai ke un mein se Rasool hue, un par kitabein utrin, unhein un ke zamane ke dusre logon par martaba diya gaya. Jaise farmaya aayat (Walaqad-ikhtarnahum 'ala 'ilmin 'alal-'alamin) (44. Ad-Dukhan: 32) yani unhein un ke zamane ke (aur logon par) hum ne ilm mein fazeelat di. Aur farmaya aayat (Wa iz qala Musa li-qaumihi ya qaumiz-kuru ni'matallahi 'alaikum iz ja'ala feekum ambiya-a wa ja'alakum mulukan wa atakum ma lam yu'ti ahadan minal-'alamin) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 20) yani Musa (A.S) ne farmaya ae meri qaum tum Allah Ta'ala ki us naimat ko yaad karo jo tum par inaam ki gayi hai, tum mein us ne paighambar paida kiye, tumhein badshah banaya aur woh diya jo tamam zamane ko nahin diya. Tamam logon par fazeelat milne se murad un ke zamane ke tamam aur log hain, is liye ke Ummat-e-Muhammadiya un se yaqeenan afzal hai. Is ummat ki nisbat farmaya gaya hai aayat (Kuntum khaira ummatin ukhrijat linnasi ta'muruna bil-ma'rufi wa tanhawna 'anil-munkari wa tu'minuna billah) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 110) tum behtar ummat ho jo logon ke liye banayi gayi ho, tum bhalaiyon ka hukum karne wale aur buraiyon se rokne wale ho aur Allah Ta'ala par imaan rakhte ho, agar Ahl-e-Kitab bhi imaan late to un ke liye behtar hota. Masaneed aur Sunan mein marwi hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum sattarwin ummat ho aur sab se behtar aur buzurg ho. Is qisam ki aur bahut si ahadees ka zikr Insha'Allah aayat (Kuntum khaira ummatin ukhrijat linnasi ta'muruna bil-ma'rufi wa tanhawna 'anil-munkari wa tu'minuna billah) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 110) ki tafseer mein aayega. Aur kaha gaya hai ke tamam logon par khaas qisam ki fazeelat murad hai jis se har qisam ki fazeelat lazim nahin aati. Razi ne yahi kaha hai magar yeh ghaur talab baat hai. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke un ki fazeelat aur tamam ummaton par hai is liye ke Anbiya-e-Kiram inhi mein se hote chale aaye hain, lekin is mein bhi ghaur-o-khauz ki zaroorat hai is liye ke is tarah ke itlaq ke ijtima'i a'zaz ko agle logon par bhi hota hai. Aur haqeeqat mein agle Anbiya in mein shumar na the jaise Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) aur Aan-Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo un sab ke baad hue lekin tamam makhlooq se afzal the aur jo tamam aulad-e-Adam ke sardar hain duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi, dua (Salawatullahi wa salamuhu 'alaihi).

Hashr ka manzar. Naimaton ko bayan karne ke baad azab se daraya jata hai aur kaha jata hai ke koi kisi ko kuch faida na dega jaise farmaya ayat (Wala taziru waziratun wizra ukhra) (35. Fatir: 18) yani kisi ka bojh kisi par na parega aur farmaya ayat (Likullimri'im minhum yauma'izin sha'un yughnihi) (80. Abasa: 37) yani us din har shakhs nafsa nafsi mein para hua hoga aur farmaya, ae logo apne Rab ka khauf khao aur us din se daro jis din baap bete ko aur beta baap ko kuch bhi faida nahin pahuncha sake ga. Irshad hai ayat (Wala yuqbalu minha shafa'atun wala yu'khazu minha 'adlun wala hum yunsarun) (2. Al-Baqarah: 48) yani kisi kafir ki na koi sifarish kare na us ki sifarish qabool ho aur farmaya in kuffar ko shafa'at karne walon ki shafa'at faida na degi dusri jagah ahl-e-jahannam ka yeh maqoola naqal kiya gaya hai ke afsos aaj hamara na koi sifarishi hai na dost. Yeh bhi irshad hai fidiya bhi na liya jaye ga aur jo log kufr par mar jate hain woh agar zameen bhar kar sona dein aur hamare azabon se chhootna chahein toh yeh bhi nahin ho sakta aur jagah hai kafiron ke paas agar tamam zameen ki cheezein aur us ke misl aur bhi hon aur Qayamat ke din woh use fidiya de kar azabon se bachna chahein toh bhi kuch qabool na hoga aur dardnak azabon mein mubtala rahenge aur jagah hai, go woh zabardast fidiya dein phir bhi qabool nahin dusri jagah hai aaj tum se na badla liya jaye na hi kafiron se tumhara thikana jahannam hai isi ki aag tumhari waris hai. Matlab yeh hai ke iman ke baghair sifarish aur shafa'at ka aasra bekar mahaz hai Quran mein irshad hai us din se pehle nekiyan kar lo jis din na kharido farokht hogi na dosti aur shafa'at mazeed farmaya ayat (Yaumul la bai'un fihi wala khilal) (14. Ibrahim: 31) us din na bai' hogi na dosti. Adl ke ma'ni yahan badle ke hain aur badla aur fidiya ek hai Hazrat Ali (R.A) wali hadith mein sarf ke ma'ni nafl aur adl ke ma'ni fariza marwi hain lekin yeh qaul yahan ghareeb hai aur sahih qaul pehla hi hai ek riwayat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se pucha gaya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) adl ke kya ma'ni hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya fidiya. In ki madad bhi na ki jaye gi yani koi himayati nahin hoga, qarabatain kat jayengi jah-o-hasham jata rahe ga kisi ke dil mein in ke liye raham na rahe ga na khud in mein koi qudrat-o-quwwat rahe gi aur jagah hai ayat (Wa huwa yujeeru wala yujaru 'alaihi) (23. Al-Mu'minun: 88) woh panah deta hai aur us ki pakar se nijat dene wala koi nahin, ek jagah hai aaj ke din na Allah ka sa koi azab de sake na us ki si qaid-o-band. Irshad hai ayat (Ma lakum la tanasarun. Bal humul yauma mustaslimun) tum aaj kyun ek dusre ki madad nahin karte? Balkeh woh sab ke sab aaj gardanein jhukaye tabe-e-farman bane khare hain aur ayat mein hai ayat (Falau la nasarahumul lazina-ttakhazu min dunillahi qurbanan aalihah) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 28).

(Surah Al-Ahqaf: 48) Allah ke nazdiki ke liye woh Allah ke siwa jin ki puja paat karte thay aaj woh mabood apne aabidon ki madad kyun nahin karte? Balkeh woh toh ghaib ho gaye matlab yeh hai ke muhabbatein fana ho gayin, rishtey kat gaye, shafa'atein mit gayin, aapas ki imdad-o-nusrat nabood ho gayi. Mamla us aadil hakim jabbar-o-qahhar Allah Ta'ala malik-ul-mulk se para hai jis ke yahan sifarishiyon aur madadgaron ki madad kuch kaam na aaye balkeh apni tamam buraiyon ka badla bhugatna parega, han yeh us ki kamal banda parwari aur rahm-o-karam in'am-o-ikram hai ke gunah ka badla barabar de aur neki ka badla kam az kam das guna barha kar de. Quran-e-Karim mein ek jagah hai ke waqfa lene do taake un se ek sawal kar liya jaye ga ke aaj yeh ek dusre ki madad chor kar nafsa nafsi mein kyun mashghool hain? Balkeh hamare samne sar jhukaye aur tabe-e-farman hain.

Ahsanat ki yaad-dihani. In aayaton mein farman-e-Bari hai ke ae aulad-e-Yaqub (A.S) meri is meharbani ko bhi yaad rakho ke main ne tumhein Firaun ke badtareen azabon se chhutkara diya. Firaun ne ek khwab dekha tha ke Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf se ek aag bharki jo Misr ke har har qibti ke ghar mein ghus gayi aur Bani Israel ke makanat mein woh nahin gayi, jis ki tabeer yeh thi ke Bani Israel mein ek shakhs paida hoga jis ke hathon is ka ghuroor tootega, us ke Allah ke dawe ki badtareen saza use milegi. Is liye is maloon ne charon taraf ahkam jari kar diye ke Bani Israel mein jo bacha bhi paida ho, sarkari taur se us ki dekh-bhal rakhi jaye, agar larka ho to foran maar dala jaye aur larki ho to chhor di jaye. Alawa azeen Bani Israel se sakht begar li jaye, har tarah ki mushaqqat ke kamon ka bojh un par daal diya jaye. Yahan par azab ki tafseer larkon ke maar dalne se ki gayi aur Surah Ibrahim mein ek ka dusri par atf dala jis ki poori tashreeh Insha'Allah Surah Qasas ke shuru mein bayan hogi. Allah Ta'ala hamein mazbooti de, hamari madad farmaye aur ta'eed kare, Ameen. Yasumunakum ke ma'ani musalsal aur karne ke aate hain, yani woh barabar dukh diye jate the. Chunke is aayat mein pehle yeh farmaya tha ke meri in'am ki hui ne'mat ko yaad karo, is liye Firaun ke azab ki tafseer ko larkon ke qatl karne ke taur par bayan farmaya taake ne'maton ki ta'dad zyada ho. Yani mutafarriq azabon se aur bachon ke qatl hone se tumhein Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke hathon nijat dilwayi. Misr ke jitne badshah Amaliq waghera kuffar mein se hue the un sab ko Firaun kaha jata tha, jaise ke Room ke kafir badshah ko Qaisar aur Fars ke kafir badshah ko Kisra aur Yaman ke kafir badshah ko Tubba aur Habsha ke kafir badshah ko Najashi aur Hind ke kafir badshah ko Batlimoos. Is Firaun ka naam Waleed bin Mus'ab bin Rayyan tha. Baaz ne Mus'ab bin Rayyan bhi kaha hai. Amliq bin Aud bin Iram bin Sam bin Nuh (A.S) ki aulad mein se tha, is ki kunniyat Abu Murrah thi. Asal mein Istakhar ke Farsiyon ki nasl mein tha, Allah ki phitkar aur la'nat is par nazil ho. Phir farmaya ke is nijat dene mein hamari taraf se ek bari bhari ne'mat thi. Bala ke asli ma'ani aazmaish ke hain lekin yahan par Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Abu Aliyah (R.H), Abu Malik (R.H), Suddi (R.H) waghera se ne'mat ke ma'ani manqool hain. Imtehan aur aazmaish bhalai burai dono ke sath hoti hai, lekin balauta bala ka lafz umooman burai ki aazmaish ke liye aur abliya abla wa bala ka lafz bhalai ke sath ki aazmaish ke liye aata hai. Yeh kaha gaya hai ke is mein tumhari aazmaish yani azab mein aur is bachon ke qatl hone mein thi. Qurtubi (R.H) is dusre matlab ko jamhoor ka qaul kehte hain, to is mein ishara zibh waghera ki taraf hoga aur bala ke ma'ani burai ke honge. Phir farmaya ke hum ne Firaun se bacha liya.

Tum Musa A.S ke sath shahar se nikle aur Firaun tumhein pakadne ko nikla toh hum ne tumhare liye pani ko phaad diya aur tumhein us mein se paar utaar kar tumhare samne Firaun ko us ke lashkar samet dubo diya. In sab baton ka tafseel-war bayan Surah Shu'ara mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Amr bin Maimun Audi farmate hain ke jab Hazrat Musa A.S Bani Israel ko le kar nikle aur Firaun ko khabar hui toh us ne kaha ke jab murgh bole tab sab niklo aur sab ko pakad kar qatl kar daalo lekin us raat Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se subah tak koi murgh na bola. Murgh ki aawaz sunte hi Firaun ne ek bakri zibah ki aur kaha ke is ki kaleji se main farigh hoon, is se pehle chhe lakh Qibtiyon ka lashkar-e-jarrar mere paas hazir ho jana chahiye, chunancha hazir ho gaya aur yeh mal'oon itni badi jam'iyat ko le kar Bani Israel ki halakat ke liye bade karr-o-farr se nikla aur darya ke kinare unhein pa liya. Ab Bani Israel par duniya tang aa gayi, pichhe hatein toh Firauniyon ki talwaron ki bhent chadhein, aage badhein toh machhliyon ka luqma banein. Is waqt Hazrat Yusha bin Noon ne kaha ke ae Allah ke Nabi ab kya kiya jaye? Aap ne farmaya hukm-e-Ilahi hamara rahnuma hai, yeh sunte hi unhon ne apna ghoda pani mein daal diya lekin gehre pani mein jab ghote khane laga toh phir kinare ki taraf laut aaye aur pucha ae Musa! Rabb ki madad kahan hai? Hum na aap ko jhoota jante hain na Rabb ko, teen martaba aisa hi kaha. Ab Hazrat Musa A.S ki taraf wahi aayi ke apna asa darya par maaro, asa marte hi pani ne rasta de diya aur pahadon ki tarah khada ho gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S aur aap ke manne wale in raston se guzar gaye, unhein is tarah paar utarte dekh kar Firaun aur Firauni afwaj ne bhi apne ghode isi raste par daal diye. Jab tamam ke tamam mein dakhil ho gaye, pani ko mil jane ka hukm hua, pani ke milte hi tamam ke tamam doob mare. Bani Israel ne qudrat-e-Ilahi ka yeh nazara apni aankhon se kinare par khade ho kar dekha jis se woh bahut hi khush hue, apni azadi aur Firaun ki barbadi un ke liye khushi ka sabab bani. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh din Ashura ka tha yani Muharram ki daswin tareekh. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ Madina Sharif mein tashreef laye toh dekha ke Yahudi Ashura ka roza rakhte hain, pucha ke tum is din ka roza kyun rakhte ho? Unhon ne kaha is liye ke is mubarak din mein Bani Israel ne Firaun ke zulm se nijat payi aur un ka dushman gharq hua jis ke shukriya mein Hazrat Musa A.S ne yeh roza rakha. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya tum se zyada haqdar Musa A.S ka main hoon, pas Huzoor ﷺ ne khud bhi is din roza rakha aur logon ko bhi roza rakhne ka hukm diya. Bukhari, Muslim, Nasai, Ibn Majah waghera mein bhi yeh hadith majood hai. Ek aur za'eef hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya is din Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ke liye samundar ko phaad diya tha, is hadith ke rawi Zaid al-Ammi za'eef hain aur un ke ustad Yazeed Raqashi un se bhi zyada za'eef hain.

Ahsanat ki yaad-dihani. In aayaton mein farman-e-Bari hai ke ae aulad-e-Yaqub (A.S) meri is meharbani ko bhi yaad rakho ke main ne tumhein Firaun ke badtareen azabon se chhutkara diya. Firaun ne ek khwab dekha tha ke Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf se ek aag bharki jo Misr ke har har qibti ke ghar mein ghus gayi aur Bani Israel ke makanat mein woh nahin gayi, jis ki tabeer yeh thi ke Bani Israel mein ek shakhs paida hoga jis ke hathon is ka ghuroor tootega, us ke Allah ke dawe ki badtareen saza use milegi. Is liye is maloon ne charon taraf ahkam jari kar diye ke Bani Israel mein jo bacha bhi paida ho, sarkari taur se us ki dekh-bhal rakhi jaye, agar larka ho to foran maar dala jaye aur larki ho to chhor di jaye. Alawa azeen Bani Israel se sakht begar li jaye, har tarah ki mushaqqat ke kamon ka bojh un par daal diya jaye. Yahan par azab ki tafseer larkon ke maar dalne se ki gayi aur Surah Ibrahim mein ek ka dusri par atf dala jis ki poori tashreeh Insha'Allah Surah Qasas ke shuru mein bayan hogi. Allah Ta'ala hamein mazbooti de, hamari madad farmaye aur ta'eed kare, Ameen. Yasumunakum ke ma'ani musalsal aur karne ke aate hain, yani woh barabar dukh diye jate the. Chunke is aayat mein pehle yeh farmaya tha ke meri in'am ki hui ne'mat ko yaad karo, is liye Firaun ke azab ki tafseer ko larkon ke qatl karne ke taur par bayan farmaya taake ne'maton ki ta'dad zyada ho. Yani mutafarriq azabon se aur bachon ke qatl hone se tumhein Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke hathon nijat dilwayi. Misr ke jitne badshah Amaliq waghera kuffar mein se hue the un sab ko Firaun kaha jata tha, jaise ke Room ke kafir badshah ko Qaisar aur Fars ke kafir badshah ko Kisra aur Yaman ke kafir badshah ko Tubba aur Habsha ke kafir badshah ko Najashi aur Hind ke kafir badshah ko Batlimoos. Is Firaun ka naam Waleed bin Mus'ab bin Rayyan tha. Baaz ne Mus'ab bin Rayyan bhi kaha hai. Amliq bin Aud bin Iram bin Sam bin Nuh (A.S) ki aulad mein se tha, is ki kunniyat Abu Murrah thi. Asal mein Istakhar ke Farsiyon ki nasl mein tha, Allah ki phitkar aur la'nat is par nazil ho. Phir farmaya ke is nijat dene mein hamari taraf se ek bari bhari ne'mat thi. Bala ke asli ma'ani aazmaish ke hain lekin yahan par Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Abu Aliyah (R.H), Abu Malik (R.H), Suddi (R.H) waghera se ne'mat ke ma'ani manqool hain. Imtehan aur aazmaish bhalai burai dono ke sath hoti hai, lekin balauta bala ka lafz umooman burai ki aazmaish ke liye aur abliya abla wa bala ka lafz bhalai ke sath ki aazmaish ke liye aata hai. Yeh kaha gaya hai ke is mein tumhari aazmaish yani azab mein aur is bachon ke qatl hone mein thi. Qurtubi (R.H) is dusre matlab ko jamhoor ka qaul kehte hain, to is mein ishara zibh waghera ki taraf hoga aur bala ke ma'ani burai ke honge. Phir farmaya ke hum ne Firaun se bacha liya.

Tum Musa A.S ke sath shahar se nikle aur Firaun tumhein pakadne ko nikla toh hum ne tumhare liye pani ko phaad diya aur tumhein us mein se paar utaar kar tumhare samne Firaun ko us ke lashkar samet dubo diya. In sab baton ka tafseel-war bayan Surah Shu'ara mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Amr bin Maimun Audi farmate hain ke jab Hazrat Musa A.S Bani Israel ko le kar nikle aur Firaun ko khabar hui toh us ne kaha ke jab murgh bole tab sab niklo aur sab ko pakad kar qatl kar daalo lekin us raat Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se subah tak koi murgh na bola. Murgh ki aawaz sunte hi Firaun ne ek bakri zibah ki aur kaha ke is ki kaleji se main farigh hoon, is se pehle chhe lakh Qibtiyon ka lashkar-e-jarrar mere paas hazir ho jana chahiye, chunancha hazir ho gaya aur yeh mal'oon itni badi jam'iyat ko le kar Bani Israel ki halakat ke liye bade karr-o-farr se nikla aur darya ke kinare unhein pa liya. Ab Bani Israel par duniya tang aa gayi, pichhe hatein toh Firauniyon ki talwaron ki bhent chadhein, aage badhein toh machhliyon ka luqma banein. Is waqt Hazrat Yusha bin Noon ne kaha ke ae Allah ke Nabi ab kya kiya jaye? Aap ne farmaya hukm-e-Ilahi hamara rahnuma hai, yeh sunte hi unhon ne apna ghoda pani mein daal diya lekin gehre pani mein jab ghote khane laga toh phir kinare ki taraf laut aaye aur pucha ae Musa! Rabb ki madad kahan hai? Hum na aap ko jhoota jante hain na Rabb ko, teen martaba aisa hi kaha. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ Madina Sharif mein tashreef laye toh dekha ke Yahudi Ashura ka roza rakhte hain, pucha ke tum is din ka roza kyun rakhte ho? Unhon ne kaha is liye ke is mubarak din mein Bani Israel ne Firaun ke zulm se nijat payi aur un ka dushman gharq hua jis ke shukriya mein Hazrat Musa A.S ne yeh roza rakha. Bukhari, Muslim, Nasai, Ibn Majah waghera mein bhi yeh hadith majood hai. Ek aur za'eef hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya is din Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ke liye samundar ko phaad diya tha, is hadith ke rawi Zaid al-Ammi za'eef hain aur un ke ustad Yazeed Raqashi un se bhi zyada za'eef hain.

Chalees din ka wada: Yahan bhi Allah Bartar-o-Aala apne ehsanat yaad dila raha hai jabke tumhare Nabi Hazrat Musa (A.S) chalees din ke wade par tumhare paas se gaye aur uske baad tumne gosala parasti shuru kardi, phir unke aane par jab tumne is shirk se tauba ki toh humne tumhare itne bade kufr ko baksh diya aur Quran mein hai aayat (Wa wa'adna Musa thalatheena lailatan wa atmamnaha bi'ashrin) (Surah Al-A'raf: 142) yani humne Hazrat Musa (A.S) se tees raaton ka wada kiya aur das badha kar poori chalees raaton ka kiya. Kaha jata hai ke yeh wade ka zamana Zul-Qa'dah ka poora mahina aur das din Zul-Hijjah ke thay. Yeh waqea Firauniyon se nijat pa kar darya se bach kar nikal jaane ke baad pesh aaya tha. Kitab se murad Taurat hai aur Furqan har us cheez ko kehte hain jo haq-o-batil, hidayat-o-zalalat mein farq kare. Yeh kitab bhi is waqea ke baad mili jaise ke Surah Al-A'raf iske is waqea ke tarz-e-bayan se zahir hota hai. Dusri jagah aayat (Min ba'di ma ahlaknal quroonal ula) (Surah Al-Qasas: 43) bhi aaya hai yani humne agle logon ko halak karne ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko woh kitab di jo sab logon ke liye baseerat afza aur hidayat-o-rahmat hai taake woh naseehat hasil karein. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke 'Wao' zaid hai aur khud kitab ko Furqan kaha gaya hai lekin yeh ghareeb hai. Baaz ne kaha hai kitab par "Furqan" ka atf hai yani kitab bhi di aur mojiza bhi diya. Dar-asal ma'ani ke aitbar se dono ka mufad ek hi hai aur aisi ek cheez do naamon se bator-e-atf ke kalam-e-Arab mein aaya karti hai, shu'ara-e-Arab ke bahut se ashaar iske shahid hain.

Sakht tareen saza. Yahan un ki tauba ka tareeqa bayan ho raha hai. Unhon ne bachhray ko pooja aur us ki mohabbat ne un ke dilon mein ghar kar liya, phir Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke samjhanay se hosh aaya aur nadim huay aur apni gumrahi ka yaqeen kar ke tauba istighfar karne lagay, tab unhein hukum hua ke tum aapas mein qatl karo. Chunancha unhon ne yahi kiya aur Allah Ta'ala ne un ki tauba qabool ki aur qatil-o-maqtool dono ko bakhash diya. Is ka poora bayan Surah Taha ki tafsir mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ka yeh farman ke apne Khaliq se tauba karo bata raha hai ke is se barh kar zulm kya hoga ke tumhein paida Allah Ta'ala kare aur tum poojo ghairon ko. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Musa (A.S) ne unhein hukum-e-Ilahi sunaya aur jin jin logon ne bachhra pooja tha unhein bitha diya aur dusray log kharay reh gaye aur qatl karna shuru kiya, qudrati taur par andhera chhaya hua tha, jab andhera hata to unhein rok diya gaya. Shumar karne par maloom hua ke sattar hazar aadmi qatl ho chukay hain aur saari qoum ki tauba qabool hui. Yeh ek sakht farman tha jis ki un logon ne tameel ki aur apnon aur ghairon ko yaksan teh-e-tegh kiya yahan tak ke Rahmat-e-Ilahi ne unhein bakhsha aur Musa (A.S) se farma diya ke ab bas karo. Maqtool ko shaheed ka ajar diya, qatil ki aur baqi manda tamam logon ki tauba qabool farmayi aur unhein jihad ka sawab diya. Musa (A.S) aur Hazrat Haroon (A.S) ne jab isi tarah apni qoum ka qatl dekha to dua karni shuru ki ke Allah ab to Bani Israel mit jayenge, chunancha unhein maaf farma diya gaya aur Parwardigar-e-Alam ne farmaya ke ae mere paighambar maqtoolon ka gham na karo, woh hamaray paas shaheedon ke darja mein hain, woh yahan zinda hain aur ghiza pa rahe hain. Ab aap ko aur aap ki qoum ko sabr aaya aur aurton aur bachon ki girya-o-zari mauqoof hui. Talwarein, neze, chhuray aur jhariyan chalni band huin, aapas mein baap beton, bhaiyon-bhaiyon mein qatl-o-khoon mauqoof hua aur Allah Tawwab-ur-Raheem ne un ki tauba qabool farmayi.

Hum bhi Allah Azza-wa-Jal ko khud dekhenge. Musa A.S jab apne sath Bani Israel ke sattar (70) shakhson ko le kar Allah Ta'ala ke wade ke mutabiq Koh-e-Toor par gaye aur un logon ne Kalam-e-Ilahi suna toh Hazrat Musa A.S se kehne lage hum toh tab maanein jab Allah Ta'ala ko apne samne khud dekh lein. Is gustakhana sawal par un par aasman se un ke dekhte hue bijli giri aur ek sakht holnak aawaz hui jis se sab ke sab mar gaye. Musa A.S yeh dekh kar girya-o-zari karne lage aur ro ro kar Janab-e-Bari mein arz karne lage ke Allah Bani Israel ko main kya jawab doon ga? Yeh jamaat toh un ke sardaron aur behtareen logon ki thi. Parwardigar agar yahi chahat thi toh inhe aur mujhe is se pehle hi maar dalta. Allah Ta'ala bewaqoofon ki bewaqoofi ke kaam par hamein na pakar. Yeh dua maqbool hui aur aap ko maloom karaya gaya ke yeh bhi darasal bachra poojne walon mein se thay inhe saza mil gayi. Phir inhe zinda kar diya aur ek ke baad ek kar ke sab zinda kiye gaye. Ek dusre ke zinda hone ko ek dusra dekhta raha. Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H farmate hain ke jab Musa A.S apni qoum ke paas aaye aur unhein bachra poojte hue dekha aur apne bhai ko aur Samri ko tanbeeh ki. Bachre ko jala diya aur us ki raakh darya mein baha di. Is ke baad un mein se behtareen logon ko chun kar apne sath liya jin ki tadaad sattar (70) thi aur Koh-e-Toor pe tauba karne ke liye chale. Un se kaha ke tum tauba karo warna roza rakho, paak saaf ho jao, kapron ko paak kar lo. Jab ba-hukm-e-Ilahi Toor-e-Sina par pohanche toh un logon ne kaha ke ae Allah ke paighambar! Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke woh apna kalam hamein bhi sunaye. Jab Musa A.S pahar ke paas pohanche toh ek badal ne aa kar saare pahar ko dhak liya aur aap usi ke andar andar Allah Ta'ala ke qareeb ho gaye. Jab Kalam-e-Rabb-e-Zuljalal shuru hua tab Musa A.S ki peshani noor se chamakne lagi is tarah ke koi us taraf nazar uthane ki taab nahin rakhta tha. Badal ki oat ho gayi aur sab log sajde mein gir pare aur Hazrat Musa A.S ki dua se aap ke saathi Bani Israel bhi Allah Ta'ala ka kalam sunne lage ke unhein hukm-o-ahkaam ho rahe hain. Jab Kalam-e-Ilah-ul-Aalameen khatam hua, badal chhat gaya aur Musa A.S un ke paas chale aaye toh yeh log kehne lage Musa! Hum toh imaan na layenge jab tak apne Rabb ko apne samne na dekh lein. Is gustakhi par ek zalzala aaya aur sab ke sab halak ho gaye. Ab Musa A.S ne khuloos-e-dil ke sath duayein shuru keen aur kehne lage is se toh yahi achha tha ke hum sab is se pehle hi halak ho jate. Bewaqoofon ke kamon par hamein halak na kar. Yeh log un ke chida aur pasandida log thay. Jab main tanha Bani Israel ke paas jaunga toh unhein kya jawab doonga? Kaun meri baat ko sacha samjhe ga aur phir is ke baad kaun mujh par imaan layega? Allah hamari tauba hai, tu qabool farma.

Aur hum par fazl-o-karam kar, Hazrat Musa (A.S) yunhi khushu-o-khuzu se dua maangte rahe yahan tak ke Parwardigar ne un ki is dua ko qabool farmaya aur un murdon ko zinda kardiya, ab sab ne ek zaban ho kar Bani Israel ki taraf se tauba shuru ki un se farmaya gaya ke jab tak yeh apni janon ko halak na karein aur ek dusre ko qatl na karein main in ki tauba qabool nahin farmaunga. Suddi Kabeer kehte hain yeh waqea Bani Israel ke aapas mein ladane ke baad ka hai. Is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke yeh khitab go aam hai lekin haqeeqat mein is se murad wahi sattar shakhs hain. Razi ne apni tafsir mein in sattar shakhson ke bare mein likha hai ke unhon ne apne jeene ke baad kaha ke ae Nabi-e-Allah (ﷺ), Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke woh hamein Nabi bana de. Aap ne dua ki aur woh qabool bhi hui lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai, Musa (A.S) ke zamane mein siwaye Haroon (A.S) ke aur us ke baad Hazrat Yusha bin Noon (A.S) ke kisi aur ki nabuwwat sabit nahin. Ahl-e-Kitab ka yeh bhi dawa hai ke in logon ne apni dua ke mutabiq Allah Ta'ala ko apni aankhon se isi jagah dekha yeh bhi ghalat hai is liye ke khud Musa (A.S) ne jab deedar-e-Bari Ta'ala ka sawal kiya to unhein mana kardiya gaya phir bhala yeh sattar ashkhas deedar-e-Bari ki taab kaise late? Is aayat ki tafsir mein ek dusra qaul bhi hai ke Musa (A.S) Taurat le kar aaye jo ahkaam ka majmooa thi aur un se kaha ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ki kitab hai is par amal karo aur mazbooti ke sath is ke paband ho jao to woh kehne lage ke Hazrat hamein kya khabar Allah Ta'ala khud aa kar zahir ho kar hum se kyun nahin kehta? Kya wajah hai ke woh aap se baatein kare aur hum se na kare? Jab tak hum Allah ko khud na dekh lein hargiz iman na layenge is qaul par un ke upar ghazab-e-Ilahi nazil hua aur halak kar diye gaye phir zinda kiye gaye phir Musa (A.S) ne unhein kaha ke ab to is Taurat ko tham lo unhon ne phir inkar kiya ab ki martaba farishte pahad utha kar laye aur un ke saron ke upar muallaq kardiya ke agar na manoge to yeh pahad tum par gira diya jayega aur tum sab pees dale jaoge is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke marne ke baad yeh jee uthe aur phir bhi mukallaf rahe yani ahkaam-e-Ilahi un par phir bhi jaari rahe. Mawardi ne kaha hai ke baaz log kehte hain ke jab unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ki yeh zabardast nishani dekh li marne ke baad zinda hue to phir takleef-e-shar'i un par se hat gayi is liye ke ab to yeh majboor the ke sab kuch maan lein. Khud un par yeh wardat pesh aayi ab tasdeeq ek be-ikhtiyari amr hogaya. Dusri jamaat kehti hai ke nahin balkay bawajood is ke woh ahkaam-e-shar'a ke mukallaf rahe kyunke har aaqil mukallaf hai.

Qurtubi kehte hain theek qaul yahi hai, yeh umoor un par qudrati taur se aaye thay jo unhein pabandi-e-shar'a se azaad nahin kar sakte. Khud Bani Israel ne bhi bade bade mojizaat dekhe, khud un ke sath aise aise mamlaat hue jo bilkul nadir aur khilaf-e-qayas aur zabardast mojizaat thay, bawajood is ke woh bhi mukallaf rahe. Isi tarah yeh bhi theek qaul hai aur wazeh amr bhi yahi hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Hum bhi Allah Azza-wa-Jal ko khud dekhenge. Musa A.S jab apne sath Bani Israel ke sattar (70) shakhson ko le kar Allah Ta'ala ke wade ke mutabiq Koh-e-Toor par gaye aur un logon ne Kalam-e-Ilahi suna toh Hazrat Musa A.S se kehne lage hum toh tab maanein jab Allah Ta'ala ko apne samne khud dekh lein. Is gustakhana sawal par un par aasman se un ke dekhte hue bijli giri aur ek sakht holnak aawaz hui jis se sab ke sab mar gaye. Musa A.S yeh dekh kar girya-o-zari karne lage aur ro ro kar Janab-e-Bari mein arz karne lage ke Allah Bani Israel ko main kya jawab doon ga? Yeh jamaat toh un ke sardaron aur behtareen logon ki thi. Parwardigar agar yahi chahat thi toh inhe aur mujhe is se pehle hi maar dalta. Allah Ta'ala bewaqoofon ki bewaqoofi ke kaam par hamein na pakar. Yeh dua maqbool hui aur aap ko maloom karaya gaya ke yeh bhi darasal bachra poojne walon mein se thay inhe saza mil gayi. Phir inhe zinda kar diya aur ek ke baad ek kar ke sab zinda kiye gaye. Ek dusre ke zinda hone ko ek dusra dekhta raha. Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H farmate hain ke jab Musa A.S apni qoum ke paas aaye aur unhein bachra poojte hue dekha aur apne bhai ko aur Samri ko tanbeeh ki. Bachre ko jala diya aur us ki raakh darya mein baha di. Is ke baad un mein se behtareen logon ko chun kar apne sath liya jin ki tadaad sattar (70) thi aur Koh-e-Toor pe tauba karne ke liye chale. Un se kaha ke tum tauba karo warna roza rakho, paak saaf ho jao, kapron ko paak kar lo. Jab ba-hukm-e-Ilahi Toor-e-Sina par pohanche toh un logon ne kaha ke ae Allah ke paighambar! Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke woh apna kalam hamein bhi sunaye. Jab Musa A.S pahar ke paas pohanche toh ek badal ne aa kar saare pahar ko dhak liya aur aap usi ke andar andar Allah Ta'ala ke qareeb ho gaye. Jab Kalam-e-Rabb-e-Zuljalal shuru hua tab Musa A.S ki peshani noor se chamakne lagi is tarah ke koi us taraf nazar uthane ki taab nahin rakhta tha. Badal ki oat ho gayi aur sab log sajde mein gir pare aur Hazrat Musa A.S ki dua se aap ke saathi Bani Israel bhi Allah Ta'ala ka kalam sunne lage ke unhein hukm-o-ahkaam ho rahe hain. Jab Kalam-e-Ilah-ul-Aalameen khatam hua, badal chhat gaya aur Musa A.S un ke paas chale aaye toh yeh log kehne lage Musa! Hum toh imaan na layenge jab tak apne Rabb ko apne samne na dekh lein. Is gustakhi par ek zalzala aaya aur sab ke sab halak ho gaye. Ab Musa A.S ne khuloos-e-dil ke sath duayein shuru keen aur kehne lage is se toh yahi achha tha ke hum sab is se pehle hi halak ho jate. Bewaqoofon ke kamon par hamein halak na kar. Yeh log un ke chida aur pasandida log thay. Jab main tanha Bani Israel ke paas jaunga toh unhein kya jawab doonga? Kaun meri baat ko sacha samjhe ga aur phir is ke baad kaun mujh par imaan layega? Allah hamari tauba hai, tu qabool farma.

Aur hum par fazl-o-karam kar, Hazrat Musa (A.S) yunhi khushu-o-khuzu se dua maangte rahe yahan tak ke Parwardigar ne un ki is dua ko qabool farmaya aur un murdon ko zinda kardiya, ab sab ne ek zaban ho kar Bani Israel ki taraf se tauba shuru ki un se farmaya gaya ke jab tak yeh apni janon ko halak na karein aur ek dusre ko qatl na karein main in ki tauba qabool nahin farmaunga. Suddi Kabeer kehte hain yeh waqea Bani Israel ke aapas mein ladane ke baad ka hai. Is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke yeh khitab go aam hai lekin haqeeqat mein is se murad wahi sattar shakhs hain. Razi ne apni tafsir mein in sattar shakhson ke bare mein likha hai ke unhon ne apne jeene ke baad kaha ke ae Nabi-e-Allah (ﷺ), Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke woh hamein Nabi bana de. Aap ne dua ki aur woh qabool bhi hui lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai, Musa (A.S) ke zamane mein siwaye Haroon (A.S) ke aur us ke baad Hazrat Yusha bin Noon (A.S) ke kisi aur ki nabuwwat sabit nahin. Ahl-e-Kitab ka yeh bhi dawa hai ke in logon ne apni dua ke mutabiq Allah Ta'ala ko apni aankhon se isi jagah dekha yeh bhi ghalat hai is liye ke khud Musa (A.S) ne jab deedar-e-Bari Ta'ala ka sawal kiya to unhein mana kardiya gaya phir bhala yeh sattar ashkhas deedar-e-Bari ki taab kaise late? Is aayat ki tafsir mein ek dusra qaul bhi hai ke Musa (A.S) Taurat le kar aaye jo ahkaam ka majmooa thi aur un se kaha ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ki kitab hai is par amal karo aur mazbooti ke sath is ke paband ho jao to woh kehne lage ke Hazrat hamein kya khabar Allah Ta'ala khud aa kar zahir ho kar hum se kyun nahin kehta? Kya wajah hai ke woh aap se baatein kare aur hum se na kare? Jab tak hum Allah ko khud na dekh lein hargiz iman na layenge is qaul par un ke upar ghazab-e-Ilahi nazil hua aur halak kar diye gaye phir zinda kiye gaye phir Musa (A.S) ne unhein kaha ke ab to is Taurat ko tham lo unhon ne phir inkar kiya ab ki martaba farishte pahad utha kar laye aur un ke saron ke upar muallaq kardiya ke agar na manoge to yeh pahad tum par gira diya jayega aur tum sab pees dale jaoge is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke marne ke baad yeh jee uthe aur phir bhi mukallaf rahe yani ahkaam-e-Ilahi un par phir bhi jaari rahe. Mawardi ne kaha hai ke baaz log kehte hain ke jab unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ki yeh zabardast nishani dekh li marne ke baad zinda hue to phir takleef-e-shar'i un par se hat gayi is liye ke ab to yeh majboor the ke sab kuch maan lein. Khud un par yeh wardat pesh aayi ab tasdeeq ek be-ikhtiyari amr hogaya. Dusri jamaat kehti hai ke nahin balkay bawajood is ke woh ahkaam-e-shar'a ke mukallaf rahe kyunke har aaqil mukallaf hai.

Qurtubi kehte hain theek qaul yahi hai, yeh umoor un par qudrati taur se aaye thay jo unhein pabandi-e-shar'a se azaad nahin kar sakte. Khud Bani Israel ne bhi bade bade mojizaat dekhe, khud un ke sath aise aise mamlaat hue jo bilkul nadir aur khilaf-e-qayas aur zabardast mojizaat thay, bawajood is ke woh bhi mukallaf rahe. Isi tarah yeh bhi theek qaul hai aur wazeh amr bhi yahi hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Yahood par ehsanat-e-Ilahiya ki tafseel sabqa aayat mein bayan hua tha ke falan falan balayen hum ne tum par se dafa kar dein, ab bayan ho raha hai ke falan falan ne'matein bhi hum ne tumhein ata farmayin. Ghamam, ghamamatun ki jama hai, chunke yeh aasman ko chupa leta hai is liye ise ghamama kehte hain. Yeh ek safed rang ka badal tha jo wadi-e-Teeh mein un ke saron par saya kiye rehta tha, jaise Nasai wagaira mein Ibn Abbas (R.A) se ek lambi hadith mein marwi hai. Ibn Abi Hatim kehte hain ke Ibn Umar (R.A), Rabi bin Anas, Abu Majaz, Zahhak aur Suddi ne bhi yahi kaha hai. Hasan aur Qatada (R.H) bhi yahi kehte hain aur log kehte hain ke yeh badal aam badalon se zyada thandak wala aur zyada umda tha. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yeh wahi badal tha jis mein Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din aayega. Abu Huzaifa ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Aayat (Hal yanzuruna illaa an ya'tiyahumullahu fee zulalim minal ghamami wal malaikatu wa quziyal amru wa ilallahi turja'ul umoor) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 210) is aayat mein is ka zikr hai ke kya in logon ko is ka intezar hai ke Allah Ta'ala aur us ke farishte badal mein aayein. Yahi woh badal hai jis mein Badr wale din farishte nazil huye thay. Jo "Mann" un par utra woh darakhton par utra tha. Yeh subah jate thay aur jama kar ke kha liya karte thay, woh gond ki qisam ka tha. Koi kehta hai shabnam ki waza ka tha. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain olon ki tarah "Mann" un ke gharon mein utarta tha jo doodh se zyada safed aur shehad se zyada meetha tha. Subah-e-Sadiq se lekar aaftab nikalne tak utarta rehta tha, har shakhs apne ghar baar ke liye utni miqdar mein jama kar leta tha jitna us din kafi ho, agar koi zyada leta to bigad jata tha. Jumma ke din woh do din ka le lete thay, Jumma aur Hafta ka, is liye ke Hafta un ka bada din tha. Rabi bin Anas (R.H) kehte hain Mann shehad jaisi cheez thi jis mein pani mila kar peete thay. Sha'bi (R.H) farmate hain tumhara yeh shehad is "Mann" ka satrawan hissa hai. Sheron mein yahi "Mann" shehad ke ma'ni mein aaya hai. Yeh sab aqwal qareeb qareeb hain. Gharz yeh hai ke ek aisi cheez thi jo unhein bila takleef-o-takalluf milti thi, agar sirf ise khaya jaye to woh khane ki cheez thi aur agar pani mein mila li jaye to peene ki cheez thi aur agar dusri cheezon ke sath murakkab kar di jati to aur cheez ho jati thi. Lekin yahan "Mann" se murad yahi "Mann" mashhoor nahin. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain khumbi Mann mein se hai aur is ka pani aankh ke liye shifa hai. Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain. Tirmidhi mein hai ke Ajwa jo Madina ki khajooron ki ek qisam hai woh Jannati cheez hai aur is mein zehar ka tiryaq hai aur khumbi Mann mein se hai aur is ka pani aankh ke dard ki dawa hai, yeh hadith Hasan Ghareeb hai. Dusre bohat se tariqon se bhi marwi hai. Ibn Marduyah ki hadith mein hai ke Sahaba (R.A) ne us darakht ke bare mein ikhtilaf kiya jo zameen ke upar hota hai jis ki jarein mazboot nahin hotin.

Ba'az kehne lage khumbi ka darakht hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya khumbi toh "Mann" mein se hai aur iska pani aankh ke liye shifa hai. "Salwa" ek qisam ka parind hai, chiriya se kuch bada hota hai, surkhi mail rang ka. Janubi hawayein chalti thin aur in parindon ko wahan la kar jama kar deti thin. Bani Israel apni zaroorat ke mutabiq inhe pakad lete the aur zibah kar ke khate the, agar ek din guzar kar bach jata toh woh bigad jata tha aur jumma ke din do din ke liye jama kar lete the kyunke hafta ka din un ke liye eid ka din hota tha, us din ibadaton mein mashghool rehne aur shikar waghera se bachne ka hukum tha. Ba'az logon ne kaha hai ke yeh parind kabootar ke barabar hote the, ek meel ki lambai chaudai mein ek neze ke barabar uncha dher in parindon ka ho jata tha. Yeh dono cheezein un par wadi-e-Teeh mein utri thin. Jahan unhon ne apne paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha tha ke is jungle mein hamare khane ka bandobast kaise hoga, tab un par "Mann-o-Salwa" utara gaya aur pani ke liye jab Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se darkhwast ki gayi toh Parwardigar-e-Alam ne farmaya ke "Is patthar par apna asa maro", asa lagte hi us se barah chashme jaari ho gaye aur Bani Israel ke barah hi firqe the. Har qabeela ne ek-ek chashma apne liye baant liya. Phir saya ke talib hue ke is chatyal maidan mein saya baghair guzara mushkil hai toh Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne Toor pahad ka un par saya kar diya. Reh gaya libas toh qudrat-e-Ilahi se jo libas woh pehne hue the woh un ke qad ke badhne ke sath badhta rehta tha, ek saal ke bacha ka libas joon-joon us ka qad-o-qamat badhta libas mein badhta jata, na phat-ta na kharab hota na mela hota. In tamam nematon ka zikr mukhtalif jagah Quran-e-Pak mein majood hai jaise yeh aayat aur aayat (Iza istasqa) wali aayat waghera. Bazli kehte hain ke Salwa shaheed ko kehte hain lekin un ka yeh qaul ghalat hai. Suraaj ne aur Johari ne bhi yahi kaha hai aur is ki shahadat mein Arab shairon ke sher aur ba'az lughwi muhaware bhi pesh kiye hain. Ba'az ne kaha hai ke ek dawa ka naam hai. Kisai kehte hain Salwa wahid ka lafz hai aur is ki jama Salawi aati hai aur ba'az kehte hain ke jama mein aur mufrad mein yahi seegha rehta hai yani lafz-e-Salwa. Gharz yeh Allah ki do nematein thin jin ka khana un ke liye mubah kiya gaya lekin in logon ne Allah Ta'ala ki in nematon ki nashukri ki aur yahi un ka apni janon par zulm karna tha bawajood-e-ke is se pehle bahut kuch Allah ki nematein un par nazil ho chuki thin.

Taqabuli jaiza: Bani Israel ki halat ka yeh naqsha aankhon ke samne rakh kar phir Ashab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki halat par nazar daalo ke bawajood sakht se sakht museebatein jhelne aur be-inteha takleefein bardasht karne ke woh itteba-e-Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par aur ibadat-e-Ilahi par jame rahe. Na mojizat talab kiye, na duniya ki rahaten maangin, na apne ta'ayyush ke liye koi nayi cheez paida karne ki khwahish ki. Jang-e-Tabook mein jabke bhook ke mare betab ho gaye aur maut ka maza aane laga tab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah! Is khane mein barkat ki dua kijiye aur jis ke paas jo kuch bacha kuch tha jama kar ke hazir kar diya jo sab mil kar bhi na hone ke barabar hi tha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dua ki aur Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne qabool farma kar is mein barkat di, unhon ne khoob khaya bhi aur tamam toshe-daan bhar liye. Pani ke qatre qatre ko jab tarsne lage to Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dua se ek abr aaya aur rel-pel kar di, piya pilaya aur mashkein aur mashkeeze sab bhar liye. Pas Sahaba ki is sabit qadmi, ulul-azmi, kamil itteba aur sachi tauheed ne un ki Ashab-e-Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) par qat'i fazeelat sabit kar di.

Yahood ki phir hukm-e-adooli. Jab Musa (A.S) Bani Israel ko le kar Misr se aaye aur unhein arz-e-muqaddas mein dakhil hone ka hukm hua jo un ki moroosi zameen thi, un se kaha gaya ke yahan jo Amaliq hain un se jihad karo to un logon ne namardi dikhayi jis ki saza mein unhein maidan-e-teeh mein daal diya gaya jaise ke Surah Maidah mein zikr hai. Qaryah se murad Bait-ul-Muqaddas hai. Suddi, Rabee, Qatadah, Abu Muslim waghera ne yahi kaha hai. Quran mein hai ke Musa (A.S) ne apni qoum se kaha, "Aye meri qoum! Is pak zameen mein jao jo tumhare liye likh di gayi hai." Baaz kehte hain is se murad Reekha hai, baaz ne kaha hai Misr murad hai lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai ke murad is se Bait-ul-Muqaddas hai. Yeh waqia teeh se nikalne ke baad ka hai. Jumma ke din shaam ko Allah Ta'ala ne unhein is par fatah ata ki, balkay suraj ko un ke liye zara si der thehra diya tha taake fatah ho jaye. Fatah ke baad unhein hukm hua ke is shehar mein sajda karte hue dakhil hon, jo is fatah ke izhar-e-tashakkur ka mazhar hoga. Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne sajde se murad ruku liya hai. Rawi kehte hain ke sajde se murad yahan par khushoo-o-khuzoo hai kyunke haqeeqat par ise mahmool karna namumkin hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) kehte hain yeh darwaza qibla ki janib tha, is ka naam Bab-ul-Hittah tha. Razi ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke darwaze se murad jihat-e-qibla hai. Bajaye sajde ke is qoum ne apni ranon par khisakna shuru kiya aur karwat ke bal dakhil hone lage, saron ko jhukane ke bajaye aur ooncha kar liya. Hittah ke ma'ani bakhshish ke hain. Baaz ne kaha hai ke yeh amr-e-haq hai. Ikrimah kehte hain is se murad ayat (La ilaha illallah) kehna hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) kehte hain in mein gunahon ka iqrar hai. Hasan aur Qatadah farmate hain is ke ma'ani yeh hain, "Allah hamari khataon ko hum se door kar de." Phir un se wada kiya jata hai ke agar tum isi tarah yahi kehte hue shehar mein jao ge aur is fatah ke waqt bhi apni pasti aur Allah ki ne'amat aur apne gunahon ka iqrar karo ge aur mujh se bakhshish mango ge to chunke yeh cheezein mujhe bohat hi pasand hain, main tumhari khataon se darguzar kar loon ga. Fatah-e-Makkah ke mauqe par farman-e-Ilahi Surah Iza Ja'a nazil hui thi aur is mein bhi yahi hukm diya gaya tha ke jab Allah ki madad aa jaye, Makkah fatah ho aur log deen-e-Allah mein fauj dar fauj aane lagen to apne Nabi (ﷺ) tum apne Rab ki tasbeeh aur hamd-o-sana bayan karo, is se istighfar karo, woh tauba qabool karne wala hai. Is surat mein jahan zikr-o-istighfar ka zikr hai wahan Huzoor (ﷺ) ke aakhri waqt ki khabar thi. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke samne is surat ka ek matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya tha jise aap ne farmaya tha, jab Makkah fatah hone ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ) shehar mein dakhil hue to intehai tawazo aur maskeeni ke aasar aap par thay, yahan tak ke sar jhukaye hue thay, oontni ke paalan se sar lag gaya tha.

Shahar mein jaate hi ghusal kar ke Zuha ke waqt aath raka'at namaz ada ki jo Zuha ki namaz bhi thi aur Fatah ke shukriya ki bhi, dono tarah ke qaul muhaddiseen ke hain. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) ne jab mulk-e-Iran fatah kiya aur Kisra ke shahi mahalaat mein pahunche toh isi sunnat ke mutabiq aath raka'atein parhein. Do do raka'at ek salaam se parhne ka ba'az ka mazhab hai aur ba'az ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke aath ek saath ek hi salaam se parhein, Wallahu A'alam. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Bani Israel ko hukm kiya gaya ke woh sajda karte hue aur 'Hittatun' kehte hue darwaze mein dakhil hon lekin unhon ne badal diya aur apni raanon par ghasat-te hue aur 'Hittatun' ke bajaye 'Habbatun fi sha'ratin' kehte hue jaane lage. Nasai, Abdur Razzaq, Abu Dawood, Muslim aur Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith ba-ikhtilaf-e-alfaaz maujood hai aur sanadan sahih hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) farmate hain ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke saath ja rahe thay. Zaat-ul-Hantal naami ghaati ke qareeb pahunche toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke is ghaati ki misaal bhi Bani Israel ke us darwaze jaisi hai jahan unhein sajda karte hue aur 'Hittatun' kehte hue dakhil hone ko kaha gaya tha aur un ke gunahon ki maafi ka waada kiya gaya tha. Hazrat Bara (R.A) farmate hain 'Sayaqoolus Sufaha' mein sufaha yani jaahilon se muraad Yahood hain jinhon ne Allah ki baat ko badal diya tha. Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain 'Hittatun' ke badle unhon ne 'Hinta, Habbatun hamra fiha sha'iratun' kaha tha. Un ki apni zabaan mein un ke alfaaz yeh thay: 'Hata sam'ana azbata mazba'. Ibn Abbas (R.A) bhi un ki is lafzi tabdeeli ko bayaan farmate hain ke ruku karne ke badle woh raanon par ghasat-te hue aur 'Hittatun' ke badle 'Hinta' kehte hue dakhil hue. Hazrat Ata, Mujahid, Ikrimah, Zahhak, Hasan, Qatadah, Rabi, Yahya ne bhi yahi bayaan kiya hai. Matlab yeh hai ke jis qaul-o-fe'l ka unhein hukm diya gaya tha unhon ne mazaq udaya jo sarih mukhalifat aur mu'anidat thi. Isi wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne un par apna azaab naazil farmaya. Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ke hum ne zaalimon par un ke fisq ki wajah se aasmani azaab naazil farmaya. 'Rijz' se muraad azaab hai, koi kehta hai ghazab hai, kisi ne ta'oon kaha hai. Ek marfoo hadith hai: Ta'oon rijz hai aur yeh azaab tum se agle logon par utara gaya tha. Bukhari aur Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke yeh dukh aur bimari rijz hai, tum se pehle log inhi se azaab diye gaye thay.

Yahood ki phir hukm-e-adooli. Ibn Abbas (R.A) kehte hain yeh darwaza qibla ki janib tha, is ka naam Bab-ul-Hittah tha. Razi ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke darwaze se murad jihat-e-qibla hai.
