Baaz ne kaha hai ke yeh amr-e-haq hai. Ikrimah kehte hain is se murad ayat (La ilaha illallah) kehna hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) kehte hain in mein gunahon ka iqrar hai. Hasan aur Qatadah farmate hain is ke ma'ani yeh hain, "Allah hamari khataon ko hum se door kar de." Phir un se wada kiya jata hai ke agar tum isi tarah yahi kehte hue shehar mein jao ge aur is fatah ke waqt bhi apni pasti aur Allah ki ne'amat aur apne gunahon ka iqrar karo ge aur mujh se bakhshish mango ge to chunke yeh cheezein mujhe bohat hi pasand hain, main tumhari khataon se darguzar kar loon ga. Fatah-e-Makkah ke mauqe par farman-e-Ilahi Surah Iza Ja'a nazil hui thi aur is mein bhi yahi hukm diya gaya tha ke jab Allah ki madad aa jaye, Makkah fatah ho aur log deen-e-Allah mein fauj dar fauj aane lagen to apne Nabi (ﷺ) tum apne Rab ki tasbeeh aur hamd-o-sana bayan karo, is se istighfar karo, woh tauba qabool karne wala hai. Is surat mein jahan zikr-o-istighfar ka zikr hai wahan Huzoor (ﷺ) ke aakhri waqt ki khabar thi. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke samne is surat ka ek matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya tha jise aap ne farmaya tha, jab Makkah fatah hone ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ) shehar mein dakhil hue to intehai tawazo aur maskeeni ke aasar aap par thay, yahan tak ke sar jhukaye hue thay, oontni ke paalan se sar lag gaya tha.

Shahar mein jaate hi ghusal kar ke Zuha ke waqt aath raka'at namaz ada ki jo Zuha ki namaz bhi thi aur Fatah ke shukriya ki bhi, dono tarah ke qaul muhaddiseen ke hain. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) ne jab mulk-e-Iran fatah kiya aur Kisra ke shahi mahalaat mein pahunche toh isi sunnat ke mutabiq aath raka'atein parhein. Do do raka'at ek salaam se parhne ka ba'az ka mazhab hai aur ba'az ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke aath ek saath ek hi salaam se parhein, Wallahu A'alam. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Bani Israel ko hukm kiya gaya ke woh sajda karte hue aur 'Hittatun' kehte hue darwaze mein dakhil hon lekin unhon ne badal diya aur apni raanon par ghasat-te hue aur 'Hittatun' ke bajaye 'Habbatun fi sha'ratin' kehte hue jaane lage. Nasai, Abdur Razzaq, Abu Dawood, Muslim aur Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith ba-ikhtilaf-e-alfaaz maujood hai aur sanadan sahih hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) farmate hain ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke saath ja rahe thay. Zaat-ul-Hantal naami ghaati ke qareeb pahunche toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke is ghaati ki misaal bhi Bani Israel ke us darwaze jaisi hai jahan unhein sajda karte hue aur 'Hittatun' kehte hue dakhil hone ko kaha gaya tha aur un ke gunahon ki maafi ka waada kiya gaya tha. Hazrat Bara (R.A) farmate hain 'Sayaqoolus Sufaha' mein sufaha yani jaahilon se muraad Yahood hain jinhon ne Allah ki baat ko badal diya tha. Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain 'Hittatun' ke badle unhon ne 'Hinta, Habbatun hamra fiha sha'iratun' kaha tha. Un ki apni zabaan mein un ke alfaaz yeh thay: 'Hata sam'ana azbata mazba'. Ibn Abbas (R.A) bhi un ki is lafzi tabdeeli ko bayaan farmate hain ke ruku karne ke badle woh raanon par ghasat-te hue aur 'Hittatun' ke badle 'Hinta' kehte hue dakhil hue. Hazrat Ata, Mujahid, Ikrimah, Zahhak, Hasan, Qatadah, Rabi, Yahya ne bhi yahi bayaan kiya hai. Matlab yeh hai ke jis qaul-o-fe'l ka unhein hukm diya gaya tha unhon ne mazaq udaya jo sarih mukhalifat aur mu'anidat thi. Isi wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne un par apna azaab naazil farmaya. Allah Ta'ala farmate hain ke hum ne zaalimon par un ke fisq ki wajah se aasmani azaab naazil farmaya. 'Rijz' se muraad azaab hai, koi kehta hai ghazab hai, kisi ne ta'oon kaha hai. Ek marfoo hadith hai: Ta'oon rijz hai aur yeh azaab tum se agle logon par utara gaya tha. Bukhari aur Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke yeh dukh aur bimari rijz hai, tum se pehle log inhi se azaab diye gaye thay.

Yahood par tasalsul-e-ehsanat: Yeh ek aur ne'amat yaad dilayi ja rahi hai ke jab tumhare Nabi ne tumhare liye paani talab kiya toh hum ne us patthar se chashme baha diye jo tumhare saath raha karta tha aur tumhare har qabeelay ke liye us mein se ek-ek chashma hum ne jaari kara diya jisay har qabeelay ne jaan liya aur hum ne keh diya ke Mann-o-Salwa khatay raho aur in chashmon ka paani peetay raho, be-mehnat ki rozi kha pee kar hamari ibadat mein lagay raho, nafarmani kar ke zameen mein fasaad mat phailao warna yeh ne'amatein chhin jayengi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain yeh ek chakoor patthar tha jo un ke saath hi tha. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne ba-hukm-e-Allah us par lakri maari, charon taraf se teen-teen nehrein beh niklin. Yeh patthar bail ke sar jitna tha jo bail par laad diya jata tha. Jahan utartay rakh detay aur asa ki zarb lagtay hi us mein se nehrein beh niklin. Jab kooch kartay utha letay, nehrein band ho jatin aur patthar ko saath rakh letay. Yeh patthar Toor pahar ka tha, ek haath lamba aur ek haath chora tha. Ba'az kehtay hain yeh Jannati patthar tha, das-das haath lamba chora tha, do shakhein thin jo chamakti rehti thin. Ek aur qaul mein hai ke yeh patthar Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke saath Jannat se aaya tha aur yunhi hathon-haath pohanchta hua Hazrat Shoaib (A.S) ko mila tha, unhon ne lakri aur patthar dono Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko diye thay. Ba'az kehtay hain yeh wohi patthar hai jis par Hazrat Musa (A.S) apne kapray rakh kar naha rahay thay aur ba-hukm-e-Ilahi yeh patthar aap ke kapray le kar bhaga tha, usay Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke mashwaray se utha liya tha jis se aap ka mo'ajiza zahir hua. Zamakhshari kehtay hain ke Hajar par Alif-Laam jins ke liye hai, ahd ke liye nahin, ya'ni isi ek patthar par asa maro, yeh nahin ke falan patthar hi par maro. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai aur yahi mo'ajizay ka kamaal aur qudrat ka poora izhaar hai, aap ki lakri lagtay hi woh behnay lagta aur phir doosri lakri lagtay hi khushk ho jata. Bani Israel aapas mein kehnay lagay ke agar yeh patthar gum ho gaya toh hum pyasay marnay lagenge toh Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke tum lakri na maro sirf zabani kaho taake unhein yaqeen aa jaye, Wallahu A'alam. Har ek qabeela apni-apni nehar ko is tarah jaan leta ke har qabeelay ka ek-ek aadmi patthar ke paas khara reh jata aur lakri lagtay hi woh behnay lagta aur phir doosri lakri lagtay hi khushk ho jata. Bani Israel aapas mein kehnay lagay ke agar yeh patthar gum ho gaya toh hum pyasay marnay lagenge toh Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke tum lakri na maro sirf zabani kaho taake unhein yaqeen aa jaye, Wallahu A'alam.

Har ek qabila apni apni nehar ko is tarah jaan leta ke har qabile ka ek ek aadmi patthar ke paas khara reh jata aur lakri lagte hi us mein se chashme jaari ho jate, jis shakhs ki taraf jo chashma jata woh apne qabile ko bula kar keh deta ke yeh chashma tumhara hai. Yeh waqia maidan-e-teeh ka hai. Surah Al-A'raf mein bhi is waqie ka bayan hai lekin chunke woh surat Makki hai is liye wahan un ka bayan ghaib ki zameer se kiya gaya hai aur Allah Ta'ala ne jo ehsanat un par nazil farmaye thay woh apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne dohraye hain aur yeh surat Madani hai is liye yahan khud unhein khitab kiya gaya hai. Surah Al-A'raf mein 'fanbajasat' kaha aur yahan 'fanfajarat' kaha is liye ke wahan awwal awwal jaari hone ke mani mein hai aur yahan aakhri haal ka bayan hai, wallahu a'lam. Aur in dono jagah ke bayan mein das wajah se farq hai jo farq lafzi bhi hai aur manwi bhi. Zamakhshari (R.H) ne apne taur par un sab wujooh ko bayan kiya hai aur haqeeqat is mein qareeb hai, wallahu a'lam.

Ahsan faramosh Yahood: Yahan Bani Israel ki besabri aur Naimat-e-Allah ki na-qadri bayan ki ja rahi hai ke Mann-o-Salwa jaise pakeeza khane par un se sabr na ho saka aur raddi cheezein maangne lage. Ek ta'am se murad ek qism ka khana yani Mann-o-Salwa hai. Qoum ke ma'ani mein ikhtilaf hai, Ibn Masood R.A ki qira'at mein 'thoom' hai, Mujahid R.H ne 'foom' ki tafseer 'thoom' ke sath ki hai, yani lehsun. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se bhi yeh tafseer marvi hai. Agli lughat ki kitabon mein 'foom-walna' ke ma'ani 'ikhtabiru' yani hamari roti pakao ke hain. Imam Ibn Jareer R.H farmate hain agar yeh sahih ho to yeh huroof-e-mubaddala mein se hain jaise 'Aasoor' 'shara' 'foor' 'shara' 'thafi' 'asasi' 'mafafeer' 'magatheer' waghera jin mein se 'ta' aur 'sa' badla gaya kyunke yeh dono makhraj ke aitbar se bahut qareeb hain, Wallahu A'alam. Aur log kehte hain 'foom' ke ma'ani gehoon ke hain, Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se bhi yahi tafseer manqool hai aur Ahiha ke sher mein bhi 'foom' gehoon ke ma'ani mein aaya hai. Bani Hashim ki zaban mein 'foom' gehoon ke ma'ani mein musta'mal tha. 'Foom' ke ma'ani roti ke bhi hain, ba'az ne sunbula ke ma'ani kiye hain. Hazrat Qatada R.H aur Hazrat Ata R.H farmate hain jis anaaj ki roti pakti hai use 'foom' kehte hain. Ba'az kehte hain 'foom' har qism ke anaaj ko kehte hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ne apni qoum ko danta ke tum raddi cheez ko behtar ke badle kyun talab karte ho? Phir farmaya shehar mein jao wahan yeh sab cheezein paoge. Jamhoor ki qira'at "Misran" hi hai aur tamam qira'aton mein yahi likha hua hai. Ibn Abbas R.A se marvi hai ke shehron mein se kisi shehar mein chale jao. Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A aur Ibn Masood R.A se 'Misr' ki qira'at bhi hai aur is ki tafseer 'Misr' shehar se ki gayi hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke 'Misran' se bhi murad makhsoos shehar-e-Misr liya gaya ho aur yeh alif 'Misra' ka aisa ho jaisa 'Qawareera' 'Qawareera' mein hai. 'Misr' se murad aam shehar lena hi behtar maloom hota hai to matlab yeh hua ke jo cheez tum talab karte ho yeh to aasaan cheez hai, jis shehar mein jaoge yeh tamam cheezein wahan pa loge, meri dua ki bhi kya zaroorat hai? Kyunke un ka yeh qaul mehez takabbur, sarkashi aur badai ke taur par tha is liye unhein koi jawab nahin diya gaya, Wallahu A'alam.

Padash-e-Amal: Matlab yeh hai ke zillat aur maskeeni un par muqaddar bana di gayi.

Ahant-o-pasti un par musallat kar di gayi, jizya un se wasool kiya gaya, musalmanon ke qadmon talay unhein daal diya gaya, faqa kashi aur bheek ki nobat pohanchi, Allah ka ghazab-o-ghussa un par utra. "Aba'u" ke ma'ani lautne aur "ruju kiya" ke hain. Ba'a kabhi bhalai ke sila ke sath aur kabhi burai ke sila ke sath aata hai, yahan burai ke sila ke sath hai. Yeh tamam azab un ke takabbur, inad, haq ki qabooliyat se inkar, Allah ki aayaton se kufr, ambiya aur un ke tabiedaron ki ahant aur un ke qatl ki bina par tha. Is se zyada bada kufr kaun sa hoga? Ke Allah ki aayaton se kufr karte aur us ke nabiyon ko bila-wajah qatl karte. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mein arz karte hain ke ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main khubsurat aadmi hoon, mera dil nahin chahta ke kisi ki jooti ka tasma bhi mujh se achha ho, to kya yeh takabbur aur sarkashi hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya nahin, balkay takabbur aur sarkashi haq ko radd karna aur logon ko haqeer samajhna hai. Chunke Bani Israel ka takabbur kufr-o-qatl-e-ambiya tak pohanch gaya tha, is liye Allah ka ghazab un par lazim ho gaya, duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) farmate hain ke ek ek Bani Israel un mein maujood teen teen sau nabiyon ko qatl kar daalte thay, phir bazaron mein ja kar apne len-den mein mashghool ho jata (Abu Dawood Tayalisi). Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain sab se zyada sakht azab qayamat ke din us shakhs ko hoga jise kisi nabi ne qatl kiya ho ya us ne kisi nabi ko maar dala ho, aur gumrahi ka woh imam jo tasweerein banane wala yani musawwir hoga. Yeh un ki nafarmaniyon aur zulm-o-ziyadati ka badla tha, yeh dusra sabab hai ke woh mana kiye hue kaam hi karte thay aur had se badh jate thay. Wallahu A'lam.

Farman-bardaron ke liye basharat. Upar chunke nafarmanon ke azab ka zikr tha to yahan un mein jo log nek thay un ke sawab ka bayan ho raha hai. Nabi ki tabedari karne walon ke liye yeh basharat ta-qayamat hai ke na mustaqbil ka dar, na yahan hasil na hone wali ashiya ka afsos-o-hasrat. Ayat (Ala inna auliya-allahi la khaufun alaihim wala hum yahzanun) (10. Yunus: 62) yani Allah ke doston par koi khauf-o-gham nahin aur woh farishtay jo musalman ki rooh nikalne ke waqt aatay hain yahi kehte hain ayat (Alla takhafu wala tahzanu wa abshiru bil-jannati allati kuntum tu'adun) (41. Fussilat: 30) tum daro nahin, tum udas na ho, tumhein hum us jannat ki khushkhabri dete hain jis ka tum se wada kiya tha. Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) farmate hain main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hone se pehle jin iman walon se mila tha un ki ibadat aur namaz rozay waghera ka zikr kiya to yeh ayat utri (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Salman ne un ka zikr karte hue kaha ke woh namazi, rozadar, imandar aur is baat ke mu'taqid thay ke aap mab'oos hone wale hain, aap ne farmaya ke woh jahannami hain, Hazrat Salman ko is se bada ranj hua, wahin yeh ayat nazil hui. Lekin yeh wazeh rahe ke Yahudiyon mein se imandar woh hai jo Taurat ko manta ho aur sunnat-e-Musa (A.S) ka amil ho, lekin jab Hazrat Isa (A.S) aa jayen to un ki tabedari na kare to phir be-deen ho jayega. Isi tarah Nasraniyon mein se imandar woh hai jo Injeel ko Kalamullah maane, shariat-e-Isawi par amal kare aur agar apne zamane mein Paighambar-e-Akharuzzaman Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko paalay to aap ki tabedari aur aap ki nabuwwat ki tasdeeq kare. Agar ab bhi woh Injeel ko aur itba-e-Isawi ko na chhore aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ko tasleem na kare to halak hoga (Ibn Abi Hatim). Suddi ne yahi riwayat ki hai aur Saeed bin Jubair bhi yahi farmate hain, matlab yeh hai ke har nabi ka tabedar us ka manne wala imandar aur saleh hai aur Allah ke yahan nijat pane wala, lekin jab dusra nabi aaye aur woh us se inkar kare to kafir ho jayega. Quran ki ek ayat to yeh jo aap ke samne hai aur dusri woh ayat jis mein bayan hai ayat (Wa man yabtaghi ghairal-Islami deenan falan yuqbala minhu, wa huwa fil-akhirati minal-khasireen) (3. Al-Imran: 85) yani jo shakhs Islam ke siwa kisi aur deen ka talib ho us se qabool na kiya jayega aur akhirat mein woh nuqsan uthane wala hoga. In dono ayaton mein yahi tatbeeq hai, kisi shakhs ka koi amal, koi tariqa maqbool nahin ta-waqtike woh shariat-e-Muhammadiya (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke mutabiq na ho. Magar yeh us waqt hai jab ke aap mab'oos ho kar duniya mein aa gaye, aap se pehle jis nabi ka jo zamana tha aur jo log us zamane mein thay un ke liye un ke zamane ke nabi ki tabedari aur us ki shariat ki mutabiqat shart hai.

Yahood kaun hain? Lafz-e-Yahood 'Haudah' se makhooz hai jis ke ma'ani mawaddat aur dosti ke hain ya yeh makhooz hai 'Tahawwud' se jis ke ma'ani tauba ke hain jaise Quran mein hai aayat (Inna hudna ilaika) Hazrat Musa (A.S) farmate hain hum ae Allah teri taraf tauba karte hain, pas unhein in dono wajoohaat ki bina par Yahood kaha gaya hai. Yahooda Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ke bade ladke ka naam tha. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke yeh Taurat padhte waqt hilte the, is bina par unhein Yahood yani harkat karne wala kaha gaya hai. Jab Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki nabuwwat ka zamana aaya to Bani Israel par aap ki nabuwwat ki tasdeeq aur aap ke farman ki itteba wajib hui tab un ka naam Nasara hua kyunke unhon ne aapas mein ek dusre ki nusrat yani ta'eed aur madad ki thi, unhein Ansar bhi kaha gaya hai. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka qaul hai aayat (Man ansari ilallah, qalal hawariyyuna nahnu ansarullah) (Surah Al-Imran: 52) Allah ke deen mein mera madadgar kaun hai? Hawariyon ne kaha hum hain. Baaz kehte hain yeh log jahan utarte the us zameen ka naam Nasira tha is liye unhein Nasara kaha gaya, Qatada aur Ibn Juraij ka yahi qaul hai, Ibn Abbas (R.A) se bhi marwi hai, wallahu a'lam. Nasara Nasran ki jama hai jaise Nashwan ki jama Nashawi aur Sakran ki jama Sakari, is ka muannas Nasrata aata hai. Ab jabke Khatam-ul-Anbiya (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka zamana aaya aur aap tamam duniya ki taraf Rasool-o-Nabi bana kar bheje gaye to un par bhi aur dusre sab par bhi aap ki tasdeeq-o-itteba wajib qarar di gayi aur imaan-o-yaqeen ki pukhtagi ki wajah se aap ki ummat ka naam Momin rakha gaya aur is liye bhi ke un ka imaan tamam agle ambiya par bhi hai aur tamam aane wali baton par bhi. Sabi ke ma'ani ek to bedeen aur la-mazhab kiye gaye hain aur Ahl-e-Kitab ke ek firqa ka naam bhi yeh tha jo Zaboor padha karte the, isi bina par Abu Hanifa (R.H) aur Ishaq (R.H) ka mazhab hai ke un ke haath ka zabiha hamare liye halal hai aur un ki aurton se nikah karna bhi. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) aur Hazrat Hakam (R.H) farmate hain yeh giroh Majusiyon ke manind hai, yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh log farishton ke pujari the. Ziyad ne jab yeh suna tha ke yeh log paanch waqt namaz qibla ki janib rukh kar ke padha karte hain to irada kiya ke unhein jizya maaf kar de lekin saath hi maloom hua ke woh mushrik hain to apne irade se baaz rahe. Abu-uz-Zinad farmate hain yeh log Iraqi hain, Bakuthi ke rehne wale sab nabiyon ko maante hain, har saal tees roze rakhte hain aur Yaman ki taraf munh kar ke har din mein paanch namazein padhte hain. Wahb bin Munabbah kehte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ko yeh log jaante hain lekin kisi shariat ke paband nahin aur kuffar bhi nahin. Abdur Rahman bin Zaid ka qaul hai ke yeh bhi ek mazhab hai, Jazeerah-e-Mausil mein yeh log the, aayat (La ilaha illallah) padhte the aur kisi kitab ya nabi ko nahin maante the aur na koi khaas shar' ke aamil the. Mushrikeen isi bina par An-Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke sahaba ko La ilaha illallah Sabi kehte the yani kehne ki bina par.

Un ka deen nasraniyon se milta julta tha, un ka qibla junoob ki taraf tha. Yeh log apne aap ko Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ke deen par batate thay. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke yahood-o-majoos ke deen ka khalt-malt yeh mazhab tha. Un ka zabiha khana aur un ki aurton se nikah karna mamnoo hai. Qurtubi (R.H) farmate hain, mujhe jahan tak maloom hua hai ke yeh log muwahid thay lekin taron ki taseer aur nujoom ke mo'taqid thay. Abu Saeed Istakhri ne un par kufr ka fatwa sadir kiya hai. Razi (R.H) farmate hain yeh sitara parast log thay, Kashran-bin mein se thay jin ki janib Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) bheje gaye thay. Haqeeqat-e-haal ka ilm to mehez Allah Ta'ala ko hai, magar bazahir yahi qaul achha maloom hota hai ke yeh log na yahoodi thay, na nasrani, na majoosi, na mushrik, balkay yeh log fitrat par thay, kisi khaas mazhab ke paband na thay aur isi ma'ani mein mushrikeen, as-hab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko Sabi kaha karte thay, ya'ni in logon ne tamam mazahib tark kar diye thay. Ba'az ulama ka qaul hai ke Sabi woh hain jinhein kisi Nabi ki da'wat nahin pahunchi. Wallahu A'lam.

Ahd-shikan Yahood: In aayaton mein Allah Ta'ala Bani Israel ko unke ahd-o-paiman yaad dila raha hai ke meri ibadat aur mere Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at ka wada main tum se le chuka hoon aur is wade ko pura karane aur manwane ke liye main ne Toor pahar ko tumhare saron par la kar khara kar diya tha jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa iz nataqnal jabala fauqahum ka'annahu zullatun wa zannu annahu waqi'um bihim) (Surah Al-A'raf: 171) jab hum ne unke saron par saiban ki tarah pahar la kar khara kiya aur woh yaqeen kar chuke ke ab pahar un par gir kar unhein kuchal dalega, us waqt hum ne kaha hamari di hui cheez ko mazboot thamo aur is mein jo kuch hai use yaad karo to bach jaoge. "Toor" se murad pahar hai jaise Surah Al-A'raf ki aayat mein hai aur jaise Sahaba (R.A) aur Tabi'een (R.H) ne is ki tafseer ki hai, sabit yahi hai ke Toor us pahar ko kehte hain jis par sabza ugta ho. Hadith-e-Futoon mein barwayat Ibn Abbas (R.A) marwi hai ke jab unhon ne ita'at se inkar karne ke ba'is unke sar par pahar aa gaya lekin isi waqt yeh sab sajde mein gir pare aur mare dar ke kankhiyon se upar ki taraf dekhte rahe, Allah Ta'ala ne un par raham farmaya aur pahar hata liya, isi wajah se woh isi sajde ko pasand karte hain ke aadha dhar sajde mein ho aur dusri taraf se unche dekh rahe hon. Jo hum ne diya us se murad Torah hai, quwwat se murad ta'at hai, yani Torah par mazbooti se jam kar amal karne ka wada karo warna pahar tum par gira diya jayega aur is mein jo hai use yaad karo aur is par amal karo yani Torah parhte parhate raho. Lekin in logon ne itne pukhta meesaq, itne a'ala ahd aur is qadar zabardast wade ke ba'ad bhi kuch parwah na ki aur ahd-shikani ki. Ab agar Allah Ta'ala ki karam-farmayi aur rahmat na hoti, agar woh tauba qabool na farmata aur Nabiyon (A.S) ke silsile ko barabar jaari na rakhta to yaqeenan tumhein zabardast nuqsan pahunchta, is wade ko torne ki bina par duniya aur aakhirat mein tum barbad ho jate.

Suratein maskh kardi gayin. Is waqia ka bayan tafseel ke sath Surah Al-A'raf mein hai jahan farmaya aayat (وَسْــــَٔـلْهُمْ عَنِ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِيْ كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ الْبَحْرِ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 163), wahin is ki tafseer bhi poori bayan hogi, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Yeh Ailah basti ke bashinday thay, un par hafta ke din ta'zeem zaroori ki gayi thi, us din ka shikar mana kiya gaya tha. Aur hukm-e-Bari Ta'ala se machliyan usi din bakasrat aaya karti thin toh unhon ne makkari ki. Garhay khod liye, rassiyan aur kaantay daal diye. Hafta walay din woh aa gayin, yahan phans gayin, itwar ki raat ko ja kar pakar liya. Is jurm par Allah ne un ki shaklein badal din. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmatay hain suratein nahin badli thin balkay dil maskh ho gaye thay, yeh sirf bator-e-misaal ke hai jaise amal na karne walay ulama ko gadhon se misaal di hai, lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai aur ibarat-e-Quran ke zahir alfaaz ke bhi khilaf hai. Is aayat par phir Surah Al-A'raf ki aayat (Wasalhum) al-kh aur aayat (وَجَعَلَ مِنْهُمُ الْقِرَدَةَ وَالْخَـنَازِيْرَ وَعَبَدَ الطَّاغُوْتَ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 60) par nazar daalo. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain ke jawan log bandar ban gaye aur boorhay suar bana diye gaye. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) farmatay hain yeh tamam mard aur aurat dum walay bandar bana diye gaye. Aasmani aawaz aayi ke tum sab bandar ban jao, chunancha sab ke sab bandar ban gaye. Jo log unhein is makrooh heela se roktay thay woh ab aaye aur kehne lagay dekho hum pehlay se tumhein mana karte thay? Toh woh sar hilatay thay yani haan. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain thori muddat mein woh sab halak ho gaye, un ki nasl nahin hui, teen din se zyada koi maskh shuda qaum zinda nahin rehti, yeh sab bhi teen din mein hi yunhi naak ragarte ragarte mar gaye, khana peena aur nasl sab munqata ho gayi. Yeh bandar jo ab hain aur jo us waqt bhi thay yeh toh janwar hain jo isi tarah paida kiye gaye thay, Allah Ta'ala jo chahay aur jis tarah chahay paida karta hai aur jisay jis tarah ka chahay bana deta hai (Allah apne ghazab-o-ghussa se aur apni pakar dhakar se aur apne dunyawi aur ukhrawi azaab se nijat de, Ameen). Khaseen ke ma'ni zaleel aur kameena. Un ka waqia tafseel ke sath Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghera ne jo bayan kiya hai woh sab sun lijiye. Un par hafta ki izzat-o-adab ko farz kiya gaya lekin unhon ne hafta ke din ko pasand na kiya aur hafta ka din rakha, us din ki azmat ke taur par un par shikar khelna waghera us din haram kar diya gaya. Idhar Allah ki aazmaish ki bina par hafta walay din tamam machliyan oopar aa jaya karti thin aur koodti uchalti rehti thin lekin baqi dinon mein koi nazar hi nahin aati thi. Ek muddat tak toh yeh log khamosh rahay aur shikar karne se rukay rahay. Baad azan un mein se ek shakhs ne yeh heela nikala ke hafta walay din machli ko pakar liya aur phanday mein phans kar dori ko kinaray par kisi cheez se baandh diya, itwar walay din ja kar nikal laya aur paka kar khai.

Logon ne khushbu pa kar pucha toh usne kaha main ne toh aaj itwar ko shikar kiya hai. Aakhir yeh raaz khula toh aur logon ne bhi is heela ko pasand kiya aur is tarah woh sab machliyon ka shikar karne lage. Phir toh baaz ne darya ke aas-paas garhay khod liye, hafta wale din jab machliyan is mein aa jatin toh usay band kar dete aur itwar wale din pakar late. Kuch log jo in mein nek dil aur sachay musalman thay woh unhein rokte aur mana karte rahe lekin un ka jawab yahi hota tha ke hum hafta ko shikar hi nahin khelte, hum toh itwar wale din pakarte hain. In shikar khelne walon aur in ko mana karne walon ke siwa ek giroh in mein aur bhi tha jo maslahat-e-waqt baratne wala aur dono firqon ko raazi rakhne wala, woh toh pura sath deta tha. In ka na shikar khelte thay na shikariyon ko rokte thay, balkay rokne walon se kehte thay ke is qoum ko kyun wa'z-o-nasihat karte ho jinhein Allah halak karega ya sakht azab karega aur tum apna farz bhi ada kar chuke, unhein mana kar chuke, jab nahin mante toh ab unhein chhoro. Yeh jawab dete ke ek toh Allah ke haan hum mazoor ho jayen is liye aur dusre is liye bhi ke shayad aaj nahin toh kal aur kal nahin toh parson yeh maan jayen aur azab-e-Allah se nijat payen. Bil-aakhir is muslim jamaat ne is heela jo firqa ka bilkul boycott kar diya aur un se bilkul alag ho gaye. Basti ke darmiyan ek deewar khench li aur darwaze apne aane jaane ka rakha aur ek darwaza in heela jo nafarmanon ke liye, is par bhi ek muddat isi tarah guzar gayi. Ek din subah musalman jaage, din charh gaya lekin ab tak un logon ne apna darwaza nahin khola tha aur na un ki awazein aa rahi thin. Yeh log mutahayyir thay ke aaj kya baat hai? Aakhir jab zyada der lag gayi toh un logon ne deewar par charh kar dekha toh wahan ajab manzar nazar aaya. Dekha ke woh tamam log ma' aurton bachon ke bandar ban gaye hain. Un ke ghar jo raton ko band thay isi tarah band hain aur andar woh kul insaan bandar ki suraton mein hain jin ki dumain nikli hui hain. Bachay chhotay bandaron ki shakal mein, mard baray bandaron ki surat mein, auratein bandariyan bani hui hain aur har ek pehchana jata hai ke yeh falan mard hai, yeh falan aurat hai, yeh falan bacha hai waghera. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke jab yeh itaab aaya toh na sirf wohi halak huye jo shikar khelte thay balkay un ke sath woh bhi halak huye jo unhein mana na karte thay aur khamosh baithe huye thay aur mel-jol tark na kiya tha. Sirf woh bachay jo unhein mana karte rahe aur un se alag-thalag ho gaye thay. Yeh tamam aqwal aur Quran-e-Kareem ki kayi ek ayatein waghera shahid hain ke sahih baat yahi hai ke un ki suratein badal di gayi thin, sach much bandar bana diye gaye, na yeh ke ma'nawi maskh tha yani un ke dil bandaron jaise ho gaye thay, jaise ke Mujahid R.H ka qaul hai. Theek tafseer yahi hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne unhein suwar aur bandar bana diya tha aur zahiri suratein bhi un ki in bad-janwaron jaisi ho gayin. Wallahu A'lam.

Faja'alna-ha mein 'ha' ki zameer ka marja' qirada hai yani hum ne in bandaron ko sabab-e-ibrat banaya. Is ka marja' heetan hai yani in machliyon ko, ya is ka marja' uqubat hai yani is saza ko. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is marja' ka qarya hai yani is basti ko hum ne aglay pichlon ke liye ibrat-naak amr-e-waqia bana diya. Aur sahih baat yahi maloom hoti hai ke qarya murad hai aur qarya se murad ahl-e-qarya hain. Nakal kehte hain azab-o-saza ko jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Fa-akhazahullahu nakalal-akhirati wal-oola) (Surah An-Nazi'at: 25). Is ko ibrat ka sabab banaya agay pichay wali bastiyon ke liye jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Walaqad ahlakna ma hawlakum minal-qura wa sarrafnal-aayati la'allahum yarji'oon) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 27). Hum ne tumhare aas paas ki bastiyon ko halak kiya aur apni nishaniyan bayan farmayin taake woh log laut aayen. Aur irshad hai aayat (Awalam yaraw anna na'til-arda nanqusuha min atraafiha) (Surah Ar-Ra'd: 41). Aur yeh bhi matlab bayan kiya gaya hai ke is waqt ke majood logon ke liye aur baad mein aanay walon ke liye yeh ibrat-naak waqia daleel-e-rah ban jaye. Go ba'az logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke aglon baad mein aanay walon ke liye yeh waqia go kitna hi zabardast ibrat-naak ho daleel nahin ban sakta is liye ke woh to guzar chuke. To theek qaul yahi hai ke yahan murad makan aur jagah hai yani aas paas ki bastiyan aur yahi tafseer hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) aur Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (Rahimahullah) ki. Wallahu A'lam. Aur yeh bhi ma'ani bayan kiye gaye hain ke un ke aglay gunah aur un ke baad aanay walay logon ko aisay hi gunahon ke liye hum ne is saza ko ibrat ka sabab banaya, lekin sahih qaul wahi hai jis ki sehat hum ne bayan ki, yani aas paas ki bastiyan. Quran farmata hai aayat (Walaqad ahlakna ma hawlakum minal-qura wa sarrafnal-aayati la'allahum yarji'oon) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 27). Aur farman hai aayat (Wala yazalul-lazeena kafaroo fee miryatin minhu hatta ta'tiyahumus-sa'atu baghtatan aw ya'tiyahum 'azabu yawmin 'aqeem) (Surah Al-Hajj: 55). Aur farman hai aayat (Afala yarawna anna na'til-arda nanqusuha min atraafiha, afahumul-ghaliboon) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 44). Garz yeh azab un ke zamanay walon ke liye aur baad mein aanay walon ke liye ek sabaq hai aur isi liye farmaya aayat (Wa maw'izatal-lil-muttaqeen) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 66). Yani yeh jo baad mein aayenge in parhezgaron ke liye mujib-e-nasihat ho. Mujib-e-nasihat yahan tak ke ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye bhi ke yeh log darte rahen ke jo azab-o-sazayen un par un ke heelon ki wajah se, un ke makr-o-fareb se haram ko halal kar lene ke ba'is nazil huin, un ke baad bhi jo aisa karenge aisa na ho ke wahi saza aur wahi azab un par bhi aa jayen.

Ek sahih hadith Imam Abu Abdullah bin Batta ne warid ki hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hadith (La tartakibu ma-rtakabatil Yahudu fastahallu maharimallahi bi-adnal hiyal) yani tum woh na karo jo Yahudiyon ne kiya yani heelay hawalon se Allah ke haram ko halal na kar liya karo. Yani shar'i ahkaam mein heela joi se bacho. Yeh hadith bilkul sahih hai aur is ke sab rawi siqah hain wallahu a'lam.

Is ko ibrat ka sabab banaya agay pichay wali bastiyon ke liye jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Walaqad ahlakna ma hawlakum minal-qura wa sarrafnal-aayati la'allahum yarji'oon) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 27). Hum ne tumhare aas paas ki bastiyon ko halak kiya aur apni nishaniyan bayan farmayin taake woh log laut aayen. Aur irshad hai aayat (Awalam yaraw anna na'til-arda nanqusuha min atraafiha) (Surah Ar-Ra'd: 41). Aur yeh bhi matlab bayan kiya gaya hai ke is waqt ke majood logon ke liye aur baad mein aanay walon ke liye yeh ibrat-naak waqia daleel-e-rah ban jaye. Go ba'az logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke aglon baad mein aanay walon ke liye yeh waqia go kitna hi zabardast ibrat-naak ho daleel nahin ban sakta is liye ke woh to guzar chuke. To theek qaul yahi hai ke yahan murad makan aur jagah hai yani aas paas ki bastiyan aur yahi tafseer hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) aur Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (Rahimahullah) ki. Wallahu A'lam. Aur yeh bhi ma'ani bayan kiye gaye hain ke un ke aglay gunah aur un ke baad aanay walay logon ko aisay hi gunahon ke liye hum ne is saza ko ibrat ka sabab banaya, lekin sahih qaul wahi hai jis ki sehat hum ne bayan ki, yani aas paas ki bastiyan. Quran farmata hai aayat (Walaqad ahlakna ma hawlakum minal-qura wa sarrafnal-aayati la'allahum yarji'oon) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 27). Aur farman hai aayat (Wala yazalul-lazeena kafaroo fee miryatin minhu hatta ta'tiyahumus-sa'atu baghtatan aw ya'tiyahum 'azabu yawmin 'aqeem) (Surah Al-Hajj: 55). Aur farman hai aayat (Afala yarawna anna na'til-arda nanqusuha min atraafiha, afahumul-ghaliboon) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 44). Garz yeh azab un ke zamanay walon ke liye aur baad mein aanay walon ke liye ek sabaq hai aur isi liye farmaya aayat (Wa maw'izatal-lil-muttaqeen) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 66). Yani yeh jo baad mein aayenge in parhezgaron ke liye mujib-e-nasihat ho. Mujib-e-nasihat yahan tak ke ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye bhi ke yeh log darte rahen ke jo azab-o-sazayen un par un ke heelon ki wajah se, un ke makr-o-fareb se haram ko halal kar lene ke ba'is nazil huin, un ke baad bhi jo aisa karenge aisa na ho ke wahi saza aur wahi azab un par bhi aa jayen.

Ek sahih hadith Imam Abu Abdullah bin Batta ne warid ki hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hadith (La tartakibu ma-rtakabatil Yahudu fastahallu maharimallahi bi-adnal hiyal) yani tum woh na karo jo Yahudiyon ne kiya yani heelay hawalon se Allah ke haram ko halal na kar liya karo. Yani shar'i ahkaam mein heela joi se bacho. Yeh hadith bilkul sahih hai aur is ke sab rawi siqah hain wallahu a'lam.

Qatil kaun? Is ka poora waqia yeh hai ke Bani Israel mein ek shakhs bahut maaldar aur tungar tha, us ki koi narina aulad na thi, sirf ek ladki thi aur ek bhatija tha. Bhatije ne jab dekha ke buddha marta hi nahin to virsa ke lalach mein use khayal aaya ke main hi use kyun na maar daalun? Aur us ki ladki se nikah bhi kar lun, qatl ki tohmat dusron par rakh kar diyat bhi vasool karun aur maqtool ke maal ka maalik bhi ban jaaun. Is shaitani khayal mein woh pukhta ho gaya aur ek din mauqa pa kar apne chacha ko qatl kar daala. Bani Israel ke bhale log un ke jhagron bakheron se tang aa kar yaksu ho kar un se alag ek aur shehar mein rehte the, shaam ko apne qila ka phatak band kar diya karte the aur subh kholte the, kisi mujrim ko apne haan ghusne bhi nahin dete the. Is bhatije ne apne chacha ki laash ko le ja kar us qila ke phatak ke samne daal diya aur yahan aa kar apne chacha ko dhundne laga, phir haye-dohai macha di ke mere chacha ko kisi ne maar daala. Aakhir-e-kaar un qila walon par tohmat laga kar un se diyat ka rupiya talab karne laga. Unhon ne is qatl se aur is ke ilm se bilkul inkaar kiya, lekin yeh ad gaya yahan tak ke apne sathiyon ko le kar un se ladai karne par tul gaya. Yeh log aajiz aa kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke paas aaye aur waqia arz kiya ke ya RasoolAllah! Yeh shakhs khwah-makhwah hum par ek qatl ki tohmat laga raha hai halankeh hum bari-uz-zimma hain. Musa (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki, wahan se wahi nazil hui ke un se kaho ek gaye zibah karein. Unhon ne kaha ae Allah ke Nabi! Kahan qatil ki tehqeeq aur kahan aap gaye ke zibah ka hukum de rahe hain? Kya aap hum se mazaq karte hain? Musa (A.S) ne farmaya: A'uzu Billah (masail-e-shariya ke mauqe par) mazaq jahilon ka kaam hai, Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka hukum yahi hai. Ab agar yeh log ja kar kisi gaye ko zibah kar dete to kaafi tha, lekin unhon ne sawalat ka darwaza khola aur kaha woh gaye kaisi honi chahiye? Is par hukum hua ke woh na bahut budhiya hai na bacha hai, jawan umr ki hai. Unhon ne kaha Hazrat! Aisi gayen to bahut hain, yeh bayan farmaiye ke us ka rang kya hai? Wahi utri ke us ka rang bilkul saaf zardi mail hai, bahar dekhne wale ki aankhon mein utarti jaati hai. Phir kehne lage Hazrat! Aisi gayen bhi bahut si hain, koi aur mumtaz wasf bayan farmaiye. Wahi nazil hui ke woh kabhi hal mein nahin joti gayi, kheton ko paani nahin pilaya, har aib se paak hai, yak-rangi hai, koi daagh dhabba nahin. Jyun jyun woh sawalat badhate gaye, hukum mein sakhti hoti gayi. Ehtram-e-Walidain par Inaam-e-Ilahi. Ab aisi gaye dhundne ko nikle to woh sirf ek ladke ke paas mili.

Yeh bacha apne maa baap ka nihayat farmanbardar tha. Ek martaba jabke iska baap soya hua tha aur naqdi wali peti ki kunji uske sarhane thi, ek saudagar ek qeemti heera bechta hua aaya aur kehne laga ke main ise bechna chahta hoon. Ladke ne kaha main khareedunga, qeemat sattar hazar tay hui. Ladke ne kaha zara thehro, jab mere walid jaagenge to main unse kunji le kar aapko qeemat ada kar dunga. Usne kaha abhi de do to das hazar kam kar deta hoon. Usne kaha nahin hazrat, main apne walid ko jagaoonga nahin, tum agar thehar jao to main bajaye sattar hazar ke assi hazar doonga. Yunhi udhar se kami aur idhar se ziyadati honi shuru hoti hai, yahan tak ke tajir tees hazar qeemat laga deta hai ke agar tum ab jaga kar mujhe rupiya de do, main tees hazar mein deta hoon. Ladka kehta hai agar tum thehar jao ya thehar kar aao, mere walid jaag jayen to main tumhein ek lakh doonga. Aakhir woh naraz ho kar apna heera wapas le kar chala gaya. Baap ki is buzurgi ke ehsas aur unke aaram pahunchane ki koshish karne aur unka adab-o-ehtram karne se Parwardigar is ladke se khush ho jata hai aur ise yeh gaye ata farmata hai. Jab Bani Israel is qisam ki gaye dhoondne nikalte hain to siwa is ladke ke aur kisi ke paas nahin paate. Us se kehte hain ke is ek gaye ke badle do gayen le lo, yeh inkar karta hai. Phir kehte hain teen le lo, chaar le lo, lekin yeh raazi nahin hota. Das tak kehte hain magar phir bhi nahin maanta. Yeh aa kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) se shikayat karte hain. Aap farmate hain jo yeh mange do aur ise raazi kar ke gaye khareedo. Aakhir gaye ke wazan ke barabar sona diya gaya tab usne apni gaye bechi. Yeh barkat Allah ne maa baap ki khidmat ki wajah se ise ata farmayi jabke yeh bahut mohtaj tha. Iske walid ka inteqal ho gaya tha aur iski bewa maa gurbat aur tangi ke din basar kar rahi thi. Garz ab yeh gaye khareed li gayi aur ise zibah kiya gaya aur iske jism ka ek tukda le kar maqtool ke jism se lagaya gaya to Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se woh murda jee utha. Is se poocha gaya ke tumhein kis ne qatl kiya hai? Usne kaha mere bhatije ne, is liye ke woh mera maal le le aur meri ladki se nikah kar le. Bas itna keh kar woh phir mar gaya aur qatil ka pata chal gaya aur Bani Israel mein jo jang-o-jidal hone wali thi woh ruk gayi aur yeh fitna dab gaya. Is bhatije ko logon ne pakad liya, iski ayyari aur makkari khul gayi aur ise iske badle mein qatl kar dala gaya. Yeh qissa mukhtalif alfaaz se marwi hai. Ba-zahiran yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh Bani Israel ke haan ka waqea hai jis ki tasdeeq, takzeeb hum nahin kar sakte, haan riwayat jaiz hai. To is aayat mein yahi bayan ho raha hai ke ae Bani Israel meri is nemat ko bhi na bhoolo ke main ne aadat ke khilaf bator-e-mojze ke ek gaye ke jism ko lagane se ek murda ko zinda kar diya. Is maqtool ne apne qatil ka pata bata diya aur ek ubharne wala fitna dab gaya.

Hujjat-bazi ka anjam Bani Israel ki sarkashi, sartabi aur hukm-e-Allah, Amr-e-Ilahi ki wazahat ke sath ka yahan bayan ho raha hai ke hukm paate hain us par amal na kar dala balke shaqqein nikalne aur baar baar sawal karne lage. Ibn-e-Jurayj farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya hai ke hukm milte hi woh agar kisi gaye ko bhi zibah kar daalte to kaafi tha lekin unhon ne pe-dar-pe sawalat shuru kiye aur kaam mein sakhti barhti gayi yahan tak ke aakhir mein woh Insha'Allah na kehte to kabhi bhi sakhti na talti aur matlooba gaye milna aur mushkil ho jaati. Pehle sawal ke jawab mein kaha gaya ke na to woh burhiya hai na bilkul kam-umar hai, balke darmiyani umar ki hai. Phir dusre sawal ke jawab mein uska rang bayan kiya gaya ke woh zard aur chamakdar rang ki hai jo dekhne walon ke dilon ko bahut pasand aaye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke jo zard jooti pehne woh har qeemat khush-o-khurram rahega aur is jumla se istidlal kiya hai "Tasurrun-Nazireen". Baaz ne kaha hai ke murad sakht siyah rang hai lekin awwal qaul hi sahih hai, haan yeh aur baat hai ke hum yun kahein ke usi ki shokhi aur chamkile-pan se woh misl kaale rang ke lagta tha. Wahab bin Munabbah (R.H) kehte hain uska rang is qadar shokh aur gehra tha ke yeh maloom hota tha goya suraj ki shua'ein us se uth rahi hain. Taurat mein uska rang surkh bayan kiya gaya hai lekin shayad Arabi karne walon ki ghalti hai, Wallahu A'lam. Chunki is rang aur is umar ki gayen bhi unhein bakasrat nazar aayin to unhon ne phir kaha ae Allah ke Nabi! koi aur nishani bhi puchiye taake shuba mit jaye, Insha'Allah ab hamein rasta mil jayega. Agar yeh Insha'Allah na kehte to unhein Qayamat tak pata na chalta aur agar yeh sawalat hi na karte to itni sakhti un par aaid na hoti balke jis gaye ko zibah kar dete kifayat ho jaati. Yeh mazmoon ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hai lekin iski sanad ghareeb hai, sahih baat yahi maloom hoti hai ke yeh Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ka apna kalam hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ab ki martaba uske ausaf bayan kiye gaye ke woh hal mein nahin juti, paani nahin seencha, uske chamre par koi daagh dhabba nahin, yak-rangi hai, saare badan mein kahin dusra rang nahin. Uske haath paon aur kul aaza bilkul durust aur tawana hain. Baaz kehte hain ke woh gaye kaam karne wali nahin, haan kheti ka kaam karti hai lekin paani nahin pilati, magar yeh qaul ghalat hai is liye ke "Zalool" ki tafseer yeh hai ke woh hal nahin jot-ti aur na paani pilati hai, is mein na koi daagh dhabba hai. Ab itni bari kado-kawish ke baad badil-e-nakhwasta woh iski qurbani ki taraf mutawajja hue, isi liye farmaya ke yeh zibah karna nahin chahte the aur zibah na karne ke bahane talash karte the. Kisi ne kaha hai is liye ke unhein apni ruswai ka khayal tha ke na jaane kaun qatil ho, baaz kehte hain uski qeemat sun kar ghabra gaye the, lekin baaz riwayaton mein aaya hai ke kul teen dinar uski qeemat lagi thi, lekin yeh teen dinar wali gaye ke wazan ke barabar sone wali dono riwayatein Bani Israel riwayatein hain.

Theek baat yahi hai ke un ka irada hukm ki baja-awari ka tha hi nahin lekin ab is qadar wazahat ke baad aur qatl ka muqadma hone ki wajah se unhein yeh hukm manna hi para. Wallahu A'lam. Is ayat se is masla par bhi istidlal ho sakta hai ke janwaron ko dekhe baghair udhar dena jaiz hai is liye ke sifat ka hasr kar diya gaya aur ausaf pooray bayan kar diye gaye, jaise ke Hazrat Imam Malik, Imam Auza'i, Imam Laith, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad aur jamhoor-e-ulama ka mazhab hai, aslaf aur mutakhireen ka bhi aur is ki daleel Bukhari-o-Muslim ki yeh hadith bhi hai ke koi aurat kisi aur aurat ke ausaf is tarah apne khawand ke samne bayan na kare ke goya woh usay dekh raha hai. Ek hadith mein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne diyat ke oonton ke ausaf bhi bayan farmaye hain, qatl-e-khata aur woh qatl jo mushaba "amd" ke hai. Haan, Imam Abu Hanifa aur dusre Kufi aur Imam Thauri waghera bai-e-salam ke qail nahin, woh kehte hain ke janwaron ke ausaf-o-ahwal poori tarah zabt nahin ho sakte. Isi tarah ki hikayat Ibn Mas'ood, Huzaifa bin Yaman aur Abdur Rahman bin Samura waghera se bhi ki jati hai.

Is ayat se is masla par bhi istidlal ho sakta hai ke janwaron ko dekhe baghair udhar dena jaiz hai is liye ke sifat ka hasr kar diya gaya aur ausaf pooray bayan kar diye gaye, jaise ke Hazrat Imam Malik, Imam Auza'i, Imam Laith, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad aur jamhoor-e-ulama ka mazhab hai, aslaf aur mutakhireen ka bhi aur is ki daleel Bukhari-o-Muslim ki yeh hadith bhi hai ke koi aurat kisi aur aurat ke ausaf is tarah apne khawand ke samne bayan na kare ke goya woh usay dekh raha hai. Ek hadith mein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne diyat ke oonton ke ausaf bhi bayan farmaye hain, qatl-e-khata aur woh qatl jo mushaba "amd" ke hai. Haan, Imam Abu Hanifa aur dusre Kufi aur Imam Thauri waghera bai-e-salam ke qail nahin, woh kehte hain ke janwaron ke ausaf-o-ahwal poori tarah zabt nahin ho sakte. Isi tarah ki hikayat Ibn Mas'ood, Huzaifa bin Yaman aur Abdur Rahman bin Samura waghera se bhi ki jati hai.

Hujjat-bazi ka anjam Bani Israel ki sarkashi, sartabi aur hukm-e-Allah, Amr-e-Ilahi ki wazahat ke sath ka yahan bayan ho raha hai ke hukm paate hain us par amal na kar dala balke shaqqein nikalne aur baar baar sawal karne lage. Ibn-e-Jurayj farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya hai ke hukm milte hi woh agar kisi gaye ko bhi zibah kar daalte to kaafi tha lekin unhon ne pe-dar-pe sawalat shuru kiye aur kaam mein sakhti barhti gayi yahan tak ke aakhir mein woh Insha'Allah na kehte to kabhi bhi sakhti na talti aur matlooba gaye milna aur mushkil ho jaati. Pehle sawal ke jawab mein kaha gaya ke na to woh burhiya hai na bilkul kam-umar hai, balke darmiyani umar ki hai. Phir dusre sawal ke jawab mein uska rang bayan kiya gaya ke woh zard aur chamakdar rang ki hai jo dekhne walon ke dilon ko bahut pasand aaye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke jo zard jooti pehne woh har qeemat khush-o-khurram rahega aur is jumla se istidlal kiya hai "Tasurrun-Nazireen". Baaz ne kaha hai ke murad sakht siyah rang hai lekin awwal qaul hi sahih hai, haan yeh aur baat hai ke hum yun kahein ke usi ki shokhi aur chamkile-pan se woh misl kaale rang ke lagta tha. Wahab bin Munabbah (R.H) kehte hain uska rang is qadar shokh aur gehra tha ke yeh maloom hota tha goya suraj ki shua'ein us se uth rahi hain. Taurat mein uska rang surkh bayan kiya gaya hai lekin shayad Arabi karne walon ki ghalti hai, Wallahu A'lam. Chunki is rang aur is umar ki gayen bhi unhein bakasrat nazar aayin to unhon ne phir kaha ae Allah ke Nabi! koi aur nishani bhi puchiye taake shuba mit jaye, Insha'Allah ab hamein rasta mil jayega. Agar yeh Insha'Allah na kehte to unhein Qayamat tak pata na chalta aur agar yeh sawalat hi na karte to itni sakhti un par aaid na hoti balke jis gaye ko zibah kar dete kifayat ho jaati. Yeh mazmoon ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hai lekin iski sanad ghareeb hai, sahih baat yahi maloom hoti hai ke yeh Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ka apna kalam hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ab ki martaba uske ausaf bayan kiye gaye ke woh hal mein nahin juti, paani nahin seencha, uske chamre par koi daagh dhabba nahin, yak-rangi hai, saare badan mein kahin dusra rang nahin. Uske haath paon aur kul aaza bilkul durust aur tawana hain. Baaz kehte hain ke woh gaye kaam karne wali nahin, haan kheti ka kaam karti hai lekin paani nahin pilati, magar yeh qaul ghalat hai is liye ke "Zalool" ki tafseer yeh hai ke woh hal nahin jot-ti aur na paani pilati hai, is mein na koi daagh dhabba hai. Ab itni bari kado-kawish ke baad badil-e-nakhwasta woh iski qurbani ki taraf mutawajja hue, isi liye farmaya ke yeh zibah karna nahin chahte the aur zibah na karne ke bahane talash karte the. Kisi ne kaha hai is liye ke unhein apni ruswai ka khayal tha ke na jaane kaun qatil ho, baaz kehte hain uski qeemat sun kar ghabra gaye the, lekin baaz riwayaton mein aaya hai ke kul teen dinar uski qeemat lagi thi, lekin yeh teen dinar wali gaye ke wazan ke barabar sone wali dono riwayatein Bani Israel riwayatein hain.

Ek hadith mein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne diyat ke oonton ke ausaf bhi bayan farmaye hain, qatl-e-khata aur woh qatl jo mushaba "amd" ke hai. Isi tarah ki hikayat Ibn Mas'ood, Huzaifa bin Yaman aur Abdur Rahman bin Samura waghera se bhi ki jati hai.

Bila-wajah tajassus mujib-e-itab hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein "Idara'tum" ke ma'ani tum ne ikhtilaf kiya ke hain. Hazrat Mujahid R.H waghera se bhi yahi marwi hai. Musayyab bin Rafi' kehte hain ke jo shakhs saat gharon mein chup kar bhi koi nek amal karega Allah us ki neki ko zahir kar dega, isi tarah agar koi saat gharon mein ghus kar bhi koi burai karega Allah Ta'ala use bhi zahir kar dega. Phir yeh ayat tilawat ki ayat (Wallaahu mukhrijum maa kuntum taktumoon) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 72). Yahan wahi waqia chacha bhatije ka bayan ho raha hai jis ke ba'is unhein zabiha-e-gao ka hukm hua tha aur kaha jata hai ke us ka koi tukda le kar maqtool ke jism par lagao. Woh tukda kaunsa tha? Is ka bayan to Quran mein nahin hai, na kisi sahih hadith mein aur na hamein us ke maloom hone se koi faida hai aur maloom nahin hone se koi nuqsan hai. Salamat-rawi isi mein hai ke jis cheez ka bayan nahin hum bhi us ki talash-o-taftish mein na padein. Ba'az ne kaha hai ke woh ghizroof ki haddi narm thi, koi kehta hai haddi nahin balkay raan ka gosht tha, koi kehta hai dono shanon ke darmiyan ka gosht tha, koi kehta hai zaban ka gosht, koi kehta hai dum ka gosht waghera, lekin hamari behtari isi mein hai jise Allah Ta'ala ne mubham rakha hai hum bhi mubham hi rakhein. Us tukde ke lagte hi woh murda jee utha aur Allah Ta'ala ne un ke jhagde ka faisla bhi isi se kiya aur Qayamat ke din jee uthne ki daleel bhi isi ko banaya. Isi surat mein paanch jagah marne ke baad jeene ka bayan hua hai. Ek to ayat (Summa ba'asnaakum mim ba'di mautikum la'allakum tashkuroon) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 56) mein aur dusra is qissay mein, teesre un ke qissay mein jo hazaron ki tadaad mein nikle thay aur ek ujaar basti par un ka guzar hua tha, chauthe Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke chaar parindon ke maar dalne ke baad zinda ho jane mein, paanchwein zameen ki murdani ke baad rooyidgi ko maut-o-zeest se tashbeeh dene mein. Abu Dawood Tayalisi ki ek hadith mein hai, Abu Zareen Uqaili ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) murdon ko Allah Ta'ala kis tarah jalaye ga? Farmaya kabhi tum banjar zameen par guzray ho? Kaha haan. Farmaya phir kabhi us ko sarsabz-o-shadab bhi dekha hai? Kaha haan. Farmaya isi tarah maut ke baad zeest hai. Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah hai ayat (Wa aayatul lahumul ardul maytah) (Surah Yaseen: 33).

(Yaseen: 33) Ya'ni in munkireen ke liye murda zameen mein bhi ek nishani hai jise hum zinda karte hain aur is mein se daane nikalte hain jise yeh khate hain aur jis mein hum khajooron aur angooron ke baagh paida karte hain aur charon taraf nehron ki rail-pel kar dete hain taake woh in phalon ko maze-maze se khayein halankeh yeh in ke hathon ka banaya hua ya paida kiya hua nahin, kya phir bhi yeh shukr-guzari na karenge? Is masle par is aayat se istidlal kiya gaya hai aur Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) ke mazhab ko is se taqwiyat pahunchayi gayi hai, is liye maqtool ke jee uthne ke baad us ne daryaft karne par jise qatil bataya use qatl kiya gaya aur maqtool ka qaul bawar kiya gaya, zahir hai ke dam-e-aakhir aisi halat mein insaan umooman sach hi bolta hai aur us waqt is par tohmat nahin lagayi jaati. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain ke ek yahoodi ne ek ladki ka sar patthar par rakh kar dusre patthar se kuchal dala aur us ke kade utaar le gaya, jab is ka pata Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko laga to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya is ladki se pucho ke ise kis ne mara hai. Logon ne puchna shuru kiya ke kya tujhe falan ne mara, falan ne mara? Woh apne sar ke ishare se inkaar karti jaati thi yahan tak ke jab usi yahoodi ka naam aaya to us ne sar ke ishare se kaha haan, chunancha us yahoodi ko giraftar kiya gaya aur ba-israr puchne par us ne iqrar kiya to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne hukum diya ke us ka sar bhi isi tarah do pattharon ke darmiyan kuchal diya jaye aur Imam Malik (R.H) ke nazdeek jab yeh barangikhtagi ke ba'is ho to maqtool ke warison ko qasam khilayi jayegi bator-e-qasama ke, lekin jamhoor is ke mukhalif hain aur maqtool ke qaul ko is baare mein suboot nahin jaante.

Patthar dil log: Is ayat mein Bani Israel ko zajr-o-taubikh ki gayi hai ke is qadar zabardast mojze aur qudrat ki nishaniyan dekh kar phir bhi bahut jald tumhare dil sakht patthar ban gaye. Isi liye iman walon ko is tarah ki sakhti se roka gaya aur kaha gaya ayat (ALAM YA'NI LILLAZINA AMANU AN TAKHSHA'A QULUBUHUM LIZIKRIL LAHI WAMA NAZALA MINAL HAQQI WALA YAKUNU KAL-LAZINA UUTUL KITABA MIN QABLU FATHALA ALAIHIMUL AMADU FAQASAT QULUBUHUM WA KASIRUM MINHUM FASIQUN) (Surah Al-Hadid: 16) yani kya ab tak woh waqt nahin aaya ke iman walon ke dil Allah Ta'ala ke zikr aur Allah ke nazil karda haq se kanp uthein? Aur agle Ahl-e-Kitab ki tarah na ho jayein jin ke dil lamba zamana guzarne ke baad sakht ho gaye aur un mein se aksar fasiq hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke is maqtool ke bhatije ne apne chacha ke dobara zinda hone aur bayan dene ke baad jab mar gaya to kaha ke us ne jhoot kaha aur phir kuch waqt guzar jane ke baad Bani Israel ke dil phir patthar se bhi zyada sakht ho gaye kyunke pattharon se to nahrein nikalti aur behne lagti hain, ba'az patthar phat jate hain un se chahe woh behne ke qabil na hon, ba'az patthar khauf-e-Allah se gir padte hain lekin un ke dil kisi wa'z-o-nasihat se, kisi pand-o-mo'izat se narm hi nahin hote. Yahan se yeh bhi maloom hua ke pattharon mein idraak aur samajh hai aur jagah hai ayat (TUSABBIHU LAHUS-SAMAWATUS-SAB'U WAL ARDU WAMAN FIHINNA WA IN MIN SHAI'IN ILLA YUSABBIHU BIHAMDIHI WALAKIN LA TAFQAHUNA TASBIHAHUM INNAHU KANA HALIMAN GAFURA) (Surah Al-Isra: 44) yani saton aasman aur zameenein aur un ki tamam makhlooq aur har har cheez Allah Ta'ala ki tasbeeh bayan karti hai lekin tum un ki tasbeeh samajhte nahin ho. Allah Ta'ala hilm-o-bardbari wala aur bakhshish-o-afw wala hai. Abu Ali Jabbani ne patthar ke khauf se gir padne ki ta'weel olon ke barasne se ki hai lekin yeh theek nahin, Razi bhi ise ghair durust batlate hain aur filwaq'a yeh ta'weel sahih nahin kyunke is mein lafzi ma'ni bedaleel ko chhodna lazim aaya hai, Wallahu A'lam. Nahrein beh nikalna zyada rona hai. Phat jana aur pani ka nikalna is se kam rona hai, gir padna dil se darna. Ba'az kehte hain yeh majazan kaha gaya jaise aur jagah hai YURIDANI YANQADDA yani deewar gir padna chah rahi thi. Zahir hai ke yeh majaz hai, haqeeqatan deewar ka irada hi nahin hota. Razi, Qurtubi waghera kehte hain aisi ta'weelon ki koi zaroorat nahin, Allah Ta'ala jo sifat jis cheez mein chahe paida kar sakta hai, dekhiye us ka farman hai ayat (INNA ARADNAL AMANATA ALAS-SAMAWATI WAL ARDI WAL JIBALI FA-ABAYNA AY YAHMILNAHA WA ASHFAQNA MINHA WA HAMALAHAL INSANU) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 72).

(Al-Ahzab: 72) Ya'ni hum ne amanat ko aasmanon, zameenon aur paharon ke samne pesh kiya, unhon ne is ke uthane se majboori zahir ki aur dar gaye. Aur aayat guzar chuki ke tamam cheezein Allah Ta'ala ki tasbeeh bayan karti hain aur jagah hai aayat (Wan-najmu wash-shajaru yasjudan) ya'ni akas bail aur darakht Allah Ta'ala ko sajda karte hain aur farmaya (Yataqayya'u zilaluhu) al-aayat aur farmaya aayat (Qalatata ataina taa'i'een) (41. Fussilat: 11) zameen-o-aasman ne kaha hum khushi khushi hazir hain. Aur jagah hai ke pahar bhi Quran se mutasir ho kar dar ke mare phat phat jate aur jagah farman hai aayat (Wa qalu lijuludihim) ya'ni gunahgar log apne jismon se kahenge tum ne hamare khilaf shahadat kyun di? Woh jawab denge ke hum se us Allah ne baat karayi jo har cheez ko bolne ki taqat ata farmata hai. Ek sahih hadith mein hai ke Uhud pahar ki nisbat Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh pahar hum se mohabbat rakhta hai aur hum bhi is se mohabbat rakhte hain. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke jis khajoor ke tane par tek laga kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jumma ka khutba parha karte the, jab mimbar bana aur woh tana hata diya gaya to woh tana phoot phoot kar rone laga. Sahih Muslim Shareef ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main Makkah ke us patthar ko pehchanta hoon jo meri nabuwwat se pehle mujhe salam kiya karta tha. Hajar-e-Aswad ke bare mein hai ke jis ne ise haq ke sath bosa diya hoga yeh is ke iman ki gawahi qayamat wale din de ga aur is tarah ki bahut si aayatein aur hadeesein hain jin se saaf maloom hota hai ke in cheezon mein idraak-o-hiss hai aur yeh tamam baatein haqeeqat par mehmool hain na ke majaz par.

Aayat mein lafz "au" jo hai is ki babat Qurtubi aur Razi to kehte hain ke yeh takhyeer ke liye hai ya'ni un ke dilon ko khwah jaise patthar samajh lo ya is se bhi zyada sakht. Razi ne ek wajah yeh bhi bayan ki hai ke yeh ibham ke liye hai goya mukhatib ke samne bawajood ek baat ka pukhta ilm hone ke do cheezein bator-e-ibham pesh ki ja rahi hain. Ba'az ka qaul hai ke matlab yeh hai ke ba'az dil patthar jaise aur ba'az is se bhi zyada sakht hain, wallahu a'alam. Is lafz ke jo ma'ani yahan par hain woh bhi sun lijiye, is par to ijma hai ke "au" shakk ke liye nahin, ya to yeh ma'ani mein "wao" ke hai ya'ni is ke dil patthar jaise aur is se bhi zyada sakht ho gaye, jaise aayat (Wa la tuti' minhum aathiman au kafoora) (76. Al-Insan: 24) mein aur aayat (Uzran au nuzra) mein shairon ke ash'aar mein aur "wao" ke ma'ani mein jama ke liye aaya hai, ya "au" yahan par ma'ani mein "bal" ya'ni balkeh ke hai, jaise aayat (Ka khashyatillahi au ashaddu khashyah) (4. An-Nisa: 77) mein aur aayat (Wa arsalnahu ila mi'ati alfin au yazeedoon) (37. As-Saffat: 147) mein aur aayat (Fa kana qaba qawsaini au adna) (53. An-Najm: 9).

An-Najm: 9 mein baaz ka qaul hai ke matlab yeh hai ke woh patthar jaise hain ya sakhti mein tumhare nazdeek us se bhi zyada. Baaz kehte hain sirf mukhatib par ibham dala gaya hai aur yeh shairon ke sheron mein bhi paya jata hai ke bawajood pukhta ilm-o-yaqeen ke sirf mukhatib par ibham dalne ke liye aisa kalam karte hain. Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah hai aayat (Wa inna au iyyakum la'ala hudan au fi dalalim mubeen) (Surah Saba: 24) yani hum ya tum saaf hidayat ya khuli gumrahi par hain, toh zahir hai ke musalmanon ka hidayat par hona aur kuffar ka gumrahi par hona yaqeeni cheez hai lekin mukhatib ke ibham ke liye us ke samne kalam-e-mubham bola gaya. Yeh bhi matlab ho sakta hai ke tumhare dil in do se kharij nahin, ya toh woh patthar jaise hain ya us se bhi zyada sakht, yani baaz aise. Is qaul ke mutabiq yeh bhi hai aayat (Kamathalilladhistas-auqada nara) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 17), phir farmaya aayat (Au kasayyib) aur farmaya hai (Kasurab) phir farmaya aayat (Au kazulumat), matlab yahi hai ke baaz aise aur baaz aise, Wallahu A'lam.

Tafsir Ibn Marduyah mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Allah ke zikr ke siwa zyada baatein na kiya karo kyunke kalam ki kasrat dil ko sakht kar deti hai aur sakht dil wala Allah se bahut door ho jata hai. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ne bhi is hadith ko bayan farmaya hai aur is ke ek tareeqe ko ghareeb kaha hai. Bazzar mein Hazrat Anas (R.A) se marfoo'an riwayat hai ke char cheezein badbakhti aur shaqawat ki hain: Khauf-e-Allah se aankhon se aansu na behna, dil ka sakht ho jana, ummeedon ka barh jana, lalchi ban jana.

Yahudi kirdar ka tajziya: Is gumrah qoum Yahood ke iman se Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke sahaba ko na-umeed kar rahe hain. Jab in logon ne itni badi nishaniyan dekh kar bhi apne dil sakht patthar jaise bana liye, Allah Ta'ala ke kalam ko sun kar, samajh kar, phir bhi is ki tahrif aur tabdili kar dali, toh in se tum kya umeed rakhte ho? Theek is ayat ki tarah aur jagah farmaya: (Fa-bima naqdihim misaqahum la'annahum wa ja'alna qulubahum qasiyah) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 13) yani in ki ahd-shikni ki wajah se hum ne in par la'nat ki aur in ke dil sakht kar diye. Yeh Allah ke kalam ko rad-o-badal kar dala karte the. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yahan Allah Ta'ala ne kalam-e-Allah sunne ko farmaya, is se murad Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke sahabiyon ki woh jama'at hai jinhon ne aap se Allah ka kalam apne kanon se sunne ki darkhwast ki thi aur jab woh pak saaf ho kar roza rakh kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke sath Toor pahad par pahunch kar sajde mein gir pade toh Allah Ta'ala ne unhein apna kalam sunaya. Jab yeh wapas aaye aur Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala ka yeh kalam Bani Israel mein bayan karna shuru kiya toh in logon ne is ki tahrif aur tabdili shuru kar di. Suddi farmate hain in logon ne Taurat mein tahrif ki thi. Yehi aam ma'ani theek hain jis mein woh log bhi shamil ho jayenge aur is bad-khaslat wale dusre Yahudi bhi. Quran mein hai: Fa-ajirhu hatta yasma'a kalam-Allah, yani mushrikon mein se koi agar tujh se panah talab kare toh tu use panah de yahan tak ke woh kalam-e-Allah sun le. Toh is se yeh murad nahin ke Allah ka kalam apne kanon se sune, balkay Quran sune, toh yahan bhi kalam-e-Allah se murad Taurat hai. Yeh tahrif karne wale aur chupane wale in ke ulama the. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke jo ausaf in ki kitab mein the, un sab mein unhon ne ta'weelein kar ke asal matlab door kar diya tha. Isi tarah halal ko haram, haram ko halal, haq ko batil, batil ko haq likh diya karte the. Quran mein hai ayat: (Wa qalat ta'ifatum min ahlil-kitabi aminu billazi unzila 'alallazina amanu wajhan-nahari wakfuru akhirahu la'allahum yarji'un) (3. Al-Imran: 72) yani Ahl-e-Kitab ki ek jama'at ne kaha iman walon par jo utra hai is par din ke shuru hissa mein iman lao phir aakhir mein kufr karo taake khud iman wale bhi is deen se phir jayen. Yeh log is fareb se yahan ke raaz maloom karna aur unhein apne walon ko batana chahte the aur musalmanon ko bhi gumrah karna chahte the, magar in ki yeh chalaki na chali aur yeh raaz Allah ne khol diya. Jab yeh yahan hote aur apna iman-e-Islam zahir karte toh sahaba in se puchte kya tumhari kitab mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki basharat waghera nahin? Woh iqrar karte.

Jab apne baron ke paas jaate toh woh unhein daant-te aur kehte apni baatein un se keh kar kyun un ki apni mukhalifat ke hathon mein hathiyar de rahe ho? Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Quraiza wale din Yahudiyon ke qila tale khade ho kar farmaya: "Ae bandar aur khanzeer aur taghoot ke abidon ke bhaiyo!" Toh woh aapas mein kehne lage yeh hamare ghar ki baatein unhein kis ne bata dein? Khabardar apni aapas ki khabrein unhein na do warna unhein Allah ke samne tumhare khilaf dalail muyassar aa jayenge. Ab Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke go tum chupao lekin mujh se toh koi cheez chup nahin sakti. Tum jo chupke chupke apnon se kehte ho ke apni baatein un tak na pahunchao aur apni kitab ki baaton ko chupate ho toh main tumhare is bure kaam se bakhoobi aagah hoon. Tum jo apne imaan ka izhar karte ho, tumhare is elaan ki haqeeqat ka ilm bhi mujhe achi tarah hai.

Ummi ka mafhoom aur Wail ke ma'ani: Ummi ke ma'ani woh shakhs jo achi tarah likhna na jaanta ho, Ummiyun is ki jama hai. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifaton mein ek sifat "Ummi" bhi aayi hai is liye ke aap bhi likhna nahin jaante thay. Quran kehta hai aayat (Wama kunta tatlu min qablihi min kitabin wala takhtuhu biyaminika idhan lartabal mubtilun) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 48) yani tu ae Nabi is se pehle na toh parh sakta na likh sakta tha agar aisa hota toh shayad in baatil paraston ke shuba ki gunjaish ho jaati. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain hum ummi aur anparh log hain na likhna jaanein na hisab, mahina kabhi itna hota hai aur kabhi itna, pehli baar toh aap ne dono hathon ki kul ungliyan teen baar neeche ki taraf jhukayin yani tees din ka do baar aur teesri martaba mein angoothe ka halqa bana liya yani untees din ka, matlab yeh hai ke hamari ibadatein aur un ke waqt hisab-kitab par mauqoof nahin. Quran-e-Kareem ne aur jagah farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne in parhon mein ek Rasool inhi mein se bheja. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain ke is lafz mein be-parhay aadmi ko maa ki taraf mansoob kiya gaya. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se ek riwayat hai ke yahan par "Ummi" nahin kaha gaya hai jinhon ne na toh kisi Rasool ki tasdeeq ki thi na kisi kitab ko maana tha aur apni likhi hui kitabon ko auron se Kitabullah ki tarah manwana chahte thay lekin awwal toh yeh qaul muhawarat-e-Arab ke khilaf hai dusre is qaul ki sanad theek nahin.

Amani ke ma'ani baatein aur aqwal hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai "Kazb", "Aarzoo", "Jhoot" ke ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain. Tilawat aur zahiri alfaaz ke ma'ani bhi marwi hain jaise Quran-e-Majeed mein aur jagah hai aayat (Illa iza tamanna), yahan tilawat ke ma'ani saaf hain. Shu'ara ke sheron mein bhi yeh lafz tilawat ke ma'ani mein hai aur woh sirf gumaan hi par hain yani haqeeqat ko nahin jaante aur is par nahaq ka gumaan karte hain aur oot-patang baatein banate hain. Phir Yahudiyon ki ek dusri qisam ka bayan ho raha hai jo parhay likhay log thay aur gumrahi ki taraf dusron ko bulate thay aur Allah par jhoot bandhte thay aur mureedon ka maal harap karte thay.

Wail ke ma'ani halakat aur barbadi ke hain aur Jahannam ke garhay ka naam bhi hai jis ki aag itni tez hai ke agar is mein pahar daalay jayen toh dhool ho jayen. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ki ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam Wail hai jis mein kafir daalay jayen ge chalis saal ke baad talay mein pahunchein ge itni gehrai hai lekin sanad ke aitbar se yeh hadith ghareeb bhi hai munkar bhi hai aur za'eef bhi hai aur ek ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Jahannam ke ek pahar ka naam Wail hai. Yahudiyon ne Taurat ki tehreef kar di is mein kami ya ziyadati ki.

Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka naam nikal dala is liye Allah ka ghazab un par nazil hua aur Taurat utha li gayi aur Allah Ta'ala ne farma diya ke un ke hathon ke likhay aur un ki kamai barbad aur halak ho. Wail ke ma'ani sakht azab, burai, halakat, afsos, dard, dukh, ranj-o-malal waghera ke bhi aatay hain. Wail, Waih, Waish, Waih, Waik, Waib sab ek hi ma'ani mein hain go ba'az ne in alfaaz ke juda juda ma'ani bhi kiye hain. Lafz Wail nakira hai aur nakira mubtada nahin ban sakta lekin chunke yeh ma'ani mein bad-dua ke hai is liye isay mubtada bana diya gaya hai. Ba'az logon ne isay nasb dena bhi jaiz samjha hai lekin Waila ki qira'at nahin. Yahan Yahudiyon ke ulama ki bhi muzammat ho rahi hai ke woh apni baton ko Allah Ta'ala ka kalam kehte thay aur apne walon ko khush kar ke duniya kamatay thay. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain ke tum Ahl-e-Kitab se kuch bhi kyun pucho? Allah Ta'ala ki taza kitab tumhare hathon mein hai. Ahl-e-Kitab ne to Kitabullah mein tehreef ki, apne hath ki likhi hui baton ko Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki taraf mansoob kar diya, is ki tashheer ki, phir tumhein apni mehfooz kitab ko chhor kar un ki tabdeel karda kitab ki kya zaroorat? Afsos ke woh tum se na poochein aur tum un se daryaft karte phiro. Thoray mol se murad sari duniya mil jaye to bhi aakhirat ke muqablay mein kamtar hai aur jannat ke muqablay mein behad haqeer cheez hai. Phir farmaya ke un ke is fe'l ki wajah se ke woh apni baton ko Allah Rabbul Izzat ki baton ki tarah logon se manwatay hain aur is par duniya kamatay hain, halakat aur barbadi hai.

Wail ke ma'ani sakht azab, burai, halakat, afsos, dard, dukh, ranj-o-malal waghera ke bhi aatay hain. Wail, Waih, Waish, Waih, Waik, Waib sab ek hi ma'ani mein hain go ba'az ne in alfaaz ke juda juda ma'ani bhi kiye hain. Lafz Wail nakira hai aur nakira mubtada nahin ban sakta lekin chunke yeh ma'ani mein bad-dua ke hai is liye isay mubtada bana diya gaya hai. Ba'az logon ne isay nasb dena bhi jaiz samjha hai lekin Waila ki qira'at nahin. Yahan Yahudiyon ke ulama ki bhi muzammat ho rahi hai ke woh apni baton ko Allah Ta'ala ka kalam kehte thay aur apne walon ko khush kar ke duniya kamatay thay. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain ke tum Ahl-e-Kitab se kuch bhi kyun pucho? Allah Ta'ala ki taza kitab tumhare hathon mein hai. Ahl-e-Kitab ne to Kitabullah mein tehreef ki, apne hath ki likhi hui baton ko Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki taraf mansoob kar diya, is ki tashheer ki, phir tumhein apni mehfooz kitab ko chhor kar un ki tabdeel karda kitab ki kya zaroorat? Afsos ke woh tum se na poochein aur tum un se daryaft karte phiro. Thoray mol se murad sari duniya mil jaye to bhi aakhirat ke muqablay mein kamtar hai aur jannat ke muqablay mein behad haqeer cheez hai. Phir farmaya ke un ke is fe'l ki wajah se ke woh apni baton ko Allah Rabbul Izzat ki baton ki tarah logon se manwatay hain aur is par duniya kamatay hain, halakat aur barbadi hai.

Chalis din ka jahannam. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Yahudi log kaha karte the ke duniya ki kul muddat saat hazar saal hai. Har saal ke badle ek din hamain azab hoga to sirf saat din hamain jahannam mein rehna parega. Is qaul ki tardeed mein yeh ayatein nazil huin. Baaz kehte hain yeh log chalis din tak aag mein rehna maante the kyunke un ke baron ne chalis din tak bachre ki puja ki thi. Baaz ka qaul hai ke yeh dhoka unhain is se laga tha ke woh kehte the ke Taurat mein hai ke jahannam ke dono taraf Zaqqoom ke darakht tak chalis saal ka rasta hai to woh kehte the ke is muddat ke baad azab uth jayenge. Ek riwayat mein hai ke unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne aa kar kaha ke chalis din tak to hum jahannam mein rahenge phir dusre log hamari jagah aa jayenge yani aap ki ummat. Aap ne un ke saron par hath rakh kar farmaya nahin balkay tum hi tum hamesha hamesha jahannam mein pare rahoge, is par yeh ayat nazil hui. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain Fatah-e-Khaibar ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein bator-e-hadiya bakri ka paka hua zehar alood gosht aaya. Aap ne farmaya yahan ke Yahudiyon ko jama kar lo. Phir un se pucha tumhara baap kaun hai? Unhon ne kaha fulan. Aap ne farmaya jhoote ho balkay tumhara baap fulan hai. Unhon ne kaha baja irshad hua wahi hamara baap hai. Aap ne farmaya dekho ab main kuch aur puchta hoon sach sach batana. Unhon ne kaha ae Abul Qasim (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar jhoot kahenge to aap ke samne na chal sake ga hum to aazma chuke. Aap ne farmaya batao jahannami kaun log hain? Unhon ne kaha kuch din to hum hain phir aap ki ummat. Aap ne farmaya ghalu hargiz nahin. Phir farmaya acha batlao is gosht mein tum ne zehar milaya hai? Unhon ne kaha haan, agar aap sache hain to yeh zehar aap ko hargiz zarar na de ga aur agar jhoote hain to hum aap se nijat hasil kar lenge. (Musnad-e-Ahmad, Bukhari, Nasai)

Jahannami kaun? Matlab yeh hai ke jis ke a'maal sarasar bad hain jo nekiyon se khaali hai woh jahannami hai aur jo shakhs Allah Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par imaan laye aur sunnat ke mutabiq amal kare woh jannati hai. Jaise ek jagah farmaya aayat (Laisa bi-amaniyyikum wa la amaniyyi ahlil-kitab) (Surah An-Nisa: 123) yani na toh tumhare mansoobay chal sakenge aur na ahl-e-kitab ke, har burai karne wala apni burai ka badla diya jayega aur har bhalai karne wala sawab payega, apni neko-kari ka ajar payega magar bure ka koi madadgar na hoga. Kisi mard ka, aurat ka, bhale aadmi ka koi amal barbad na hoga. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yahan burai se matlab kufr hai aur ek riwayat mein hai ke murad shirk hai. Abu Wa'il, Abul-Aliyah, Mujahid, Ikrimah, Hasan, Qatadah, Rabi' bin Anas waghera se yahi marwi hai. Suddi kehte hain murad kabira gunah hain jo teh-ba-teh ho kar dil ko ganda kar dein. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) waghera farmate hain murad shirk hai jis ke dil par bhi qabiz ho jaye. Rabi' bin Khuthaim ka qaul hai jo gunahon par hi mare aur tauba naseeb na ho. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain gunahon ko haqeer na samjha karo woh jama ho kar insaan ki halakat ka sabab ban jate hain, dekhte nahin ho ke agar kai aadmi ek-ek lakdi le kar aayen toh anbaar lag jata hai, phir agar us mein aag lagai jaye toh badi-badi cheezon ko jala kar khakastar kar deti hai. Phir imandaron ka haal bayan farmaya ke jo tum jaise amal nahin karte balkay tumhare kufr ke muqablay mein un ka imaan pukhta hai, tumhari bad-a'maliyon ke muqablay mein un ke pakeeza a'maal mustahkam hain, unhein abadi rahatein aur hamesha ki maskan jannatein milengi aur Allah ke azaab-o-sawab dono lazawal hain.

Ma'budan-e-Batil se bacho. Bani Israel ko jo hukm-o-ahkam diye gaye aur un se jin cheezon par ahd liya gaya un ka zikr ho raha hai, un ki ahd-shikni ka zikr ho raha hai. Unhein hukm diya gaya tha ke woh tauheed ko tasleem karein, Allah Ta'ala ke siwa kisi dusre ki ibadat na karein. Yeh hukm na sirf Bani Israel ko hi diya gaya balkay tamam makhlooq ko diya gaya hai. Farman hai, Ayat: (Wa ma arsalna min qablika mir-rasulin illa nuhi ilaihi annahu la ilaha illa ana fa'budun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 25). Ya'ni tamam rasoolon ko hum ne yahi hukm diya ke woh elaan kar dein ke qabil-e-ibadat mere siwa aur koi nahin, sab log meri hi ibadat karein. Aur farmaya, Ayat: (Wa laqad ba'asna fi kulli ummatir-rasulan ani'budullaha wajtanibut-taghut) (Surah An-Nahl: 36). Ya'ni hum ne har ummat mein rasool bheja ke Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa dusre ma'budan-e-batil se bacho. Sab se bada haq Allah Ta'ala hi ka hai aur us ke tamam huqooq mein bada haq yahi hai ke us ki ibadat ki jaye aur dusre kisi ki ibadat na ki jaye. Ab huqooq-e-Allah ke baad huqooq-ul-ibad ka bayan ho raha hai. Bandon ke huqooq mein maa-baap ka haq sab se bada hai, isi liye pehle un ka haq bayan kiya gaya hai. Irshad hai, Ayat: (Anishkur li wa liwalidaik) (Surah Luqman: 14). Mera shukr karo aur apne maa-baap ka bhi ehsan maan. Aur jagah farmaya, Ayat: (Wa qada rabbuka...) tere Rab ka faisla hai ke us ke siwa dusre ki ibadat na karo aur maa-baap ke sath ehsan aur sulook karte raho. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) ne pucha, Ya Rasool Allah! Kaun sa amal sab se afzal hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, namaz ko waqt par ada karna. Pucha us ke baad? Farmaya, maa-baap ke sath sulook-o-ehsan karna. Pucha phir kaun sa? Phir Allah ki raah mein jihad karna. Ek aur sahih hadith mein hai, kisi ne pucha, Huzoor! Main kis ke sath achha sulook aur bhalai karoon? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, apni maa ke sath. Pucha phir kis ke sath? Farmaya, apni maa ke sath. Phir pucha kis ke sath? Farmaya, apni maa ke sath. Phir pucha kis ke sath? Farmaya, apne baap ke sath aur qareeb wale ke sath, phir aur qareeb wale ke sath. Ayat mein "La ta'buduna" farmaya is liye ke is mein ba-nisbat "La ta'budu" ke mubalagha zyada hai. "Talab" yeh khabar ma'ni mein hai. Baaz logon ne "An la ta'budu" bhi padha hai. Ubay aur Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke woh "La ta'budu" padhte thay. Yateem un chhotay bachon ko kehte hain jin ka sarparast baap na ho. Miskeen un logon ko kaha jata hai jo apni aur apne baal-bachon ki parwarish aur deegar zarooriyaat puri tarah muhayya na kar sakte hon. Is ki mazeed tashreeh Insha'Allah-ul-Azeem Surah Nisa ki is ma'ni ki ayaat mein aayegi. Phir farmaya, logon ko achhi baatein kaha karo. Ya'ni un ke sath narm-kalami aur kushada peshani ke sath pesh aaya karo, bhali baaton ka hukm aur burai se roka karo. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain, bhalai ka hukm do, burai se roko.

Burd-bari, darguzar aur khataon ki maafi ko apna shiar bana lo, yahi achha khulq hai jise ikhtiyar karna chahiye. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Achhi cheez ko haqeer na samjho, agar aur kuch na ho sake to apne bhaiyon se hanste hue chehre se mulaqat to kar liya karo (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Pas Quran-e-Kareem ne pehle apni ibadat ka hukum diya, phir logon ke sath bhalai karne ka, phir achhi baatein kehne ka, phir baaz ahem cheezon ka zikr bhi kar diya; namaz padho, zakat do. Phir khabar di ke in logon ne ahd-shikni ki aur umooman nafarman ban gaye magar thode se paband-e-ahd rahe. Is ummat ko bhi yahi hukum diya gaya, farmaya: Ayat (Wa'budullaha wa la tushriku bihi shai'an wa bil-walidaini ihsana) (Surah An-Nisa: 36). Allah ki ibadat karo, uske sath kisi ko shareek na karo. Maa-baap ke sath, rishtedaron ke sath, yateemon aur maskeenon ke sath, qarabat-dar padosi ke sath, ajnabi padosi ke sath, ham-mashrab maslak ke sath, musafiron ke sath, laundi ghulamon ke sath, sulook-e-ehsan aur bhalai kiya karo. Yaad rakho takabbur aur fakhr karne walon ko Allah pasand nahin karta. Alhamdulillah ke yeh ummat ba-nisbat aur ummaton ke in farmanon ke manne mein aur in par amal-pira hone mein zyada mazboot sabit hui. Asad bin Wada'a se marwi hai ke woh yahudiyon aur nasraniyon ko salam kiya karte the aur yeh daleel dete the ke farman-e-bari hai: Ayat (Wa qulu lin-nasi husnan wa aqimus-salata wa atuz-zakah) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 83). Lekin yeh asar ghareeb hai aur hadees ke khilaf hai. Hadees mein saaf maujood hai ke yahud-o-nasara ko ibtidaan salam-e-alaik na kiya karo. Wallahu A'lam.

Aus-o-Khazraj aur deegar qabail ko dawat-e-ittehad. Aus aur Khazraj Ansar-e-Madina ke do qabile thay. Islam se pehle in dono qabilo ki aapas mein kabhi banti na thi, hamesha aapas mein jang-o-jidal rehta tha. Madine ke Yahudiyo ke bhi teen qabile thay: Bani Qainuqa, Banu Nazir aur Banu Quraiza. Banu Qainuqa aur Bani Nazir to Khazraj ke tarafdar aur unke bhai-band bane hue thay, Bani Quraiza ka bhai-chara Aus ke sath tha. Jab Aus-o-Khazraj mein jang than jati to Yahudiyo ke yeh teeno giroh bhi apne apne haleef ka sath dete aur un se mil kar unke dushman se ladte. Dono taraf ke Yahudi Yahudiyo ke hath mare bhi jate aur mauqa pa kar ek dusre ke gharo ko bhi ujad dalte, des nikala bhi de diya karte thay aur maal-o-daulat par bhi qabza kar liya karte thay. Jab ladai mauqoof hoti to maghloob fareeq ke qaidiyo ka fidiya de kar chuda lete aur kehte ke hamein Allah Ta'ala ka hukum hai ke hum mein se jab koi qaid ho jaye to hum fidiya de kar chuda lein. Is par Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala unhein farmata hai ke is ki kya wajah ke mere is ek hukum ko to tum ne maan liya lekin main ne kaha tha ke aapas mein kisi ko qatl na karo, gharo se na nikalo, use kyun nahin mante? Kisi hukum par imaan lana aur kisi ke sath kufr karna yeh kahan ki imandari hai? Aayat mein farmaya ke apne khoon na bahao aur apne aap ko apne gharo se na nikalo, yeh is liye ke hum mazhab sare ke sare ek jaan ke manind hain. Hadith mein bhi hai ke tamam imandar dosti, ukhuwwat, sila-rehmi aur raham-o-karam mein ek jism ke misl hain. Kisi ek uzw ke dard se tamam jism betab ho jata hai, bukhar chadh jata hai, rato ki neend uchat ho jati hai. Isi tarah ek Musalman ke liye sare jahan ke Musalmano ko tadap uthna chahiye. Abd-e-Khair kehte hain hum Salman bin Rabia ki mat-huti mein "Bukhar" mein jihad kar rahe thay, muhasra ke baad hum ne is shahar ko fatah kiya jis mein bahut se qaidi bhi mile. Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A) ne in mein se ek Yahudi londi ko saat sau mein khareeda. Raas-ul-Jaloot ke paas jab hum pahunche to Hazrat Abdullah us ke paas gaye aur farmaya yeh londi teri hum-mazhab hai, main ne ise saat sau mein khareeda hai, ab tum ise mujh se khareed lo aur azaad kar do. Us ne kaha bahut achha, main chaudah sau deta hoon. Aap ne farmaya main to char hazar se kam nahin bechunga. Us ne kaha phir main nahin khareedta. Aap ne kaha sun, ya to tu ise khareed warna tera deen jata rahega. Taurat mein likha hua hai ke Banu Israel ka koi bhi shakhs giraftar ho jaye to use khareed kar azaad kiya karo.

Agar woh qaidi ho kar tumhare paas aayen toh fidiya de kar chura liya karo aur unhein un ke ghar se be-ghar bhi na kiya karo. Ab ya toh Taurat ko maan kar use khareed ya Taurat ka munkir hone ka iqrar kar! Woh samajh gaya aur kehne laga aisa maloom hota hai ke tum shayad Abdullah bin Salam ho. Aap ne farmaya haan. Chunancha woh chaar hazaar le aaya, aap ne do hazaar le liye aur do hazaar lota diye. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke Raas-ul-Jaloot Koofa mein tha, yeh un laundiyon ka fidiya nahin deta tha jo Arab se na bachi hon. Is par Hazrat Abdullah ne use Taurat ki yeh aayat sunayi. Garz aayat mein Yahudiyon ki muzammat hai ke woh ahkaam-e-Ilahiya ko jaante hue phir bhi pas-e-pusht daal diya karte the. Amanat daari aur imandaari un se uth chuki thi. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifatein, aap ki nishaniyan, aap ki nabuwat ki tasdeeq, aap ki jaye paidaish, jaye hijrat waghera waghera sab cheezein un ki kitaab mein maujood thin lekin yeh un sab ko chupaye hue the aur itna hi nahin balkeh huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mukhalifat karte the. Isi baais un par dunyawi ruswayi aayi aur kam na hone wale aur daimi aakhirat ka azaab bhi.

Banu Qainuqa aur Bani Nazir to Khazraj ke tarafdar aur unke bhai-band bane hue thay, Bani Quraiza ka bhai-chara Aus ke sath tha.
