Dono taraf ke Yahudi Yahudiyo ke hath mare bhi jate aur mauqa pa kar ek dusre ke gharo ko bhi ujad dalte, des nikala bhi de diya karte thay aur maal-o-daulat par bhi qabza kar liya karte thay. Jab ladai mauqoof hoti to maghloob fareeq ke qaidiyo ka fidiya de kar chuda lete aur kehte ke hamein Allah Ta'ala ka hukum hai ke hum mein se jab koi qaid ho jaye to hum fidiya de kar chuda lein. Is par Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala unhein farmata hai ke is ki kya wajah ke mere is ek hukum ko to tum ne maan liya lekin main ne kaha tha ke aapas mein kisi ko qatl na karo, gharo se na nikalo, use kyun nahin mante? Kisi hukum par imaan lana aur kisi ke sath kufr karna yeh kahan ki imandari hai? Aayat mein farmaya ke apne khoon na bahao aur apne aap ko apne gharo se na nikalo, yeh is liye ke hum mazhab sare ke sare ek jaan ke manind hain. Hadith mein bhi hai ke tamam imandar dosti, ukhuwwat, sila-rehmi aur raham-o-karam mein ek jism ke misl hain. Kisi ek uzw ke dard se tamam jism betab ho jata hai, bukhar chadh jata hai, rato ki neend uchat ho jati hai. Isi tarah ek Musalman ke liye sare jahan ke Musalmano ko tadap uthna chahiye. Abd-e-Khair kehte hain hum Salman bin Rabia ki mat-huti mein "Bukhar" mein jihad kar rahe thay, muhasra ke baad hum ne is shahar ko fatah kiya jis mein bahut se qaidi bhi mile. Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A) ne in mein se ek Yahudi londi ko saat sau mein khareeda. Raas-ul-Jaloot ke paas jab hum pahunche to Hazrat Abdullah us ke paas gaye aur farmaya yeh londi teri hum-mazhab hai, main ne ise saat sau mein khareeda hai, ab tum ise mujh se khareed lo aur azaad kar do. Us ne kaha bahut achha, main chaudah sau deta hoon. Aap ne farmaya main to char hazar se kam nahin bechunga. Us ne kaha phir main nahin khareedta. Aap ne kaha sun, ya to tu ise khareed warna tera deen jata rahega. Taurat mein likha hua hai ke Banu Israel ka koi bhi shakhs giraftar ho jaye to use khareed kar azaad kiya karo.

Agar woh qaidi ho kar tumhare paas aayen toh fidiya de kar chura liya karo aur unhein un ke ghar se be-ghar bhi na kiya karo. Ab ya toh Taurat ko maan kar use khareed ya Taurat ka munkir hone ka iqrar kar! Woh samajh gaya aur kehne laga aisa maloom hota hai ke tum shayad Abdullah bin Salam ho. Aap ne farmaya haan. Chunancha woh chaar hazaar le aaya, aap ne do hazaar le liye aur do hazaar lota diye. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke Raas-ul-Jaloot Koofa mein tha, yeh un laundiyon ka fidiya nahin deta tha jo Arab se na bachi hon. Is par Hazrat Abdullah ne use Taurat ki yeh aayat sunayi. Garz aayat mein Yahudiyon ki muzammat hai ke woh ahkaam-e-Ilahiya ko jaante hue phir bhi pas-e-pusht daal diya karte the. Amanat daari aur imandaari un se uth chuki thi. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifatein, aap ki nishaniyan, aap ki nabuwat ki tasdeeq, aap ki jaye paidaish, jaye hijrat waghera waghera sab cheezein un ki kitaab mein maujood thin lekin yeh un sab ko chupaye hue the aur itna hi nahin balkeh huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mukhalifat karte the. Isi baais un par dunyawi ruswayi aayi aur kam na hone wale aur daimi aakhirat ka azaab bhi.

Khud-parast Israeli, Bani Israel ke inaad-o-takabbur aur un ki khwahish-parasti ka bayan ho raha hai ke Taurat mein tahrif-o-tabaddul kiya, Hazrat Musa A.S ke baad unhi ki shariat par aane wale ambiya ki bhi mukhalifat ki. Chunancha farmaya aayat (Inna anzalnat-Taurata fiha hudan wa noor) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 44) yani hum ne Taurat nazil farmayi jis mein hidayat aur noor tha, jis par ambiya khud bhi amal karte aur Yahudiyon ko bhi un ke ulama aur darwesh un par amal karne ka hukum karte the. Garz pay-dar-pay yakay-baad-deegaray ambiya-e-kiram Bani Israel mein aate rahe yahan tak ke yeh silsila Isa A.S par khatam hua. Unhein Injeel mili jis mein ba'az ahkam Taurat ke khilaf bhi the, isi liye unhein naye naye mojizaat bhi mile, jaise murdon ko bahukum-e-Rabbul-Izzat zinda kar dena, mitti se parind bana kar us mein phoonk maar kar bahukum-e-Rabbul-Izzat uda dena, beemaron ko apne dam-jhaare se Rabbul-Izzat ke hukum se achha kar dena, ba'az ba'az ghaib ki khabrein Rabbul-Izzat ke maloom karane se dena wagaira. Aap ki ta'eed par Rooh-ul-Qudus yani Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ko laga diya, lekin Bani Israel apne kufr aur takabbur mein aur barh gaye aur zyada hasad karne lage aur un tamam ambiya-e-kiram ke sath bure sulook se pesh aaye. Kahin jhutlate aur kahin maar daalte the, mehez is bina par ke ambiya ki taleem un ki tabiyaton ke khilaf hua karti thi, un ki raye aur un ke qayasat aur un ke banaye hue usool-o-ahkam un ki qubooliyat se takrate the, is liye dushmani par tul jaate the. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas, Muhammad bin Ka'ab, Ismail bin Khalid, Suddi, Rabee bin Anas, Atiya Aufi aur Qatada wagaira ka qaul yahi hai ke Rooh-ul-Qudus se murad Hazrat Jibraeel A.S hain, jaise Quran-e-Sharif mein aur jagah hai aayat (Nazala bihir-Roohul-Ameen) (26. Ash-Shu'ara: 193) yani ise lekar Rooh-e-Ameen utre hain. Sahih Bukhari mein ta'leeqan marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Hassan shair ke liye masjid mein mimbar rakhwaya, woh mushrikeen ki hajv ka jawab dete the aur aap un ke liye dua karte the ke Aye Allah Azzawajal Hassan ki madad Rooh-ul-Qudus se farma, jaise ke yeh tere Nabi ki taraf se jawab dete hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Hassan R.A khilafat-e-Faruqi ke zamane mein ek martaba Masjid-e-Nabvi mein kuch ashaar parh rahe the, Hazrat Umar R.A ne aap ki taraf tez nigahain uthayin to aap ne farmaya: Main to is waqt bhi in sher'on ko yahan parhta tha jab yahan tum se behtar shakhs maujood the. Phir Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ki taraf dekh kar farmaya: Abu Huraira! Tumhein Allah ki qasam, kya tum ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ko yeh farmate nahin suna? Ke aye Hassan! Tu mushrikon ke ashaar ka jawab de, aye Allah Ta'ala! Tu Hassan ki ta'eed Rooh-ul-Qudus se kar.

Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne farmaya haan Allah ki qasam main ne Huzoor ﷺ se yeh suna hai. Baaz riwayaton mein yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya, "Hassan! Tum in mushrikeen ki hajo karo, Jibraeel A.S bhi tumhare saath hain." Hazrat Hassan R.A ke sher mein bhi Jibraeel A.S ko Rooh-ul-Qudus kaha gaya hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke jab Yahudiyon ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se rooh ki babat poocha toh Aap ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tumhein Allah ki qasam, Allah ki naimaton ko yaad kar ke kaho, kya khud tumhein maloom nahin ke woh Jibraeel A.S hain aur wohi mere paas bhi wahi late hain?" In sab ne kaha, "Beshak." (Ibn Ishaq). Ibn-e-Hibban mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain, "Jibraeel A.S ne mere dil mein dala ke koi shakhs apni rozi aur zindagi poori kiye baghair nahin marta. Allah Ta'ala se darte raho aur duniya kamane mein deen ka khayal rakho."

Baaz ne Rooh-ul-Qudus se murad Ism-e-Azam liya hai, baaz ne kaha hai farishton ka ek sardar farishta hai, baaz kehte hain Qudus se murad Allah Ta'ala aur Rooh se murad Jibraeel A.S hai. Kisi ne kaha hai Qudus yani barkat, kisi ne kaha hai paak, kisi ne kaha hai Rooh se murad Injeel hai, jaise farmaya ayat (Wa kazalika auhaina ilaika roohan min amrina) (Surah Ash-Shura: 52) yani isi tarah hum ne teri taraf rooh ki wahi apne hukum se ki. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ka faisla yahi hai ke yahan murad Rooh-ul-Qudus se Hazrat Jibraeel A.S hain, jaise aur jagah hai, "Iz ayyad-taka bi Rooh-il-Qudus" al-kh. Is ayat mein Rooh-ul-Qudus ki ta'eed ke zikr ke saath kitab-o-hikmat, Taurat-o-Injeel ke sikhane ka bayan hai, maloom hua ke yeh aur cheez hai aur woh aur cheez. Alawa azeen rawani-e-ibarat bhi is ki ta'eed karti hai. Qudus se murad muqaddas hai, jaise Hatim-e-Jood aur Rajul-e-Sidq mein. Rooh-ul-Qudus kehne mein aur Rooh-e-Minhu kehne mein qurbat aur buzurgi ki ek khusoosiyat payi jati hai. Yeh is liye bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh rooh murdon ki peethon aur haiz wale rehamon se be-taluq rahi hai. Baaz mufassireen ne is se murad Hazrat Isa A.S ki pakeeza rooh li hai.

Phir farmaya ke ek firqe ko tum ne jhutlaya aur ek firqe ko tum qatl karte ho. Jhutlane mein mazi ka seegha laye lekin qatl mein mustaqbil ka, is liye ke un ka haal ayat ke nuzool ke waqt bhi yahi raha. Chunancha Huzoor ﷺ ne apne marz-ul-maut mein farmaya ke is zehar-alood luqme ka asar barabar mujh par raha jo main ne Khyber mein khaya tha, us waqt is ne ruk ruk kar jaan kaat di.

Ghuluf ke ma'ani: Yahudiyon ka ek qaul yeh bhi tha ke hamare dilon par ghilaf hain, ya'ni yeh ilm se bharpoor hain, ab hamein naye ilm ki koi zaroorat nahin. Is liye jawab mila ke ghilaf nahin balkay la'nat-e-Ilahiya ki mohar lag gayi hai, imaan naseeb hi nahin hota. Ghuluf ko ghuluf bhi parha gaya hai, ya'ni yeh ilm ke bartan hain. Aur jagah Quran-e-Kareem mein hai, aayat: (Wa qalu qulubuna fi akinnatim mimma tad'una ilaihi wa fi azanina waqrun wa mim bainina wa bainika hijabun fa'mal innana 'amilun) (Surah Fussilat: 5). Ya'ni jis cheez ki taraf tum hamein bula rahe ho us cheez se hamare dil parde aur aar mein hain aur hamare dilon ke darmiyan parda hai, aar hai. In par mohar lagi hui hai, woh ise nahin samajhte. Isi bina par woh na is ki taraf mail hote hain na ise yaad rakhte hain. Ek hadith mein bhi hai ke ba'z dil ghilaf wale hote hain jin par Allah Ta'ala ka ghazab hota hai, yeh kuffar ke dil hote hain. Surah Nisa mein bhi ek aayat isi ma'ani ki hai, aayat: (Wa qalu qulubuna ghulfun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 88). Thoda imaan lane ke ek ma'ani to yeh hain ke in mein se bahut kam log imandar hain aur dusre ma'ani yeh bhi hain ke un ka imaan bahut kam hai, ya'ni Qayamat, sawab, azab waghera ka qail. Hazrat Musa A.S par imaan rakhne wale Taurat ko Allah Ta'ala ki kitab mante hain magar is Paighambar-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko maan kar apna imaan poora nahin karte balkay Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath kufr kar ke is thode imaan ko bhi gharat aur barbad kar dete hain. Teesre ma'ani yeh hain ke yeh sire se be-imaan hain kyunke Arabi zaban mein aise mauqa par bhi aise alfaaz bole jate hain, maslan: main ne is jaisa bahut hi kam dekha, matlab yeh hai ke dekha hi nahin. Wallahu A'lam.

Inkar ka sabab: Jab kabhi Yahudiyon aur Arab ke mushrikeen ke darmiyan ladai hoti toh Yahud kaha karte the ke anqareeb Allah Ta'ala ki sachi kitab le kar Allah Azzawajal ke ek azeem-ush-shan paighambar tashreef lane wale hain, hum un ke sath mil kar tumhein aisa qatl-o-gharat karenge ke tumhara naam-o-nishan mit jayega. Allah Ta'ala se duayein kiya karte the, kaha: Aye Allah! Tu is Nabi ko jald bhej jis ki sifatein hum Taurat mein padhte hain taake hum un par iman la kar un ke sath mil kar apna bazu mazboot kar ke Tere dushmanon se inteqam lein. Mushrikon se kaha karte the ke is Nabi ka zamana ab bilkul qareeb aa gaya hai, lekin jis waqt Huzoor (ﷺ) mab'oos hue, tamam nishaniyan aap mein dekh lein. Pehchan bhi liya, dil se qail bhi ho gaye, magar chunke aap Arab mein se the, hasad kiya aur aap ki nabuwwat se inkar kar diya aur Allah Ta'ala ke la'nat yafta ho gaye. Balkeh woh mushrikeen-e-Madina jo un se Nabi (ﷺ) ki aamad ke bare mein sunte chale aate the, unhein toh iman naseeb hua aur bil-akhir Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sath mil kar woh Yahud par ghalib aa gaye. Ek martaba Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A), Hazrat Bashir bin Bara (R.A), Hazrat Dawood bin Salma (R.A) ne un Yahud-e-Madina se kaha bhi ke tum toh hamare shirk ki halat mein hum se Huzoor (ﷺ) ki nabuwwat ka zikr kiya karte the, balkeh hamein daraya karte the aur ab jab ke woh aam ausaf jo tum Hazrat (ﷺ) ke bayan karte the woh tamam ausaf aap mein hain, phir tum khud iman kyun nahin late? Aap ka sath kyun nahin dete? Toh Salam bin Mishkam ne jawab diya ke hum un ke bare mein nahin kehte the. Isi ka zikr is ayat mein hai ke pehle toh maante the, muntazir bhi the, lekin aap (ﷺ) ke aane ke baad hasad aur takabbur se apni riyasat ke khoye jaane ke darr se saaf inkar kar baithe.

Bura ho hasad ka matlab yeh hai ke in Yahudiyon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq ke badle takzeeb ki aur Aap par imaan lane ke badle kufr kiya. Aap ki nusrat-o-imdad ke badle mukhalifat aur dushmani ki, is wajah se apne aap ko jis ghazab-e-Ilahi ka sazawari banaya woh badtareen cheez hai jo behtareen cheez ke badle unhon ne li aur is ki wajah se siwaye hasad-o-bughz, takabbur-o-inaad ke aur kuch nahin. Chunki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ke qabeela mein se na thay balkay Aap Arab mein se thay is liye yeh munh mor kar baith gaye halankeh Allah par koi hakim nahin, woh risalat ke haq-dar ko khoob janta hai, woh apna fazl-o-karam apne jis banday ko chahe ata farmata hai. Pas ek toh Taurat ke ahkaam ki pabandi na karne ki wajah se un par ghazab nazil hua, dusra Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath kufr karne ke sabab nazil hua. Ya yun samajh lijiye ke pehla ghazab Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko paighambar na manne ki wajah se aur dusra ghazab Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko paighambar tasleem na karne ke sabab. Suddi ka khayal hai ke pehla ghazab bachray ke poojne ke sabab tha, dusra ghazab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mukhalifat ki bina par. Chunki yeh hasad-o-bughz ki wajah se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat se munkir hue thay aur is hasad-o-bughz ka asli baais un ka takabbur tha, is liye unhein zaleel azabon mein mubtala kar diya gaya taake gunah ka badla pura ho jaye. Jaise farman hai aayat: (Innal-lazina yastakbiruna an ibadati sayadkhuluna jahannama dakhirin) (Surah Ghafir: 60) "Meri ibadat se jo bhi takabbur karenge woh zaleel ho kar jahannam mein dakhil honge." Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Mutakabbir logon ka hashr qayamat ke din insani surat mein chiyuntiyon ki tarah hoga jinhein tamam cheezein rondti hui chalengi aur jahannam ke "Bulas" nami qaid khanay mein daal diye jayenge jahan ki aag dusri tamam aagon se tez hogi aur jahannumiyon ka lahu peep waghera unhein pilaya jayega.

Khud pasand Yahudi mored-e-itaab, yani jab un se Quran par aur Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman par imaan lane ko kaha jata hai toh keh dete hain ke hamein Taurat-o-Injeel par imaan rakhna kaafi hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke yeh is mein bhi jhoote hain. Quran toh un kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wala hai aur khud un ki kitabon mein bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq majood hai, jaise farmaya aayat: (Allazina atainahumul kitaba ya'rifunahu kama ya'rifuna abna'ahum) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 146), yani Ahl-e-Kitab aap ko is tarah jante hain jis tarah apni aulad ko pehchante hain. Pas aap se inkaar ka matlab Taurat-o-Injeel se bhi inkaar ke mutaradif hai. Is hujjat ko qaim kar ke ab dusri tarah hujjat qaim ki jati hai ke achha Taurat aur Injeel par agar tumhara imaan hai phir agle ambiya jo inhi ki tasdeeq aur tabedari karte hue baghair kisi nayi shariat aur nayi kitab ke aaye toh tum ne unhein qatl kyun kiya? Maloom hua ke tumhara imaan na toh is kitab par hai na us kitab par. Tum mehez khwahish ke bande, nafs ke ghulam, apni raye-o-qiyas ke ghulam ho. Phir farmaya ke achha Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se toh tum ne bade bade mojize dekhe; toofan, tiddiyan, juyen, mendak, khoon waghera jo un ki bad-dua se bator-e-mojize zahir hue, lakdi ka saanp ban jana, haath ka roshan chand ban jana, darya ko cheer dena aur paani ko patthar ki tarah bana dena, badalon ka saya karna, Mann-o-Salwa ka utarna, patthar se nehrein jaari karna waghera tamam bade bade mojizaat jo un ki nabuwwat ki aur Allah ki tauheed ki roshan daleelein thin, sab apni aankhon se dekhein lekin udhar Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Toor pahad par gaye udhar tum ne bachhde ko Allah bana liya. Ab batao ke khud Taurat par aur khud Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) par bhi tumhara imaan kahan gaya? Kya yeh badkariyan tumhein zalim kehlwane wali nahin? 'Min ba'dihi' se murad Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke Toor par jane ke baad hai. Dusri jagah irshad hai aayat: (Wattakhaza qaumu Musa) al-aayat, yani Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke Toor par jane ke baad aap ki qaum ne bachhde ko mabood bana liya aur apni jaanon par is gausala parasti se wazeh zulm kiya, jis ka ehsas baad mein khud unhein bhi hua jaise farmaya aayat: (Wa lamma suqita fi aidihim), yani jab unhein hosh aaya, nadim hue aur apni gumrahi ko mehsoos karne lage, us waqt kaha: Aye Allah! Agar tu hum par raham na kare aur hamari khata na bakhshe toh hum ziyan-kaar ho jayenge.

Sada-e-Bazgasht: Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala Bani Israel ki khatayen, mukhalifatein, sarkashi aur haq se ro-gardani bayan farma raha hai ke Toor pahar jab saron par dekha to iqrar kar liya, jab woh hat gaya to phir munkir ho gaye. Is ki tafsir bayan ho chuki hai. Bachhray ki mohabbat un ke dilon mein rach gayi. Jaise ke hadith mein hai ke kisi cheez ki mohabbat insan ko andha behra bana deti hai. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne us bachhray ke tukray tukray kar ke, jala kar, us ki raakh ko hawa mein ura kar darya mein daal diya tha, jis pani ko Bani Israel ne pee liya aur us ka asar un par zahir hua. Go bachhra neest-o-nabood kar diya gaya lekin un ke dilon ka talluq ab bhi us mabood-e-batil se laga raha. Dusri ayat ka matlab yeh hai ke tum iman ka dawa kis tarah karte ho? Apne iman par nazar nahin daalte? Baar baar ki ahd-shikniyan, kayi baar ke kufr bhool gaye? Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke samne tum ne kufr kiya, un ke baad ke paighambaron ke sath tum ne sarkashi ki, yahan tak ke Afzal-ul-Anbiya, Khatam-ul-Mursaleen Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) ki nabuwwat ko bhi na mana jo sab se bara kufr hai.

Mubahala aur Yahudi ma'a Nasara. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke in Yahudiyon ko Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka zabani paigham diya gaya ke agar tum sache ho to muqabla mein aao hum tum mil kar Allah Ta'ala se dua karein ke woh hum mein se jo jhoota hai use halak kar de. Lekin sath hi peshingoi bhi kar di ke yeh log hargiz is par amada nahin honge, chunancha yahi hua ke yeh log muqabla par na aaye is liye ke woh dil se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aur aasmani kitab Quran-e-Kareem ko sacha jante the. Agar yeh log is elaan ke mat-hat muqabla mein nikalte to sab ke sab halak ho jate. Roo-e-zameen par ek Yahudi bhi baqi na rehta. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi aaya hai ke agar Yahudi muqabla par aate aur jhoote ke liye maut talab karte to sab ke sab mar jate aur apni jagah jahannam mein dekh lete. Isi tarah jo Nasrani aap ke paas aaye the woh bhi agar Mubahala ke liye tayyar hote to woh laut kar apne ahl-o-ayal aur maal-o-daulat ka naam-o-nishan bhi na paate (Musnad Ahmad). Surah Jumu'ah mein bhi isi tarah ki dawat unhein di gayi hai, aayat (Qul ya ayyuhallazina hadu in za'amtum annakum auliya'u lillahi min dunin-nasi fatamannawul-mauta in kuntum sadiqin) (62. Al-Jumu'ah: 6) aakhir tak parhiye. Un ka dawa tha ke aayat (Nahnu abna'ullahi wa ahibba'uhu) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 18) hum to Allah ki aulad aur us ke pyare hain, yeh kaha karte the aayat (Lan yadkhulal-jannata illa man kana hudan au nasara) (2. Al-Baqarah: 111) jannat mein sirf Yahudi aur Nasara hi jayenge. Is liye unhein kaha gaya ke aao is ka faisla is tarah kar lein ke dono fareeq maidan mein nikal kar Allah se dua karein ke woh jhoote ko halak kar de, lekin chunke is jamaat ko apne jhoot ka ilm tha is liye tayyar na hui aur un ka kizb sab par khul gaya. Isi tarah jab Najran ke Nasrani Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye, behs-o-mubahisa ho chuka to un se bhi yahi kaha gaya ke aayat (Ta'alau nad'u abna'ana wa abna'akum wa nisa'ana wa nisa'akum wa anfusana wa anfusakum summa nabtahil fanaj'al la'natallahi 'alal-kazibin) (3. Aali Imran: 61) aao hum tum dono apni apni auladon, biwiyon ko le kar niklein aur Allah Ta'ala se dua karein ke woh jhooton par apni la'nat nazil farmaye. Lekin woh aapas mein kehne lage ke hargiz is Nabi se Mubahala na karo, foran barbad ho jaoge. Chunancha Mubahala se inkar kar diya, jhuk kar sulah kar li aur dab kar jizya dena manzoor kar liya. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) ko un ke sath ameen bana kar bhej diya. Isi tarah Mushrikeen-e-Arab se bhi kaha gaya aayat (Man kana fid-dalalati falyamdud lahur-Rahmanu maddan) (19. Maryam: 75).

(Maryam: 75) Ya'ni hum mein se jo gumrah ho Allah Ta'ala us ki gumrahi barha de, is ki poori tafsir is ayat ke sath bayan hogi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Mandarja bala ayat ki tafsir mein ek marjoo' qaul yeh bhi hai ke tum khud apne janon ke liye maut talab karo kyunke baqol tumhare akhirat ki bhala'iyan sirf tumhare liye hi hain, unhon ne is se inkar kiya lekin yeh qaul kuch dil ko nahin lagta. Is liye ke bahut se achhe aur nek aadmi bhi zindagi chahte hain, balkeh hadith mein hai ke tum mein se behtar woh hai jis ki lambi umr hui ho aur a'maal achhe hon. Alawa azeen yahi qaul yahudi bhi keh sakte the to baat faisla kun na hoti. Theek tafsir wahi hai jo pehle bayan hui ke dono fareeq mil kar jhoot ki halakat aur us ki maut ki dua karein aur is elaan ke sunte hi yahood to thande par gaye aur tamam logon par un ka jhoot khul gaya aur woh peshgo'i bhi sachi sabit hui ke yeh log hargiz maut talab nahin karenge. Is mubahila ka naam istilah mein tamanni rakha gaya kyunke har fareeq batil parast ki maut ki aarzoo karta hai.

Phir farmaya ke yeh to mushrikeen se bhi zyada taweel umr ke khwahan hain kyunke kuffar ke liye duniya jannat hai aur un ki tamanna aur koshish hai ke yahan zyada rahein. Khwaja Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain munafiq ko hayat-e-duniyawi ki hirs kafir se bhi zyada hoti hai. Yeh yahudi to ek ek hazar saal ki umrein chahte hain halankeh itni lambi umr bhi unhein un azabon se nijat nahin de sakti. Chunkeh kuffar ko to akhirat par yaqeen hi nahin hota magar inhein yaqeen to tha lekin un ki apni siyah kariyan bhi un ke samne thin is liye maut se bahut zyada darte the. Lekin Iblees ke barabar bhi umr pa li to kya hua, azab se to nahin bach sakte. Allah Ta'ala un ke a'maal se bekhabar nahin, tamam bandon ke tamam bhale bure a'maal ko woh bakhoobi janta hai aur waisa hi badla de ga.

Khasumat-e-Jibraeel A.S Maujib-e-Kufr-o-Isyan. Imam Jafar Tabari R.H farmate hain is par tamam mufassireen ka ittefaq hai ke jab Yahudiyon ne Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ko apna dushman aur Hazrat Mikaeel A.S ko apna dost bataya tha us waqt un ke jawab mein yeh aayat nazil hui lekin baaz kehte hain ke Amr-e-Nabuwwat ke bare mein jo guftagu un ki Huzoor ﷺ se hui thi us mein unhon ne yeh kaha tha. Baaz kehte hain Umar bin Khattab R.A se un ka jo munazra Huzoor ﷺ ki nabuwwat ke bare mein hua tha us mein unhon ne yeh kaha tha. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Yahudiyon ki ek jamaat Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ke paas aayi aur kaha ke hum aap se chand sawal karte hain jin ke sahih jawab nabi ke siwa aur koi nahin janta agar aap sache nabi hain to un ke jawabat dijiye. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya behtar hai jo chaho pucho magar ahd karo ke agar main theek theek jawab doon ga to tum meri nabuwwat ka iqrar kar loge aur meri farmanbardari ke paband ho jaoge. Unhon ne aap se wada kiya aur ahd diya. Is ke baad aap ne Hazrat Yaqub A.S ki tarah Allah Jalla Shanahu ki shahadat ke sath un se pukhta wada le kar unhein sawal karne ki ijazat di, unhon ne kaha pehle to yeh bataye ke Taurat nazil hone se pehle Hazrat Israel A.S ne apne nafs par kis cheez ko haram kiya tha? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya jab Hazrat Yaqub A.S irq-un-nisa ki bimari mein sakht bimar hue to nazr mani ke agar Allah mujhe is marz se shifa de to main apni khane ki sab se zyada marghoob cheez aur sab se zyada mehboob cheez peene ki chhod doon ga. Jab tandurust ho gaye to oont ka gosht khana aur oontni ka doodh peena jo aap ko pasand-e-khatir tha chhod diya, tumhein Allah ki qasam jis ne Hazrat Musa A.S par Taurat utari batao yeh sach hai? Un sab ne qasam kha kar kaha ke haan Huzoor ﷺ sach hai. Baja irshad hua achha ab hum puchte hain ke aurat mard ke pani ki kya kaifiyat hai? Aur kyun kabhi ladka paida hota hai aur kabhi ladki? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya suno mard ka pani gadha aur safed hota hai aur aurat ka pani patla aur zardi mail hota hai jo bhi ghalib aa jaye usi ke mutabiq paidaish hoti hai aur shabih bhi. Jab mard ka pani aurat ke pani par ghalib aa jaye to hukm-e-Ilahi se aulad-e-narina hoti hai aur jab aurat ka pani mard ke pani par ghalib aa jaye to hukm-e-Ilahi se aulad ladki hoti hai tumhein Allah Ta'ala ki qasam jis ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq nahin sach batao mera jawab sahih hai? Sab ne qasam kha kar kaha beshak aap ne baja irshad farmaya. Aap ﷺ ne in do baton par Allah Ta'ala ko gawah banaya. Unhon ne kaha achha yeh farmaye ke Taurat mein jis Nabi-e-Ummi ki khabar hai us ki khas nishani kya hai? Aur us ke paas kaun sa farishta wahi le kar aata hai? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya is ki khas nishani yeh hai ke is ki aankhein jab soyi hui hon us waqt mein is ka dil jagta rehta hai tumhein us Rabb ki qasam jis ne Hazrat Musa A.S ko Taurat di batao to main ne theek jawab diya? Sab ne qasam kha kar kaha aap ne bilkul sahih jawab diya.

Ab hamare is sawal ki dusri shaq ka jawab bhi inayat farma dijiye isi par behas ka khatma hai. Aap ne farmaya mera wali Jibraeel hai wohi mere paas wahi lata hai aur wahi tamam Anbiya-e-Kiram ke paas paigham-e-Bari Ta'ala lata raha. Sach kaho aur qasam kha kar kaho ke mera yeh jawab bhi durust hai? Unhon ne qasam kha kar kaha ke jawab toh durust hai lekin chunke Jibraeel hamara dushman hai woh sakhti aur khoon-rezi waghera le kar aata rehta hai is liye hum is ki nahin manenge na aap ki manenge, haan agar aap ke paas Hazrat Mikaeel wahi le kar aate jo rahmat, barish, paidawar waghera le kar aate hain aur hamare dost hain toh hum aap ki tabedari aur tasdeeq karte is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke unhon ne yeh bhi sawal kiya tha ke Ra'ad kya cheez hai? Aap ne farmaya woh ek farishta hai jo badalon par muqarrar hai jo Allah Ta'ala ke hukum ke mutabiq unhein idhar udhar le jata hai. Unhon ne kaha yeh garaj ki aawaz kya hai? Aap ne farmaya yeh isi farishtay ki aawaz hai mulahiza ho Musnad-e-Ahmad waghera. Sahih Bukhari ki ek riwayat mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madina mein tashreef laye us waqt Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) apne bagh mein thay aur yahoodiyat par qaim thay. Unhon ne jab aap ki aamad ki khabar suni toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas hazir hue aur kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh farmaye ke Qayamat ki pehli shart kya hai? Aur jannatiyon ka pehla khana kya hai? Aur kaunsi cheez bacha ko kabhi maa ki taraf kheenchti hai aur kabhi baap ki taraf, aap ne farmaya in teenon sawalon ke jawab abhi abhi Jibraeel ne mujhe batlaye hain suno, Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam ne kaha woh toh hamara dushman hai. Aap ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi phir farmaya pehli nishani Qayamat ki ek aag hai jo logon ke peeche lagegi aur unhein mashriq se maghrib ki taraf ikatha kar degi. Jannatiyon ki pehli khorak machli ki kaleji bator-e-ziyafat hogi. Jab mard ka pani aurat ke pani par sabqat kar jata hai toh larka paida hota hai aur jab aurat ka pani mard ke pani se sabqat le jata hai toh larki hoti hai yeh jawab sunte hi Hazrat Abdullah musalman ho gaye aur pukar uthay hadith (Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa annaka rasulullah) phir kehne lage Huzoor yahoodi baray bewaqoof log hain. Agar unhein mera Islam lana pehle maloom ho jayega toh woh mujhe kahenge aap pehle unhein zara qail kar lijiye. Is ke baad aap ke paas jab yahoodi aaye toh aap ne un se poocha ke Abdullah bin Salam tum mein kaise shakhs hain? Unhon ne kaha baray buzurg aur danishwar aadmi hain buzurgon ki aulad mein se hain woh toh hamare sardar hain aur sardaron ki aulad mein se hain aap ne farmaya achha agar woh musalman ho jayen phir toh tumhein Islam qabool karne mein koi tamul toh nahin hoga? Kehne lage Auzubillah Auzubillah woh musalman hi kyun hone lage? Hazrat Abdullah jo ab tak chhupe hue thay bahar aa gaye aur zor se kalma parha. Toh tamam ke tamam shor machane lage ke yeh khud bhi bura hai is ke baap dada bhi buray thay yeh bara neeche darja ka aadmi hai khandani kameena hai.

Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isi cheez ka mujhe dar tha. Sahih Bukhari mein hai Hazrat Ikrama farmate hain Jabr, Meek, Israaf, ke ma'ani Abd yani bande ke hain aur Eel ke ma'ani Allah ke hain toh Jibraeel waghera ke ma'ani Abdullah huye. Baaz logon ne is ke ma'ani ulat bhi kiye hain woh kehte hain Eel ke ma'ani Abd ke hain aur is se pehle ke alfaaz Allah ke naam hain, jaise Arabi mein Abdullah, Abdur-Rahman, Abdul-Malik, Abdul-Quddus, Abdus-Salam, Abdul-Kafi, Abdul-Jaleel waghera. Lafz Abd har jagah baqi raha aur Allah ke naam badalte rahe, is tarah Eel har jagah baqi hai aur Allah ke Asma-e-Husna badalte rehte hain. Ghair Arabi zaban mein muzaf-ilaih pehle aata hai aur muzaf baad mein. Isi qa'ide ke mutabiq in namon mein bhi hai jaise Jibraeel, Meekaeel, Israfeel, Izraeel waghera. Ab mufassireen ki dusri jama'at ki daleel suniye jo likhte hain ke yeh guftagu Janab-e-Umar se hui thi. Shu'ba kehte hain Hazrat Umar Rauha mein aaye. Dekha ke log daur bhaag kar ek pathron ke taude ke paas ja kar namaz ada kar rahe hain, pucha ke yeh kya baat hai? Jawab mila ke is jagah Rasool-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne namaz ada ki hai. Aap bahut naraz huye ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jahan kahin namaz ka waqt aata tha parh liya karte the, pehle chale jaya karte the, ab in maqamat ko mutabarrik samajh kar khwah-makhwah wahin ja kar namaz ada karna kis ne bataya? Phir aap aur baton mein lag gaye, farmane lage main Yahudiyon ke majmay mein kabhi kabhi chala jaya karta aur yeh dekhta rehta tha ke kis tarah Quran Taurat ki aur Taurat Quran ki sachai ki tasdeeq karta hai. Yahudi bhi mujh se mohabbat zahir karne lage aur aksar baat-cheet hua karti thi. Ek din main un se baten kar hi raha tha toh raaste se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nikle, unhon ne mujh se kaha tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh ja rahe hain. Main ne kaha main un ke paas jata hoon lekin tum yeh toh batao tumhein Allah Wahdahu ki qasam, Allah Jalla Shanahu bar-haq ko mad-e-nazar rakho, us ki ne'maton ka khayal karo. Allah Ta'ala ki kitab tum mein maujood hai, Rab ki qasam kha kar batao kya tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Rasool nahin maante? Ab sab khamosh ho gaye. Un ke bare aalim ne jo un sab mein ilm mein bhi kamil tha aur sab ka sardar bhi tha, us ne kaha is shakhs ne itni sakht qasam di hai tum saaf aur sacha jawab kyun nahin dete? Unhon ne kaha Hazrat aap hi hamare bare hain zara aap hi jawab dijiye. Is bare padri ne kaha suniye Janab! Aap ne zabardast qasam di hai lehaza sach toh yahi hai ke hum dil se jante hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah Ta'ala ke sache Rasool hain. Main ne kaha afsos jab yeh jante ho toh phir maante kyun nahin? Kaha sirf is wajah se ke un ke paas aasmani wahi le kar aane wale Jibraeel hain jo nihayat sakhti, tangi, shiddat, azab aur takleef ke farishte hain, hum un ke aur woh hamare dushman hain. Agar wahi le kar Hazrat Meekaeel aate jo rahmat-o-raafat, takhfeef-o-rahat wale farishte hain toh hamain manne mein ta'ammul na hota.

Main ne kaha achha batao toh un dono ki Allah ke nazdeek kya qadr-o-manzil hai? Unhon ne kaha ek toh Janab-e-Bari ke dahne bazu hai aur dusra dusri taraf. Main ne kaha Allah ki qasam jis ke siwa aur koi mabood nahin jo in mein se kisi ka dushman ho, us ka dushman Allah bhi hai aur dusra farishta bhi, kyunke Jibraeel ke dushman se Mikaeel dosti nahin rakh sakte aur Mikaeel ka dushman Jibraeel ka dost nahin ho sakta. Na in mein se kisi ek ka dushman Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka dost ho sakta hai, na in dono mein se koi ek Bari Ta'ala ki ijazat ke baghair zameen par aa sakta hai na koi kaam kar sakta hai. Wallah mujhe na tum se lalach hai na khauf. Suno jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ka dushman ho, us ke farishton, us ke rasoolon aur Jibraeel-o-Mikaeel ka dushman ho toh us kafir ka Allah Wahdahu La-Shareek bhi dushman hai. Itna keh kar main chala aaya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas pahuncha toh aap ne mujhe dekhte hi farmaya, "Ae Ibn-e-Khattab! Mujh par taza wahi nazil hui hai." Main ne kaha, "Huzoor sunaiye," aap ne yahi aayat parh kar sunai. Main ne kaha, "Huzoor aap par mere maa baap qurban hon, yahi baatein abhi abhi Yahudiyon se meri ho rahi thin. Main toh chahta hi tha balkeh isi liye hazir-e-khidmat hua tha ke aap ko ittila karoon, magar mere aane se pehle Latif-o-Khabir sunne dekhne wale Allah ne aap ko khabar pahuncha di." Mulahiza ho Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera, magar yeh riwayat munqata hai, sanad muttasil nahin, Sha'bi ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka zamana nahin paya.

Aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke Jibraeel (A.S) Allah ke ameen farishte hain, Allah ke hukum se aap ke dil mein Allah ki wahi pahunchane par muqarrar hain. Woh farishton mein se Allah ke rasool hain. Kisi ek rasool se adawat rakhne wala sab rasoolon se adawat rakhne wala hota hai, jaise ek rasool par iman sab rasoolon par iman lane ka naam hai aur ek rasool ke sath kufr tamam nabiyon ke sath kufr karne ke barabar hai. Khud Allah Ta'ala ne ba'az rasoolon ke na manne walon ko kafir farmaya hai. Farmata hai aayat: (Innal-lazina yakfuruna billahi wa rusulihi wa yuriduna ay-yufarriqu baina-llahi wa rusulihi wa yaquluna nu'minu bi-ba'din wa nakfuru bi-ba'din, wa yuriduna ay-yattakhizu baina zalika sabila) (Surah An-Nisa: 150). Yani jo log Allah Ta'ala ke sath aur us ke rasoolon ke sath kufr karte hain aur Allah aur us ke rasoolon ke darmiyan tafreeq karna chahte hain aur kehte hain ke hum ba'az ko maante hain aur ba'az ko nahin maante, dusri aayat ke aakhir tak. Pas in aayaton mein sarahatan logon ko kafir kaha jo kisi ek rasool ko bhi na maanein. Isi tarah Jibraeel ka dushman Allah ka dushman hai kyunke woh apni marzi se nahin aate. Quran farmata hai: (Wa ma natanazzalu illa bi-amri Rabbik). Farmata hai aayat: (Wa innahu latanzilu Rabbil-Alamin) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 192).

(Ash-Shu'ara: 192) Ya'ni hum Allah ke hukm ke siwa nahin utarte hain, nazil kiya hua Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka hai jise le kar Rooh-ul-Amin aate hain aur tere dil mein daalte hain taake tu logon ko hoshiyar kar de. Sahih Bukhari ki Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai, mere doston se dushmani karne wala mujh se ladai ka elaan karne wala hai. Quran-e-Karim ki yeh bhi ek sifat hai ke woh apne se pehle ke tamam Rabbani kalam ki tasdeeq karta hai aur imandaron ke dilon ki hidayat aur un ke liye jannat ki khushkhabri deta hai, jaise farmaya aayat (Qul huwa lilladhina aamanu hudan wa shifa'un) (Fussilat: 44). Farmaya aayat (Wa nunazzilu minal-Qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatun lil-mu'minina wa la yaziduz-zalimina illa khasara) (Al-Isra: 82), ya'ni yeh Quran iman walon ke liye hidayat-o-shifa hai. Rasoolon mein insani rasool aur malaki rasool sab shamil hain, jaise farmaya aayat (Allahu yastafi minal-mala'ikati rusulan wa minan-nasi innallaha Sami'un Basir) (Al-Hajj: 75). Allah Ta'ala farishton mein se aur insanon mein se apne rasool chhanth leta hai. Jibra'il aur Mika'il bhi farishton mein hain lekin un ka khusoosan naam liya taake mas'ala bilkul saaf ho jaye aur yeh bhi jaan lein ke un mein se ek ka dushman dusre ka dushman hai, balkeh Allah bhi us ka dushman hai. Hazrat Mika'il bhi kabhi kabhi Anbiya ke paas aate rahe hain jaise ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath shuru shuru mein the lekin is kaam par muqarrar Hazrat Jibra'il hain, jaise Hazrat Mika'il ro'idgi aur barish waghera par aur jaise Hazrat Israfil soor phoonkne par. Ek sahih hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raat ko jab Tahajjud ki namaz ke liye khade hote tab yeh dua padhte. Dua: (Allahumma Rabba Jibra'ila wa Mika'ila wa Israfila, Fatiras-samawati wal-ardi, 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, anta tahkumu bayna 'ibadika fima kanu fihi yakhtalifuna, ihdini lima khtulifa fihi minal-haqqi bi-idhnika, innaka tahdi man tasha'u ila siratin mustaqim). Ae Allah! Ae Jibra'il, Mika'il, Israfil ke Rabb! Ae zameen-o-aasman ke paida karne wale! Ae zahir-o-batin ko janne wale! Apne bandon ke ikhtilaf ka faisla tu hi karta hai, ae Allah! ikhtilafi umoor mein apne hukm se haq ki taraf meri rahbari kar, tu jise chahe seedhi raah dikha deta hai. Lafz Jibra'il waghera ki tahqeeq aur us ke ma'ani pehle bayan ho chuke hain. Hazrat Abdul Aziz bin Umar farmate hain farishton mein Hazrat Jibra'il ka naam Khadim-ullah hai. Abu Sulaiman Darani yeh sun kar bahut hi khush hue aur farmane lage yeh ek riwayat meri riwayaton ke ek daftar se mujhe zyada mehboob hai. Jibra'il aur Mika'il ke lafz mein bahut saare lughat hain aur mukhtalif qira'atein hain jin ke bayan ki munasib jagah kutub-e-lughat hain, hum kitab ke hajm ko badhana nahin chahte kyunke kisi ma'ani ki samajh ya kisi hukm ka mafaad un par mauqoof nahin. Allah hamari madad kare. Hamara bharosa aur tawakkul usi ki paak zaat par hai.

Aayat ke khatma mein yeh nahin farmaya ke Allah bhi un logon ka dushman hai balkay farmaya Allah kafiron ka dushman hai. Is mein aisay logon ka hukum bhi maloom ho gaya, isay Arabi mein muzmar ki jagah mazhar kehte hain aur kalam-e-Arab mein aksar is ki misalein sher-on mein bhi payi jati hain. Goya yun kaha jata hai ke jis ne Allah ke dost se dushmani ki us ne Allah se dushmani ki aur jo Allah ka dushman, Allah bhi us ka dushman aur jis ka dushman khud Allah Qadir-e-Mutlaq ho jaye us ke kufr-o-barbadi mein kya shuba reh gaya? Sahih Bukhari ki hadith pehle guzar chuki ke Allah farmata hai mere doston se dushmani rakhne wale ko main elan-e-jang deta hoon, main apne doston ka badla le liya karta hoon aur hadith mein hi hai jis ka dushman main ho jaun woh barbad ho kar hi rehta hai.

Khasumat-e-Jibraeel A.S Maujib-e-Kufr-o-Isyan. Imam Jafar Tabari R.H farmate hain is par tamam mufassireen ka ittefaq hai ke jab Yahudiyon ne Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ko apna dushman aur Hazrat Mikaeel A.S ko apna dost bataya tha us waqt un ke jawab mein yeh aayat nazil hui lekin baaz kehte hain ke Amr-e-Nabuwwat ke bare mein jo guftagu un ki Huzoor ﷺ se hui thi us mein unhon ne yeh kaha tha. Baaz kehte hain Umar bin Khattab R.A se un ka jo munazra Huzoor ﷺ ki nabuwwat ke bare mein hua tha us mein unhon ne yeh kaha tha. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Yahudiyon ki ek jamaat Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ke paas aayi aur kaha ke hum aap se chand sawal karte hain jin ke sahih jawab nabi ke siwa aur koi nahin janta agar aap sache nabi hain to un ke jawabat dijiye. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya behtar hai jo chaho pucho magar ahd karo ke agar main theek theek jawab doon ga to tum meri nabuwwat ka iqrar kar loge aur meri farmanbardari ke paband ho jaoge. Unhon ne aap se wada kiya aur ahd diya. Is ke baad aap ne Hazrat Yaqub A.S ki tarah Allah Jalla Shanahu ki shahadat ke sath un se pukhta wada le kar unhein sawal karne ki ijazat di, unhon ne kaha pehle to yeh bataye ke Taurat nazil hone se pehle Hazrat Israel A.S ne apne nafs par kis cheez ko haram kiya tha? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya jab Hazrat Yaqub A.S irq-un-nisa ki bimari mein sakht bimar hue to nazr mani ke agar Allah mujhe is marz se shifa de to main apni khane ki sab se zyada marghoob cheez aur sab se zyada mehboob cheez peene ki chhod doon ga. Jab tandurust ho gaye to oont ka gosht khana aur oontni ka doodh peena jo aap ko pasand-e-khatir tha chhod diya, tumhein Allah ki qasam jis ne Hazrat Musa A.S par Taurat utari batao yeh sach hai? Un sab ne qasam kha kar kaha ke haan Huzoor ﷺ sach hai. Baja irshad hua achha ab hum puchte hain ke aurat mard ke pani ki kya kaifiyat hai? Aur kyun kabhi ladka paida hota hai aur kabhi ladki? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya suno mard ka pani gadha aur safed hota hai aur aurat ka pani patla aur zardi mail hota hai jo bhi ghalib aa jaye usi ke mutabiq paidaish hoti hai aur shabih bhi. Jab mard ka pani aurat ke pani par ghalib aa jaye to hukm-e-Ilahi se aulad-e-narina hoti hai aur jab aurat ka pani mard ke pani par ghalib aa jaye to hukm-e-Ilahi se aulad ladki hoti hai tumhein Allah Ta'ala ki qasam jis ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq nahin sach batao mera jawab sahih hai? Sab ne qasam kha kar kaha beshak aap ne baja irshad farmaya. Aap ﷺ ne in do baton par Allah Ta'ala ko gawah banaya. Unhon ne kaha achha yeh farmaye ke Taurat mein jis Nabi-e-Ummi ki khabar hai us ki khas nishani kya hai? Aur us ke paas kaun sa farishta wahi le kar aata hai? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya is ki khas nishani yeh hai ke is ki aankhein jab soyi hui hon us waqt mein is ka dil jagta rehta hai tumhein us Rabb ki qasam jis ne Hazrat Musa A.S ko Taurat di batao to main ne theek jawab diya? Sab ne qasam kha kar kaha aap ne bilkul sahih jawab diya.

Ab hamare is sawal ki dusri shaq ka jawab bhi inayat farma dijiye isi par behas ka khatma hai. Aap ne farmaya mera wali Jibraeel hai wohi mere paas wahi lata hai aur wahi tamam Anbiya-e-Kiram ke paas paigham-e-Bari Ta'ala lata raha. Sach kaho aur qasam kha kar kaho ke mera yeh jawab bhi durust hai? Unhon ne qasam kha kar kaha ke jawab toh durust hai lekin chunke Jibraeel hamara dushman hai woh sakhti aur khoon-rezi waghera le kar aata rehta hai is liye hum is ki nahin manenge na aap ki manenge, haan agar aap ke paas Hazrat Mikaeel wahi le kar aate jo rahmat, barish, paidawar waghera le kar aate hain aur hamare dost hain toh hum aap ki tabedari aur tasdeeq karte is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke unhon ne yeh bhi sawal kiya tha ke Ra'ad kya cheez hai? Aap ne farmaya woh ek farishta hai jo badalon par muqarrar hai jo Allah Ta'ala ke hukum ke mutabiq unhein idhar udhar le jata hai. Unhon ne kaha yeh garaj ki aawaz kya hai? Aap ne farmaya yeh isi farishtay ki aawaz hai mulahiza ho Musnad-e-Ahmad waghera. Sahih Bukhari ki ek riwayat mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madina mein tashreef laye us waqt Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) apne bagh mein thay aur yahoodiyat par qaim thay. Unhon ne jab aap ki aamad ki khabar suni toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas hazir hue aur kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh farmaye ke Qayamat ki pehli shart kya hai? Aur jannatiyon ka pehla khana kya hai? Aur kaunsi cheez bacha ko kabhi maa ki taraf kheenchti hai aur kabhi baap ki taraf, aap ne farmaya in teenon sawalon ke jawab abhi abhi Jibraeel ne mujhe batlaye hain suno, Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam ne kaha woh toh hamara dushman hai. Aap ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi phir farmaya pehli nishani Qayamat ki ek aag hai jo logon ke peeche lagegi aur unhein mashriq se maghrib ki taraf ikatha kar degi. Kehne lage Auzubillah Auzubillah woh musalman hi kyun hone lage? Hazrat Abdullah jo ab tak chhupe hue thay bahar aa gaye aur zor se kalma parha. Toh tamam ke tamam shor machane lage ke yeh khud bhi bura hai is ke baap dada bhi buray thay yeh bara neeche darja ka aadmi hai khandani kameena hai.
