Main ne kaha afsos jab yeh jante ho toh phir maante kyun nahin? Kaha sirf is wajah se ke un ke paas aasmani wahi le kar aane wale Jibraeel hain jo nihayat sakhti, tangi, shiddat, azab aur takleef ke farishte hain, hum un ke aur woh hamare dushman hain. Agar wahi le kar Hazrat Meekaeel aate jo rahmat-o-raafat, takhfeef-o-rahat wale farishte hain toh hamain manne mein ta'ammul na hota.

Main ne kaha achha batao toh un dono ki Allah ke nazdeek kya qadr-o-manzil hai? Unhon ne kaha ek toh Janab-e-Bari ke dahne bazu hai aur dusra dusri taraf. Main ne kaha Allah ki qasam jis ke siwa aur koi mabood nahin jo in mein se kisi ka dushman ho, us ka dushman Allah bhi hai aur dusra farishta bhi, kyunke Jibraeel ke dushman se Mikaeel dosti nahin rakh sakte aur Mikaeel ka dushman Jibraeel ka dost nahin ho sakta. Na in mein se kisi ek ka dushman Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka dost ho sakta hai, na in dono mein se koi ek Bari Ta'ala ki ijazat ke baghair zameen par aa sakta hai na koi kaam kar sakta hai. Wallah mujhe na tum se lalach hai na khauf. Suno jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ka dushman ho, us ke farishton, us ke rasoolon aur Jibraeel-o-Mikaeel ka dushman ho toh us kafir ka Allah Wahdahu La-Shareek bhi dushman hai. Itna keh kar main chala aaya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas pahuncha toh aap ne mujhe dekhte hi farmaya, "Ae Ibn-e-Khattab! Mujh par taza wahi nazil hui hai." Main ne kaha, "Huzoor sunaiye," aap ne yahi aayat parh kar sunai. Main ne kaha, "Huzoor aap par mere maa baap qurban hon, yahi baatein abhi abhi Yahudiyon se meri ho rahi thin. Main toh chahta hi tha balkeh isi liye hazir-e-khidmat hua tha ke aap ko ittila karoon, magar mere aane se pehle Latif-o-Khabir sunne dekhne wale Allah ne aap ko khabar pahuncha di." Mulahiza ho Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera, magar yeh riwayat munqata hai, sanad muttasil nahin, Sha'bi ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka zamana nahin paya.

Aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke Jibraeel (A.S) Allah ke ameen farishte hain, Allah ke hukum se aap ke dil mein Allah ki wahi pahunchane par muqarrar hain. Woh farishton mein se Allah ke rasool hain. Kisi ek rasool se adawat rakhne wala sab rasoolon se adawat rakhne wala hota hai, jaise ek rasool par iman sab rasoolon par iman lane ka naam hai aur ek rasool ke sath kufr tamam nabiyon ke sath kufr karne ke barabar hai. Khud Allah Ta'ala ne ba'az rasoolon ke na manne walon ko kafir farmaya hai. Farmata hai aayat: (Innal-lazina yakfuruna billahi wa rusulihi wa yuriduna ay-yufarriqu baina-llahi wa rusulihi wa yaquluna nu'minu bi-ba'din wa nakfuru bi-ba'din, wa yuriduna ay-yattakhizu baina zalika sabila) (Surah An-Nisa: 150). Yani jo log Allah Ta'ala ke sath aur us ke rasoolon ke sath kufr karte hain aur Allah aur us ke rasoolon ke darmiyan tafreeq karna chahte hain aur kehte hain ke hum ba'az ko maante hain aur ba'az ko nahin maante, dusri aayat ke aakhir tak. Pas in aayaton mein sarahatan logon ko kafir kaha jo kisi ek rasool ko bhi na maanein. Isi tarah Jibraeel ka dushman Allah ka dushman hai kyunke woh apni marzi se nahin aate. Quran farmata hai: (Wa ma natanazzalu illa bi-amri Rabbik). Farmata hai aayat: (Wa innahu latanzilu Rabbil-Alamin) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 192).

(Ash-Shu'ara: 192) Ya'ni hum Allah ke hukm ke siwa nahin utarte hain, nazil kiya hua Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka hai jise le kar Rooh-ul-Amin aate hain aur tere dil mein daalte hain taake tu logon ko hoshiyar kar de. Sahih Bukhari ki Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai, mere doston se dushmani karne wala mujh se ladai ka elaan karne wala hai. Quran-e-Karim ki yeh bhi ek sifat hai ke woh apne se pehle ke tamam Rabbani kalam ki tasdeeq karta hai aur imandaron ke dilon ki hidayat aur un ke liye jannat ki khushkhabri deta hai, jaise farmaya aayat (Qul huwa lilladhina aamanu hudan wa shifa'un) (Fussilat: 44). Farmaya aayat (Wa nunazzilu minal-Qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatun lil-mu'minina wa la yaziduz-zalimina illa khasara) (Al-Isra: 82), ya'ni yeh Quran iman walon ke liye hidayat-o-shifa hai. Rasoolon mein insani rasool aur malaki rasool sab shamil hain, jaise farmaya aayat (Allahu yastafi minal-mala'ikati rusulan wa minan-nasi innallaha Sami'un Basir) (Al-Hajj: 75). Allah Ta'ala farishton mein se aur insanon mein se apne rasool chhanth leta hai. Jibra'il aur Mika'il bhi farishton mein hain lekin un ka khusoosan naam liya taake mas'ala bilkul saaf ho jaye aur yeh bhi jaan lein ke un mein se ek ka dushman dusre ka dushman hai, balkeh Allah bhi us ka dushman hai. Hazrat Mika'il bhi kabhi kabhi Anbiya ke paas aate rahe hain jaise ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath shuru shuru mein the lekin is kaam par muqarrar Hazrat Jibra'il hain, jaise Hazrat Mika'il ro'idgi aur barish waghera par aur jaise Hazrat Israfil soor phoonkne par. Ek sahih hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raat ko jab Tahajjud ki namaz ke liye khade hote tab yeh dua padhte. Dua: (Allahumma Rabba Jibra'ila wa Mika'ila wa Israfila, Fatiras-samawati wal-ardi, 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, anta tahkumu bayna 'ibadika fima kanu fihi yakhtalifuna, ihdini lima khtulifa fihi minal-haqqi bi-idhnika, innaka tahdi man tasha'u ila siratin mustaqim). Ae Allah! Ae Jibra'il, Mika'il, Israfil ke Rabb! Ae zameen-o-aasman ke paida karne wale! Ae zahir-o-batin ko janne wale! Apne bandon ke ikhtilaf ka faisla tu hi karta hai, ae Allah! ikhtilafi umoor mein apne hukm se haq ki taraf meri rahbari kar, tu jise chahe seedhi raah dikha deta hai. Lafz Jibra'il waghera ki tahqeeq aur us ke ma'ani pehle bayan ho chuke hain. Hazrat Abdul Aziz bin Umar farmate hain farishton mein Hazrat Jibra'il ka naam Khadim-ullah hai. Abu Sulaiman Darani yeh sun kar bahut hi khush hue aur farmane lage yeh ek riwayat meri riwayaton ke ek daftar se mujhe zyada mehboob hai. Jibra'il aur Mika'il ke lafz mein bahut saare lughat hain aur mukhtalif qira'atein hain jin ke bayan ki munasib jagah kutub-e-lughat hain, hum kitab ke hajm ko badhana nahin chahte kyunke kisi ma'ani ki samajh ya kisi hukm ka mafaad un par mauqoof nahin. Allah hamari madad kare. Hamara bharosa aur tawakkul usi ki paak zaat par hai.

Aayat ke khatma mein yeh nahin farmaya ke Allah bhi un logon ka dushman hai balkay farmaya Allah kafiron ka dushman hai. Is mein aisay logon ka hukum bhi maloom ho gaya, isay Arabi mein muzmar ki jagah mazhar kehte hain aur kalam-e-Arab mein aksar is ki misalein sher-on mein bhi payi jati hain. Goya yun kaha jata hai ke jis ne Allah ke dost se dushmani ki us ne Allah se dushmani ki aur jo Allah ka dushman, Allah bhi us ka dushman aur jis ka dushman khud Allah Qadir-e-Mutlaq ho jaye us ke kufr-o-barbadi mein kya shuba reh gaya? Sahih Bukhari ki hadith pehle guzar chuki ke Allah farmata hai mere doston se dushmani rakhne wale ko main elan-e-jang deta hoon, main apne doston ka badla le liya karta hoon aur hadith mein hi hai jis ka dushman main ho jaun woh barbad ho kar hi rehta hai.

Sulaiman A.S jadugar nahin thay, yani ae Muhammad ﷺ hum ne aisi nishaniyan jo aap ki nabuwwat ki sarih daleel ban sakein nazil farma di hain. Yahudiyon ki makhsoos maloomat ka zakheera, un ki kitab ki posheeda baatein, un ki tahreef-o-tabdeel-e-ahkaam waghera sab hum ne apni mojiza-numa kitab Quran-e-Kareem mein bayan farma diye hain jinhein sun kar har zinda zameer aap ki nabuwwat ki tasdeeq karne par majboor ho jata hai. Haan yeh aur baat hai ke yahudiyon ko un ka hasad-o-bughz rok de, warna har shakhs jaan sakta hai ke ek ummi shakhs se aisa pakeeza khubiyon wala, hikmaton wala kalam kaha nahin ja sakta.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke Ibn-e-Sooriya Qatoobni ne Huzoor ﷺ se kaha tha ke aap bator-e-nabuwwat koi aisi cheez nahin laye jis se hum pehchan lein, na aap ke paas koi aisi khaas roshan daleelein hain. Is par yeh aayat-e-pak nazil hui. Chunke yahudiyon ne is baat se inkar kar diya tha ke hum se paighambar-e-aakhir-uz-zaman ki babat koi ahd liya gaya hai, is par Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke yeh to un ki aadat hi hai ke ahd kiya aur toda, balkeh un ki aksariyat to imaan se bilkul khali hai.

Nabd ka ma'ni phenk dena hai, chunke in logon ne Kitabullah ko aur ahd-e-Bari ko is tarah chhod rakha tha goya phenk diya tha, is liye un ki muzammat mein yahi lafz laya gaya. Dusri jagah saaf bayan hai ke un ki kitabon mein Huzoor ﷺ ka zikr majood tha. Farmaya aayat: (يَجِدُوْنَهٗ مَكْتُوْبًا عِنْدَهُمْ فِي التَّوْرٰىةِ وَالْاِنْجِيْلِ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 157) yani yeh log Taurat-o-Injeel mein Huzoor ka zikr majood paate hain. Yahan bhi farmaya hai ke jab un ki kitab ki tasdeeq karne wala hamare paighambar un ke paas aaya to un ke ek fareeq ne Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat ki kitab se be-parwahi barat kar is tarah ise chhod diya jaise koi ilm hi nahin. Balkeh jadoo ke peeche pad gaye aur khud Huzoor ﷺ par jadoo kiya jis ki ittila aap ko Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne di aur us ka asar zail hua aur aap ko shifa mili.

Taurat se toh Huzoor (ﷺ) ka muqabla nahin kar sakte thay is liye ke woh toh is ki tasdeeq wali thi toh use chhor kar dusri kitabon ki pairwi karne lage aur Allah ki kitab ko is tarah chhor diya ke goya kabhi jaante hi na thay. Nafsani khwahishein samne rakh lein aur Kitabullah ko peeth peeche daal diya. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke raag baaje, khel tamashe aur Allah ke zikr se rokne wali har cheez aayat (Ma tattlu-ush-Shayatin) mein dakhil hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke paas ek angoothi thi, jab aap bait-ul-khala jaate toh apni biwi Hazrat Jarada ko de jaate. Jab Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki aazmaish ka waqt aaya us waqt ek shaitan jin aap ki surat mein aap ki biwi sahiba ke paas aaya aur angoothi talab ki jo de di gayi. Usne pehan li aur takht-e-Sulaimani par baith gaya, tamam jinnaat waghera hazir-e-khidmat ho gaye, hukumat karne laga. Idhar jab Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) wapas aaye aur angoothi talab ki toh jawab mila tu jhoota hai, angoothi toh Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) le gaye. Aap ne samajh liya ke yeh Allah ki taraf se aazmaish hai. In dinon mein shayatin ne jaadu, nujoom, kahanat, sher-o-ashaar aur ghaib ki jhooti sachi khabron ki kitabein likh likh kar Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki kursi tale dafan karni shuru kar dein. Aap ki aazmaish ka yeh zamana khatam ho gaya, aap phir takht-o-taaj ke maalik hue. Umr-e-taba'i ko pahunch kar jab rihlat farmayi toh shayatin ne insaanon se kehna shuru kiya ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ka khazana aur woh kitabein jin ke zariye se woh hawaon aur jinnaat par hukmrani karte thay un ki kursi tale dafan hain. Chunke jinnaat us kursi ke paas nahin ja sakte thay is liye insaanon ne use khoda toh woh kitabein bar-aamad huin. Bas un ka charcha ho gaya aur har shakhs ki zabaan par charh gaya ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki hukumat ka raaz yahi tha, balkay log Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki nabuwwat se munkir ho gaye aur aap ko jaadugar kehne lage. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne is baat ki uqda kushai ki aur farman-e-Bari Ta'ala nazil hua ke jaadugari ka yeh kufr toh shayatin ka phailaya hua hai, Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) is se bari-uz-zimma hain. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ke paas ek shakhs aaya, aap ne poocha kahan se aaye ho? Usne kaha Iraq se! Farmaya Iraq ke kis shehar se? Usne kaha Kufa se! Poocha wahan ki kya khabrein hain? Usne kaha wahan baatein ho rahi hain ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) inteqal nahin kar gaye balkay zinda roposh hain aur anqareeb aayenge. Aap kaanp uthay aur farmane lage agar aisa hota toh hum un ki meeras taqseem na karte aur un ki auratein apna dusra nikah na kartin. Suno shayatin aasmani baatein chura laya karte thay aur un mein apni baatein mila kar logon mein phailaya karte thay, Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ne yeh tamam kitabein jama kar ke apni kursi tale dafan kar dein.

Aap ke inteqal ke baad jinnaat ne woh phir nikal lein, wahi kitabein Iraqiyon mein phaili hui hain aur un hi kitabon ki baatein woh bayan karte aur phailate rehte hain, isi ka zikr is aayat (Wattaba'u) al-kh mein hai. Is zamane mein yeh bhi mashhoor ho gaya tha ke shayateen ilm-e-ghaib jaante hain. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ne un kitabon ko sandooq mein bhar kar dafan kar dene ke baad yeh hukum jaari kar diya ke jo yeh kahega us ki gardan maari jayegi. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke jinnaat ne un kitabon ko Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke inteqal ke baad aap ki kursi tale dafan kiya tha aur un ke shuru safha par likh diya tha ke yeh ilmi khazana Asif bin Barkhiya ka jama kiya hua hai jo Hazrat Sulaiman bin Dawood (A.S) ke wazeer-e-azam, musheer-e-khas aur dili dost the. Yahudiyon mein mashhoor tha ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) nabi na the balkay jadugar the, is bina par yeh aayatein nazil huin aur Allah ke sachay nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek sachay nabi ki baraat ki aur yahudiyon ke is aqeeday ka ibtal kiya. Woh Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ka naam nabiyon ke zumray mein sun kar bahut badakte the, is liye tafseel ke sath is waqiye ko bayan kar diya. Ek wajah yeh bhi hui ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ne tamam moozi janwaron se ahd liya tha, jab unhein woh ahd yaad karaya jata tha to woh satate na the, phir logon ne apni taraf se ibaratein bana kar jadoo ki qisam ke mantar tantar bana kar un sab ko aap ki taraf mansoob kar diya jis ka butlan in aayat-e-karima mein hai. Yaad rahe ke "Ala" yahan par "Fi" ke ma'ani mein hai ya "Tatlu" mutazammin hai takazzub ka, yahi aula aur ahsan hai, wallahu a'alam. Khwaja Hasan Basri (R.H) ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke zamane mein jadugaron ka hona Quran se sabit hai aur Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ka Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke baad hona bhi Quran se zahir hai. Dawood (A.S) aur Jaloot ke qissay mein hai "Min ba'di Musa", balkay Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) se bhi pehle Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ko un ki qoum ne kaha tha aayat (Innama anta minal musahhareen) yani tu jadoo kiye gaye logon mein se hai. Phir farmata hai aayat (Wama unzila) al-kh. Baaz to kehte hain yahan par "Ma Nafiya" hai yani inkar ke ma'ani mein hai aur is ka atf "Ma kafara Sulaiman" par hai. Yahudiyon ke is dusre aitqaad ki ke jadoo farishton par nazil hua hai, is aayat mein tardeed hai. Haroot, Maroot lafz shayateen ka badal hai, tasniya par bhi jama ka itlaq hota hai jaise aayat (In kana lahu ikhwah) mein, ya is liye jama kiya gaya ke un ke manne walon ko bhi shamil kar liya gaya hai aur un ka naam un ki zyada sarkashi ki wajah se sar-e-fehrist diya gaya hai. Qurtubi (R.H) to kehte hain ke is aayat ka yahi theek matlab hai, is ke siwa kisi aur ma'ani ki taraf iltifat bhi na karna chahiye. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jadoo Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka nazil kiya hua nahin. Rabee bin Anas (R.H) farmate hain un par koi jadoo nahin utra.

Is bina par ayat ka tarjuma is tarah par hoga ke un Yahudiyon ne us cheez ki tabedari ki jo Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke zamana mein shaitan padha karte the. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne kufr nahin kiya na Allah Ta'ala ne jadu ko un do farishton par utara hai (jaise ae Yahudiyon tumhara khayal Jibrail A.S o Mikail A.S ki taraf hai) balkeh yeh kufr shaitanon ka hai jo Babul mein logon ko jadu sikhaya karte the aur un ke sardar do aadmi the jin ka naam Harut o Marut tha. Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Abzi R.A ise is tarah padhte the ayat (Wa ma unzila 'alal malakaini Dawuda wa Sulaimana) yani Dawud A.S o Sulaiman A.S dono badshahon par bhi jadu nahin utara gaya ya yeh ke woh is se rokte the kyunke yeh kufr hai. Imam Ibn Jarir R.H ne is ka zabardast radd kiya hai woh farmate hain "Ma" ma'ani mein "Allazi" ke hai aur Harut Marut do farishte hain jinhein Allah ne zameen ki taraf utara hai aur apne bandon ki aazmaish aur imtehan ke liye unhein jadu ki ta'leem di hai lehaza Harut Marut is farman-e-Bari Ta'ala ko baja la rahe hain. Ek gareeb qaul yeh bhi hai ke yeh jinnon ke do qabile hain. "Malakaini" yani do badshahon ki qira'at par inzal khalq ke ma'ani mein hoga jaise farmaya ayat (Wa anzala lakum minal an'ami samaniyata azwaj) aur farmaya ayat (Wa anzalnal hadid) aur kaha ayat (Wa yunazzilu lakum minas sama'i rizqa) (40. Ghafir: 13) yani hum ne tumhare liye aath qisam ke chaupaye paida kiye, loha banaya, aasman se roziyan utarein. Hadith mein hai dua (Ma anzala Allahu da'an) yani Allah Ta'ala ne jitni bimariyan paida ki hain un sab ke ilaj bhi paida kiye hain. Masal mashhoor hai ke bhalai burai ka nazil karne wala Allah hai, yahan sab jagah inzal yani paidaish ke ma'ani mein hai, ijad yani lane aur utarne ke ma'ani mein nahin. Isi tarah is ayat mein bhi aksar salaf ka mazhab yeh hai ke yeh dono farishte the. Ek marfu hadith mein bhi yeh mazmoon bast o tool ke sath hai jo abhi bayan hogi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Koi yeh aitraz na kare ke farishte to masoom hain woh gunah karte hi nahin che ja'ike logon ko jadu sikhayen jo kufr hai, is liye ke yeh dono bhi aam farishton mein se khas ho jayenge. Jaise ke Iblis ki babat aap ayat (Wa iz qulna lil mala'ikatis judu li Adama fasajadu illa Iblis) (2. Al-Baqarah: 34).

Al-Baqarah: 34 ki tafsir mein parh chuke hain. Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A), Ka'ab Ahbar (R.H), Hazrat Suddi (R.H), Hazrat Kalbi (R.H) yahi farmate hain. Ab is hadith ko suniye: "Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke jab Adam (A.S) ko Allah Ta'ala ne zameen par utara aur un ki aulad phaili aur zameen mein Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani hone lagi to farishton ne kaha ke dekho yeh kis qadar bure log hain, kaise nafarman aur sarkash hain. Hum agar in ki jagah hote to hargiz hargiz Allah ki nafarmani na karte. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: Acha tum apne mein se do farishton ko pasand kar lo, main un mein insani khwahishat paida karta hoon aur unhein insanon mein bhejta hoon, phir dekhta hoon ke woh kya karte hain. Chunancha unhon ne Harut-o-Marut ko pesh kiya. Allah Ta'ala ne un mein insani tabiyat paida ki aur un se keh diya ke dekho, Bani Adam ko to main nabiyon ke zariye apne hukm-o-ahkam pahunchata hoon, lekin tum se bila-wasta khud keh raha hoon ke mere sath kisi ko sharik na karna, zina na karna, sharab na peena. Ab yeh dono zameen par utre aur Zuhra ko un ki aazmaish ke liye haseen-o-shakeel aurat ki surat mein un ke paas bheja, jise dekh kar yeh maftoon ho gaye aur us se zina karna chaha. Us ne kaha: Agar tum shirk karo to main manzoor karti hoon. Unhon ne jawab diya ke yeh to hum se na ho sake ga. Woh chali gayi, phir aayi aur kehne lagi: Acha is bache ko qatl kar daalo to mujhe tumhari khwahish puri karni manzoor hai. Unhon ne ise bhi na mana. Woh phir aayi aur kaha ke acha yeh sharab pee lo. Unhon ne ise halka gunah samajh kar ise manzoor kar liya. Ab nasha mein mast ho kar zina-kari bhi ki aur us bache ko bhi qatl kar dala. Jab hosh-o-hawas durust hue to us aurat ne kaha: Jin jin kamon ka tum pehle inkar karte the, sab tum ne kar dale. Yeh nadim hue. Unhein ikhtiyar diya gaya ke ya to azab-e-duniya ko ikhtiyar karo ya azab-e-ukhrawi ko. Unhon ne duniya ka azab pasand kiya." Sahih Ibn-e-Hibban, Musnad-e-Ahmad, Ibn-e-Marduyah, Ibn-e-Jarir, Abdur-Razzaq mein yeh hadith mukhtalif alfaz se marwi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki yeh riwayat gharib hai, is mein ek rawi Musa bin Jubair Ansari Sulami ko Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne mastoor-ul-hal likha hai. Ibn-e-Marduyah ki riwayat mein yahi hai ke ek raat ko asna-e-safar mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ne Hazrat Nafi (R.H) se pucha ke kya Zuhra tara nikla? Us ne kaha nahin. Do teen martaba sawal ke baad kaha: Ab Zuhra tulu hua. To farmane lage: Is se na khushi ho na bhalai mile.

Hazrat Nafi ne kaha Hazrat ek sitara jo Allah Ta'ala ke hukum se tulu-o-ghuroob hota hai aap use bura kehte hain? Farmaya main wahi kehta hoon aur main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai phir us ke baad mandaraja-bala hadith bakhtilaf-e-alfaz sunayi lekin yeh bhi ghareeb hai. Hazrat Ka'ab wali riwayat marfoo se zyada sahih mauqif hai aur mumkin hai ke woh Bani Israel riwayat ho, wallahu a'alam. Sahaba aur tabieen se bhi is qisam ki riwayatein bohat kuch manqool hain. Ba'az mein hai ke Zahra ek aurat thi us ne un farishton se yeh shart ki thi ke tum mujhe woh dua sikha do jise parh kar tum aasman par charh jate ho, unhon ne sikha di, yeh parh kar charh gayi aur wahan tare ki shakal mein bana di gayi. Ba'az marfoo riwayaton mein bhi yeh hai lekin woh munkar aur ghair sahih hain. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke is waqiye se pehle to farishte sirf iman walon ki bakhshish ki dua mangte the lekin us ke baad tamam ahl-e-zameen ke liye dua shuru kar di. Ba'az riwayaton mein hai ke jab un dono farishton se yeh nafarmaniyan sarzad huin tab aur farishton ne iqrar kar liya ke Bani Adam jo Allah Ta'ala se door hain aur bin dekhe iman late hain jin se khataon ka sarzad ho jana koi aisi anokhi cheez nahin. Un dono farishton se kaha gaya ke ab ya to duniya ka azab pasand kar lo ya aakhirat ke azabon ko ikhtiyar kar lo. Unhon ne duniya ka azab chun liya chunancha unhein Babul mein azab ho raha hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke unhein Allah Ta'ala ne jo ahkam diye the un mein qatl se aur maal-e-haram se mumanat bhi ki thi aur yeh hukum bhi tha ke hukum adl ke sath karein. Yeh bhi warid hua hai ke yeh teen farishte the lekin ek ne aazmaish se inkar kar diya aur wapas chala gaya phir do ki aazmaish hui. Ibn Abbas farmate hain yeh waqiya Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke zamana ka hai. Yahan Babul se murad Babul-e-Dunyawand hai. Us aurat ka naam arabi mein Zahra tha aur labti zaban mein us ka naam Baidukht tha aur farsi mein Nahid tha. Yeh aurat apne khawand ke khilaf ek muqadma layi thi jab unhon ne us se burayi ka irada kiya to us ne kaha pehle mujhe mere khawand ke khilaf hukum do to mujhe manzoor hai, unhon ne aisa hi kiya phir us ne kaha mujhe yeh bhi bata do ke tum kya parh kar aasman par charh jate ho aur kya parh kar utarte ho? Unhon ne yeh bhi bata diya chunancha woh use parh kar aasman par charh gayi, utarne ka wazifa bhool gayi aur wahin sitare ki surat mein mask kar di gayi.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A jab kabhi Zohra sitaray ko dekhte toh laanat bheja karte thay. Ab un farishton ne jab charhna chaha toh na charh sakay, samajh gaye ke ab hum halak huay. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmatay hain, pehlay pehal chand dinon tak toh farishtay sabit qadam rahay, subh se sham tak faisla adl ke sath karte rehtay, sham ko aasman par charh jatay, phir Zohra ko dekh kar apnay nafs par qabu na rakh sakay. Zohra sitaray ko aik khubsurat aurat ki shakal mein bheja gaya. Al-gharaz Harut Marut ka yeh qissa tabieen mein se bhi aksar logon ne bayan kiya hai, jaisay Mujahid, Suddi, Hasan Basri, Qatadah, Abu Al-Aliyah, Zuhri, Rabee bin Anas, Muqatil bin Hayyan waghera waghera Rahimahumullah Ajmaeen. Aur mutaqaddimeen aur muta'akhireen mufassireen ne bhi apni apni tafseeron mein isay naqal kiya hai, lekin is ka zyada tar dar-o-madar Bani Israel ki kitabon par hai. Koi sahih marfoo muttasil hadith is baat mein Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se sabit nahin aur na Quran-e-Kareem mein is qadar bast-o-tafseel hai. Pas hamara imaan hai ke jis qadar Quran mein hai sahih aur durust hai aur haqeeqat-e-haal ka ilm Allah Ta'ala ko hi hai. (Quran-e-Kareem ke zahiri alfaaz, Musnad-e-Ahmad, Ibn-e-Hibban, Baihaqi waghera ki marfoo hadith, Hazrat Ali R.A, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A, Ibn-e-Masood R.A waghera ki mauqoof riwayat, tabieen waghera ki tafaseer waghera mila kar is waqea ki bohat kuch taqwiyat ho jati hai, na is mein koi muhaal-e-aqli hai na is mein kisi usool-e-Islami ka khilaf hai, phir zahir se be-ja hat aur takallufat uthanay ki koi zaroorat baqi nahin reh jati, Wallahu A'alam) (Fath-ul-Bayan). Ibn-e-Jareer mein aik ghareeb asar aur aik ajeeb waqea hai, isay bhi suniye. Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa R.A farmati hain ke Dumat-ul-Jandal ki aik aurat Huzoor ﷺ ke inteqal ke thoray hi zamana ke baad aap ki talash mein aayi aur aap ke inteqal ki khabar pa kar be-chain ho kar ronay peetnay lagi. Main ne us se poocha ke aakhir kya baat hai? Toh us ne kaha ke mujh mein aur meray shohar mein hamesha na-chaqi raha karti thi, aik martaba woh mujhe chor kar lapata kahin chala gaya, aik burhiya se main ne yeh sab zikr kiya, us ne kaha jo main kahoon woh kar, woh khud-ba-khud teray paas aa jaye ga. Main tayyar ho gayi, woh raat ke waqt do kuttay le kar meray paas aayi, aik par woh khud sawar hui aur dusray par main baith gayi.

Thori hi der mein hum dono Babil pahunch gayin. Main ne dekha ke do shakhs udhar latke hue hain aur lohay mein jakray hue hain. Is aurat ne mujh se kaha in ke paas ja aur in se keh ke main jadu seekhne aayi hoon. Main ne un se kaha, unhon ne kaha sun hum to aazmaish mein hain, tu jadu na seekh, is ka seekhna kufr hai. Main ne kaha main to seekhungi. Unhon ne kaha achha phir ja aur is tanoor mein peshab kar ke chali aa. Main gayi, irada kiya lekin kuch dehshat si tari hui, main wapas aa gayi aur kaha main farigh ho aayi hoon. Unhon ne poocha kya dekha? Main ne kaha kuch nahin. Unhon ne kaha tu ghalat kehti hai, abhi to kuch nahin bigra, tera imaan sabit hai, ab bhi laut ja aur kufr na kar. Main ne kaha mujhe to jadu seekhna hai. Unhon ne phir kaha ja aur is tanoor mein peshab kar aa. Main phir gayi lekin ab ki martaba bhi dil na mana, wapas aayi, phir isi tarah sawal jawab hue. Main teesri martaba phir tanoor ke paas gayi aur dil kara kar ke peshab karne ko baith gayi. Main ne dekha ke ek ghoray sawar munh par naqab daalay nikla aur aasman par charh gaya hai.

Wapas chali aayi, un se zikr kiya, unhon ne kaha haan ab ki martaba toh sach kehti hai, woh tera imaan tha jo tujh mein se nikal gaya, ab ja chali ja. Main aayi aur us burhiya se kaha unhon ne mujhe kuch bhi nahin sikhaya. Us ne kaha bas tujhe kuch aa gaya, ab tu jo kahegi ho jayega. Main ne aazmaish ke liye ek dana gehun ka liya, use zameen par daal kar kaha ug ja, woh foran ug aaya. Main ne kaha tujh mein baal paida ho jaye, chunancha ho gaye. Main ne kaha sookh ja, woh baal sookh gaye. Main ne kaha alag alag dana ho ja, woh bhi ho gaya. Phir main ne kaha sookh ja toh sookh gaya, phir main ne kaha aata ban ja toh aata ban gaya, main ne kaha roti pak ja toh roti pak gayi. Yeh dekhte hi mera dil nadim hone laga aur mujhe apne be-imaan ho jaane ka sadma hone laga. Aye Umm-ul-Momineen! Qasam Allah ki, na main ne is jaadu se koi kaam liya na kisi par kiya, main yunhi roti peetti Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho gayi ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kahun, lekin afsos badqismati se aap ko bhi main ne na paya, ab main kya karun? Itna keh kar chup ho gayi, sab ko is par tars aane laga. Sahaba-e-Kiram bhi mutahayyar thay ke ise kya fatwa dein? Aakhir baaz sahaba ne kaha ab is ke siwa kya ho sakta hai ke tum is fe'l ko na karo, tauba istighfar karo aur apne maa baap ki khidmat guzari karti raho. Yahan yeh bhi khayal rakhna chahiye ke Sahaba-e-Kiram fatwa dene mein bahut ehtiyat karte thay ke chhoti si baat batane mein taammul hota tha, aaj hum badi se badi baat bhi atkal aur raye qiyas se ghad ghada kar batane mein bilkul nahin rukte. Is ki asnaad bilkul sahih hain. Baaz log kehte hain ke "Ain" cheez jaadu ke zor se palat jaati hai aur baaz kehte hain nahin, sirf dekhne wale ko aisa khayal padta hai, asal cheez jaisi hoti hai waisi hi rehti hai, jaise Quran mein hai aayat (Saharoo a'yunannas) al-kh, yani unhon ne logon ki aankhon par jaadu kar diya aur farmaya aayat (Yukhayyalu ilaihi min sihrihim annaha tas'a), Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki taraf khayal dala jaata tha ke goya woh saanp waghera un ke jaadu ke zor se chal phir rahe hain. Is waqiye se yeh bhi maloom hota hai ke aayat mein lafz Babil se murad Babil-e-Iraq hai, Babil-e-Damawand nahin. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (R.A) Babil ki zameen mein ja rahe thay, Asr ki namaz ka waqt aa gaya lekin aap ne wahan namaz ada na ki, balkay is zameen ki sarhad se nikal jaane ke baad namaz padhi aur farmaya mere Habib (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe qabristan mein namaz padhne se rok diya hai aur Babil ki zameen mein namaz padhne se bhi muman'at farmayi hai, yeh zameen mal'oon hai. Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh hadith marwi hai aur Imam sahab ne is par koi kalam nahin kiya, aur jis hadith ko Hazrat Imam Abu Dawood apni kitab mein layein aur us ki sanad par khamoshi karein toh woh hadith Imam sahab ke nazdeek hasan hoti hai. Is se maloom hua ke Babil ki sar-zameen mein namaz makrooh hai, jaise ke Thamudiyon mein na jao, agar ittefaqan jaana pade toh khauf-e-Ilahi se rote hue jao.

Haiyat danon ka qaul hai ke Babul ki doori Bahr-e-Gharbi Oqiyanus se sattar darja lambi aur wast-e-zameen se noob ki janib ba-khat-e-istawa se teis darja hai, wallahu a'lam. Chunki Haroot Maroot ko Allah Ta'ala ne khair-o-sharr, kufr-o-imaan ka ilm de rakha hai is liye har ek kufr ki taraf jhukne wale ko nasihat karte hain aur har tarah rokte hain, jab nahin maanta to woh use keh dete hain, is ka noor-e-imaan jaata rehta hai, imaan se haath dho baithta hai, shaitan is ka rafeeq-e-kaar ban jaata hai, imaan ke nikal jaane ke baad Allah Ta'ala ka ghazab is ke room-room mein ghus jaata hai. Ibn-e-Jurayj farmate hain siwaye kaafir ke aur koi jaadu seekhne ki jurrat nahin karta. Fitna ke ma'ni yahan par bala, aazmaish aur imtehan ke hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ka qaul Quran-e-Pak mein mazkoor hai, aayat (In hiya illa fitnatuka). Is aayat se yeh bhi maloom ho gaya ke jaadu seekhna kufr hai. Hadees mein bhi hai jo shakhs kisi kaahin ya jaadugar ke paas jaaye aur us ki baat ko sach samjhe us ne Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utri hui wahi ke saath kufr kiya (Bazzar). Yeh hadees sahih hai aur is ki ta'eed mein aur hadeesein bhi aayi hain. Phir farmaya ke log Haroot Maroot se jaadu seekhte hain jis ke zariye bure kaam karte hain, aurat mard ki mohabbat aur muwafiqat ko bughz aur mukhalifat se badal dete hain. Sahih Muslim mein hadees hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain shaitan apna arsh paani par rakhta hai, phir apne lashkaron ko behkane ke waaste bhejta hai, sab se zyada martaba wala us ke nazdeek woh hai jo fitne mein sab se badha hua ho. Yeh jab wapas aate hain to apne badtareen kaamon ka zikr karte hain, koi kehta hai main ne falaan ko is tarah gumrah kar diya, koi kehta hai main ne falaan shakhs se yeh gunaah karaya, shaitan un se kehta hai.

Kuch nahin yeh toh mamooli kaam hai yahan tak ke ek aa kar kehta hai ke main ne falan shakhs ke aur us ki biwi ke darmiyan jhagda daal diya yahan tak ke judai ho gayi, shaitan use gale laga leta hai aur kehta hai haan tu ne bada kaam kiya, use apne paas bitha leta hai aur us ka martaba badha deta hai. Pas jadugar bhi apne jadoo se woh kaam karta hai jis se miyan biwi mein judai ho jaye, maslan us ki shakal-o-surat use buri maloom hone lage ya us ke aadat-o-atwar se jo ghair-e-shari na hon yeh nafrat karne lage ya dil mein adawat aa jaye waghera waghera. Rafta rafta yeh baatein badhti jayen aur aapas mein chhoot-chhutao ho jaye. "Mara" kehte hain us ka muzakkar, monas aur tasniya toh hai jama nahin banta. Phir farmaya yeh kisi ko bhi baghair Allah ki marzi ke eeza nahin pahuncha sakte, yani us ke apne bas ki baat nahin, Allah Ta'ala ki qaza-o-qadar aur us ke irade ke matehat yeh nuqsan bhi pahunchta hai. Agar Allah na chahe toh us ka jadoo mehez be-asar aur be-faida ho jata hai. Yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh jadoo usi shakhs ko nuqsan deta hai jo ise hasil kare aur is mein dakhil ho. Phir irshad hota hai woh aisa ilm seekhte hain jo un ke liye sarasar nuqsan-deh hai jis mein koi nafa nahin aur yeh Yahudi jante hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari chhod jadoo ke peeche lagne walon ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahin, na un ki qadr-o-waqat Allah Ta'ala ke paas hai na woh deendar samjhe jate hain. Phir farmaya agar yeh is kaam ki burai ko mehsoos karte aur iman-o-taqwa barte toh yaqeenan un ke liye bahut hi behtar tha magar yeh be-ilm log hain aur farmaya ke ahl-e-ilm ne kaha tum par afsos hai, Allah Ta'ala ka diya hua sawab imandaron aur nek aamal walon ke liye bahut hi behtar hai lekin ise sabr karne wale hi pa sakte hain. Is aayat se yeh bhi istidlal buzrugan-e-deen ne kiya hai ke jadugar kafir hai kyunke aayat mein (Wa lau annahum aamanu wattaqau lamathubatun min indillahi khairun) (2. Al-Baqarah: 103) farmaya hai. Hazrat Imam Ahmad aur salaf ki ek jamaat bhi jadoo seekhne wale ko kafir kehti hai, baaz kafir toh nahin kehte lekin farmate hain ke jadugar ki had yeh hai ke use qatl kar diya jaye. Bajala bin Ubaid kehte hain Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne apne ek farman mein likha tha ke har ek jadugar mard-o-aurat ko qatl kar do, chunancha hum ne teen jadugaron ki gardan mari. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Hafsa (R.A) par un ki ek laundi ne jadoo kiya jis par use qatl kiya gaya. Hazrat Imam Ahmad Hanbal (R.H) farmate hain teen sahabiyon se jadugar ke qatl ka fatwa sabit hai. Tirmidhi mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jadugar ki had talwar se qatl kar dena hai. Is hadith ke ek rawi Ismaeel bin Muslim zaeef hain, sahih baat yahi maloom hoti hai ke ghaliban yeh hadith mauqoof hai lekin Tabrani mein ek dusri sanad se bhi yeh hadith marfoo marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Walid bin Uqba ke paas ek jadugar tha jo apne kartab badshah ko dikhaya karta tha, bazahir ek shakhs ka sar kaat leta phir aawaz deta to sar jud jata aur woh maujood ho jata. Muhajireen Sahaba mein se ek buzurg Sahabi ne yeh dekha aur dusre din talwar bandhe hue aaye, jab sahir ne apna khel shuru kiya aap ne apni talwar se khud us ki gardan uda di aur farmaya, "Le ab agar saccha hai to khud jee uth." Phir Quran-e-Pak ki yeh aayat padh kar logon ko sunayi, aayat: (A-fata'tuna-s-sihra wa antum tubsirun) (21. Al-Anbiya: 3) "Kya tum dekhte bhalte jadoo ke paas jate ho?" Chunke is buzurg Sahabi ne Walid ki ijazat us ke qatl mein nahin li thi isliye badshah ne naraz ho kar unhein qaid kar diya phir chhod diya. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke farman aur Hazrat Hafsa (R.A) ke waqiye ke mutaliq yeh kaha hai ke yeh hukm us waqt hai jab jadoo shirkiya alfaaz se ho. Mu'tazila jadoo ke wujood ke munkireen hain, woh kehte hain jadoo koi cheez nahin, balki ba'az log to ba'az dafa itna badh jate hain ke kehte hain jo jadoo ka wujood manta ho woh kafir hai, lekin Ahl-e-Sunnat jadoo ke wujood ke qail hain. Yeh mante hain ke jadugar apne jadoo ke zor se hawa par ud sakte hain aur insaan bazahir gadha aur gadhe ko bazahir insaan bana dalte hain, magar kalmaat aur mantar tantar ke waqt in cheezon ko paida karne wala Allah Ta'ala hai. Aasman ko aur taron ko taseer paida karne wala Ahl-e-Sunnat nahin mante, falsafe aur nujoom wale aur be-deen log to taron ko aur aasman ko hi asar paida karne wala jante hain. Ahl-e-Sunnat ki ek daleel to aayat (Wa ma hum bi-darrina) hai aur dusri daleel khud Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jadoo kiya jana aur aap par us ka asar hona hai, teesre us aurat ka waqiya jise Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne bayan farmaya hai jo upar abhi abhi guzra hai aur bhi beesiyon aise hi waqiyat waghera hain. Razi (R.H) ne apni tafsir mein likha hai ke jadoo ka hasil karna bura nahin, muhaqqiqeen ka yahi qaul hai isliye ke woh bhi ek ilm hai aur Allah Ta'ala farmata hai aayat (Qul hal yastawi-lladhina ya'lamuna wa-lladhina la ya'lamun) (39. Az-Zumar: 9) yani ilm wale aur be-ilm barabar nahin hote aur isliye ke yeh ilm hoga to us se mojze aur jadoo mein farq puri tarah wazeh ho jayega aur mojze ka ilm wajib hai aur woh mauqoof hai jadoo ke seekhne par jis se farq maloom ho, pas jadoo ka seekhna bhi wajib hua. Razi (R.H) ka yeh qaul sartapa ghalat hai, agar aqlan woh ise bura na batayen to Mu'tazila maujood hain jo aqlan bhi is ki burayi ke qail hain aur agar shar'an bura na batate hon to Quran ki yeh aayat shar'i burayi batane ke liye kafi hai. Sahih hadith mein hai, "Jo kisi shakhs kisi jadugar ya kahan ke paas jaye woh kafir ho jaye ga."

Jadu ke jawaz aur adam-e-jawaz ki behas: Sunan mein hadith hai ke jis ne girah lagayi aur us mein phoonka, us ne jadu kiya. Lehaza Razi ka yeh kehna ke muhaqqiqeen ka qaul yahi hai yeh bhi theek nahin. Aakhir in muhaqqiqeen ke aise aqwal kahan hain? Aima-e-Islam mein se kis ne aisa kaha hai? Phir aayat (Hal yastawillazina) aayat ko pesh karna bhi niri jurrat hai kyunke aayat mein ilm se murad deeni ilm hai. Isi aayat mein shar'i ilm wale ulama ki fazeelat bayan hui hai. Phir un ka yeh kehna ke isi ilm se ke isi se mojze ka ilm taqabuli hasil hota hai, yeh to bilkul wahi, mehez ghalat aur fasid hai. Is liye ke hamare Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka sab se bada mojza Quran-e-Pak hai jo batil se sarasar mehfooz hai, lekin is ka mojza manne ke liye jadu janna zaroori nahin hai. Woh log jinhein jadu se door ka bhi talluq nahin, woh bhi ise mojza maan gaye. Sahaba, Taba'een, Aima-e-Muslimeen, balkay aam musalman bhi ise mojza maante hain, halankeh in tamam mein se koi ek bhi jadu janta to kya, jadu ke paas tak nahin phatka, jadu seekha na sikhaya, na kiya na karaya. Balkay in sab kamon ko kufr kehte rahe. Phir yeh dawa karna ke jadu ka janna wajib hai is liye ke jadu ke ilm se mojze ka farq maloom ho sakta hai is liye is ka seekhna wajib, kis qadar mohmal dawa hai.

Jadu ki aqsam: Ab jadu ki qismein suniye jinhein Abu Abdullah Razi ne bayan kiya hai: (1) Ek jadu to sitara parast firqa ka hai, woh saat sitaron ki nisbat aqeeda rakhte hain ke bhalai burai inhi ke ba'is hoti hai, is liye in ki taraf khitab ke muqarrar alfaz padha karte hain aur inhi ki parastish karte hain. Isi qoum mein Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) aaye aur inhein hidayat ki.

Razi ne is fan mein ek khaas kitab tasneef ki hai jis ka naam Al-Sirr-ul-Maktum fi Mukhatabat-ish-Shams-in-Nujum rakha hai, mulahiza ho Ibn-e-Khallikan waghera. Baaz kehte hain ke unhon ne baad mein is se tauba kar li hai aur baaz kehte hain ke sirf logon ko is ilm se aashna karne aur khud ko is ka aalim saabit karne ke liye yeh kitab likhi thi, warna un ka apna etiqad yeh tha jo sarasar kufr hai. Is kitab mein un logon ke taur-tareeqe likhe hain. (2) Dusra jaadu qawi nafs aur quwwat-e-wahima ke taqatwar logon ka fan hai. Wahm aur khayal ka zindagi mein bada asar hota hai. Dekhiye agar ek tang pul zameen par rakh diya jaye to is par insaan ba-aasani guzar jayega, lekin yahi tang pul agar kisi darya par ho to nahin guzar sake ga, is liye ke us waqt khayal hoga ke ab gira, ab gira. To wahima ki kamzori ke baa'is jitni jagah par zameen mein chal phir sakta tha, utni jagah par aise dar ke waqt nahin chal sakta. Hakeemon aur tabibon ne bhi mar'oof (jis ko naksir behne ki bimari ho) shakhs ko surkh chehron ko dekhne se rok diya hai aur mirgi walon ko zyada roshni wali aur tez harkat karne wali cheezon ke dekhne se mana kiya hai, jis se zahir hai ke quwwat-e-wahima ka ek khaas asar tabiyat par padta hai. Aqalmand logon ka is par bhi ittefaq hai ke nazar lagti hai. Sahih hadith mein bhi aaya hai ke nazar ka lagna haq hai, agar koi cheez taqdeer se sabqat karne wali hoti to nazar hoti. Ab agar nafs qawi hai to zahiri saharon aur zahiri kaamon ki koi zaroorat nahin aur agar itna qawi nahin to phir use aalaat ki bhi zaroorat padti hai. Jis qadar nafs ki quwwat badhti jayegi, woh ruhaniyat mein taraqqi karta jayega aur taseer mein badhta jayega aur jis qadar yeh quwwat kam hoti jayegi, usi qadar ghat-ta jayega. Yeh kaifiyat kabhi ghiza ki kami se aur logon ke mel-jol se tark karne se bhi hasil ho jati hai. Kabhi to quwwat ko hasil kar ke insaan neki ke kaam yani shariat ke mutabiq is se kaam leta hai, is haal ko shariat ki istilah mein karamat kehte hain, jaadu nahin kehte. Aur kabhi is haal se baatil mein aur khilaf-e-shara kaamon mein madad leta hai aur deen se door pad jata hai. Aise logon ke aise qabil-e-hairat kaamon se kisi ko dhoka kha kar unhein wali na samajh lena chahiye, kyunke shariat ke khilaf chalne wala wali-e-Allah nahin ho sakta. Aap dekhte nahin ke sahih ahadith mein Dajjal ki baabat kya kuch aaya hai? Woh kaise kaise khilaf-e-aadat kaam kar ke dikhayega, lekin un ki wajah se woh Allah ka wali nahin balkay mal'oon-o-mardood hai. (3) Teesri qisam ka jaadu jinnat ke zariye zameen walon ki roohon se imdad-o-e'aanat talab karne ka hai. Mo'tazila aur falasifa is ke qaa'il nahin. In roohon se baaz makhsoos alfaaz aur a'maal se talluq paida karte hain, ise sihr-e-bil-aza'im aur amal-e-taskheer bhi kehte hain. (4) Chauthi qisam khayalat ka badal dena, aankhon par andhera daal dena aur shobda-bazi karna hai, jis se haqeeqat ke khilaf dikhai dene lagta hai. Tum ne dekha hoga ke shobda-baaz pehle ek kaam shuru karta hai, jab log dilchaspi ke sath is taraf nazrein jama dete hain aur un ki baaton ki taraf mutawajjeh ho kar hama-tan is mein masroof ho jate hain, woh furti se ek dusra kaam kar dalta hai jo logon ki nigahon se posheeda rehta hai aur ise dekh kar woh hairan reh jate hain. Baaz mufassireen ka qaul hai ke Firaun ke jadugaron ka jaadu bhi isi qisam ka tha, isi liye Quran mein hai aayat: (Saharu a'yun-an-naasi wast-arhabuhum wa jaa'u bi sihrin azeem) 7.

(Al-A'raf: 116) Logon ki aankhon par jadoo kardiya aur unke dilon mein dar bitha diya aur jagah hai yukhayyalu ilaihi Musa (A.S) ke khayal mein woh sab lakriyan aur rassiyan saanp ban kar daurti hui nazar aane lagin halankeh darhaqiqat aisa na tha wallahu a'lam. (5) Paanchwin qism ba'az cheezon ki tarkeeb de kar koi ajeeb kaam us se lena maslan ghore ki shakal banadiya us par ek sawaar bana kar bitha diya uske haath mein naqoos hai jahan ek sa'at guzri aur us naqoos mein se aawaz nikli halankeh koi use nahin chherhta, isi tarah insani surat is karigari se banayi keh goya asli insan hans raha hai ya ro raha hai, Firaun ke jadugaron ka jadoo bhi isi qism mein se tha keh woh banaye hue saanp waghera zai'baq ke ba'is zinda harkat karne wale dikhayi dete the ghari aur ghante aur chhoti chhoti cheezain jin se bari bari wazni cheezain khench aati hain sab isi qism mein dakhil hain haqiqat mein ise jadoo hi na kehna chahiye kyunkeh yeh toh ek tarkeeb aur karigari hai jis ke asbaab bilkul zahir hain jo unhein jaanta ho woh in asbaab-o-funoon se yeh kaam le sakta hai isi tarah ka woh heela bhi hai keh jo Bait-ul-Muqaddas ke Nasrani karte the keh pur-asrar tareeqay se garjay ki qandeelain jala dein aur use garjay ki karamat mashhoor kardi ya aur logon ko apne deen ki taraf jhuka liya ba'az Karamiya sufiyon ka bhi khayal hai keh agar targheeb-o-tarheeb ki hadeesain ghar li jayen aur logon ko ibadat ki taraf mail kiya jaye toh koi haraj nahin, lekin yeh bari ghalti hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs mujh par jaan boojh kar jhoot bole woh apni jagah jahannam mein muqarrar karle aur farmaya meri hadeesain bayan karte raho lekin mujh par jhoot na bandho mujh par jhoot bolne wala qatan jahannami hai. Ek Nasrani padri ne ek martaba dekha keh ek parind ka chhota sa bacha jise urne aur chalne phirne ki taqat nahin ek ghonslay mein baitha hai jab woh apni za'eef aur past aawaz nikalta hai toh aur parinday use sun kar raham kha kar zaitoon ka phal us ghonslay mein la la kar rakh jate hain us ne isi surat ka ek parinda kisi cheez ka banaya aur neeche se use khokhla rakha aur ek surakh uski chonch ki taraf rakha jis se hawa uske andar ghusti thi phir jab nikalti thi toh isi tarah ki aawaz us se paida hoti thi use la kar apne garjay mein hawa ke rukh rakh diya chhat mein ek chhota surakh kardiya taakeh hawa us se jaye ab jab hawa chalti aur uski aawaz nikalti toh is qism ke parinday jama hojate aur zaitoon ke phal la la kar rakh jate us ne logon mein shohrat deni shuru ki keh is garjay mein yeh karamat hai yahan ek buzurg ka mazar hai aur yeh karamat inhi ki hai logon ne bhi jab apni aankhon yeh an-honi ajeeb baat dekhi toh mu'taqid hogaye aur us qabr par nazr-o-niyaz charhane lage ab karamat door door tak mashhoor hogayi halankeh koi karamat na thi na mo'jiza tha sirf ek posheeda fun tha jise us mal'oon shakhs ne pet bharne ke liye posheeda taur par rakha tha aur ek la'nati firqa us par reejha hua tha. (6) Chhati qism jadoo ki ba'az dawaon mein ajeeb ajeeb khasiyatain hain maqnatees hi ko dekho keh loha kis tarah uski taraf khinch jata hai aksar soofi aur faqeer aur darwesh inhi heela saziyon ko karamat kar ke logon ko dikhate hain aur unhein mureed banate phirte hain.

(7) Saatwein qism dil par ek khaas qism ka asar daal kar us se jo chahna manwa lena hai maslan us se keh diya ke mujhe Ism-e-Azam yaad hai ya jinnaat meri qabza mein hain ab agar saamne wala kamzor dil, kachche kaanon aur bouday aqeeday wala hai toh woh usay sach samajh le ga aur us ki taraf se ek qism ka khauf, darr, haibat aur ra'ab us ke dil par baith jaye ga jo us ko za'eef bana de ga ab us waqt jo chahe kare ga aur us ka kamzor dil usay ajeeb ajeeb baatein dikhata jaye ga isi ko tumbala (aam zabaan mein isay mamool) kehte hain aur yeh aksar kam-aql logon par ho jaya karta hai aur ilm-e-firasat se kaamil aql wala aur kam-aql wala insaan maloom ho sakta hai aur is harkat ka karne wala apna yeh fe'l apni quwwat-e-qiyafa ke zariye se kam-aql shakhs ko pehchan kar ke hi karta hai. (8) Aathwein qism chughli karna jhoot sach mila kar kisi ke dil mein apna ghar kar lena aur khufiya chaalon se usay apna garweeda kar lena yeh chughal khori agar logon ko bharkane, badkane aur un ke darmiyan adawat-o-dushmani daalne ke liye ho toh shar'an haram hai jab islah ke taur par aur aapas mein ek dusre musalman ko milane ke liye koi aisi baat zahir keh di jaye jis se ek fareeq dusre fareeq se khush ho jaye ya koi aane wali museebat musalmanon par se tal jaye ya kuffar ki quwwat zail ho jaye un mein bad-dili phail jaye aur mukhalif-o-phoot par jaye toh yeh jaiz hai jaise hadith mein hai ke woh shakhs jhoota nahin jo bhalai ke liye idhar ki udhar le jata hai aur jaise hadith mein hai ke larai makr ka naam hai aur jaise Hazrat Na'eem bin Mas'ood R.A ne jang-e-Ahzab ke mauqa par kuffar-e-Arab aur kuffar-e-Yahood ke darmiyan kuch idhar udhar ki oopri baatein keh kar judai dalwa di thi aur unhein musalmanon ke muqabla mein shikast hui yeh kaam bade aali dimagh, zeerak aur mamla fehm shakhs ka hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke Imam Razi ne jaadu ki jo yeh aath qismein bayan ki hain yeh sirf ba-aitbar-e-lafz ke hain kyunke Arabi zabaan mein sahr yani jaadu har us cheez ko kehte hain jo bahut lateef aur bareek ho aur zahir-been insaan ki nigahon se us ke asbaab posheeda reh jayen isi waste ek hadith mein hai ke ba'az bayan bhi jaadu hota hai aur isi liye subh ke awwal waqt ko sahoor kehte hain ke woh makhfi hota hai aur is rag ko bhi sahr kehte hain jo ghiza ki jagah hai. Abu Jahl ne Badr wale din yahi kaha tha ke is ki sahr yani rag-e-ta'am maare khauf ke phool gayi. Hazrat Ayesha R.A farmati hain mere sahr-o-nahr ke darmiyan Rasool Allah ﷺ faut hue toh nahar se murad seena aur sahr se murad rag-e-ghiza.

Quran mein bhi hai aayat (Saharu a'yun-an-naas) ya'ni logon ki nigahon se apna jaadu ke waqt jo chahta hai dikha deta hai, ke Mu'tazila aur Abu Ishaq Isfaraini Shafi'i is ke qail nahin aur jaadu kabhi haath ki chalaki se bhi hota hai aur kabhi doron dhagon se bhi, kabhi Allah ka naam parh kar dam karne se bhi is mein ek khaas asar hota hai.

Jadu aur sher kabhi shayateen ka naam le kar shetani kaam se bhi log karte hain, kabhi dawaon waghera ke zariye se bhi jadu kiya jata hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is farman ke mutabiq ke baaz bayan jadu hain, do matlab ho sakte hain. Ek toh yeh ke bator-e-tareef ke aap ne farmaya ho aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke bator-e-muzammat ke yeh irshad hua ho ke woh apni ghalat baat is tarah bayan karta hai ke sach maloom hoti hai, jaise ek aur hadith mein hai ke kabhi mere paas tum muqadma le kar aate ho toh ek apni charb-zabani se apne ghalat dawe ko sahih sabit kar deta hai. Wazir Abu-ul-Muzaffar Yahya bin Muhammad bin Hubair (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne apni kitab "Al-Ashraf 'ala Madhahib-il-Ashraf" mein sahar ke baab mein kaha hai ke ijma hai ke jadu ek haqeeqat hai lekin Abu Hanifa (Rahimahullah / R.H) is ke qail nahin. Jadu ke seekhne wale aur ise istemaal mein lane wale ko Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Malik aur Imam Ahmad (Rahimahumullah / R.H) toh kafir batate hain. Imam Abu Hanifa ke baaz shagirdon ka qaul hai ke agar jadu ko bachao ke liye seekhe toh kafir nahin hota, haan jo is ka etiqad rakhe aur nafa dene wala samjhe, woh kafir hai. Aur isi tarah jo yeh khayal karta hai ke shayateen yeh kaam karte hain aur itni qudrat rakhte hain woh bhi kafir hai. Imam Shafi'i (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain jadugar se daryaft kiya jaye, agar woh Babil walon ka sa aqeeda rakhta ho aur saat sayyara sitaron ko taseer paida karne wala janta ho toh kafir hai aur agar yeh na ho toh bhi agar jadu ko jaiz janta ho toh bhi kafir hai. Imam Malik aur Imam Ahmad (Rahimahumullah / R.H) ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke jadugar ne jab jadu kiya aur jadu ko istemaal mein laya wahin use qatl kar diya jaye. Imam Shafi'i aur Imam Abu Hanifa (Rahimahumullah / R.H) farmate hain ke is ka qatl ba-wajah-e-hadd ke hai magar Imam Shafi'i ka bayan hai ke ba-wajah-e-qisas ke hai. Imam Malik, Imam Abu Hanifa aur ek mashhoor qaul mein Imam Ahmad (Rahimahumullah / R.H) ka farman hai ke jadugar se tauba bhi na karayi jaye, is ki tauba se is par se hadd nahin hategi aur Imam Shafi'i ka qaul hai ke is ki tauba maqbool hogi. Imam Ahmad ka hi sahih qaul hai. Ek riwayat mein yeh hai ke Ahl-e-Kitab ka jadugar bhi Imam Abu Hanifa ke nazdeek qatl kar diya jayega lekin teenon aur imamon ka mazhab is ke bar-khilaf hai. Labeed bin A'sam Yahudi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jadu kiya tha aur aap ne is ke qatl karne ko nahin farmaya. Agar koi Musalman aurat jadugarni ho toh is ke bare mein Imam Abu Hanifa farmate hain ke woh qaid kar di jaye aur teenon kehte hain ise bhi mard ki tarah qatl kar diya jaye, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Zuhri (Rahimahullah / R.H) ka qaul hai ke Musalman jadugar qatl kar diya jaye aur mushrik qatl na kiya jaye.

Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain agar zimmi ke jadoo se koi mar jaye toh zimmi ko bhi maar dalna chahiye. Yeh bhi aap se marwi hai ke pehle toh use kaha jaye ke tauba kar, agar woh kar le aur Islam qabool kare toh khair, warna qatl kar diya jaye aur yeh bhi aap se marwi hai ke agarche Islam qabool kar le taham qatl kar diya jaye. Us jadugar ko jis ke jadoo mein shirkiya alfaaz hon use charon Imam kafir kehte hain kyunke Quran mein hai fala takfur. Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain jab us par ghalba pa liya jaye phir woh tauba kare toh tauba qabool nahin hogi jis tarah zindiq ki tauba qabool nahin hogi. Haan us se pehle agar tauba kar le toh qabool hogi. Agar us ke jadoo se koi mar gaya phir toh bahar-surat mara jaye ga. Imam Shafi (R.H) farmate hain agar woh kahe ke main ne is par jadoo maar dalne ke liye nahin kiya toh qatl-e-khata ki diyat (jurmana) le liya jaye. Jadugar se us ke jadoo ko utarwane ki Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.A) ne ijazat di hai jaise Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai. Aamir Sha'bi (R.H) bhi is mein koi harj nahin batlate lekin Khwaja Hasan Basri (R.H) ise makrooh batate hain. Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein arz kiya tha, kaha aap kyun jadoo ko ifsha nahin karte? Toh aap ne farmaya mujhe toh Allah Ta'ala ne shifa de di aur main logon par burai ifsha karne se darta hoon. Hazrat Wahab (R.H) farmate hain beri ke saat patte le kar sil batte par koot liye jayen aur pani mila liya jaye, phir Ayatul Kursi parh kar us par dam kar diya jaye aur jis par jadoo kiya gaya hai use teen ghoont pila diya jaye aur baqi pani se ghusal kar diya jaye, Insha'Allah jadoo ka asar jata rahe ga. Yeh amal khusoosiyat se us shakhs ke liye bahut hi achha hai jo apni biwi se rok diya gaya ho. Jadoo ko door karne aur us ke asar ko zail karne ke liye sab se aala cheez Ayat (Qul A'uzu bi Rabbinnas) aur Ayat (Qul A'uzu bi Rabbil Falaq) ki suratein hain. Hadith mein hai ke in jaisa koi ta'weez nahin, isi tarah Ayatul Kursi bhi shaitan ko dafa karne mein aala darja ki cheez hai.

Imam Shafi'i aur Imam Abu Hanifa (Rahimahumullah / R.H) farmate hain ke is ka qatl ba-wajah-e-hadd ke hai magar Imam Shafi'i ka bayan hai ke ba-wajah-e-qisas ke hai. Imam Malik, Imam Abu Hanifa aur ek mashhoor qaul mein Imam Ahmad (Rahimahumullah / R.H) ka farman hai ke jadugar se tauba bhi na karayi jaye, is ki tauba se is par se hadd nahin hategi aur Imam Shafi'i ka qaul hai ke is ki tauba maqbool hogi. Imam Ahmad ka hi sahih qaul hai. Ek riwayat mein yeh hai ke Ahl-e-Kitab ka jadugar bhi Imam Abu Hanifa ke nazdeek qatl kar diya jayega lekin teenon aur imamon ka mazhab is ke bar-khilaf hai. Labeed bin A'sam Yahudi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jadu kiya tha aur aap ne is ke qatl karne ko nahin farmaya. Agar koi Musalman aurat jadugarni ho toh is ke bare mein Imam Abu Hanifa farmate hain ke woh qaid kar di jaye aur teenon kehte hain ise bhi mard ki tarah qatl kar diya jaye, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Zuhri (Rahimahullah / R.H) ka qaul hai ke Musalman jadugar qatl kar diya jaye aur mushrik qatl na kiya jaye.

Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain agar zimmi ke jadoo se koi mar jaye toh zimmi ko bhi maar dalna chahiye. Yeh bhi aap se marwi hai ke pehle toh use kaha jaye ke tauba kar, agar woh kar le aur Islam qabool kare toh khair, warna qatl kar diya jaye aur yeh bhi aap se marwi hai ke agarche Islam qabool kar le taham qatl kar diya jaye. Us jadugar ko jis ke jadoo mein shirkiya alfaaz hon use charon Imam kafir kehte hain kyunke Quran mein hai fala takfur. Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain jab us par ghalba pa liya jaye phir woh tauba kare toh tauba qabool nahin hogi jis tarah zindiq ki tauba qabool nahin hogi. Haan us se pehle agar tauba kar le toh qabool hogi. Agar us ke jadoo se koi mar gaya phir toh bahar-surat mara jaye ga. Imam Shafi (R.H) farmate hain agar woh kahe ke main ne is par jadoo maar dalne ke liye nahin kiya toh qatl-e-khata ki diyat (jurmana) le liya jaye. Jadugar se us ke jadoo ko utarwane ki Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.A) ne ijazat di hai jaise Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai. Aamir Sha'bi (R.H) bhi is mein koi harj nahin batlate lekin Khwaja Hasan Basri (R.H) ise makrooh batate hain. Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein arz kiya tha, kaha aap kyun jadoo ko ifsha nahin karte? Toh aap ne farmaya mujhe toh Allah Ta'ala ne shifa de di aur main logon par burai ifsha karne se darta hoon. Hazrat Wahab (R.H) farmate hain beri ke saat patte le kar sil batte par koot liye jayen aur pani mila liya jaye, phir Ayatul Kursi parh kar us par dam kar diya jaye aur jis par jadoo kiya gaya hai use teen ghoont pila diya jaye aur baqi pani se ghusal kar diya jaye, Insha'Allah jadoo ka asar jata rahe ga. Yeh amal khusoosiyat se us shakhs ke liye bahut hi achha hai jo apni biwi se rok diya gaya ho. Jadoo ko door karne aur us ke asar ko zail karne ke liye sab se aala cheez Ayat (Qul A'uzu bi Rabbinnas) aur Ayat (Qul A'uzu bi Rabbil Falaq) ki suratein hain. Hadith mein hai ke in jaisa koi ta'weez nahin, isi tarah Ayatul Kursi bhi shaitan ko dafa karne mein aala darja ki cheez hai.

Musalmano kafiron ki surat, libas aur zaban mein mushabahat se bacho! Is ayat mein Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko kafiron ki bol chaal aur unke kamon ki mushabahat se rok raha hai. Yahudi ba'az alfaz zaban daba kar bolte thay aur matlab bura lete thay. Jab unhein yeh kehna hota ke hamari suniye toh kehte thay 'Ra'ina' aur murad is se ra'unat aur sarkashi lete thay, jaise aur jagah bayan hai ayat (Minallazina hadu) yani yahudiyon mein aise log bhi hain jo baton ko asliyat se hata dete hain aur kehte hain hum sunte hain lekin mante nahin, apni zabanon ko mor tor kar is deen mein ta'ana zani ke liye 'Ra'ina' kehte hain. Agar yeh kehte ke hum ne suna aur mana, hamari baat suniye aur hamari taraf tawajjo kijiye toh yeh unke liye behtar aur munasib hota, lekin unke kufr ki wajah se Allah ne unhein apni rahmat se door phenk diya hai, is mein iman bahut hi kam hai. Ahadith mein yeh bhi aaya hai ke jab yeh log salam karte hain toh 'Assamu Alaikum' kehte hain aur 'Sam' ke ma'ani maut ke hain, toh tum unke jawab mein 'Wa Alaikum' kaha karo, hamari dua unke haq mein qabool hogi aur unki bad-dua hamare haq mein maqbool nahin hogi. Al-garaz qaul-o-fe'l mein un se mushabahat karna mana hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai: "Main Qayamat ke qareeb talwar ke sath bheja gaya hoon, meri rozi haq Ta'ala ne mere neze tale likhi hai, uske liye zillat aur pasti hai magar jo mere ahkam ke khilaf chale kare aur jo shakhs kisi (ghair muslim) qaum se mushabahat kare woh unhi mein se hai." Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh pichla hissa marwi hai. Is ayat aur hadith se sabit hua ke kuffar ke aqwal-o-af'al, libas, eid aur ibadat mein unki mushabahat karna jo hamare liye mashroo aur muqarrar nahin, sakht mana hai. Aisa karne walon ko shariat mein azab ki dhamki, sakht darawa aur hurmat ki ittila di gayi hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) farmate hain ke jab tum Quran-e-Karim mein ayat (Ya Ayyuhallazina Amanu) suno toh kaan laga do aur dil se mutawajjo ho jaya karo, kyunke ya toh kisi bhalai ka hukm hoga ya kisi burai se muman'at hogi. Hazrat Khaisama farmate hain, Taurat mein Bani Israel ko khitab karte hue Allah Ta'ala ne 'Ya Ayyuhal Masakin' farmaya hai, lekin Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ayat (Ya Ayyuhallazina Amanu) ke mo'azzaz khitab se yaad farmaya hai. 'Ra'ina' ke ma'ani hamari taraf kaan lagane ke hain, bar-wazn 'Aatina'. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain iske ma'ani khilaf ke bhi hain, yani khilaf na kaha karo. Is se yeh bhi marwi hai ke matlab yeh ke aap hamari suniye aur hum aap ki sunen. Ansar ne bhi yahi lafz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne kehna shuru kar diya tha jis se Quran-e-Pak ne unhein rok diya. Hasan farmate hain 'Ra'in' kehte hain (Ra'in mazaq ki baat ko kehte hain) yani tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki baton aur Islam se mazaq na kiya karo. Abu Sakhr kehte hain jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jane lagte toh jinhein koi baat kehni hoti woh kehte apna kaan idhar kijiye, Allah Ta'ala ne is be-adabi ke kalma se rok diya aur apne Nabi ki izzat karne ki ta'leem farmayi.

Suddi kehte hain Rifa'ah bin Zaid Yahudi Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se baatein karte hue yeh lafz kaha karta tha, musalmanon ne bhi yeh khayal kar ke yeh lafz adab ke hain, yahi lafz istemaal karne shuru kar diye jis par unhein rok diya gaya, jaise Surah Nisa mein hai. Maqsad yeh hai ke is kalma ko Allah ne bura jaana aur is ke istemaal se musalmanon ko rok diya, jaise hadith mein aaya hai ke angoor ko 'karm' aur ghulam ko 'abd' na kaho waghera. Ab Allah Ta'ala in bad-batin logon ke hasad-o-bughz ko bayan farmata hai ke ae musalmano! Tumhein jo is kamil Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zariye kamil shariat mili hai, is se yeh toh jal-bhun rahe hain. In se keh do ke yeh toh Allah ka fazl hai jise chahe inayat farmaye, woh bade hi fazl-o-karam wala hai.
