Tabdili ya Tansikh. Allah Ta'ala Mukhtar-e-Kul hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain naskh ke ma'ani badal ke hain. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain mitane ke ma'ani hain jo (kabhi) likhne mein baqi rehta hai aur hukm badal jata hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ke shagird aur Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) aur Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi (R.H) se bhi isi tarah marwi hai. Zahhak (R.H) farmate hain bhula dene ke ma'ani hain. "Atta farmate hain" chhor dene ke ma'ani hain. Suddi (R.H) kehte hain utha lene ke ma'ani hain, jaise aayat: "Ash-shaikhu wash-shaikhatu iza zanaya farjumuhuma albatta" yani zani mard-o-aurat ko sangsar kar diya karo. Aur jaise aayat: "Lau kana li-ibni Adama wadiyan min zahabin labtagha lahuma thalitha" yani Ibn-e-Adam ko agar do jangal sone ke mil jayen jab bhi woh teesre ki justuju mein rahega. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain ke ahkam mein tabdili hum kar diya karte hain, halal ko haram, haram ko halal, jaiz ko najaiz, najaiz ko jaiz wagaira. Amr-o-nahi, rok aur rukhsat, jaiz aur mamnoo kamon mein naskh hota hai. Haan jo khabrein di gayi hain, waqiyat bayan kiye gaye hain, un mein rad-o-badal-o-nasikh-o-mansookh nahin hota. Naskh ke lafzi ma'ani naqal karne ke bhi hain jaise kitab ke ek nuskhe se dusra naqal kar lena. Isi tarah yahan bhi chunke ek hukm ke badle dusra hukm hota hai is liye naskh kehte hain, khwah woh hukm ka badal jana ho khwah alfaz ka. Ulama-e-usool ki ibaratein is masle mein go mukhtalif hain magar ma'ani ke lihaz se sab qareeb qareeb ek hi hain. Naskh ke ma'ani kisi hukm-e-shar'i ka pichli daleel ki ro se hat jana hai. Kabhi halki cheez ke badle bhari aur kabhi bhari ke badle halki aur kabhi koi badal hi nahin hota hai. Naskh ke ahkam, is ki qismein, is ki shartein wagaira hain, is ke liye is fan ki kitabon ka mutala'a karna chahiye, tafsilat ki bast ki jagah nahin. Tabrani mein ek riwayat hai ke do shakhson ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek surat yaad ki thi, use woh parhte rahe. Ek martaba raat ki namaz mein har chand use parhna chaha lekin yaad ne sath na diya, ghabra kar khidmat-e-Nabawi mein hazir hue aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ka zikr kiya. Aap ne farmaya yeh mansookh ho gayi aur bhula di gayi, dilon mein nikal li gayi, tum gham na karo be-fikr ho jao. Hazrat Zuhri (R.H) noon khafifa pesh ke sath parhte the, is ke ek rawi Sulaiman bin Raqim za'eef hain. Abu Bakr Anbari (R.H) ne bhi dusri sanad se ise marfoo riwayat kiya hai, jaise Qurtubi (R.H) ka kehna hai. "Nunsaha" ko "Nansa-ha" bhi parha gaya hai. "Nansa-ha" ke ma'ani mo'akhar karne, piche hata dene ke hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ki tafsir mein farmate hain yani hum use chhor dete hain, mansookh karte hain. Ibn-e-Marwi hai hum use mo'akhar karte hain aur multawi karte hain. Atiyah Aufi (R.H) kehte hain yani mansookh nahin karte. Suddi (R.H) aur Rabee (R.H) bhi yahi kehte hain. Zahhak (R.H) farmate hain nasikh ko mansookh ke piche rakhte hain. Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) kehte hain apne paas use rok lete hain. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne khutba mein "Nunsilha" parha aur is ke ma'ani mo'akhar hone ke bayan kiye. Nunsaha jab parhein to yeh matlab hoga ke hum use bhula dein.

Allah Ta'ala jis hukm ko utha lena chahta tha woh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bhula deta tha is tarah woh aayat uth jaati thi. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) 'Nansaha' parhte thay to un se Qasim bin Rabi'ah ne kaha ke Sa'eed bin Musayyab to 'Nansaha' parhte hain to aap ne farmaya Sa'eed par ya Sa'eed ke khandan par to Quran nahin utra? Allah Ta'ala farmata hai aayat (SANUQRI'UKA FALA TANSA) (87. Al-A'la: 6) hum tujhe parhayenge jise tu na bhule ga aur farmata hai aayat (WADHKUR RABBAKA IDHA NASITA) (18. Al-Kahf: 24) jab bhool jaye to apne Rab ko yaad kar. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka farman hai ke Ali (R.A) sab se achha faisla karne wale hain aur Ubay (R.A) se zyada achhe Quran ke qari hain aur hum Ubay (R.A) ka qaul chhor dete hain is liye ke Ubay (R.A) kehte hain main ne to jo kuch Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai use nahin chhoroon ga aur farmate hain Wama naskh al-kh ya'ni hum jo mansookh karein ya bhula dein us se behtar late hain ya us jaisa (Bukhari o Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is se behtar hota hai ya'ni bandon ki sahoolat aur un ke aaram ke lihaz se ya us jaisa hota hai lekin maslahat-e-Ilahi is sabiqah cheez mein hoti hai makhlooq mein taghayyur-o-tabaddul karne wala paidaish aur hukm ka ikhtiyar rakhne wala. Ek Allah Ta'ala hi hai jis tarah jise chahta hai banata hai jise chahe nek bakhti deta hai jise chahe badbakhti deta hai jise chahe tandurusti jise chahe bimari, jise chahe taufiq jise chahe benaseeb kar de.

Bandon mein jo hukum chahe jaari kare, jise chahe halal jise chahe haram farma de, jise chahe rukhsat de jise chahe rok de. Woh hakim-e-mutlaq hai, jaise chahe ahkaam jaari farmaye, koi uske hukum ko rad nahin kar sakta, jo chahe kare koi us se baaz purs nahin kar sakta. Woh bandon ko aazmata hai aur dekhta hai ke woh nabiyon aur rasoolon ke kaise tabe-daar hain. Kisi cheez ka maslahat ki wajah se hukum diya phir maslahat ki wajah se hi us hukum ko hata diya. Ab aazmaish hoti hai, nek log us waqt bhi itaat ke liye kamar basta thay aur ab bhi hain, lekin bad-baatin log baatein banate hain aur naak bhon charhate hain. Halankeh tamam makhlooq ko apne khaliq ki tamam baatein manni chahiyein aur har haal mein Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki pairwi karni chahiye aur jo woh kahe use dil se sacha manna chahiye, jo hukum de baja lana chahiye, jis se roke ruk jana chahiye.

Is maqam par bhi yahudiyon ka zabardast rad hai aur un ke kufr ka bayan hai ke woh naskh ke qail na thay. Baaz toh kehte thay is mein aqli muhaal lazim aata hai aur baaz naqli muhaal bhi maante thay. Is aayat mein go khitab Fakhr-e-Aalam (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hai magar dar-asal yeh kalam yahudiyon ko sunana hai jo Injeel ko aur Quran ko is wajah se nahin maante thay ke un mein baaz ahkaam-e-Taurat ke mansookh ho gaye thay aur isi wajah se woh un nabiyon ki nabuwat ke bhi munkir ho gaye thay aur sirf inaad-o-takabbur ki bina thi, warna aqlan naskh muhaal nahin. Is liye ke jis tarah woh apne kaamon mein ba-ikhtiyar rahe isi tarah apne hukumon mein bhi ba-ikhtiyar rahe, jo chahe aur jab chahe paida kare, jise chahe aur jis tarah chahe aur jis waqt chahe rakhe. Isi tarah jo chahe aur jis waqt chahe hukum de, is hakimon ke hakim ka hakim kaun?

Isi tarah naqlan bhi yeh sabit shuda amr hai, agli kitabon aur pehli shariyaton mein maujood hai. Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki betiyan bete aapas mein bhai behan hote thay lekin nikah jaiz tha phir ise haram kar diya. Nooh (A.S / Alaihis Salam) jab kashti se utarte hain tab tamam haiwanat ka khana halal tha lekin phir baaz ki hillat mansookh ho gayi. Do behnon ka nikah Israel aur un ki aulad par halal tha lekin phir Taurat mein aur us ke baad haram ho gaya. Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko bete ki qurbani ka hukum diya phir qurban karne se pehle hi mansookh kar diya. Bani Israel ko hukum diya jata hai ke bachra poojne mein jo shamil thay sab apni jaanon ko qatl kar dalein lekin phir bahut se baqi thay ke yeh hukum mansookh ho jata hai. Isi tarah ke aur bahut se waqiat maujood hain aur khud yahudiyon ko un ka iqrar hai lekin phir bhi Quran aur Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh keh kar nahin maante ke is se Allah ke kalam mein naskh lazim aata hai aur woh muhaal hai. Baaz log jo is ke jawab mein lafzi behson mein par jate hain woh yaad rakhein ke is se dalalat nahin badalti aur maqsood wahi rehta hai.

Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki basharat yeh log apni kitabon mein paate thay, aap ki tabedari ka hukum bhi dekhte thay. Yeh bhi maloom tha ke aap ki shariat ke mutabiq jo amal na ho woh maqbool nahin hoga. Yeh aur baat hai ke koi kahe ke agli shariatein sirf aap ke aane tak hi thin is liye yeh shariat un ki nasikh nahin ya kahe ke nasikh hai, bahar-surat Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari ke baghair koi chara nahin. Is liye ke aap aakhri Kitabullah ke paas se abhi abhi le kar aaye hain. Pas is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne naskh ke jawaz ko bayan farma kar is mal'oon giroh Yahood ka radd kiya. Surah Al-Imran mein bhi, jis ke shuru mein Bani Israel ko khitab kiya gaya hai, naskh ke waqay hone ka zikr majood hai. Farmata hai aayat (Kullut-ta'ami) al-kh, yani sabhi khane Bani Israel par halal thay magar jis cheez ko Hazrat Israel (A.S) ne apne oopar haram kar liya tha, us ki mazeed tafseer wahin aayegi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Musalman kul ke kul muttafiq hain ke ahkam-e-Bari Ta'ala mein naskh ka hona jaiz hai, balkay waqay bhi hai aur Parwardigar ki hikmat-e-baligha ka dastoor bhi yahi hai. Abu Muslim Asbahani mufassir ne likha hai ke Quran mein naskh waqay nahin hota, lekin us ka yeh qaul za'eef aur mardood aur mehez ghalat aur jhoot hai. Jahan naskh-e-Quran majood hai us ke jawab mein go ba'az ne bohat mehnat se us ki tardeed ki hai lekin mehez besood. Dekhiye pehle us aurat ki iddat jis ka khawand mar jaye ek saal thi lekin phir chaar mahine das din hui aur dono aayatein Quran-e-Pak mein majood hain. Qibla pehle Bait-ul-Muqaddas tha, phir Ka'batullah hua aur dusri aayat saaf aur pehla hukum bhi zimnan mazkoor hai. Pehle ke musalmanon ko hukum tha ke ek ek musalman das das kafiron se lare aur un ke muqablay se na hate, lekin yeh phir hukum mansookh kar ke do do ke muqablay mein sabr karne ka hukum hua aur dono aayatein Kalamullah mein majood hain. Pehle hukum tha ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sargoshi karne se pehle kuch sadaqa diya karo, phir yeh hukum mansookh hua aur dono aayatein Quran-e-Kareem mein majood hain waghera. Wallahu A'lam.

Tabdili ya Tansikh. Allah Ta'ala Mukhtar-e-Kul hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain naskh ke ma'ani badal ke hain. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain mitane ke ma'ani hain jo (kabhi) likhne mein baqi rehta hai aur hukm badal jata hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ke shagird aur Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) aur Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi (R.H) se bhi isi tarah marwi hai. Zahhak (R.H) farmate hain bhula dene ke ma'ani hain. "Atta farmate hain" chhor dene ke ma'ani hain. Suddi (R.H) kehte hain utha lene ke ma'ani hain, jaise aayat: "Ash-shaikhu wash-shaikhatu iza zanaya farjumuhuma albatta" yani zani mard-o-aurat ko sangsar kar diya karo. Aur jaise aayat: "Lau kana li-ibni Adama wadiyan min zahabin labtagha lahuma thalitha" yani Ibn-e-Adam ko agar do jangal sone ke mil jayen jab bhi woh teesre ki justuju mein rahega. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain ke ahkam mein tabdili hum kar diya karte hain, halal ko haram, haram ko halal, jaiz ko najaiz, najaiz ko jaiz wagaira. Amr-o-nahi, rok aur rukhsat, jaiz aur mamnoo kamon mein naskh hota hai. Haan jo khabrein di gayi hain, waqiyat bayan kiye gaye hain, un mein rad-o-badal-o-nasikh-o-mansookh nahin hota. Naskh ke lafzi ma'ani naqal karne ke bhi hain jaise kitab ke ek nuskhe se dusra naqal kar lena. Isi tarah yahan bhi chunke ek hukm ke badle dusra hukm hota hai is liye naskh kehte hain, khwah woh hukm ka badal jana ho khwah alfaz ka. Ulama-e-usool ki ibaratein is masle mein go mukhtalif hain magar ma'ani ke lihaz se sab qareeb qareeb ek hi hain. Naskh ke ma'ani kisi hukm-e-shar'i ka pichli daleel ki ro se hat jana hai. Kabhi halki cheez ke badle bhari aur kabhi bhari ke badle halki aur kabhi koi badal hi nahin hota hai. Naskh ke ahkam, is ki qismein, is ki shartein wagaira hain, is ke liye is fan ki kitabon ka mutala'a karna chahiye, tafsilat ki bast ki jagah nahin. Tabrani mein ek riwayat hai ke do shakhson ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek surat yaad ki thi, use woh parhte rahe. Ek martaba raat ki namaz mein har chand use parhna chaha lekin yaad ne sath na diya, ghabra kar khidmat-e-Nabawi mein hazir hue aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ka zikr kiya. Aap ne farmaya yeh mansookh ho gayi aur bhula di gayi, dilon mein nikal li gayi, tum gham na karo be-fikr ho jao. Hazrat Zuhri (R.H) noon khafifa pesh ke sath parhte the, is ke ek rawi Sulaiman bin Raqim za'eef hain. Abu Bakr Anbari (R.H) ne bhi dusri sanad se ise marfoo riwayat kiya hai, jaise Qurtubi (R.H) ka kehna hai. "Nunsaha" ko "Nansa-ha" bhi parha gaya hai. "Nansa-ha" ke ma'ani mo'akhar karne, piche hata dene ke hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ki tafsir mein farmate hain yani hum use chhor dete hain, mansookh karte hain. Ibn-e-Marwi hai hum use mo'akhar karte hain aur multawi karte hain. Atiyah Aufi (R.H) kehte hain yani mansookh nahin karte. Suddi (R.H) aur Rabee (R.H) bhi yahi kehte hain. Zahhak (R.H) farmate hain nasikh ko mansookh ke piche rakhte hain. Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) kehte hain apne paas use rok lete hain. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne khutba mein "Nunsilha" parha aur is ke ma'ani mo'akhar hone ke bayan kiye. Nunsaha jab parhein to yeh matlab hoga ke hum use bhula dein.

Allah Ta'ala jis hukm ko utha lena chahta tha woh Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bhula deta tha is tarah woh aayat uth jaati thi. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) 'Nansaha' parhte thay to un se Qasim bin Rabi'ah ne kaha ke Sa'eed bin Musayyab to 'Nansaha' parhte hain to aap ne farmaya Sa'eed par ya Sa'eed ke khandan par to Quran nahin utra? Allah Ta'ala farmata hai aayat (SANUQRI'UKA FALA TANSA) (87. Al-A'la: 6) hum tujhe parhayenge jise tu na bhule ga aur farmata hai aayat (WADHKUR RABBAKA IDHA NASITA) (18. Al-Kahf: 24) jab bhool jaye to apne Rab ko yaad kar. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka farman hai ke Ali (R.A) sab se achha faisla karne wale hain aur Ubay (R.A) se zyada achhe Quran ke qari hain aur hum Ubay (R.A) ka qaul chhor dete hain is liye ke Ubay (R.A) kehte hain main ne to jo kuch Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai use nahin chhoroon ga aur farmate hain Wama naskh al-kh ya'ni hum jo mansookh karein ya bhula dein us se behtar late hain ya us jaisa (Bukhari o Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is se behtar hota hai ya'ni bandon ki sahoolat aur un ke aaram ke lihaz se ya us jaisa hota hai lekin maslahat-e-Ilahi is sabiqah cheez mein hoti hai makhlooq mein taghayyur-o-tabaddul karne wala paidaish aur hukm ka ikhtiyar rakhne wala. Ek Allah Ta'ala hi hai jis tarah jise chahta hai banata hai jise chahe nek bakhti deta hai jise chahe badbakhti deta hai jise chahe tandurusti jise chahe bimari, jise chahe taufiq jise chahe benaseeb kar de.

Bandon mein jo hukum chahe jaari kare, jise chahe halal jise chahe haram farma de, jise chahe rukhsat de jise chahe rok de. Woh hakim-e-mutlaq hai, jaise chahe ahkaam jaari farmaye, koi uske hukum ko rad nahin kar sakta, jo chahe kare koi us se baaz purs nahin kar sakta. Woh bandon ko aazmata hai aur dekhta hai ke woh nabiyon aur rasoolon ke kaise tabe-daar hain. Kisi cheez ka maslahat ki wajah se hukum diya phir maslahat ki wajah se hi us hukum ko hata diya. Ab aazmaish hoti hai, nek log us waqt bhi itaat ke liye kamar basta thay aur ab bhi hain, lekin bad-baatin log baatein banate hain aur naak bhon charhate hain. Halankeh tamam makhlooq ko apne khaliq ki tamam baatein manni chahiyein aur har haal mein Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki pairwi karni chahiye aur jo woh kahe use dil se sacha manna chahiye, jo hukum de baja lana chahiye, jis se roke ruk jana chahiye.

Is maqam par bhi yahudiyon ka zabardast rad hai aur un ke kufr ka bayan hai ke woh naskh ke qail na thay. Baaz toh kehte thay is mein aqli muhaal lazim aata hai aur baaz naqli muhaal bhi maante thay. Is aayat mein go khitab Fakhr-e-Aalam (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hai magar dar-asal yeh kalam yahudiyon ko sunana hai jo Injeel ko aur Quran ko is wajah se nahin maante thay ke un mein baaz ahkaam-e-Taurat ke mansookh ho gaye thay aur isi wajah se woh un nabiyon ki nabuwat ke bhi munkir ho gaye thay aur sirf inaad-o-takabbur ki bina thi, warna aqlan naskh muhaal nahin. Is liye ke jis tarah woh apne kaamon mein ba-ikhtiyar rahe isi tarah apne hukumon mein bhi ba-ikhtiyar rahe, jo chahe aur jab chahe paida kare, jise chahe aur jis tarah chahe aur jis waqt chahe rakhe. Isi tarah jo chahe aur jis waqt chahe hukum de, is hakimon ke hakim ka hakim kaun?

Isi tarah naqlan bhi yeh sabit shuda amr hai, agli kitabon aur pehli shariyaton mein maujood hai. Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki betiyan bete aapas mein bhai behan hote thay lekin nikah jaiz tha phir ise haram kar diya. Nooh (A.S / Alaihis Salam) jab kashti se utarte hain tab tamam haiwanat ka khana halal tha lekin phir baaz ki hillat mansookh ho gayi. Do behnon ka nikah Israel aur un ki aulad par halal tha lekin phir Taurat mein aur us ke baad haram ho gaya. Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko bete ki qurbani ka hukum diya phir qurban karne se pehle hi mansookh kar diya. Bani Israel ko hukum diya jata hai ke bachra poojne mein jo shamil thay sab apni jaanon ko qatl kar dalein lekin phir bahut se baqi thay ke yeh hukum mansookh ho jata hai. Isi tarah ke aur bahut se waqiat maujood hain aur khud yahudiyon ko un ka iqrar hai lekin phir bhi Quran aur Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh keh kar nahin maante ke is se Allah ke kalam mein naskh lazim aata hai aur woh muhaal hai. Baaz log jo is ke jawab mein lafzi behson mein par jate hain woh yaad rakhein ke is se dalalat nahin badalti aur maqsood wahi rehta hai.

Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki basharat yeh log apni kitabon mein paate thay, aap ki tabedari ka hukum bhi dekhte thay. Yeh bhi maloom tha ke aap ki shariat ke mutabiq jo amal na ho woh maqbool nahin hoga. Yeh aur baat hai ke koi kahe ke agli shariatein sirf aap ke aane tak hi thin is liye yeh shariat un ki nasikh nahin ya kahe ke nasikh hai, bahar-surat Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari ke baghair koi chara nahin. Is liye ke aap aakhri Kitabullah ke paas se abhi abhi le kar aaye hain. Pas is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne naskh ke jawaz ko bayan farma kar is mal'oon giroh Yahood ka radd kiya. Surah Al-Imran mein bhi, jis ke shuru mein Bani Israel ko khitab kiya gaya hai, naskh ke waqay hone ka zikr majood hai. Farmata hai aayat (Kullut-ta'ami) al-kh, yani sabhi khane Bani Israel par halal thay magar jis cheez ko Hazrat Israel (A.S) ne apne oopar haram kar liya tha, us ki mazeed tafseer wahin aayegi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Musalman kul ke kul muttafiq hain ke ahkam-e-Bari Ta'ala mein naskh ka hona jaiz hai, balkay waqay bhi hai aur Parwardigar ki hikmat-e-baligha ka dastoor bhi yahi hai. Abu Muslim Asbahani mufassir ne likha hai ke Quran mein naskh waqay nahin hota, lekin us ka yeh qaul za'eef aur mardood aur mehez ghalat aur jhoot hai. Jahan naskh-e-Quran majood hai us ke jawab mein go ba'az ne bohat mehnat se us ki tardeed ki hai lekin mehez besood. Dekhiye pehle us aurat ki iddat jis ka khawand mar jaye ek saal thi lekin phir chaar mahine das din hui aur dono aayatein Quran-e-Pak mein majood hain. Qibla pehle Bait-ul-Muqaddas tha, phir Ka'batullah hua aur dusri aayat saaf aur pehla hukum bhi zimnan mazkoor hai. Pehle ke musalmanon ko hukum tha ke ek ek musalman das das kafiron se lare aur un ke muqablay se na hate, lekin yeh phir hukum mansookh kar ke do do ke muqablay mein sabr karne ka hukum hua aur dono aayatein Kalamullah mein majood hain. Pehle hukum tha ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sargoshi karne se pehle kuch sadaqa diya karo, phir yeh hukum mansookh hua aur dono aayatein Quran-e-Kareem mein majood hain waghera. Wallahu A'lam.

Kasrat-e-sawal hujjat-bazi ke mutaradif hai! Is Ayat-e-Karima mein Allah Ta'ala iman walon ko rokte hue farmata hai ke kisi waqia ke hone se pehle mere Nabi se fuzool sawal na kiya karo. Yeh kasrat-e-sawal ki aadat bahut buri hai jaise aur jagah irshad hai Ayat (Ya ayyuhallazina amanu la tas'alu an ashya'a) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 101) Iman walo! Un cheezon ka sawal na kiya karo jo agar zahir kar di jayen to tumhein bura lagega aur agar tum Quran ke nazil hone ke zamana mein aise sawalon ka silsila jari rakhoge to yeh baatein zahir kar di jayengi. Kisi baat ke waqay hone se pehle uski nisbat sawal karne mein khauf yeh hai ke kahin us sawal ki wajah se woh haram na ho jayen. Sahih hadith mein hai ke musalmanon mein se bada mujrim woh hai jo us cheez ke bare mein sawal kare jo haram na thi phir uske sawal se haram ho gayi. Ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya gaya ke "Ek shakhs apni biwi ke sath ghair mard ko paye to kya kare? Agar logon ko khabar kare to yeh bhi badi besharmi ki baat hai aur agar chup ho jaye to badi beghairati ki baat hai?" Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh sawal bahut bura maloom hua, aakhir usi shakhs ko aisa waqia pesh aaya aur Li'an ka hukm nazil hua. Sahihain ki ek hadith mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) fuzool bakwas, maal ko zaya karne aur zyada pooch gach se mana farmaya karte the. Sahih Muslim mein hai, "Main jab tak kuch na kahoon, tum bhi na poocho. Tum se pehle logon ko isi bad-khaslat ne halak kar diya ke woh bakasrat sawal karte the aur apne Nabiyon (A.S) ke samne ikhtilaf karte the. Jab main tumhein koi hukm doon to apni taqat ke mutabiq baja lao aur agar mana karoon to ruk jaya karo." Yeh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us waqt farmaya tha jab logon ko khabar di ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne tum par Hajj farz kiya hai to kisi ne kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) har saal?" Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khamosh ho gaye. Usne phir poocha, aap ne koi jawab na diya. Usne teesri dafa phir yahi sawal kiya, aap ne farmaya, "Har saal nahin, lekin agar main haan keh deta to har saal farz ho jata aur phir tum kabhi bhi is hukm ko baja na la sakte." Phir aap ne mandarja-bala farman irshad farmaya. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain, jab hamein aap se sawal karne se rok diya gaya to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poochte hue haibat khate the, chahte the ke koi badiyanashin (dehati) nawaqif shakhs aa jaye woh pooche to hum bhi sun lein. Hazrat Bara bin Azib (R.A) farmate hain, main koi sawal Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se karna chahta tha to saal saal bhar guzar jata tha ke mare haibat ke poochne ki jurrat nahin hoti thi, hum to khwahish rakhte the ke koi A'rabi aaye aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kar baithe phir hum bhi sun lein. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain, Ashab-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se behtar koi jamaat nahin, unhone Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sirf barah hi masle pooche jo sab sawal ma' jawab ke Quran-e-Pak mein mazkoora hain, jaise sharab wagaira ka sawal, hurmat wale mahinon ki babat ka sawal, yateemon ki babat ka sawal wagaira wagaira.

Yahan par "Am" ya "Tubil" ke ma'ani mein hai ya apne asli ma'ani mein hai yani sawal ke bare mein jo yahan par inkari hai yeh hukm momin kafir sab ko hai kyunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat sab ki taraf thi. Quran mein aur jagah hai ayat (Yasaluka ahlul kitabi) (Surah An-Nisa: 153) ahl-e-kitab tujh se sawal karte hain ke tu un par koi aasmani kitab utare, unhon ne Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se is se bhi bada sawal kiya tha ke Allah ko hum apni aankhon se dekhna chahte hain jis zulm ki wajah se unhein ek tund-o-tez aawaz se halak kar diya gaya. Rafi' bin Harmala aur Wahb bin Zaid ne kaha tha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) koi aasmani kitab hum par nazil kijiye jise hum padhein aur hamare shahron mein darya jaari kar dein to hum aap ko maan lein, is par yeh ayat utri. Abu Al-Aliyah kehte hain ke ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kaash ke hamare gunahon ka kaffara bhi isi tarah ho jata jis tarah Bani Israel ke gunahon ka kaffara tha, aap ne yeh sunte hi teen dafa Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz ki ke "Nahin, Ilah nahin" hum yeh nahin chahte, phir farmaya suno Bani Israel mein se jahan koi gunah karta us ke darwaze par qudratan likha hua paya jata aur sath hi us ka kaffara bhi likha hua hota tha, ab ya to duniya ki ruswai ko manzoor kar ke kaffara ada kar de aur apne posheeda gunahon ko zahir kare ya kaffara na de aur aakhirat ki ruswai manzoor kare, lekin tum se Allah Ta'ala ne farma diya ayat (Wa man ya'mal su'an au yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha ghafooran raheema) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) yani jis se koi bura kaam ho jaye ya woh apni jaan par zulm kar baithe phir istighfar kare to woh Allah ko bahut bada bakhshish aur meherbani karne wala payega.

Isi tarah ek namaz dusri namaz tak gunahon ka kaffara ho jati hai, phir jumma dusre jumma tak kaffara ho jata hai. Suno! Jo shakhs burai ka irada kare lekin burai na kare to burai likhi nahin jati aur agar kar guzre to ek hi burai likhi jati hai, aur agar bhalai ka irada kare phir go na kare lekin bhalai likh li jati hai aur agar kar bhi le to das bhalaiyan likhi jati hain. Ab batao tum achhe rahe ya Bani Israel? Tum Bani Israel se bahut hi achhe ho. Haan, bawajood itne karam aur rahm ke phir bhi koi halak ho to samjho ke yeh khud halak hone wala hi tha. Is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Quraishiyon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke agar Safa pahar sone ka ho jaye to hum imaan late hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya achha, lekin phir Ma'ida (aasmani dastarkhwan) mangne walon ka jo anjam hua wahi tumhara bhi hoga. Is par woh inkari ho gaye aur apne sawal ko chhor diya. Murad yeh hai ke takabbur, inaad, sarkashi ke sath nabiyon se sawal karna nihayat mazmoom harkat hai. Jo kufr ko imaan ke badle mol le aur aasani ko sakhti se badle woh seedhi rah se hat kar jahalat-o-zalalat mein ghar jata hai. Isi tarah ghair zaroori sawal karne wala bhi, jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Alam tara ilallazina baddalu ni'matallahi kufraw wa ahallu qawmahum daral bawar) (14. Ibrahim: 28). Kya tu unhein nahin dekhta jo Allah ki ne'mat ko kufr se badalte hain aur apni qawm ko halakat mein dalte hain? Woh jahannam mein dakhil honge aur woh bari buri qarargah hai.

Qaumi asabiyat ba'is-e-shaqawat hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Huyay bin Akhtab aur Abu Yasir bin Akhtab yeh dono Yahudi sab se zyada Musalmanon ke hasid thay, logon ko Islam se rokte thay aur Arabon se jalte thay. In ke bare mein yeh aayat nazil hui. Ka'ab bin Ashraf ka bhi yahi shughal tha. Zuhri (R.H) kehte hain is ke bare mein yeh aayat nazil hui hai, yeh bhi Yahudi tha aur apne sher-on mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hajo kiya karta tha. Go un ki kitab mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq majood thi aur yeh bakhoobi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifatein jante thay aur Aap ko achi tarah pehchante thay. Phir yeh bhi dekh rahe thay ke Quran un ki kitab ki tasdeeq kar raha hai, ek ummi aur an-parh woh kitab parhta hai jo sarasar mojiza hai, lekin sirf hasad ki bina par ke yeh Arab mein Aap kyun mab'oos hue, kufr-o-afkar par aamada ho gaye, balkay aur logon ko bhi behkana shuru kar diya. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne mominon ko hukum diya ke tum darguzar karte raho aur Allah ke hukum ka aur us ke faisle ka intezar karo. Jaise aur jagah farmaya: Tumhein mushrikon aur Ahl-e-Kitab se bohat karwi baatein sunni paren gi, magar baad mein hukum nazil farma diya ke in mushrikeen se ab dab kar na raho, in se larai karne ki tumhein ijazat hai. Shaitan sifat maghroor Yahudi: Yahan par Yahudiyon aur Nasraniyon ke ghuroor ka bayan ho raha hai ke woh apne siwa kisi ko kuch bhi nahin samajhte aur saaf kehte hain ke hamare siwa jannat mein koi nahin jayega. Surah Ma'idah mein un ka ek qaul yeh bhi bayan hua hai ke hum Allah Ta'ala ki aulad aur us ke mehboob hain jis ke jawab mein Quran ne kaha ke phir tum par Qayamat ke din azab kyun hoga? Isi tarah ke mafhoom ka bayan pehle bhi guzra hai ke un ka da'wa yeh bhi tha ke hum chand din jahannam mein rahenge jis ke jawab mein irshad-e-Bari hua ke yeh da'wa bhi mehez be-daleel hai. Isi tarah yahan un ke ek da'we ki tardeed ki aur kaha ke lao daleel pesh karo, unhein aajiz sabit kar ke phir farmaya ke haan jo koi bhi Allah ka farmanbardar ho jaye aur khuloos-o-tauheed ke sath nek amal kare use pura pura ajar-o-sawab milega, jaise aur jagah farmaya ke yeh agar jhagrein to un se keh do ke main aur mere manne walon ne apne chehre Allah ke samne mutawajjah kar diye hain. Garz yeh hai ke ikhlas aur mutabiqat-e-sunnat har amal ki qabooliyat ke liye shart hai to 'aslama wajhahu' se murad khuloos aur 'wa huwa muhsin' se murad itteba-e-sunnat hai. Nira khuloos bhi amal ko qabool nahin kara sakta jab tak sunnat ki tabedari na ho. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai jo shakhs aisa amal kare jis par hamara hukm na ho woh mardood hai (Muslim). Pas rahbaniyat ka amal go khuloos par mabni ho lekin taham itteba-e-sunnat na hone ki wajah se woh mardood hai. Aise hi a'maal ki nisbat Quran-e-Kareem ka irshad hai: Ayat (Wa qadimna ila ma 'amilu min 'amalin fa ja'alnahu haba'an mansura) (25. Al-Furqan: 23) yani unhon ne jo a'maal kiye the hum ne sab radd kar diye. Dusri jagah farmaya kafiron ke a'maal ret ke chamkile todon ki tarah hain jinhein pyasa pani samajhta hai lekin jab us ke paas jata hai to kuch nahin pata. Aur jagah hai ke Qayamat ke din bahut se chehron par zillat barasti hogi jo amal karne wale takleefen uthane wale honge aur bhadakti hui aag mein dakhil honge aur garam kholta hua pani unhein pilaya jayega. Hazrat Amir-ul-Momineen Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne is ayat ki tafsir mein murad Yahud-o-Nasara ke ulama aur aabid liye hain. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke koi amal go bazahir sunnat ke mutabiq ho lekin amal mein ikhlas na ho, maqsood Allah ki khushnudi na ho to woh amal bhi mardood hai. Riya-kar aur munafiq logon ke a'maal ka bhi yahi haal hai jaise Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke munafiq Allah ko dhoka dete hain aur woh unhein dhoka deta hai aur namaz ko khade hote hain to susti se khade hote hain, sirf logon ko dikhane ke liye amal karte hain aur Allah ka zikr bahut hi kam karte hain aur farmaya Ayat (Fawailul-lil-musallin) un namaziyon ke liye 'wail' hai jo apni namaz se ghafil hain, jo riyakari karte hain aur chhoti chhoti cheezein bhi rokte phirte hain. Aur jagah irshad hai Ayat (Faman kana yarju liqa'a Rabbihi falya'mal 'amalan salihaun wa la yushrik bi 'ibadati Rabbihi ahada) (18. Al-Kahf: 110).

(Al-Kahf: 110) Jo shakhs apne Rab ki mulaqat ka aarzoo-mand ho use nek amal karna chahiye aur apne Rab ki ibadat mein kisi ko shareek na karna chahiye. Phir farmaya unhein unka Rab ajar dega aur dar-o-khauf se bachaye ga, aakhirat mein unhein dar nahin aur duniya ke chhorne ka malal nahin. Phir Yahood-o-Nasara ki aapas ki bughz-o-adawat ka zikr farmaya, Najran ke Nasraniyon ka wafd jab Nabi Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya to unke paas Yahoodiyon ke ulama bhi aaye, us waqt un logon ne unhein aur unhon ne unko gumrah bataya halankeh dono Ahl-e-Kitab hain. Taurat mein Injeel ki tasdeeq aur Injeel mein Taurat ki tasdeeq majood hai, phir unka yeh qaul kis qadar laghw hai. Agle Yahood-o-Nasara deen-e-haq par qaim thay lekin phir bid'aton aur fitna-pardaziyon ki wajah se deen un se chhin gaya, ab na Yahood hidayat par thay na Nasrani. Phir farmaya keh na janne walon ne bhi isi tarah kaha, is mein bhi ishara unhi ki taraf hai aur baaz ne kaha murad is se Yahood-o-Nasara se pehle ke log hain. Baaz kehte hain Arab log murad hain, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer is se aam log murad lete hain goya sab shamil hain aur yahi theek bhi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmaya keh ikhtilaf ka faisla Qayamat ko khud Allah Ta'ala karega jis din koi zulm-o-zor nahin hoga aur yahi mazmoon dusri jagah bhi aaya hai. Surah Hajj mein irshad hai, aayat (Innal-laha yafsilu bainahum yaumal qiyamah) (22. Al-Hajj: 17) yani mominon aur Yahoodiyon aur Sabiyon aur Nasraniyon aur Majusiyon aur mushrikon mein Qayamat ke din Allah faisla farmaye ga, Allah Ta'ala har cheez par gawah aur majood hai. Aur jagah irshad hai, aayat (Qul yajma'u bainana Rabbuna summa yaftahu bainana bil-haqqi wa huwal Fattahul 'Aleem) (34. Saba: 26) keh de keh hamara Rab hamein jama karega phir haq ke sath faisla karega, woh ba-khabar faisle karne wala hai.

Nasara aur Yahudi mukafat-e-amal ka shikar! Is ayat ki tafsir mein do qaul hain. Ek toh yeh ke is se murad Nasara hain, dusra yeh ke is se murad Mushrikeen hain. Nasrani bhi Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki masjid mein paleedi daal dete thay aur logon ko is mein namaz ada karne se rokte thay. Bakht-e-Nasr ne jab Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki barbadi ke liye charhai ki thi toh in Nasranyon ne is ka sath diya tha aur madad ki thi. Bakht-e-Nasr Babul ka rehne wala Majusi tha aur Yahudiyon ki dushmani par Nasranyon ne bhi is ka sath diya tha aur is liye bhi ke Bani Israel ne Hazrat Yahya bin Zakariya (A.S) ko qatl kar dala tha. Aur Mushrikeen ne bhi Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko Hudaibiya wale saal Ka'batullah se roka tha, yahan tak ke Zi-Tawa mein aap ko qurbaniyan dena parin aur Mushrikeen se sulah karne ke baad aap wahin se wapas aa gaye, halankeh yeh aman ki jagah thi, baap aur bhai ke qatil ko bhi yahan koi nahin chher-ta tha aur in ki koshish yahi thi ke Zikr-e-Allah aur Hajj-o-Umrah karne wali Muslim jamaat ko rok dein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka yahi qaul hai. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne pehle qaul ko pasand farmaya hai aur kaha hai ke Mushrikeen Ka'batullah ko barbad karne ki sa'i nahin karte thay, yeh sa'i Nasara ki thi ke woh Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki veerani ke darpay ho gaye thay. Lekin haqeeqat mein dusra qaul zyada sahih hai, Ibn-e-Zaid aur Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ka qaul bhi yahi hai aur is baat ko bhi na bhoolna chahiye ke jab Nasranyon ne Yahudiyon ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas se roka tha, us waqt Yahudi bhi mehez bedeen ho chuke thay. Un par toh Hazrat Dawood (A.S) aur Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ki zabani la'natain nazil ho chuki thin, woh nafarman aur had se mutajawiz ho chuke thay aur Nasrani Hazrat Masih (A.S) ke deen par thay. Is se maloom hota hai ke is ayat se murad Mushrikeen-e-Makkah hain aur yeh bhi ek wajah hai ke oopar Yahood-o-Nasara ki muzammat bayan hui thi aur yahan Mushrikeen-e-Arab ki is bad-khaslat ka bayan ho raha hai ke unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko aur aap (ﷺ) ke sahabiyon ko Masjid-ul-Haram se roka, Makkah se nikala, phir Hajj waghera se bhi rok diya. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ka yeh farman ke Makkah wale Baitullah ki veerani mein koshan na thay, is ka jawab yeh hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aur Sahaba (R.A) ko wahan se rokne aur nikal dene aur Baitullah mein but bitha dene se barh kar is ki veerani kya ho sakti hai? Khud Quran mein majood hai ayat (وَهُمْ يَصُدُّوْنَ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ) (8. Al-Anfal: 34) aur jagah farmaya ayat (مَا كَانَ لِلْمُشْرِكِيْنَ اَنْ يَّعْمُرُوْا مَسٰجِدَ اللّٰهِ شٰهِدِيْنَ عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ بالْكُفْرِ) (9. At-Tawbah: 17).

(At-Tawbah: 17) Ya'ni yeh log Masjid-e-Haram se rokte hain. Mushrikon se Allah ki masajid abad nahin hosakti hain jo apne kufr ke khud gawah hain, jin ke a'maal gharat hain aur jo hamesha ke liye jahannami hain. Masajid ki abadi un logon se hoti hai jo Allah par aur Qayamat ke din par imaan rakhne wale aur namaz-o-zakat ke paband aur sirf Allah hi se darne wale hain. Yehi log rah-e-rast wale hain. Aur jagah farmaya aayat (HUMUL-LAZEENA KAFARU WA SADDUKUM 'ANIL-MASJIDIL-HARAMI WAL-HADYAM MA'KUFAN AY YABLUGA MAHILLAH) (48. Al-Fath: 25). In logon ne bhi kufr kiya aur tumhein Masjid-e-Haram se bhi roka aur qurbaniyon ko un ke zibah hone ki jagah tak na pahunchne diya. Agar hamein un momin mardon aurton ka khayal na hota jo apni za'eefi aur kam-quwwati ke ba'is Makkah se nahin nikal sake. Jinhein tum jante bhi nahin ho to hum tumhein un se lad kar un ke gharat kar dene ka hukum dete, lekin yeh beganah musalman pis na diye jayen is liye hum ne sardast yeh hukum nahin diya. Lekin yeh kuffar apni shararton se baaz na aaye to woh waqt door nahin jab un par hamare dard-naak azab baras padein. Pas jab woh musalman hastiyan jin se masajid ki abadi haqeeqi ma'ni mein hai woh hi rok diye gaye to masajid ke ujadne mein kaunsi kami reh gayi? Masajid ki abadi sirf zahiri zeb-o-zeenat rang-o-roghan se nahin hoti balki is mein zikr-e-Allah hona, is mein shariat ka qaim rehna aur shirk aur zahiri mail-kuchail se paak rakhna yeh un ki haqeeqi abadi hai. Phir farmaya ke unhein laiq nahin ke be-khaufi aur be-baki ke sath Baitullah mein na aane do, hum tumhein ghalib kar denge us waqt yehi karna. Chunancha jab Makkah fath ho gaya, agle saal 9 Hijri ailan kara diya ke is saal ke ba'd hajj mein koi mushrik na aane paye aur Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf koi nanga ho kar na kare. Jin logon ke darmiyan sulh ki koi muddat muqarrar hui hai woh qaim hai. Yeh hukum darasal tasdeeq aur amal hai is aayat par aayat (YA AYYUHAL-LAZEENA AMANU INNAMAL-MUSHRIKUNA NAJASUN FALA YAQRABUL-MASJIDAL-HARAMA BA'DA 'AMIHIM HAZA) (9. At-Tawbah: 28). Ya'ni mushrik log najas hain, is saal ke ba'd unhein Masjid-e-Haram mein na aane do. Aur yeh ma'ni bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke chahiye to yeh tha ke yeh mushrik kanpte hue aur khauf-zada masjid mein aayen lekin barkhilaf is ke ulte yeh musalmanon ko rok rahe hain. Yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai ke is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko basharat deta hai ke anqareeb main tumhein ghalba dunga aur yeh mushrik is masjid ki taraf rukh karne se bhi kapkapane lagenge. Chunancha yehi hua aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne wasiyat ki ke Jazeerat-ul-Arab mein do deen baqi na rehne payein aur Yahood-o-Nasara ko wahan se nikal diya jaye. Alhamdulillah ke is ummat ke buzurgon ne is wasiyat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par amal bhi kar dikhaya. Is se masajid ki fazeelat aur buzurgi bhi sabit hui, bilkhusoos is jagah ki aur masjid ki jahan sab se bade aur kul jinn-o-ins ke Rasool Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bheje gaye the.

In kafiron par duniya ki ruswai bhi aayi, jis tarah unhon ne musalmanon ko roka jala-watan kiya theek uska poora badla unhein mila yeh bhi roke gaye, jala-watan kiye gaye aur abhi ukhrawi azab baqi hain kyunke unhon ne Baitullah Sharif ki hurmat todi wahan but bithaye ghair-Allah se duayein aur munajatein shuru kar dein. Nange ho kar Baitullah ka tawaf kiya waghera aur agar is se murad Nasrani liye jayein toh bhi zahir hai ke unhon ne bhi Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki be-hurmati ki thi, bilkhusoos us Sakhra (patthar) ki jis ki taraf Yahood namaz padhte the, isi tarah jab Yahoodiyon ne bhi Nasraniyon se bahut zyada hatak ki aur toh un par zillat bhi is wajah se zyada nazil hui. Duniya ki ruswai se murad Imam Mahdi ke zamana ki ruswai bhi hai aur jizya ki adaigi bhi hai. Hadith Sharif mein ek dua warid hui hai. Dua: (Allahumma ahsin aqibatana fil-umuri kulliha wa ajirna min khiz-yid-dunya wa azabil-akhirah) Aye Allah tu hamare tamam kamon ka anjam achha kar aur duniya ki ruswai aur akhirat ke azab se nijat de. Yeh hadith Hasan hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein majood hai, Sahah-e-Sitta mein nahin. Is ke rawi Bashr bin Artah Sahabi hain. Un se ek toh yeh hadith marwi hai dusri woh hadith marwi hai jis mein hai ke ghazwe aur jang ke mauqa par hath na kaate jayein.

Ka'aba sirf alamat-e-wahdat-o-simt hai, Allah ka jamal-o-jalal ghair mehdood hai. Is ayat mein Nabi (ﷺ) aur aap ke un ashab ko tasalli di ja rahi hai jo Makkah se nikale gaye aur apni masjid se roke gaye. Huzoor (ﷺ) Makkah Sharif mein namaz Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf munh kar ke parhte to Ka'abatullah bhi samne hi hota tha, jab Madina tashreef laye to solah satrah mah tak to udhar hi namaz parhte rahe magar phir Allah Ta'ala ne Ka'abatullah ki taraf mutawajja hone ka hukum diya. Imam Abu Ubaidah Qasim bin Salam ne apni kitab Nasikh Mansookh mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se riwayat ki hai ke Quran mein sab se pehla mansookh hukum yahi Qibla ka hukum hai. Lillah-il-Mashriqu wali ayat nazil hui, Huzoor (ﷺ) Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf munh kar ke namazein parhne lage, phir ayat (وَمِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 149) nazil hui aur aap ne Baitullah ki taraf mutawajja ho kar namaz ada karni shuru ki. Madina mein jab Huzoor (ﷺ) Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf munh kar ke namaz parhne lage to Yahood bahut khush hue lekin jab yeh hukum chand mah ke baad mansookh hua aur aap ko apni chahat, dua aur intezar ke mutabiq Ka'abatullah ki taraf munh kar ke namazein parhne ka hukum diya gaya to un Yahudiyon ne ta'ane dene shuru kar diye ke ab is Qibla se kyun hat gaye? To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari ke Mashriq-o-Maghrib ka malik Allah Ta'ala hi hai, phir yeh aitraz kiya? Jidhar us ka hukum ho phir jana chahiye. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Mashriq-Maghrib mein jahan kahin bhi ho munh Ka'aba ki taraf karo. Ba'az buzurgon ka bayan hai ke yeh ayat Ka'aba ki taraf mutawajja hone ke hukum se pehle utri hai aur matlab yeh hai ke Mashriq-Maghrib jidhar chaho munh phero, sab jihat Allah ki hain aur sab taraf Allah maujood hai, is se koi jagah khali nahin, jaise farmaya ayat (وَلَآ اَدْنٰى مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَآ اَكْثَرَ اِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ اَيْنَ مَا كَانُوْا) (Surah Al-Mujadilah: 7) thore bahut jo bhi hon Allah un ke sath hai, phir yeh hukum mansookh ho kar Ka'abatullah ki taraf mutawajja hona farz hua. Is qaul mein jo yeh lafz hain ke Allah se koi jagah khali nahin, agar is se murad ilm-e-Allah ho to sahi hai, koi makan Allah ke ilm se khali nahin aur agar Zaat-e-Bari murad ho to theek nahin, Allah Ta'ala ki pak zaat is se bahut buland-o-bala hai ke woh apni makhlooq mein se kisi cheez mein mehsoor ho. Ek matlab ayat ka yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke yeh ayat safar aur rah-rawi aur khauf ke waqt ke liye hai ke un waqton mein nafl namaz ko jis taraf munh ho ada kar liya karo.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar R.A se marwi hai ke un ki oontni ka munh jis tarah hota tha namaz parh lete thay aur farmate thay ke Huzoor ﷺ ka tareeqa yahi tha aur is aayat ka matlab bhi yahi hai. Aayat ka zikr kiye baghair yeh hadees Muslim, Tirmidhi, Nasai, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim, Ibn-e-Marduyah waghaira mein marwi hai aur asal is ki Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim mein bhi majood hai. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Ibn-e-Umar R.A se jab namaz-e-khauf ke bare mein poocha jata to namaz-e-khauf ko bayan farmate aur kehte ke jab is se bhi zyada khauf ho to paidal aur sawar kharay parh liya karo, munh khwah Qibla ki janib ho khwah na ho. Hazrat Nafi ka bayan hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A mere khayal se isay marfoo bayan karte thay. Imam Shafi R.H ka mashhoor farman aur Imam Abu Hanifa R.H ka qaul hai ke safar khwah pur-aman ho khwah khauf, dar aur larai ka ho, sawari par nafl ada kar lene jaiz hain. Imam Malik R.H aur aap ki jamaat is ke khilaf hai. Imam Abu Yusuf R.H aur Abu Saeed Istakhri R.H baghair safar ke bhi isay jaiz kehte hain, Hazrat Anas R.A se bhi yeh riwayat hai. Imam Abu Jafar Tabri R.H bhi isay pasand farmate hain yahan tak ke woh to paidal chalne wale ko bhi rukhsat dete hain. Baaz aur mufassireen ke nazdeek yeh aayat un logon ke bare mein nazil hui hai jinhein Qibla maloom na ho saka aur unhon ne qayas se mukhtalif jahaton ki taraf namaz parhi jis par yeh aayat nazil hui aur un ki woh namaz ada shuda batai gayi. Hazrat Rabia R.H farmate hain hum Nabi ﷺ ke sath ek safar mein thay, ek manzil par utray, raat andheri thi, logon ne patthar le le kar bator-e-nishan ke Qibla rukh rakh kar namaz parhni shuru kar di, subah uth kar roshni mein dekha to namaz Qibla ki taraf ada nahin hui thi, hum ne Huzoor ﷺ se zikr kiya is par yeh aayat nazil hui, yeh hadees Tirmidhi Shareef mein hai, Imam Sahab R.H ne isay Hasan kaha hai, is ke do rawi zaeef hain. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt ghata-top andhera chhaya hua tha aur hum ne namaz parh kar apne apne samne khat khench diye thay taake subah roshni mein maloom ho jaye ke namaz Qibla ki taraf ada hui ya nahin? Subah maloom hua ke Qibla janne mein hum ne ghalti ki lekin Huzoor ﷺ ne hamein woh namaz lautane ka hukum nahin diya aur yeh aayat nazil hui, is riwayat ke bhi do rawi zaeef hain, yeh riwayat Dar-e-Qutni waghaira mein majood hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke un ke sath Huzoor ﷺ na thay, yeh bhi sandan zaeef hai. Aisi namaz ke lautane ke bare mein ulama ke do qaul mein se theek qaul yahi hai ke dohrai na jaye aur isi qaul ki tayeed karne wali yeh hadeesein hain jo oopar bayan huin. Baaz mufassireen kehte hain ke is ke nazil hone ka baais Najashi hai, jab Nabi ﷺ ne un ki maut ki khabar di aur kaha un ke janaza ki ghaibana namaz parho to baaz ne kaha ke woh to musalman na tha Nasrani tha, is par aayat nazil hui ke aayat (Wa in min ahlil kitabi illa layu'minanna bihi qabla mautihi, wa yaumal qiyamati yakunu alaihim shahida) (4:159).

(An-Nisa: 159) Ya'ni ba'z Ahl-e-Kitab Allah Ta'ala par aur us cheez par jo ae musalmano tumhari taraf nazil hui aur us cheez par jo un par nazil ki gayi iman late hain aur Allah Ta'ala se darte rehte hain. Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) woh Qibla ki taraf toh namaz nahin padhta tha, is par yeh ayat nazil hui lekin yeh riwayat ghareeb hai, Wallahu A'lam. Is ke ma'ni yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke woh Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf is liye namazein padhte rahe ke unhein is ke mansookh ho jane ka ilm nahin hua tha. Qurtubi farmate hain un ke janaze ki namaz Huzoor (ﷺ) ne padhi aur yeh daleel hai ke janaze ki namaz ghaibana ada karni chahiye aur is ke na manne wale is hukm ko makhsoos jante hain aur is ki teen taweelein karte hain: ek toh yeh ke Aap (ﷺ) ne us ke janaze ko dekh liya, zameen Aap (ﷺ) ke liye sameit li gayi thi; dusri yeh ke chunke wahan un ke paas un ke janaza ki namaz padhne wala aur koi na tha is liye Aap (ﷺ) ne yahan ghaibana ada ki, Ibn-e-Arabi isi jawab ko pasand karte hain. Qurtubi kehte hain ke yeh namumkin hai ke ek badshah musalman ho aur us ki qoum ka koi shakhs us ke paas musalman na ho, Ibn-e-Arabi is ke jawab mein kehte hain ke shayad un ke nazdeek janaze ki namaz un ki shariat mein na ho, yeh jawab bahut achha hai; teesri yeh ke namaz Aap (ﷺ) ne is liye ada ki ke dusre logon ki raghbat ka sabab ho aur us jaise dusre badshah bhi deen-e-Islam ki taraf mail hon. (Lekin yeh teeno taweelein zahir ke khilaf hone ke ilawa sirf ehtemalat ki bina par hain aur unhein maan lene ke baad bhi mas'ala wahin rehta hai kya janaza ghaibana padhna chahiye? Kyunke go Huzoor (ﷺ) ne is janaze ka mushahida kar liya lekin sahaba ki namaz toh ghaibana hi rahi. Agar hum dusra jawab maan lein toh bhi janaza toh ghaibana na hi hua. Jo log sire se namaz-e-janaza ghaibana ke qail hi nahin woh toh is surat mein bhi qail nahin hain aur yeh baat toh dil ko lagti hi nahin ke un ke nazdeek namaz-e-janaza shuru na ho, shariat un ki bhi Islam hi thi na ke koi aur. Teesra jawab bhi kuch aisa hi hai aur bar-taqdeer-e-tasleem ab bhi woh wajah baqi hai ke janaza ghaibana ada kiya karein taake dusre logon ki raghbat-e-Islam ka ba'is ho, Wallahu A'lam.)

(Mutarjim) Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hadith hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Ahl-e-Madina, Ahl-e-Sham, Ahl-e-Iraq ka Qibla mashriq-o-maghrib ke darmiyan hai. Yeh riwayat Tirmidhi mein bhi dusre alfaaz se marwi hai aur is ke ek rawi Abu Ma'shar ke hafiza par ba'az ahl-e-ilm ne kalam kiya hai. Imam Tirmidhi ne ise ek aur sanad se bhi warid kiya hai aur ise Hasan Sahih kaha hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab, Ali ibn-e-Abu Talib, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar farmate hain: Jab tu maghrib ko apni dayin janib aur mashriq ko bayin janib kar le, toh tere samne ki jihat Qibla ho jayegi. Hazrat Umar se bhi upar ki tarah hadith marwi hai ke mashriq-o-maghrib ke darmiyan Qibla hai, mulahiza ho Darqutni, Baihaqi waghaira. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain: Yeh matlab bhi is ayat ka ho sakta hai ke tum mujh se duayein mangne mein apna munh jis taraf bhi karo, mera munh bhi usi taraf paoge aur main tumhari duayon ko qabool farmaunga. Hazrat Mujahid se marwi hai ke jab yeh ayat (ادْعُوْنِيْٓ اَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ) (40. Ghafir: 60) "Mujh se dua karo main qabool karunga" utri, toh logon ne kaha kis taraf rukh kar ke dua karein? Is ke jawab mein ayat (فَاَيْنَـمَا تُوَلُّوْا فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ اللّٰهِ) (2. Al-Baqarah: 115) nazil hui. Phir farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala tamam wus'aton par ghalib, gunjaish wala aur ilm wala hai, jis ki kifayat, saqawat aur fazl-o-karam ne tamam makhlooq ka ihata kar rakha hai. Woh sab cheezon ko janta bhi hai, koi choti se choti cheez bhi us ke ilm se bahar nahin, balkeh woh tamam cheezon ka aalim hai.

Allah hi Muqtadir-e-Aala hai ke dalail yeh aur us ke sath ki ayat Nasraniyon ke radd mein hai aur is tarah un jaise Yahood-o-Mushrikeen ki tardeed mein hai jo Allah ki aulad batate thay. Un se kaha jata hai ke zameen-o-aasman waghera tamam cheezon ka toh Allah malik hai, un ka paida karne wala, unhein roziyan dene wala, un ke andaze muqarrar karne wala, unhein qabze mein rakhne wala, un mein har taghayyur-o-tabaddul karne wala Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Phir bhala is makhlooq mein se koi us ki aulad kaise ho sakta hai? Na Uzair aur na hi Isa (A.S) Allah ke bete ban sakte hain jaise ke Yahood-o-Nasara ka khayal tha, na farishte us ki betiyan ban sakte hain jaise ke Mushrikeen-e-Arab ka khayal tha. Is liye do barabar ki munasibat rakhne wale ham-jins se aulad hoti hai aur Allah Ta'ala ka na koi nazeer, na us ki azmat-o-kibriyai mein us ka koi shareek, na us ki jins ka koi aur. Woh toh aasmanon aur zameeno ka paida karne wala hai, us ki aulad kaise hogi? Us ki koi biwi bhi nahin, woh har cheez ka khaliq aur har cheez ka aalim hai. Yeh log Rahman ki aulad batate hain, yeh kitni be-mani aur behuda be-tuki baat tum kehte ho? Itni buri baat zaban se nikalte ho ke is se aasmanon ka phat jana aur zameen ka shaq ho jana aur paharon ka reza-reza ho jana mumkin hai.

Un ka dawa hai ke Allah Ta'ala sahib-e-aulad hai, Allah ki aulad toh koi ho hi nahin sakti, us ke siwa jo bhi hai sab us ki hi malkiyat hai. Zameen-o-aasman ki tamam hastiyan us ki ghulami mein zahir hone wali hain jinhein ek-ek kar ke us ne gher rakha hai aur shumar kar rakha hai. Un mein se har ek us ke paas Qayamat wale din tanha-tanha pesh hone wali hai. Pas ghulam aulad nahin ban sakta, malkiyat aur walidiyat do mukhtalif aur mutazad haisiyatain hain. Dusri jagah puri surat mein is ki nafi farmayi, irshad hua ayat (Qul huwallahu Ahad, Allahus Samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad) ke keh do ke Allah ek hi hai, Allah be-niyaz hai, us ki na aulad hai na maa-baap, us ka ham-jins koi nahin. In ayaton aur in jaisi aur ayaton mein is Khaliq-e-Kainat ne apni tasbeeh-o-taqdees bayan ki aur apna be-nazeer, be-misal aur la-shareek hona sabit kiya aur in mushrikeen ke is gande aqeeday ko batil qarar diya aur bataya ke woh toh sab ka Khaliq-o-Rabb hai, phir us ki aulad, bete-betiyan kahan se honge?

Surah Baqarah ki is ayat ki tafsir mein Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki ek Qudsi hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mujhe Ibn-e-Adam jhutlata hai, use yeh laiq na tha, mujhe woh galiyan deta hai, use yeh nahin chahiye tha. Us ka jhutlana toh yeh hai ke woh khayal kar baithta hai ke main use maar dalne ke baad phir zinda karne par qadir nahin hoon aur us ka galiyan dena yeh hai ke woh meri aulad batata hai, halankeh main pak hoon aur meri aulad aur biwi ho, is se bahut buland-o-bala hoon. Yehi hadith dusri sanadon se aur kitabon mein bhi ba-ikhtilaf-e-alfaz marwi hai. Sahihain mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Buri baatein sun kar sabr karne mein Allah Ta'ala se zyada koi kamil nahin. Log us ki aulad batayen aur woh unhein rizq-o-aafiyat deta rahe.

Phir farmaya har cheez us ki itaat-guzar hai, us ki ghulami ka iqrar kiye hue hai, us ke liye mukhlis. Us ki sarkar mein Qayamat ke roz dast-basta khadi hone wali aur duniya mein bhi ibadat-guzar hai, jis ko kahe yun ho jao ya is tarah ban, foran woh usi tarah ho jati aur ban jati hai. Is tarah har ek us ke samne past-o-muti hai, kuffar na chahte hue bhi us ke muti hain, har maujood ke saye Allah ke samne jhukte rehte hain. Quran ne aur jagah farmaya ayat (Wa lillahi yasjudu) al-kh, aasman-o-zameen ki kul cheezein khushi-na-khushi Allah Ta'ala ko sajda karti hain, un ke saye subh-o-sham jhukte rehte hain. Ek hadith mein marwi hai ke jahan kahin Quran mein Qunut ka lafz hai wahan murad itaat hai, lekin is ka marfu hona sahi nahin, mumkin hai sahabi ka ya aur kisi ka kalam ho. Is sanad se aur ayaton ki tafsir bhi marfu'an marwi hai lekin yaad rakhna chahiye ke yeh zaeef hai, koi shakhs is se dhoka mein na pade, Wallahu A'lam.

Phir farmaya woh aasman-o-zameen ko baghair kisi sabiqah namoone ke pehli hi baar ki paidaish mein paida karne wala hai. Lughat mein bid'at ke ma'ani nau-paida karne, naya banane ke hain. Hadith mein hai har nayi baat bid'at hai aur har bid'at gumrahi hai. Yeh toh shar'i bid'at hai, kabhi bid'at ka itlaq sirf lughatan hota hai, shar'an murad nahin hoti. Jaise Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne logon ko namaz-e-tarawih par jama kiya aur phir use isi tarah jaari dekh kar farmaya tha achi bid'at hai. Badi' ka manba se tasarruf kiya gaya hai, jaise mu'lim se aleem aur musmi' se samee. Ma'ani mubtadi' ke insha aur nau-paida karne wale ke hain. Baghair misaal, baghair namoone aur baghair pehli paidaish ke paida karne wale. Bid'ati ko is liye bid'ati kaha jata hai ke woh bhi Allah ke deen mein woh kaam ya woh tariqa ijaad karta hai jo is se pehle shariyat mein na ho. Isi tarah kisi nayi baat ke paida karne wale ko Arab mubtadi' kehte hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain matlab yeh hua ke Allah Ta'ala aulad se paak hai, woh aasman-o-zameen ki tamam cheezon ka maalik hai, har cheez uski wahdaniyat ki daleel hai, har cheez uski ita'at guzari ka iqrar karti hai. Sab ka paida karne wala, banane wala, maujood karne wala, baghair asl aur misaal ke unhein wujood mein lane wala, ek wahi Rabb-ul-Alameen hai. Uski gawahi har cheez deti hai, khud Maseeh (A.S) bhi uske gawah aur bayan karne wale hain. Jis Rabb ne in tamam cheezon ko baghair namoone ke aur baghair maade aur asl ke paida kiya, usne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko bhi be-baap paida kar diya, phir koi wajah nahin ke unhein tum khwah-makhwah Allah ka beta maan lo. Phir farmaya us Allah ki qudrat, saltanat, satwat-o-shaukat aisi hai ke jis cheez ko jis tarah ki banana aur paida karna chahe, use keh deta hai ke is tarah ki aur aisi ho ja, woh usi waqt ho jati hai. Jaise farmaya aayat (Innama amruhu iza arada shai'an an yaqula lahu kun fayakun) (36. Ya-Seen: 82). Dusri jagah farmaya aayat (Innama qauluna lishai'in iza aradnahu an naqula lahu kun fayakun) (16. An-Nahl: 40). Aur irshad hota hai aayat (Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bil-basar) (54. Al-Qamar: 50). Shair kehta hai:
Iza ma arada Allahu amran fa-innama
Yaqulu lahu kun qaulatan fayakun
Matlab iska hai ke idhar kisi cheez ka Allah ne irada farmaya, usne kaha ho ja, wahin woh ho gaya, uske irade se murad juda nahin. Pas mandarija bala aayat mein Isaiyon ko nihayat lateef pairaye mein yeh bhi samjha diya gaya hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) bhi isi 'Kun' ke kehne se paida hue hain. Dusri jagah saaf saaf farma diya aayat (Inna masala Isa indallahi kamasali Adama khalaqahu min turabin thumma qala lahu kun fayakun) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 59). Ya'ni Hazrat Isa ki misaal Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek Hazrat Adam (A.S) jaisi hai jinhein mitti se paida kiya, phir farmaya ho ja woh ho gaye.

Allah hi Muqtadir-e-Aala hai ke dalail yeh aur us ke sath ki ayat Nasraniyon ke radd mein hai aur is tarah un jaise Yahood-o-Mushrikeen ki tardeed mein hai jo Allah ki aulad batate thay. Un se kaha jata hai ke zameen-o-aasman waghera tamam cheezon ka toh Allah malik hai, un ka paida karne wala, unhein roziyan dene wala, un ke andaze muqarrar karne wala, unhein qabze mein rakhne wala, un mein har taghayyur-o-tabaddul karne wala Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Phir bhala is makhlooq mein se koi us ki aulad kaise ho sakta hai? Na Uzair aur na hi Isa (A.S) Allah ke bete ban sakte hain jaise ke Yahood-o-Nasara ka khayal tha, na farishte us ki betiyan ban sakte hain jaise ke Mushrikeen-e-Arab ka khayal tha. Is liye do barabar ki munasibat rakhne wale ham-jins se aulad hoti hai aur Allah Ta'ala ka na koi nazeer, na us ki azmat-o-kibriyai mein us ka koi shareek, na us ki jins ka koi aur. Woh toh aasmanon aur zameeno ka paida karne wala hai, us ki aulad kaise hogi? Us ki koi biwi bhi nahin, woh har cheez ka khaliq aur har cheez ka aalim hai. Yeh log Rahman ki aulad batate hain, yeh kitni be-mani aur behuda be-tuki baat tum kehte ho? Itni buri baat zaban se nikalte ho ke is se aasmanon ka phat jana aur zameen ka shaq ho jana aur paharon ka reza-reza ho jana mumkin hai.

Un ka dawa hai ke Allah Ta'ala sahib-e-aulad hai, Allah ki aulad toh koi ho hi nahin sakti, us ke siwa jo bhi hai sab us ki hi malkiyat hai. Zameen-o-aasman ki tamam hastiyan us ki ghulami mein zahir hone wali hain jinhein ek-ek kar ke us ne gher rakha hai aur shumar kar rakha hai. Un mein se har ek us ke paas Qayamat wale din tanha-tanha pesh hone wali hai. Pas ghulam aulad nahin ban sakta, malkiyat aur walidiyat do mukhtalif aur mutazad haisiyatain hain. Dusri jagah puri surat mein is ki nafi farmayi, irshad hua ayat (Qul huwallahu Ahad, Allahus Samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad) ke keh do ke Allah ek hi hai, Allah be-niyaz hai, us ki na aulad hai na maa-baap, us ka ham-jins koi nahin. In ayaton aur in jaisi aur ayaton mein is Khaliq-e-Kainat ne apni tasbeeh-o-taqdees bayan ki aur apna be-nazeer, be-misal aur la-shareek hona sabit kiya aur in mushrikeen ke is gande aqeeday ko batil qarar diya aur bataya ke woh toh sab ka Khaliq-o-Rabb hai, phir us ki aulad, bete-betiyan kahan se honge?

Surah Baqarah ki is ayat ki tafsir mein Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki ek Qudsi hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mujhe Ibn-e-Adam jhutlata hai, use yeh laiq na tha, mujhe woh galiyan deta hai, use yeh nahin chahiye tha. Us ka jhutlana toh yeh hai ke woh khayal kar baithta hai ke main use maar dalne ke baad phir zinda karne par qadir nahin hoon aur us ka galiyan dena yeh hai ke woh meri aulad batata hai, halankeh main pak hoon aur meri aulad aur biwi ho, is se bahut buland-o-bala hoon. Yehi hadith dusri sanadon se aur kitabon mein bhi ba-ikhtilaf-e-alfaz marwi hai. Sahihain mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Buri baatein sun kar sabr karne mein Allah Ta'ala se zyada koi kamil nahin. Log us ki aulad batayen aur woh unhein rizq-o-aafiyat deta rahe.

Talab-e-Nazara. Ek hamaqat. Rafi bin Harimla ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha tha ke agar aap sache hain toh Allah Ta'ala khud hum se kyun nahin kehta? Hum bhi toh khud us se us ka kalam sunen, is par yeh aayat utri. Mujahid kehte hain yeh baat Nasraniyon ne kahi thi, Ibn Jarir farmate hain yahi theek bhi maloom hota hai is liye ke aayat unhi se mutaliq bayan ke darmiyan mein hai lekin yeh qaul sochne ke qabil hai. Qurtubi farmate hain ke unhon ne kaha tha ke aap ki nabuwwat ki ittila khud Janab-e-Bari humein kyun nahin deta? Yahi baat theek hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ba'az aur mufassir kehte hain yeh qaul kuffar-e-Arab ka tha, isi tarah be-ilm logon ne bhi kaha tha, un se murad Yahood-o-Nasara hain. Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah hai aayat (Wa iza ja'athum aayatun qalu lan nu'mina hatta nu'ta misla ma utiya rusulullahi Allahu a'lamu haisu yaj'alu risalatahu) (Surah Al-An'am: 124). Un ke paas jab kabhi koi nishani aati hai toh kehte hain hum toh nahin manenge jab tak hum ko bhi woh na diya jaye jo Allah ke rasoolon ko diya gaya. Aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wa qalu lan nu'mina laka hatta tafjura lana minal ardi yanbu'a) (Surah Al-Isra: 90). Ya'ni unhon ne kaha ke hum aap par hargiz iman na layenge jab tak ke aap hamare liye in zameeno mein chashme jaari nahin kar dein. Aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wa qalal lazina la yarjuna liqa'ana lawla unzila alaynal mala'ikatu aw nara rabbana) (Surah Al-Furqan: 21). Ya'ni hamari mulaqat ke munkir kehte hain hum par farishtey kyun nahin utaray jate, Allah Ta'ala hamare samne kyun nahin aata. Aur jagah farmaya aayat (Bal yuridu kullumri'im minhum ay yu'ta suhufam munashsharah) (Surah Al-Muddaththir: 52). In mein se har shakhs chahta hai ke us ko khud koi kitab di jaye, waghera waghera aayatein jo saaf batati hain ke mushrikeen-e-Arab ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sirf takabbur-o-inaad ki bina par aisi cheezein talab keen. Isi tarah yeh mutalba bhi inhi mushrikeen ka tha, un se pehle Ahl-e-Kitab ne bhi aise hi be-ma'ni sawalat kiye thay. Irshad hota hai aayat (Yas'aluka ahlul kitabi ay tunazzila alayhim kitabam minas sama'i faqad sa'alu musa akbara min zalik) (Surah An-Nisa: 153). Ahl-e-Kitab tum se chahte hain ke tum un par koi aasmani kitab utaro aur Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se unhon ne is se bhi bada sawal kiya tha. Un se toh kaha tha ke humein Allah ko hamari aankhon se dikha. Aur jagah farman hai ke jab tum ne kaha ae Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) hum tujh par hargiz iman na layenge jab tak apne Rabb ko samne na dekh lein. Phir farmaya un ke aur un ke dil yaksan aur mushaba ho gaye, ya'ni in mushrikeen ke dil sabqa kuffar jaise ho gaye aur jagah farmaya hai ke pehle guzarne walon ne bhi apne ambiya ko jadugar aur deewana kaha tha, unhon ne bhi inhi baton ko dohraya tha.

Phir farmaya hum ne yaqeen walon ke liye apni aayatein isi tarah bayan kar di hain jin se Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq ayan hai, kisi aur cheez ki wazahat baqi nahin rahi. Yehi nishaniyan imaan lane ke liye kafi hain. Haan jin ke dilon par mohar lagi hui ho unhein kisi aayat se koi faida na hoga. Jaise farmaya aayat: (Innal-lazina haqqat 'alaihim kalimatu Rabbika la yu'minun) (10. Yunus: 96). Jin par tere Rabb ki baat sabit ho chuki hai woh imaan na layenge, go un ke paas tamam aayatein aa jayen jab tak ke woh dard-naak azab na dekh lein.

Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nasihat ki had tak mas'ool hain. Hadith mein hai khushkhabri jannat ki aur darawa jahannam se. La tus'al ki dusri qira'at ma tus'al bhi hai aur Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) ki qira'at mein lan tus'al bhi hai, yani tujh se kuffar ki babat sawal nahin kiya jaye ga. Jaise farmaya ayat (Fa innama alaikal balaghu wa alainal hisab) yani tujh par sirf pahuncha dena hai, hisab toh hamare zimme hai. Aur farmaya ayat (Fazzakir innama anta muzakkir. Lasta alaihim bimusaitir) (Surah Al-Ghashiyah: 21-22), toh nasihat karta reh, tu sirf nasihat karne wala hai, un par darogha nahin. Aur jagah farmaya ayat (Nahnu a'lamu bima yaqooloon) al-kh, hum un ki baatein bakhoobi jante hain, tum un par jabr karne wale nahin ho. Toh Quran ki nasihaten unhein suna do jo Qayamat se darte hon. Isi mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si ayatein hain. Ek qira'at is ki wala tus'al bhi hai, yani un jahannumiyon ke bare mein ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujh se kuch na poocho. Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Kash ke main apne maa baap ka haal jaan leta, kash ke main apne maa baap ka haal jaan leta, kash ke main apne maa baap ka haal jaan leta. Is par yeh farman nazil hua. Phir aakhri dam tak aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne walidain ka zikr na farmaya. Ibn Jarir (R.H) ne bhi ise barwayat Musa bin Ubaidah warid kiya hai lekin is rawi par kalam hai. Qurtubi (R.H) kehte hain matlab yeh hai ke jahannumiyon ka haal itna bad aur bura hai ke tum kuch na poocho. Tazkirah mein Qurtubi (R.H) ne ek riwayat naqal ki hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walidain zinda kiye gaye aur iman le aaye aur Sahih Muslim mein jo hadith hai jis mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi ke sawal par farmaya hai ke mera baap aur tera baap aag mein hain, un ka jawab bhi wahan hai. Lekin yaad rahe ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke maa baap ke zinda hone ki riwayat kutub-e-Sihah-e-Sittah wagairah mein nahin aur is ki asnaad za'eef hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek din poocha ke mere baap kahan hain, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Ibn-e-Jarir ne is ki tardeed ki hai aur farmaya hai ke yeh mahal hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne maa baap ke bare mein shak karein. Pehli hi qira'at theek hai lekin hamein Imam-e-Humam par ta'ajjub aata hai ke unhon ne ise mahal kaise keh diya? Mumkin hai yeh waqea us waqt ka ho jab aap apne maa baap ke liye istifsar karte thay aur anjam maloom na tha, phir jab un dono ki halat maloom ho gayi to aap is se hat gaye aur bezari zahir farmayi aur saaf bata diya ke woh dono jahannami hain, jaise ke sahih hadith se sabit ho chuka hai. Is ki aur bhi bahut si misalein hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Aas (R.A) se Hazrat Ata bin Yasar ne poocha ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifat-o-sana Taurat mein kya hai? To aap ne farmaya: Haan, Allah ki qasam! Jo sifatein aap ki Quran mein hain, wahi Taurat mein bhi hain. Taurat mein bhi hai: "Aye Nabi! Hum ne tujhe gawah aur khushkhabriyan dene wala aur daranay wala aur anparhon ka bachao bana kar bheja hai. Tu mera banda aur mera Rasool hai, main ne tera naam Mutawakkil rakha hai. Tu na bad-zaban hai, na sakht-go, na bad-khulq, na bazaron mein shor-o-ghul karne wala hai, na tu burai ke badle burai karne wala hai, balkay maaf aur dar-guzar karne wala hai. Allah Ta'ala unhein duniya se na uthaye ga jab tak ke tere deen ko teri wajah se bilkul theek aur durust na kar de aur log La Ilaha Illallah ka iqrar na kar lein aur un ki andhi aankhein khul na jayen aur un ke behray kaan sunne na lag jayen aur un ke zang-alood dil saaf na ho jayen." Bukhari ki Kitab-ul-Buyu mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur Kitab-ut-Tafsir mein bhi. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein is riwayat ke baad mazeed yeh hai ke main ne phir ja kar Hazrat Ka'ab se yahi sawal kiya to unhon ne bhi theek yahi jawab diya.

Deen-e-Haq ka baatil se samjhota jurm-e-azeem hai. Aayat-e-bala ka matlab yeh hai ke yeh log tujh se hargiz raazi nahin honge, lehaza tu bhi inhe chhor aur Rabb ki raza ke peeche lag ja. Tu ne inhe dawat-e-risalat pahuncha di. Deen-e-Haq wahi hai jo Allah ne tujhe diya hai, tu us par jam ja. Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai, "Meri ummat ki ek jamaat haq par jam kar dusron ke muqable mein rahegi aur ghalba ke sath rahegi yahan tak ke Qayamat aaye." Phir apne Nabi ko khitab kar ke dhamkaya ke hargiz in ki raza-mandi aur in se sulah-joi ke liye apne deen mein sust na hona, in ki taraf na jhukna, in ki na manna. Fuqaha-e-Kiram ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai ke kufr ek hi mazhab hai, khwah woh Yahood hon, Nasrani hon ya koi aur hon, is liye ke millat ka lafz yahan mufrad hi rakha, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Lakum deenukum waliya deen) tumhare liye tumhara deen hai aur mere liye mera deen hai. Is istidlal par is masle ki bina dali hai ke Musalman aur kuffar aapas mein waris nahin ho sakte aur kuffar aapas mein ek dusre ke waris ho sakte hain, go woh dono ek hi qisam ke kafir hon ya do alag alag kufron ke kafir hon. Imam Shafi'i aur Imam Abu Hanifa ka yahi mazhab hai aur Imam Ahmad se bhi ek riwayat mein yahi qaul manqool hai aur dusri riwayat mein Imam Ahmad ka aur Imam Malik ka yeh qaul marwi hai ke do mukhtalif mazhab wale aapas mein ek dusre ke waris na hon. Ek sahih hadees mein bhi yahi mazmoon hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Haq-e-tilawat se kya murad hai? Phir farmaya ke jinhein hum ne Kitab di hai woh haq-e-tilawat ada karte hue parhte hain. Qatada kehte hain is se murad Yahood-o-Nasara hain aur riwayat mein hai ke is se murad Ashab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain. Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate hain haq-e-tilawat yeh hai ke Jannat ke zikr ke waqt Jannat ka sawal kiya jaye aur Jahannam ke zikr ke waqt us se panah mangi jaye. Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain halal-o-haram ko janna, kalmaat ko un ki jagah rakhna, taghayyur-o-tabaddul na karna waghera yahi tilawat ka haq ada karna hai. Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain khuli aayaton par amal karna, mutashabih aayaton par imaan lana, mushkilat ko ulama ke samne pesh karna haq-e-tilawat ke sath parhna hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se is ka matlab haq-e-ittiba baja lana bhi marwi hai, pas tilawat ba-ma'ni ittiba hai jaise aayat (Wal qamari iza talaha) (Surah Ash-Shams: 2) mein. Ek marfoo hadees mein bhi is ke yahi ma'ni marwi hain lekin is ke ba'z rawi majhool hain go ma'ni theek hai. Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) farmate hain Quran ki ittiba karne wala Jannat ke bagheechon mein utarne wala hai. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ki tafseer ke mutabiq yeh bhi marwi hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab koi rahmat ke zikr ki aayat parhte to thehar jate aur Allah se rahmat talab karte aur jab kabhi kisi azab ki aayat tilawat farmate to ruk kar Allah Ta'ala se panah talab farmate.

Phir farmaya is par imaan yahi log rakhte hain yani jo Ahl-e-Kitab apni kitab ki soch samajh kar tilawat karte hain woh Quran par imaan lane par majboor ho jate hain jaise aur jagah aayat (Wa lau annahum aqamu-t-taurata wal-injila wa ma unzila ilaihim mir-rabbihim la-akalu min fauqihim wa min tahti arjulihim) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 66) agar yeh Taurat, Injeel par aur Allah ki un ki taraf nazil karda cheez par qaim rehte toh un ke upar se aur pairon tale se unhein khana milta aur farmaya ae Ahl-e-Kitab jab tak tum Taurat-o-Injeel ko aur jo tumhari taraf tumhare Rab ki taraf se utra us ko qaim na kar lo tab tak tum kisi cheez par nahin ho, un ka qaim karna mustalzim hai ke tum is mein jo hai use sacha jano aur is mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zikr ki sifaat, aap ki tabedari ka hukum, aap ki itteba ki raghbat sab kuch majood hai. Aur jagah farmaya jo log Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Ummi ki tabedari karte hain jis Rasool ka zikr aur tasdeeq apni kitab Taurat-o-Injeel mein bhi likha dekhte hain. Aur jagah farmaya aayat (Innal-lazina utul-ilma min qablihi iza yutla 'alaihim yakhirruna lil-azqani sujjada) (Surah Al-Isra: 107) yani tum imaan lao ya na lao jinhein is se pehle ilm diya gaya hai un par jab Allah ki aayatein padhi jati hain munh ke bal sajde mein gir padte hain aur zabani kehte hain ke hamara Rab pak hai, hamare Rab ka wada bilkul sacha aur sahih hai. Aur jagah hai jinhein hum ne is se agli kitab di hai woh bhi is par imaan late hain aur un par yeh padhi jati hai toh apne imaan ka iqrar kar ke kehte hain hum toh pehle hi se manne walon mein hain, unhein un ke sabr ka dohra ajar diya jaye ga, yeh log burai ko bhalai se hatate hain aur hamare diye hue mein se dusron ko dete hain. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Wa qul lillazina utul-kitaba wal-ummiyyina a-aslamtum, fa-in aslamu faqad-ihtadau) (Surah Al-Imran: 20) yani padhe likhe aur be-padhe logon se keh do ke kya tum Islam qabool karte ho? Agar maan lein toh raah par hain aur agar na maanein toh tujh par sirf tabligh hai, Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko khoob dekh raha hai. Isi liye yahan farmaya ke is ke sath kufr karne wale khasare wale hain, jaise farmaya aayat (Wa may-yakfur bihi minal-ahzabi fan-naru mau'iduh) (Surah Hud: 17) jo bhi is ke sath kufr kare us ke wade ki jagah aag hai. Sahih hadith mein hai, us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, is ummat mein se jo bhi mujhe sune khwah Yahudi ho khwah Nasrani ho phir mujh par imaan na laye woh jahannam mein jaye ga.

Deen-e-Haq ka baatil se samjhota jurm-e-azeem hai. Aayat-e-bala ka matlab yeh hai ke yeh log tujh se hargiz raazi nahin honge, lehaza tu bhi inhe chhor aur Rabb ki raza ke peeche lag ja. Tu ne inhe dawat-e-risalat pahuncha di. Deen-e-Haq wahi hai jo Allah ne tujhe diya hai, tu us par jam ja. Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai, "Meri ummat ki ek jamaat haq par jam kar dusron ke muqable mein rahegi aur ghalba ke sath rahegi yahan tak ke Qayamat aaye." Phir apne Nabi ko khitab kar ke dhamkaya ke hargiz in ki raza-mandi aur in se sulah-joi ke liye apne deen mein sust na hona, in ki taraf na jhukna, in ki na manna. Fuqaha-e-Kiram ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai ke kufr ek hi mazhab hai, khwah woh Yahood hon, Nasrani hon ya koi aur hon, is liye ke millat ka lafz yahan mufrad hi rakha, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Lakum deenukum waliya deen) tumhare liye tumhara deen hai aur mere liye mera deen hai. Is istidlal par is masle ki bina dali hai ke Musalman aur kuffar aapas mein waris nahin ho sakte aur kuffar aapas mein ek dusre ke waris ho sakte hain, go woh dono ek hi qisam ke kafir hon ya do alag alag kufron ke kafir hon. Imam Shafi'i aur Imam Abu Hanifa ka yahi mazhab hai aur Imam Ahmad se bhi ek riwayat mein yahi qaul manqool hai aur dusri riwayat mein Imam Ahmad ka aur Imam Malik ka yeh qaul marwi hai ke do mukhtalif mazhab wale aapas mein ek dusre ke waris na hon. Ek sahih hadees mein bhi yahi mazmoon hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Intibah: Pehle bhi is jaisi aayat shuru-e-surat mein guzar chuki hai aur is ki mufassal tafsir bhi bayan ho chuki hai. Yahan sirf takeed ke taur par zikr kiya gaya aur unhein Nabi-e-Ummi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari ki raghbat dilayi gayi jin ki sifatein woh apni kitabon mein paate thay, jin ka naam aur kaam bhi is mein likha hua tha, balkay un ki ummat ka zikr bhi is mein maujood hai. Pas unhein is ke chupane aur Allah Ta'ala ki dusri nematon ko posheeda karne se daraya ja raha hai aur deeni aur dunyawi nematon ko zikr karne ka kaha ja raha hai. Aur Arab mein jo nasli taur par bhi un ke chacha zaad bhai hain, Allah Ta'ala ki jo nemat aayi, un mein jis Khatam-ul-Anbiya (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Allah Ta'ala ne mab'oos farmaya, un se hasad kar ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mukhalifat aur takzeeb par aamada na hone ki hidayat ki gayi hai.
