Imam-e-Tauheed: Is aayat mein Khalilullah Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki buzurgi ka bayan ho raha hai jo tauheed mein duniya ke imam hain. Unhon ne takaleef par sabr kar ke Allah Ta'ala ke hukm ki baja aawari mein sabit qadmi aur jawan mardi dikhayi. Farmata hai: Aye Nabi (ﷺ)! Tum in mushrikeen aur Ahl-e-Kitab ko jo millat-e-Ibrahim ke daavedar hain, zara Ibrahim (A.S) ki farman bardari aur itaat guzari ke waqiyat to sunao taake unhein maloom ho jaye ke Deen-e-Hanif par, uswa-e-Ibrahimi par kaun qaim hai? Woh ya aap aur aap ke as-haab? Quran-e-Kareem ka irshad hai aayat: (Wa Ibrahimal-lazi waffa) (Surah An-Najm: 37) Ibrahim woh hain unhon ne poori wafadari dikhayi. Aur farmaya aayat: (Inna Ibrahima kana ummatan qanital-lillahi hanifan wa lam yaku minal-mushrikin) (Surah An-Nahl: 120). Ibrahim logon ke peshwa, Allah Ta'ala ke farman bardar, mukhlis aur nemat ke shukr guzar thay jinhein Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne pasand farma kar raah-e-raast par laga diya tha. Jinhein hum ne duniya mein bhalayi di thi aur aakhirat mein bhi saleh aur nek anjam banaya tha. Phir hum ne teri taraf aye Nabi (ﷺ) wahi ki ke tu bhi Ibrahim Hanif ki millat ki pairwi kar jo mushrikeen mein se na thay. Aur jagah irshad hai ke Ibrahim (A.S) na to Yahudi thay, na Nasrani thay, na mushrik thay, balkeh khalis musalman thay. Un se qurbat aur nazdiki wala woh shakhs hai jo un ki taleem ka tabe ho aur yeh Nabi (ﷺ) aur imaan wale. In imaan walon ka dost Allah Ta'ala khud hai. Ibtila ke ma'ani imtehan aur aazmaish ke hain. Kalimaat se murad shariat, hukm aur mumanat waghera hai. Kalimaat se murad kalimaat-e-taqdeeriya bhi hoti hai, jaise Maryam (Alaihima-Salam) ki baabat irshad hai: Sadaqat bi-kalimati Rabbiha, yani unhon ne apne Rabb ke kalimaat ki tasdeeq ki. Kalimaat se murad kalimaat-e-shariya bhi hoti hai. Aayat: (Wa tammat kalimatu Rabbika sidqan wa adlan la mubaddila li-kalimatihi wa huwas-Sami-ul-Alim) (Surah Al-An'am: 115). Yani Allah Ta'ala ke shari kalimaat sachayi aur adl ke sath pooray hue. Yeh kalimaat ya to sachi khabrein hain ya talab-e-adl hai. Garz in kalimaat ko poora karne ki jaza mein unhein imamat ka darja mila. In kalimaat ki nisbat bohat se aqwal hain, maslan ahkaam-e-hajj, moonchon ko kam karna, kulli karna, naak saaf karna, miswak karna, sar ke baal mundwana ya rakhwana, tau maang nikalna, naakhun kaatna, zer-e-naaf ke baal kaatna, khatna karana, baghal ke baal kaatna, peshab paakhana ke baad istinja karna, Jumma ke din ghusal karna, tawaf karna, Safa-o-Marwa ke darmiyan sa'i karna, rami-e-jimaar karna, tawaf-e-ifaza karna.

Mukammal Islam: Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain is se murad poora Islam hai jis ke tees hissay hain. Das ka bayan Surah Bara'at mein hai ayat (At-Ta'iboonal 'Abidoonal Hamidoonas Sa'ihunar Raki'unas Sajidoonal Amiruna bil ma'roofi wan-nahoona 'anil munkari wal hafizoona li hududillah) se Momineen tak, yani tauba karna, ibadat karna, hamd karna, Allah ki rah mein phirna, ruku karna, sajda karna, bhalai ka hukum dena, burai se rokna, Allah ki hudood ki hifazat karna, iman lana. Das ka bayan "Qad Aflaha" ke shuru se "Yuhafizoon" tak hai aur Surah Ma'arij mein hai, yani namaz ko khushoo-o-khuzoo se ada karna, laghw aur fazool baton aur kamon se munh pher lena, zakat dete raha karna, sharmgah ki hifazat karna, amanat dari karna, wada wafai karna, namaz par hamishgi aur hifazat karna, Qayamat ko sacha janna, azabon se darte rehna, sachi shahadat par qaim rehna. Aur das ka bayan Surah Ahzab mein ayat (Innal muslimeena wal muslimati wal mu'mineena wal mu'minati wal qaniteena wal qanitati wassadiqeena wassadiqati wassabireena wassabirati wal khashi'eena wal khashi'ati wal mutasaddiqeena wal mutasaddiqati wassa'imeena wassa'imati wal hafizeena furoojahum wal hafizati wazzakireenallaha katheeran wazzakirati a'addallahu lahum maghfiratan wa ajran 'azeema) (33-Al-Ahzab: 35) tak hai, yani Islam lana, iman rakhna, Quran parhna, sach bolna, sabr karna, aajizi karna, khairat dena, roza rakhna, badkari se bachna, Allah Ta'ala ka har waqt bakasrat zikr karna. In teenon ahkam ka jo amil ho woh poore Islam ka paband hai aur Allah ke azabon se bari hai. Kalimat-e-Ibrahimi mein apni qoum se alaidgi karna, badshah-e-waqt se nadar ho kar usay bhi tableegh karna, phir Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein jo museebat aaye us par sabr karna, sehna, phir watan aur ghar bar ko Allah ki rah mein chor kar hijrat karna, mehmandari karna, Allah ki rah mein jaani aur maali museebat rah-e-Allah bardasht karna, yahan tak ke bacha ko Allah ki rah mein qurban karna aur woh bhi apne hi hath se, yeh kul ahkam Khalil-ur-Rahman (A.S) baja laye.

Suraj, chand aur sitaron se bhi Aap ki aazmaish hui. Imamat ke sath, Baitullah banane ke hukm ke sath, Hajj ke hukm aur Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke sath, Baitullah ke rehne walon ki roziyon ke sath, Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Aap ke deen par bhejne ke sath bhi aazmaish hui. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke ae Khalil! Main tumhein aazmata hoon, dekhta hoon tum kya ho? To Aap ne farmaya mujhe logon ka imam bana de, is Ka'aba ko logon ke sawab aur ijtima ka markaz bana de, yahan walon ko phalon ki roziyan de. Yeh tamam baatein Azz-o-Jal ne poori kar dein aur yeh sab ne'amatein Aap ko ata huin, sirf ek aarzoo poori na hui woh yeh ke meri aulad ko bhi imamat mile, to jawab mila zalimon ko mera ahd nahin pahunchta. Kalimat se murad is ke sath ki aayatein bhi hain. Mu'atta wagaira mein hai ke sab se pehle khatna karane wale, sab se pehle mehman nawazi karne wale, sab se pehle nakhun katwane wale, sab se pehle moonchein past karne wale, sab se pehle safed baal dekhne wale Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) hi hain. Safed baal dekh kar poocha ke ae Allah! Yeh kya hai? Jawab mila waqar-o-izzat hai. Kehne lage phir to ae Allah! Ise aur zyada kar. Sab se pehle mimbar par khutba kehne wale, sab se pehle qasid bhejne wale, sab se pehle talwar chalane wale, sab se pehle miswak karne wale, sab se pehle pani ke sath istinja karne wale, sab se pehle pajama pehanne wale Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) hain. Ek ghair sabit hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar main mimbar banaoon to mere baap Ibrahim ne bhi banaya tha aur agar main lakdi hath mein rakhoon to yeh bhi mere baap Ibrahim ki sunnat hai. Mukhtalif buzurgon se kalimat ki tafseer mein jo kuch hum ne naqal kar diya aur theek bhi yahi hai ke yeh sab baatein un kalimat mein thin, kisi khas takhsees ki koi wajah hamein nahin mili. Wallahu A'alam. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai das baatein fitrat ki aur asal deen ki hain: moonchein kam karna, darhi barhana, miswak karna, naak mein pani dena, nakhun lena, puriyan dhona, baghal ke baal lena, zer-e-naaf ke baal lena, istinja karna. Rawi kehta hai main daswin baat bhool gaya, shayad kulli karna thi. Sahihain mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain panch baatein fitrat ki hain: khatna karana, moo-e-zahar lena, moonchein kam karna, nakhun lena, baghal ke baal lena. Ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko wafa karne wala is liye farmaya hai ke woh har subah ke waqt parhte the aayat: (Fasubhanallahi heena tumsoona wa heena tusbihoon. Wa lahul hamdu fis-samawati wal-ardi wa ashishan wa heena tuzhiroon. Yukhrijul hayya minal mayyiti wa yukhrijul mayyita minal hayyi wa yuhyil arda ba'da mautiha wa kazalika tukhrajoon) (Surah Ar-Rum: 17-19).

(Surah Ar-Rum: 17) Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke har din chaar raka'atein parhte thay lekin yeh dono hadeesein za'eef hain aur in mein kayi kayi raawi za'eef hain aur zu'f ki bahut si wajoohaat hain, balkay in ka bayaan bhi be-bayaan zu'f jaaiz nahin, matan bhi zu'f par dalaalat karta hai. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) apni ummat ki khushkhabri sun kar apni aulad ke liye bhi yahi dua karte thay jo qabool toh ki jaati hai lekin saath hi khabar kar di jaati hai ke aap ki aulad mein zaalim bhi honge jinhein Allah Ta'ala ka ahd na pahunche ga, woh imam na banaye jayenge, na un ki iqtida aur pairwi ki jaye gi. Surah Al-Ankabut ki aayat mein is matlab ko wazeh kar diya gaya hai ke Khalilullah ki yeh dua bhi qabool hui, wahan hai aayat (وَجَعَلْنَا فِيْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتٰبَ وَاٰتَيْنٰهُ اَجْرَهٗ فِي الدُّنْيَا) (29. Al-Ankabut: 27) yani hum ne un ki aulad mein nabuwwat aur kitaab rakh di. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke baad jitne ambiya aur rasool aaye woh sab aap hi ki aulad mein thay aur jitni kitabein naazil huin sab aap hi ki aulad mein huin (Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihim ajma'een). Yahan yeh bhi khabar di gayi hai ke aap ki aulad mein zulm karne wale bhi honge. Zaalim se muraad ba'az ne mushrik bhi li hai. Ahd se muraad amr hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain zaalim ko kisi cheez ka wali aur bada na banana chahiye go woh aulad-e-Ibrahim mein se ho. Hazrat Khalil (A.S) ki dua un ki nek aulad ke haq mein qabool hui hai. Yeh bhi ma'ani kiye gaye hain ke zaalim se koi ahd nahin ke us ki ita'at ki jaye, us ka ahd tod diya jaye, poora na kiya jaye aur yeh bhi matlab hai ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala ne use kuch dene ka ahd nahin kiya, duniya mein toh kha pi raha hai aur aish-o-ishrat kar raha hai. Bas yahi hai, ahd se muraad deen bhi hai yani teri kul aulad deendar nahin, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّـتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَّظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهٖ مُبِيْنٌ) (37. As-Saffat: 113) yani un ki aulad mein bhale bhi hain aur bure bhi. Ita'at ke ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain yani ita'at sirf ma'roof aur bhalai mein hi hogi aur ahd ke ma'ani nabuwwat ke bhi aaye hain. Ibn Khuwaiz Mindad Maliki farmate hain zaalim shakhs na toh khalifa ban sakta hai, na haakim, na mufti, na gawah, na raawi.

Shauq-e-ziyarat aur barhta hai. "Masabatan" se murad baar baar aana. Hajj karne ke baad bhi dil mein lagan lagi rehti hai, goya hajj karne ke baad bhi har baar dil mein ek baar aur hajj karne ki tamanna rehti hai. Duniya ke har goshe se log bhage daure is ki taraf jaug dar jaug chale aa rahe hain, yahi jama hone ki jagah hai aur yahi aman ka maqam hai jis mein hathiyar nahin uthaya jata. Jahiliyat ke zamane mein bhi is ke aas paas to loot maar hoti rehti lekin yahan aman-o-aman hi rehta, koi kisi ko gaali bhi nahin deta. Yeh jagah hamesha mutabarrak aur shareef rahi. Nek roohein is ki taraf mushtaq hi rehti hain, go har saal ziyarat karein lekin phir bhi shauq-e-ziyarat kam nahin hota hai. Yeh Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki dua ka asar hai. Aap ne dua mangi thi ke aayat (FAJ'AL AF'IDATAN MINAN-NASI TAHWI ILAIHIM WARZUQHUM MINATH-THAMARATI LA'ALLAHUM YASHKURUN) (Surah Ibrahim: 37) to logon ke dilon ko in ki taraf jhuka de. Yahan baap aur bhai ke qatil ko bhi koi dekhta to khamosh ho jata. Surah Maidah mein "Qiyamal-lin-nas" yani yeh logon ke qayam ka ba'is hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain agar log hajj karna chhor dein to aasman zameen par gira diya jaye. Is ghar ke is sharaf ko dekh kar phir is ke bani-e-awwal Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ke sharaf ko khayal farmaye. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai aayat (WA ID BAWWA'NA LI-IBRAHIMA MAKANAL-BAITI AL LA TUSHRIK BI SHAI'AN WA TAHHIR BAITIYA LIT-TA'IFINA WAL-QA'IMINA WAR-RUKKA'IS-SUJUD) (Surah Al-Hajj: 26) hum ne Baitullah ki jagah Ibrahim (A.S) ko bata di (aur keh diya) ke mere sath kisi ko shareek na karna. Aur jagah hai aayat (INNA AWWALA BAITIN WUDI'A LIN-NASI LALLAZI BIBAKKATA MUBARAKAN WA HUDAN LIL-'ALAMIN) (Surah Al-Imran: 96). Allah Jalla Shanuhu ka pehla ghar Makkah mein jo barkat-o-hidayat wala, nishaniyon wala, Maqam-e-Ibrahim wala, aman-o-aman wala hai. Maqam-e-Ibrahim bhi hai aur hajj kul ka kul bhi hai, maslan Arafat, Mash'ar-ul-Haram, Mina, Rami, Jamarat, Safa-Marwa ka tawaf. Maqam-e-Ibrahim darasal woh patthar hai jise Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ki biwi sahiba ne Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke nahane ke liye un ke paon ke neeche rakha tha, lekin Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) kehte hain yeh ghalat hai. Darasal woh yeh patthar hai jis par khare ho kar Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) Ka'aba banate the. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) ki lambi hadith mein hai jab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tawaf kar liya to Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Maqam-e-Ibrahim ki taraf ishara kar ke kaha, kya yahi hamare baap Ibrahim (A.S) ka maqam hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan. Kaha phir hum ise qibla kyun na bana lein? Is par aayat nazil hui. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Farooq (R.A) ke sawal par thori hi der guzri thi jo hukm nazil hua. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke Fatah-e-Makkah wale din Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke patthar ki taraf ishara kar ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne poocha yahi hai jise qibla banane ka hamein hukm hua hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan yahi. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai.

Hazrat Umar R.A farmate hain main ne apne Rab se teen baaton mein muwafiqat ki jo Allah Ta'ala ko manzoor tha wohi meri zaban se nikla. Main ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ kaash ke hum Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko Qibla bana lete toh hukum-e-ayat (وَاتَّخِذُوْا مِنْ مَّقَامِ اِبْرٰهٖمَ مُصَلًّى) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 125) nazil hua. Main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ kaash ke aap Ummahat-ul-Momineen ko parde ka hukum dein, is par parde ki ayat utri. Jab mujhe maloom hua ke aaj Huzoor ﷺ apni biwiyon se khafa hain toh main ne ja kar un se kaha ke agar tum baaz na aaogi toh Allah Ta'ala tum se achi biwiyan tumhare badle apne Nabi ko dega, is par farman-e-bari nazil hua ke ayat (عسی ربہ) al-kh. Is hadith ki bohat si asnaad hain aur bohat si kitabon mein marwi hai. Ek riwayat mein Badr ke qaidiyon ke bare mein bhi Hazrat Umar R.A ki muwafiqat marwi hai, aap ne farmaya tha ke is se fidiya na liya jaye balkay inhe qatl kar diya jaye, Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ko bhi yahi manzoor tha. Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool munafiq jab mar gaya aur Huzoor ﷺ us ke janaze ki namaz ada karne ke liye tayyar hue toh main ne kaha tha ke kya aap is munafiq kafir ka janaza padhenge? Aap ne mujhe daant diya, is par ayat (وَلَا تُصَلِّ عَلٰٓي اَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ مَّاتَ اَبَدًا وَّلَا تَقُمْ عَلٰي قَبْرِهٖ) (Surah At-Tawbah: 84) nazil hui aur aap ko aison ke janaze se roka gaya. Ibn Juraij mein riwayat hai Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ne pehle tawaf mein teen martaba ramal kiya yani daur ki chaal chale aur chaar phere chal kar kiye, phir Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke peeche aa kar do rakat namaz ada ki aur yeh ayat tilawat farmayi ayat (وَاتَّخِذُوْا مِنْ مَّقَامِ اِبْرٰهٖمَ مُصَلًّى) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 125). Hazrat Jabir R.A ki hadith mein hai ke Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko aap ne apne aur Baitullah ke darmiyan kar liya tha. In ahadees se maloom hota hai ke Maqam-e-Ibrahim se murad woh patthar hai jis par khade ho kar Hazrat Ibrahim A.S Ka'aba bana rahe the, Hazrat Ismail A.S aap ko patthar dete jate the aur aap Ka'aba ki bina karte jate the aur is patthar ko sarkate jate the, jahan deewar oonchi karni hoti thi wahan le jate the, isi tarah Ka'aba ki deewarein poori keen. Is ka poora bayan Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke waqiye mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Is patthar par aap ke dono qadmon ke nishan zahir the, Arab ki jahiliyat ke zamane ke logon ne bhi dekhe the.

Abu Talib ne apne mashhoor qaside mein kaha hai: Wa mawti Ibrahim fis-sakhr ratbatuhu, ala qadamaihi haiyan ghaira na'ilin. Ya'ni is patthar mein Ibrahim (A.S) ke dono pairon ke nishan taza-ba-taza hain jin mein jooti nahin, balkay musalmanon ne bhi ise dekha tha. Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A) farmate hain ke main ne Maqam-e-Ibrahim mein Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ke pairon ki ungliyon aur aap ke talway ka nishan dekha tha, phir logon ke chhoone se woh nishan mit gaye. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain: Hukm is ki janib namaz ada karne ka hai, tabarruk ke taur par chhoone aur haath lagane ka nahin. Is ummat ne bhi agli ummaton ki tarah bila hukm-e-Rabbul Aalameen ba'az kaam apne zimme lazim kar liye jo nuqsan-rasan hain, woh nishan logon ke haath lagane se mit gaye. Yeh Maqam-e-Ibrahim pehle deewar-e-Ka'aba ke muttasil tha, Ka'aba ke darwaze ki taraf, Hajar-e-Aswad ki janib, darwaze se jaane wale ke daayin janib mustaqil jagah par tha jo aaj bhi logon ko maloom hai. Khalilullah (A.S) ne ya to ise yahan rakhwa diya tha ya Baitullah banate hue aakhri hissa yahi banaya hoga aur yahin woh patthar rakha hai. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne apni khilafat ke zamane mein ise peeche hata diya, is ke suboot mein bahut si riwayatein hain. Phir ek martaba pani ke sailab mein yeh patthar yahan se bhi hat gaya tha, Khalifa-e-Sani (R.A) ne ise phir apni jagah rakhwa diya. Hazrat Sufyan (R.H) farmate hain: Mujhe maloom nahin hua ke yeh asli jagah se hataya gaya, is se pehle deewar-e-Ka'aba se kitni door tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke khud Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ki asli jagah se hata kar wahan rakha tha jahan ab hai, lekin yeh riwayat mursal hai. Theek baat yahi hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne ise peeche rakha, Wallahu A'alam.

Ahd jo mutaradif-e-hukm hai, yahan ahd se murad woh hukm hai jis mein kaha gaya hai gandi aur najis aur buri cheezon se pak rakhna. Ahd ka ta'diya ila se ho to ma'ni hum ne wahi ki aur pehle se keh diya ke pak rakhne ka matlab yeh hai ke ise buton se bachana, ghair-ullah ki ibadat na hone dena, laghw kamon, fazool bakwas, jhooti baton, shirk-o-kufr, hasti aur mazaq se ise mehfooz rakhna bhi isi mein shamil hai. Taif ke ek ma'ni tawaf karne walon ke hain, dusre ma'ni bahar se aane walon ke hain. Is taqdeer par Aakifeen ke ma'ni Makka ke bashinday honge. Ek martaba logon ne kaha ke ameer-e-waqt se kehna chahiye ke logon ko Baitullah Sharif mein sone se mana karein kyunke mumkin hai koi kisi waqt junubi ho jaye, mumkin hai kabhi aapas mein fazool batein karein, to hum ne suna ke unhein na rokna chahiye. Ibn-e-Umar R.A unhein bhi Aakifeen kehte thay. Ek sahih hadith mein hai ke Masjid-e-Nabvi mein Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ke sahibzaday Hazrat Abdullah R.A soya karte thay, woh jawan aur kunwaray thay. Ruk-is-Sujood se murad namazi hain. Pak rakhne ka hukm is wastay diya gaya ke us waqt bhi but-parasti raij thi, dusre is liye ke yeh buzurg apni niyaton mein khuloos ki baat rakhein. Dusri jagah irshad hai ayat (Wa iz bawwa'na) al-kh. Is ayat mein bhi hukm hai ke mere sath shareek na karna aur mere ghar ko pak saaf rakhna. Fuqaha ka is mein ikhtilaf hai ke Baitullah ki namaz afzal hai ya tawaf? Imam Malik R.H farmate hain bahar walon ke liye tawaf afzal hai aur jumhoor ka qaul hai ke har ek ke liye namaz afzal hai, is ki tafseel ki jagah tafseer nahin. Maqsad is se mushrikeen ko tanbeeh aur tardeed hai ke Baitullah to khas Allah ki ibadat ke liye banaya gaya hai, is mein auron ki ibadat karna aur khalis Allah ki ibadat karne walon ko is se rokna kis qadar sareeh be-insafi hai aur isi liye Quran mein farmaya ke aise zalimon ko hum dardnak azab chakhayenge. Mushrikeen ki is khuli tardeed ke sath hi Yahood-o-Nasara ki tardeed bhi is ayat mein ho gayi ke agar woh Ibrahim aur Ismail Alaihimas Salam ki afzaliyat, buzurgi aur nabuwwat ke qail hain aur yeh bhi jante aur maante hain ke yeh shareef gharanay ke mutabarrak hathon ka bana hua hai, jab woh is ke bhi qail hain ke yeh mehez namaz-o-tawaf-o-dua aur ibadat-e-Allah ke liye banaya gaya hai, hajj-o-umray aur aitikaf waghera ke liye makhsoos kiya gaya hai to phir un nabiyon ki tabedari ke da'way ke bawajood kyun hajj-o-umray se rukay hue hain? Kyun Baitullah Sharif mein haziri nahin dete? Balkay khud Musa A.S ne is ghar ka hajj kiya jaisa ke hadith mein saaf maujood hai. Ayat-e-Kareema se yeh bhi sabit hua ke aur masjidon ko bhi pak saaf rakhna chahiye aur jagah Quran mein hai ayat (Fi buyutin azinallahu an turfa'a wa yuzkara feehasmuhu, yusabbihu lahu feeha bil-ghuduwwi wal-asal) (24:36).

(An-Noor: 36) Allah Ta'ala ne masjidon ko buland karne ki ijazat di hai, in mein Us ka naam zikr kiya jaye, in mein subh-o-sham us ki tasbeeh us ke nek banday karte hain. Hadees-e-Shareef mein bhi hai ke masjidain isi kaam ke liye hain aur ahadees mein bohat hi takeed ke sath masjidon ki pakeezgi ka hukum aaya hai. Imam Ibn-e-Kaseer (R.H) ne is baray mein ek khaas risala tasneef farmaya hai. Baaz log to kehte hain sab se pehle Ka'batullah farishton ne banaya tha lekin yeh sanadan ghareeb hai. Baaz kehte hain Adam (A.S) ne sab se pehle banaya tha, Hira, Toor-e-Seena, Toor-e-Zeeta, Jabal-e-Lubnan aur Joodi in paanch paharon se banaya tha lekin yeh bhi sanadan ghareeb hai. Baaz kehte hain Shees (A.S) ne sab se pehle banaya tha lekin yeh bhi Ahl-e-Kitab ki baat hai. Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne Makkah ko haram banaya aur farmaya main Madina Munawwara ko haram qarar deta hoon. Is mein shikar na khela jaye, yahan ke darakht na kaatay jayain, yahan hathiyar na uthaye jayain. Sahih Muslim Shareef ki ek hadees mein hai ke log taaza phal le kar khidmat-e-Nabwi mein hazir hote thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) usay le kar dua karte ke aye Allah hamare phalon mein, hamare shehar mein, hamare naap tol mein bhi barkat de. Aye Allah! Ibrahim (A.S) tere banday, tere Khaleel aur tere Rasool thay, main bhi tera banda, tera Rasool hoon, unhon ne mujh se Makkah ke liye dua ki thi, main tujh se Madina (Munawwara) ke liye dua karta hoon jaise unhon ne Makkah Mukarrama ke liye ki thi. Aap kisi chotay bacha ko bula kar woh phal usay ata farma diya karte. Anas bin Malik (R.A) farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba Abu Talha (R.A) se kaha ke jao apne bachon mein se kisi ek ko hamari khidmat ke liye lao, Abu Talha (R.A) mujhe le kar hazir huye, main ab safar-o-hazar mein hazir-e-khidmat rehne laga. Ek martaba aap bahar se aa rahe thay jab Uhud pahar par nazar pari to aap ne farmaya yeh pahar hum se aur hum is se mohabbat karte hain. Jab Madina nazar aaya to farmane lage ya Allah main is ke dono kinaron ke darmiyan ki jagah ko haram muqarrar karta hoon jaise Ibrahim (A.S) ne Makkah ko haram banaya, aye Allah in ke mudd aur saa' mein aur naap mein barkat de. Aur riwayat mein hai ya Allah jitni barkat tu ne Makkah mein di hai us se dugni barkat Madina mein de. Aur riwayat mein hai Madina mein qatl na kiya jaye aur charay ke siwa aur pattay bhi yahan ke darakhton ke na jharay jayain. Isi mazmoon ki hadeesain jin se sabit hota hai Madina bhi misl-e-Makkah ke haram hai aur bhi bohat si hain.

Yahan in ahadees ke warid karne se hamari garz Makkah Sharif ki hurmat aur yahan ka aman bayan karna hai, ba'az toh kehte hain ke yeh shuru se haram aur aman hai, ba'az kehte hain Khalilullah (A.S) ke zamane se, lekin pehla qaul zyada zahir hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadees mein hai, Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Fatah-e-Makkah wale din farmaya, "Jab se Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen paida kiye, tab se is shehar ko hurmat-o-izzat wala banaya hai, ab yeh Qayamat tak hurmat-o-izzat wala hi rahega. Is mein jang-o-qital kisi ko halal nahin, mere liye bhi aaj ke din hi zara si der ke liye halal tha, ab woh haram hi haram hai. Suno! Is ke kaante na kaate jayen, is ka shikar na bhagaya jaye, is mein kisi ki giri padi cheez na uthai jaye, jo pahunchwayi jaye us ke liye uthana jaiz hai, is ki ghaas na kaati jaye." Dusri riwayat mein hai ke yeh hadees aap ne asna-e-khutba mein bayan farmayi thi aur Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ke sawal par aap ne 'Izkhir' nami ghaas ke kaatne ki ijazat di thi.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Shuraih Adawi ne Umar bin Saeed se us waqt kaha jab woh Makkah ki taraf lashkar bhej raha tha ke, "Ae Ameer! Sun, Fatah-e-Makkah wale din subah hi subah Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne khutbe mein farmaya, jise mere kaanon ne suna, dil ne yaad rakha aur main ne aankhon se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko us waqt dekha, aap ne hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya ke Makkah ko Rabb-e-Zuljalal ne haram kiya hai, logon ne nahin kiya. Kisi imandar ko is mein khoon bahana, is ka darakht kaatna halal nahin. Agar koi meri is ladai ko daleel banaye toh keh dena ke mere liye sirf aaj hi ke din ki aisi sa'at yahan jihad halal tha. Phir is shehar ki hurmat aa gayi hai jaise kal thi. Khabardar! Har hazir ghaib ko yeh pahuncha de." Lekin Umar ne yeh hadees sun kar saaf jawab de diya ke main tujh se zyada is hadees ko jaanta hoon. Haram nafarman ko aur khooni ko aur barbadi karne wale ko nahin bachana (Bukhari, Muslim).

In dono ahadees mein koi ta'aruz na samjhe, tatbiq yun hai ke Makkah roz-e-awwal se hurmat wala tha lekin is hurmat ki tableegh Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne ki. Jis tarah Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toh us waqt se thay jab ke Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka khameer goondh rakha tha, balkay aap us waqt bhi Khatam-ul-Anbiya likhe hue thay, lekin taham Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne aap ki nabuwat ki dua ki ke aayat (رَبَّنَا وَابْعَثْ فِيْهِمْ رَسُوْلًا مِّنْھُمْ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 129) "In hi mein se ek Rasool in mein bhi bhej," jo Allah ne poori ki aur taqdeer ki likhi hui woh baat zahir-o-bahir hui. Ek hadees mein hai ke logon ne aap se kaha ke aap apni ibtida-e-nabuwat ka toh kuch zikr kijiye. Aap ne farmaya, "Mere baap Ibrahim (A.S) ki dua aur Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ki basharat aur meri maa ka khwab, woh dekhti hain ke un se goya ek noor nikla jis ne Shaam ke mehalat ko roshan kar diya aur woh nazar aane lage."

Madina Munawwara afzal ya Makkah Mukarramah? Is baat ka bayan ke Makkah afzal hai ya Madina? Jaisa ke jamhoor ka qaul hai, jaise ke Imam Malik (R.H) aur un ke tabieen ka mazhab hai, Madina afzal hai Makkah se. Ise dono taraf ke dalail ke sath anqareeb hum bayan karenge, Insha'Allah Ta'ala.

Hazrat Ibrahim A.S dua karte hain ke Bari Ta'ala is jagah ko aman wala shehar bana yani yahan ke rehne walon ko nidar aur be-khauf rakh. Allah Ta'ala ise qabool farmata hai jaise ke farmaya aayat (Wa man dakhalahu kana amina) (Surah Al-Imran: 97). Is mein jo aaya woh aman wala ho gaya aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Awalam yarau) al-kh kya woh nahin dekhte ke hum ne haram ko aman wala banaya log iske aas paas se uchak liye jate hain aur yahan woh pur-aman rehte hain. Isi qisam ki aur aayatein bhi hain aur is mazmoon ki bahut si hadeesein bhi oopar guzar chuki hain ke Makkah Sharif mein qitaal haram hai. Hazrat Jabir R.A farmate hain main Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna aap farmate the kisi ko halal nahin ke Makkah mein hathiyar uthaye (Sahih Muslim). Aap ki yeh dua hurmat-e-Ka'batullah ki bina se pehle thi is liye kaha ke ae Allah is jagah ko aman wala shehar bana, Surah Ibrahim mein yahi dua in lafzon mein hai aayat (Rabbi-j'al hadhal balada amina) (Surah Ibrahim: 35). Shayad yeh dua dobara ki thi. Jab Baitullah Sharif tayyar ho gaya aur shehar bas gaya aur Hazrat Ishaq A.S jo Hazrat Ismail A.S se teen saal chote the tawalud ho chuke isi liye is dua ke aakhir mein un ki paidaish ka shukriya bhi ada kiya. Wa man kafara se aakhir tak Allah Ta'ala ka kalam hai, baaz ne ise bhi dua mein dakhal kiya hai to is taqdeer par yeh matlab hoga ke kuffar ko bhi thoda sa faida de phir unhein azab ki taraf be-bas kar. Is mein bhi Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki khillat zahir hoti hai ke woh apni buri aulad ke bhi mukhalif hain aur ise Kalam-e-Ilahi manne ka yeh matlab hoga ke chunke imamat ka sawal jab apni aulad ke liye kiya aur zalimon ki mehroomi ka elaan sun chuke aur maloom ho gaya ke aap peeche aane walon mein bhi Allah ke nafarman honge to mare dar ke adab ke sath baad mein aane wali naslon ko rozi talab karte hue sirf imandar aulad ke liye kaha. Irshad-e-Bari hua ke duniya ka faida to kuffar ko bhi deta hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Kullan numiddu ha'ula'i wa ha'ula'i min 'ata'i Rabbika wa ma kana 'ata'u Rabbika mahzura) (Surah Al-Isra: 20) yani hum unhein aur in ko bhi faida denge tere Rabb ki bakhshish mehdood nahin. Aur jagah hai jo log Allah par jhoot bandhte hain woh falah nahin paate duniya ka kuch faida go utha lein lekin hamari taraf aa kar apne kufr ke badle sakht azab chakhenge. Aur jagah hai kafiron ka kufr tujhe ghamgeen na kare jab yeh hamari taraf lautenge to un ke a'maal par hum unhein tanbeeh karenge Allah Ta'ala seenon ki chupi baton ko bakhoobi janta hai hum unhein yunhi sa faida pohancha kar sakht ghaleez azabon ki taraf be-qarar karenge aur jagah hai aayat (Wa lau la an yakuna-nnasu ummatan wahidatan laja'alna liman yakfuru bir-Rahmani libuyutihim suqufan min fiddatin wa ma'arija 'alaiha yazharun) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 33).

(Az-Zukhruf: 33) Agar yeh khatra na ho taake log ek hi ummat ho jayen toh hum kafiron ki chhaten aur seedhiyan chandi ki bana dete aur unke ghar ke darwaze aur takht jin par tek lagaye baithe rehte aur sona bhi dete lekin yeh sab dunyawi fawaid hain, aakhirat ka bhala ghar toh sirf parhezgaron ke liye hai. Yehi mazmoon is aayat mein bhi hai ke unka anjam bura hai, yahan dheel pa lenge lekin wahan sakht pakad hogi. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Faka-ayyin min qaryatin ahlaknaaha wahiya zaalimatun fahiya khaawiyatun 'ala 'urooshiha wa bi'rin mu'attalatin wa qasrin masheed) (Al-Hajj: 45). Bahut si zaalim bastiyon ko hum ne mohlat di phir pakad liya, anjam ko toh hamare hi paas lautna hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai, gandi baton ko sun kar sabr karne mein Allah se badh kar koi nahin, log uski aulad batate hain lekin taham woh unhein rizq-o-'aafiyat de raha hai. Aur hadith mein hai, Allah Ta'ala zaalim ko dheel deta hai phir use achanak pakad leta hai, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi: Aayat (Wa kazalika akhzu rabbika iza akhazal qura wahiya zaalimatun inna akhzahu aleemun shadeed) (Hud: 102). Is jumla ko Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki dua mein shamil karna shaaz qira'at ki bina par hai jo saaton qariyon ki qira'at ke khilaf hai aur tarkeeb-e-siyaq-o-sabaq bhi yehi zahir karti hai, wallahu a'lam. Is liye ke 'qaala' ki zameer ka marja' Allah ki taraf hai aur is shaaz qira'at ki bina par is ke fa'il aur qail bhi Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) hi hote hain jo nazm-e-kalam se bazahir mukhalif hai, wallahu a'lam. Qawaid jama' hai qaida ki, tarjuma is ka paya aur neev hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai, ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne walon ko bina-e-Ibrahimi ki khabar do, ek qira'at mein wa Isma'eel ke baad wa yaqoolan bhi hai, isi dalalat mein aage lafz muslimeen bhi hai. Donon Nabi nek kaam mein mashghool hain aur qabool na hone ka khatka hai toh Allah Ta'ala se qabooliyat ki dua karte hain. Hazrat Waheeb bin Ward jab is aayat ki tilawat karte toh bahut rote aur farmate, aah! Khalil-ur-Rahman jaise Allah ke maqbool paighambar Allah ka kaam Allah ke hukm se karte hain, uska ghar uske farman se banate hain aur phir khauf hai ke kahin yeh qabooliyat se gir na jaye. Sach hai mukhlis mominon ka yehi haal hai: Aayat (Wallazeena yu'toona ma aataw wa quloobuhum wajilatun annahum ila rabbihim raaji'oon) (Al-Mu'minun: 60).

(Al-Mu'minun: 60) Woh nek kaam karte hain, sadqe khairaat karte hain lekin phir bhi khauf-e-Allah se kanpte rehte hain ke aisa na ho ke qabool na hon. Hazrat Ibrahim A.S uthate the aur dua Hazrat Ismail A.S karte the, lekin sahih yahi hai ke dono har ek kaam mein shareek the. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki ek riwayat aur ba'az aur aasar bhi is waqiye ke mutaliq yahan zikr kiye jaane ke qabil hain. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke kamar-band baandhna aurton ne Hazrat Ismail A.S ki walida mohtarma se seekha hai. Unhon ne baandha tha ke Hazrat Mai Sarah R.A ko un ka naqsh-e-qadam na mile. Unhein aur un ke jigar ke tukde apne iklote farzand Hazrat Ismail A.S ko le kar Hazrat Ibrahim A.S nikle jabke yeh pyara bacha doodh peeta tha.

Sanate ki aaghosh mein zindagi. Ab jahan par Baitullah bana hua hai yahan ek teela tha aur sunsan bayaban tha, koi basne wala wahan na tha. Yahan pahunch kar maa bete ko bitha kar paas thodi si khajoorein aur mashkeeza paani ka rakh kar aap chale gaye. Jab Khalilullah (A.S) ne peeth modi aur jaane lage toh Mai Hajra ne aawaz di, "Ae Khalilullah! Hamein is dehshat-o-wahshat wale bayaban mein yakka-o-tanha chhod kar jahan hamara koi moonis-o-hamdam nahin, aap kahan tashreef le ja rahe hain?" Lekin Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne koi jawab na diya balkeh is taraf tawajjah tak na ki, munh mod kar bhi na dekha. Hazrat Hajra ke baar baar kehne par bhi aap ne iltifat na farmaya toh aap farmane lagein, "Allah ke Khalil! Aap hamein kise sonp chale?" Aap ne kaha, "Allah Ta'ala ko." Kaha, "Ae Khalilullah! Kya Allah Ta'ala ka aap ko yeh hukm hai?" Aap ne farmaya, "Haan, mujhe Allah ka yahi hukm hai." Yeh sun kar Umm-e-Ismail ko taskeen ho gayi aur farmane lagein, "Phir tashreef le jaiye, woh Allah Jalla Shanuhu hamein hargiz zaya na karega, usi ka bharosa aur usi ka sahara hai." Hazrat Hajra laut gayin aur apne kaleje ki thandak, apni aankhon ke noor, Ibn-e-Nabi Allah ko god mein le kar is sunsan bayaban mein, is ho ke aalam mein lachar aur majboor ho kar baith rahin. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) jab Saniyah ke paas pahunche aur yeh maloom kar liya ke ab Hazrat Hajra peeche nahin aur wahan se yahan tak un ki nigah kaam bhi nahin kar sakti toh Baitullah Sharif ki taraf mutawajjah ho kar haath utha kar dua ki aur kaha, aayat: (RABBANA INNI ASKAN-TU MIN ZURRIYYATI BI-WADIN GHAIRI ZI ZAR'IN 'INDA BAITIKAL MUHARRAM) (14:37).

(Ibrahim: 37) Ilah-ul-Alameen! Main ne apne baal bachon ko ek ghair-abad jungle mein tere barguzida ghar ke paas chhora hai taake woh namaz qaim karein, toh logon ke dilon ko un ki taraf jhuka de aur unhein phalon ki roziyan de, shayad woh shukr-guzari karein. Aap ne yeh dua kar ke, hukm-e-Ilahi baja la kar, apne ahl-o-ayal ko Allah ke supurd kar ke chale gaye. Idhar Hazrat Hajra sabr-o-shukr ke saath bachay se dil behlane lagein. Jab thori si khajoorein aur zara sa pani khatam ho gaya, ab anaj ka ek dana paas hai na pani ka ghont, khud bhi bhooki pyasi hain aur bacha bhi bhook pyas se betab hai. Yahan tak ke is masoom nabi-zaday ka phool sa chehra kumhlane laga aur woh tarpne aur balkne laga. Mamta bhari maa kabhi apni tanhai aur bekasi ka khayal karti hai, kabhi apne nannhay se iklotay bachay ka yeh haal baghor dekhti hai aur sehmi jati hai. Maloom hai ke kisi insan ka guzar is bhayanak jungle mein nahin, meelon tak abadi ka naam-o-nishan nahin, khana toh kahan? Pani ka ek qatra bhi mayassar nahin aa sakta. Aakhir is nanni si jaan ka yeh abtar haal nahin dekha jata toh uth kar chali jati hain aur Safa pahar jo paas hi tha us par charh jati hain aur maidan ki taraf nazar dorati hain ke koi aata jata nazar aa jaye, lekin nigahain mayoosi ke saath charon taraf dalti hain aur kisi ko bhi na dekh kar phir wahan se utar aati hain aur isi tarah darmiyani thora sa hissa dor kar baqi hissa jaldi jaldi tay kar ke phir Safa par charhti hain, isi tarah saat martaba karti hain. Har baar aa kar bacha ko dekh jati hain, us ki halat sa'at-ba-sa'at bigarti ja rahi hai. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmatay hain Safa Marwa ki sa'i jo haaji kartay hain us ki ibtida yahin se hai. Saatwin martaba jab Hazrat Hajra Marwa par aati hain toh kuch aawaz kaan mein parti hai. Aap khamosh ho kar ehtiyat ke saath us ki taraf mutawajja hoti hain ke yeh aawaz kaisi? Aawaz phir aati hai aur is martaba saaf sunai deti hai toh aap aawaz ki taraf lapak kar aati hain aur ab jahan Zamzam hai wahan Hazrat Jibraeel ko pati hain. Hazrat Jibraeel poochtay hain tum kaun ho? Aap jawab deti hain main Hajra hoon, main Hazrat Ibrahim ke larkay ki maa hoon. Farishta poochta hai Ibrahim tumhein is sunsan biyaban mein kisay sonp gaye hain? Aap farmati hain Allah ko. Farmaya phir toh woh kaafi hai. Hazrat Hajra ne farmaya ae ghaibi shakhs! Aawaz toh main ne sun li, kya kuch mera kaam bhi niklay ga? Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ne apni eri zameen par ragri, wahin zameen se ek chashma pani ka ubalne laga.

Hazrat Hajra (Alaihimas Salam) ne haath se us paani ko mashk mein bharna shuru kiya, mashk bhar kar phir is khayal se ke paani idhar udhar beh kar nikal na jaye aas paas baar baandhni shuru kar di. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Umm-e-Ismail par raham kare, agar woh is tarah paani ko na roktin toh Zam-Zam kuye ki misl mein na hota balkay woh ek jaari nahar ki surat mein hota. Ab Hazrat Hajra ne paani piya aur bacha ko bhi pilaya aur doodh pilane lagin. Farishtay ne keh diya ke tum be-fikr raho Allah tumhein zaya na karega, jahan tum baithi ho yahan Allah ka ek ghar is bache aur us ke baap ke hathon banega. Hazrat Hajra ab yahin reh parin, Zam-Zam ka paani peetin aur bacha se dil behlatin. Barish ke mausam mein paani ke sailab charon taraf se aate lekin yeh jagah zara unchi thi, idhar udhar se paani guzar jata aur yahan aman rehta. Kuch muddat ke baad Jurhum ka qabeela Khuda ke rasta ki taraf se ittefaqan guzra aur Makkah Sharif ke neeche ke hissa mein utra. Un ki nazrein ek aabi parind par parin toh aapas mein kehne lage yeh parinda toh paani ka hai aur yahan paani kabhi na tha, hamari aamad-o-raft yahan se kayi martaba hui, yeh toh khushk jungle aur chatyal maidan hai yahan paani kahan? Chunancha unhon ne apne aadmi asliyat maloom karne ke liye bheje, unhon ne wapas aa kar khabar di ke wahan toh behtareen aur bohat sa paani hai. Ab woh sab aaye aur Hazrat Umm-e-Ismail se arz karne lage ke mayi sahiba agar aap ijazat dein toh hum bhi yahan thehar jayen, paani ki jagah hai. Aap ne farmaya haan shauq se raho lekin paani par qabza mera hi rahega. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Hajra toh chahti thin ke koi ham-jins mil jaye, chunancha yeh qafila yahan reh para. Hazrat Ismail bhi baray ho gaye, un sab ko aap se bari mohabbat ho gayi yahan tak ke aap baligh hue toh inhi mein nikah bhi kiya aur inhi se Arabi bhi seekhi. Mayi Hajra (Alaihimas Salam) ka inteqal yahin hua. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko Allah ki taraf se ijazat mili toh aap apne lakht-e-jigar ki mulaqat ke liye tashreef laye. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke aap ka yeh aana jana Buraq par hota tha, mulk-e-Sham se aate the aur phir wapas jate the. Yahan aaye toh Hazrat Ismail ghar par na mile, apni bahu se poocha ke woh kahan hain? Toh jawab mila ke khane peene ki talash mein yani shikar ko gaye hain. Aap ne poocha tumhara kya haal hai? Kaha bura haal hai, bari tangi aur sakhti hai. Farmaya achha tumhare khawand aavein toh unhein salam kehna aur keh dena ke apne darwaze ki chaukhat badal dalein.

Hazrat Zabihullah jab wapas aaye toh goya aap ko kuch uns sa maloom hua, poochne lage kya koi sahib tashreef laye thay? Biwi ne kaha haan, aisi aisi shakal-o-shabahat ke ek umr-rasida buzurg aaye thay. Aap ki nisbat poocha, maine kaha woh shikar ki talash mein bahar gaye hain. Phir poocha ke guzran kaisi chalti hai? Maine kaha badi sakhti aur tangi se guzar-auqat hoti hai. Poocha kuch mujh se kehne ko bhi farma gaye hain? Biwi ne kaha haan, keh gaye ke woh jab woh aayein mera salam kehna aur keh dena ke apne darwaze ki chaukhat badal dalein. Aap farmane lage biwi suno yeh mere walid sahib thay aur jo farma gaye hain us se matlab yeh hai ke (chunke tum ne nashukri ki) main tum ko alag kar doon, jao main ne tumhein talaq di. Unhein talaq de kar aap ne usi qabeela mein apna doosra nikah kar liya. Ek muddat ke baad phir Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ba-ijazat-e-Ilahi yahan aaye. Ab ki martaba bhi ittefaqan Hazrat Zabih (A.S) se mulaqat na hui. Bahu se poocha toh jawab mila ke hamare liye rizq ki talash mein shikar ko gaye hain, aap aaiye, tashreef rakhiye jo kuch hazir hai tanawul farmaiye. Aap ne farmaya yeh toh batao ke guzar-basar kaisi hoti hai? Kya haal hai? Jawab mila Alhamdulillah hum khairiyat se hain aur ba-fazl-e-Rabb-e-Kaaba kushadagi aur rahat hai, Allah ka bada shukr hai. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne kaha tumhari khorak kya hai? Kaha gosht. Poocha tum peete kya ho? Jawab mila pani. Aap ne dua ki ke Parwardigar inhein gosht aur pani mein barkat de. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain agar anaj un ke paas hota aur yeh kehtin toh Hazrat Khalil (A.S) un ke liye anaj ki barkat ki dua bhi karte. Ab is dua ki barkat se ahl-e-Makkah sirf gosht aur pani par guzar kar sakte hain, aur log nahin kar sakte. Aap ne farmaya achha main toh ja raha hoon, tum apne miyan ko mera salam kehna aur kehna ke woh apni chaukhat ko sabit aur abad rakhein. Baad azan Hazrat Ismail (A.S) aaye, sara waqea maloom hua, aap ne farmaya yeh mere walid-e-mukarram thay, mujhe hukm de gaye hain ke main tumhein alag na karoon (tum shukr-guzar ho).

Ta'meer-e-Ka'bah: Phir ek muddat ke baad Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko ijazat mili aur aap tashreef laye toh Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ko Zamzam ke paas ek teelay par teer seedhay karte hue paya, Hazrat Ismail (A.S) baap ko dekhte hi kharay ho gaye aur ba-adab milay. Jab baap betay milay toh Khalilullah (A.S) ne farmaya, "Aye Ismail! Mujhe Allah ka ek hukm hua hai." Aap (A.S) ne farmaya, "Abba jaan! Jo hukm hua ho uski tameel kijiye." Kaha, "Beta! Tumhein bhi mera saath dena paray ga." Arz karne lagay, "Main hazir hoon, is jagah Allah ka ek ghar banana hai." Kehne lagay, "Bohat behtar."

Ab baap bete ne Baitullah ki neev rakhi aur deewarein oonchi karni shuru keen, Hazrat Ismail (A.S) patthar la la kar dete jaate the aur Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) chunte jaate the. Jab deewarein qadre oonchi ho gayin toh Hazrat Zabihullah (A.S) yeh patthar yani Maqam-e-Ibrahim ka patthar laye, is oonche patthar par khade ho kar Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) Kaaba ke patthar rakhte jaate the aur dono baap beta yeh dua maangte jaate the ke Bari Ta'ala tu hamari is naacheez khidmat ko qabool farmana, tu sunne aur jaanne wala hai. Yeh riwayat aur kutub-e-hadith mein bhi hai kahin mukhtasar aur kahin mufassalan. Ek sahih hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Zabihullah (A.S) ke badle jo dumba zibah hua tha uske seeng bhi Kaabatullah mein the. Upar ki lambi riwayat barwayat Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi marwi hai, is mein yeh bhi hai ke Ibrahim (A.S) jab bhi Kaabatullah Shareef ke qareeb pahunche toh aap ne apne sar par ek baadal sa mulahiza farmaya jis mein se aawaz aayi ke ae Ibrahim! Jahan jahan tak is baadal ka saya hai wahan tak ki zameen Baitullah mein le lo, kami ziyadati na ho. Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Baitullah bana kar wahan Hazrat Hajra (R.A) aur Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ko chhod kar aap tashreef le gaye, lekin riwayat hi theek hai aur is tarah tatbeeq bhi ho sakti hai ke bina pehle rakh di thi lekin banaya baad mein, aur banane mein beta aur baap dono shamil the jaise ke Quran-e-Pak ke alfaaz bhi hain. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke logon ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bina-e-Baitullah shuru karne ki kaifiyat daryaft ki toh aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko hukum diya ke mera ghar banao. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ghabraye ke mujhe kahan banana chahiye, kis tarah aur kitna bada banana chahiye waghera. Is par Sakeena nazil hua aur hukum hua ke jahan yeh thehre wahan tum mera ghar banao. Aap ne banana shuru kiya, jab Hajar-e-Aswad ki jagah pahunche toh Hazrat Ismail (A.S) se kaha beta koi achha sa patthar dhoond lao, toh dekha ke aap aur patthar wahan laga chuke hain, poocha yeh patthar kaun laya? Aap ne farmaya Allah ke hukum se yeh patthar Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aasman se le kar aaye. Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.H) farmate hain ke ab jahan Baitullah hai wahan zameen ki paidaish se pehle paani par bulbulo ke saath jhaag si thi, yahin se zameen phailayi gayi. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain Kaabatullah banane ke liye Hazrat Khaleel (A.S) Armenia se tashreef laye the. Hazrat Suddi (R.H) farmate hain Hajar-e-Aswad Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) Hind se laye the, us waqt woh safed chamakdar yaqoot tha jo Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne bana ki. Musnad-e-Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke Hazrat Adam (A.S) Hind mein utre the, us waqt unka qad lamba tha, zameen mein aane ke baad farishton ki tasbeeh, namaz-o-dua waghera sunte the, jab qad ghat gaya aur woh pyari aawazein aani band ho gayin toh aap ghabrane lage, hukum hua ke Makkah ki taraf rakha aur ise apna ghar qarar diya. Hazrat Adam (A.S) yahan tawaf karne lage aur manoos hue, ghabrahat jaati rahi. Hazrat Nooh (A.S) ke toofan ke zamane mein yeh phir uth gaya aur Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke zamane mein phir Allah Ta'ala ne banwaya. Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne yeh ghar Hira, Toor, Zaitahil, Lubnan, Toor-e-Sina aur Judi in paanch pahadon se banaya tha lekin in tamam riwayaton mein tafawat hai, Wallahu A'alam. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke zameen ki paidaish se do hazar saal pehle Baitullah banaya gaya tha. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke saath Baitullah ke nishan batane ke liye Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) chale the, us waqt yahan jangli darakhton ke siwa kuch na tha, kis daur-e-Amaliq ki aabadi thi yahan. Aap Hazrat Umm-e-Ismail (R.A) ko aur Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ko ek chhappar tale bitha gaye. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Baitullah ke chaar arkaan hain aur saatwin zameen tak woh neeche hote hain. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Zulqarnain jab yahan pahunche aur Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko Baitullah banate hue dekha toh poocha yeh kya kar rahe ho? Toh unhone kaha Allah ke hukum se uska ghar bana rahe hain, poocha kya daleel? Kaha yeh bheinrein gawahi dengi, paanch bheinron ne kaha hum gawahi deti hain ke yeh dono Allah ke mamoor hain, Zulqarnain khush ho gaye aur kehne lage main ne maan liya. Ar-Razi ki Tareekh-e-Makkah mein hai ke Zulqarnain ne Khaleelullah (A.S) aur Zabihullah (A.S) ke saath Baitullah ka tawaf kiya, Wallahu A'alam. Sahih Bukhari mein hai Qawaid bunyaan aur asaas ko kehte hain, yeh qaida ki jama hai. Quran mein aur jagah aayat (Wal-qawa'idu minan-nisa'il-lati la yarjoona nikahan falaisa alaihinna junahun an yada'na siyabahunna ghaira mutabarrijatin bi-zeenah) (24:60).

(An-Noor: 60) mein bhi aaya hai, is ka mufrad bhi qa'idatan hai. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Kya tum nahin dekhtin ke tumhari qoum ne jab Baitullah banaya to qawaid-e-Ibrahim se ghata diya? Maine kaha: Huzoor (ﷺ)! Aap ise barha kar asli bana dein? Farmaya: Agar teri qoum ka Islam taza aur un ka zamana-e-kufr ke qareeb na hota to main aisa kar leta. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ko jab yeh hadith pahunchi to farmane lage: Shayad yahi wajah hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Hajar-e-Aswad ke paas ke do sutoonon ko chhoote na thay. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain: Ae Ayesha! Agar teri qoum ka jahiliyat ka zamana na hota to main Kaaba ke khazane ko Allah ki raah mein khairat kar dalta aur darwaze ko zameen-doz kar deta aur Hateem ko Baitullah mein dakhil kar deta. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh bhi hai ke main is ka doosra darwaza bhi bana deta, ek aane ke liye aur doosra jaane ke liye. Chunancha Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) ne apne zamana-e-khilafat mein aisa hi kiya aur ek riwayat mein hai ke ise main dobara banaye-e-Ibrahimi par banata.

Dusri riwayat mein hai ke ek darwaza mashriq rukh karta aur dusra maghrib rukh aur chhe haath Hateem ko is mein dakhil kar leta jise Quraish ne bahar kar diya hai. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat se paanch saal pehle Quraish ne naye sire se Ka'aba banaya tha, is ka mufassal zikr mulahiza ho. Is bina mein khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi shareek thay, aap ki umr paintis saal ki thi aur patthar aap bhi uthate thay. Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki umr-e-mubarak paintis saal ki hui, us waqt Quraish ne Ka'abatullah ko naye sire se banane ka irada kiya. Ek to is liye ke is ki deewarein bahut chhoti thin, chhat na thi, dusre is liye bhi ke Baitullah ka khazana chori ho gaya tha jo Baitullah ke beech mein ek gehre garhay mein rakha hua tha. Yeh maal "Duwaik" ke paas mila tha jo Khuzaima ke qabeelay Bani Maleeh bin Amr ka maula tha. Mumkin hai choron ne yahan la rakha ho lekin is ke haath is chori ki wajah se kaatay gaye. Ek aur qudrati sahoolat bhi is ke liye ho gayi thi ke Room ke tajiron ki ek kashti jis mein bahut aala darjay ki lakriyan thin, woh toofan ki wajah se Jeddah ke kinaray aa lagi thi. Yeh lakriyan chhat mein kaam aa sakti thin, is liye Quraishiyon ne unhein khareed liya aur Makkah ke ek barhai jo Qibti qabeelay mein se tha ko chhat ka kaam saunpa. Yeh sab tayariyan to ho rahi thin lekin Baitullah ko girane ki himmat na parti thi. Is ke qudrati asbaab bhi muhayya ho gaye. Baitullah ke khazanay mein ek bara azdaha tha, jab kabhi log is ke qareeb bhi jaate to woh munh phaad kar un ki taraf lapakta tha. Yeh saanp har roz is kunwein se nikal kar Baitullah ki deewaron par aa baithta tha. Ek roz woh baitha hua tha to Allah Ta'ala ne ek bahut bara parinda bheja, woh use pakar kar le ura. Quraishiyon ne samajh liya ke hamara irada marzi-e-Maula ke mutabiq hai, lakriyan bhi hamein mil gayin, barhai bhi hamare paas maujood hai, saanp ko bhi Allah Ta'ala ne dafa kiya. Ab unhon ne mustaqil irada kar liya ke Ka'abatullah ko gira kar naye sire se banayen. Sab se pehle Ibn-e-Wahb khara hua aur ek patthar Ka'abatullah ko gira kar utara jo is ke haath se ur kar phir wahin ja kar nasb ho gaya. Is ne tamam Quraishiyon se khitab kar ke kaha suno, Baitullah ke banane mein har shakhs apna tayyab aur paak maal kharch kare. Is mein zina-kari ka rupiya, soodi byopar ka rupiya, zulm se hasil kiya hua maal na lagana. Ba'az log kehte hain yeh mashwara Waleed bin Mugheera ne diya tha. Ab Baitullah ke hissay baant liye gaye, darwaza ka hissa Banu Abd-e-Manaf aur Zuhra banayen, Hajar-e-Aswad aur Rukn-e-Yamani ka hissa Banu Makhzoom banayen. Quraish ke aur qabail bhi un ka saath dein. Ka'aba ka pichla hissa Banu Jumah aur Sahm banayen. Hateem ke paas ka hissa Banu Abd-e-Dar, Banu Qasf aur Banu Asad bin Abdul Uzza aur Banu Adi bin Ka'ab banayen.

Yeh muqarrar kar ke ibn-e-bani hui imarat ko dhane ke liye chale lekin kisi ko himmat nahin padti ke use mismar karna shuru kare. Aakhir Waleed bin Mughira ne kaha lo main shuru karta hoon, kudal le kar upar chadh gaye aur kehne lage ae Allah tujhe khoob ilm hai ke hamara irada bura nahin, hum tere ghar ko ujadna nahin chahte balkeh is ke abad karne ki fikr mein hain. Yeh keh kar kuch hissa dono rukn ke kinaron ka giraya. Quraishiyon ne kaha bas ab chhodo aur raat bhar ka intezar karo, agar is shakhs par koi wabaal aa jaye to yeh patthar isi jagah par laga dena aur khamosh ho jana aur agar koi azab na aaye to samajh lena ke is ka girana Allah ko na-pasand nahin, phir kal sab mil kar apne apne kaam mein lag jana. Chunancha subah hui aur har tarah khairiyat rahi, ab sab aa gaye aur Baitullah ki agli imarat ko gira diya yahan tak ke asli neev yani bina-e-Ibrahimi tak pahunch gaye. Yahan sabz rang ke patthar the, jin ke hilne ke sath hi tamam Makkah ki zameen hilne lagi to unhon ne samajh liya ke inhe juda kar ke aur patthar in ki jagah lagana Allah ko manzoor nahin, is liye hamare bas ki baat nahin, is irade se baaz rahe aur in pattharon ko isi tarah rehne diya. Phir har qabeela ne apne apne hissa ke mutabiq alaihda alaihda patthar jama kiye aur imarat banni shuru hui yahan tak ke ba-qaida jang ki naubat aa gayi, firqe aapas mein khinch gaye aur ladai ki tayariyon mein mashghool ho gaye. Banu Abd-e-Dar aur Banu Adi ne ek tashtari mein khoon bhar kar is mein hath dubo kar halaf uthaya ke sab kat marenge lekin Hajar-e-Aswad kisi ko nahin rakhne denge. Isi tarah char paanch din guzar gaye, phir Quraish masjid mein jama hue ke aapas mein mashwara aur insaaf karein, to Abu Umayya bin Mughira ne jo Quraish mein sab se zyada mu'ammar aur aqalmand the kaha suno logo tum apna munsif kisi ko bana lo, woh jo faisla kare sab manzoor kar lo. Lekin phir munsif banane mein bhi ikhtilaf hoga is liye aisa karo ke ab jo sab se pehle yahan masjid mein aaye wohi hamara munsif. Is raye par sab ne ittefaq kar liya. Ab muntazir hain ke dekhein sab se pehle kaun aata hai? Pas sab se pehle Hazrat Muhammad Rasoolullah (ﷺ) aaye. Aap ko dekhte hi yeh log khush ho gaye aur kehne lage hamein aap ka faisla manzoor hai, hum aap ke hukum par raza-mand hain. Yeh to Ameen hain, yeh to Muhammad (ﷺ) hain. Phir sab aap ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur sara waqia aap ko keh sunaya. Aap ne farmaya jao koi moti aur badi si chadar lao, woh le aaye. Aap ne Hajar-e-Aswad utha kar apne dast-e-mubarak se is mein rakha, phir farmaya har qabeela ka sardar aaye aur is kapde ka kona pakad le aur is tarah har ek Hajar-e-Aswad ke uthane ka hissa-dar bane. Is par sab log bahut hi khush hue aur tamam sardaron ne ise tham kar utha liya. Jab is ke rakhne ki jagah tak pahunche to Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne ise le kar apne hath se isi jagah rakh diya aur woh niza'a-o-ikhtilaf balkeh jidal-o-qitaal rafa ho gaya aur is tarah Allah ne apne Rasool (ﷺ) ke hath apne ghar mein is mubarak patthar ko nasb karaya.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par wahi nazil hone se pehle Quraish aap ko Ameen kaha karte the. Ab phir upar ka hissa bana aur Ka'batullah ki imarat tamam hui. Ibn-e-Ishaq muwarrikh farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein Ka'ba athara hath ka tha. Qibati ka parda charhaya jata tha phir chadar ka parda charhne laga. Reshmi parda sab se pehle Hajjaj bin Yusuf ne charhaya. Ka'ba ki yahi imarat rahi yahan tak ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) ki khilafat ke ibtidai zamane mein sath saal ke baad yahan aag lagi aur Ka'ba jal gaya. Yeh Yazid bin Muawiyah ki wilayat ka aakhri zamana tha aur us ne Ibn-e-Zubair ka Makkah mein muhasara kar rakha tha. In dinon mein khalifa-e-Makkah Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) ne apni khala Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) se jo hadith suni thi usi ke mutabiq Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tamanna par Baitullah ko gira kar Ibrahimi qawaid par banaya, Hateem andar shamil kar liya, mashriq-o-maghrib do darwaze rakhe, ek andar aane ka dusra bahar jaane ka aur darwazon ko zameen ke barabar rakha. Aap ki imarat ke zamane tak Ka'batullah yunhi raha yahan tak ke zalim Hajjaj ke hathon aap shaheed hue. Ab Hajjaj ne Abdul Malik bin Marwan ke hukum se Ka'ba ko phir tor kar pehle ki tarah bana liya. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Yazid bin Muawiyah ke zamane mein jab ke Shamiyon ne Makkah Sharif par charhai ki aur jo hona tha woh hua. Us waqt Hazrat Abdullah ne Baitullah ko yunhi chor diya. Mausam-e-Hajj ke mauqe par log jama hue, unhon ne yeh sab kuch dekha. Baad azan aap ne logon se mashwara liya ke kya Ka'batullah saare ko gira kar naye sire se banayen ya jo tota hua hai uski islah kar len? To Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya meri raye yeh hai ke aap jo tota hua hai usi ki murammat kar den, baqi sab purana hai rehne den. Aap ne farmaya agar tum mein se kisi ka ghar jal jata to woh to khush na hota jab tak use naye sire se na banata, phir tum apne Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal ke ghar ki nisbat itni kamzor raye kyun rakhte ho? Acha main teen din tak apne Rabb se istikhara karunga phir jo samajh mein aayega woh karunga. Teen din ke baad aap ki raye yahi hui ke baqi manda diwaren bhi tori jayen aur az-sare-nau Ka'ba ki tameer ki jaye. Chunancha yeh hukum de diya lekin Ka'be ko torne ki kisi ki himmat nahin parti thi. Dar tha ke jo pehle torne ke liye charhega us par azab nazil hoga lekin ek bahimat shakhs charh gaya aur us ne ek patthar tora. Jab logon ne dekha ke use kuch eza nahin pahunchi to ab dhana shuru kiya aur zameen tak barabar yaksan saaf kar diya. Us waqt charon taraf sutoon khare kar diye the aur ek kapra taan diya tha. Ab bina-e-Baitullah shuru hui.

Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya main ne Hazrat Aisha R.A se suna woh kehti thin Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya hai agar logon ka kufr ka zamana qareeb na hota aur mere paas kharch bhi hota jis mein bana sakoon toh Hateem mein se paanch haath Baitullah mein le leta aur Kaaba ke do darwaze karta ek aane ka aur ek jaane ka. Hazrat Abdullah ne yeh riwayat bayan kar ke farmaya ab logon ke kufr ka zamana qareeb ka nahin raha un se khauf jata raha aur khazana bhi mamoor hai mere paas kaafi rupiya hai phir koi wajah nahin ke main Huzoor ﷺ ki tamanna poori na karoon. Chunancha paanch haath Hateem andar le li aur ab jo deewar khadi ki toh theek Ibrahimi bunyad nazar aane lagi jo logon ne apni aankhon dekh li aur isi par deewar khadi ki. Baitullah ka tool athara haath tha ab jo is mein paanch haath aur barh gaya toh chota ho gaya is liye tool mein das haath aur barhaya gaya aur do darwaze banaye gaye ek andar aane ka dusra bahar jaane ka. Ibn Zubair ki shahadat ke baad Hajjaj bin Abdul Malik ko likha aur un se mashwara liya ke ab kya kiya jaye? Yeh bhi likh bheja ke Makka Sharif ke aadilon ne dekha hai theek Hazrat Ibrahim ki neev par Kaaba tayyar hua hai lekin Abdul Malik ne jawab diya ke tool ko toh baqi rehne do aur Hateem ko bahar kar do aur dusra darwaza band kar do. Hajjaj ne is hukm ke mutabiq Kaaba ko turwa kar phir usi bina par bana diya lekin sunnat tareeqa yahi tha ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair ki bina ko baqi rakha jata is liye ke Huzoor ﷺ ki chahat yahi thi lekin us waqt aap ko yeh khauf tha ke log badgumani na karein abhi naye naye Islam mein dakhil hue hain lekin yeh hadith Abdul Malik bin Marwan ko nahin pahunchi thi is liye unhon ne ise turwa diya jab unhein hadith pahunchi toh ranj karte thay aur kehte thay kaash ke hum yunhi rehne dete aur na turate. Chunancha Sahih Muslim Sharif ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke Haris Ubaidullah jab ek wafd mein Abdul Malik bin Marwan ke paas pahunche toh Abdul Malik ne kaha mera khayal hai ke Abu Habib yani Abdullah bin Zubair ne (apni khala) Hazrat Aisha se yeh hadith suni hogi. Haris ne kaha zaroor suni thi khud main ne bhi Umm-ul-Momineen se suna hai. Poocha tum ne kya suna hai? Kaha main ne suna hai aap farmati thin ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne ek martaba mujh se farmaya ke Aisha teri qoum ne Baitullah ko tang kar diya.

Agar teri qoum ka zamana shirk ke qareeb na hota toh main naye sire se in ki kami ko pura kardeta lekin aao main tujhe asli neev bata doon shayad kisi waqt teri qoum phir ise is ki asliyat par banana chahe toh aap ne Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ko Hateem mein se qareeban saat haath andar daakhil karne ko farmaya aur farmaya main is ke darwaze bana deta ek aane ke liye aur dusra jaane ke liye aur dono darwaze zameen ke barabar rakhta ek mashriq rukh rakhta dusra maghrib rukh jaanti bhi ho ke tumhari qoum ne darwaze ko itna ooncha kyun rakha hai? Aap ne farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe khabar nahin farmaya mehez apni oonchai aur badai ke liye ke jise chahein andar jaane dein aur jise chahein daakhil na hone dein jab koi shakhs andar jaana chahta toh use oopar se dhakka de dete woh gir padta aur jise daakhil karna chahte use haath thaam kar andar le lete. Abdul Malik ne kaha ise Haris khud suna hai toh thodi der tak toh Abdul Malik apni lakdi tikaye sochte rahe phir kehne lage kaash ke main ise yunhi chhod deta. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke Abdul Malik bin Marwan ne ek martaba tawaf karte hue Hazrat Abdullah ko kos kar kaha ke woh Hazrat Aisha (R.A) par is hadith ka bohtan baandhna tha toh Hazrat Haris ne roka aur shahadat di ke woh sache the main ne bhi Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) se yeh suna hai ab Abdul Malik afsos karne lage aur kehne lage agar mujhe pehle se maloom hota toh main hargiz ise na todta. Qazi Ayaz aur Imam Nawawi (R.H) ne likha hai Khalifa Haroon Rashid ne Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) se poocha tha ke agar aap ijazat dein toh main phir Kaaba ko Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) ke banaye hue ke mutabiq bana doon, Imam Malik (R.H) ne farmaya aap aisa na kijiye aisa na ho ke Kaaba badshahon ka ek khilona ban jaye jo aaye apni tabiyat ke mutabiq tod phod karta rahe chunancha Khalifa apne irade se baaz rahe yahi baat theek bhi maloom hoti hai ke Kaaba ko baar baar chhedna theek nahin. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Kaaba ko do chhoti pindliyon wala ek Habshi phir kharab karega. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain goya main ise dekh raha hoon woh siyah faam ek ek patthar alag alag kar dega is ka ghilaf le jaye ga aur is ka khazana bhi woh tedhe haath paon wala aur ganja hoga main dekh raha hoon ke goya woh kudal baja raha hai aur barabar tukde kar raha hai ghaliban yeh nashudni waqia (jis ke dekhne se hamein mehfooz rakhe) Yajuj Majuj ke nikal chukne ke baad hoga. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki ek hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum Yajuj Majuj ke nikalne ke baad bhi Baitullah Sharif ka hajj-o-umra karoge. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) aur Hazrat Ismail (A.S) apni dua mein kehte hain ke hamein Musalman bana le yani mukhlis bana le muti bana le maujood har shar se bacha. Riya kaari se mehfooz rakh khushoo-o-khuzoo ata farma.

Hazrat Salam bin Abi Muti' farmate hain musalman toh thay hi lekin Islam ki sabit qadmi talab karte hain jis ke jawab mein irshad-e-bari hua Qad fa'altu main ne tumhari yeh dua qabool farmai phir apni aulad ke liye bhi yahi dua karte hain jo qabool hoti hai. Bani Israel bhi aap ki aulad mein hain aur Arab bhi. Quran mein hai aayat (Wa min qawmi Musa ummatun yahduna bil-haqqi wa bihi ya'dilun) (Surah Al-A'raf: 159) yani Musa ki qoum mein ek jamaat haq aur adl par thi lekin rawani-e-ibarat se maloom hota hai ke Arab ke liye yeh dua go aam tor par dusron par bhi mushtamil ho is liye ke is ke baad dusri dua mein hai ke in mein ek Rasool bhej aur is Rasool se murad Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ hain. Chunancha yeh dua bhi puri hui jaise farmaya aayat (Huwallazi ba'atha fil-ummiyyina rasulan minhum) lekin is se aap ki risalat khas nahin hoti balkay aap ki risalat aam hai Arab-o-Ajam sab ke liye jaise aayat (Qul ya ayyuhan-nasu inni rasulullahi ilaikum jami'a) (Surah Al-A'raf: 158) keh do ke ae logo main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka Rasool hoon. In dono nabiyon ki yeh dua jaisi hai aisi hi har muttaqi ki dua honi chahiye. Jaise Qurani taleem hai ke musalman yeh dua karein aayat (Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa zurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama) (Surah Al-Furqan: 74) ae hamare Rab hamein hamari biwiyon aur auladon se hamari aankhon ki thandak ata farma aur hamein parhezgaron ka imam bana. Yeh bhi Allah Ta'ala ki mohabbat ki daleel hai insan yeh chahe ke meri aulad mere baad bhi Allah ki aabid rahe. Aur jagah is dua ke alfaaz yeh hain aayat (Wajnubni wa baniyya an na'budal-asnam) (Surah Ibrahim: 35) ae Allah mujhe aur meri aulad ko but parasti se bacha. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain insan ke marte hi us ke a'maal khatam ho jate hain magar teen kaam jaari rehte hain: sadqa, ilm jis se nafa hasil kiya jaye aur nek aulad jo dua karti rahe (Muslim). Phir aap dua karte hain ke hamein manasik dikha yani ahkaam-o-zibah waghera sikha. Hazrat Jibraeel A.S aap ko le kar Ka'aba ki imarat puri ho jane ke baad Safa par aate hain phir Marwa par jate hain aur farmate hain yeh sha'air-e-Allah hain phir Mina ki taraf le chale, Aqaba par shaitan darakht ke paas khara hua mila toh farmaya takbeer parh kar use kankar maro. Iblees yahan se bhaag kar Jamra-e-Wusta ke paas ja khara hua. Yahan bhi use kankariyan maarein toh yeh khabees na-umeed ho kar chala gaya. Is ka irada tha ke Hajj ke ahkaam mein kuch dakhal de lekin mauqa na mila aur mayoos ho gaya. Yahan se aap ko Mash'ar-ul-Haram mein laye phir Arafat mein pohanchaya phir teen baar pucha kaho samajh liya? Aap ne farmaya haan. Dusri riwayat mein teen jagah shaitan ko kankariyan maarni marwi hain aur yeh shaitan ko saat saat kankariyan maari hain.

Du'a-e-Ibrahim A.S ka mahasil Ahl-e-Haram ke liye yeh du'a bhi hai ke aap ki aulad mein se hi Rasool un mein aaye chunancha yeh bhi poori hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain "Main Allah Jalla Shanahu ke nazdeek aakhri Nabi us waqt se hoon jabke Adam abhi mitti ki surat mein thay" main tumhein ibtidai amr bataoon main apne baap Ibrahim ki du'a aur Hazrat Isa A.S ne di aur meri maa ne dekha ke goya un mein se ek noor nikla, jis se Sham ke mahal chamka diye. "Matlab yeh hai ke duniya mein shohrat ka zariya yeh cheezein huin. Aap ki walida sahiba ka khwab bhi Arab mein pehle hi mashhoor ho gaya tha aur woh kehte hain ke batn-e-Amina se koi bada shakhs paida hoga Bani Israel ke Nabiyon ke khatam karne wale Hazrat Roohullah ne to Bani Israel mein khutba padhte hue aap ka saaf naam bhi le diya aur farmaya logo main tumhari taraf Allah ka Rasool hoon, mujh se pehle ki kitab Taurat ki main tasdeeq karta hoon aur mere baad aane wale Nabi ki main tumhein basharat deta hoon jin ka naam Ahmad hai ﷺ isi ki taraf is hadith mein ishara hai, khwab mein noor se Sham ke mahal ka chamak uthna ishara hai, is amr ki taraf ke deen wahan jam jayega balkeh riwayaton se sabit hai ke aakhir zamana mein Sham Islam aur Ahl-e-Islam ka markaz jayega. Sham ke mashhoor shehar Damishq hi mein Hazrat Isa A.S sharqi safed minara par nazil honge. Bukhari Muslim mein hai "Meri ummat ki ek jamaat haq par qaim rahegi, un ke mukhalifeen unhein nuqsan na pahuncha sakenge yahan tak ke Amr-e-Ilahi aajaye" Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke "Woh Sham mein honge." Abu Aliyah se marwi hai ke yeh bhi isi maqbool du'a ka ek hissa hai ke aur yeh paighambar-e-aakhir zamana mein mab'oos honge. "Kitab se murad Quran aur Hikmat se murad Sunnat-o-Hadith hai Hasan aur Qatadah aur Muqatil bin Hayyan aur Abu Malik waghera ka yahi farman hai aur Hikmat se murad deen ki samajh boojh bhi hai. Paak karna yani ta'at-o-ikhlas seekhna, bhalaian karana, buraiyon se bachana, ita'at-e-Ilahi kar ke raza-e-Rabb hasil karna, nafarmani se bach kar narazgi se mehfooz rehna. Allah Aziz hai jise koi cheez nahi kar sakti jo har cheez par ghalib hai woh Hakeem hai yani us ka koi qaul-o-fe'l hikmat se khali nahin, woh har cheez ko apne mehal par hi hikmat-o-adl-o-ilm ke sath rakhta hai.

Tauheed ke da'we aur mushrikeen ka zikr. In aayaton mein bhi mushrikeen ki tardeed hai ke jo apne aap ko Deen-e-Ibrahimi par batate thay halankeh kamil mushrik thay jabkeh Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) muwahidon ke imam thay. Tauheed ko shirk se mumtaz karne wale thay, umr bhar mein ek aankh jhapakne ke barabar bhi Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek nahin kiya, balkeh har mushrik se aur har qisam ke shirk se aur har ghair-ullah se jo Allah mana jata ho, woh dil se nafrat karte thay aur un sab se bezar thay. Isi bina par qoum se alag hue, watan chhora, balkeh baap tak ki mukhalifat ki parwah na ki aur saaf keh diya ke aayat (QALA YA QAWMI INNI BARI'UM MIMMA TUSHRIKOON) (Surah Al-An'am: 78) mein bezar hoon, us cheez se jise tum shareek karte ho, main ne toh yaksu ho kar apni tamam tar tawajjah us pak zaat ki taraf kar di hai, jis ne zameen-o-aasman ko paida kiya hai, main shirk karne walon mein se nahin. Aur farmaya ke Ibrahim (A.S) ne apne baap se aur apni qoum se saaf keh diya ke main tumhare maboodon se bari hoon, toh apne khaliq hi ka garwida hoon, wahi mujhe rah-e-rast dikhayega. Aur jagah hai aayat (WAMA KANA ISTIGHFARU IBRAHIMA LI-ABIHI ILLA 'AN MAW'IDATIN WA'ADAHA IYYAH) (Surah At-Tawbah: 114) Ibrahim (A.S) ne apne walid ke liye bhi sirf ek wa'ade ki bina par istighfar ki thi lekin jab unhein maloom hua ke woh Allah ka dushman hai toh us se bezar ho gaye. Rabb ki ne'amaton ke shukr guzar thay, Allah Rabb-e-Ka'aba ke pasandeeda thay aur rah-e-rast par lage hue thay, duniya ke bhale logon mein se thay aur aakhirat mein bhi saleh logon mein honge. In aayaton ki tarah yahan bhi farmaya ke "Apni janon par zulm karne wale, be-tadbeer aur gumrah log hi Millat-e-Ibrahimi ko tark karte hain kyunkeh Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko Allah ne hidayat ke liye chun liya tha aur bachpan se hi taufeeq-e-haq de rakhi thi, Khalil jaisa mu'azzaz khitab unhi ko diya gaya. Woh aakhirat mein bhi sa'eed bakht logon mein hain. Un ke maslak-o-millat ko chhor kar zalalat-o-gumrahi mein parne wale se zyada bewaqoof aur zalim aur kaun hoga?" Is aayat mein Yahudiyon ka bhi radd hai. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (MA KANA IBRAHIMU YAHUDIYYA) Ibrahim (A.S) na toh Yahudi thay, na Nasrani, na mushrik balkeh muwahid musalman aur mukhlis thay. Un se dosti rakhne wale sirf wohi jo un ke farman-bardar hue aur yeh Nabi aur imandar, Allah bhi mominon ka wali hai. Jab kabhi Allah farmata ke yeh maan lo woh jawab dete ke Aye Rabb-ul-Aalameen main ne maan liya, isi millat-e-wahdaniyat ki wasiyat Ibrahim (A.S) aur Ya'qub (A.S) ne apni aulad ko bhi ki. Ha ki zameer ka marja' ya toh millat hai ya kalma, millat se murad Islam aur kalma se murad aayat (ASLAMTU LI-RABBIL AALAMEEN) hai. Dekhiye un ke dil mein Islam ki kis qadar mohabbat-o-izzat thi ke khud bhi is par muddat-ul-umr aamil rahe, apni aulad ko bhi isi ki wasiyat ki. Aur jagah hai aayat (WA JA'ALAHA KALIMATAN BAQIYATAN FI 'AQIBIHI LA'ALLAHUM YARJI'OON) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 28).

(Az-Zukhruf: 28) Hum ne is kalma ko un ki aulad mein bhi baqi rakha, ba'az salaf ne "wa Ya'qub" bhi parha toh "baina" par atf hoga aur matlab yeh hoga ke Khalilullah ne apni aulad ko aur aulad ki aulad mein Hazrat Ya'qub ko jo us waqt maujood thay deen-e-Islam ki istiqamat ki wasiyat ki. Qushairi kehte hain, "Hazrat Ya'qub, Hazrat Ibrahim ke inteqal ke baad paida huay thay, lekin yeh mujarrad da'wa hai, jis par koi sahih daleel nahin. Wallahu A'lam. Balkay bazahir yeh maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Ya'qub Hazrat Ishaq ke haan Hazrat Ibrahim ki zindagi mein paida huay thay kyunke Quran-e-Pak ki ayat mein hai, ayat (Fa bashsharnaha bi Ishaqa wa min wara'i Ishaqa Ya'qub) (11. Hud: 71) yani hum ne unhein Ishaq ki aur Ishaq ke peechay Ya'qub ki khushkhabri di aur is ka nasb khafz ko hata kar bhi parha gaya hai, pas agar Hazrat Ya'qub Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki hayat mein maujood na hon toh phir un ka naam lene mein koi zabardast faida baqi nahin rehta. Surah Ankabut mein bhi hai ke hum ne Ibrahim ko Ishaq o Ya'qub ata farmaya aur is ki aulad mein hum ne nabuwwat o kitab di aur isi ayat mein hai hum ne usay Ishaq diya aur Ya'qub za'id ata farmaya. Un se maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Ya'qub Hazrat Ibrahim ki zindagi mein hi thay, agli kitabon mein bhi hai ke woh Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein aayenge. Abu Zar (R.A) ek martaba poochte hain, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) kaunsi masjid pehle tameer ki gayi? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Masjid-e-Haram. Poocha, phir farmaya, Masjid-e-Bait-ul-Muqaddas. Maine kaha dono ke darmiyan kis qadar muddat thi? Farmaya, chalees saal. Ibn-e-Hibban ne kaha hai ke "Hazrat Ibrahim aur Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihimas Salam) ki darmiyani muddat se mutaliq yeh bayan hai" halankay yeh qaul bilkul ulat hai. In dono nabiyon ke darmiyan toh hazaron saal ki muddat thi balkay matlab hadith ka kuch aur hi hai aur Shah-e-Zaman Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salatu Was Salam toh is masjid ke mujaddid thay, mujid na thay. Isi tarah Hazrat Ya'qub (A.S) ne bhi wasiyat ki thi, jaise anqareeb zikr aayega. Wasiyat is amr ki hoti hai jab tak zinda raho musalman ho kar raho taake maut bhi isi par aaye. Maut aur hamaray a'maal: Umooman insaan zindagi mein jin a'maal par rehta hai, isi par maut bhi aati hai aur jis par marta hai, us par uthay ga bhi. Yehi Allah Ta'ala ka dastoor hai ke bhalai ke qasd karne walay ko bhalai ki taufeeq bhi di jaati hai. Bhalai us par aasaan bhi kar di jaati hai aur usay sabit qadam bhi rakha jaata hai. Koi shak nahin ke hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke insaan jannatiyon ke kaam karte karte jannat mein ek haath door reh jaata hai ke us ki taqdeer us par ghalib aati hai aur woh jahannumiyon ka kaam kar ke jahannumi ban jaata hai aur kabhi is ke khilaf bhi hota hai lekin is se matlab yeh hai ke yeh kaam achay buray zahiri hotay hain, haqeeqi nahin hotay.

Imam Malik R.H, Imam Shafi R.H aur ek mashhoor riwayat mein Imam Ahmed R.H se manqool hai ke woh bhaiyon behnon ko bhi waris qarar detay hain. Hazrat Umar R.A, Hazrat Usman R.A, Hazrat Ali R.A, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A, Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit R.A aur salaf-o-khalaf ka mazhab bhi yahi hai. Imam Malik R.H, Imam Shafi R.H, Basri R.H, Taoos R.H aur Ata R.H bhi yahi kehtay hain. Imam Abu Hanifa R.H aur bohat se salaf-o-khalaf ka mazhab bhi yahi hai. Qazi Abu Yusuf R.H aur Muhammad bin Hassan R.H bhi yahi kehtay hain aur yeh dono Imam Abu Hanifa R.H ke shagird-e-rasheed hain. Is maslay ki safai ka yeh maqam nahin aur na tafsir ka yeh mauzoo hai. In sab bachon ne iqrar kiya ke hum ek hi mabood ki ibadat karenge yani us Allah ki uluhiyat mein kisi ko sharik na karenge aur hum us ki itaat guzari, farmanbardari aur khushoo-o-khuzoo mein mashghool raha karenge. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa lahu aslama) al-kh, zameen-o-aasman ki har cheez khushi aur na-khushi se us ki muti hai, us ki taraf tum sab lautaye jaoge. Tamam ambiya ka deen yahi Islam raha hai agarche ahkaam mein ikhtilaf raha hai. Jaise farmaya ayat (Wa ma arsalna min qablika mir rasulin illa noohi ilaihi annahu la ilaha illa ana fa'budoon) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 25) yani tujh se pehle jitnay rasool hum ne bhejay sab ki taraf wahi ki ke mere siwa koi mabood nahin, tum sab meri hi ibadat kartay raho. Aur aayatein bhi is mazmoon ki bohat si hain aur ahadees mein bhi yeh mazmoon bakasrat warid hai. An-Hazrat ﷺ farmatay hain "Hum allati bhai hain, hamara deen ek hai". Phir farmata hai yeh ummat jo guzar chuki tumhein un ki taraf nisbat nafa na degi, haan agar amal hon toh aur baat hai, un ke aamal un ke sath aur tumhare aamal tumhare sath, tum un ke afaal ke baray mein nahin poochay jaoge. Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai jis ka amal acha na hoga us ka nasab usay koi faida nahin dega.

Azali aur abadi mustahiq-e-ibadat Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu. Mushrikeen-e-Arab par jo Hazrat Ismail A.S ki aulad thay aur Kuffar-e-Bani Israel par jo Hazrat Yaqub A.S ki aulad thay daleel laatay huay Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke Hazrat Yaqub A.S ne toh apni aulad ko apne aakhri waqt mein Allah Ta'ala Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat ki wasiyat ki thi. Un se pehle toh poocha ke tum mere baad kis ki ibadat karoge? Sab ne jawab diya ke aap ke aur aap ke buzurgon ki jo bar-haq thi. Hazrat Yaqub A.S, Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke larkay aur Hazrat Ishaq A.S, Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke. Hazrat Ismail A.S ka naam baap dadon ke zikr mein bator-e-takhtib ke aa gaya hai kyunke aap chacha hotay hain aur yeh bhi wazeh rahay ke Arab mein chacha ko bhi baap keh detay hain. Is ayat se istidlal kar ke dada ko bhi baap ke hukum mein rakh kar dada ki maujoodgi mein behan bhai ko virsa se mehroom kiya hai. Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ka faisla yahi hai jaise ke Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein maujood hai, Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha R.A ka mazhab bhi yahi hai. Abdullah bin Suriya Awar ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha tha ke hidayat par hum hain tum hamari mano to tumhein bhi hidayat milegi. Nasraniyon ne bhi yehi kaha tha. Is par yeh aayat nazil hui ke hum to Ibrahim Hanif (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke muttabe hain jo istiqamat wale, ikhlas wale, hajj wale, Baitullah ki taraf munh karne wale, istita'at ke waqt hajj ko farz janne wale, Allah ki farmanbardari karne wale, tamam rasoolon par iman lane wale, La Ilaha Illallah ki shahadat dene wale, maa beti khala phuphi ko haram janne wale aur tamam haram kariyon se bachne wale thay. Hanif ke yeh sab ma'ani mukhtalif hazrat ne bayan kiye hain.

Ahl-e-Kitab ki tasdeeq ya takzeeb! Allah Ta'ala apne imandar bandon ko irshad farmata hai ke jo kuch Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ par utra us par toh woh tafseel-war iman layein aur jo Aap ﷺ se pehle ambiya par utra, us par bhi ijmalan iman layein. In agle ambiya-e-kiram mein se baaz ke naam bhi le diye aur baqi nabiyon ka mujmal zikr kar diya. Saath hi farmaya ke yeh kisi nabi ke darmiyan tafreeq na karein ke ek ko manein aur dusre se inkar kar jayein jo aadat auron ki thi ke woh ambiya mein tafreeq karte thay, kisi ko mante thay, kisi se inkari thay, yahudi Hazrat Isa A.S aur Muhammad ﷺ teenon ko nahin mante thay. In sab ko fatwa mila ke aayat (Ula'ika humul kafiruna haqqan) (Surah An-Nisa: 151) yeh log bil-yaqeen kafir hain. Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A farmate hain "Ahl-e-Kitab Taurat ko Ibrani mein parhte thay aur Arabi mein tafseer kar ke Ahl-e-Islam ko sunate thay." Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya ke Ahl-e-Kitab ki sachai ya takzeeb na karo. Keh diya ke Allah par aur us ki nazil hui kitabon par hamara iman hai. Nabi ﷺ subh ki do sunnaton mein pehli rakat mein yeh aayat (Amanna billahi wa ma unzila ilaina) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 136) puri aayat aur dusri rakat mein aayat (Amanna billahi wash-had bi-anna muslimun) (Surah Al-Imran: 52) parha karte thay. Asbaat Hazrat Yaqub A.S ke beton ko kehte hain, jo barah thay, jin mein se har ek ki nasal mein bohat se insan hue, Bani Ismail ko qabail kehte thay, aur Bani Israel ko asbaat kehte thay. Zamakhshari ne Kashaf mein likha hai ke yeh Hazrat Yaqub A.S ke pote thay jo un ke barah larkon ki aulad thi. Bukhari mein hai ke murad qabail-e-Bani Israel hain. In mein bhi nabi hue thay jin par wahi nazil hui thi. Jaise Musa A.S ne farmaya aayat (Iz ja'ala feekum ambiya'a wa ja'alakum mulukan wa atakum ma lam yu'ti ahadan minal alameen) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 20) Allah ki ne'mat ko yaad karo ke us ne tum mein ambiya aur badshah banaye. Aur jagah hai aayat (Wa qatta'nahum ithnatay ash-rata asbatan umaman) (Surah Al-A'raf: 160) hum ne un ke barah giroh kar diye. Sibt kehte hain darakht ko yani yeh misl-e-darakht ke hain, jis ki shakhein phaili hui hain. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain kul ambiya Bani Israel mein se hi hue hain siwaye das ke: Nuh, Hud, Saleh, Shoaib, Ibrahim, Lut, Ishaq, Yaqub, Ismail, Muhammad Alaihimus Salam. Sibt kehte hain us jamaat aur qabeela ko jin ka moris-e-aala upar ja kar ek ho. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai hamein Taurat-o-Injeel par iman rakhna zaroori hai lekin amal ke liye sirf Quran-o-Hadith hi hai.

Shart-e-Najat yani apne imandar sahabiyo! Agar yeh kuffar bhi tum jaisa iman layein yani tamam kitabon aur rasoolon ko maan lein toh haq-o-rushd hidayat-o-najat payenge aur agar bawajood qayam-e-hujjat ke baaz rahein toh yaqeenan haq ke khilaf hain. Allah Ta'ala tujhe un par ghalib kar ke tumhare liye kafi hoga, woh sunne janne wala hai. Nafi bin Naeem kehte hain ke kisi khalifa ke paas Hazrat Usman (R.A) ka Quran bheja gaya, Ziyad ne yeh sun kar kaha ke logon mein mashhoor hai ke jab Hazrat Usman (R.A) ko logon ne shaheed kiya us waqt yeh Kalam-e-Allah unki god mein tha aur aap ka khoon theek in alfaaz par tha, aayat (فَسَيَكْفِيْكَهُمُ اللّٰهُ ۚ وَھُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 137) kya yeh sahi hai? Hazrat Nafi ne kaha bilkul theek hai, maine khud is aayat par Zul-Noorain ka khoon dekha tha. Rang se murad deen hai aur iska zabar bator-e-ighra ke hai. Jaise fitrat-e-Allah mein matlab yeh hai ke Allah ke deen ko lazim pakad lo, is par chimat jao. Baaz kehte hain yeh badal hai millat-e-Ibrahim se jo is se pehle majood hai. Sibwaih kehte hain yeh sadar-e-muakkad hai. Aamanna billah ki wajah se mansoob hai jaise wa'ad-e-Allah. Ek marfoo hadith hai "Bani Israel ne kaha ae Rasool-e-Allah! Kya hamara Rab rang bhi karta hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah se daro, aawaz aayi un se keh do ke tamam rang main hi toh paida karta hoon." Yehi matlab is aayat ka bhi hai lekin is riwayat ka mauqoof hona hi sahi hai aur yeh bhi us waqt jab ke iski asnaad sahi hon.
