Mushrikeen ke a'maal par bezari. Mushrikon ke jhagde ko dafa karne ka hukum Rabb-ul-Aalameen apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko de raha hai ke "Tum hum se Allah ki tauheed, ikhlaas, ita'at waghera ke baare mein kyun jhagadte ho? Woh sirf hamara hi nahin balkay tumhara Rabb bhi toh hai, hum par aur tum par qabiz-o-mutasarrif bhi wahi akela hai. Hamare a'maal hamare saath hain aur tumhare a'maal tumhein kaam aayenge, hum tum se aur tumhare shirk se bezar hain." Aur jagah farmaya aayat (Fa-in kazzabooka faqul rabbukum zoo rahmatin wasi'ah) (6. Al-An'am: 147) yani "Agar yeh tujhe jhutlayein toh tu keh de ke mere liye mera amal hai aur tumhare liye tumhara amal hai, tum mere (neek) kaam se aur main tumhare a'maal se bezar hoon." Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Fa-in haajjooka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillahi wa manittaba'an) (3. Aali-Imran: 20) "Agar yeh tujh se jhagdein toh tu keh de main ne aur mere manne walon ne apne munh Allah ki taraf kar diye." Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne bhi apni qoum se yahi farmaya tha aayat (Atuhaajjoonni fillahi wa qad hadaan) (6. Al-An'am: 80) kya tum Allah ke baare mein mujh se ikhtilaf karte ho? Aur jagah hai aayat (Alam tara ilallazi haajja Ibraheema fee rabbihi an aatahullahul mulk) (2. Al-Baqarah: 258) tu ne use bhi dekha jo Ibrahim (A.S) se us ke Rabb ke baare mein jhagadne laga. Pas yahan un jhagdalu logon se kaha gaya ke hamare a'maal hamare liye aur tumhare a'maal tumhare liye. Hum tum se alag. Hum ibadat aur tawajjo mein ikhlaas aur yaksooi karne wale log hain. Phir un logon ke da'we ki tardeed ho rahi hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim na toh Yahoodi, na Nasrani, tum ae Yahudiyo aur ae Nasraniyo kyun yeh baatein bana rahe ho? Kya tumhara ilm Allah se bhi badh gaya hai? Allah ne toh saaf farma diya aayat (Ma kana Ibraheemu Yahoodiyyan wa la Nasraniyan wa lakin kana Haneefan Musliman wa ma kana minal mushrikeen) (3. Aali-Imran: 67) Ibrahim (A.S) na toh Yahoodi thay, na Nasrani, na mushrik, balkay khalis Musalman thay. Un ka haq ki shahadat ko chhupa kar bada zulm karna yeh tha ke Allah ki Kitab jo us ke paas aayi us mein unhon ne padha ke haqeeqi deen Islam hai. Muhammad (ﷺ) sachay Rasool hain. Ibrahim, Isma'eel, Ishaq, Ya'qoob waghera Yahoodiyat aur Nasraniyat se alag thay lekin phir na maana aur itna hi nahin balkay is baat ko bhi chhupa diya. Phir farmaya tumhare a'maal Allah se posheeda nahin, us ka muheet ilm sab cheezon ko ghere hue hai, woh har bhalai aur burai ka poora poora badla de ga. Yeh dhamki de kar phir farmaya ke yeh paakbaaz jama'at toh Allah ke paas pahunch chuki. Tum jab un ke naqsh-e-qadam par na chalo toh sirf un ki aulad mein se hona tumhein Allah ke haan koi izzat aur nafa nahin de sakta hai.

Un ke nek a'maal mein tumhara koi hissa nahin aur tumhari bad-a'maliyon ka un par koi bojh nahin. "Jo kare so bhare." Tum ne jab ek Nabi ko jhutlaya to goya tamam Anbiya ko jhutlaya. Bilkhusoos ae woh logo! Jo Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke mubarak zamane mein ho. Tum to bade hi wabaal mein aa gaye, tum ne to us Nabi ko jhutlaya jo Sayyid-ul-Anbiya, jo Khatm-ul-Mursaleen hain, jo Rasool-e-Rabb-ul-Aalameen hain jin ki risalat tamam insanon aur jinnon ki taraf hai. Jin ki risalat ke manne ka har ek shakhs mukallaf hai. Allah Ta'ala ke beshumar durood-o-salam aap par nazil hon aur aap ke siwa tamam Anbiya-e-Kiram (A.S) par bhi.

Aali-Imran: 20) "Agar yeh tujh se jhagdein toh tu keh de main ne aur mere manne walon ne apne munh Allah ki taraf kar diye." Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne bhi apni qoum se yahi farmaya tha aayat (Atuhaajjoonni fillahi wa qad hadaan) (6. Al-An'am: 80) kya tum Allah ke baare mein mujh se ikhtilaf karte ho? Aur jagah hai aayat (Alam tara ilallazi haajja Ibraheema fee rabbihi an aatahullahul mulk) (2. Al-Baqarah: 258) tu ne use bhi dekha jo Ibrahim (A.S) se us ke Rabb ke baare mein jhagadne laga. Pas yahan un jhagdalu logon se kaha gaya ke hamare a'maal hamare liye aur tumhare a'maal tumhare liye. Hum tum se alag. Hum ibadat aur tawajjo mein ikhlaas aur yaksooi karne wale log hain. Phir un logon ke da'we ki tardeed ho rahi hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim na toh Yahoodi, na Nasrani, tum ae Yahudiyo aur ae Nasraniyo kyun yeh baatein bana rahe ho? Kya tumhara ilm Allah se bhi badh gaya hai? Allah ne toh saaf farma diya aayat (Ma kana Ibraheemu Yahoodiyyan wa la Nasraniyan wa lakin kana Haneefan Musliman wa ma kana minal mushrikeen) (3. Aali-Imran: 67) Ibrahim (A.S) na toh Yahoodi thay, na Nasrani, na mushrik, balkay khalis Musalman thay. Un ka haq ki shahadat ko chhupa kar bada zulm karna yeh tha ke Allah ki Kitab jo us ke paas aayi us mein unhon ne padha ke haqeeqi deen Islam hai. Muhammad (ﷺ) sachay Rasool hain. Ibrahim, Isma'eel, Ishaq, Ya'qoob waghera Yahoodiyat aur Nasraniyat se alag thay lekin phir na maana aur itna hi nahin balkay is baat ko bhi chhupa diya. Phir farmaya tumhare a'maal Allah se posheeda nahin, us ka muheet ilm sab cheezon ko ghere hue hai, woh har bhalai aur burai ka poora poora badla de ga. Yeh dhamki de kar phir farmaya ke yeh paakbaaz jama'at toh Allah ke paas pahunch chuki. Tum jab un ke naqsh-e-qadam par na chalo toh sirf un ki aulad mein se hona tumhein Allah ke haan koi izzat aur nafa nahin de sakta hai.

Un ke nek a'maal mein tumhara koi hissa nahin aur tumhari bad-a'maliyon ka un par koi bojh nahin. "Jo kare so bhare." Tum ne jab ek Nabi ko jhutlaya to goya tamam Anbiya ko jhutlaya. Bilkhusoos ae woh logo! Jo Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke mubarak zamane mein ho. Tum to bade hi wabaal mein aa gaye, tum ne to us Nabi ko jhutlaya jo Sayyid-ul-Anbiya, jo Khatm-ul-Mursaleen hain, jo Rasool-e-Rabb-ul-Aalameen hain jin ki risalat tamam insanon aur jinnon ki taraf hai. Jin ki risalat ke manne ka har ek shakhs mukallaf hai. Allah Ta'ala ke beshumar durood-o-salam aap par nazil hon aur aap ke siwa tamam Anbiya-e-Kiram (A.S) par bhi.

Tahweel-e-Ka'aba ek imtehan bhi tha. Aur taqarrur-e-jihat bhi. Be-waqoofon se murad yahan mushrikeen-e-Arab aur ulama-e-Yahood aur munafiqeen waghera hain. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein Hazrat Bara (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne solah ya satra mahine tak Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf namaz padhi lekin khud aap ki chahat yeh thi ke aap ka qibla Baitullah Shareef ho. Chunancha ab hukm aa gaya aur aap ne Asr ki namaz us ki taraf ada ki. Aap ke sath ke namaziyon mein se ek shakhs kisi aur masjid mein pahuncha, wahan jamaat ruku mein thi us ne un se kaha Allah ki qasam main Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath Makka ki taraf namaz padh kar abhi aa raha hoon. Jab un logon ne suna to isi halat mein woh Ka'aba ki taraf ghoom gaye, ab ba'az logon ne yeh kaha ke jo log agle qibla ki taraf namazein padhte hue shaheed ho chuke hain un ki namazon ka kya haal hai. Tab yeh farman nazil hua ke (Wama kanallahu) al-kh, yani Allah tumhare imaan ko zaya na karega. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke "Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf namaz padhte the to aap aksar aasman ki taraf nazrein uthate the aur Allah Ta'ala ke hukm ke muntazir the yahan tak ke aayat (Qad nara) al-kh, yani Allah tumhare imaan ko zaya na karega. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf namaz padhte the to aap aksar aasman ki taraf nazrein uthate the aur Allah Ta'ala ke hukm ke muntazir the yahan tak ke aayat jis par farman (Ma kanallahu) al-kh nazil hua aur un ki namazon ki taraf se itminan hua. Ab ba'az be-waqoof Ahl-e-Kitab ne qibla ke badle jaane par aitraz kiya, jis par yeh aayatein (Sayaqoolus sufaha'u) al-kh nazil huin". Shuru hijrat ke waqt Madina Shareef mein aap ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf namazein ada karne ka hukm hua tha. Yahood is se khush the lekin aap ki chahat aur dua qibla-e-Ibrahimi ki thi. Aakhir jab yeh hukm nazil hua to yahoodiyon ne jhat se aitraz jad diya. Jis ka jawab mila ke mashriq-o-maghrib Allah hi ke hain. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si riwayatein hain khulasa yeh hai ke Makka Shareef mein aap dono rukn ke darmiyan namaz padhte the to aap ke samne Ka'aba hota tha aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas ke sakhra ki taraf aap ka munh hota tha, lekin Madina ja kar yeh mamla mushkil ho gaya. Dono jama nahin ho sakte the to wahan aap ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf namaz ada karne ka hukm Quran mein nazil hua tha ya dusri wahi ke zariye yeh hukm mila tha. Ba'az buzurg to kehte hain yeh sirf Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ijtihadi amr tha aur Madina aane ke baad kayi mah tak isi taraf aap namazein padhte rahe go chahat aur thi. Yahan tak ke Parwardigar ne Bait-ul-Ateeq ki taraf munh pherne ko farmaya aur aap ne us taraf munh kar ke pehle namaz-e-Asr padhi aur phir logon ko apne khutba mein is amr se aagah kiya. Ba'az riwayaton mein yeh bhi aaya hai ke yeh Zohar ki namaz thi. Hazrat Abu Saeed bin Mu'alla farmate hain "Main ne aur mere saathi ne awwal awwal Ka'aba ki taraf namaz padhi hai aur Zohar ki namaz thi". Ba'az mufassireen waghera ka bayan hai ke "Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jab qibla badalne ki aayat nazil hui.

Is waqt aap Masjid-e-Bani Salma mein Zohar ki namaz parh rahe thay, do rakat ada kar chuke thay phir baqi ki do rakatein aap ne Baitullah Sharif ki taraf parhein, isi wajah se is masjid ka naam hi Masjid-e-Zul Qiblatain yani do qiblon wali masjid hai. Hazrat Nuwaila bint-e-Muslim farmati hain ke hum Zohar ki namaz mein thay jab hamein yeh khabar mili aur hum namaz mein hi ghoom gaye. Mard aurton ki jagah aa gaye aur auratein mardon ki jagah ja pahunchin. Haan Ahl-e-Quba ko dusre din subah ki namaz ke waqt yeh khabar pahunchi. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) se marwi hai ke log Masjid-e-Quba mein subah ki namaz ada kar rahe thay. Achanak kisi aane wale ne kaha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) par raat ko hukm-e-Qurani nazil hua aur Kaaba ki taraf mutawajja hone ka hukm ho gaya. Chunancha hum log bhi Shaam ki taraf se munh hata kar Kaaba ki taraf mutawajja ho gaye. Is hadith se yeh bhi maloom hua ke nasikh ke hukm ka luzoom usi waqt hota hai jab is ka ilm ho jaye, go woh pehle hi pahunch chuka ho. Is liye ke in hazrat ko Asr, Maghrib aur Isha ko lautane ka hukm nahin hua. Wallahu A'lam. Ab batil parast kamzor aqeede wale baatein banane lage ke is ki kya wajah hai, kabhi ise qibla kehta hai kabhi ise qibla qarar deta hai. Inhein jawab mila ke hukm aur tasarruf aur Amr Allah Ta'ala hi ka hai, jidhar munh karo usi taraf us ka munh hai. Bhalai isi mein nahin aa gayi balkay asliyat to imaan ki mazbooti hai jo har hukm ke manne par majboor kar deti hai aur is mein goya mominon ko adab sikhaya gaya hai ke un ka kaam sirf hukm ki baja-awari hai, jidhar unhein mutawajja hone ka hukm diya jaye yeh mutawajja ho jate hain. Itaat ke ma'ani is ke hukm ki tameel ke hain, agar woh ek din mein sau martaba har taraf ghumaye to hum bakhushi ghoom jayenge, hum us ke ghulam hain, hum us ke matahat hain, us ke farmanbardar hain aur us ke khadim hain, jidhar woh hukm de ga pher lenge. Ummat-e-Muhammadiya par yeh bhi Allah Ta'ala ka ikram hai ke unhein Khalil-ur-Rahman (A.S) ke qibla ki taraf munh karne ka hukm hua jo usi Allah La-Shareek ke naam par banaya gaya hai aur tamam tar fazilatein jise hasil hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek marfoo hadith hai ke yahudiyon ko hum se is baat par bohat hasad hai ke Allah ne hamein Jumma ke din ki taufiq di aur yeh is se bhatak gaye aur is par ke hamara qibla yeh hai aur woh is se gumrah ho gaye aur bara hasad un ko hamari Aameen kehne par bhi hai jo hum Imam ke peeche kehte hain.

Phir farmata hai ke is pasandida qibla ki taraf tumhein mutawajja karna is liye hai ke tum khud bhi pasandida ummat ho, tum aur ummaton par qayamat ke din gawah bane rahoge kyunke woh sab tumhari fazeelat maante hain. Wast ke ma'ani yahan par behtar aur umda ke hain jaise kaha jata hai ke Quraish nasab ke aitbar se wast-e-Arab hain aur kaha gaya hai huzoor ﷺ apni qaum mein wast thay yani ashraf-e-nasab wale aur salat-e-wusta yani afzal-tar namaz jo asr hai jaise sahih ahadees se sabit hai. Aur chunke tamam ummaton mein yeh ummat bhi behtar, afzal aur aala thi is liye inhe shariat bhi, kamil rasta bhi bilkul durust mila aur deen bhi bahut wazeh diya gaya jaise farmaya (Huwal-jtabakum wa ma ja'ala alaikum fid-deeni min haraj) (22. Al-Hajj: 78) "Is Allah ne tumhein chun liya aur tumhare deen mein koi tangi nahin ki, tumhare baap Ibrahim (A.S) ke deen par tum ho. Isi ne tumhara naam Muslim rakha hai is se pehle bhi aur is mein bhi taake Rasool tum par gawah ho aur tum logon par."

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: Nuh (A.S) ko qayamat ke din bulaya jayega aur un se daryaft kiya jayega ke kya tum ne mera paigham mere bandon ko pahuncha diya tha? Woh kahenge ke haan Allah pahuncha diya tha. Un ki ummat ko bulaya jayega aur un se pursish hogi kya Nuh (A.S) ne meri baatein tumhein pahunchayi thin? Woh saaf inkar karenge aur kahenge hamare paas koi darane wala nahin aaya. Nuh (A.S) se kaha jayega tumhari ummat inkar karti hai tum gawah pesh karo. Yeh kahenge ke haan Muhammad ﷺ aur aap ki ummat meri gawah hai. Yehi matlab is aayat (Wa kazalika ja'alnakum ummatan wasatal-litakunu shuhada'a alan-nasi wa yakunar-rasulu alaikum shahida) (2. Al-Baqarah: 143) ka hai. Wast ke ma'ani adl ke hain. Ab tumhein bulaya jayega aur tum gawahi doge aur main tum par gawahi dunga (Bukhari, Tirmidhi, Nasai, Ibn Majah).

Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek aur riwayat mein hai: Qayamat ke din Nabi aayenge aur un ke sath un ki ummat ke sirf do hi shakhs honge aur is se zyada bhi. Us ki ummat ko bulaya jayega aur un se pucha jayega ke kya is Nabi ne tumhein tabligh ki thi? Woh inkar karenge. Nabi se kaha jayega tum ne tabligh ki? Woh kahenge haan. Kaha jayega tumhara gawah kaun hai? Woh kahenge ke Muhammad ﷺ aur aap ki ummat. Pas Muhammad ﷺ aur aap ki ummat bulayi jayegi, un se yehi sawal hoga ke kya is paighambar ne tabligh ki? Yeh kahenge haan. Un se kaha jayega ke tumhein kaise ilm hua? Yeh jawab denge ke hamare paas hamare Nabi aaye aur aap ne khabar di ke Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ne tera paigham apni apni ummaton ko pahunchaya.

Yahi matlab hai Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke is farman (Wa-kazalika) al-kh ka. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek aur hadith mein wastan ba-mani adlan aaya hai. Ibn-e-Marduyah aur Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Main aur meri ummat qayamat ke din ek unche teele par honge, tamam makhlooq mein numaya honge aur sab ko dekh rahe honge. Us roz tamam duniya tamanna karegi ke kaash woh bhi hum mein se hote. Jis jis Nabi ki qoum ne use jhutlaya hai, hum darbar-e-Rabbul-Aalameen mein shahadat denge ke un tamam ambiya ne haq-e-risalat ada kiya tha.

Mustadrak-e-Hakim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Bani Salma ke qabeelay ke ek shakhs ke janazay mein hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath thay. Log kehne lage, "Huzoor! Yeh bada nek aadmi tha, bada muttaqi, parsa aur saccha musalman tha," aur bhi bahut si tareefain keen. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Tum yeh kis tarah keh rahe ho?" Us shakhs ne kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Posheedgi ka ilm to Allah hi ko hai lekin zahardari to is ki aisi hi halat thi." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Is ke liye jannat wajib ho gayi." Phir Banu Haritha ke ek shakhs ke janazay mein thay, log kehne lage, "Hazrat! Yeh bura aadmi tha, bada bad-zaban aur kaj-khulq tha." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ki buraiyan sun kar poocha, "Tum kaise keh rahe ho?" Us shakhs ne bhi yahi kaha. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Is ke liye (jahannam) wajib ho gayi." Muhammad bin Ka'ab is hadith ko sun kar farmanay lage, "Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sacchay hain, dekho Quran bhi keh raha hai (Wa-kazalika) al-kh."

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Abu-al-Aswad farmatay hain: Main Madina mein aaya, yahan bimari thi, log bakasrat mar rahe thay. Main Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ke paas baitha hua tha ke ek janaza nikla aur logon ne marhoom ki nekiyan bayan karni shuru keen. Aap (R.A) ne farmaya: "Is ke liye wajib ho gayi." Itnay mein dusra janaza nikla, logon ne is ki buraiyan bayan keen. Aap (R.A) ne farmaya: "Is ke liye wajib ho gayi." Maine kaha, "Ameer-ul-Momineen! Kya wajib ho gayi?" Aap (R.A) ne farmaya: "Maine wahi kaha jo Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai ke jis musalman ki bhalai ki shahadat chaar shakhs dein, use Allah jannat mein dakhil karta hai." Hum ne kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Agar teen dein?" Aap (R.A) ne farmaya: "Teen bhi." Hum ne kaha, "Agar do hon?" Aap (R.A) ne farmaya: "Do bhi." Phir hum ne ek ki babat sawal na kiya. Ibn-e-Marduyah ki ek hadith mein hai, "Qareeb hai ke tum apne bhalon aur buron ko pehchan liya karo." Logon ne kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Kis tarah?" Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Acchi tareef aur buri shahadat se. Tum zameen par Allah ke gawah ho."

Phir farmata hai ke agla qibla sirf imtihan-an tha, yani pehle Bait-ul-Muqaddas ko qibla muqarrar kar ke phir Ka'abatullah ki taraf pherna sirf is liye tha ke maloom ho jaye ke saccha tabe-dar kaun hai? Aur jahan aap tawajjuh karein wahin apni tawajjuh karne wala kaun hai? Aur kaun hai jo ek dam karwat le leta hai aur murtad ho jata hai. Yeh kaam fil-haqeeqat ahem kaam tha, lekin jin ke dilon mein iman-o-yaqeen hai, jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sacchay pairaukar hain, jo jantay hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo farmayein sacch hai, jin ka aqeeda hai ke Allah jo chahta hai karta hai, jo irada karta hai hukum karta hai.

Apne bandon ko jis tarah chahe hukum de, jo chahe mitaye, jo chahe baqi rakhe, uska har kaam, har hukum hikmat se pur hai, un par is hukum ki baja-awari kuch bhi mushkil nahin. Haan, bimar dil wale to jahan naya hukum aaya unhein foran naya dard utha. Quran-e-Karim mein aur jagah hai (Wa iza ma unzilat suratun nazara ba'zuhum ila ba'zin hal yarakum min ahadin summasarafu sarafallahu qulubahum bi-annahum qawmun la yafqahun) (Surah At-Tawbah: 127) yani jab kabhi koi surat nazil hoti hai to un mein se ba'z puchte hain is se kis ka iman badha? Haqiqat yeh hai ke imandaron ke iman badhte hain aur un ki dili khushi bhi, aur bimar dil wale apni palidi mein aur badh jate hain. Aur jagah farman hai (Qul huwa lillazina amanu hudan wa shifa'un wallazina la yu'minuna fi azanihim waqrun wa huwa alaihim ama) (Surah Fussilat: 44) yani iman walon ke liye yeh hidayat aur shifa hai aur be-iman logon ke kanon mein bojh aur ankhon par andhapa hai. Aur jagah farman hai (Wa nunazzilu minal qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatun lilmu'minina wa la yaziduz-zalimina illa khasara) (Surah Al-Isra: 82) yani hamara utara hua Quran mominon ke liye sarasar shifa aur rahmat hai aur zalimon ka nuqsan hi badhta rehta hai. Is waqia mein bhi tamam buzurg sahaba sabit qadam rahe, awwal sabqat karne wale muhajir aur ansar dono qabilon ki taraf namaz padhne wale hain. Chunancha upar hadith bayan ho chuki ke kis tarah woh namaz padhte hue yeh khabar sun kar ghoom gaye. Muslim Sharif mein riwayat hai ke ruku ki halat mein the aur isi mein Ka'ba ki taraf phir gaye jis se un ki kamal-e-ita'at aur a'la darja ki farman-bardari sabit hui. Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah tumhare iman ko zaya nahin karega. Yani tumhari Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf padhi hui namazein rad nahin hongi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain balkeh un ki a'la imandari sabit hui, unhein dono qiblon ki taraf namaz padhne ka sawab ata hoga. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke Allah Ta'ala Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aur un ke sath tumhare ghoom jane ko zaya na karega. Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah Ra'uf-ur-Rahim hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek jangi qaidi aurat ko dekha jis se uska bacha chhoot gaya tha, woh apne bacha ko paglon ki tarah talash kar rahi thi aur jab woh nahin mila to qaidiyon mein se jis kisi bacha ko dekhti isi ko gale laga leti, yahan tak ke uska apna bacha mil gaya, khushi khushi lapak kar use god mein utha liya, seene se lagaya, pyar kiya aur us ke munh mein doodh diya. Yeh dekh kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sahaba se farmaya batao to yeh apna bas chalte hue is bacha ko aag mein daal degi? Logon ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hargiz nahin. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah ki qasam jis qadar yeh maa apne bacha pe meharban hai us se kahin zyada Allah Ta'ala apne bandon par Ra'uf-ur-Rahim hai.

Khushu-o-khuzu zaroori hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka bayan hai ke Quran mein Qibla ka hukum pehla naskh hai. Huzoor ﷺ ne Madina ki taraf hijrat ki, yahan ke aksar bashinday Yahood thay. Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ﷺ ko Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf namazein parhne ka hukum diya, Yahood is se bohat khush hue. Aap ﷺ kayi maah tak isi rukh namaz parhte rahe lekin khud Aap ﷺ ki chahat Qibla-e-Ibrahimi ki thi. Aap ﷺ Allah se duayein manga karte thay aur nigahain aasman ki taraf uthaya karte thay. Bil-akhir aayat (Qad nara...) al-kh nazil hui. Is par Yahood kehne lage ke is Qibla se yeh kyun hat gaye? Jis ke jawab mein kaha gaya ke mashriq aur maghrib ka maalik Allah Ta'ala hi hai aur farmaya jidhar tumhara munh ho udhar hi Allah ka munh hai aur farmaya ke agla Qibla imtihan-an tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ namaz ke baad apna sar aasman ki taraf uthate thay, is par yeh aayat utri aur hukum hua ke Masjid-e-Haram ki taraf, Kaaba ki taraf, Meezab ki taraf munh karo. Jibraeel A.S ne imamat karayi. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A ne Masjid-e-Haram mein Meezab ke samne baithe hue is aayat-e-pak ki tilawat ki aur farmaya Meezab-e-Kaaba ki taraf rukh karne ka hukum hai. Imam Shafi R.H ka bhi ek qaul yeh hai ke ain Kaaba ki taraf tawajjo maqsood hai aur dusra qaul Aap R.H ka yeh hai ke Kaaba ki jihat hona kaafi hai aur yahi mazhab aksar aimma-e-kiram ka hai. Hazrat Ali R.A farmate hain murad is ki taraf hai. Abu Al-Aliya, Mujahid, Ikrama, Saeed bin Jubair, Qatada, Rabee bin Anas waghera ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Ek hadith mein bhi hai ke mashriq-o-maghrib ke darmiyan Qibla hai. Ibn-e-Jurayj mein hadith hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Baitullah Masjid-e-Haram walon ka Qibla aur Masjid-e-Haram, Ahl-e-Haram ka Qibla aur tamam zameen walon ka Haram Qibla hai, khwah mashriq mein hon khwah maghrib mein, meri tamam ummat ka Qibla yahi hai.

Abu Nu'aim mein barwayat-e-Bara mervi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne solah satrah mahine tak toh Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf namaz padhi lekin aap ko pasand amr yeh tha ke Bait-ullah ki taraf padhein, chunancha Allah ke hukm se aap ne Bait-ullah ki taraf mutawajjeh ho kar Asr ki namaz ada ki. Phir namaziyon mein se ek shakhs masjid walon ke paas gaya, woh ruku mein thay, us ne kaha main halfiya gawahi deta hoon ke main ne Rasool-ullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath Makkah Sharif ki taraf namaz ada ki, yeh sun kar woh jis halat mein thay usi halat mein Bait-ullah Sharif ki taraf phir gaye. Abdur Razzaq mein bhi yeh riwayat qadray kami beshi ke sath mervi hai. Nasai mein Hazrat Abu Saeed bin Mu'alla se mervi hai ke hum subah ke waqt Masjid-e-Nabvi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein jaya karte thay aur wahan kuch nawafil padha karte thay. Ek din hum gaye toh dekha ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mimbar par baithe hue hain, main ne kaha aaj koi nayi baat zaroor hui hai, main bhi baith gaya toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat (Qad nara) tilawat farmayi. Main ne apne saathi se kaha aao Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farigh hon, mimbar se utarne se pehle hi hum is naye hukm ki tameel karein aur awwal farmanbardar ban jayen, chunancha hum ek taraf ho gaye aur sab se pehle Bait-ullah Sharif ki taraf namaz padhi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi mimbar se utar aaye aur is qibla ki taraf pehli namaz Zohar ada ki gayi. Ibn Marduyah mein barwayat-e-Ibn-e-Umar mervi hai ke pehli namaz jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ka'aba ki taraf ada ki woh Zohar ki namaz hai aur yahi namaz Salat-ul-Wusta hai, lekin mashhoor yeh hai ke pehli namaz Ka'aba ki taraf Asr ki ada ki hui, isi wajah se Ahl-e-Quba ko dusre din subah ke waqt ittila pahunchi. Ibn Marduyah mein riwayat-e-Nuwaila bint-e-Muslim majood hai ke hum Masjid-e-Banu Haritha mein Zohar ya Asr ki namaz Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf munh kiye hue ada kar rahe thay, do rakat padh chuke thay ke kisi ne aa kar qibla ke badal jaane ki khabar di. Chunancha hum namaz mein Bait-ullah ki taraf mutawajjeh ho gaye aur baqi namaz usi taraf ada ki, is ghoomne mein mard aurton ki jagah aur aurtein mardon ki jagah aa gayin, aap ke paas jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh khush ho kar farmaya yeh hain imaan bil-ghaib rakhne wale. Ibn Marduyah mein barwayat-e-Ammara bin Aus mervi hai ke ruku ki halat mein hamein ittila hui aur hum sab mard, aurtein, bachay usi halat mein qibla ki taraf ghoom gaye. Phir irshad hota hai tum jahan bhi ho mashriq, maghrib, shumal ya junoob mein har surat namaz ke waqt munh Ka'aba ki taraf kar liya karo. Haan albatta safar mein sawari par nafl padhne wala jidhar sawari ja rahi ho udhar hi nafl ada kar le, us ke dil ki tawajjeh Ka'aba ki taraf honi kaafi hai. Isi tarah maidan-e-jang mein namaz padhne wala jis tarah aur jis taraf ban pade namaz ada kar le aur isi tarah woh shakhs jise qibla ki jihat ka qat'i ilm nahin woh andazay se jis taraf zyada dil maane namaz ada kar le. Phir go us ki namaz fil-waq'i qibla ki taraf na bhi hui ho toh bhi woh Allah ke haan maaf hai.

Mas'ala: Malikiyah ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai ke namazi halat-e-namaz mein apne samne apni nazrein rakhe na ke sajde ki jagah jaise ke Shafi'i, Ahmad aur Abu Hanifa R.H ka mazhab hai. Is liye ke aayat ke alfaaz yeh hain ke munh Masjid-e-Haram ki taraf karo aur agar sajde ki jagah nazar jamana chahega to qadre jhukna padega aur yeh takleef kamal-e-khushoo ke khilaf hoga. Ba'az Malikiyah ka yeh qaul bhi hai ke qayam ki halat mein apne seena ki taraf nazar rakhe. Qazi Shareek R.H kehte hain ke qayam ke waqt sajde ki jagah nazar rakhe jaise ke jamhoor-e-jamaat ka qaul hai is liye ke yeh poora poora khushoo-o-khuzoo hai aur ek hadith bhi is mazmoon ki warid hui hai. Aur ruku ki halat mein apne qadmon ki jagah par nazar rakhe aur sajde ke waqt naak ki jagah aur at-tahiyat ke waqt apni god ki taraf. Phir irshad hota hai ke yeh Yahudi jo chahein baatein banayein lekin un ke dilon mein jante hain ke qibla ki tabdeeli Allah Ta'ala ki janib se hai aur bar-haq hai kyunke yeh khud un ki kitabon mein bhi maujood hai lekin yeh log kufr-o-inaad aur takabbur-o-hasad ki wajah se ise chupate hain. Allah Ta'ala bhi un ki in kartooton se be-khabar nahin.

Kufr-o-inaad zada Yahudi: Yahudiyon ke kufr-o-inaad aur mukhalifat-o-sarkashi ka bayan ho raha hai ke bawajood-e-ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shaan ka unhein ilm hai lekin phir bhi yeh halat hai ke har qisam ki daleelein pesh ho chukne ke baad bhi haq ki pairwi nahin karte. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Innal-lazina haqqat alaihim kalimat-u-rabbika la yu'minuna wa lau ja'at-hum kullu aayatin hatta yarawul-azabal-aleem) (10:96-97) yani jin logon par tere Rab ki baat saabit ho chuki hai woh imaan na layenge chahe un ke paas yeh tamam aayatein aa jayen yahan tak ke dard-naak azaab na dekh lein. Phir apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki istaqamat bayan farmata hai ke jis tarah woh na-haq par date hue hain aur wahan se hatna nahin chahte to woh bhi samajh lein ke hamare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aise nahin ke un ki baton mein aa jayen aur un ki raah chal padein. Woh hamare taabi-e-farman hain aur hamari marzi ke aamil hain, woh un ki baatil khwahish ki tabedari hargiz nahin karenge, na un se yeh ho sakta hai ke hamara hukm aa jane ke baad un ke qibla ki taraf tawajjah karein. Phir apne Nabi ko khitaab kar ke dar-asal ulama ko dhamkaya gaya ke haq ke wazeh ho jane ke baad kisi ke peeche lag jana aur apni ya dusron ki khwahish parasti karna yeh sareeh zulm hai.

Sifat-e-Nabawi aur aghmaz baratne wale Yahudi ulama. Irshad hota hai ke ulama-e-Ahl-e-Kitab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki layi hui baton ki haqaniyat ko is tarah jante hain jis tarah baap apne beton ko pehchane. Yeh ek misaal thi jo mukammal yaqeen ke waqt Arab diya karte the. Ek hadith mein hai ek shakhs ke sath chota bacha tha, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us se pucha yeh tera ladka hai? Us ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap bhi gawah rahiye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya na yeh tujh par poshida rahe na tu is par. Qurtubi kehte hain ek martaba Hazrat Umar Farooq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam se jo Yahudiyon ke zabardast allama the pucha, kya tu Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aisa hi janta hai jis tarah apni aulad ko pehchanta hai? Jawab diya haan, balkeh is se bhi zyada, is liye ke aasmanon ka ameen farishta zameen ke ameen shakhs par nazil hua aur us ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sahih tareef bata di, yani Hazrat Jibraeel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ke paas aaye aur phir Parwardigar-e-Alam ne un ki sifatein bayan keen jo sab ki sab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein maujood hain, phir hamein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Nabi-e-Barhaq hone mein kya shak raha? Hum Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ba-ek nigah kyun na pehchan lein? Balkeh hamein apni aulad ke bare mein shak hai aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwat mein kuch shak nahin. Garz yeh hai ke jis tarah logon ke ek bade majmay mein ek shakhs apne ladke ko pehchan leta hai, isi tarah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ausaf jo Ahl-e-Kitab ki aasmani kitabon mein hain, woh tamam sifat Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein is tarah numaya hain ke ba-ek nigah har shakhs Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jaan jata hai.

Phir farmaya ke bawajood is ilm-e-haq ke phir bhi yeh log ise chupate hain, phir apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur musalmanon ko sabit qadmi ka hukum diya ke khabardar tum hargiz haq mein shak na karna.

Sacha Qibla: Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke har mazhab walon ka ek qibla hai lekin sacha qibla woh hai jis par Musalman hain. Abu Al-Aliyah ka qaul hai ke Yahood ka bhi qibla hai, Nasraniyon ka bhi qibla hai aur tumhara bhi qibla hai lekin hidayat wala qibla wahi hai jis par ae Musalmano tum ho. Mujahid se yeh bhi marwi hai ke har ek woh qaum jo Kaaba ko qibla manti hai woh bhulaiyon mein sabqat kare. Aayat (Muwalliha) ki dusri qiraat (Muwallaha) hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Li-kullin ja'alna minkum shir'atan wa minhaja) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 48) yani har shakhs ko apne apne qibla ki padi hui hai, har shakhs apni apni raah laga hua hai. Phir farmaya ke go tumhare jism aur badan mukhtalif ho jayen, go tum idhar udhar bikhar jao lekin Allah Ta'ala tumhein apni qudrat-e-kamilah se isi zameen se jama kar lega.

Teen baar nuzool-e-hukm yeh teesri martaba hukm ho raha hai ke roo-e-zameen ke musalmanon ko namaz ke waqt Masjid-e-Haram ki taraf munh karna chahiye. Teen martaba takeed is liye ki gayi ke yeh tabdeeli ka hukm pehli baar waqay hua tha. Fakhruddin Razi (R.H) ne is ki yeh wajah bayan ki hai ke pehla hukm toh un ke liye hai jo Kaaba ko dekh rahe hain. Doosra hukm un ke liye hai jo Makkah mein hain lekin Kaaba un ke samne nahin. Teesri baar unhein hukm diya jo Makkah ke bahar roo-e-zameen par hain. Qurtubi (R.H) ne ek taujeeh yeh bhi bayan ki hai ke pehla hukm Makkah walon ko hai, doosra aur shehar walon ko, teesra musafiron ko. Baaz kehte hain teenon hukmon ka talluq agli pichli ibarat se hai.

Pehle hukm mein toh Huzoor ﷺ ki talab ka aur phir uski qabooliyat ka zikr hai aur dusre hukm mein is baat ka bayan hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ki yeh chahat bhi hamari chahat ke mutabiq thi aur haq amr yahi tha aur teesre hukm mein Yahudiyon ki hujjat ka jawab hai ke unki kitabon mein pehle se maujood tha ke Aap ka qibla Ka'aba hoga toh is hukm se woh peshingoi bhi poori hui. Saath hi mushrikeen ki hujjat bhi khatam hui ke woh Ka'aba ko mutabarrak aur musharraf maante the aur ab Huzoor ﷺ ki tawajjo bhi isi ki taraf hogayi. Razi waghera ne is hukm ko baar baar laane ki hikmaton ko bakhoobi tafseel se bayan kiya hai, Wallahu A'alam. Phir farmaya taake Ahl-e-Kitab koi hujjat tum par baqi na rahe, woh jaante the ke ummat ki tarah pehchan Ka'aba ki taraf rukh kar ke namaz padhta hai, jab woh yeh sifat na payenge toh unhein shak ki gunjaish ho sakti hai lekin jab unhon ne Aap ﷺ ko is qibla ki taraf phirte hue dekh liya toh ab unhein kisi tarah ka shak na rehna chahiye aur yeh baat bhi hai ke jab woh tumhein apne qibla ki taraf namazein padhte hue dekhenge toh unke haath ek bahana lag jayega lekin jab tum Ibrahimi qibla ki taraf mutawajjo ho jaoge toh woh khaali haath reh jayenge. Hazrat Abu Al-Aliyah farmate hain Yahud ki yeh hujjat thi ke aaj yeh hamare qibla ki taraf hain yani hamare qibla ki taraf rukh karte hain kal hamara mazhab bhi maan lenge lekin jab apne Allah ke hukm se asli qibla ikhtiyar kar liya toh unki is hawas par paani pad gaya. Phir farmaya magar jo un mein se zalim aur ziddi mushrikeen bator-e-aitraz kehte the ke yeh shakhs Millat-e-Ibrahimi par hone ka da'wa karta hai aur phir Ibrahimi qibla ki taraf namaz nahin padhta, unhein jawab bhi mil gaya ke yeh Nabi ﷺ hamare ahkaam ka muttaba' hai, pehle hum ne apni kamaal hikmat se unhein Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf munh karne ka hukm diya jise woh baja laye, phir Ibrahimi qibla ki taraf phir jaane ko kaha jise jaan-o-dil se baja laye, pas Aap har haal mein hamare ahkaam ke ma-taht hain (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa 'Ala Aalihi Wa As-haabihi Wasallam). Phir farmaya in zalimon ke shuba daalne se tum shak mein na pado, in baghiyon ki sarkashi se tum khauf na karo, unke be-jaan aitrazon ki mutlaq parwah na kar, wahan meri zaat se khauf kiya karo, sirf mujh hi se darte raha karo. Qibla badalne mein jahan yeh maslahat thi ke logon ki zabaanein band ho jayein wahan yeh bhi baat thi ke main chahta tha ke apni ne'mat tum par poori kar doon aur qibla ki tarah tumhari tamam shari'at kaamil kar doon aur tumhare deen ko har tarah mukammal kar doon aur is mein yeh ek raaz bhi tha ke jis qibla se agli ummatein behak gayin tum us se na hato, hum ne is qibla ko khusoosiyat ke saath tumhein ata farma kar tumhara sharaf aur tumhari fazeelat-o-buzurgi tamam ummaton par saabit kar di.

Allah ki yaad shukr hai aur bhool kufr hai! Yahan Allah Ta'ala apni bahut badi nemat ka zikr farma raha hai ke usne hum mein hamari jins ka ek Nabi mab'oos farmaya, jo Allah Ta'ala ki roshan aur noorani kutub ki aayatein hamare samne tilawat farmata hai aur razeel aadaton aur nafs ki shararaton aur jahiliyat ke kamon se humein rokta hai aur zulmat-e-kufr se nikal kar noor-e-iman ki taraf rahbari karta hai aur Kitab-o-Hikmat yani Quran-o-Hadith humein sikhata hai aur woh raaz hum par kholta hai jo aaj tak hum par nahin khule thay. Pas aap ki wajah se woh log jin par sadiyon se jahl chhaya hua tha jinhein sadiyon se tareeki ne gher rakha tha jin par muddaton se bhalai ka partau bhi nahin pada tha duniya ki zabardast allama hastiyon ke ustad ban gaye, woh ilm mein gehre takalluf mein thode dilon ke paak aur zaban ke sache ban gaye, duniya ki halat ka yeh inqilab bajaye khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ki tasdeeq ka ek shahid-o-adl hai aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Laqad mannal-lahu 'alal-mu'mineena iz ba'atha feehim rasoolam min anfusihim yatloo 'alaihim aayatihee wa yuzakkeehim wa yu'allimuhumul-kitaba wal-hikmata wa in kanoo min qablu lafee dalalim mubeen) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 164) yani aise ulu-al-azm paighambar ki ba'asat mominon par Allah ka ek zabardast ehsan hai. Is nemat ki qadr na karne walon ko Quran kehta hai aayat (Alam tara ilallazeena baddaloo ni'matallahi kufran wa ahalloo qawmahum daral-bawar) (Surah Ibrahim: 28) kya tu unhein nahin dekhta jinhon ne Allah ki is nemat ke badle kufr kiya aur apni qaum ko halakat ke gadhe mein dala. Yahan Allah ki nemat se murad Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain isi liye is aayat mein bhi apni nemat ka zikr farma kar logon ko apni yaad aur apne shukr ka hukum diya ke jis tarah main ne ehsan tum par kiya tum bhi mere zikr aur mere shukr se ghaflat na karo.

Musa A.S Allah Rabbul Izzat se arz karte hain ke aye Allah tera shukr kis tarah karoon? Irshad hota hai mujhe yaad rakho bhoolo nahin, yaad shukr hai aur bhool kufr hai. Hasan Basri R.H wagairah ka qaul hai ke Allah ki yaad karne wale ko Allah bhi yaad karta hai, us ka shukr karne wale ko woh zyada deta hai aur nashukre ko azab karta hai. Buzurgan-e-Salaf se marvi hai ke Allah se poora darna yeh hai ke us ki ita'at ki jaye nafarmani na ki jaye, us ka zikr kiya jaye ghaflat na barti jaye, us ka shukr kiya jaye nashukri na ki jaye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A se sawal hota hai ke kya zani, sharabi, chor aur qatil-e-nafs ko bhi yaad karta hai? Farmaya haan burai se. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain mujhe yaad karo yani mere zaroori ahkaam baja lao, main tumhein yaad karoon ga yani apni ne'matein ata farmaoon ga. Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain main tumhein bakhash doon ga aur apni rahmatein tum par nazil karoon ga. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke Allah ka yaad karna bahut badi cheez hai. Ek Qudsi Hadith mein hai jo tujhe apne dil mein yaad karta hai main use apne dil mein yaad karta hoon aur jo mujhe kisi jamaat mein yaad karta hai main bhi use us se behtar jamaat mein yaad karta hoon. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke woh jamaat farishton ki hai. Jo shakhs meri taraf ek balisht badhta hai main us ki taraf ek haath badhata hoon aur agar tu aye Bani Adam meri taraf ek haath badhayega main teri taraf do haath badhaoon ga aur agar tu meri taraf chalta hua aayega to main teri taraf daudta hua aaoon ga. Sahih Bukhari mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Hazrat Qatada R.H farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat us se bhi zyada qareeb hai. Phir farmaya mera shukr karo nashukri na karo aur jagah hai aayat (La'in shakartum la-azidannakum wala'in kafartum inna azabi lashadid) (14. Ibrahim: 7) yani tere Rab ki taraf se aam aagahi hai ke agar tum shukr karoge to main tumhein barkat doon ga aur agar nashukri karoge to yaad rakhna mera azab sakht hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Umar bin Hussain R.A ek martaba nihayat qeemti hulla pehne hue aaye aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala jab kisi par inaam karta hai to us ka asar us par dekhna chahta hai.

Phir farmaya ke shaheedon ko murda na kaho balkay woh aisi zindagi mein hain jisay tum nahin samajh sakte. Unhein hayat-e-barzakhi hasil hai aur wahan woh khurd-o-nosh pa rahe hain. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke shaheedon ki roohein sabz rang ke parindon ke qalib mein hain aur jannat mein jis jagah chahein charti chugti udti phirti hain, phir un qandeelon mein aa kar baith jati hain jo Arsh ke neechay latak rahi hain. Un ke Rab ne ek martaba unhein dekha aur un se daryaft kiya ke ab tum kya chahte ho? Unhon ne jawab diya, Allah! Hamein toh Tu ne woh woh de rakha hai jo kisi ko nahin diya, phir hamein kis cheez ki zaroorat hogi? Un se phir yahi sawal hua, jab unhon ne dekha ke ab hamein koi jawab dena hi hoga toh kaha, Allah! Hum chahte hain ke Tu hamein dobara duniya mein bhej, hum Teri raah mein phir jang karein, phir shaheed ho kar Tere paas aayein aur shahadat ka dugna darja payein. Rab Jalla Jalaluhu ne farmaya, yeh nahin ho sakta, yeh toh main likh chuka hoon ke koi bhi marne ke baad duniya ki taraf palat kar nahin jayega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek aur hadees mein hai ke momin ki rooh ek parinday mein hai jo jannati darakhton par rehti hai aur Qayamat ke din woh apne jism ki taraf laut aayegi. Is se maloom hota hai ke har momin ki rooh wahan zinda hai lekin shaheedon ki rooh ko ek tarah ki imtiyazi sharafat, karamat, izzat aur azmat hasil hai.

Wafa-e-ahd ke liye aazmaish lazim hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke woh apne bandon ki aazmaish zaroor kar liya karta hai, kabhi taraqqi aur bhalai ke zariye aur kabhi tanazzul aur burai se, jaise farmata hai aayat (Wa lanabluwannakum hatta na'lamal-mujahideena minkum was-sabireena wa nablua akhbarakum) (Surah Muhammad: 31), yani hum aazma kar mujahidon aur sabr karne walon ko maloom kar lenge. Aur jagah hai aayat (Fa-azaqahallahu libasal-joo'i wal-khawfi bima kanoo yasna'oon) (Surah An-Nahl: 112). Matlab yeh hai ke thoda sa khauf, kuch bhook, kuch maal ki kami, kuch jaanon ki kami yani apnon aur ghair khwesh-o-aqarib, dost-o-ahbab ki maut, kabhi phalon aur paidawar ki nuqsan waghera se Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko aazma leta hai. Sabr karne walon ko nek ajar aur achha badla inayat farmata hai aur be-sabr, jald-baaz aur na-umeedi karne walon par uske azaab utar aate hain. Ba'az salaf se manqool hai ke yahan khauf se murad Allah Ta'ala ka darr hai, bhook se murad rozon ki bhook hai, maal ki kami se murad Zakat ki adaigi hai, jaan ki kami se murad bimariyan hain, phalon se murad aulad hai, lekin yeh tafseer zara gaur talab hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Ab bayan ho raha hai ke jin sabr karne walon ki Allah ke haan izzat hai woh kaun log hain? Pas farmata hai yeh woh log hain jo tangi aur museebat ke waqt aayat (Inna lillahi) parh liya karte hain aur is baat se apne dil ko tasalli de liya karte hain ke hum Allah ki malkiyat hain aur jo hamein pahuncha hai woh Allah ki taraf se hai aur in mein jis tarah woh chahe tasarruf karta rehta hai aur phir Allah ke haan is ka badla hai jahan unhein bil-aakhir jaana hai, un ke is qaul ki wajah se Allah ki nawazishein aur altaaf un par nazil hote hain, azaab se najaat milti hai aur hidayat bhi naseeb hoti hai.

Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) farmate hain do barabar ki cheezein salawat aur rahmat aur ek darmiyan ki cheez yani hidayat un sabr karne walon ko milti hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Umme Salama (R.A) farmati hain mere khawand Hazrat Abu Salama (R.A) ek roz mere paas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein ho kar aaye aur khushi khushi farmane lage aaj toh main ne ek aisi hadith suni hai ke main bahut hi khush hua hoon woh hadith yeh hai ke jis kisi musalman ko koi takleef pahunche aur woh kahe dua (Allahumma ajurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khairan minha) yani Allah mujhe is musibat mein ajar de aur mujhe is se behtar badla ata farma toh Allah Ta'ala use ajar aur badla zaroor deta hai, Hazrat Umme Salama (R.A) farmati hain main ne is dua ko yaad kar liya jab Hazrat Abu Salama (R.A) ka inteqal hua toh main ne ayat (Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un) parh kar phir yeh dua bhi parh li lekin mujhe khayal aaya ke bhala Abu Salama se behtar shakhs mujhe kaun mil sakta hai? Jab meri iddat guzar chuki toh main ek roz ek khaal ko dabaghat de rahi thi ke Aan-Huzoor (ﷺ) tashreef laye aur andar aane ki ijazat chahi main ne apne hath dho dale khaal rakh di aur Huzoor (ﷺ) se andar tashreef lane ki darkhwast ki aur aap ko ek gaddi par bitha diya aap ne mujh se apna nikah karne ki koshish zahir ki, main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh toh meri khush-qismati ki baat hai lekin awwal toh main bari baghairat aurat hoon aisa na ho ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki tabiyat ke khilaf koi baat mujh se sarzad ho jaye aur Allah ke haan azab ho dusre yeh ke main umr-rasida hoon, teesre baal bachon wali hoon aap ne farmaya suno aisi beja ghairat Allah Ta'ala tumhari door kar dega aur umr mein kuch main bhi choti umr ka nahin aur tumhare baal bache mere hi baal bache hain main ne yeh sun kar kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) mujhe koi uzr nahin chunancha mera nikah Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) se ho gaya aur mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne is dua ki barkat se mere miyan se bahut hi behtar yani apna Rasool (ﷺ) ata farmaya falhamdulillah sahih Muslim Shareef mein bhi yeh hadith bakhtilaf-e-alfaz marwi hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya jis kisi musalman ko koi ranj-o-musibat pahunche us par goya zyada waqt guzar jaye phir use yaad aaye aur woh Inna lillahi parhe toh musibat ke sabr ke waqt jo ajar mila tha wohi ab bhi milega, Ibn-e-Majah mein hai Hazrat Abu Sinan (R.H) farmate hain main ne apne ek bache ko dafan kiya abhi main us ki qabr mein se nikla na tha ke Abu Talha Khaulani (R.H) ne mera hath pakar kar mujhe nikala aur kaha suno main tumhein ek khushkhabri sunaoon Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya hai ke Allah Ta'ala Malak-ul-Maut se daryaft farmata hai tu ne mere bande ki aankhon ki thandak aur us ka kaleje ka tukra cheen liya bata toh us ne kya kaha? Woh kehte hain Allah teri tareef ki aur Inna lillahi parha Allah Ta'ala farmata hai us ke liye jannat mein ek ghar banao aur us ka naam Bait-ul-Hamd rakho.

Safa aur Marwah ka tawaf: Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se Hazrat Urwah daryaft karte hain ke is ayat se toh aisa maloom hota hai ke tawaf na karne mein bhi koi haraj nahin. Aap ne farmaya bhatije tum sahi nahin samjhe, agar yeh bayan mad-e-nazar hota toh "an la yatuffa bihima" hota. Suno ayat-e-sharifa ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke Mushallal (ek jagah ka naam hai) ke paas Manat but tha, Islam se pehle Ansar ise poojte the aur jo is ke naam labbaik pukar leta woh Safa Marwah ke tawaf karne mein haraj samajhta tha. Ab baad az Islam un logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Safa Marwah ke tawaf ke haraj ke bare mein sawal kiya toh yeh ayat utri ke is mein koi haraj nahin, lekin isi ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Safa Marwah ka tawaf kiya is liye masnoon ho gaya aur kisi ko is ke tark karne ka jawaz na raha (Bukhari, Muslim). Abu Bakr bin Abdur Rahman ne jab yeh riwayat suni toh woh kehne lage ke beshak yeh ilmi baat hai, main ne toh is se pehle suni hi na thi. Baaz ahl-e-ilm farmaya karte the ke Ansar ne kaha tha ke hamein Baitullah ke tawaf ka hukm hai, Safa Marwah ke tawaf ko jahiliyat ka kaam jante the aur Islam ki halat mein is se bachte the yahan tak ke yeh ayat nazil hui. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke in dono pahariyon ke darmiyan bahut se but the aur shayateen raat bhar is ke darmiyan ghoomte rehte the. Islam ke baad logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yahan ke tawaf ki babat masla daryaft kiya jis par yeh ayat utri. "Isaf" but Safa par tha aur "Naila" Marwah par, mushrik log inhe chhoote aur choomte the. Islam ke baad log is se alag ho gaye lekin yeh ayat utri jis se yahan ka tawaf sabit hua. Seerat-e-Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke "Isaf" aur "Naila" do mard-o-aurat the, in badkaron ne Kaaba mein zina kiya, Allah Ta'ala ne inhe patthar bana diya, Quraish ne inhe Kaaba ke bahar rakh diya taake logon ko ibrat ho, lekin kuch zamana ke baad in ki ibadat shuru ho gayi aur Safa Marwah par la kar nasb kar diye gaye aur in ka tawaf shuru ho gaya. Sahih Muslim ki ek lambi hadith mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf kar chuke toh rukn ko chhoo kar Bab-us-Safa se nikle aur ayat tilawat farma rahe the, phir farmaya main bhi shuru karunga us se jis se Allah Ta'ala ne shuru kiya. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya tum shuru karo us se jis se Allah ne shuru kiya, yani Safa se chal kar Marwah jao. Hazrat Habiba bint Tijza (R.A) farmati hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dekha, Aap Safa Marwah ka tawaf karte the, log Aap ke aage aage the aur Aap un ke peeche the, Aap qadre daur laga rahe the aur is ki wajah se Aap ka tahband Aap ke takhnon ke darmiyan idhar udhar ho raha tha aur zaban se farmate jate the, logon daur kar chalo, Allah Ta'ala ne tum par sa'i likh di hai (Musnad Ahmad). Isi ki ham-mani ek riwayat aur bhi hai.

Yeh hadith daleel hai un logon ki jo Safa-o-Marwa ki sa'i ko Hajj ka rukn jaante hain jaise Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H) aur un ke muwafiqeen ka mazhab hai, Imam Ahmad (R.H) se bhi ek riwayat isi tarah ki hai, Imam Malik (R.H) ka mashhoor mazhab bhi yahi hai. Ba'az ise wajib toh kehte hain lekin Hajj ka rukn nahin kehte, agar amdan ya sahwan ya koi shakhs ise chhod de toh ek janwar zibah karna padega. Imam Ahmad (R.H) se ek riwayat isi tarah marwi hai aur ek aur jama'at bhi yahi kehti hai aur ek qaul mein yeh mustahab hai. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H), Thawri (R.H), Sha'bi (R.H), Ibn Sirin (R.H) yahi kehte hain. Hazrat Anas (R.A), Ibn Umar (R.A) aur Ibn Abbas (R.A) se yahi marwi hai, Imam Malik (R.H) se Ateeba ki bhi riwayat hai, un ki daleel aayat (Faman tatawwa'a khairan) hai, lekin pehla qaul hi zyada rajeh hai is liye ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne koh-e-Safa-o-Marwa ka tawaf kiya aur farmaya ahkam-e-Hajj mujh se lo, pas aap (ﷺ) ne apne is Hajj mein jo kuch kiya woh wajib ho gaya, us ka karna zaroori hai, agar koi kaam kisi khaas daleel se wujoob se hat jaye toh aur baat hai, wallahu a'lam. Alawa azeen hadith mein aaya hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne tum par sa'i likh di yani farz kar di. Garz yahan bayan ho raha hai ke Safa-o-Marwa ka tawaf bhi Allah Ta'ala ke un shar'i ahkam mein se hai jinhein Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko baja-awari-e-Hajj ke liye sikhaye thay, yeh pehle bayan ho chuka hai ke is ki asal Hazrat Hajra (A.S) ka yahan saat phere karna hai jabke Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne unhein un ke chhote bachche samet yahan chhod kar chale gaye thay aur un ke paas khana peena khatam ho chuka tha aur bachche ki jaan par aa bani thi, tab Umm-e-Ismail (A.S) nihayat be-qarari, be-basi, darr, khauf aur iztirab ke sath un pahadon ke darmiyan apna daaman phailaye Allah se bheek maangti phir rahi thin. Yahan tak ke aap ka gham-o-ham, ranj-o-karb, takleef aur dukh door hua. Yahan se phere karne wale haaji ko bhi chahiye ke nihayat zillat-o-maskanat, khuzoo-o-khushoo se yahan phere kare aur apni faqiri, haajat aur zillat Allah ke samne pesh kare aur apne dil ki salahiyat aur apne maal ki hidayat aur apne gunahon ki bakhshish talab kare aur naqais aur aibon se pakeezgi aur nafarmaniyon se nafrat chahe aur sabit qadmi, neki, falah aur behboodi ki dua mange aur Allah Ta'ala se arz kare ke gunahon aur buraiyon ki tangi ki raah se hata kar kamal-o-ghufran aur neki ki taufeeq bakhshe jaise ke Hazrat Hajra (A.S) ke haal ko us Maalik ne idhar se udhar kar diya. Phir irshad hota hai ke jo shakhs apni khushi neki mein zyadati kare yani bajaye saat pheron ke aath nau kare, nafli Hajj-o-Umre mein bhi Safa-o-Marwa ka tawaf kare aur ba'az ne ise aam rakha hai yani har neki mein zyadati kare, wallahu a'lam. Phir farmaya Allah Ta'ala qadr-daan aur ilm wala hai, yani thode se kaam par bada sawab deta hai aur jaza ki sahih miqdar ko jaanta hai, na toh woh kisi ke sawab ko kam kare na kisi par zarra barabar zulm kare, haan nekiyon ka sawab badha kar ata farmata hai aur apne paas azeem inayat farmata hai, falhamdu wash-shukru lillah.

Haq baat ka chupana jurm-e-azeem hai. Is mein zabardast dhamki hai un logon ko jo Allah Ta'ala ki baatein yani shar'i masail chupa liya karte hain, Ahl-e-Kitab ne Na'at-e-Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko chupa liya tha jis par irshad hota hai ke haq ke chupane wale mal'oon log hain. Jis tarah is aalim ke liye jo logon mein Allah ki baatein phailaye har cheez istighfar karti hai yahan tak ke pani, machliyan aur hawa ke parind bhi, isi tarah un logon par jo haq ki baat ko jante hue goonge behre ban jate hain har cheez la'nat bhejti hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis shakhs se kisi shar'i amr ki nisbat sawal kiya jaye aur woh use chupa le use Qayamat ke din aag ki lagam pehnayi jayegi. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain agar yeh aayat na hoti to main ek hadith bhi bayan na karta. Hazrat Bara bin Aazib (R.A) farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath ek janaze mein the, aap ne farmaya ke qabr mein kafir ki peshani par is zor se hathora mara jata hai ke sab jandar is ka dhamaka sunte hain siwaye jinn-o-ins ke. Phir woh sab us par la'nat bhejte hain, yahi ma'ni hain ke un par Allah ki aur tamam la'nat karne walon ki la'nat hai yani tamam jandaron ki. Hazrat Atta farmate hain aayat (La'anoon) se murad tamam janwar aur kul jinn-o-ins hai. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain jab khushk-sali hoti hai barish nahin barasti to chopaye janwar kehte hain yeh Bani Adam ke gunahgaron ke gunah ki shoomi-e-qismat se hai, Allah Ta'ala Bani Adam ke gunahgaron par la'nat nazil kare. Ba'az mufassireen kehte hain is se murad farishte aur momin log hain. Hadith mein hai aalim ke liye har cheez istighfar karti hai yahan tak ke samundar ki machliyan bhi. Is aayat mein hai ke ilm ke chupane walon ko Allah la'nat karta hai aur farishte aur tamam log aur kul la'nat karne wale yani har ba-zaban aur har be-zaban chahe zaban se kahe chahe qara'in se aur Qayamat ke din bhi sab cheezein un par la'nat karengi, Wallahu A'lam. Phir in mein se un logon ko alag kar liya gaya jo apne is fe'l se baaz aa jayen aur apne a'maal ki poori islah kar lein aur jo chupaya tha use zahir karein, un logon ki tauba woh Allah Tawwab-ur-Rahim qubool farma leta hai. Is se maloom hua ke jo shakhs kufr-o-bid'at ki taraf logon ko bulane wala ho woh bhi jab sache dil se ruju kar le to us ki tauba bhi qubool hoti hai. Ba'az riwayaton se pata chalta hai ke agli ummaton mein aise zabardast badkaron ki tauba qubool nahin hoti thi lekin Nabi-ut-Tauba aur Nabi-ur-Rahma Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ummat ke sath yeh meherbani makhsoos hai.

Is ke baad un logon ka bayan ho raha hai jo kufr karein, tauba naseeb na ho aur kufr ki halat mein hi mar jayein. Un par Allah Ta'ala, farishton aur tamam logon ki la'nat hai, yeh la'nat un par chipak jati hai aur Qayamat tak sath hi rahegi aur dozakh ki aag mein le jayegi aur azab bhi hamesha hi rahega, na to azab mein kabhi kami hogi na kabhi mauqoof hogi balkeh hamesha dawam ke sath sakht azab mein rahenge, na'oozubillahi min azabillah. Hazrat Abu Al-Aliyah aur Hazrat Qatadah (Rahimahumullah) farmate hain, Qayamat ke din kafir ko thahraya jayega phir us par Allah Ta'ala la'nat karega, phir farishtey, phir sab log. Kafiron par la'nat bhejne ke mas'ala mein kisi ka ikhtilaf nahin, Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) aur aap ke ahd ke aimma-e-kiram sab ke sab qunoot waghera mein kuffar par la'nat bhejte thay, lekin kisi mu'ayyan kafir par la'nat bhejne ke bare mein ulama-e-kiram ka ek giroh kehta hai ke yeh ja'iz nahin is liye ke us ke khatima ka kisi ko ilm nahin aur is aayat ki yeh qaid ke marte dam tak woh kafir rahe, mu'ayyan kafir par daleel hai kisi par la'nat na bhejne ki. Ek dusri jama'at is ki bhi qa'il hai jaise Faqih Abu Bakr bin Arabi Maliki, lekin un ki daleel ek za'eef hadith hai. Ba'az ne is hadith se yeh bhi daleel li hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas ek shakhs bar bar nasha ki halat mein laya gaya aur us par bar bar had lagayi gayi to ek shakhs ne kaha is par Allah ki la'nat ho, bar bar sharab peeta hai, yeh sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is par la'nat na bhejo, yeh Allah aur us ke Rasool ko dost rakhta hai. Is se sabit hua ke jo shakhs Allah Rasool se dosti na rakhe us par la'nat bhejni ja'iz hai, wallahu a'lam.

Is mein zabardast dhamki hai un logon ko jo Allah Ta'ala ki baatein yani shar'i masail chupa liya karte hain, Ahl-e-Kitab ne Na'at-e-Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko chupa liya tha jis par irshad hota hai ke haq ke chupane wale mal'oon log hain. Jis tarah is aalim ke liye jo logon mein Allah ki baatein phailaye har cheez istighfar karti hai yahan tak ke pani, machliyan aur hawa ke parind bhi, isi tarah un logon par jo haq ki baat ko jante hue goonge behre ban jate hain har cheez la'nat bhejti hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis shakhs se kisi shar'i amr ki nisbat sawal kiya jaye aur woh use chupa le use Qayamat ke din aag ki lagam pehnayi jayegi. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain agar yeh aayat na hoti to main ek hadith bhi bayan na karta. Hazrat Bara bin Aazib (R.A) farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath ek janaze mein the, aap ne farmaya ke qabr mein kafir ki peshani par is zor se hathora mara jata hai ke sab jandar is ka dhamaka sunte hain siwaye jinn-o-ins ke. Phir woh sab us par la'nat bhejte hain, yahi ma'ni hain ke un par Allah ki aur tamam la'nat karne walon ki la'nat hai yani tamam jandaron ki. Hazrat Atta farmate hain aayat (La'anoon) se murad tamam janwar aur kul jinn-o-ins hai. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain jab khushk-sali hoti hai barish nahin barasti to chopaye janwar kehte hain yeh Bani Adam ke gunahgaron ke gunah ki shoomi-e-qismat se hai, Allah Ta'ala Bani Adam ke gunahgaron par la'nat nazil kare. Ba'az mufassireen kehte hain is se murad farishte aur momin log hain. Hadith mein hai aalim ke liye har cheez istighfar karti hai yahan tak ke samundar ki machliyan bhi. Is aayat mein hai ke ilm ke chupane walon ko Allah la'nat karta hai aur farishte aur tamam log aur kul la'nat karne wale yani har ba-zaban aur har be-zaban chahe zaban se kahe chahe qara'in se aur Qayamat ke din bhi sab cheezein un par la'nat karengi, Wallahu A'lam. Phir in mein se un logon ko alag kar liya gaya jo apne is fe'l se baaz aa jayen aur apne a'maal ki poori islah kar lein aur jo chupaya tha use zahir karein, un logon ki tauba woh Allah Tawwab-ur-Rahim qubool farma leta hai. Is se maloom hua ke jo shakhs kufr-o-bid'at ki taraf logon ko bulane wala ho woh bhi jab sache dil se ruju kar le to us ki tauba bhi qubool hoti hai. Ba'az riwayaton se pata chalta hai ke agli ummaton mein aise zabardast badkaron ki tauba qubool nahin hoti thi lekin Nabi-ut-Tauba aur Nabi-ur-Rahma Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ummat ke sath yeh meherbani makhsoos hai.

Is ke baad un logon ka bayan ho raha hai jo kufr karein, tauba naseeb na ho aur kufr ki halat mein hi mar jayein. Un par Allah Ta'ala, farishton aur tamam logon ki la'nat hai, yeh la'nat un par chipak jati hai aur Qayamat tak sath hi rahegi aur dozakh ki aag mein le jayegi aur azab bhi hamesha hi rahega, na to azab mein kabhi kami hogi na kabhi mauqoof hogi balkeh hamesha dawam ke sath sakht azab mein rahenge, na'oozubillahi min azabillah. Hazrat Abu Al-Aliyah aur Hazrat Qatadah (Rahimahumullah) farmate hain, Qayamat ke din kafir ko thahraya jayega phir us par Allah Ta'ala la'nat karega, phir farishtey, phir sab log. Kafiron par la'nat bhejne ke mas'ala mein kisi ka ikhtilaf nahin, Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) aur aap ke ahd ke aimma-e-kiram sab ke sab qunoot waghera mein kuffar par la'nat bhejte thay, lekin kisi mu'ayyan kafir par la'nat bhejne ke bare mein ulama-e-kiram ka ek giroh kehta hai ke yeh ja'iz nahin is liye ke us ke khatima ka kisi ko ilm nahin aur is aayat ki yeh qaid ke marte dam tak woh kafir rahe, mu'ayyan kafir par daleel hai kisi par la'nat na bhejne ki. Ek dusri jama'at is ki bhi qa'il hai jaise Faqih Abu Bakr bin Arabi Maliki, lekin un ki daleel ek za'eef hadith hai. Ba'az ne is hadith se yeh bhi daleel li hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas ek shakhs bar bar nasha ki halat mein laya gaya aur us par bar bar had lagayi gayi to ek shakhs ne kaha is par Allah ki la'nat ho, bar bar sharab peeta hai, yeh sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is par la'nat na bhejo, yeh Allah aur us ke Rasool ko dost rakhta hai. Is se sabit hua ke jo shakhs Allah Rasool se dosti na rakhe us par la'nat bhejni ja'iz hai, wallahu a'lam.

Thos dalail matlab yeh hai ke us Allah ki farman-rawai aur uski tauheed ki daleel ek toh yeh aasman hai jiski bulandi, latafat, kushadgi, jiske thehre hue aur chalte phirte wale roshan sitare tum dekh rahe ho, phir zameen ki paidaish jo kaseef cheez hai jo tumhare qadmon tale bichhi hui hai, jisme buland buland chotiyon ke sar-ba-falak pahar hain, jisme maujein maarne wale be-payan samundar hain, jisme anwa-o-aqsam ke khush-rang bail-boote hain, jisme tarah-tarah ki paidawar hoti hai, jisme tum rehte sehte ho aur apni marzi ke mutabiq aaram-deh makanat bana kar baste ho aur jisse saikdon tarah ka nafa uthate ho, phir raat din ka aana jana, raat gayi din gaya raat aa gayi. Na woh is par sabqat kare na yeh is par.

Har ek apne sahih andaaz se aaye aur jaaye, kabhi ke din bade kabhi ki raatein, kabhi din ka kuch hissa raat mein jaaye kabhi raat ka kuch hissa din mein aa jaaye, phir kashtiyon ko dekho jo khud tumhein aur tumhare maal-o-asbaab aur tijarati cheezon ko le kar samundar mein idhar se udhar jaati aati rehti hain, jin ke zariye is mulk wale us mulk walon se aur us mulk wale is mulk walon se rabta aur len-den kar sakte hain, yahan ki cheezein wahan aur wahan ki yahan pahunch sakti hain, phir Allah Ta'ala ka apni Rahmat-e-Kamilah se baarish barsana aur us se murda zameen ko zinda kar dena, us se anaaj aur khetiyan paida karna, charon taraf rail-pel kar dena, zameen mein mukhtalif qisam ke chhote bade kaar-aamad janwaron ko paida karna, un sab ki hifazat karna, unhein roziyan pahunchana, un ke liye sone baithne charne chugne ki jagah tayyar karna, hawaon ko poorab pachham chalana, kabhi thandi kabhi garam kabhi kam kabhi zyada, baadalon ko aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan musakhkhar karna, unhein ek taraf se dusri ki taraf le jana, zaroorat ki jagah barsana waghera yeh sab Allah ki qudrat ki nishaniyan hain jin se aqalmand apne Allah ke wajood ko aur us ki wahdaniyat ko pa lete hain, jaise aur jagah farmaya ke aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish aur raat din ke aane jaane mein aqalmandon ke liye nishaniyan hain, jo uthte baithte lete Allah Ta'ala ka naam liya karte hain aur zameen-o-aasman ki paidaish mein gaur-o-fikr se kaam lete hain aur kehte hain ae hamare Rab tu ne inhe bekar nahin banaya teri zaat paak hai tu hamein jahannam ke azaab se bacha.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Quraishi Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas aaye aur kehne lage aap Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke woh Safa pahad ko sone ka bana de hum is se ghode aur hathiyar waghera khareedein aur tera saath dein aur imaan bhi layein, aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya pukhta wade karte ho? Unhon ne kaha haan pukhta wada hai, aap (ﷺ) ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki, Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye aur farmaya tumhari dua to qabool hai lekin agar yeh log phir bhi imaan na laye to in par Allah ka woh azaab aayega jo aaj se pehle kisi par na aaya ho, aap (ﷺ) kaanp uthe aur arz karne lage nahin Allah tu inhein yunhi rehne de main inhein teri taraf bulata rahunga kya ajab aaj nahin kal aur kal nahin to parson in mein se koi na teri taraf jhuk jaaye, is par yeh aayat utri ke agar inhein qudrat ki nishaniyan dekhni hain to kya yeh nishaniyan kuch kam hain?

Ek aur shaan-e-nuzool bhi marwi hai ke jab aayat (Wa Ilahukum) al-kh utri to mushrikeen kehne lage ek Allah tamam jahan ka bandobast kaise karega? Is par yeh aayat nazil hui ke woh Allah itni badi qudrat wala hai, baaz riwayaton mein hai Allah ka ek hona sun kar unhon ne daleel talab ki jis par yeh aayat nazil hui aur qudrat ke nishaan-e-haaye in par zahir kiye gaye.

Muhabbat Allah Ta'ala ya apni pasand se? Is ayat mein mushrikeen ka dunyawi aur ukhrawi haal bayan ho raha hai, yeh Allah ka shareek muqarrar karte hain us jaisa auron ko thahrate hain aur phir un ki muhabbat apne dilon mein aisi hi jamate hain jaisi Allah ki honi chahiye halankeh woh Mabood-e-Barhaq sirf ek hi hai, woh shareek aur hissa-dari se paak hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) se riwayat hai farmate hain main ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sab se bada gunah kya hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Allah ke saath shirk karna halankeh paida usi akele ne kiya hai. Phir farmaya imandar Allah Ta'ala ki muhabbat mein bahut sakht hote hain un ke dil azmat-e-Ilahi aur tauheed-e-Rabbani se ma'moor hote hain, woh Allah ke siwa dusre se aisi muhabbat nahin karte kisi aur se taraf iltija karte hain na dusron ki taraf jhukte hain na us ki paak zaat ke saath kisi ko shareek thahrate hain. Phir un mushrikeen ko jo apni jaanon par shirk ke bojh ka zulm karte hain unhein is azab ki khabar pahunchata hai keh agar yeh log ise dekh lein to yaqeen ho jaye keh qudraton wala sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai, tamam cheezein usi ke mat-e-hat aur zer-e-farman hain aur us ka azab bada bhari hai jaise aur jagah hai keh us din na to us ke azab jaisa koi azab kar sakta hai na us ki pakad jaisi kisi ki pakad ho sakti, dusra matlab yeh bhi hai keh agar unhein is manzar ka ilm hota to yeh apni gumrahi aur shirk-o-kufr par hargiz na udte. Us din un logon ne jin jin ko apna peshwa bana rakha tha woh sab un se alag ho jayenge, farishtey kahenge Allah hum un se bezar hain yeh hamari ibadat nahin karte the Allah teri zaat paak hai tu hi hamara wali hai, yeh log to jinnaat ki ibadat karte the unhein par iman rakhte the, isi tarah jinnaat bhi un se bezari ka elaan karenge aur saaf saaf un ke dushman ho jayenge aur ibadat se inkaar karenge aur jagah Quran mein hai keh yeh log jin jin ki ibadat karte the woh sab ke sab qayamat ke din ayat (Sayakfuruna bi-ibadatihim wa yakoonoona alaihim didda) (19. Maryam: 82) un ki ibadat se inkaar karenge aur un ke dushman ban jayenge, Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ka farman hai ayat (Innamattakhaztum min doonillahi ausanan mawaddata bainikum fil-hayatid-dunya) (29. Al-Ankabut: 25) tum ne Allah ke siwa buton ki muhabbat dil mein bitha kar un ki pooja shuru kar di hai qayamat ke din woh tumhari ibadat ka inkaar karenge aur aapas mein ek dusre par la'nat bhejenge aur tumhara thikana jahannam hoga aur tumhara madadgar koi na hoga, isi tarah aur jagah hai ayat (Wa lau tara iziz-zalimoona mauqoofoona inda rabbihim yarji'u ba'duhum ila ba'dinil-qaul, yaqoolul-lazinas-tud'ifu lillazinas-takbaroo laula antum lakunna mu'mineen) (34. Saba: 31).

(Surah Saba: 31) Ya'ni yeh zalim Rabb ke samne khade hue honge aur apne peshwayon se keh rahe honge ke agar tum na hote toh hum imandar ban jate, woh jawab denge kya hum ne tumhein Allah parasti se roka? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke tum khud mujrim the, woh kahenge tumhari din raat ki makariyan, tumhare kufrana ahkam, tumhari shirk ki taleem ne hamein phans liya, ab sab dil se nadim honge aur un ki gardanon mein un ke bure a'mal ke tauq honge aur jagah hai ke us din Shaitan bhi kahega Ayat (Innal-laha wa'adakum wa'dal-haqqi wa wa'adttukum fa-akhlaftukum) (14. Ibrahim: 22) ya'ni Allah ka wa'da toh sacha tha aur main tumhein jo sabz bagh dikhaya karta tha woh mehez dhoka tha lekin tum par mera koi zor toh nahin tha main ne tumhein sirf kaha aur tum ne manzoor kar liya ab mujhe malamat karne se kya faida? Rozi dene wala kaun? Upar chunke Tauheed ka bayan hua tha is liye yahan yeh bayan ho raha hai ke tamam makhlooq ka rozi-rasan bhi wahi hai, farmata hai ke mera yeh ehsan bhi na bhoolo ke main ne tum par pakeeza cheezein halal keen jo tumhein lazeez aur marghoob hain jo na jism ko zarar pahunchayein na sehat ko na aql-o-hosh ko zarar dein, main tumhein rokta hoon ke Shaitan ki rah par na chalo jis tarah aur logon ne us ki chaal chal kar ba'az halal cheezein apne upar haram kar leen, Sahih Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Parwardigar-e-Alam farmata hai main ne jo maal apne bandon ko diya hai use un ke liye halal kar diya hai main ne apne bandon ko muwahid paida kiya magar Shaitan ne is Deen-e-Hanif se unhein hata diya aur meri halal karda cheezon ko un par haram kar diya, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne jis waqt is ayat ki tilawat hui to Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne khade ho kar kaha Huzoor mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah Ta'ala meri duaon ko qabool farmaya kare, Aap ne farmaya ae Sa'ad paak cheezein aur halal luqma khate raho. Allah Ta'ala tumhari duayein qabool farmata rahe ga qasam hai us Allah ki jis ke hath mein Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jaan hai haram ka luqma jo insan apne pet mein dalta hai us ki nahoosat ki wajah se chalees din tak us ki ibadat qabool nahin hoti jo gosht post haram se pala woh jahannami hai. Al-Kahf: 50) kya tum use aur us ki aulad ko apna dost samajhte ho? Halan-ke haqeeqatan woh tumhara dushman hai zalimon ke liye bura badla hai. (Khutwat-ush-Shaitan) se murad Allah Ta'ala ki har ma'asiyat hai jis mein Shaitan ka behkawa shamil hota hai Sha'bi (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain ek shakhs ne nazr mani ke woh apne ladke ko zibah kare ga Hazrat Masrooq ke paas jab yeh waqea pahuncha to Aap ne fatwa diya ke woh shakhs ek mendha zibah kar de warna nazr Shaitan ke naqsh-e-qadam se hai.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) ek din bakre ka paya namak laga kar kha rahe thay, ek shakhs jo aap ke paas baitha hua tha woh hat kar door ja baitha. Aap ne farmaya khao, us ne kaha main nahin khaunga. Aap ne poocha kya rozay se ho? Kaha nahin, main to ise apne oopar haram kar chuka hoon. Aap ne farmaya yeh shaitan ki raah chalna hai, apni qasam ka kaffara do aur kha lo. Abu Rafe' kehte hain ek din main apni biwi par naraz hua to woh kehne lagi ke main ek din Yahudiya hoon, ek din Nasraniya hoon aur mere tamam ghulam azad hain agar tu apni biwi ko talaq na de. Ab main Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ke paas masla poochne aaya, is soorat mein kya kiya jaye? To aap ne farmaya shaitan ke qadmon ki pairwi hai. Phir main Hazrat Zainab bint-e-Umm-e-Salma (R.A) ke paas gaya aur us waqt Madina bhar mein un se zyada faqih aurat koi na thi, main ne un se bhi yahi masla poocha, yahan bhi yahi jawab mila. Asim aur Ibn-e-Umar ne bhi yahi fatwa diya. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka fatwa hai ke jo qasam ghussay ki halat mein khai jaye aur jo nazr aisi halat mein mani jaye woh shaitani qadam ki tabedari hai, is ka kaffara qasam ke kaffaray ke barabar de de. Phir farmaya ke shaitan tumhein buray kamon aur us se bhi barh kar zinakari aur us se bhi barh kar Allah se un baton ko jor lene ko kehta hai jin ka tumhein ilm na ho, un baton ko Allah se mutaliq karta hai jin ka use ilm bhi nahin hota. Phir farmaya ke shaitan tumhein buray kamon aur us se bhi barh kar zinakari aur us se bhi barh kar Allah se un baton ko jor lene ko kehta hai jin ka tumhein ilm na ho, un baton ko Allah se mutaliq karta hai jin ka use ilm bhi nahin hota. Lehaza har kafir aur bid'ati in mein dakhil hai jo burai ka hukum kare aur badi ki taraf raghbat dilaye.

Gumrahi aur jahalat kya hai? Ya'ni in kafiron aur mushrikon se jab kaha jata hai ke Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasoolullah ki pairwi karo aur apni zalalat-o-jahalat ko chhor do to woh kehte hain ke hum to apne baron ki rah lage hue hain, jin cheezon ki woh pooja paat karte the hum bhi kar rahe hain aur karte rahenge, jis ke jawab mein Quran kehta hai ke woh to fahm-o-hidayat se ghafil the. Yeh aayat Yahudiyon ke bare mein utri hai. Phir un ki misaal di ke jis tarah charne chugne wale janwar apne charwahe ki koi baat sahi taur se samajh nahin sakte, sirf aawaz kanon mein padti hai aur kalam ki bhalai burai se bekhabar rehte hain, isi tarah yeh log bhi hain. Yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai ke jin jin ko yeh Allah ke siwa poojte hain aur un se apni hajatein aur muradein mangte hain, woh na sunte hain na jante hain, na un mein zindagi hai na unhein kuch ehsas hai. Kafiron ki yeh jamaat haq ki baton ke sunne se behri hai, haq kehne se bezuban hai, haq ke rah chalne se andhi hai, aql-o-fahm se door hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Summun wa bukmun fiz-zulumati) (6. Al-An'am: 39) ya'ni hamari baton ko jhutlane wale behre, goonge aur andhere mein hain, jise Allah chahe gumrah kare aur jise chahe seedhi rah laga de.
