Halal aur haram kya hai? Is ayat mein Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko hukum deta hai ke tum pak saaf aur halal tayyib cheezein khaya karo aur meri shukr guzari karo, luqma-e-halal dua-e-ibadat ki qabooliyat ka sabab hai aur luqma-e-haram adam-e-qabooliyat ka, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain logon Allah Ta'ala pak hai woh pak cheez ko qabool farmata hai usne rasoolon ko aur iman walon ko hukum diya ke woh pak cheezein khayein aur nek aamal karein farman hai ayat (Ya ayyuhar rusulu kulu minat tayyibati wa'malu saliha) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 51) aur farmaya ayat (Ya ayyuhallazina amanu kulu min tayyibati ma razaqnakum washkuru lillahi in kuntum iyyahu ta'budun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 172) phir aap ﷺ ne farmaya ke ek shakhs lamba safar karta hai woh paraganda baalon wala ghubar alood hota hai apne haath aasman ki taraf uthakar dua karta hai aur gidgida kar Allah Ta'ala ko pukarta hai lekin uska khana peena libas aur ghiza sab haram ke hain is liye uski is waqt ki aisi dua bhi qabool nahin hoti. Halal cheezon ka zikr karne ke baad haram cheezon ka bayan ho raha hai ke tum par murdar janwar jo apni maut aap mar gaya ho jise shar'i taur par zibah na kiya gaya ho haram hai khwah kisi ne uska gala ghont diya ho ya lakdi aur lath lagne se mar gaya ho kahin se gir pada ho aur mar gaya ho ya dusre janwaron ne apne seeng se use halak kar diya ho ya darindon ne use maar dala ho yeh sab meeta mein dakhil hain aur haram hain lekin is mein se pani ke janwar makhsoos hain woh agarche khud ba khud mar jayein to bhi halal hain. Ayat (U hilla lakum saidul bahri wa ta'amuhu mata'al lakum wa lissayyara) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 96) iska poora bayan is ayat ki tafsir mein aayega. Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Anbar nami janwar ka mara hua milna aur sahaba ka use khana phir Huzoor ﷺ ko uski khabar hona aur aap ﷺ ka use jaiz qarar dena yeh sab baatein hadith mein hain. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke samundar ka pani pak hai aur uska murda halal hai, ek aur hadith mein hai Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain do murde aur do khoon hum par halal hain machli aur tiddi, kaleji aur tilli, Surah Ma'idah mein iska bayan tafseel war aayega. Insha'Allah.

Mas'ala: Murdar ka doodh aur us ke anday jo us mein hon najis hain. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka yahi mazhab hai is liye ke woh bhi mayyat ka ek juzv hai. Imam Malik (R.H) se ek riwayat mein hai ke woh to pak hai lekin mayyat mein shamil honay ki wajah se najis ho jata hai. Isi tarah murdar ki khees (kheeri) bhi mashhoor mazhab mein un buzurgon ke nazdeek napak hai go is mein ikhtilaf bhi hai. Sahaba (R.A) ka majoosiyon ka paneer khana go bator-e-aitraz un par ho sakta hai magar is ka jawab Qurtubi (R.H) ne yeh diya hai ke doodh bahut hi kam hota hai aur koi behne wali aisi thodi si cheez agar kisi miqdar mein zyada behne wali mein mil jaye to koi harj nahin. Nabi (ﷺ) se ghee aur paneer aur gor-e-khar ke baray mein sawal hua to aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Halal woh hai jisay Allah ne apni Kitab mein halal bataya aur haram woh hai jisay Allah Ta'ala ne apni Kitab mein haram qarar diya aur jis ka bayan nahin woh sab maaf hain.

Phir farmaya tum par soor ka gosht bhi haram hai khwah usay zibah kiya ho khwah woh khud mar gaya ho. Soor ki charbi ka hukm bhi yahi hai is liye ke chunke aksar gosht hi hota hai aur charbi gosht ke sath hi hoti hai pas jab gosht haram hua to charbi bhi haram hui, dusre is liye bhi ke gosht mein hi charbi hoti hai aur qiyas ka taqaza bhi yahi hai.

Phir farmaya ke jo cheez Allah Ta'ala ke siwa aur kisi ke naam par mansoob ki jaye woh bhi haram hai. Jahiliyat ke zamane mein kafir log apne maboodan-e-batil ke naam par janwar zibah kiya karte thay jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne haram qarar diya. Ek martaba ek aurat ne guriya ke nikah par ek janwar zibah kiya to Hasan Basri (R.H) ne fatwa diya ke usay na khana chahiye is liye ke woh ek tasveer ke liye zibah kiya gaya. Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) se sawal kiya gaya ke ajmi log jo apne tehwar aur eid ke mauqa par janwar zibah karte hain aur musalmanon ko bhi us mein se hadiya bhejte hain un ka gosht khana chahiye ya nahin? To farmaya: Is din ki azmat ke liye jo janwar zibah kiya jaye usay na khao, haan un ke darakhton ke phal khao.

Phir Allah Ta'ala ne zaroorat aur haajat ke waqt jabke kuch aur khane ko na mile in haram cheezon ka kha lena mubah kiya hai aur farmaya jo shakhs bebas ho jaye magar baghi aur sarkash aur had se barh jane wala na ho us par in cheezon ke khane mein gunah nahin Allah Ta'ala bakhshish karne wala meharban hai. Baghi aur 'aad ki tafsir mein Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain, daaku rahzan musalman badshah par charhai karne wala saltanat-e-Islam ka mukhalif aur Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani mein safar karne wala sabhi ke liye is iztirar ke waqt bhi haram cheezein haram hi rehti hain, ghair-e-baghi ki tafsir Hazrat Muqatil bin Habban R.H yeh bhi karte hain ke woh ise halal samajhne wala na ho aur is mein lazzat aur maza ka khwahishmand na ho, ise bhun bhan kar lazeez bana kar achha paka kar na khaye balkay jaisa taisa sirf jaan bachane ke liye kha le aur agar sath le to itna ke zindagi ke sath halal cheez ke milne tak baqi reh jaye jab halal cheez mil gayi ise phenk de. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ise khoob pet bhar kar na khaye, Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain jo shakhs is ke khane ke liye majboor kar diya jaye aur be-ikhtiyar ho jaye us ka bhi yahi hukm hai. Masla: Ek shakhs bhook ke mare bebas ho gaya hai use ek murdar janwar nazar para aur kisi dusre ki halal cheez bhi dikhayi di jis mein na rishta ka tootna hai na eeza-dahi hai to use is dusre ki cheez ko kha lena chahiye murdar na khaye, phir aaya is cheez ki qeemat ya wahi cheez us ke zimme rahegi ya nahin is mein do qaul hain ek yeh ke rahegi dusre yeh ke na rahegi. Na rehne wale qaul ki tayeed mein yeh hadith hai jo Ibn-e-Majah mein hai, Hazrat Abbad bin Sharjeel Ghazi R.H kehte hain hamare han ek saal qahat-sali pari main Madina gaya aur ek khet mein se kuch baalein tor kar cheel kar dane chabane laga aur thori si baalein apni chadar mein bandh kar chala khet wale ne dekh liya aur mujhe pakar kar mara peeta aur meri chadar cheen li, main An-Hazrat ﷺ ke paas gaya aur aap se waqia arz kiya to aap ne us shakhs ko kaha is bhooke ko na to tu ne khana khilaya na is ke liye koi aur koshish ki na ise kuch samjhaya sikhaya yeh bechara bhooka tha nadan tha jao is ka kapra wapas karo aur ek wasq ya aadha wasq ghalla ise de do, (ek wasq chaar man ke qareeb hota hai) ek aur hadith mein hai ke darakhton mein lage hue phalon ki nisbat Huzoor ﷺ se poocha gaya to aap ne farmaya jo haajat-mand shakhs in mein se kuch kha le lekar na jaye is par kuch jurm nahin.

Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain matlab ayat ka yeh hai ke iztirab aur bebasi ke waqt itna kha lene mein koi muza'iqa nahin jis se bebasi aur iztirar hat jaye, yeh bhi marwi hai ke teen luqmon se zyada na khaye garaz aise waqt mein Allah Ta'ala ki meherbani aur nawazish hai yeh haram us ke liye halal hai. Hazrat Masrooq (R.H) farmate hain iztirar ke waqt bhi jo shakhs haram cheez na khaye aur mar jaye woh jahannami hai, is se maloom hua ke aise waqt aisi cheez ka khana zaroori hai na ke sirf rukhsat hi ho, yahi baat zyada sahih hai jaise ke beemar ka roza chhor dena waghera.

Badtareen log yani jo Yahudi Nabi ki sifaat ki aayaton ko jo Taurat mein hain chupate hain aur uske badle apni aao bhagat Arab se karate hain aur awaam se tohfe aur naqdi samet-te rehte hain woh is ghatiya duniya ke badle apni aakhirat kharab kar rahe hain, unhein darr laga hua hai ke agar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat ki sachai aur aap ke da'we ki tasdeeq ki aayatein (jo Taurat mein hain) logon par zahir ho gayin toh log aap ke matahat ho jayenge aur unhein chhod denge is khauf se woh hidayat-o-maghfirat ko chhod baithe aur zalalat-o-azaab par khush ho gaye is ba'is duniya aur aakhirat ki barbadi un par nazil hui, aakhirat ki ruswai toh zahir hai lekin duniya mein bhi logon par un ka makr khul gaya, waqtan-fawaqtan woh aayatein jinhein yeh badtareen ulama chupate rehte the zahir hoti rahin, alawa azeen khud Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke mojizaat aur aap ki pakeeza aadat ne logon ko aap ki tasdeeq par aamada kardiya aur un ki woh jamaat jis ke haath se nikal jaane ke darr ne unhein Kalam-e-Ilahi chupane par aamada kiya tha bil-aakhir haath se jaati rahin un logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bai'at karli iman le aaye aur aap ke saath mil kar un haq ke chupane walon ki jaanein lein aur un se baqaida jihad kiya, Quran-e-Kareem mein un ki haqaiq chupane wali harkaton ko jagah jagah bayan kiya gaya, aur farmaya hai ke jo maal tum kamate ho Allah ki baaton ko chhupa kar, Quran-e-Kareem ne un logon ke bare mein bhi jo yateemon ka maal zulm se hadap karlein. Un ke liye bhi yahi farmaya hai ke woh bhi apne pet mein Jahannam ki aag bhar rahe hain aur Qayamat ke din bhadakti hui aag mein dakhil honge sahih hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate jo shakhs sone chandi ke bartan mein khata peeta hai woh bhi apne pet mein Jahannam ki aag bharta hai. Phir farmaya un se Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din baat-cheet bhi nahin karega na unhein paak karega balkay alamnaak azaabon mein mubtala karega. Is liye ke un ke is kartoot ki wajah se Allah ka ghazab un par nazil hua hai aur ab un par se nazar-e-rahmat hat gayi hai aur yeh sataish aur tareef ke qabil nahin rahe balkay sazayab honge aur wahan talmalate rahenge. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai teen qisam ke logon se Allah baat-cheet na karega na un ki taraf dekhega na unhein paak karega aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab mein zani budha, jhoota badshah, mutakabbir faqeer farmaya ke un logon ne hidayat ke badle gumrahi le li unhein chahiye tha ke Taurat mein jo khabrein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nisbat thin unhein un padhon tak pahunchate lekin us ke badle unhon ne unhein chhupa liya aur khud bhi aap ke saath kufr kiya aur aap ki takzeeb ki, un ke izhaar par jo na'atein aur rahmatein unhein milne wali thin un ke badle zahmatein aur azaab apne sar le liye. Phir farmata hai unhein woh dardnaak aur hairat-angez azaab honge ke dekhne wala shashdar reh jaye aur yeh bhi ma'ani hain ke unhein aag ke azaab ki bardasht par kis cheez ne aamada kiya jo yeh Allah ki nafarmaniyon mein mashghool ho gaye.

Phir irshad hota hai ke yeh log is azab ke mustahiq is liye hue ke unhon ne Allah ki baton ko hansi khel samjha aur jo Kitab-e-Allah haq ko zahir karne aur batil ka nabood karne ke liye utri thi unhon ne is ki mukhalifat ki, zahir karne ki baten chupayin aur Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) se dushmani ki, Aap (ﷺ) ki sifaton ko zahir na kiya. Fi-al-waq is kitab ke bare mein ikhtilaf karne wale door ki gumrahi mein ja pade.

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai teen qisam ke logon se Allah baat-cheet na karega na un ki taraf dekhega na unhein paak karega aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab mein zani budha, jhoota badshah, mutakabbir faqeer farmaya ke un logon ne hidayat ke badle gumrahi le li unhein chahiye tha ke Taurat mein jo khabrein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nisbat thin unhein un padhon tak pahunchate lekin us ke badle unhon ne unhein chhupa liya aur khud bhi aap ke saath kufr kiya aur aap ki takzeeb ki, un ke izhaar par jo na'atein aur rahmatein unhein milne wali thin un ke badle zahmatein aur azaab apne sar le liye. Phir farmata hai unhein woh dardnaak aur hairat-angez azaab honge ke dekhne wala shashdar reh jaye aur yeh bhi ma'ani hain ke unhein aag ke azaab ki bardasht par kis cheez ne aamada kiya jo yeh Allah ki nafarmaniyon mein mashghool ho gaye.

Phir irshad hota hai ke yeh log is azab ke mustahiq is liye hue ke unhon ne Allah ki baton ko hansi khel samjha aur jo Kitab-e-Allah haq ko zahir karne aur batil ka nabood karne ke liye utri thi unhon ne is ki mukhalifat ki, zahir karne ki baten chupayin aur Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) se dushmani ki, Aap (ﷺ) ki sifaton ko zahir na kiya. Fi-al-waq is kitab ke bare mein ikhtilaf karne wale door ki gumrahi mein ja pade.

Iman ka ek pehlu is pak ayat mein sahi aqeeday aur rah-e-mustaqeem ki taleem ho rahi hai. Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se iman ke bare mein sawal kiya gaya ke iman kya cheez hai? To Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ayat ki tilawat farmayi, unhon ne phir sawal kiya, Huzoor ne phir yahi ayat tilawat farmayi, phir yahi sawal kiya, Aap ne farmaya suno neki se mohabbat aur burai se adawat iman hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Lekin is riwayat ki sanad munqata hai, Mujahid Hazrat Abu Zar se is hadith ko riwayat karte hain halankeh un ki mulaqat sabit nahin hui. Ek shakhs ne Hazrat Abu Zar se sawal kiya ke iman kya hai? To Aap ne yahi ayat tilawat farma di, us ne kaha Hazrat main aap se bhalai ke bare mein sawal nahin karta mera sawal iman ke bare mein hai, to Aap ne farmaya sun, ek shakhs ne yahi sawal Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiya, Aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat farma di, woh bhi tumhari tarah raazi na hua to Aap ne farmaya momin jab nek kaam karta hai to us ka jee khush ho jata hai aur use sawab ki umeed hoti hai aur jab gunah karta hai to us ka dil ghamgeen ho jata hai aur woh azab se darne lagta hai (Ibn Marduyah). Yeh riwayat bhi munqata hai. Ab is ayat ki tafsir suniye. Mominon ko pehle to hukm hua ke woh Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf munh kar ke namaz parhein, phir unhein Kaaba ki taraf ghuma diya gaya jo Ahl-e-Kitab par aur ba'az iman walon par bhi shaq guzra, pas Allah Ta'ala ne is ki hikmat bayan farmayi ke is ka asal maqsad ita'at-e-farman-e-Allah hai, woh jidhar munh karne ko kahe kar lo. Ahl-e-taqwa, asal bhalai aur kamil iman yahi hai ke malik ke zer-e-farman raho. Agar koi mashriq ki taraf munh kare ya maghrib ki taraf munh pher le aur Allah ka hukm na ho to woh is tawajjuh se imandar nahin ho jaye ga, balkeh haqiqat mein ba-iman woh hai jis mein woh ausaf hon jo is ayat mein bayan hue. Quran-e-Karim ne ek aur jagah farmaya hai ayat (Lan yanallaha luhoomuha wa la dima'uha wa lakin yanalluhut-taqwa minkum) (22. Al-Hajj: 37) yani tumhari qurbaniyon ke gosht aur lahu Allah ko nahin pohanchte balkeh us tak tumhara taqwa pohanchta hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) is ayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke tum namazein parho aur dusre a'amal na karo yeh koi bhalai nahin.

Yeh hukm us waqt tha jab Makkah se Madinah ki taraf lautay thay lekin phir us ke baad aur faraiz aur ahkaam nazil huay aur un par amal karna zaroori qarar diya gaya, mashriq-o-maghrib ko us ke liye khaas kiya gaya ke Yahood maghrib ki taraf aur Nasara mashriq ki taraf munh kiya kartay thay, pas gharz yeh hai ke yeh toh sirf lafzi imaan hai imaan ki haqeeqat toh amal hai, Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmatay hain bhalai yeh hai ke ita'at ka maada dil mein paida hojaye, faraiz pabandi ke sath ada hon, tamam bhalaiyon ka aamil ho, haq toh yeh hai ke jis ne is aayat par amal karliya us ne kaamil Islam pa liya aur dil khol kar bhalai samet li, us ka zaat-e-bari par imaan hai yeh woh jaanta hai ke mabood-e-barhaq wahi hai farishton ke wujood ko aur is baat ko ke woh Allah ka paigham Allah ke makhsoos bandon par laatay hain yeh maanta hai, kul aasmani kitabon ko barhaq jaanta hai aur sab se aakhri kitab Quran-e-Kareem ko jo ke tamam agli kitabon ko sacha kehnay wali tamam bhalaiyon ki jame' aur deen-o-duniya ki sa'adat par mushtamil hai woh maanta hai, isi tarah awwal se aakhir tak ke tamam ambiya par bhi us ka imaan hai, bilkhusoos Khatam-ul-Anbiya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par bhi. Maal ko bawajood maal ki mohabbat ke rah-e-Allah mein kharch karta hai, sahih hadith shareef mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain afzal sadaqa yeh hai ke tu apni sehat aur maal ki mohabbat ki halat mein Allah ke naam de bawajood-e-ke maal ki kami ka andesha ho aur ziyadati ki raghbat bhi ho (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aayat (وَاٰتَى الْمَالَ عَلٰي حُبِّهٖ ذَوِي الْقُرْبٰى وَالْيَـتٰمٰى وَالْمَسٰكِيْنَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيْلِ ۙ وَالسَّاۗىِٕلِيْنَ وَفِي الرِّقَابِ ۚ وَاَقَام الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتَى الزَّكٰوةَ ۚ وَالْمُوْفُوْنَ بِعَهْدِهِمْ اِذَا عٰھَدُوْا) (2-Al-Baqarah: 177) parh kar farmaya ke is ka matlab yeh hai tum sehat mein aur maal ki chahat ki halat mein faqiri se dartay huay aur amiri ki khwahish rakhtay huay sadaqa karo, lekin is riwayat ka mauqoof hona ziyada sahih hai, asal mein yeh farman Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) ka hai, Quran-e-Kareem mein Surah Dahr mein farmaya aayat (وَيُطْعِمُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ عَلٰي حُبِّهٖ مِسْكِيْنًا وَّيَـتِـيْمًا وَّاَسِيْرًا) (76-Al-Insan: 8) Musalman bawajood khanay ki chahat ke maskeenon yateemon aur qaidiyon ko khana khilatay hain aur kehtay hain ke hum tumhein Allah ki khushnoodi ke liye khilatay hain na tum se is ka badla chahtay hain na shukriya aur jagah farmaya aayat (لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتّٰى تُنْفِقُوْا مِمَّا تُحِبُّوْنَ) (3-Aal-e-Imran: 92) jab tak tum apni chahat ki cheezein Allah ke naam na do tum haqeeqi bhalai nahin pa saktay. Aur jagah farmaya aayat (وَيُؤْثِرُوْنَ عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ) (59-Al-Hashr: 9).

(Surah Al-Hashr: 9) Ya'ni bawajood apni haajat aur zaroorat ke bhi woh dusron ko apne nafs par muqaddam karte hain. Pas yeh log bade paya ke hain kyunke pehli qism ke logon ne toh apni pasandeeda cheez bawajood uski mohabbat ke dusron ko di lekin in buzurgon ne apni chahat ki woh cheez jiske woh khud mohtaj thay dusron ko de di aur apni haajat mandi ka khayal bhi na kiya. Zawi-ul-Qurba unhein kehte hain jo rishtedar hon, sadqa dete waqt yeh dusron se zyada muqaddam hain. Hadees mein hai maskeen ko dena ikhara sawab hai aur qarabat-dar maskeen ko dena dohra sawab hai, ek sawab sadqe ka dusra sila-e-rehmi ka. Tumhari bakhshish aur khairaton ke zyada mustahiq yeh hain, Quran-e-Kareem mein inke sath sulook karne ka hukum kayi jagah hai. Yateem se murad woh chote bache hain jin ke walid mar gaye hon aur unka kamane wala koi na ho, na khud unhein apni rozi hasil karne ki quwwat-o-taqat ho. Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai balughat ke baad yateemi nahin rehti. Masakeen woh hain jin ke paas itna ho jo unke khane peene, pehne odhne, rehne sehne ka kafi ho sake, unke sath bhi sulook kiya jaye jis se unki haajat poori ho aur faqr-o-faqa aur qillat-o-zillat ki halat se bach sakein. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marwi hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain maskeen sirf wohi log nahin jo mangte phirte hon aur ek ek do do khajoorein ya ek ek do do luqme roti ke le jate hon, balkay maskeen woh bhi hain jin ke paas itna na ho ke unke sab kaam nikal jayen, na woh apni halat aisi banayein jis se logon ko ilm ho jaye aur unhein koi kuch de de. Ibn-us-Sabeel musafir ko kehte hain, isi tarah woh shakhs bhi jo ita'at-e-Allah mein safar kar raha ho use jane aane ka kharch dena, mehman bhi isi hukum mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) mehman ko bhi Ibn-us-Sabeel mein dakhil karte hain aur dusre buzurg salaf bhi. Sa'ileen woh log hain jo apni haajat zahir kar ke logon se kuch mangein, unhein bhi sadqa-o-zakat dena chahiye, Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain sa'il ka haq hai agarche woh ghode par sawar aaye (Abu Dawood). Aayat (Fi-Riqab) se murad ghulamon ko azadi dilana hai khwah yeh woh ghulam hon jinhon ne apne malikon ko muqarrara qeemat ki adayegi ka likh diya ho ke itni raqam hum tumhein ada kar denge toh hum azad hain lekin ab in becharon se ada nahin ho saki toh unki imdad kar ke unhein azad karana. In tamam qismon ki aur dusre isi qism ke logon ki poori tafseer Surah Bara'at mein aayat (Innama-s-Sadaqatu) ki tafseer mein bayan hogi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Hazrat Fatima bint-e-Qais (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya maal mein zakat ke siwa kuch aur bhi Allah Ta'ala ka haq hai, phir aap ne yeh aayat padh kar sunayi, is hadees ka ek rawi Abu Hamza Maimoon A'war za'eef hai.

Phir farmaya namaz ko waqt par pooray rukoo sajday itminan aur aaram khushoo aur khuzoo ke sath ada kare jis tarah adaigi ka shariat ka hukum hai aur zakat ko bhi ada kare ya yeh maani ke apne nafs ko be-maani baton aur razeel akhlaqon se pak kare jaise farmaya aayat (QAD AFLAHA MAN ZAKKAHAA) 91. Ash-Shams: 9 yani apne nafs ko pak karne wala falah pa gaya aur usay gandagi mein latheerne (lat-pat karne wala) tabah ho gaya. Musa A.S ne Firaun se yahi farmaya tha ke aayat (HAL LAKA ILA AN TAZAKKA) al-kh. Aur jagah Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai aayat (WA WAILUL LIL-MUSHRIKEEN. ALLAZEENA LAA YUTOONAZ ZAKAATA WA HUM BIL-AAKHIRATI HUM KAAFIROON) 41. Fussilat: 6 yani un mushrikon ko wail hai jo zakat ada nahin karte ya yeh ke jo apne aap ko shirk se pak nahin karte, pas yahan mandaraja bala aayat zakat se murad zakat-e-nafs yani apne aap ko gandagiyon aur shirk-o-kufr se pak karna hai, aur mumkin hai maal ki zakat murad ho to aur ahkaam nafli sadqa se mutaliq samjhay jayenge jaise oopar hadith bayan hui ke maal mein zakat ke siwa aur haq bhi hain. Phir farmaya waday pooray karne wale jaise aur jagah hai aayat (YOOFOONA BI-AHDILLAAHI WA LAA YANQUDOONAL MEESAQ) 13. Ar-Ra'd: 20 yeh log Allah ke ahd ko poora karte hain aur waday nahin tortay, waday torna nifaq ki khaslat hai, jaise hadith mein hai munafiq ki teen nishaniyan hain, baat karte hue jhoot bolna, wada khilafi karna, amanat mein khayanat karna, ek aur hadith mein hai jhagray ke waqt gaaliyan bakna. Phir farmaya faqr-o-faqa mein maal ki kami ke waqt badan ki bimari ke waqt larai ke mauqa par dushmanan-e-deen ke samnay maidan-e-jang mein jihad ke waqt sabr-o-sabit qadam rehne wale aur fauladi chattan ki tarah jam janay wale. Sabireen ka nasb bator-e-madah ke hai in sakhtiyon aur museebaton ke waqt sabr ki taleem aur talqeen ho rahi hai, Allah Ta'ala hamari madad kare hamara bharosa usi par hai. Phir farmaya in ausaf wale log hi sachay iman wale hain unka zahir batin qaul fe'l yaksan hai aur muttaqi bhi yahi log hain kyunke itaat guzar hain aur nafarmaniyon se door hain.

Qisas ki wazahat yani ae Musalmanon qisas ke waqt adl se kaam liya karo, azad ke badle azad, ghulam ke badle ghulam, aurat ke badle aurat. Is bare mein had se na barho jaise ke agle log had se barh gaye aur Allah ka hukum badal diya. Is ayat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke jahiliyat ke zamane mein Banu Quraiza aur Banu Nazir ki jang hui thi jis mein Banu Nazir ghalib aaye thay. Ab yeh dastoor ho gaya tha ke jab Nazri kisi Qurzi ko qatl kare to us ke badle use qatl nahin kiya jata tha balkeh ek sau wasq khajoor diyat mein li jati thi aur jab koi Qurzi Nazri ko maar dale to qisas mein use qatl kar diya jata tha aur agar diyat li jaye to doguni diyat yani do sau wasq khajoor li jati thi. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne jahiliyat ki is rasm ko mitaya aur adl-o-musawat ka hukum diya. Abu Hatim ki riwayat mein shaan-e-nuzool yun bayan hua hai ke Arab ke do qabeelon mein jidal-o-qital hua tha, Islam ke baad us ka badla lene ki thani aur kaha ke hamare ghulam ke badle un ka azad qatl ho aur aurat ke badle mard qatl ho, to un ke radd mein yeh ayat nazil hui aur yeh hukum bhi mansookh hai. Quran farmata hai ayat (An-nafsu bin-nafs) pas har qatil maqtool ke badle maar dala jaye ga khwah azad ne kisi ghulam ko qatl kiya ho khwah us ke bar-aks ho, khwah mard ne aurat ko qatl kiya ho khwah us ke bar-aks ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh log mard ko aurat ke badle qatl nahin karte thay jis par (An-nafsa bin-nafsi wal-aina bil-aini wal-anfa bil-anfi wal-uzuna bil-uzuni was-sinna bis-sinni wal-jurooha qisas) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 45) nazil hui. Pas azad log sab barabar hain, jis ki jaan ke badle jaan li jaye gi khwah qatil mard ho khwah aurat ho, isi tarah maqtool khwah mard ho khwah aurat ho, jab ke ek azad insan ne ek azad insan ko maar dala hai to use bhi maar dala jaye ga. Isi tarah yahi hukum ghulamon aur londiyon mein bhi jari hoga aur jo koi jaan lene ke qasd se dusre ko qatl kare ga woh qisas mein qatl kiya jaye ga aur yahi hukum qatl ke alawa aur zakhmiyon ka aur dusre aaza ki barbadi ka bhi hai. Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) bhi is ayat ko ayat (An-nafsu bin-nafs) se mansookh batlate hain.

Mas'ala: Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Thawri, Imam Ibn Abi Laila aur Dawood ka mazhab hai ke azad ne agar ghulam ko qatl kiya hai toh uske badle woh bhi qatl kiya jayega. Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood (R.A), Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i, Hazrat Qatada aur Hazrat Hakam ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Hazrat Imam Bukhari, Ali bin Madini, Ibrahim Nakh'i aur ek aur riwayat ki ro se Hazrat Thawri ka bhi mazhab yahi hai ke agar koi aaqa apne ghulam ko maar dale toh uske badle uski jaan li jayegi. Daleel mein yeh hadith bayan farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai: "Jo shakhs apne ghulam ko qatl kare hum use qatl karenge aur jo shakhs apne ghulam ko nakta kare hum bhi uski naak kaat denge aur jo use khasi kare us se bhi yahi badla liya jaye." Lekin jamhoor ka mazhab in buzurgon ke khilaf hai, woh kehte hain azad ghulam ke badle qatl nahin kiya jayega isliye ke ghulam maal hai, agar woh khata se qatl ho jaye toh diyat yani jurmana nahin dena padta, sirf uske maalik ko uski qeemat ada karni padti hai aur isi tarah uske haath paon waghera ke nuqsan par bhi badle ka hukm nahin. Aaya musalman kafir ke badle qatl kiya jayega ya nahin? Is bare mein jamhoor ulama-e-ummat ka mazhab toh yeh hai ke qatl na kiya jayega aur daleel Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki yeh hadith hai ke hadith: "La yuqtalu muslimun bi kafirin" (Musalman kafir ke badle qatl na kiya jaye). Is hadith ke khilaf na toh koi sahih hadith hai ke koi aisi ta'weel ho sakti hai jo iske khilaf ho, lekin taham sirf Imam Abu Hanifa ka mazhab yeh hai ke musalman kafir ke badle qatl kar diya jaye.

Mas'ala: Hazrat Hasan Basri aur Hazrat Ata ka qaul hai ke mard aurat ke badle qatl na kiya jaye aur daleel mein mandarja-bala aayat ko pesh karte hain, lekin jamhoor ulama-e-Islam iske khilaf hain kyunke Surah Al-Ma'idah ki aayat aam hai jisme aayat (An-nafsu bin-nafsi) maujood hai. Alawa azeen hadith-e-sharif mein bhi hai hadith: "Al-muslimuna tatakafa'u dima'uhum" yani musalmanon ke khoon aapas mein yaksan hain. Hazrat Laith ka mazhab hai ke khawand agar apni biwi ko maar dale toh khastan uske badle uski jaan nahin li jaye.

Mas'ala: Charon imamon aur jamhoor-e-ummat ka mazhab hai ke kayi ek ne mil kar ek musalman ko qatl kiya hai toh woh saare us ek ke badle qatl kar diye jayenge. Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ke zamane mein ek shakhs ko saat shakhs mil kar maar dalte hain toh aap un saaton ko qatl karate hain aur farmate hain agar Sana ke tamam log bhi is qatl mein shareek hote toh main qisas mein sab ko qatl kara deta. Aap ke is farman ke khilaf aap ke zamane mein kisi sahabi (R.A) ne aitraz nahin kiya, pas is baat par goya ijma ho gaya. Lekin Imam Ahmad se marwi hai ke woh farmate hain ek ke badle ek hi qatl kiya jaye, zyada qatl na kiye jayen.

Hazrat Mu'az, Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair, Abdul Malik bin Marwan, Zuhri, Ibn-e-Sirin, Habib bin Abi Thabit se bhi yeh qaul marwi hai, Ibn-e-Mundar farmate hain yahi zyada sahih hai aur ek jama'at ko ek maqtool ke badle qatl karne ki koi daleel nahin aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) se yeh sabit hai ke woh is mas'ala ko nahin maante thay, pas jab Sahaba (R.A) mein ikhtilaf hua to ab mas'ala ghaur talab ho gaya. Phir farmata hai ke yeh aur baat hai ke kisi qatil ko maqtool ka koi waris kuch hissa maaf kar de, ya'ni qatl ke badle woh diyat qabool kar le ya diyat bhi apne hissa ki chhor de aur saaf maaf kar de, agar woh diyat par raazi ho gaya hai to qatil ko mushkil mein na daale balkay achhai se diyat wasool kare aur qatil ko bhi chahiye ke bhalai ke sath usay diyat ada kar de, heel-o-hujjat na kare.

Mas'ala: Imam Malik ka mashhoor mazhab aur Imam Abu Hanifa aur aap ke shagirdon ka aur Imam Shafi'i aur Imam Ahmad ka ek riwayat ki roo se yeh mazhab hai ke maqtool ke awliya ka qisas chhor kar diyat par raazi hona us waqt ja'iz hai jab khud qatil bhi is par aamada ho, lekin aur buzrugan-e-deen farmate hain ke is mein qatil ki razamandi shart nahin.

Mas'ala: Salaf ki ek jama'at kehti hai ke aurat qisas se darguzar kar ke diyat par agar razamand hon to un ka e'tibar nahin. Hasan, Qatada, Zuhri, Ibn-e-Shubruma, Lais aur Auza'i ka yahi mazhab hai lekin baqi ulama-e-deen in ke mukhalif hain, woh farmate hain ke agar kisi aurat ne bhi diyat par razamandi zahir ki to qisas jata rahe ga. Phir farmate hain ke qatl-e-amd mein diyat lena yeh Allah ki taraf se takhfeef aur meharbani hai, agli ummaton ko yeh ikhtiyar na tha. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Bani Israel par qisas farz tha, unhein qisas se darguzar karne aur diyat lene ki ijazat na thi, lekin is ummat par yeh meharbani hui ke diyat leni bhi ja'iz ki gayi, to yahan teen cheezein huin: qisas, diyat aur ma'afi. Agli ummaton mein sirf qisas aur ma'afi hi thi, diyat na thi. Ba'z log kehte hain Ahl-e-Taurat ke yahan sirf qisas aur ma'afi thi aur Ahl-e-Injeel ke yahan sirf ma'afi hi thi.

Phir farmaya jo shakhs diyat ya'ni jurmana lene ke baad ya diyat qabool kar lene ke baad bhi ziyadati par tul jaye us ke liye sakht dardnak azab hai. Maslan diyat lene ke baad phir qatl ke darpay ho waghera. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jis shakhs ka koi maqtool ya majrooh ho to usay teen baton mein se ek ka ikhtiyar hai: ya qisas ya'ni badla le le, ya darguzar kare, ma'af kar de, ya diyat ya'ni jurmana le le aur agar kuch aur karna chahe to usay rok do, in mein se ek kar chukne ke baad bhi jo ziyadati kare woh hamesha ke liye jahannami ho jaye ga (Ahmad). Doosri hadith mein hai ke jis ne diyat wasool kar li phir qatil ko qatl kiya to ab main us se diyat bhi na loon ga balkay usay qatl karoon ga.

Phir irshad hota hai ke ae aqalmando qisas mein nasl-e-insan ki baqa hai is mein hikmat-e-azeema hai go bazahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke ek ke badle ek qatl hua toh do mare lekin darasal agar socho toh pata chalega ke yeh sabab-e-zindagi hai, qatil ko khud khayal hoga ke main ise qatl na karoon warna khud bhi qatl kardiya jaunga toh woh is fe'l-e-bad se ruk jayega toh do aadmi qatl-o-khoon se bach gaye. Agli kitabon mein bhi yeh baat toh bayan farmayi thi ke aayat (Al-Qatlu anfa lil-qatl) qatl qatl ko rok deta hai lekin Quran-e-Pak mein bahut hi fasahat-o-balaghat ke sath is mazmoon ko bayan kiya gaya. Phir farmaya yeh tumhare bachao ka sabab hai ke ek toh Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani se mehfooz rahoge dusre na koi kisi ko qatl karega na ke woh qatl kiya jayega zameen par aman-o-aman sukoon-o-salam rahega, taqwa nekion ke karne aur kul buraiyon ke chhodne ka naam hai.

Qisas ki wazahat yani ae Musalmanon qisas ke waqt adl se kaam liya karo, azad ke badle azad, ghulam ke badle ghulam, aurat ke badle aurat. Is bare mein had se na barho jaise ke agle log had se barh gaye aur Allah ka hukum badal diya. Is ayat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke jahiliyat ke zamane mein Banu Quraiza aur Banu Nazir ki jang hui thi jis mein Banu Nazir ghalib aaye thay. Ab yeh dastoor ho gaya tha ke jab Nazri kisi Qurzi ko qatl kare to us ke badle use qatl nahin kiya jata tha balkeh ek sau wasq khajoor diyat mein li jati thi aur jab koi Qurzi Nazri ko maar dale to qisas mein use qatl kar diya jata tha aur agar diyat li jaye to doguni diyat yani do sau wasq khajoor li jati thi. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne jahiliyat ki is rasm ko mitaya aur adl-o-musawat ka hukum diya. Abu Hatim ki riwayat mein shaan-e-nuzool yun bayan hua hai ke Arab ke do qabeelon mein jidal-o-qital hua tha, Islam ke baad us ka badla lene ki thani aur kaha ke hamare ghulam ke badle un ka azad qatl ho aur aurat ke badle mard qatl ho, to un ke radd mein yeh ayat nazil hui aur yeh hukum bhi mansookh hai. Quran farmata hai ayat (An-nafsu bin-nafs) pas har qatil maqtool ke badle maar dala jaye ga khwah azad ne kisi ghulam ko qatl kiya ho khwah us ke bar-aks ho, khwah mard ne aurat ko qatl kiya ho khwah us ke bar-aks ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh log mard ko aurat ke badle qatl nahin karte thay jis par (An-nafsa bin-nafsi wal-aina bil-aini wal-anfa bil-anfi wal-uzuna bil-uzuni was-sinna bis-sinni wal-jurooha qisas) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 45) nazil hui. Pas azad log sab barabar hain, jis ki jaan ke badle jaan li jaye gi khwah qatil mard ho khwah aurat ho, isi tarah maqtool khwah mard ho khwah aurat ho, jab ke ek azad insan ne ek azad insan ko maar dala hai to use bhi maar dala jaye ga. Isi tarah yahi hukum ghulamon aur londiyon mein bhi jari hoga aur jo koi jaan lene ke qasd se dusre ko qatl kare ga woh qisas mein qatl kiya jaye ga aur yahi hukum qatl ke alawa aur zakhmiyon ka aur dusre aaza ki barbadi ka bhi hai. Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) bhi is ayat ko ayat (An-nafsu bin-nafs) se mansookh batlate hain.

Mas'ala: Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Thawri, Imam Ibn Abi Laila aur Dawood ka mazhab hai ke azad ne agar ghulam ko qatl kiya hai toh uske badle woh bhi qatl kiya jayega. Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood (R.A), Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i, Hazrat Qatada aur Hazrat Hakam ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Hazrat Imam Bukhari, Ali bin Madini, Ibrahim Nakh'i aur ek aur riwayat ki ro se Hazrat Thawri ka bhi mazhab yahi hai ke agar koi aaqa apne ghulam ko maar dale toh uske badle uski jaan li jayegi. Daleel mein yeh hadith bayan farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai: "Jo shakhs apne ghulam ko qatl kare hum use qatl karenge aur jo shakhs apne ghulam ko nakta kare hum bhi uski naak kaat denge aur jo use khasi kare us se bhi yahi badla liya jaye." Lekin jamhoor ka mazhab in buzurgon ke khilaf hai, woh kehte hain azad ghulam ke badle qatl nahin kiya jayega isliye ke ghulam maal hai, agar woh khata se qatl ho jaye toh diyat yani jurmana nahin dena padta, sirf uske maalik ko uski qeemat ada karni padti hai aur isi tarah uske haath paon waghera ke nuqsan par bhi badle ka hukm nahin. Aaya musalman kafir ke badle qatl kiya jayega ya nahin? Is bare mein jamhoor ulama-e-ummat ka mazhab toh yeh hai ke qatl na kiya jayega aur daleel Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki yeh hadith hai ke hadith: "La yuqtalu muslimun bi kafirin" (Musalman kafir ke badle qatl na kiya jaye). Is hadith ke khilaf na toh koi sahih hadith hai ke koi aisi ta'weel ho sakti hai jo iske khilaf ho, lekin taham sirf Imam Abu Hanifa ka mazhab yeh hai ke musalman kafir ke badle qatl kar diya jaye.

Mas'ala: Hazrat Hasan Basri aur Hazrat Ata ka qaul hai ke mard aurat ke badle qatl na kiya jaye aur daleel mein mandarja-bala aayat ko pesh karte hain, lekin jamhoor ulama-e-Islam iske khilaf hain kyunke Surah Al-Ma'idah ki aayat aam hai jisme aayat (An-nafsu bin-nafsi) maujood hai. Alawa azeen hadith-e-sharif mein bhi hai hadith: "Al-muslimuna tatakafa'u dima'uhum" yani musalmanon ke khoon aapas mein yaksan hain. Hazrat Laith ka mazhab hai ke khawand agar apni biwi ko maar dale toh khastan uske badle uski jaan nahin li jaye.

Mas'ala: Charon imamon aur jamhoor-e-ummat ka mazhab hai ke kayi ek ne mil kar ek musalman ko qatl kiya hai toh woh saare us ek ke badle qatl kar diye jayenge. Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ke zamane mein ek shakhs ko saat shakhs mil kar maar dalte hain toh aap un saaton ko qatl karate hain aur farmate hain agar Sana ke tamam log bhi is qatl mein shareek hote toh main qisas mein sab ko qatl kara deta. Aap ke is farman ke khilaf aap ke zamane mein kisi sahabi (R.A) ne aitraz nahin kiya, pas is baat par goya ijma ho gaya. Lekin Imam Ahmad se marwi hai ke woh farmate hain ek ke badle ek hi qatl kiya jaye, zyada qatl na kiye jayen.

Hazrat Mu'az, Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair, Abdul Malik bin Marwan, Zuhri, Ibn-e-Sirin, Habib bin Abi Thabit se bhi yeh qaul marwi hai, Ibn-e-Mundar farmate hain yahi zyada sahih hai aur ek jama'at ko ek maqtool ke badle qatl karne ki koi daleel nahin aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) se yeh sabit hai ke woh is mas'ala ko nahin maante thay, pas jab Sahaba (R.A) mein ikhtilaf hua to ab mas'ala ghaur talab ho gaya. Phir farmata hai ke yeh aur baat hai ke kisi qatil ko maqtool ka koi waris kuch hissa maaf kar de, ya'ni qatl ke badle woh diyat qabool kar le ya diyat bhi apne hissa ki chhor de aur saaf maaf kar de, agar woh diyat par raazi ho gaya hai to qatil ko mushkil mein na daale balkay achhai se diyat wasool kare aur qatil ko bhi chahiye ke bhalai ke sath usay diyat ada kar de, heel-o-hujjat na kare.

Mas'ala: Imam Malik ka mashhoor mazhab aur Imam Abu Hanifa aur aap ke shagirdon ka aur Imam Shafi'i aur Imam Ahmad ka ek riwayat ki roo se yeh mazhab hai ke maqtool ke awliya ka qisas chhor kar diyat par raazi hona us waqt ja'iz hai jab khud qatil bhi is par aamada ho, lekin aur buzrugan-e-deen farmate hain ke is mein qatil ki razamandi shart nahin.

Mas'ala: Salaf ki ek jama'at kehti hai ke aurat qisas se darguzar kar ke diyat par agar razamand hon to un ka e'tibar nahin. Hasan, Qatada, Zuhri, Ibn-e-Shubruma, Lais aur Auza'i ka yahi mazhab hai lekin baqi ulama-e-deen in ke mukhalif hain, woh farmate hain ke agar kisi aurat ne bhi diyat par razamandi zahir ki to qisas jata rahe ga. Phir farmate hain ke qatl-e-amd mein diyat lena yeh Allah ki taraf se takhfeef aur meharbani hai, agli ummaton ko yeh ikhtiyar na tha. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Bani Israel par qisas farz tha, unhein qisas se darguzar karne aur diyat lene ki ijazat na thi, lekin is ummat par yeh meharbani hui ke diyat leni bhi ja'iz ki gayi, to yahan teen cheezein huin: qisas, diyat aur ma'afi. Agli ummaton mein sirf qisas aur ma'afi hi thi, diyat na thi. Ba'z log kehte hain Ahl-e-Taurat ke yahan sirf qisas aur ma'afi thi aur Ahl-e-Injeel ke yahan sirf ma'afi hi thi.

Phir farmaya jo shakhs diyat ya'ni jurmana lene ke baad ya diyat qabool kar lene ke baad bhi ziyadati par tul jaye us ke liye sakht dardnak azab hai. Maslan diyat lene ke baad phir qatl ke darpay ho waghera. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jis shakhs ka koi maqtool ya majrooh ho to usay teen baton mein se ek ka ikhtiyar hai: ya qisas ya'ni badla le le, ya darguzar kare, ma'af kar de, ya diyat ya'ni jurmana le le aur agar kuch aur karna chahe to usay rok do, in mein se ek kar chukne ke baad bhi jo ziyadati kare woh hamesha ke liye jahannami ho jaye ga (Ahmad). Doosri hadith mein hai ke jis ne diyat wasool kar li phir qatil ko qatl kiya to ab main us se diyat bhi na loon ga balkay usay qatl karoon ga.

Phir irshad hota hai ke ae aqalmando qisas mein nasl-e-insan ki baqa hai is mein hikmat-e-azeema hai go bazahir toh yeh maloom hota hai ke ek ke badle ek qatl hua toh do mare lekin darasal agar socho toh pata chalega ke yeh sabab-e-zindagi hai, qatil ko khud khayal hoga ke main ise qatl na karoon warna khud bhi qatl kardiya jaunga toh woh is fe'l-e-bad se ruk jayega toh do aadmi qatl-o-khoon se bach gaye. Agli kitabon mein bhi yeh baat toh bayan farmayi thi ke aayat (Al-Qatlu anfa lil-qatl) qatl qatl ko rok deta hai lekin Quran-e-Pak mein bahut hi fasahat-o-balaghat ke sath is mazmoon ko bayan kiya gaya. Phir farmaya yeh tumhare bachao ka sabab hai ke ek toh Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani se mehfooz rahoge dusre na koi kisi ko qatl karega na ke woh qatl kiya jayega zameen par aman-o-aman sukoon-o-salam rahega, taqwa nekion ke karne aur kul buraiyon ke chhodne ka naam hai.

Wasiyyat ki wazahat is aayat mein maa baap aur qarabat-daron ke liye wasiyyat karne ka hukum ho raha hai, meeras ke hukum se pehle yeh wajib tha theek qaul yahi hai, lekin meeras ke ahkaam ne is wasiyyat ke hukum ko mansookh kardiya, har waris apna muqarrara hissa be-wasiyyat le le ga, Sunan waghera mein Hazrat Amr bin Kharija R.A se hadees hai kehte hain main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ko khutba mein yeh farmate hue suna ke Allah Ta'ala ne har haqdaar ko uska haq pahuncha diya hai ab kisi waris ke liye koi wasiyyat nahin, Ibn Abbas R.A Surah Al-Baqarah ki tilawat karte hain jab aap is aayat par pahunchte hain to farmate hain yeh aayat mansookh hai (Musnad Ahmad). Aap se yeh bhi marwi hai ke pehle maa baap ke sath aur koi rishtedar waris na tha auron ke liye sirf wasiyyat hoti thi phir meeras ki aayatein nazil huin aur ek tihai maal mein wasiyyat ka ikhtiyar baqi raha. Is aayat ke hukum ko mansookh karne wali aayat (LIL-RIJALI NASIBUN MIMMA TARAKAL-WALIDANI WAL-AQRABUNA WA LIL-NISA'I NASIBUN MIMMA TARAKAL-WALIDANI WAL-AQRABUNA MIMMA QALLA MINHU AW KATHUR; NASIBAN MAFRUDA) (Surah An-Nisa: 7) hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar R.A, Hazrat Abu Musa R.A, Saeed bin Musayyab, Hasan, Mujahid, Atta, Saeed bin Jubair, Muhammad bin Sireen, Ikrama, Zaid bin Aslam, Rabee bin Anas, Qatada, Suddi, Muqatil bin Hayyan, Taoos, Ibrahim Nakh'i, Shuraih, Zahhak aur Zahri Rahimahumullah yeh sab hazraat bhi is aayat ko mansookh batate hain, lekin bawajood iske ta'ajjub hai ke Imam Razi ne apni Tafsir-e-Kabeer mein Abu Muslim Isfahani se yeh kaise naqal kardiya ke yeh aayat mansookh nahin balkay aayat-e-meeras iski tafsir hai aur matlab aayat ka yeh hai ke tum par woh wasiyyat farz ki gayi jiska bayan aayat (YUSIKUMULLAHU FI AULADIKUM LIL-ZAKARI MITHLU HAZZIL-UNTHAYAIN) (Surah An-Nisa: 11) mein hai.

(An-Nisa: 11) mein hai aur yehi qaul aksar mufassireen aur mu'tabar fuqaha ka hai baaz kehte hain ke wasiyat ka hukm warison ke haqq mein mansookh hai aur jin ka wirsa muqarrar nahin un ke haqq mein sabit hai Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A), Hasan, Masrooq, Ta'oos, Zahhak, Muslim bin Yasar aur Ala bin Ziyad ka mazhab bhi yehi hai, mein kehta hoon Saeed bin Jubair, Rabi bin Anas, Qatadah aur Muqatil bin Hayyan bhi yehi kehte hain lekin in hazrat ke is qaul ki bina par pehle fuqaha ki istilah mein yeh ayat mansookh nahin theherti is liye ke mirath ki ayat se woh log toh is hukm se makhsoos ho gaye jin ka hissa Shariat ne khud muqarrar kar diya aur jo is se pehle is ayat ke hukm ki ru se wasiyat mein dakhil thay kyunke qarabat-dar aam hain khwah un ka wirsa muqarrar ho ya na ho toh ab wasiyat un ke liye hui jo waris nahin aur un ke haqq mein na rahi jo waris hain, yeh qaul aur baaz digar hazrat ka yeh qaul ke wasiyat ka hukm ibtida-e-Islam mein tha aur woh bhi ghair zaroori, donon ka matlab qareeban ek ho gaya, lekin jo log wasiyat ke is hukm ko wajib kehte hain aur rawani-e-ibarat aur siyaq-o-sibaq se bhi bazahir yehi maloom hota hai un ke nazdeek toh yeh ayat mansookh hi thehre gi jaise ke aksar mufassireen aur mu'tabar fuqaha-e-kiram ka qaul hai, pas walidain aur wirasat pane wale qarabat-daron ke liye wasiyat karna bil-ijma mansookh hai balkay mamnoo hai Hadith Shareef mein aa chuka hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne har haqdar ko us ka haqq de diya hai ab waris ke liye koi wasiyat nahin, Ayat-e-Mirath ka hukm mustaqil hai aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se woh wajib-o-farz hai Zu-al-Furooz aur Asbaat ka hissa muqarrar hai aur is se is ayat ka hukm kulliyatan uth gaya, baqi rahe woh qarabat-dar jin ka koi wirsa muqarrar nahin un ke liye tihayi maal mein wasiyat karana mustahab hai kuch toh is ka hukm is ayat se bhi nikalta hai doosre yeh ke Hadith Shareef mein saaf aa chuka hai Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se marwi hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain kisi mard-e-Musalman ko layaq nahin ke us ke paas koi cheez ho aur woh wasiyat karni chahta ho toh do raatein bhi baghair wasiyat likhe hue guzare rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Umar Farooq ke sahibzade farmate hain ke is farman ke sunne ke baad mein ne toh ek raat bhi bila wasiyat nahin guzari, qarabat-daron aur rishtedaron se sulook-o-ihsan karne ke bare mein bohat si aayatein aur hadithein aayi hain, ek hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ae Ibn-e-Adam tu jo maal meri raah mein kharch karega mein is ki wajah se tujhe paak saaf karoon ga aur tere intiqal ke baad bhi mere naik bandon ki duaon ka sabab banaoon ga.

'Khairan' se murad yahan maal hai, aksar jaleel-ul-qadr mufassireen ki yehi tafsir hai. Baaz mufassireen ka toh qaul hai ke maal khwah thoda ho khwah bahut, wasiyat mashru' hai jaise mirath thode maal mein bhi hai aur zyada mein bhi. Baaz kehte hain wasiyat ka hukm us waqt hai jab zyada maal ho. Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se riwayat hai ke ek Quraishi mar gaya hai aur teen char sau dinar uske wirse mein thay aur usne wasiyat kuch nahin ki, Aap ne farmaya yeh raqam wasiyat ke qabil nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne ayat (In taraka khairan) farmaya hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) apni qaum ke ek bimar ki bimar-pursi ko gaye, us se kisi ne kaha wasiyat karo toh Aap ne farmaya wasiyat 'khair' mein hoti hai aur tu toh kam maal chhod raha hai, isey aulad ke liye hi chhod ja. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain saath (60) dinar jis ne nahin chhode usne 'khair' nahin chhodi yaani uske zimma wasiyat karna nahin. Tawus, assi (80) dinar batate hain, Qatadah ek hazar batate hain. Ma'roof se murad narmi aur ihsan hai. Hazrat Hasan farmate hain wasiyat karna har Musalman par zaroori hai, is mein bhalayi kare burayi na kare, warison ko nuqsan na pahunchaye, israf aur fuzool-kharchi na kare. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Sa'd (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne farmaya, "Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mein maldar hoon aur meri waris sirf meri ek ladki hi hai, toh Aap ijazat dijiye ke mein apne do-tihayi maal ki wasiyat karoon." Aap ne farmaya, "Nahin." Kaha, "Aadhe ki ijazat dijiye." Farmaya, "Nahin." Kaha, "Ek-tihayi ki ijazat dijiye." Farmaya, "Khair, tihayi maal ki wasiyat karo go yeh bhi bahut hai. Tum apne peeche apne warison ko maldar chhod kar jao yeh behtar hai is se ke tum unhein faqeer aur tang-dast chhod kar jao ke woh auron ke samne hath phailayein." Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai, Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain, "Kaash ke log tihayi se hat kar chauthayi par aa jayein, is liye ke Aan-hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tihayi ki rukhsat dete hue yeh bhi farmaya hai ke tihayi bahut hai." Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Hanzalah bin Jazeem bin Hanfiyah ke dada Hanfiyah ne ek yateem bacche ke liye jo unke haan palte thay, sau (100) oonton ki wasiyat ki. Unki aulad par yeh bahut giran guzra, muamla Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tak pahuncha. Huzoor ne farmaya, "Nahin, nahin, nahin. Sadqa mein paanch do, warna das do, warna pandrah do, warna bees do, warna pacchis do, warna tees do, warna paintis do, agar is par bhi na maano toh khair zyada se zyada chalis do." Phir farmaya jo shakhs wasiyat ko badal de, is mein kami-beshi kar de ya wasiyat ko chhupa le, us ka gunah badalne wale ke zimma hai, mayyit ka ajr Allah Ta'ala ke zimma sabit ho gaya. Allah Ta'ala wasiyat karne wale ki wasiyat ki asliyat ko bhi jaanta hai aur badalne wale ki tabdeeli ko bhi, na us se koi awaaz poshida na koi raaz. 'Haif' ke ma'ni khata aur ghalati ke hain, maslan kisi waris ko kisi tarah zyada dilwa dena, maslan keh diya ke falan cheez falan ke hath itne itne mein bech di jaye waghairah. Ab yeh khwah bator-e-ghalati aur khata ke ho ya zyadati-e-muhabbat-o-shafqat ki wajah se baghair qasd aisi harkat sarzad ho gayi ho ya gunah ke taur par ho, toh wasi ko iske radd-o-badal mein koi gunah nahin.

Wasiyyah ko shar'i ahkaam ke mutabiq poori ho aisi haalat mein badalne waale par koi gunah ya haraj nahin Wallahu A'lam. Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain zindagi mein zulm kar ke sadqah dene waale ka sadqah isi tarah lauta diya jaye ga jis tarah maut ke waqt gunahgaar karne waale ka sadqah lauta diya jata hai yeh hadees Ibn Mardawayh mein bhi marwi hai Ibn Abi Hatim farmate hain Waleed bin Yazeed jo is hadees ka rawi hai us ne is mein ghalti ki hai dar-asl yeh kalaam Hazrat Urwah ka hai, Waleed bin Muslim ne isey Awza'i se riwayat kiya hai aur Urwah se aage sanad nahin le gaye Imam Ibn Mardawayh bhi ek marfoo' hadees ba-riwayat Ibn Abbas bayan karte hain ke wasiyyah ki kami beshi kabeerah gunah hai lekin is hadees ke marfoo' hone mein bhi kalaam hai is baare mein sab se achhi woh hadees hai jo Musnad Abdul Razzaq mein ba-riwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aadmi nek logon ke a'maal sattar saal tak karta rehta hai aur wasiyyah mein zulm karta hai aur burai ke amal par khatmah hone ki wajah se jahannami ban jata hai aur ba'az log sattar baras tak bad-a'maaliyan karte rehte hain lekin wasiyyah mein adl-o-insaaf karte hain aur aakhri amal un ka bhala hota hai aur woh jannati ban jaate hain, phir Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne farmaya agar chaho toh Quran Paak ki is aayat ko padho aayat (Tilka hudoodullahi fala ta'tadooha wa man yat'adda hudoodallahi fa-ula'ika humuz-zalimoon) (65. At-Talaq: 1) ya'ni yeh Allah Ta'ala ki hadein hain un se aage nah barho.

sabit hai Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A), Hasan, Masrooq, Ta'oos, Zahhak, Muslim bin Yasar aur Ala bin Ziyad ka mazhab bhi yehi hai, mein kehta hoon Saeed bin Jubair, Rabi bin Anas, Qatadah aur Muqatil bin Hayyan bhi yehi kehte hain lekin in hazrat ke is qaul ki bina par pehle fuqaha ki istilah mein yeh ayat mansookh nahin theherti is liye ke mirath ki ayat se woh log toh is hukm se makhsoos ho gaye jin ka hissa Shariat ne khud muqarrar kar diya aur jo is se pehle is ayat ke hukm ki ru se wasiyat mein dakhil thay kyunke qarabat-dar aam hain khwah un ka wirsa muqarrar ho ya na ho toh ab wasiyat un ke liye hui jo waris nahin aur un ke haqq mein na rahi jo waris hain, yeh qaul aur baaz digar hazrat ka yeh qaul ke wasiyat ka hukm ibtida-e-Islam mein tha aur woh bhi ghair zaroori, donon ka matlab qareeban ek ho gaya, lekin jo log wasiyat ke is hukm ko wajib kehte hain aur rawani-e-ibarat aur siyaq-o-sibaq se bhi bazahir yehi maloom hota hai un ke nazdeek toh yeh ayat mansookh hi thehre gi jaise ke aksar mufassireen aur mu'tabar fuqaha-e-kiram ka qaul hai, pas walidain aur wirasat pane wale qarabat-daron ke liye wasiyat karna bil-ijma mansookh hai balkay mamnoo hai Hadith Shareef mein aa chuka hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne har haqdar ko us ka haqq de diya hai ab waris ke liye koi wasiyat nahin, Ayat-e-Mirath ka hukm mustaqil hai aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se woh wajib-o-farz hai Zu-al-Furooz aur Asbaat ka hissa muqarrar hai aur is se is ayat ka hukm kulliyatan uth gaya, baqi rahe woh qarabat-dar jin ka koi wirsa muqarrar nahin un ke liye tihayi maal mein wasiyat karana mustahab hai kuch toh is ka hukm is ayat se bhi nikalta hai doosre yeh ke Hadith Shareef mein saaf aa chuka hai Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se marwi hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain kisi mard-e-Musalman ko layaq nahin ke us ke paas koi cheez ho aur woh wasiyat karni chahta ho toh do raatein bhi baghair wasiyat likhe hue guzare rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Umar Farooq ke sahibzade farmate hain ke is farman ke sunne ke baad mein ne toh ek raat bhi bila wasiyat nahin guzari, qarabat-daron aur rishtedaron se sulook-o-ihsan karne ke bare mein bohat si aayatein aur hadithein aayi hain, ek hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ae Ibn-e-Adam tu jo maal meri raah mein kharch karega mein is ki wajah se tujhe paak saaf karoon ga aur tere intiqal ke baad bhi mere naik bandon ki duaon ka sabab banaoon ga.

'Khairan' se murad yahan maal hai, aksar jaleel-ul-qadr mufassireen ki yehi tafsir hai. Baaz mufassireen ka toh qaul hai ke maal khwah thoda ho khwah bahut, wasiyat mashru' hai jaise mirath thode maal mein bhi hai aur zyada mein bhi. Baaz kehte hain wasiyat ka hukm us waqt hai jab zyada maal ho. Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se riwayat hai ke ek Quraishi mar gaya hai aur teen char sau dinar uske wirse mein thay aur usne wasiyat kuch nahin ki, Aap ne farmaya yeh raqam wasiyat ke qabil nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne ayat (In taraka khairan) farmaya hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) apni qaum ke ek bimar ki bimar-pursi ko gaye, us se kisi ne kaha wasiyat karo toh Aap ne farmaya wasiyat 'khair' mein hoti hai aur tu toh kam maal chhod raha hai, isey aulad ke liye hi chhod ja. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain saath (60) dinar jis ne nahin chhode usne 'khair' nahin chhodi yaani uske zimma wasiyat karna nahin. Hazrat Hasan farmate hain wasiyat karna har Musalman par zaroori hai, is mein bhalayi kare burayi na kare, warison ko nuqsan na pahunchaye, israf aur fuzool-kharchi na kare. Farmaya, "Nahin." Kaha, "Ek-tihayi ki ijazat dijiye." Farmaya, "Khair, tihayi maal ki wasiyat karo go yeh bhi bahut hai. Sadqa mein paanch do, warna das do, warna pandrah do, warna bees do, warna pacchis do, warna tees do, warna paintis do, agar is par bhi na maano toh khair zyada se zyada chalis do." Ab yeh khwah bator-e-ghalati aur khata ke ho ya zyadati-e-muhabbat-o-shafqat ki wajah se baghair qasd aisi harkat sarzad ho gayi ho ya gunah ke taur par ho, toh wasi ko iske radd-o-badal mein koi gunah nahin.

Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain zindagi mein zulm kar ke sadqah dene waale ka sadqah isi tarah lauta diya jaye ga jis tarah maut ke waqt gunahgaar karne waale ka sadqah lauta diya jata hai yeh hadees Ibn Mardawayh mein bhi marwi hai Ibn Abi Hatim farmate hain Waleed bin Yazeed jo is hadees ka rawi hai us ne is mein ghalti ki hai dar-asl yeh kalaam Hazrat Urwah ka hai, Waleed bin Muslim ne isey Awza'i se riwayat kiya hai aur Urwah se aage sanad nahin le gaye Imam Ibn Mardawayh bhi ek marfoo' hadees ba-riwayat Ibn Abbas bayan karte hain ke wasiyyah ki kami beshi kabeerah gunah hai lekin is hadees ke marfoo' hone mein bhi kalaam hai is baare mein sab se achhi woh hadees hai jo Musnad Abdul Razzaq mein ba-riwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aadmi nek logon ke a'maal sattar saal tak karta rehta hai aur wasiyyah mein zulm karta hai aur burai ke amal par khatmah hone ki wajah se jahannami ban jata hai aur ba'az log sattar baras tak bad-a'maaliyan karte rehte hain lekin wasiyyah mein adl-o-insaaf karte hain aur aakhri amal un ka bhala hota hai aur woh jannati ban jaate hain, phir Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne farmaya agar chaho toh Quran Paak ki is aayat ko padho aayat (Tilka hudoodullahi fala ta'tadooha wa man yat'adda hudoodallahi fa-ula'ika humuz-zalimoon) (65. At-Talaq: 1) ya'ni yeh Allah Ta'ala ki hadein hain un se aage nah barho.

Roodad-e-Roza aur Salat: Allah Ta'ala is ummat ke imandaron ko mukhatib kar ke unhein hukum de raha hai ke rozay rakho. Rozay ke ma'ani Allah Ta'ala ke farman ki baja-awari ki khalis niyat ke sath khanay peenay aur jima' se ruk janay ke hain. Is se faida yeh hai ke nafs-e-insan pak saaf aur tayyab-o-tahir ho jata hai, raddi akhlat aur behooda akhlaq se insan ka tanqiya ho jata hai. Is hukum ke sath hi farmaya gaya hai ke is hukum ke sath tum tanha nahin balkay tum se aglon ko bhi rozay rakhnay ka hukum tha. Is bayan se yeh bhi maqsad hai ke yeh ummat is fareeza ki baja-awari mein agli ummaton se peechay na reh jaye, jaisay aur jagah hai ayat (Li-kullin ja'alna minkum shir'atan wa minhaja) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 48), yani har ek ke liye ek tareeqa aur rasta. Agar Allah Ta'ala chahta to tum sab ko ek hi ummat kar deta lekin woh tumhein azma raha hai, tumhein chahiye ke nekiyon mein sabqat kartay raho. Yehi yahan bhi farmaya ke tum par bhi rozay isi tarah farz hain jis tarah tum se pehlay guzarnay walon par thay. Rozay se badan ko pakeezgi milti hai aur amal-e-shaitani rah par chalnay se ruk jata hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain: "Ae jawanon! Tum mein se jisay nikah ki taqat ho woh nikah kar lay aur jisay taqat na ho woh rozay rakhay, is ke liye yeh josh ko sard kar detay hain." Phir rozon ki miqdar bayan ho rahi hai ke yeh chand din hi hain taake kisi par bhari na paray aur adaigi se qasir na reh jaye, balkay zauq-o-shauq se is Ilahi fareeza ko baja laye. Pehlay to har mah mein teen rozon ka hukum tha, phir Ramzan ke rozon ka hukum hua aur agla hukum mansookh hua, is ka mufassal bayan aa raha hai Insha'Allah Ta'ala.

Hazrat Mu'az (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ud (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), 'Ata, Qatadah, Zahhak ka farman hai ke Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ke zamane se har mahine mein teen rozon ka hukum tha jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ummat ke liye badla aur un par is mubarak mahine ke rozay farz hue. Hazrat Hasan Basri farmate hain ke agli ummaton par bhi ek mahina-e-kamil ke rozay farz thay. Ek marfu' hadith mein hai ke Ramadan ke rozay tum se pehle ki ummaton par bhi farz thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke pehli ummaton ko yeh hukum tha ke jab woh Isha ki namaz ada kar lein aur so jayen to un par khana peena auraton se mubashirat karna haram ho jata hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain agle logon se murad Ahl-e-Kitab hain. Phir bayan ho raha hai ke tum mein se jo shakhs mah-e-Ramadan mein bimar ho ya safar mein ho to woh is halat mein rozay chhor de mushaqqat na uthaye aur us ke baad aur dinon mein jabke yeh uzr hat jayen qaza kar lein. Haan ibtida-e-Islam mein jo shakhs tandurust ho aur musafir bhi na ho use bhi ikhtiyar tha khwah roza rakhe khwah na rakhe magar fidyah mein ek maskeen ko khana khila de agar ek se zyada ko khilaye to afzal tha go roza rakhna fidyah dene se zyada behtar tha. Ibn-e-Mas'ud, Ibn-e-Abbas, Mujahid, Ta'us, Muqatil wagairah yahi farmate hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) farmate hain namaz ki aur rozay ki teen halatein badli gayin, pehle to solah satrah mahine tak Madina mein aakar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki taraf namaz ada ki, phir "Qad nara" wali ayat aayi aur Makkah Sharif ki taraf aap ne munh phera.

Doosri tabdeeli yeh hui ke namaz ke liye ek doosre ko pukarta tha aur jama ho jate thay lekin is se aakhir aajiz aa gaye phir ek Ansari Hazrat Abdullah bin Zaid huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur arz ki ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne khwab mein dekha lekin woh khwab goya bedari ki si halat mein tha ke ek shakhs sabz rang ka hulla pehne hue hai aur qibla ki taraf mutawajja ho kar keh raha hai Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar, Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah, dobara yunhi azan poori ki phir thodi der ke baad us ne takbeer kahi jis mein ayat Qad qamatis-salah bhi do martaba kaha. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ko yeh sikhao woh azan kahenge chunancha sab se pehle Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ne azan kahi. Doosri riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne bhi aa kar apna yahi khwab bayan kiya tha. Lekin un se pehle Hazrat Zaid (R.A) aa chuke thay.

Teesri tabdeeli yeh hui ke pehle yeh dastoor tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) namaz padha rahe hain, koi aaya, kuch raka'atein ho chuki hain to woh kisi se daryaft karta ke kitni raka'atein ho chuki hain, woh jawab deta ke itni raka'atein padh li hain, woh itni raka'atein ada karta phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath mil jata. Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ek martaba aaye aur kehne lage ke main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jis haal mein paunga usi mein mil jaunga aur jo namaz chhoot gayi hai use Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke salam pherne ke baad ada karunga. Chunancha unhon ne yahi kiya aur Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke salam pherne ke baad apni rahi hui raka'atein ada karne ke liye khade hue. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein dekh kar farmaya: Mu'az ne tumhare liye yeh achha tareeqa nikala hai, tum bhi ab yunhi kiya karo. Yeh teen tabdeeliyaan to namaz ki huin, rozon ki tabdeeliyaan suniye. Awwal jab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madina mein aaye to har mahine mein teen rozay rakhte thay aur Ashura ka roza rakha karte thay, phir Allah Ta'ala ne aayat (يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَي الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 183) nazil farma kar Ramzan ke rozay farz kiye. Doosra ibtidai yeh hukum tha ke jo chahe roza rakhe jo chahe na rakhe aur fidiya de de, phir yeh aayat (فَمَنْ شَهِدَ مِنْكُمُ الشَّهْرَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 185) tum mein se jo shakhs Ramzan ke mahine mein qayam ki halat mein ho woh roza rakha kare. Pas jo shakhs muqeem ho, musafir na ho, tandurust ho, bimar na ho, us par roza rakhna zaroori ho gaya. Haan, bimar aur musafir ke liye rukhsat mili aur aisa boodha intehai jo rozay ki taqat hi na rakhta ho use bhi rukhsat di gayi.

Teesri halat yeh hai ke ibtida mein khana peena auraton ke paas aana sone se pehle pehle jaiz tha, so gaya toh phir go raat ko hi jaage lekin khana peena aur jama' uske liye mana tha. Phir Sarma nami ek Ansari sahabi din bhar kaam kaaj kar ke raat ko thake haare ghar aaye, Isha ki namaz ada ki aur neend aa gayi. Dusre din kuch khaye piye baghair roza rakha lekin halat bahut nazuk ho gayi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne poocha ke yeh kya baat? Toh unhon ne sara waqia keh diya. Idhar yeh waqia toh unke saath hua, idhar Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne so jaane ke baad apni biwi sahiba se mujamat kar li aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aakar hasrat-o-afsos ke saath apne is qasoor ka iqrar kiya, jis par aayat (اُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَام الرَّفَثُ اِلٰى نِسَاۗىِٕكُمْ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 187) se (ثُمَّ اَتِمُّوا الصِّيَامَ اِلَى الَّيْلِ ۚ وَلَا تُـبَاشِرُوْھُنَّ وَاَنْتُمْ عٰكِفُوْنَ ۙ فِي الْمَسٰجِدِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 187) tak nazil hui aur Maghrib ke baad se le kar subh-e-sadiq ke tuloo hone tak Ramzan ki raaton mein khane peene aur mujamat karne ki rukhsat de di gayi. Bukhari, Muslim mein Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) se marwi hai ke pehle Ashura ka roza rakha jata, jab Ramzan ki farziyat nazil hui toh ab zaroori na raha, jo chahta rakh leta jo na chahta na rakhta, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi hai. Aayat (وَعَلَي الَّذِيْنَ يُطِيْقُوْنَهٗ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِيْنٍ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 184) ka matlab Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) bayan farmate hain ke ibtida-e-Islam mein jo chahta roza rakhta jo chahta na rakhta aur har rozay ke badle ek miskeen ko khana khila deta.

Hazrat Salama bin Akwa R.A se bhi Sahih Bukhari mein ek riwayat aayi hai ke is aayat ke nazil hone ke waqt jo shakhs chahta iftar karta aur fidiya de deta yahan tak ke is ke baad ki aayat utri aur yeh mansookh hui, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar R.A bhi ise mansookh kehte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain yeh mansookh nahin, murad is se boodha mard aur budhiya aurat hai jise rozay ki taqat na ho. Ibn-e-Abi Laila R.H kehte hain, Atta R.H ke paas Ramzan mein gaya, dekha ke woh khana kha rahe hain, mujhe dekh kar farmane lage ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke is aayat ne pehli aayat ka hukm mansookh kar diya, ab yeh hukm sirf bahut zyada be-taqat boodhay baray ke liye hai. Hasil-e-kalam yeh hai ke jo shakhs muqeem ho aur tandurust ho us ke liye yeh hukm nahin balkay use roza hi rakhna hoga. Haan aise boodhay, baray mu'ammar aur kamzor aadmi jinhein rozay ki taqat hi na ho roza na rakhein aur na un par qaza zaroori hai, lekin agar woh maaldar hon to aaya unhein kaffara bhi dena paray ga ya nahin, hamein ikhtilaf hai. Imam Shafi R.H ka ek qaul to yeh hai ke chunke is mein rozay ki taqat nahin lehaza yeh bhi misl bachay ke hai, na is par kaffara hai na is par qaza kyunke Allah Ta'ala kisi ko us ki taqat se zyada takleef nahin deta. Doosra qaul Hazrat Imam Shafi R.H ka yeh hai ke us ke zimma kaffara hai, aksar ulama-e-kiram ka bhi yahi faisla hai.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghera ki tafseeron se bhi yahi sabit hua hai. Imam Bukhari (R.H) ka pasandeeda masla bhi yahi hai. Woh farmate hain ke bahut badi umar wala boodha jise rozay ki taqat na ho toh fidiya de de, jaise Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A) ne apni badi umar mein budhapay ke aakhri dinon mein saal do saal tak roza na rakha aur har rozay ke badlay ek maskeen ko roti gosht khila diya karte. Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la mein hai ke jab Hazrat Anas (R.A) roza rakhne se aajiz ho gaye toh gosht roti tayyar kar ke tees maskeenon ko bula kar khila diya karte. Isi tarah hamal wali aur doodh pilane wali aurat ke baray mein jab unhein apni jaan ka ya apne bachay ki jaan ka khauf ho, ulama mein sakht ikhtilaf hai. Ba'az toh kehte hain ke woh roza na rakhein fidiya de dein aur jab khauf hat jaye qaza bhi kar lein. Ba'az kehte hain sirf fidiya hai qaza na karein, ba'az kehte hain qaza kar lein fidiya nahin aur ba'az ka qaul hai ke na roza rakhein na fidiya na qaza karein. Imam Ibn-e-Kaseer (R.H) ne is maslay ko apni kitab 'As-Siyam' mein tafseel ke sath likha hai, falhamdulillah. (Bazahir yahi baat dalail se zyada qareeb nazar aati hai ke yeh dono aisi halat mein roza rakhein aur baad mein qaza karein, na fidiya dein.)
