Pas jo shakhs muqeem ho, musafir na ho, tandurust ho, bimar na ho, us par roza rakhna zaroori ho gaya. Haan, bimar aur musafir ke liye rukhsat mili aur aisa boodha intehai jo rozay ki taqat hi na rakhta ho use bhi rukhsat di gayi.

Teesri halat yeh hai ke ibtida mein khana peena auraton ke paas aana sone se pehle pehle jaiz tha, so gaya toh phir go raat ko hi jaage lekin khana peena aur jama' uske liye mana tha. Phir Sarma nami ek Ansari sahabi din bhar kaam kaaj kar ke raat ko thake haare ghar aaye, Isha ki namaz ada ki aur neend aa gayi. Dusre din kuch khaye piye baghair roza rakha lekin halat bahut nazuk ho gayi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne poocha ke yeh kya baat? Toh unhon ne sara waqia keh diya. Idhar yeh waqia toh unke saath hua, idhar Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne so jaane ke baad apni biwi sahiba se mujamat kar li aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aakar hasrat-o-afsos ke saath apne is qasoor ka iqrar kiya, jis par aayat (اُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَام الرَّفَثُ اِلٰى نِسَاۗىِٕكُمْ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 187) se (ثُمَّ اَتِمُّوا الصِّيَامَ اِلَى الَّيْلِ ۚ وَلَا تُـبَاشِرُوْھُنَّ وَاَنْتُمْ عٰكِفُوْنَ ۙ فِي الْمَسٰجِدِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 187) tak nazil hui aur Maghrib ke baad se le kar subh-e-sadiq ke tuloo hone tak Ramzan ki raaton mein khane peene aur mujamat karne ki rukhsat de di gayi. Bukhari, Muslim mein Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) se marwi hai ke pehle Ashura ka roza rakha jata, jab Ramzan ki farziyat nazil hui toh ab zaroori na raha, jo chahta rakh leta jo na chahta na rakhta, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi hai. Aayat (وَعَلَي الَّذِيْنَ يُطِيْقُوْنَهٗ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِيْنٍ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 184) ka matlab Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) bayan farmate hain ke ibtida-e-Islam mein jo chahta roza rakhta jo chahta na rakhta aur har rozay ke badle ek miskeen ko khana khila deta.

Hazrat Salama bin Akwa R.A se bhi Sahih Bukhari mein ek riwayat aayi hai ke is aayat ke nazil hone ke waqt jo shakhs chahta iftar karta aur fidiya de deta yahan tak ke is ke baad ki aayat utri aur yeh mansookh hui, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar R.A bhi ise mansookh kehte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain yeh mansookh nahin, murad is se boodha mard aur budhiya aurat hai jise rozay ki taqat na ho. Ibn-e-Abi Laila R.H kehte hain, Atta R.H ke paas Ramzan mein gaya, dekha ke woh khana kha rahe hain, mujhe dekh kar farmane lage ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke is aayat ne pehli aayat ka hukm mansookh kar diya, ab yeh hukm sirf bahut zyada be-taqat boodhay baray ke liye hai. Hasil-e-kalam yeh hai ke jo shakhs muqeem ho aur tandurust ho us ke liye yeh hukm nahin balkay use roza hi rakhna hoga. Haan aise boodhay, baray mu'ammar aur kamzor aadmi jinhein rozay ki taqat hi na ho roza na rakhein aur na un par qaza zaroori hai, lekin agar woh maaldar hon to aaya unhein kaffara bhi dena paray ga ya nahin, hamein ikhtilaf hai. Imam Shafi R.H ka ek qaul to yeh hai ke chunke is mein rozay ki taqat nahin lehaza yeh bhi misl bachay ke hai, na is par kaffara hai na is par qaza kyunke Allah Ta'ala kisi ko us ki taqat se zyada takleef nahin deta. Doosra qaul Hazrat Imam Shafi R.H ka yeh hai ke us ke zimma kaffara hai, aksar ulama-e-kiram ka bhi yahi faisla hai.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghera ki tafseeron se bhi yahi sabit hua hai. Imam Bukhari (R.H) ka pasandeeda masla bhi yahi hai. Woh farmate hain ke bahut badi umar wala boodha jise rozay ki taqat na ho toh fidiya de de, jaise Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A) ne apni badi umar mein budhapay ke aakhri dinon mein saal do saal tak roza na rakha aur har rozay ke badlay ek maskeen ko roti gosht khila diya karte. Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la mein hai ke jab Hazrat Anas (R.A) roza rakhne se aajiz ho gaye toh gosht roti tayyar kar ke tees maskeenon ko bula kar khila diya karte. Isi tarah hamal wali aur doodh pilane wali aurat ke baray mein jab unhein apni jaan ka ya apne bachay ki jaan ka khauf ho, ulama mein sakht ikhtilaf hai. Ba'az toh kehte hain ke woh roza na rakhein fidiya de dein aur jab khauf hat jaye qaza bhi kar lein. Ba'az kehte hain sirf fidiya hai qaza na karein, ba'az kehte hain qaza kar lein fidiya nahin aur ba'az ka qaul hai ke na roza rakhein na fidiya na qaza karein. Imam Ibn-e-Kaseer (R.H) ne is maslay ko apni kitab 'As-Siyam' mein tafseel ke sath likha hai, falhamdulillah. (Bazahir yahi baat dalail se zyada qareeb nazar aati hai ke yeh dono aisi halat mein roza rakhein aur baad mein qaza karein, na fidiya dein.)

Nuzul-e-Quran aur Mah-e-Ramazan

Mah-e-Ramazan Sharif ki fazilat-o-buzurgi ka bayan ho raha hai. Isi mah-e-mubarak mein Quran-e-Karim utra. Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya hai: Ibrahim sahifa Ramazan ki pehli raat utra aur Taurat chhatti tarikh, agle tamam sahife aur Taurat-o-Injeel terhwin tarikh aur Quran chaubiswin tarikh nazil hua. Aik aur riwayat mein hai ke Zabur barhwin ko aur Injeel atharhwin ko, agle tamam sahife aur Taurat-o-Injeel-o-Zabur jis paighambar par utrein aik sath aik hi martaba utrein, lekin Quran-e-Karim Bait-ul-Izzat se aasmani duniya tak to aik hi martaba nazil hua aur phir waqtan-fowaqtan hasb-e-zarurat zameen par nazil hota raha. Yehi matlab ayat (INNA ANZALNAHU FI LAILATIL QADR) [97. Al-Qadr: 1] ayat aur ayat (INNA ANZALNAHU FI LAILATIN MUBARAKATIN INNA KUNNA MUNZIRIN) [44. Ad-Dukhan: 3] aur ayat (UNZILA FIHIL QUR'AN) [2. Al-Baqarah: 185] ka hai.

Matlab yeh hai ke Quran-e-Karim aik sath aasman-e-awwal par Ramazan-ul-Mubarak ke mahine mein Lailatul Qadr ko nazil hua aur isi ko Laila-e-Mubaraka bhi kaha hai. Ibn Abbas R.A waghera se yehi marwi hai. Aap se jab yeh sawal hua ke Quran-e-Karim to mukhtalif mahino mein barson mein utrta raha phir Ramazan mein aur woh bhi Lailatul Qadr mein utarne ke kya mani? To aap ne yehi matlab bayan kiya (Ibn Marduyah waghera). Aap se yeh bhi mروی hai ke aadhe Ramazan mein Quran-e-Karim duniya ke aasman ki taraf utra, Bait-ul-Izzat mein rakha gaya, phir hasb-e-zarurat waqiat aur sawalat par thoda thoda utrta raha aur bees saal mein kamil hua. Is mein bahut si aatein kuffar ke jawab mein bhi utreen. Kuffar ka aik aitraz yeh bhi tha ke yeh Quran-e-Karim aik sath sara kyun nahi utra? Jis ke jawab mein farmaya gaya ayat (LINUSHABBITA BIHI FU'ADAKA WA RATTALNAHU TARTILA) [25. Al-Furqan: 32].

(Surah Al-Furqan: 32) Yeh is liye ke tere dil ko برقرار aur مضبوط rakhein phir Quran-e-Kareem ki taarif mein bayaan ho raha hai ke yeh logon ke dilon ki hidayat hai aur is mein wazeh aur roshan daleelein hain tadabbur aur ghor-o-fikr karne wala is se sahih rah par pahunch sakta hai yeh haq-o-batil haram-o-halal mein farq zahir karne wala hai hidayat-o-gumraahi aur rushd-o-burai mein alag-i-dagi karne wala hai, baaz salaf se manqool hai ke sirf Ramzan kehna makrooh hai Shahr-e-Ramzan yaani Ramzan ka mahina kehna chahiye, Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se marwi hai Ramzan na kaho yeh Allah Ta'ala ka naam hai Shahr-e-Ramzan yaani Ramzan ka mahina kaha karo, Hazrat Mujahid R.H aur Muhammad bin Ka'ab se bhi yehi marwi hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas aur Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit R.A ka mazhab is ke khilaf hai, Ramzan na kehne ke bare mein ek marfoo' hadith bhi hai lekin sanadan woh wahin hai Imam Bukhari ne bhi is ke radd mein baab baandh kar bahut si hadeethein bayaan farwai hain ek mein hai jo shakhs Ramzan ke rozey iman aur naik niyati ke sath rakhe us ke sabab us ke agle gunah bakhsh diye jate hain waghera gharz is ayat se sabit huwa ke jab Ramzan ka chand charhe koi shakhs apne ghar ho, safar mein na ho aur tandrust bhi ho use rozey rakhne lazmi aur zaroori hain, pehle is qism ke logon ko bhi jo rukhsat thi woh uth gayi is ka bayaan farma kar phir bimar aur musafir ke liye rukhsat ka bayaan farmaya ke yeh log roza in dinon mein na rakhein aur phir qaza karlein yaani jis ke badan mein koi takleef ho jis ki wajah se rozey mein mashaqqat pare ya takleef barh jaye ya safar mein ho to iftar karle aur jitne rozey jayen utne din phir qaza karle. Phir irshad hota hai ke in halaton mein rukhsat ata farma kar tumhein mashaqqat se bacha lena yeh sarasar hamari rehmat ka zuhoor hai aur ahkam-e-Islam mein asani hai, ab yahan chand masail bhi suniye 001 salaf ki ek jamat ka khayal hai ke jo shakhs apne ghar mein muqeem ho aur chand charhe Ramzan Shareef ka mahina aajaye phir darmiyan mein use safar darpesh ho to use roza tark karna jaiz nahi kyunke aise logon ko roza rakhne ka saf hukm Quran Pak mein mojood hai, han in logon ko bahalat-e-safar roza chorna jaiz hai jo safar mein hon aur Ramzan ka mahina aajaye, lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai, Abu Muhammad bin Hazm ne apni kitab "Muhalla" mein Sahaba aur Tabieen ki ek jamat ka yehi mazhab naqal kiya hai lekin is mein kalam hai Wallahu A'lam. Nabi ﷺ Ramzan-ul-Mubarak mein Fath Makkah ke ghazwa ke liye nikle rozey se thay "Kadeed" mein pahunch kar roza iftar kiya aur logon ko bhi hukm diya ke roza tor dein (Mutفق alaih) 002 Sahaba Rahimahumullah Tabieen ki ek aur jamat ne kaha ke safar mein roza tor dena wajib hai kyunke Quran Kareem mein hai ayat (Fa 'iddatun min ayyamin ukhar) (2. Al-Baqarah: 185)

Lekin sahi qaul jo jumhoor ka mazhab hai yeh hai ke aadmi ko ikhtiyar hai khwah rakhe khwah na rakhe is liye ke mah-e-Ramzan mein log Janab Rasool Allah ﷺ ke sath nikalte thay ba'iz rozay se hote thay ba'iz rozay se nahi hote thay pas rozay-dar be-roza par aur be-roza-dar roza-dar par koi aib nahi pakrata tha agar iftar wajib hota to roza rakhne walon par inkar kiya jata, balki khud Nabi ﷺ se bi-halat-e-safar roza rakhna sabit hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Hazrat Abu Darda ؓ farmate hain Ramzan-ul-Mubarak ke sakht garmi ke mausam mein hum Nabi ﷺ ke sath ek safar mein thay garmi ki shiddat ki wajah se sar par hath rakhe rakhe phir rahe thay hum mein se koi bhi rozay se na tha siwaye Rasool Allah ﷺ aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawahah ke. 003 Teesra masla. Ek jamalat ulama ka khayal hai jin mein Hazrat Imam Shafi'i ؒ bhi hain ke safar mein roza rakhna na rakhne se afzal hai kyunke Huzoor ﷺ se bi-halat-e-safar ro

Chautha masala: Aya qaza rozon mein pe dar pe roze rakhne zaroori hain ya juda juda bhi rakh liye jaayen toh haraj nahin? Ek mazhab baaz logon ka yeh hai ke qaza ko misl-e-ada ke poora karna chahiye, ek ke peeche ek yunhi lagataar roze rakhne chahiyein dusra yeh ke pe dar pe rakhna wajib nahin khwah alag alag rakhe khwah ek sath ikhtiyar hai, jamhoor salaf o khalaf ka yahi qoul hai aur dalail se suboot bhi usi ka hai, Ramadan mein pe dar pe roze rakhna is liye hain ke woh mahina hi adaigi-e-roza ka hai aur Ramadan ke nikal jaane ke baad toh sirf woh ginti poori karni hai khwah koi din ho, isi liye qaza ke hukm ke baad Allah ki asani ki nemat ka bayan hua hai.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya behtar deen wahi hai jo asani wala ho, behtar deen wahi hai jo asani wala ho. Musnad hi mein ek aur hadith mein hai, Urwah kehte hain ke hum ek martaba Rasulullah ﷺ ka intezar kar rahe the ke aap tashreef laye sar se pani ke qatre tapak rahe the maloom hota tha ke wuzu ya ghusal kar ke tashreef la rahe hain jab namaz se farigh hue toh logon ne aap ﷺ se sawalat karne shuru kar diye ke Huzoor ﷺ kya falan kaam mein koi haraj hai? Falan kaam mein koi haraj hai? Aakhir mein Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya Allah ka deen asaniyon wala hai teen martaba yahi farmaya.

Musnad hi ki ek aur hadith mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain logon asani karo sakhti na karo taskeen do nafrat na dulao. Bukhari o Muslim ki hadith mein bhi hai Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hazrat Mu'az aur Hazrat Abu Musa ko jab Yaman ki taraf bheja toh farmaya tum dono khushkhabriyaan dena, nafrat na dilana, asaniyaan karna sakhtiyan na karna, aapas mein ittefaq se rehna ikhtilaf na karna. Sunan aur masaneed mein hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya main yak-tarfa narmi aur asani wale deen ke sath bheja gaya hoon.

Muhajin bin Adra' R.H farmate hain ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek shakhs ko namaz padhte hue dekha ghaur se aap use dekhte rahe phir farmaya kya tum ise sachai ke sath namaz padhte hue dekh rahe ho? Logon ne kaha Ya Rasulullah ﷺ yeh tamam Ahl-e-Madina se zyada namaz padhne wala hai, aap ﷺ ne farmaya ise na sunao kahin yeh is ki halakat ka bais na ho, suno Allah Ta'ala ka irada is ummat ke sath asani ka hai sakhti ka nahi.

Pas ayat ka matlab yeh hua ke mareez aur musafir waghera ko yeh rukhsat dena aur unhein mazoor janna is liye hai ke Allah Ta'ala ka irada asani ka hai sakhti ka nahi, aur qaza ka hukm ginti ke poora karne ke liye hai aur is rehmat, nemat, hidayat aur ibadat par tumhein Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ki badai aur zikr karna chahiye jaise aur jagah Hajj ke mauqe par farmaya ayat: Fa iza qazaytum manasikakum fazkurullaha kazikrikum abaakum aw ashadda zikra (2:200).

(Surah Al-Baqarah: 200) Yaani jab ahkam-e-hajj ada kar chuko toh Allah ka zikr karo aur jagah jum'ah jum'ah ki namaz ki adayegi ke baad farmaya ke jab namaz poori ho jaye toh zameen mein phail jao aur rizq talash karo aur Allah ka zikr zyada karo taake tumhein fلاح (falah) miley, aur jagah farmaya ayat (Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wa kun minas-sajidin) (15. Al-Hijr: 98) yaani sooraj ke nikalne se pehle, sooraj ke doobne se pehle, raat ko aur sajdon ke baad Allah Ta'ala ki tasbeeh bayan kiya karo, isi liye masnoon tareeqa yeh hai ke har farz namaz ke baad Allah Ta'ala ki hamd, tasbeeh aur takbeer parhni chahiye. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se riwayat hai ke hum Rasool Allah ﷺ ka namaz se farigh hona sirf Allahu Akbar ki awazon se jaante thay. Yeh ayat daleel hai is amr ki ke Eid-ul-Fitr mein bhi takbeerien parhni chahiyein. Dawood bin Ali Asbahani Zahiri ka mazhab hai ke is eid mein takbeeron ka kehna wajib hai kyunke is mein sigha amr ka hai "Wal tukbiro-llah" aur is ke bilkul barkhilaf Hanafi mazhab hai, woh kehte hain ke is eid mein takbeerien parhna masnoon nahi, baqi buzrugan-e-deen isay mustahab batate hain go baaz tafseelon mein qadray ikhtilaf hai. Phir farmaya taake tum shukr karo yaani Allah Ta'ala ke ahkam baja la kar, is ke faraiz ko ada kar ke, is ke haram kardah kamon se bach kar, is ki hudood ki hifazat kar ke tum shukr guzar bande ban jao.

Dua aur Allah Mujeeb-ud-Da'wat. Ek A'rabi ne poocha tha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Kya hamara Rab qareeb hai? Agar qareeb ho toh hum us se sargoshiyan kar lein ya door hai? Agar door ho toh hum oonchi oonchi aawazon se usey pukarein, Nabi (ﷺ) khamosh rahe is par yeh aayat utri (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Sahaba (R.A) ke is sawal par ke hamara Rab kahan hai? Yeh aayat utri (Ibn-e-Jareer). Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain ke jab aayat (Rabbukumud'oonee astajib lakum) (40. Ghafir: 60) nazil hui yani mujhe pukaro main tumhari duayein qabool karta rahunga toh logon ne poocha ke dua kis waqt karni chahiye? Is par yeh aayat utri (Ibn-e-Jureij). Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) ka bayan hai ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke sath ek ghazwa mein thay har bulandi par charhte waqt aur har wadi mein utarte waqt buland aawazon se takbeer kehte ja rahe thay, Nabi (ﷺ) hamare paas aakar farmane lage logo! Apni jaanon par reham karo tum kisi kam sunne wale ya door wale ko nahin pukare rahe balkay jise tum pukarte ho woh tum se tumhari sawariyon ki gardan se bhi zyada qareeb hai, ae Abdullah bin Qais! Sun lo!

Jannat ka khazana La-hawla wala quwwata illa billah hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala farmata hai mera banda mere sath jaisa aqeeda rakhta hai main bhi uske sath waisa hi bartao karta hoon jab bhi woh mujhse dua mangta hai main uske qareeb hi hota hoon (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke mera banda jab mujhe yaad karta hai aur uske hont mere zikr mein hilte hain main uske qareeb hota hoon isko Imam Ahmad ne riwayat kiya hai. Is mazmoon ki aayat-e-Kalam-e-Pak mein bhi hai farman hai aayat (Innal-laha ma'allazina-ttaqaw wallazina hum muhsinun) (16. An-Nahl: 128) jo taqwa-o-ehsan-o-khuloos wale log hon unke sath Allah Ta'ala hota hai, Hazrat Musa aur Haroon (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) se farmaya jata hai aayat (Innani ma'akuma asma'u wa ara) (20. Taha: 46).

(Ta-Ha: 46) Mein tum dono ke sath hoon aur dekh raha hoon, maqsood yeh hai ke Bari Ta'ala dua karne walon ki dua ko zaya nahin karta na aisa hota hai ke woh is dua se ghafil rahe ya na sune. Usne dua karne ki dawat di hai aur iske zaya na hone ka wada kiya hai. Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) farmate hain Nabi Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya banda jab Allah Ta'ala ke samne hath buland kar ke dua mangta hai to woh Arham-ur-Rahimeen uske hathon ko khali pherte hue sharmata hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke jo banda Allah Ta'ala se koi aisi dua karta hai jis mein na gunah ho na rishte nate toot-te hon to use Allah teen baton mein se ek zaroor ata farmata hai; ya to uski dua isi waqt qabool farma kar uski munh mangi murad poori karta hai, ya use zakhira kar ke rakh chorta hai aur Aakhirat mein ata farmata hai, ya uski wajah se koi aane wali bala aur museebat ko taal deta hai. Logon ne yeh sun kar kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) phir to hum bakasrat dua manga karenge, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir Allah ke han kya kami hai?

(Musnad-e-Ahmad) Ubadah bin Samit (R.A) farmate hain ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke roo-e-zameen ka jo musalman Allah Azzawajal se dua mange use Allah Ta'ala qabool farmata hai ya to use uski munh mangi murad milti hai ya waisi hi burai talti hai jab tak ke gunah ki aur rishtadari ke katne ki dua na ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad) Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jab tak koi shakhs dua mein jaldi na kare uski dua zaroor qabool hoti hai jaldi karna yeh ke kehne lage main ne to harchand dua mangi lekin Allah qabool nahin karta (Muwatta Imam Malik) Bukhari ki riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke use sawab mein jannat ata farmata hai, Sahih Muslim mein yeh bhi hai ke namaqbooliyat ka khayal kar ke woh na-umeedi ke sath dua mangna tark kar de yeh jaldi karna hai, Abu Jafar Tabari ki tafsir mein yeh qaul Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka bayan kiya gaya hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai ke dil misl bartanon ke hain ba'az ba'az se zyada nigrani karne wale hote hain, ae logon tum jab Allah Ta'ala se dua manga karo to qabooliyat ka yaqeen rakha karo, suno ghaflat wale dil ki dua Allah Ta'ala ek martaba bhi qabool nahin farmata (Musnad-e-Ahmad) Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ayat ke bare mein sawal kiya to aap ne dua ki ke Ilah-ul-Alameen! Ayesha ke is sawal ka kya jawab hai?

Jibraeel (A.S) aaye aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala aap ko salam kehta hai aur farmata hai murad is se woh shakhs hai jo nek a'amal karne wala ho aur sachi niyat aur nek dili ke sath mujhe pukare to main labbaik keh kar us ki haajat zaroor poori kar deta hoon (Ibn Marduyah). Yeh hadith asnaad ki roo se ghareeb hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki phir farmaya: Ae Allah! Tu ne dua ka hukum diya hai aur ijaabat ka wada farmaya hai, main hazir hoon Ilahi, main hazir hoon Ilahi, main hazir hoon, main hazir hoon. Ae La-shareek Allah! Main hazir hoon, hamd-o-ni'amat aur mulk tere hi liye hai, tera koi shareek nahin. Meri gawahi hai ke tu nirala, yakta, bemisal aur ek hi hai. Tu paak hai, biwi bachon se door hai, tera hum-palla koi nahin, teri kufu ka koi nahin, tujh jaisa koi nahin. Meri gawahi ke tera wada sacha, teri mulaqat haq, jannat-o-dozakh, qayamat aur dobara jeena yeh sab bar-haq amr hain (Ibn Marduyah). Hazrat Anas (R.A) se riwayat hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka irshad hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Ek cheez to teri hai, ek meri hai aur ek mujh aur tujh mein mushtarak hai. Khalis mera haq to yeh hai ke tu ek meri hi ibadat kare aur mere sath kisi ko shareek na kare. Goya mere liye makhsoos yeh hai ke tere har har a'amal ka poora poora badla main tujhe zaroor doon ga, kisi neki ko zaya na karoon ga. Mushtarak cheez yeh hai ke tu dua kar aur main qabool karoon, tera kaam dua karna aur mera kaam qabool karna (Bazzar). Dua ki is aayat ko rozon ke ahkaam ki aayaton ke darmiyan warid karne ki hikmat yeh hai ke rozay khatam hone ke baad logon ko dua ki targheeb ho, balkay roza iftar ke waqt woh bakasrat duayein kiya karein.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke rozay-dar iftar ke waqt jo dua karta hai Allah Ta'ala usay qabool farmata hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) iftar ke waqt apne ghar walon ko aur bachon ko sab ko bula letay aur duayein kiya karte thay (Abu Dawood Tayalisi). Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh riwayat hai aur is mein sahabi ki yeh dua manqool hai: Dua "Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-rahmatikal-lati wasi'at kulla shai'in an taghfira li" yani ae Allah! Main teri us rahmat ko tujhe yaad dila kar jis ne tamam cheezon ko gher rakha hai, tujh se sawal karta hoon ke tu mere gunah maaf farma de. Aur hadith mein hai ke teen shakhson ki dua rad nahin hoti: Aadil badshah, rozay-dar aur mazloom. Isay Qayamat walay din Allah Ta'ala buland karega. Mazloom ki bad-dua ke liye aasman ke darwazay khul jatay hain aur Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mujhe meri izzat ki qasam! Main teri madad zaroor karunga go der se karoon (Musnad, Tirmidhi, Nasai aur Ibn-e-Majah).

Ramzan mein mara'at aur kuch pabandiyan:

Ibtida-e-Islam mein yeh hukm tha ke iftar ke baad khana peena, jama' karna 'Asha ki namaz tak jaiz tha aur agar koi is se bhi pehle so gaya toh us par neend aate hi haram ho gaya, is mein Sahaba (R.A) ko qadray mashaqqat hui jis se yeh ruk

Jama'

(Musnad Ahmad) Yeh bhi hadith se sabit hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne iska naam ghiza-e-mubarak rakha hai, Musnad Ahmad wagheira ki hadith mein hai Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ farmate hain ke hum ne Huzoor ﷺ ke sath sehri khayi aise waqt ke goya suraj tuloo hone wala hi tha lekin is mein ek rawi Asim bin Abu Najood munfarid hain aur murad is se din ki nazdiki hai jaise farman-e-Bari Ta'ala Fa-iza balaghna ajalahunna, ilakh ya'ani jab woh auratein apne waqtoun ko pahunch jayein murad yeh hai ke jab iddat ka zamana khatam hojane ke qareeb ho yahi murad yahan is hadith se bhi hai ke unhoun ne sehri khayi aur subh-e-sadiq hojane ka yaqeen na tha balke aisa waqt tha ke koi kehta tha ho gayi koi kehta tha nahi hui ke aksar Ashab-e-Rasool Allah ka dair se sehri khana aur aakhri waqt tak khatay rehna sabit hai jaise Hazrat Abu Bakar, Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Ali, Ibn Masood, Hazrat Huzaifa, Hazrat Abu Hurairah, Hazrat Ibn Umar, Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit ؓ ajmaeen aur tabi'in ki bhi ek bohat badi jama'at se subh-e-sadiq tuloo hone ke bilkul qareeb tak hi sehri khana marwi hai, jaise Muhammad bin Ali bin Hussain, Abu Majlaz, Ibrahim Nakh'i, Abu Al-Zuha, Abu Wail wagheira, shagirdan-e-Ibn Masood, Ata, Hasan, Hakam bin Uyainah, Mujahid, Urwah bin Zubair, Abu Al-Sha'sa, Jabir bin Ziyad, A'mash aur Jabir bin Rushd ka Allah Ta'ala un sab par apni rehmatein nazil farmaye hum ne un sab ki asnadein apni mustaqil kitab Kitab us-Siyam mein bayan kar di hain wa lillahil-hamd. Ibn Jarir ne apni tafsir mein ba'az logon se yeh bhi naqal kiya hai ke suraj ke tuloo hone tak khana peena jaise ghuroob hote hi iftar karna, lekin yeh قول koi ahl-e-ilm qabul nahi kar sakta kyunke nas-e-Quran ke khilaf hai Quran mein khait ka lafz mojood hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya Hazrat Bilal ؓ ki azan sun kar tum sehri se na ruk jaya karo woh raat baqi hoti hai azan de diya karte hain tum khatay peete raho jab tak Hazrat Abdullah bin Umm Maktum ؓ ki azan na sun lo woh azan nahi kehte jab tak fajr tuloo na ho jaye. Musnad Ahmad mein hadith hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke woh fajr nahi jo aasman ke kinaron mein lambi phailti hai balke woh hai jo surkhi wali aur kinare kinare zahir hone wali hoti hai Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh riwayat hai is mein hai ke is pehli fajr ko jo tuloo ho kar oopar ko chadhti hai dekh kar khane peene se na ruko balke khatay peete raho yahan tak ke surkh dhari paish ho jaye, ek aur hadith mein subh-e-kazib aur azan-e-Bilal ko ek sath bhi bayan farmaya hai ek aur riwayat mein subh-e-kazib ko subh ki safedi ke satoon ki manind bataya hai, doosri riwayat mein is pehli azan ko jis ke mo'azzin Hazrat Bilal ؓ thay yeh wajah bayan ki hai ke woh soton ko jagane aur namaz-e-tahajjud padhne walon aur qaza lotane ke liye hoti, fajr is tarah nahi hai jab tak is tarah na ho (ya'ani aasman mein oonchi chadhne wali nahi balke kinaron mein dhari ki tarah zahir hone wali).

Ek Mursal hadith mein hai ke fajr do hain ek toh bheriye ki dum ki tarah hai is par rozay-dar par koi cheez haram nahi hoti haan woh fajr jo kinaron mein zahir ho woh subh ki namaz aur rozay-dar ka khana mauquf karne ka waqt hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain jo safedi asman ke neeche se upar ko chadhti hai usay namaz ki hillat aur rozay ki hurmat se koi sarokar nahi lekin fajr jo paharon ki chotiyon par chamakne lagti hai woh khana peena haram karti hai. Hazrat Ata se marwi hai ke asman mein lambi lambi chadne wali roshni na toh roza rakhne wale par khana peena haram karti hai na is se namaz ka waqt aya hua maloom ho sakta hai na haj faut hota hai lekin jo subh paharon ki chotiyon par phail jati hai yeh woh subh hai jo rozay-dar ke liye sab cheezein haram kar deti hai aur namazi ko namaz halal kar deti hai aur haj faut ho jata hai. In donon riwayaton ki sanad sahih hai aur bohat se salaf se manqool hai. Allah Ta'ala un par apni rahmaten nazil farmaye. 

Masla: Chonke jima ka aur khana peena ka akhri waqt Allah Ta'ala ne roza rakhne wale ke liye subh-e-sadiq ka muqarrar kiya hai is se is masle par bhi istadlal ho sakta hai ke subh ke waqt jo shakhs junubi utha woh ghusal kar le aur apna roza poora kar le is par koi haraj nahi. Charon imamon aur salaf-o-khalaf ke jamoor ulama-e-kiram ka yahi mazhab hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Aisha aur Hazrat Umm-e-Salma R.A se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah ﷺ raat ko jima karte subh ke waqt junubi uthte phir ghusal kar ke roza rakhte. Aap ka yeh junubi hona ihtilam ke sabab na hota tha. Hazrat Umm-e-Salma wali riwayat mein hai phir aap na iftar karte thay na qaza karte thay. 

Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Hazrat Aisha R.A se riwayat mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ! Main subh namaz ka waqt aa jane tak junubi hota hoon toh phir kya main roza rakh loon? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yahi baat mere sath bhi hoti hai aur main roza rakhta hoon. Us ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ hum toh aap jaise nahi, Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke toh sab agle pichle gunah maaf farma diye hain. Aap ne farmaya Wallah mujhe toh umeed hai ke tum sab se zyada Allah Ta'ala se darne wala aur tum sab se zyada taqwa ki baaton ko janne wala main hoon. 

Musnad Ahmad ki ek hadith mein hai ke jab subh ki azan ho jaye aur tum mein se koi junubi ho toh woh us din roza na rakhe. Is ki isnad bohat umdah hai aur yeh hadith shart-e-shaikhain par hai. Jaise ke zahir hai yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se marwi hai, woh Fazal bin Abbas se riwayat karte hain woh Nabi ﷺ se. Sunan Nisai mein yeh hadith bi-riwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A, Salim, Ata, Hisham bin Urwah aur Hasan Basri Rahimahumullah bhi yahi kehte hain.

Ba'z log kehte hain ki agar junubi ho kar so gaya ho aur aankh khule to subh-e-sadiq ho gayi ho toh uske roze mein koi nuqsan nahi. Hazrat Aisha aur Hazrat Umm-e-Salamah wali hadith ka yahi matlab hai aur agar usne amdan ghusal nahi kiya aur usi halat mein subh-e-sadiq ho gayi toh uska roza nahi hoga. Hazrat Urwah, Tawus aur Hasan yahi kehte hain. Ba'z kehte hain agar farzi roza ho toh pura toh kar le lekin qaza lazim hai aur nafli roza ho toh koi haraj nahi, Ibrahim Nakh'i yahi kehte hain, Khwaja Hasan Basri se bhi ek riwayat hai. Ba'z kehte hain Hazrat Abu Hurairah wali hadith Hazrat Aisha wali hadith se mansukh hai lekin haqeeqat mein tarikh ka pata nahi jis se nakh sabit ho sake. Ibn Hazm farmate hain iski nasikh yeh ayat-e-qurani hai lekin yeh bhi door ki baat hai isliye ki is ayat ka baad mein hona tarikh se sabit nahi balki is haisiyat se toh bazahir yeh hadith is ayat ke baad ki hai. Ba'z log kehte hain Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A wali hadith mein la-kamal nafi ka hai yaani us shakhs ka roza kamil nahi kyunki Hazrat Aisha R.A aur Hazrat Umm-e-Salamah wali hadith se jawaz saf taur se sabit ho raha hai. Yahi maslak theek bhi hai aur dusre tamam aqwal se yeh qaul umdah hai aur yun kehne se dono riwayaton mein tatbeeq ki surat bhi nikal aati hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Phir farmata hai ke rozay ko raat tak poora karo, is se sabit hua ke suraj ke doobtay hi roza iftar kar lena chahiye. Bukhari Muslim mein Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya jab idhar se raat aa jaye aur idhar se din chala jaye to rozay daar iftar kar le. Bukhari Muslim mein Hazrat Sahl bin Saad Sa'idi (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya jab tak log iftar karne mein jaldi karenge khair se rahenge. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka irshad hai ke mujhe sab se zyada pyaray woh banday hain jo roza iftar karne mein jaldi karne walay hain. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) is hadith ko Hasan Ghareeb kehte hain. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke Bushra bin Khasasiyah ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Laila farmati hain ke main ne do rozon ko baghair iftar kiye milana chaha to mere khawand ne mujhe mana kiya aur kaha Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne is se mana kiya hai aur farmaya hai ke yeh kaam Nasraniyon ka hai, tum to rozay is tarah rakho jis tarah Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke raat ko roza iftar kar liya karo. Aur bhi bohat si ahadith rozay se rozay ko milanay ki muman'at mein aayi hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya rozay se roza na milao, to logon ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aap khud to milatay hain! Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya main tum jaisa nahin hoon, main raat guzarta hoon, mera Rab mujhe khila pila deta hai. Lekin log phir bhi is se baaz na rahay to aap ne do din do raaton ka barabar roza rakha, phir chand dikhayi diya to aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya agar chand na charhta to main yunhi rozon ko milaye jata, goya aap (ﷺ) apni aajizi zahir karna chahtay thay. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur isi tarah rozay ke be-iftar kiye aur raat ko kuch khaye baghair dusray rozay se mila lene ki muman'at mein Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Anas, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar aur Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se bhi marfoo ahadith marwi hain. Pas sabit hua ke ummat ko to mana kiya gaya hai lekin aap ki zaat is se mustasna thi, aap ko is ki taqat thi aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se aap ki madad ki jati thi. Yeh bhi khayal rahe ke "mujhe mera Rab khila pila deta hai" is se murad haqeeqatan khana peena nahin kyunke phir to rozay se rozay ka wisal na hua, balkay yeh sirf roohani tor par madad hai, jaise ke ek Arabi shair ka sher hai: "Laha ahadeesun min zikrika tashghaluha, anish-sharabi wa tulheeha aniz-zaadi" yani usay tere zikr aur teri baaton mein woh dilchaspi hai ke khane peene se yak-qalam be-parwah ho jati hai. Haan agar koi shakhs dusri sehri tak ruk rehna chahe to yeh jaiz hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) wali hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya rozay ko rozay se mat milao, jo milna hi chahe to sehri tak mila le, logon ne kaha ke aap to mila dete hain.

Aap ﷺ ne farmaya main tum jaisa nahin, mujhe toh raat hi ko khilane wala khila deta hai aur pilane wala pila deta hai (Bukhari, Muslim). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke ek Sahabiya aurat Nabi ﷺ ke paas aayi, aap sehri kha rahe thay, farmaya aao tum bhi kha lo, usne kaha main toh rozay se hoon, aap ne farmaya tum roza kis tarah rakhti ho? Usne bayan kiya. Toh aap ne farmaya Aal-e-Muhammad ﷺ ki tarah sehri ke waqt se dusri sehri ke waqt tak ka mila hua roza kyun nahin rakhtin? (Ibn-e-Jarir). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Nabi ﷺ ek sehri se dusri sehri tak ka roza rakhte thay. Ibn-e-Jarir mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair R.A waghera salaf-e-saliheen se marwi hai ke woh kayi kayi din tak pay-dar-pay baghair kuch khaye roza rakhte thay, baaz log kehte hain ke yeh ibadat ke taur par na tha balkay nafs ko maarne ke liye riyazat ke taur par tha, Wallahu A'lam. Aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke unhon ne samjha ho ke Huzoor ﷺ ka is se rokna sirf shafqat aur meharbani ke taur par tha, na ke na-jaiz batane ke taur par, jaise ke Hazrat Ayesha R.A farmati hain aap ne logon par reham kha kar is se mana farmaya tha. Pas Ibn-e-Zubair aur un ke sahibzaday Aamir aur un ki raah chalne wale apne nafs mein quwwat paate thay aur rozay par roza rakhe jaate thay. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke jab woh iftar karte toh pehle ghee aur kadwa gond khate taake pehle ghiza pahunchne se aantain jal na jayain. Marwi hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair R.A saat saat din tak barabar rozay se rehte, is asna mein din ko ya raat ko kuch na khate aur phir saatwein din khoob tandurust, chust-o-chalak aur sab se zyada qawi paye jaate. Abu Al-Aliyah farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne din ka roza farz kar diya, rahi raat toh jo chahe khaye jo na chahe na khaye. Phir farman hota hai ke aitikaf ki halat mein aurton se mubashirat na karo. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka qaul hai jo shakhs masjid mein aitikaf mein baitha ho khwah Ramzan mein khwah aur mahinon mein, us par din ke waqt ya raat ke waqt apni biwi se jama karna haram hai jab tak aitikaf pura na ho jaye. Hazrat Zahhak farmate hain pehle log aitikaf ki halat mein bhi jama kar liya karte thay jis par yeh aayat utri aur masjid mein aitikaf kiye huye par jama haram kiya gaya. Mujahid aur Qatadah bhi yahi kehte hain. Pas ulama-e-kiram ka muttafiqa fatwa hai ke aitikaf wala agar kisi zaroori haajat ke liye ghar mein jaye maslan peshab pakhana ke liye ya khana khane ke liye, toh is kaam se farigh hote hi masjid mein chala aaye, wahan theharna jaiz nahin, na apni biwi se bos-o-kinar waghera jaiz hai, na kisi aur kaam mein siwaye aitikaf ke mashghool hona us ke liye jaiz hai, balkay bimar ki bimar pursi ke liye bhi jana jaiz nahin, haan yeh aur baat hai ke chalte chalte pooch le. Aitikaf ke aur bhi bohat se ahkaam hain, baaz mein ikhtilaf bhi hai jin sab ko hum ne apni mustaqil kitab Kitab-us-Siyam ke aakhir mein bayan kiye hain, Walillahil Hamd wal Minnah.

Chunki Quran-e-Pak mein rozay ke bayan ke baad aitikaf ka zikr hai is liye aksar musannifeen ne bhi apni apni kitabon mein rozay ke baad hi aitikaf ke ahkaam bayan kiye hain. Is mein is baat ki taraf bhi ishara hai ke aitikaf rozay ki halat mein karna chahiye ya Ramzan ke aakhir mein. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi Ramzan Sharif ke aakhri dinon mein aitikaf kiya karte thay yahan tak ke aap ko wafat aayi. Aap ke baad Ummahat-ul-Momineen aap ki biwiyan aitikaf kiya karti thin (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Safiya bint-e-Huyay Nabi Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein aap ki aitikaf ki halat mein hazir hoti thin aur koi zaroori baat poochne ki hoti to woh daryaft kar ke chali jati. Ek martaba raat ko jab jaane lagin to chunki makan Masjid-e-Nabwi se faslay par tha is liye Huzoor saath ho liye ke pahuncha aayen. Raste mein do Ansari Sahabi mil gaye aur aap ke saath aap ki biwi sahiba ko dekh kar sharm ke maaray jaldi jaldi qadam barha kar jaane lage. Aap ne farmaya thehar jao suno yeh meri biwi Safiya hain. Woh kehne lage SubhanAllah! (kya hamain koi aur khayal bhi ho sakta hai?) Aap ne farmaya shaitan insaan ki rag rag mein khoon ki tarah phirta rehta hai mujhe khayal hua ke kahin tumhare dilon mein koi badgumani na paida kar de. Hazrat Imam Shafi (R.H) farmate hain ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne is waqiye se apni ummat ko goya sabaq sikha rahe hain ke woh tohmat ki jaghon se bachte rahein warna namumkin hai ke woh pakbaz Sahaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nisbat koi bura khayal bhi dil mein layein aur yeh bhi namumkin hai ke aap un ki nisbat yeh khayal farmayein, Wallahu A'lam. Aayat mein murad mubashirat se jima aur us ke asbab hain jaise bos-o-kinar waghera warna kisi cheez ka lena dena waghera yeh sab baatein jaiz hain. Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aitikaf ki halat mein meri taraf jhuka diya karte thay main aap ke sar mein kanghi kar diya karti thi halankeh main haiz se hoti thi. Aap aitikaf ke dinon mein zaroori haajat ke rafa ke siwa aur waqt ghar mein tashreef nahin late thay. Hazrat Ayesha farmati hain aitikaf ki halat mein to chalte chalte hi ghar ke bimar ki bimar pursi kar liya karti hoon.

Phir farmata hai ke yeh hamari bayan karda baatein aur farz kiye hue ahkaam aur muqarrar ki hui hadein hain, rozay aur rozon ke ahkaam aur us ke masail aur us mein jo kaam jaiz hain ya jo najaiz hain, garz woh sab hamari had-bandiyan hain. Khabardar! In ke qareeb bhi na aana, na in se tajawuz karna, na in ke aagay barhna. Baaz kehte hain yeh had aitikaf ki halat mein mubashirat se alag rehna hai. Baaz kehte hain in aayaton ke charon hukum murad hain. Phir farmaya jis tarah rozay aur us ke ahkaam aur us ke masail aur us ki tafseel hum ne bayan kar di, isi tarah aur ahkaam bhi hum apne banday aur Rasool (ﷺ) ki marifat sab ke sab tamam jahan ke liye bayan kiya karte hain taake woh yeh maloom kar sakein ke hidayat kya hai aur itaat kisay kehte hain? Aur is bina par woh muttaqi ban jayein. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Huwal-lazi yunazzilu 'ala 'abdihi aayatin bayyinatin liyukhrijakum minaz-zulumati ilan-noor, wa innallaha bikum la-ra'ufur-raheem) (Surah Al-Hadid: 9). Woh Allah jo apne banday par roshan aayatein nazil farmata hai taake tumhein andheron se nikal kar roshni mein laye, Allah Ta'ala tum par rafat-o-rahmat karne wala hai.

Munsif, insaaf aur mudda'i. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh aayat us shakhs ke baare mein hai jis par kisi aur ka maal chahiye aur us haqdaar ke paas koi daleel na ho to yeh shakhs ka inkaar kar jaye aur haakim ke paas jaakar bari ho jaye halankeh woh jaanta ho ke is par is ka haq hai, woh is ka maal maar raha hai aur haraam kha raha hai aur apne tayin gunahgaron mein kar raha hai. Hazrat Mujahid, Saeed bin Jubair, Ikrimah, Mujahid, Hasan, Qatadah, Suddi, Muqatil bin Hayyan, Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid Aslam bhi yahi farmate hain ke bawajood is ilm ke ke tu zaalim hai jhagda na kar. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Umme-Salmah (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Main insaan hoon, mere paas log jhagda le kar aate hain, shayad ek doosre se zyada hujjat-baaz ho aur main us ki chikni chupri taqreer sun kar us ke haq mein faisla kar doon (halankeh darhaqeeqat mera faisla waqia ke khilaf ho) to samajh lo ke jis ke haq mein is tarah ke faisla se kisi musalman ke haq ko main dilwa doon woh aag ka ek tukda hai, khwah utha le khwah na uthaye. Main kehta hoon yeh aayat aur hadees is amr par daleel hai ke haakim ka hukm kisi mamla ki haqeeqat ko shariat ke nazdeek badalta nahin. Fi-alwaqia bhi nafs-ul-amr ke mutabiq ho to khair, warna haakim ko to ajr milega, lekin is faisla ki bina par haq ko na-haq ko haq lene wala Allah ka mujrim thehrega aur is par wabaal baqi rahega, jis par aayat-e-mandarja-bala gawah hai, ke tum apne da'we ko baatil hone ka ilm rakhte hue logon ke maal maar khane ke liye jhoote muqadmaat bana kar, jhoote gawah guzar kar, na-jaiz tareeqon se hukaam ko ghalti khila kar apne da'won ko saabit na kiya karo. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain: Logo! Samajh lo ke qazi ka faisla tere liye haraam ko halaal nahin kar sakta aur na baatil ko haq kar sakta hai. Qazi to apni aql-o-samajh se gawahon ki gawahi ke mutabiq zahiri halaat ko dekhte hue faisla saadir kar deta hai aur woh bhi aakhir insaan hai, mumkin hai khata kare aur mumkin hai khata se bach jaye, to jaan lo ke agar faisla qazi ka waqia ke khilaf ho to tum sirf qazi ka faisla use jaiz maal na samajh lo, yeh jhagda baqi hi hai yahan tak qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala donon ko jama kare aur baatil walon par haq walon ko ghalba de kar un ka haq un se dilwaye aur duniya mein jo faisla hua tha us ke khilaf faisla saadir farma kar us ki nekiyon mein use badla dilwaye.

Chand aur mah-o-saal. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se logon ne chand ke bare mein sawal kiya jis par yeh aayat nazil hui ke is se qarz waghera ke wadon ki mi'aad maloom ho jati hai, auraton ki iddat ka waqt maloom hota hai, hajj ka waqt maloom hota hai, musalmanon ke rozay ke iftar ka talluq bhi isi se hai. Musnad-e-Abdur Razzaq mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne chand ko logon ke waqt maloom karne ke liye banaya hai, ise dekh kar rozay rakho, ise dekh kar eid manao, agar abr-o-baran ki wajah se chand na dekh sako to tees din pooray gin liya karo. Is riwayat ko Hazrat Imam Hakim ne sahih kaha hai, yeh hadith aur sanadon se bhi marwi hai, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se ek mauqoof riwayat mein bhi yeh mazmoon warid hua hai.

Aagay chal kar irshad hota hai ke bhalai gharon ke peechay se aane mein nahin balkay bhalai taqwa mein hai, gharon mein darwazon se aao. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke jahiliyat ke zamane mein yeh dastoor tha ke ehram mein hote to gharon mein pusht ki janib se aatay jis par yeh aayat nazil hui. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein bhi yeh riwayat hai, Ansar ka aam dastoor tha ke safar se jab wapas aatay to ghar ke darwazay mein nahin ghustay thay. Dar-asal yeh bhi jahiliyat ke zamane mein Quraishiyon ne apne liye ek aur imtiyaz qaim kar liya tha ke apna naam unhon ne Hums rakha tha, ehram ki halat mein yeh to barah-e-rast apne gharon mein aa saktay thay lekin dusray log seedhay rastay gharon mein dakhil nahin ho saktay thay. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ek baagh se us ke darwazay se niklay to aap ke ek Ansari sahabi Hazrat Qutba bin Aamir (R.A) bhi aap ke sath hi usi darwazay se niklay, is par logon ne Hazrat (ﷺ) se kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh to ek tijarat pesha shakhs hain, yeh aap ke sath aap ki tarah is darwazay se kyun niklay? Unhon ne aap (ﷺ) se pehlay jawab diya ke main ne to Huzoor (ﷺ) ko jis tarah karte dekha kiya. Mana ke aap Hums mein se hain lekin main bhi to aap ke deen par hi hoon, is par yeh aayat nazil hui (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim).

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas waghera (R.A) se bhi yeh riwayat marwi hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain ke jahiliyat ke zamane mein bohat si qomon ka yeh riwaj tha ke jab woh safar ke iraday se nikalte phir safar adhoora chhor kar agar kisi wajah se wapas chalay aatay to ghar ke darwazay se ghar mein na aatay balkay peechay ki taraf se charh kar aatay jis se is aayat mein roka gaya. Muhammad bin Ka'ab farmate hain aitikaf ki halat mein bhi yahi dastoor tha jisay Islam ne khatam kiya. Ata farmate hain ahl-e-Madina ka eidon mein bhi yahi dastoor tha jisay Islam ne khatam kar diya. Phir farmaya Allah Ta'ala ke hukumon ko baja lana, us ke man'a kiye huay kaamon se ruk jana, us ka darr dil mein rakhna, yeh cheezein hain jo dar-asal us din kaam aanay wali hain jis din har shakhs Allah Ta'ala ke samnay pesh hoga aur poori poori jaza saza payega.

Hukm-e-Jihad aur Sharait: Hazrat Abul Aliyah (R.H) farmate hain ke Madina Sharif mein Jihad ka pehla hukm yahi nazil hua hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ayat ke hukm ki ro se sirf un logon se hi ladte the jo aap se ladein, jo aap se na ladein khud un se ladai nahin karte the yahan tak ke Surah Bara'at nazil hui. Balkeh Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) toh yahan tak farmate hain ke yeh ayat mansookh hai aur nasikh ayat (فَاقْتُلُوا الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ حَيْثُ وَجَدْتُّمُــوْهُمْ وَخُذُوْهُمْ وَاحْصُرُوْهُمْ وَاقْعُدُوْا لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ) (Surah At-Tawbah: 5) hai, yani jahan kahin mushrikeen ko pao unhein qatl karo. Lekin is bare mein ikhtilaf hai is liye ke is se toh musalmanon ko raghbat dilana aur unhein amada karna hai ke apne aise dushmanon se kyun jihad na karo jo tumhare aur tumhare deen ke khule dushman hain, jaise woh tum se ladte hain tum bhi un se lado. Jaise aur jagah farmaya ayat (وَقَاتِلُوا الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ كَاۗفَّةً كَمَا يُقَاتِلُوْنَكُمْ كَاۗفَّةً ۭ وَاعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ) (Surah At-Tawbah: 36) yani mil jul kar mushrikon se jihad karo jis tarah woh tum se sab ke sab mil kar ladai karte hain. Chunancha is ayat mein bhi farmaya unhein qatl karo jahan pao aur unhein wahan se nikalo jahan se unhon ne tumhein nikala hai, matlab yeh hai ke jis tarah un ka qasd tumhare qatl ka aur tumhein jala-watan karne ka hai tumhara bhi is ke badle mein yahi qasd rehna chahiye. Phir farmaya tajawuz karne wale ko Allah Ta'ala pasand nahin karta, yani Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani na karo, naak kaan waghera na kaato, khayanat aur chori na karo, aurton aur bachon ko qatl na karo, un budhe bade logon ko bhi na maaro jo na ladne ke laiq hain na ladai mein dakhal dete hain, darveshon aur tarik-e-duniya logon ko bhi qatl na karo, balkeh bila maslahat-e-jangi na darakht kaato na haiwanon ko zaya karo. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H), Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan (R.H) waghera ne is ayat ki tafsir mein yahi farmaya hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujahideen ko farman diya karte the ke Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, khayanat na karo, bad-ahdi se bacho, naak kaan waghera aaza na kaato, bachon ko aur zahid logon ko jo ibadat khanon mein pade rehte hain qatl na karo. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek riwayat mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmaya karte the Allah ka naam le kar niklo, Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, kuffar se lado, zulm-o-ziyadati na karo, dhoka bazi na karo.

Dushman ke aaza-e-badan na kaato, darveshon ko qatl na karo. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke ek martaba ek ghazwe mein ek aurat qatl ki hui payi gayi, Huzoor ﷺ ne ise bahut bura maana aur aurton aur bachon ke qatl ko mana farma diya. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ek, teen, paanch, saat, nau, gyarah misalein dein, ek toh zahir kar di baqi chhod dein. Farmaya ke kuch log kamzor aur maskeen thay ke un par zor-awar maal-daar dushman chadh aaya, Allah Ta'ala ne za'ifon ki madad ki aur un taqatwaron par unhein ghalib kar diya. Ab un logon ne un par zulm-o-ziyadati shuru kar di, jis ke baais Allah Ta'ala un par Qayamat tak ke liye naraz ho gaya. Yeh hadith isnaadan sahih hai. Matlab yeh hai ke jab yeh kamzor qoum ghalib aa gayi toh unhon ne zulm-o-ziyadati shuru kar di, farman-e-Bari Ta'ala ka koi lihaz na kiya, is ke baais Parwardigar-e-Aalam un se naraz ho gaya. Is baare mein ahadith aur aasar bakasrat hain jin se saaf zahir hai ke zulm-o-ziyadati Allah ko na-pasand hai aur aise logon se Allah na-khush rehta hai. Chunke Jihad ke ahkaam mein bazahir qatl-o-khoon hota hai, is liye yeh bhi farma diya ke idhar agar qatl-o-khoon hai toh udhar Allah ke saath kufr-o-shirk hai aur us Maalik ki raah se us ki makhlooq ko rokna hai aur yeh fitna qatl se bahut zyada sakht hai. Abu Malik farmate hain tumhari yeh khata-kariyan aur bad-kariyan qatl se zyada zaboon-tar hain. Phir farman jaari hota hai ke Baitullah mein un se ladai na karo, jaise Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke yeh shehar hurmat wala hai, aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish ke zamane se le kar Qayamat tak ba-hurmat hi hai. Sirf thode se waqt ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne mere liye ise halal kar diya tha lekin woh aaj us waqt bhi hurmat wala hai aur Qayamat tak is ka yeh ehtram aur buzurgi baqi rahegi. Is ke darakht na kaate jayen aur is ke kaante na ukhede jayen. Agar koi shakhs is mein ladai ko jaiz kahe aur meri jang ko daleel mein laye toh tum keh dena Allah Ta'ala ne sirf apne Rasool ﷺ ko thode se waqt ke liye ijazat di thi lekin tumhein koi ijazat nahin. Aap ke is farman se murad Fatah-e-Makkah ka din hai jis din aap ne Makkah walon se Jihad kiya tha aur Makkah ko fatah kiya tha, chand mushrikeen bhi maare gaye thay. Go ba'az ulama-e-kiram yeh bhi farmate hain ke Makkah sulah se fatah hua, Huzoor ﷺ ne saaf irshad farma diya tha ke jo shakhs apna darwaza band kar le woh aman mein hai, jo masjid mein chala jaye aman mein hai, jo Abu Sufyan ke ghar mein chala jaye woh bhi aman hai. Phir farmaya ke haan agar woh tum se yahan ladai shuru kar dein toh tumhein ijazat hai ke tum bhi yahin un se lado taake yeh zulm dafa ho sake. Chunancha An-Hazrat ﷺ ne Hudaibiya wale din apne as-haab se ladai ki bai'at li, jab Quraishiyon ne apne sathiyon se mil kar yurish ki thi tab aap ﷺ ne darakht tale apne as-haab se bai'at li.

Phir Allah Ta'ala ne is ladai ko dafa kar diya chunancha is ne'mat ka bayan is aayat mein hai ke woh aayat (وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ كَفَّ اَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَاَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اَنْ اَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ) (48. Al-Fath: 24). Phir irshad hota hai ke agar yeh kuffar haram mein ladai band kar dein aur is se baaz aa jayein aur Islam qabool kar lein to Allah Ta'ala un ke gunah maaf farma dega go unhon ne musalmanon ko haram mein qatl kiya ho, Bari Ta'ala aise bade gunah ko bhi maaf farma dega. Phir hukum hota hai ke in mushrikeen se jihad jaari rakho taake yeh shirk ka fitna mit jaye aur Allah Ta'ala ka deen ghalib aur buland ho jaye aur tamam deen par zahir ho jaye, jaise Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha gaya ke ek shakhs apni bahaduri jatane ke liye ladta hai, ek shakhs hamiyat-o-ghairat-e-qaumi se ladta hai, ek shakhs riyakari aur dikhawe ke taur par ladta hai to farmaiye ke in mein se kaun shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein jihad karne wala hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein jihad karne wala wahi hai jo sirf is ke liye lade ke Allah Ta'ala ki baat buland ho, us ke deen ka bol bala ho. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main logon se jihad karta rahoon yahan tak ke woh La Ilaha Illallah kahein, un ki jaan-o-maal ka tahaffuz mere zimme hoga magar islami ahkaam aur un ke baatini hisaab Allah Ta'ala ke zimme hain. Phir farmaya ke agar yeh kuffar shirk-o-kufr se aur tumhein qatl karne se baaz aa jayein to tum bhi un se ruk jao, is ke baad jo qitaal karega woh zalim hoga aur zalimon ko zulm ka badla dena zaroori hai, yahi ma'ani hain Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ke is qaul ke ke jo ladein un se hi lada jaye, ya matlab yeh hai ke agar woh in harkaton se ruk jayein to woh zulm ya'ni shirk se hat gaye, phir koi wajah nahin ke un se jang-o-jidal ho. Yahan lafz 'udwan' jo ke ziyadati ke ma'ani mein hai, woh ziyadati ke muqable mein ziyadati ke badle ke liye hai, haqeeqatan woh ziyadati nahin, jaise farmaya aayat (فَمَنِ اعْتَدٰى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاعْتَدُوْا عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ مَا اعْتَدٰى عَلَيْكُمْ) ya'ni tum par jo ziyadati kare tum bhi us par us jaisi ziyadati kar lo. Aur jagah hai aayat (جَزَاۗءُ سَـيِّئَةٍۢ بِمِثْلِهَا ۙ وَتَرْهَقُھُمْ ذِلَّةٌ) (10. Yunus: 27) ya'ni burai ka badla usi jaisi burai hai. Aur jagah farman hai aayat (وَاِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوْا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوْقِبْتُمْ بِهٖ) (16. An-Nahl: 126).

(An-Nahl: 126) Ya'ni agar tum saza aur azab karo toh usi misl saza karo jo tum kiye gaye ho, pas in teenon jaghon mein ziyadati, burai aur saza "badle" ke taur par kaha gaya hai warna fil-waq'a woh ziyadati, burai aur saza-o-azab nahin. Hazrat Ikrimah aur Hazrat Qatadah R.H ka farman hai asli zalim wohi hai jo La ilaha illallah ko tasleem karne se inkar kare. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A ko gher kar kaha ke log toh mar-kat rahe hain, aap Hazrat Umar R.A ke sahibzade hain, Rasoolullah ﷺ ke sahabi hain, kyun is ladai mein shamil nahin hote? Aap R.A ne farmaya suno, Allah Ta'ala ne musalman bhai ka khoon haram kar diya hai. Unhon ne kaha kya Janab-e-Bari ka yeh farman nahin ke "Un se lado yahan tak ke fitna baqi na rahe"? Aap ne jawab diya ke hum toh ladte rahe yahan tak ke fitna dab gaya aur Allah Ta'ala ka pasandida deen ghalib aa gaya, lekin ab tum chahte ho ke tum lado taake fitna paida ho aur dusre mazahib ubhar aayen. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke kisi ne aap se pucha ke ae Abu Abdur Rahman! Aap ne Allah ki rah mein jihad karna kyun chhod rakha hai aur yeh kya ikhtiyar kar rakha hai ke hajj par hajj kar rahe ho, har dusre saal hajj ko jaya karte ho, halankeh jihad ke fazail aap se makhfi nahin? Aap ne farmaya bhatije suno! Islam ki bina'ein paanch hain: Allah aur us ke Rasool par iman lana, paanchon waqton ki namaz ada karna, Ramzan ke rozay rakhna, Zakat dena, Baitullah Sharif ka hajj karna. Us ne kaha kya Quran-e-Pak ka yeh hukm aap ne nahin suna ke "Iman walon ki do jamatein agar aapas mein jhagdein toh tum un mein sulah kara do, agar phir bhi ek groh dusre par baghawat kare toh baghi groh se lado yahan tak ke woh phir se Allah ka farmanbardar ban jaye", aur jagah irshad hai "Un se lado ta-waqtike fitna mit jaye". Aap ne farmaya hum ne Huzoor ﷺ ke zamana mein is ki tameel kar li jabkeh Islam kamzor tha aur musalman thode thay, jo Islam qabool karta tha us par fitna aa padta tha, ya toh qatl kar diya jata ya sakht azab mein phans jata, yahan tak ke yeh pak deen phail gaya aur is ke halqa-ba-gosh ba-kasrat ho gaye aur fitna barbad ho gaya. Us ne kaha achha toh phir farmayiye ke Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Usman R.A ke bare mein aap ka kya khayal hai? Farmaya Usman R.A ko toh Allah Ta'ala ne maaf farma diya go tum is maafi se bura manao, aur Ali toh Rasoolullah ﷺ ke chacha-zad bhai aur aap ke damad thay aur yeh dekho un ka makan yeh raha jo tumhari aankhon ke samne hai.

Is baare mein ahadith aur aasar bakasrat hain jin se saaf zahir hai ke zulm-o-ziyadati Allah ko na-pasand hai aur aise logon se Allah na-khush rehta hai. Chunke Jihad ke ahkaam mein bazahir qatl-o-khoon hota hai, is liye yeh bhi farma diya ke idhar agar qatl-o-khoon hai toh udhar Allah ke saath kufr-o-shirk hai aur us Maalik ki raah se us ki makhlooq ko rokna hai aur yeh fitna qatl se bahut zyada sakht hai. Abu Malik farmate hain tumhari yeh khata-kariyan aur bad-kariyan qatl se zyada zaboon-tar hain. Phir farman jaari hota hai ke Baitullah mein un se ladai na karo, jaise Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke yeh shehar hurmat wala hai, aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish ke zamane se le kar Qayamat tak ba-hurmat hi hai. Is ke darakht na kaate jayen aur is ke kaante na ukhede jayen. Agar koi shakhs is mein ladai ko jaiz kahe aur meri jang ko daleel mein laye toh tum keh dena Allah Ta'ala ne sirf apne Rasool ﷺ ko thode se waqt ke liye ijazat di thi lekin tumhein koi ijazat nahin. Aap ke is farman se murad Fatah-e-Makkah ka din hai jis din aap ne Makkah walon se Jihad kiya tha aur Makkah ko fatah kiya tha, chand mushrikeen bhi maare gaye thay. Go ba'az ulama-e-kiram yeh bhi farmate hain ke Makkah sulah se fatah hua, Huzoor ﷺ ne saaf irshad farma diya tha ke jo shakhs apna darwaza band kar le woh aman mein hai, jo masjid mein chala jaye aman mein hai, jo Abu Sufyan ke ghar mein chala jaye woh bhi aman hai. Phir farmaya ke haan agar woh tum se yahan ladai shuru kar dein toh tumhein ijazat hai ke tum bhi yahin un se lado taake yeh zulm dafa ho sake. Chunancha An-Hazrat ﷺ ne Hudaibiya wale din apne as-haab se ladai ki bai'at li, jab Quraishiyon ne apne sathiyon se mil kar yurish ki thi tab aap ﷺ ne darakht tale apne as-haab se bai'at li.

Al-Fath: 24). Phir irshad hota hai ke agar yeh kuffar haram mein ladai band kar dein aur is se baaz aa jayein aur Islam qabool kar lein to Allah Ta'ala un ke gunah maaf farma dega go unhon ne musalmanon ko haram mein qatl kiya ho, Bari Ta'ala aise bade gunah ko bhi maaf farma dega. Phir hukum hota hai ke in mushrikeen se jihad jaari rakho taake yeh shirk ka fitna mit jaye aur Allah Ta'ala ka deen ghalib aur buland ho jaye aur tamam deen par zahir ho jaye, jaise Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha gaya ke ek shakhs apni bahaduri jatane ke liye ladta hai, ek shakhs hamiyat-o-ghairat-e-qaumi se ladta hai, ek shakhs riyakari aur dikhawe ke taur par ladta hai to farmaiye ke in mein se kaun shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein jihad karne wala hai? Phir farmaya ke agar yeh kuffar shirk-o-kufr se aur tumhein qatl karne se baaz aa jayein to tum bhi un se ruk jao, is ke baad jo qitaal karega woh zalim hoga aur zalimon ko zulm ka badla dena zaroori hai, yahi ma'ani hain Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ke is qaul ke ke jo ladein un se hi lada jaye, ya matlab yeh hai ke agar woh in harkaton se ruk jayein to woh zulm ya'ni shirk se hat gaye, phir koi wajah nahin ke un se jang-o-jidal ho. Yahan lafz 'udwan' jo ke ziyadati ke ma'ani mein hai, woh ziyadati ke muqable mein ziyadati ke badle ke liye hai, haqeeqatan woh ziyadati nahin, jaise farmaya aayat (فَمَنِ اعْتَدٰى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاعْتَدُوْا عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ مَا اعْتَدٰى عَلَيْكُمْ) ya'ni tum par jo ziyadati kare tum bhi us par us jaisi ziyadati kar lo. Aur jagah hai aayat (جَزَاۗءُ سَـيِّئَةٍۢ بِمِثْلِهَا ۙ وَتَرْهَقُھُمْ ذِلَّةٌ) (10. Yunus: 27) ya'ni burai ka badla usi jaisi burai hai. Aur jagah farman hai aayat (وَاِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوْا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوْقِبْتُمْ بِهٖ) (16. An-Nahl: 126).

(An-Nahl: 126) Ya'ni agar tum saza aur azab karo toh usi misl saza karo jo tum kiye gaye ho, pas in teenon jaghon mein ziyadati, burai aur saza "badle" ke taur par kaha gaya hai warna fil-waq'a woh ziyadati, burai aur saza-o-azab nahin. Hazrat Ikrimah aur Hazrat Qatadah R.H ka farman hai asli zalim wohi hai jo La ilaha illallah ko tasleem karne se inkar kare. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A ko gher kar kaha ke log toh mar-kat rahe hain, aap Hazrat Umar R.A ke sahibzade hain, Rasoolullah ﷺ ke sahabi hain, kyun is ladai mein shamil nahin hote? Us ne kaha achha toh phir farmayiye ke Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Usman R.A ke bare mein aap ka kya khayal hai? Hukm-e-Jihad aur Sharait: Hazrat Abul Aliyah (R.H) farmate hain ke Madina Sharif mein Jihad ka pehla hukm yahi nazil hua hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ayat ke hukm ki ro se sirf un logon se hi ladte the jo aap se ladein, jo aap se na ladein khud un se ladai nahin karte the yahan tak ke Surah Bara'at nazil hui. Balkeh Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) toh yahan tak farmate hain ke yeh ayat mansookh hai aur nasikh ayat (فَاقْتُلُوا الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ حَيْثُ وَجَدْتُّمُــوْهُمْ وَخُذُوْهُمْ وَاحْصُرُوْهُمْ وَاقْعُدُوْا لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ) (Surah At-Tawbah: 5) hai, yani jahan kahin mushrikeen ko pao unhein qatl karo. Lekin is bare mein ikhtilaf hai is liye ke is se toh musalmanon ko raghbat dilana aur unhein amada karna hai ke apne aise dushmanon se kyun jihad na karo jo tumhare aur tumhare deen ke khule dushman hain, jaise woh tum se ladte hain tum bhi un se lado. Phir farmaya tajawuz karne wale ko Allah Ta'ala pasand nahin karta, yani Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani na karo, naak kaan waghera na kaato, khayanat aur chori na karo, aurton aur bachon ko qatl na karo, un budhe bade logon ko bhi na maaro jo na ladne ke laiq hain na ladai mein dakhal dete hain, darveshon aur tarik-e-duniya logon ko bhi qatl na karo, balkeh bila maslahat-e-jangi na darakht kaato na haiwanon ko zaya karo. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H), Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan (R.H) waghera ne is ayat ki tafsir mein yahi farmaya hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujahideen ko farman diya karte the ke Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, khayanat na karo, bad-ahdi se bacho, naak kaan waghera aaza na kaato, bachon ko aur zahid logon ko jo ibadat khanon mein pade rehte hain qatl na karo. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek riwayat mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmaya karte the Allah ka naam le kar niklo, Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, kuffar se lado, zulm-o-ziyadati na karo, dhoka bazi na karo.
