Us ne kaha achha toh phir farmayiye ke Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Usman R.A ke bare mein aap ka kya khayal hai? Farmaya Usman R.A ko toh Allah Ta'ala ne maaf farma diya go tum is maafi se bura manao, aur Ali toh Rasoolullah ﷺ ke chacha-zad bhai aur aap ke damad thay aur yeh dekho un ka makan yeh raha jo tumhari aankhon ke samne hai.

Hukm-e-Jihad aur Sharait: Hazrat Abul Aliyah (R.H) farmate hain ke Madina Sharif mein Jihad ka pehla hukm yahi nazil hua hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ayat ke hukm ki ro se sirf un logon se hi ladte the jo aap se ladein, jo aap se na ladein khud un se ladai nahin karte the yahan tak ke Surah Bara'at nazil hui. Balkeh Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) toh yahan tak farmate hain ke yeh ayat mansookh hai aur nasikh ayat (فَاقْتُلُوا الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ حَيْثُ وَجَدْتُّمُــوْهُمْ وَخُذُوْهُمْ وَاحْصُرُوْهُمْ وَاقْعُدُوْا لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ) (Surah At-Tawbah: 5) hai, yani jahan kahin mushrikeen ko pao unhein qatl karo. Lekin is bare mein ikhtilaf hai is liye ke is se toh musalmanon ko raghbat dilana aur unhein amada karna hai ke apne aise dushmanon se kyun jihad na karo jo tumhare aur tumhare deen ke khule dushman hain, jaise woh tum se ladte hain tum bhi un se lado. Jaise aur jagah farmaya ayat (وَقَاتِلُوا الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ كَاۗفَّةً كَمَا يُقَاتِلُوْنَكُمْ كَاۗفَّةً ۭ وَاعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ) (Surah At-Tawbah: 36) yani mil jul kar mushrikon se jihad karo jis tarah woh tum se sab ke sab mil kar ladai karte hain. Chunancha is ayat mein bhi farmaya unhein qatl karo jahan pao aur unhein wahan se nikalo jahan se unhon ne tumhein nikala hai, matlab yeh hai ke jis tarah un ka qasd tumhare qatl ka aur tumhein jala-watan karne ka hai tumhara bhi is ke badle mein yahi qasd rehna chahiye. Phir farmaya tajawuz karne wale ko Allah Ta'ala pasand nahin karta, yani Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani na karo, naak kaan waghera na kaato, khayanat aur chori na karo, aurton aur bachon ko qatl na karo, un budhe bade logon ko bhi na maaro jo na ladne ke laiq hain na ladai mein dakhal dete hain, darveshon aur tarik-e-duniya logon ko bhi qatl na karo, balkeh bila maslahat-e-jangi na darakht kaato na haiwanon ko zaya karo. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H), Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan (R.H) waghera ne is ayat ki tafsir mein yahi farmaya hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujahideen ko farman diya karte the ke Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, khayanat na karo, bad-ahdi se bacho, naak kaan waghera aaza na kaato, bachon ko aur zahid logon ko jo ibadat khanon mein pade rehte hain qatl na karo. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek riwayat mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmaya karte the Allah ka naam le kar niklo, Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, kuffar se lado, zulm-o-ziyadati na karo, dhoka bazi na karo.

Dushman ke aaza-e-badan na kaato, darveshon ko qatl na karo. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke ek martaba ek ghazwe mein ek aurat qatl ki hui payi gayi, Huzoor ﷺ ne ise bahut bura maana aur aurton aur bachon ke qatl ko mana farma diya. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ek, teen, paanch, saat, nau, gyarah misalein dein, ek toh zahir kar di baqi chhod dein. Farmaya ke kuch log kamzor aur maskeen thay ke un par zor-awar maal-daar dushman chadh aaya, Allah Ta'ala ne za'ifon ki madad ki aur un taqatwaron par unhein ghalib kar diya. Ab un logon ne un par zulm-o-ziyadati shuru kar di, jis ke baais Allah Ta'ala un par Qayamat tak ke liye naraz ho gaya. Yeh hadith isnaadan sahih hai. Matlab yeh hai ke jab yeh kamzor qoum ghalib aa gayi toh unhon ne zulm-o-ziyadati shuru kar di, farman-e-Bari Ta'ala ka koi lihaz na kiya, is ke baais Parwardigar-e-Aalam un se naraz ho gaya. Is baare mein ahadith aur aasar bakasrat hain jin se saaf zahir hai ke zulm-o-ziyadati Allah ko na-pasand hai aur aise logon se Allah na-khush rehta hai. Chunke Jihad ke ahkaam mein bazahir qatl-o-khoon hota hai, is liye yeh bhi farma diya ke idhar agar qatl-o-khoon hai toh udhar Allah ke saath kufr-o-shirk hai aur us Maalik ki raah se us ki makhlooq ko rokna hai aur yeh fitna qatl se bahut zyada sakht hai. Abu Malik farmate hain tumhari yeh khata-kariyan aur bad-kariyan qatl se zyada zaboon-tar hain. Phir farman jaari hota hai ke Baitullah mein un se ladai na karo, jaise Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke yeh shehar hurmat wala hai, aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish ke zamane se le kar Qayamat tak ba-hurmat hi hai. Sirf thode se waqt ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne mere liye ise halal kar diya tha lekin woh aaj us waqt bhi hurmat wala hai aur Qayamat tak is ka yeh ehtram aur buzurgi baqi rahegi. Is ke darakht na kaate jayen aur is ke kaante na ukhede jayen. Agar koi shakhs is mein ladai ko jaiz kahe aur meri jang ko daleel mein laye toh tum keh dena Allah Ta'ala ne sirf apne Rasool ﷺ ko thode se waqt ke liye ijazat di thi lekin tumhein koi ijazat nahin. Aap ke is farman se murad Fatah-e-Makkah ka din hai jis din aap ne Makkah walon se Jihad kiya tha aur Makkah ko fatah kiya tha, chand mushrikeen bhi maare gaye thay. Go ba'az ulama-e-kiram yeh bhi farmate hain ke Makkah sulah se fatah hua, Huzoor ﷺ ne saaf irshad farma diya tha ke jo shakhs apna darwaza band kar le woh aman mein hai, jo masjid mein chala jaye aman mein hai, jo Abu Sufyan ke ghar mein chala jaye woh bhi aman hai. Phir farmaya ke haan agar woh tum se yahan ladai shuru kar dein toh tumhein ijazat hai ke tum bhi yahin un se lado taake yeh zulm dafa ho sake. Chunancha An-Hazrat ﷺ ne Hudaibiya wale din apne as-haab se ladai ki bai'at li, jab Quraishiyon ne apne sathiyon se mil kar yurish ki thi tab aap ﷺ ne darakht tale apne as-haab se bai'at li.

Phir Allah Ta'ala ne is ladai ko dafa kar diya chunancha is ne'mat ka bayan is aayat mein hai ke woh aayat (وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ كَفَّ اَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَاَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اَنْ اَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ) (48. Al-Fath: 24). Phir irshad hota hai ke agar yeh kuffar haram mein ladai band kar dein aur is se baaz aa jayein aur Islam qabool kar lein to Allah Ta'ala un ke gunah maaf farma dega go unhon ne musalmanon ko haram mein qatl kiya ho, Bari Ta'ala aise bade gunah ko bhi maaf farma dega. Phir hukum hota hai ke in mushrikeen se jihad jaari rakho taake yeh shirk ka fitna mit jaye aur Allah Ta'ala ka deen ghalib aur buland ho jaye aur tamam deen par zahir ho jaye, jaise Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha gaya ke ek shakhs apni bahaduri jatane ke liye ladta hai, ek shakhs hamiyat-o-ghairat-e-qaumi se ladta hai, ek shakhs riyakari aur dikhawe ke taur par ladta hai to farmaiye ke in mein se kaun shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein jihad karne wala hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein jihad karne wala wahi hai jo sirf is ke liye lade ke Allah Ta'ala ki baat buland ho, us ke deen ka bol bala ho. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main logon se jihad karta rahoon yahan tak ke woh La Ilaha Illallah kahein, un ki jaan-o-maal ka tahaffuz mere zimme hoga magar islami ahkaam aur un ke baatini hisaab Allah Ta'ala ke zimme hain. Phir farmaya ke agar yeh kuffar shirk-o-kufr se aur tumhein qatl karne se baaz aa jayein to tum bhi un se ruk jao, is ke baad jo qitaal karega woh zalim hoga aur zalimon ko zulm ka badla dena zaroori hai, yahi ma'ani hain Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ke is qaul ke ke jo ladein un se hi lada jaye, ya matlab yeh hai ke agar woh in harkaton se ruk jayein to woh zulm ya'ni shirk se hat gaye, phir koi wajah nahin ke un se jang-o-jidal ho. Yahan lafz 'udwan' jo ke ziyadati ke ma'ani mein hai, woh ziyadati ke muqable mein ziyadati ke badle ke liye hai, haqeeqatan woh ziyadati nahin, jaise farmaya aayat (فَمَنِ اعْتَدٰى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاعْتَدُوْا عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ مَا اعْتَدٰى عَلَيْكُمْ) ya'ni tum par jo ziyadati kare tum bhi us par us jaisi ziyadati kar lo. Aur jagah hai aayat (جَزَاۗءُ سَـيِّئَةٍۢ بِمِثْلِهَا ۙ وَتَرْهَقُھُمْ ذِلَّةٌ) (10. Yunus: 27) ya'ni burai ka badla usi jaisi burai hai. Aur jagah farman hai aayat (وَاِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوْا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوْقِبْتُمْ بِهٖ) (16. An-Nahl: 126).

(An-Nahl: 126) Ya'ni agar tum saza aur azab karo toh usi misl saza karo jo tum kiye gaye ho, pas in teenon jaghon mein ziyadati, burai aur saza "badle" ke taur par kaha gaya hai warna fil-waq'a woh ziyadati, burai aur saza-o-azab nahin. Hazrat Ikrimah aur Hazrat Qatadah R.H ka farman hai asli zalim wohi hai jo La ilaha illallah ko tasleem karne se inkar kare. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A ko gher kar kaha ke log toh mar-kat rahe hain, aap Hazrat Umar R.A ke sahibzade hain, Rasoolullah ﷺ ke sahabi hain, kyun is ladai mein shamil nahin hote? Aap R.A ne farmaya suno, Allah Ta'ala ne musalman bhai ka khoon haram kar diya hai. Unhon ne kaha kya Janab-e-Bari ka yeh farman nahin ke "Un se lado yahan tak ke fitna baqi na rahe"? Aap ne jawab diya ke hum toh ladte rahe yahan tak ke fitna dab gaya aur Allah Ta'ala ka pasandida deen ghalib aa gaya, lekin ab tum chahte ho ke tum lado taake fitna paida ho aur dusre mazahib ubhar aayen. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke kisi ne aap se pucha ke ae Abu Abdur Rahman! Aap ne Allah ki rah mein jihad karna kyun chhod rakha hai aur yeh kya ikhtiyar kar rakha hai ke hajj par hajj kar rahe ho, har dusre saal hajj ko jaya karte ho, halankeh jihad ke fazail aap se makhfi nahin? Aap ne farmaya bhatije suno! Islam ki bina'ein paanch hain: Allah aur us ke Rasool par iman lana, paanchon waqton ki namaz ada karna, Ramzan ke rozay rakhna, Zakat dena, Baitullah Sharif ka hajj karna. Us ne kaha kya Quran-e-Pak ka yeh hukm aap ne nahin suna ke "Iman walon ki do jamatein agar aapas mein jhagdein toh tum un mein sulah kara do, agar phir bhi ek groh dusre par baghawat kare toh baghi groh se lado yahan tak ke woh phir se Allah ka farmanbardar ban jaye", aur jagah irshad hai "Un se lado ta-waqtike fitna mit jaye". Aap ne farmaya hum ne Huzoor ﷺ ke zamana mein is ki tameel kar li jabkeh Islam kamzor tha aur musalman thode thay, jo Islam qabool karta tha us par fitna aa padta tha, ya toh qatl kar diya jata ya sakht azab mein phans jata, yahan tak ke yeh pak deen phail gaya aur is ke halqa-ba-gosh ba-kasrat ho gaye aur fitna barbad ho gaya. Us ne kaha achha toh phir farmayiye ke Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Usman R.A ke bare mein aap ka kya khayal hai? Farmaya Usman R.A ko toh Allah Ta'ala ne maaf farma diya go tum is maafi se bura manao, aur Ali toh Rasoolullah ﷺ ke chacha-zad bhai aur aap ke damad thay aur yeh dekho un ka makan yeh raha jo tumhari aankhon ke samne hai.

Bai'at-e-Rizwan Zul-Qa'dah san 6 Hijri mein Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) umray ke liye Sahaba-e-Kiram samet Makkah ko tashreef le chalay lekin mushrikeen ne aap ko Hudaibiyah walay maidan mein rok liya. Bil-aakhir is baat par sulh hui ke aainda saal aap umrah karein aur is saal wapas tashreef le jayein. Choonke Zi-Qa'dah ka mahina bhi hurmat wala mahina hai is liye yeh aayat nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai ke Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hurmat walay mahino mein jang nahin karte thay, haan agar koi aap par charhai kare to aur baat hai, balkay jang karte hue agar hurmat walay mahinay aa jatay to aap larai mauqoof kar detay. Hudaibiyah ke maidan mein bhi jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh khabar pahunchi ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ko mushrikeen ne qatl kar diya jo ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka paigham le kar Makkah Sharif mein gaye thay to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne chaudah sau Sahaba se ek darakht talay mushrikon se jihad karne ki bai'at li. Phir jab maloom hua ke yeh khabar ghalat hai to aap ne apna irada multavi kar diya aur sulh ki taraf mail ho gaye. Phir jo waqia hua woh hua. Isi tarah jab aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hawazin ki larai se Hunain walay din farigh hue aur mushrikeen Taif mein ja kar qila-band ho gaye to aap ne is ka muhasra kar liya. Chalees din tak yeh muhasra raha, bil-aakhir kuch Sahaba ki shahadat ke baad muhasra utha kar aap Makkah ki taraf laut gaye aur Ji'ranah se aap ne umray ka ehram bandha, yahin Hunain ki ghanimatein taqseem keen aur yeh umrah aap ka Zul-Qa'dah mein hua, yeh san 8 Hijri ka waqia hai, Allah Ta'ala aap par durood-o-salam bheje. Phir farmata hai jo tum par ziyadati kare tum bhi us par utni hi ziyadati kar lo, yani mushrikeen se bhi adl ka khayal rakho, yahan bhi ziyadati ke badlay ko ziyadati se ta'beer karna waisa hi hai jaise aur jagah azab-o-saza ke badlay mein burai ke lafz se bayan kiya gaya. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh aayat Makkah Sharif mein utri jahan musalmanon mein koi shaukat-o-shan na thi na jihad ka hukum tha, phir yeh aayat Madina Sharif mein jihad ke hukum se mansookh ho gayi, lekin Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne is baat ki tardeed ki hai aur farmate hain ke yeh aayat Madani hai, Umrah-e-Qaza ke baad nazil hui hai, Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Irshad hai Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at aur parhezgari ikhtiyar karo aur ise jaan lo ke aise hi logon ke sath deen-o-duniya mein Allah Ta'ala ki ta'eed-o-nusrat rehti hai.

Haqq-e-Jihad kya hai? Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh aayat Allah ki raah mein kharch karne ke baare mein nazil hui hai (Bukhari) aur buzurgon ne bhi is aayat ki tafsir mein yahi bayan farmaya hai, Hazrat Abu Imran farmate hain ke Muhajireen mein se ek ne Qustuntuniya ki jang mein kuffar ke lashkar par dalirana hamla kiya aur unki safon ko chirta hua un mein ghus gaya toh baaz log kehne lage ke yeh dekho yeh apne hathon apni jaan ko halakat mein daal raha hai. Hazrat Abu Ayyub (R.A) ne yeh sun kar farmaya is aayat ka sahih matlab hum jaante hain suno! Yeh aayat hamare hi baare mein nazil hui hai hum ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sohbat uthai, aap ke sath jang-o-jihad mein sharik rahe, aap ki madad par tale rahe yahan tak ke Islam ghalib hua aur musalman ghalib aagaye toh hum Ansariyon ne ek martaba jama ho kar aapas mein mashwara kiya ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sohbat ke sath hamein musharraf farmaya, hum aap ki khidmat mein lage rahe, aap ki ham-rikabi mein jihad karte rahe, ab bi-hamdillah Islam phail gaya, musalmanon ka ghalba hogaya, ladai khatam hogai, in dinon mein na hum ne apni aulad ki khabar-giri ki, na maal ki dekh-bhaal ki, na khetiyon aur baghon ka kuch khayal kiya, ab hamein chahiye ke apne khangi mamlaat ki taraf tawajjuh karein, is par yeh aayat nazil hui, pas jihad ko chhod kar baal-bachon aur byopar-tijarat mein mashghool hojana yeh apne hathon apne tayin halak karna hai (Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasai wagaira). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Qustuntuniya ki ladai ke waqt Misriyon ke sardar Hazrat Uqba bin Aamir (R.A) the aur Shamiyon ke sardar Yazeed bin Fazala bin Ubaid the, Hazrat Bara bin Aazib (R.A) se ek shakhs ne poocha ke agar main akela tanha dushman ki saf mein ghus jaaun aur wahan ghir jaaun aur qatl kardiya jaaun toh kya is aayat ke mutabiq main apni jaan ko aap hi halak karne wala banunga? Aap ne jawab diya nahin nahin Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai aayat (فَقَاتِلْ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ۚ لَا تُكَلَّفُ اِلَّا نَفْسَكَ وَحَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ) (Surah An-Nisa: 84) Ae Nabi Allah ki raah mein ladta reh tu apni jaan ka hi maalik hai isi ko takleef de, yeh aayat toh Allah ki raah mein kharch karne se ruk jaane walon ke baare mein nazil hui hai (Ibn Marduyah wagaira). Tirmidhi ki ek aur riwayat mein itni ziyadati hai ke aadmi ka gunahon par gunah kiye chale jaana aur tauba na karna yeh apne hathon apne tayin halak karna hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke musalmanon ne Damishq ka muhasara kiya aur Azd-Shanuah ke qabila ka ek aadmi jurrat kar ke dushmanon mein ghus gaya, unki safen chirta phadta andar chala gaya, logon ne use bura jaana aur Hazrat Amr bin Aas (R.A) ke paas yeh shikayat ki, chunancha Hazrat Amr (R.A) ne unhein bula liya aur farmaya Quran mein hai apni jaanon ko halakat mein na daalo.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain larai mein is tarah ki bahaduri karna apni jaan ko barbadi mein dalna nahin balkay Allah ki rah mein maal kharch na karna halakat mein parna hai, Hazrat Zahhak bin Abu Jubaira R.H farmate hain ke Ansar apne maal Allah ki rah mein khulay dil se kharch karte rehte thay lekin ek saal qahat-sali ke mauqay par unhon ne woh kharch rok liya jis par yeh ayat nazil hui, Hazrat Imam Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain is se murad bukhal karna hai, Hazrat Noman bin Bashir R.A farmate hain ke gunahgar ka Rahmat-e-Bari se na-umeed ho jana yeh halak hona hai aur hazrat mufassireen bhi farmate hain ke gunah ho jayen phir bakhshish se na-umeed ho kar gunahon mein mashghool ho jana apne hathon par aap halak hona hai, tahluka se murad Allah ka azab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai, Qurtubi waghera se riwayat hai ke log Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath jihad mein jate thay aur apne sath kuch kharch nahin le jate thay ab ya to woh bhookon marein ya un ka bojh dusron par paray to un se is ayat mein farmaya jata hai ke Allah ne jo tumhein diya hai usay us ki rah ke kamon mein lagao aur apne hathon halakat mein na paro ke bhook pyas se ya paidal chal chal kar mar jao. Is ke sath hi un logon ko jin ke paas kuch hai hukum ho raha hai ke tum ehsan karo taake Allah tumhein dost rakhay neki ke har kaam mein kharch kiya karo bilkhusoos jihad ke mauqay par Allah ki rah mein kharch karne se na ruko yeh darasal khud tumhari halakat hai, pas ehsan aala darjay ki ita'at hai jis ka yahan hukum ho raha hai aur sath hi yeh bayan ho raha hai ke ehsan karne wale Allah ke dost hain.

Hajj aur Umrah ke masail: Upar chunke rozon ka zikr hua tha phir Jihad ka bayan hua ab Hajj ka tazkira ho raha hai aur hukm hota hai ke Hajj aur Umrah ko pura karo, zahir alfaaz se maloom hota hai ke Hajj aur Umrah ko shuru karne ke baad pura karna chahiye, tamam ulama is par muttafiq hain ke Hajj-o-Umrah ko shuru karne ke baad unka pura karna lazim hai go Umrah ke wajib hone aur mustahab hone mein ulama ke do qaul hain jinhein hum ne puri tarah Kitab-ul-Ahkam mein bayan kardiya hai, fallillahil hamdu wal minnah. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke pura karna yeh hai ke tum apne ghar se ehram bandho. Hazrat Sufyan Thauri (R.H) farmate hain ke inka tamam karne ka maqsad yeh hai ke tum apne ghar se ehram bandho, tumhara safar sirf Hajj-o-Umrah ki garz se ho, miqat pahunch kar labbaik pukarna shuru kardo, tumhara irada tijarat yani kisi aur dunyawi garz ka na ho, ke nikle to apne kaam ko aur Makkah ke qareeb pahunch kar khayal aagaya ke aao Hajj-o-Umrah bhi karta chalun, go is tarah bhi Hajj-o-Umrah ada ho jaye lekin yeh pura karna nahin, pura karna yeh hai ke sirf isi irade se ghar se niklo. Hazrat Makhool farmate hain ke inka pura karna yeh hai ke inhe miqat se shuru kare. Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate hain inka pura karna yeh hai ke in dono ko alag alag ada kare aur Umrah ko Hajj ke mahinon mein na kare is liye ke Quran Sharif mein hai aayat (Al-Hajju ash-hurum ma'lumat, faman farada fihinnal hajja fala rafatha wala fusuqa wala jidala fil hajj) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 197). Hajj ke mahine muqarrar hain. Qasim bin Muhammad farmate hain ke Hajj ke mahinon mein Umrah karna pura hona nahin. Unse pucha gaya ke Muharram mein Umrah karna kaisa hai? Kaha log ise to pura kehte the lekin is qaul mein shuba hai is liye ke yeh sabit shuda amr hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne chaar Umre kiye aur charon Zul-Qa'dah mein kiye, ek san 6 Hijri mein Zul-Qa'dah ke mahine mein, dusra Zul-Qa'dah san 7 Hijri mein Umrat-ul-Qaza, teesra Zul-Qa'dah san 8 Hijri mein Umrat-ul-Ji'ranah, chautha Zul-Qa'dah san 10 Hijri mein Hajj ke saath, in umron ke siwa hijrat ke baad aap ka aur koi Umrah nahin hua, haan aap ne Umme Hani (R.A) ne aap ke saath Hajj ke liye jaane ka irada karliya tha lekin sawari ki wajah se saath na ja sakein jaise ke Bukhari Sharif mein yeh waqia manqool hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) to saaf farmate hain ke yeh Umme Hani (R.A) ke liye hi makhsoos hai, wallahu a'lam.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Hajj-o-Umrah ka ehram bandhne ke baad baghair pura kiye chhorna jaiz nahin, Hajj us waqt pura hota hai jabke qurbani wale din Jamra-e-Aqaba ko kankar maar le aur Baitullah ka tawaf kar le aur Safa-Marwa ke darmiyan daur le ab Hajj ada ho gaya, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Hajj Arafat ka naam hai aur Umrah tawaf hai. Hazrat Abdullah ki qirat yeh hai aayat (Wa atimmul Hajja wal Umrata ilal Bait) Umrah Baitullah tak jaate hi pura ho gaya, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair se jab yeh zikr hua to aap ne farmaya Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ki qirat bhi yahi thi, Hazrat Alqama bhi yahi farmate hain Ibrahim se marvi hai hadith (Wa aqimul Hajja wal Umrata ilal Bait), Hazrat Sha'bi ki qirat mein wal Umrah hai woh farmate hain Umrah wajib nahin go is ke khilaf bhi un se marvi hai, bahut si ahadith mein bahut sanadon ke sath Hazrat Anas (R.A) aur Sahaba (R.A) ki ek jamaat se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne Hajj-o-Umrah ka ek sath ehram bandha, ek aur hadith mein hai Umrah Hajj mein Qayamat tak ke liye dakhil ho gaya. Abu Muhammad bin Abi Hatim ne apni kitab mein ek riwayat warid ki hai ke ek shakhs Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur zafran ki khushbu se mehak raha tha us ne pucha Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ)! Mere ehram ke baare mein kya hukm hai is par yeh aayat utri. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne pucha woh sail kahan hai? Us ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ)! Apne zafrani kapde utaar daal aur khoob mal kar ghusal kar lo aur jo apne Hajj mein karta hai wahi Umrah mein bhi kar. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur yeh siyaq ajeeb hai, baaz riwayaton mein ghusal ka aur is aayat ke nazil hone ka zikr nahin, ek riwayat mein is ka naam Ya'la bin Umayya aaya hai dusri riwayat mein Safwan bin Umayya (R.A) wallahu a'lam.

Phir farmaya agar tum gher liye jao to jo qurbani mayassar ho kar daalo. Mufassireen ne zikr kiya ke yeh aayat san 6 Hijri mein Hudaibiya ke maidan mein utri jabke mushrikeen ne Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ko Makkah jaane se roka tha aur isi baare mein puri Surah Fath utri aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ke Sahaba ko rukhsat mili ke woh apni qurbaniyon ko wahin zibah kar daalein chunancha sattar oont zibah kiye gaye, sar mundwaye gaye aur ehram khol diye gaye. Awwal martaba Huzoor (ﷺ) ke farman ko sun kar log zara jhijhke aur unhein intezar tha ke shayad koi nasikh hukm utre yahan tak ke khud aap bahar aaye, aur apna sar mundwane walon par raham kare. Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) baal katwane walon ke liye bhi dua kijiye, aap (ﷺ) ne phir sar mundwane walon ke liye yahi dua ki, teesri martaba katwane walon ke liye bhi dua kar di, saat saat shakhs ek ek oont mein shareek thay, Sahaba ki kul tadaad chaudah sau thi, Hudaibiya ke maidan mein thehre hue thay jo hadd-e-Haram se bahar tha go yeh bhi marvi hai ke hadd-e-Haram ke kinare par thay wallahu a'lam.

Ulama ka is mein ikhtilaf hai ke yeh hukm sirf un logon ke liye hi hai jinhein dushman ghere ya kisi bimari waghera se bhi koi majboor hojaye to us ke liye bhi rukhsat hai ke woh usi jagah ehram khol dale aur sar mundwale aur qurbani kar de, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) to sirf pehli qism ke logon ke liye hi batate hain, Ibn-e-Umar (R.A), Taoos, Zuhri aur Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain, lekin Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke jis shakhs ka hath paon toot jaye ya bimar hojaye ya langra lola hojaye to woh halal hogaya woh agle saal hajj karle, rawi-e-hadith kehta hai ke main ne ise Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) aur Abu Huraira (R.A) se zikr kiya unhon ne bhi farmaya sach hai, Sunan-e-Arba'a mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A), Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A), Alqama, Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H), Urwa bin Zubair (R.H), Mujahid (R.H), Nakh'i (R.H), Ata (R.H) aur Muqatil bin Hayyan (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai ke bimar hojana aur langra lola hojana bhi aisa hi uzr hai, Hazrat Sufyan Thauri (R.H) har musibat-o-eeza ko aisa hi uzr batate hain, Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Zubair bin Abdul Muttalib (R.A) ki sahibzadi Dhiba'a (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft karti hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! mera irada hajj ka hai lekin main bimar rehti hoon, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hajj ko chali jao aur shart karlo ke mere ehram se farigh hone ki wahi jagah hogi jahan main marz ki wajah se ruk jaon, isi hadith ki bina par ba'az ulama-e-kiram ka fatwa hai ke hajj mein shart karna jaiz hai, Imam Shafi'i (R.H) bhi farmate hain ke agar yeh hadith sahi ho to mera qaul bhi yahi hai, Hazrat Imam Baihaqi (R.H) farmate hain yeh hadith bilkul sahi, pas Imam sahab ka mazhab bhi yahi hua, Falhamdulillah. Phir irshad hota hai ke jo qurbani mayassar ho use qurban kar de, Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain yani ek bakri zibah kar de, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain oont ho, gaye ho, bakri ho, bher ho in ke nar hon.

In aathon qismon mein se jise chahe zibah kare, Ibn-e-Abbas se sirf bakri bhi marwi hai aur bhi bahut se mufassireen ne yahi farmaya aur charon imamon ka bhi yahi mazhab hai, Hazrat Ayesha aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar wagaira farmate hain ke is se murad sirf oont aur gaye hi hai, ghaliban un ki daleel Hudaibiya wala waqia hoga is mein kisi sahabi se bakri ka zibah karna manqool nahin, gaye aur oont hi in buzurgon ne qurban kiye hain, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Jabir R.A se marwi hai ke hamein Allah ke Nabi ﷺ ne hukum diya ke hum saat saat aadmi gaye aur oont mein shareek hojayen, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se yeh bhi manqool hai ke jis janwar ke zibah karne ki wus'at ho use zibah kar dale, agar maldar hai to oont us se kam haisiyat wala hai to gaye warna phir bakri, Hazrat Urwah farmate hain mehenge saste damon par mauqoof hai, jumhoor ke is qaul ki ke bakri kafi hai yeh daleel hai ke Quran ne mayassar aasaan hone ka zikr farmaya hai yani kam se kam woh cheez jis par qurbani ka itlaq ho sake aur qurbani ke janwar oont, gaye, bakriyan aur bheinrein hain jaise Habr-ul-Bahr tarjuman-e-Quran Rasool Allah ﷺ ke chacha zaad bhai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A ka farman hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ek martaba bakri ki qurbani ki. Phir farmaya jab tak qurbani apni jagah par na pahunch jaye tum apne saron ko na mundwao, is ka atf aayat (وَاَتِمُّوا الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ لِلّٰهِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 196) par hai, aayat (فان احصرتم) par nahin, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer se yahan saho hogaya hai wajah yeh hai ke An-Hazrat ﷺ aur aap ke sathiyon ne Hudaibiya wale saal jabke mushrikeen rukawat ban gaye the aur aap ko haram mein na jane diya to haram se bahar hi sab ne sar bhi mundwaye aur qurbaniyan bhi kar dein, lekin aman ki halat mein jabke haram mein pahunch sakte hon to jaiz nahin jab tak ke qurbani apni jagah par na pahunch jaye aur haaji hajj-o-umre ke jumla ahkaam se farigh na hole agar woh hajj-o-umre ka ek sath ehram bandhe huye ho to in mein se ek ko karne wale ho to khwah us ne sirf hajj ka ehram bandha ho khwah tamattu ki niyat ki ho, Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen Hafsa R.A ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se poocha ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Sab to ehram khol dale lekin aap to ehram mein hi hain aap ne farmaya haan main ne apna sar mundwa liya hai aur apni qurbani ke janwar ke gale mein alamat daal di hai jab tak yeh zibah na hojaye main ehram nahin utaar sakta.

Phir hukm hota hai ke bimar aur sar ki takleef wala shakhs fidiya de de. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Abdullah bin Ma'qal R.A kehte hain ke main Koofe ki masjid mein Hazrat Ka'ab bin Ujra R.A ke paas baitha hua tha, main ne un se is aayat ke bare mein poocha to unhon ne jawab mein kaha ke mujhe log utha kar Huzoor ﷺ ke paas le gaye, juyen mere munh par chal rahi thin. Aap ﷺ ne mujhe dekh kar farmaya tumhari halat yahan tak pahunch gayi hogi main khayal bhi nahin kar sakta, kya tumhein itni taqat nahin ke ek bakri zibah kar daalo? Main ne kaha Huzoor! Main to muflis aadmi hoon. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya jao apna sar mundwa do aur teen rozay rakh lena ya chhay maskeenon ko aadha aadha saa (taqreeban sawa seer sawa chhatank) anaaj de dena. Yeh aayat mere bare mein utri hai aur hukm ke aitbar se har ek aise mazoor shakhs ko shamil hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke main handiya talay aag sulga raha tha ke Huzoor ﷺ ne meri yeh halat dekh kar mujhe yeh masla bataya. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh waqia Hudaibiya ka hai aur mere sar par bade bade baal thay jin mein bakasrat juyen ho gayi thin. Ibn Marduya ki riwayat mein hai ke phir main ne sar mundwa diya aur ek bakri zibah kar di. Ek aur hadith mein hai (Nusuk) yani qurbani ek bakri hai aur rozay agar rakhay to teen rakhay, agar sadqa de to ek farq (paimana) chhay maskeenon ke darmiyan taqseem kar dena hai. Hazrat Ali, Muhammad bin Ka'ab, Alqama, Ibrahim, Mujahid, Atta, Suddi aur Rabee bin Anas Rahimahumullah ka bhi yahi fatwa hai. Ibn Abi Hatim ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool-e-Akram ﷺ ne Hazrat Ka'ab bin Ujra R.A ko teenon maslay bata kar farma diya tha ke is mein se jis par tum chaho amal karo kaafi hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain jahan do teen soortein lafz "au" ke sath bayan hui hon wahan ikhtiyar hota hai jise chahe kar le. Hazrat Mujahid, Ikrama, Atta, Tawoos, Hasan, Hameed, A'raj, Ibrahim Nakh'i aur Zahhak se bhi yahi marwi hai. Charon imamon ka aur aksar ulama ka bhi yahi mazhab hai ke agar chahe rozay rakh le, agar chahe sadqa kar de, agar chahe qurbani kar le. Rozay teen hain, sadqa ek farq yani teen saa yani aath seer mein aadhi chhatank kam hai chhay maskeenon par taqseem kar de aur qurbani ek bakri ki hai. In teenon soorton mein se jo chahe kar le. Parwardigar Rahman-o-Raheem ko chunke yahan rukhsat deni thi is liye sab se pehle rozay bayan farmaye jo sab se aasaan surat hai, sadqa ka zikr kiya phir qurbani ka, aur Huzoor ﷺ ko chunke afzaliyat par amal karana tha is liye pehle qurbani ka zikr kiya phir chhay maskeenon ko khilane ka phir teen rozay rakhne ka. SubhanAllah dono maqam ke aitbar se dono tarkeebain kis qadar durust aur bar-mahal hain, falhamdulillah. Saeed bin Jubair se is aayat ka matlab poocha jata hai to farmate hain ke ghalla ka hukm lagaya jayega agar us ke paas hai to ek bakri khareed le warna bakri ki qeemat dirhamon se lagayi jaye aur us ka ghalla khareeda jaye aur sadqa kar diya jaye warna har aadhe saa ke badle ek roza rakhe. Hazrat Hasan farmate hain jab muharram ke sar mein takleef ho to baal mundwa de aur in teen mein se ek fidiya ada kar de, rozay das hain, sadqa das maskeenon ka khana batlate hain lekin yeh aqwal theek nahin is liye ke marfoo hadith mein aa chuka hai ke rozay teen hain aur chhay maskeenon ka khana hai aur in teenon soorton mein ikhtiyar hai, qurbani ki bakri kar de khwah teen rozay rakh le khwah chhay faqiron ko khana khila de. Haan yeh tarkeeb ehram ki halat mein shikar karne wale par hai jaise ke Quran-e-Kareem ke alfaaz hain aur fuqaha ka ijma hai lekin yahan tarkeeb zaroori nahin ikhtiyar hai. Tawoos farmate hain yeh qurbani aur yeh sadqa Makkah mein hi kar de lekin rozay jahan chahe rakh le. Ek aur riwayat mein hai Abu Asma jo Ibn Ja'far ke maula hain farmate hain ke Hazrat Usman bin Affan R.A hajj ko nikle, aap ke sath Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Hussain R.A bhi thay, main Abu Ja'far ke sath tha hum ne dekha ke ek shakhs soya hua hai aur us ki oontni us ke sarhane bandhi hui hai, main ne use jagaya dekha to woh Hazrat Hussain thay. Ibn Ja'far unhein le kar chale yahan tak ke hum Suqya mein pahunche wahan bees din tak hum un ki teemardari mein rahe. Ek martaba Hazrat Ali ne poocha kya haal hai? Janab Hussain ne apne sar ki taraf ishara kiya, aap ne hukm diya ke sar mundwa lo phir oont mangwa kar zibah kar diya. To agar us oont ka nahr karna ehram se halal hone ke liye tha to khair aur agar yeh fidiya ke liye tha to zahir hai ke Makkah ke bahar yeh qurbani hui.

Phir irshad hota hai ke tamattu wala shakhs bhi qurbani kare, khwah hajj-o-umre ka ek sath ehram bandha ho ya pehle umre ka ehram bandha ho ya us se farigh ho kar hajj ka ehram bandh liya ho, asal tamattu yahi hai aur fuqaha ke kalam mein bhi mashhoor yahi hai aur aam tamattu in dono qismon mein shamil hai, jaise ke is par sahih hadeesein dalalat karti hain. Baaz rawi toh kehte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khud hajj-e-tamattu kiya tha, baaz kehte hain aap qarin thay aur itna sab kehte hain ke qurbani ke janwar aap ke sath thay, pas aayat mein yeh hukm hai ke tamattu karne wala jis qurbani par qadir ho woh kar dale jis ka adna darja ek bakri ko qurbani karna hai go gaye ki qurbani bhi kar sakta hai chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni biwiyon ki taraf se gaye ki qurbani ki thi jo sab ki sab tamattu wali thin (Ibn Marduyah). Is se sabit hua ke tamattu bhi mashroo hai, Imran bin Husain (R.A) farmate hain ke tamattu ki aayat bhi Quran mein nazil ho chuki hai aur hum ne khud Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath tamattu kiya phir na toh Quran mein is ki mumanat nazil hui na Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is se roka lekin logon ne apni raye se ise mamnoo qarar diya, Imam Bukhari (R.H) farmate hain is se murad ghaliban Hazrat Umar (R.A) hain, Hazrat Imam-ul-Muhaddiseen ki yeh baat bilkul sahih hai, Hazrat Umar (R.A) se manqool hai ke woh logon ko is se rokte thay aur farmate thay ke agar hum Kitabullah ko lein toh is mein bhi hajj-o-umre ke poora karne ka hukm majood hai aayat (Wa atimmul hajja wal umrata lillah) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 196) lekin yeh yaad rahe ke log bakasrat Baitullah Sharif ka qasd hajj-o-umre ke irade se karein jaise ke aap se sarahatan marwi hai (R.A). Phir farmaya jo shakhs qurbani na kar sake woh teen rozay hajj mein rakh le aur saat rozay us waqt rakh le jab hajj se lautay yeh pooray das ho jayenge, yani qurbani ki taqat jisay na ho woh rozay rakh le teen toh ayyam-e-hajj mein aur baqiya baad mein, ulama ka farman hai ke awla yeh hai ke yeh rozay arfay se pehle Zil-Hajj ke dinon mein rakh le, Hazrat Ta'oos, Mujahid waghera yeh bhi farmate hain ke awwal-e-Shawwal mein bhi yeh rozay jaiz hain, Hazrat Sha'bi waghera farmate hain rozon ko agar arfa ke din ka roza shamil kar ke khatam kare toh bhi ikhtiyar hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se bhi yeh manqool hai ke agar arfay se pehle do dinon mein do rozay rakh le aur teesra arfa ke din ho toh bhi jaiz hai, Hazrat Ibn Umar (R.A) bhi farmate hain ek roza yaum-ut-tarwiyah se pehle, ek yaum-ut-tarwiyah ka aur ek arfa ka, Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka farman bhi wahi hai.

Agar kisi shakhs se yeh teeno rozay ya ek do chhoot gaye hon aur Ayyam-e-Tashreeq yani baqadr-e-Eid ke baad ke teen din aajayein toh Hazrat Ayesha aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ka farman hai ke woh in dinon mein bhi yeh rozay rakh sakta hai (Bukhari). Imam Shafi (R.H) ka bhi pehla qaul yahi hai, Hazrat Ali (Karam Allahu Wajhahu) se bhi yahi marwi hai, Hazrat Ikrama, Hasan Basri aur Urwah bin Zubair se bhi shamil hai. Hazrat Imam Shafi (R.H) ka naya qaul yeh hai ke in dinon mein yeh rozay najayaz hain, kyunke Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hadith hai ke Ayyam-e-Tashreeq khane peene aur Allah ka zikr karne ke din hain. Phir saat rozay lautne ke waqt is se murad ya toh yeh hai ke jab laut kar apni qayam-gah pahunch jao, pas laut-te waqt raste mein bhi yeh saat rozay rakh sakta hai, Mujahid aur Ata yahi kehte hain, ya murad watan mein pahunch jaane se hai, Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) yahi farmate hain aur bhi bahut se tabieen ka yahi mazhab hai, balkay Ibn-e-Jarir toh is par ijma batate hain. Bukhari Sharif ki ek mutawwal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida mein Umray ka Hajj ke sath tamattu kiya aur qurbani di, Zul-Hulaifa se aap ne qurbani sath le li thi umray ke, phir Hajj ki tahleel ki, logon ne bhi aap ke sath tamattu kiya, baaz logon ne toh qurbani sath hi rakh li thi, baaz ke sath qurbani ke janwar na thay. Makkah Sharif pahunch kar aap ne farmaya ke jis ke sath qurbani hai woh Hajj khatam hone tak ehram mein rahe aur jis ke sath qurbani nahin woh Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf kar ke Safa Marwa ke darmiyan daud kar ehram khol dale, sar ke baal mundwa le ya katwa le, phir Hajj ka ehram bandhe, agar qurbani ki taqat na ho toh teen rozay toh Hajj mein rakh le aur saat rozay jab apne watan pahunche tab rakh le (Bukhari). Is se sabit hota hai ke yeh saat rozay watan mein jaane ke baad hain. Phir farmaya yeh pooray das hain, yeh farman takeed ke liye hai, jaise Arabon mein kaha jata hai main ne apni aankhon se dekha, kaanon se suna, hath se likha aur Quran mein bhi hai aayat (Wala ta'irun yatiru bijanahaihi) na koi parinda jo apne dono paron se udta ho aur jagah hai aayat (Wala takhtuhu biyameenika) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 48) toh apne dayein hath se likhna nahin, aur jagah hai hum ne Musa (A.S) ko tees raaton ka wada diya aur das aur is ke sath poora kiya aur is ke Rab ka waqt-e-muqarrara chalees raaton ko poora hua, aur is ke Rab ka waqt-e-muqarrara chalees raaton ko poora hua, pas jaise in sab jaghon mein sirf takeed hai aise hi yeh jumla bhi takeed ke liye hai, aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh tamam-o-kamal karne ka hukum hai aur kamilah ka matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke yeh qurbani ke badle kafi hain.

Is ke baad farmaya gaya hai yeh hukm un logon ke liye hai jis ke ghar wale Masjid-e-Haram ke rehne wale na hon, is par toh ijma hai ke Haram wale tamattu nahin kar sakte. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yahi farmate hain, balkay aap (ﷺ) se marvi hai ke aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Aye Makkah walo! Tum tamattu nahin kar sakte, bahar walon ke liye tamattu hai, tum ko toh zara si door jana padta hai, thoda sa fasla tay kiya phir umre ka ehram bandh liya." Hazrat Ta'oos ki tafsir bhi yahi hai, lekin Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain ke miqat yani ehram bandhne ke maqamat ke andar hon woh bhi isi hukm mein hain, un ke liye bhi tamattu karna jaiz nahin, Makhool bhi yahi farmate hain, toh Arafat walon ka, Muzdalifa walon ka, Urfa aur Raje' ke rehne walon ka bhi yahi hukm hai. Zuhri farmate hain Makkah Sharif se ek din ki rah ke fasle par ho ya us ke qareeb woh toh tamattu kar sakta hai aur log nahin kar sakte, Hazrat Atta (R.H) do din bhi farmate hain. Imam Shafi (R.H) ka mazhab yeh hai ke Ahl-e-Haram aur jo itne fasle par hon ke wahan Makki logon ke liye namaz-e-qasr karna jaiz na ho un sab ke liye yahi hukm hai, is liye ke yeh sab hazir kahe jayenge un ke ilawa sab musafir, aur un sab ke liye hajj mein tamattu karna jaiz hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmaya Allah Ta'ala se daro, us ke ahkam baja lao, jin kamon se us ne mana kiya hai ruk jao aur yaqeen rakho ke us ke nafarmanon ko woh sakht saza karta hai.

Ahram ke masail. Arabi daan hazrat ne kaha hai ke matlab agle jumla ka yeh hai ke Hajj, Hajj hai un mahinon ka jo maloom aur muqarrar hain, pas Hajj ke mahinon mein ahram bandhna dusre mahinon ke ahram se zyada kamil hai, go aur mah ka ahram bhi sahih hai. Imam Malik, Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Ahmad, Imam Ishaq, Imam Ibrahim Nakh'i, Imam Thawri, Imam Laith, Allah Ta'ala un par sab rahmatain nazil farmaye, farmate hain ke saal bhar mein jis mahine mein chahe Hajj ka ahram bandh sakta hai. In buzurgon ki daleel ayat (يَسْــَٔـلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الْاَهِلَّةِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 189) hai. Dusri daleel yeh hai ke Hajj aur Umrah dono ko nusuk kaha gaya hai aur Umre ka ahram Hajj ke mahinon mein hi bandhna sahih hoga, balkeh agar aur mah mein Hajj ka ahram bandha to ghair sahih hai lekin is se Umrah bhi ho sakta hai ya nahin? Is mein Imam Sahab ke do qaul hain. Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Hazrat Jabir, Hazrat Ata, Mujahid Rahimahumullah ka bhi yahi mazhab hai ke Hajj ka ahram Hajj ke mahinon ke siwa bandhna ghair sahih hai aur is par daleel ayat (اَلْحَجُّ اَشْهُرٌ مَّعْلُوْمٰتٌ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 197) hai. Arabi daan hazrat ki ek dusri jamaat kehti hai ke ayat ke in alfaaz se matlab yeh hai ke Hajj ka waqt khaas khaas muqarrar karda mahine mein to sabit hua ke in mahinon se pehle Hajj ka jo ahram bandhe ga woh sahih na hoga jis tarah namaz ke waqt se pehle koi namaz parh le. Imam Shafi'i R.H farmate hain ke hamein Muslim bin Khalid ne khabar di, unhon ne Ibn Juraij se suna aur unhein Amr bin Ata ne kaha, un se Ikrama ne zikr kiya ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A ka farman hai ke kisi shakhs ko laiq nahin ke Hajj ke mahinon ke siwa bhi Hajj ka ahram bandhe kyunke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (اَلْحَجُّ اَشْهُرٌ مَّعْلُوْمٰتٌ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 197). Is riwayat ki aur bhi bohat si sanadein hain, ek sanad mein hai ke sunnat yahi hai, Sahih Ibn Khuzaima mein bhi yeh riwayat manqool hai. Usool ki kitabon mein yeh masla tay shuda hai ke sahabi ka farman hukm mein marfoo hadith ke masawi hota hai, pas yeh hukm-e-Rasool ho gaya aur sahabi bhi yahan woh sahabi hain jo mufassir-e-Quran aur tarjuman-ul-Quran hain. Alawa azeen Ibn Marduyah ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Hajj ka ahram bandhna kisi ko siwa Hajj ke mahinon ke laiq nahin, is ki asnaad bhi achi hain. Lekin Shafi'i aur Baihaqi ne riwayat ki hai ke is hadith ke rawi Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah R.A se pucha gaya ke Hajj ke mahinon se pehle Hajj ka ahram bandh liya jaye to aap ne farmaya nahin, yeh mauqoof hadith hi zyada sabit aur zyada sahih hai aur sahabi ke is fatway ki taqwiyat Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas ke is qaul se bhi hoti hai ke sunnat yun hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Ash-hur-e-Ma'lumat se murad Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain Shawwal, Zul-Qa'dah aur das din Zul-Hijjah ke hain (Bukhari). Yeh riwayat Ibn-e-Jarir mein bhi hai, Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi hai aur Imam Hakim isay sahih batlate hain. Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Ata (R.H), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H), Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H), Hazrat Hasan (R.H), Hazrat Ibn-e-Sirin (R.H), Hazrat Makhool (R.H), Hazrat Qatadah (R.H), Hazrat Zahhak bin Muzahim (R.H), Hazrat Rabi' bin Anas (R.H), Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan (Rahimahumullah) bhi yahi kehte hain. Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H), Imam Abu Hanifah (R.H), Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H), Abu Yusuf (R.H) aur Abu Saur (Rahimahumullah) ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi qaul ko pasand farmate hain. Ash-hur ka lafz jama hai toh is ka itlaq do pooray mahino aur teesray ke ba'az hissay par bhi ho sakta hai, jaise Arabi mein kaha jata hai ke main ne is saal ya aaj ke din isay dekha hai, pas haqiqat mein sara saal aur poora din toh dekhta nahin rehta balkay dekhne ka waqt thoda hi hota hai magar aghlaban (taqreeban) aisa bol diya karte hain. Isi tarah yahan bhi aghlaban teesray mahina ka zikr hai. Quran mein bhi hai ayat (Faman ta'ajjala fi yaumaini fala isma alaih) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 203), halankeh woh jaldi dedh din ki hoti hai magar ginti mein do din kahe gaye. Imam Malik (R.H), Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka ek pehla qaul yeh bhi hai ke Shawwal, Zul-Qa'dah aur Zul-Hijjah ka poora mahina hai. Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai, Ibn-e-Shihab (R.H), Ata (R.H), Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Ta'oos (R.H), Mujahid (R.H), Urwah (R.H), Rabi' (R.H) aur Qatadah (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi yeh aaya hai lekin woh mauzoo hai, kyunke is ka rawi Hussain bin Makhariq hai jis par ahadith ko waza karne ki tohmat hai, balkay is ka marfoo hona sabit nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Imam Malik (R.H) ke is qaul ko maan lene ke baad yeh sabit hota hai ke Zul-Hijjah ke mahine mein Umrah karna sahih na hoga, yeh matlab nahin ke das Zul-Hijjah ke baad bhi Hajj ho sakta hai. Chunancha Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Hajj ke mahino mein Umrah durust nahin. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir bhi in aqwal ka yahi matlab bayan karte hain ke Hajj ka zamana toh Mina ke din guzarte hi jata raha. Muhammad bin Sirin (R.H) ka bayan hai ke mere ilm mein toh koi ahl-e-ilm aisa nahin jo Hajj ke mahino ke ilawa Umrah karne ko in mahino ke andar Umrah karne se afzal manne mein shak karta ho. Qasim bin Muhammad (R.H) se Ibn-e-Aun (R.H) ne Hajj ke mahino mein Umrah karne ke masla ko poocha toh aap ne jawab diya ke isay log poora Umrah nahin maante. Hazrat Umar (R.A) aur Hazrat Usman (R.A) bhi Hajj ke mahino ke ilawa Umrah karna pasand farmate the balkay in mahino mein Umrah karne ko mana karte the, Wallahu A'lam. (Is se agli ayat ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai) ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Zul-Qa'dah mein chaar umray ada farmaye hain aur Zul-Qa'dah bhi Hajj ka mahina hai, pas Hajj ke mahino mein Umrah karna jaiz thehra, Wallahu A'lam.

Phir irshad hota hai ke jo shakhs in mahinon mein Hajj muqarrar kare yani Hajj ka ehram bandh le, is se sabit hua ke Hajj ka ehram bandhna aur use pura karna lazim hai, farz se murad yahan wajib-o-lazim kar lena hai, Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Hajj aur umre ka ehram bandhne wale se murad hai. Atta R.H farmate hain farz se murad ehram hai, Ibrahim aur Zahhak R.H ka bhi yahi qaul hai, Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ehram bandh lene aur labbaik pukarne ke baad kahin thehra rehna theek nahin aur buzurgon ka bhi yahi qaul hai, baaz buzurgon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke farz se murad labbaik pukarna hai. (Rafas) se murad jima hai jaise aur jagah Quran mein hai ayat (Uhill lakum lailatassiyami-r-rafasu ila nisaikum) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 187) yani roze ki raton mein apni biwiyon se jima karna tumhare liye halal kiya gaya hai, ehram ki halat mein jima aur is ke tamam muqaddamat bhi haram hain jaise mubashirat karna, bosa lena, in baton ka aurton ki maujudgi mein zikr karna. Goya baaz ne mardon ki mehfilon mein bhi aisi baten karne ko daryaft karne par farmaya ke aurton ke samne is qisam ki baten karna rafas hai. Rafas ka adna darja yeh hai ke jima waghera ka zikr kiya jaye, fahash baten karna, dabi zaban se aise zikr karna, isharon kinayon mein jima ka zikr, apni biwi se kehna ke ehram khul jaye to jima karenge, chher chhar karna, masas karna waghera yeh sab rafas mein dakhil hai aur ehram ki halat mein yeh sab baten haram hain, mukhtalif mufassiron ke mukhtalif aqwal ka majmua yeh hai. Fusuq ke ma'ni isyan-o-nafarmani, shikar, gali galoch waghera bad-zabani hai jaise hadith mein hai musalman ko gali dena fisq hai aur use qatl karna kufr hai, Allah ke siwa dusre ke taqarrub ke liye janwaron ko zibah karna bhi fisq hai jaise Quran-e-Karim mein hai ayat (Au fisqan uhilla lighairillahi bihi) (Surah Al-An'am: 145), bad-alqab se yaad karna bhi fisq hai, Quran farmata hai ayat (Wala tanabazu bil-alqab). Mukhtasar yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki har nafarmani fisq mein dakhil hai, go yeh fisq har waqt haram hai lekin hurmat wale mahinon mein is ki hurmat aur barh jati hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Fala tazlimu fihinna anfusakum wa qatilu-l-mushrikina kaffatan kama yuqatilunakum kaffatan) (Surah At-Tawbah: 36), in hurmat wale mahinon mein apni jaan par zulm na karo, is tarah haram mein bhi yeh hurmat barh jati hai, irshad hai ayat (Wa man yurid fihi bi-ilhadin bizulmin nuziqhu min azabin alim) (Surah Al-Hajj: 25), yani haram mein jo ilhad aur bedini ka irada kare aur use hum alamnak azab denge. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain yahan murad fisq se woh kaam hain jo ehram ki halat mein mana hain jaise shikar khelna, baal mundwana ya katwana ya nakhun lena waghera, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar R.A se bhi yahi marwi hai lekin behtareen tafsir wahi hai jo hum ne bayan ki yani har gunah se roka gaya hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai jo shakhs Baitullah ka Hajj kare na rafas kare na fisq toh woh gunahon se aisa nikal jata hai jaise apne paida hone ka din tha. Phir irshad hota hai ke Hajj mein jhagda nahin yani Hajj ke waqt aur Hajj ke arkaan waghera mein jhagda na karo aur is ka poora bayan Allah Ta'ala ne farma diya hai, Hajj ke mahine muqarrar ho chuke hain in mein kami zyadati na karo, mausam-e-Hajj ko aage peeche na karo jaisa ke mushrikeen ka watira tha jis ki muzammat Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah farma di gayi hai isi tarah Quraish-e-Mash'ar-e-Haram ke paas Muzdalifah mein thehar jate the aur baqi Arab Arafat mein theharte the phir aapas mein jhagadte the aur ek dusre se kehte the ke hum sahih raah par aur tariq-e-Ibrahimi par hain jis se yahan muman'at ki ja rahi hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hathon waqt-e-Hajj, arkaan-e-Hajj aur theharne waghera ki jaghein bayan kar di hain ab na koi ek dusre par fakhr kare na Hajj ke din aage peeche kare bas yeh jhagde ab mita do. Wallahu A'lam. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke Hajj ke safar mein aapas mein na jhagdo na ek dusre ko gussa dilao na kisi ko galiyan do, bahut se mufassireen ka yeh qaul bhi hai aur bahut se mufassireen ka pehla qaul bhi hai, Hazrat Ikrimah farmate hain ke kisi ka apne ghulam ko daant dapat karna yeh is mein dakhil nahin han mare nahin, lekin main kehta hoon ke ghulam ko agar maar bhi le toh koi dar khauf nahin, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath safar-e-Hajj mein the aur Arj mein thehre hue the Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas baithi hui thin aur Hazrat Asma (R.A) apne walid Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ke paas baithi hui thin Hazrat Abu Bakr aur Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke unton ka saman Hazrat Abu Bakr ke khadim ke paas tha Hazrat Siddiq is ka intezar kar rahe the thodi der mein woh aa gaya us se poocha ke unt kahan hai? Us ne kaha Hazrat kal raat ko gum ho gaya aap naraz hue aur farmane lage ek unt ko bhi toh sambhal na saka yeh keh kar aap ne use mara Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) muskura rahe the aur farmate ja rahe the dekho ehram ki halat mein kya kar rahe hain? Yeh hadith Abu Dawood aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai, ba'az salaf se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Hajj ke tamam hone mein yeh bhi hai lekin yeh khayal rahe ke Aan-Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ke is kaam par yeh farmana is mein nihayat latafat ke saath ek qisam ka inkar hai pas mas'ala yeh hua ke use chhod dena hi aula hai Wallahu A'lam. Musnad-e-Abd bin Humaid mein hai ke jo shakhs apna Hajj poora kare aur musalman us ki zaban aur hath se eeza na payein us ke tamam agle gunah maaf ho jate hain. Phir farmaya tum jo bhalai karo is ka ilm Allah Ta'ala ko hai, chunke upar har burai se roka tha ke na koi bura kaam karo na buri baat kaho toh yahan neki ki raghbat dilai ja rahi hai ke har neki ka poora badla Qayamat ke din paoge.

Phir irshad hota hai ke tosha aur safar kharch le liya karo. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain log bila kharch safar ko nikal khade hote the phir logon se mangte phirte jis par yeh hukm hua. Hazrat Ikrimah, Hazrat Ainiyah bhi yahi farmate hain, Bukhari, Nasai waghera mein yeh riwayatein marwi hain. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aini log aisa karte the aur apne tayein mutawakkil kehte the. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se yeh bhi riwayat hai ke jab ehram bandhte to jo kuch tosha bhuna hota sab phenk dete aur naye sire se naya saman karte, is par yeh hukm hua ke aisa na karo, aata, sattoo waghera toshe hain sath le lo. Deegar bahut se motabar mufassireen ne bhi isi tarah kaha hai, balkeh Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) to yeh bhi farmate hain ke insaan ki izzat isi mein hai ke woh umdah saman-e-safar sath rakhe. Aap apne sathiyon se dil khol kar kharch karne ki shart kar liya karte the. Chunki dunyawi tosha ka hukm diya hai to sath hi farmaya hai ke aakhirat ke tosha ki tayyari bhi kar lo, yani apni qabr mein apne sath khauf-e-Allah le kar jao. Jaise aur jagah libas ka zikr kar ke irshad farmaya: Aayat (Wa libasut-taqwa zalika khair) (Surah Al-A'raf: 26), parhezgari ka libas behtar hai. Yani khushoo-o-khuzoo, ta'at-o-taqwa ke batini libas se bhi khali na raho, balkeh yeh libas is zahiri libas se kahin zyada behtar aur nafa dene wala hai. Ek hadith mein bhi hai ke duniya mein agar kuch khooge to aakhirat mein paoge, yahan ka tosha wahan faida dega (Tabrani). Is hukm ko sun kar ek maskeen sahabi (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se kaha: Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Hamare paas to kuch hai hi nahin. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Itna to hona chahiye jis se kisi se sawal na karna pade aur behtareen khazana Allah Ta'ala ka khauf hai (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Phir irshad hota hai ke aqalmando mujh se darte raha karo, yani mere azabon se, meri pakad-dhakad se, meri giraft se, meri sazaon se daro, dab kar mere ahkaam ki tameel karo, mere irshad ke khilaf na karo taakeh nijaat pa sako, yeh hi aqli imtiyaz hai.

Tijarat aur Hajj: Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is ayat ki tafsir mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marvi hai ke jahiliyat ke zamana mein Ukaz, Majannah aur Zul-Majaz nami bazaar thay. Islam ke baad Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ayyam-e-hajj mein tijarat ko gunah samajh kar daray toh unhein ijazat di gayi ke ayyam-e-hajj mein tijarat karna gunah nahin. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh masla An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya gaya jis par yeh ayat nazil hui ke hajj ke dinon mein ehram se pehle ya ehram ke baad haji ke liye khareedo-farokht halal hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki qirat mein ayat (min rabbikum) ke baad fi mawasim-il-hajj ka lafz bhi hai, Ibn Zubair (R.A) se bhi yahi marvi hai, dusre mufassireen ne bhi is ki tafsir isi tarah ki hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se pucha gaya ke ek shakhs hajj ko nikalta hai aur saath hi khush-ilhani ke saath padhta jata hai toh us ke bare mein kya hukum hai? Aap ne yahi ayat padh kar sunayi (Ibn Jarir). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki riwayat mein hai ke Abu Umamah Taimi ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se pucha ke hum hajj mein janwar kiraya par dete hain kya hamara hajj ho jata hai? Aap ne farmaya ke tum Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf nahin karte? Kya tum Arafat mein nahin thehrte? Kya tum shaitanon ko kankariyan nahin marte? Kya tum sar nahin mundwate? Us ne kaha yeh sab kaam toh hum karte hain toh aap ne farmaya suno ek shakhs ne yahi sawal Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiya tha aur us ke jawab mein Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ayat (لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ اَنْ تَبْتَغُوْا فَضْلًا مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 198) le kar utre aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne use bula kar farmaya ke tum haji ho tumhara hajj ho gaya.

Musnad-e-Abdur-Razzaq mein bhi yeh riwayat hai ke aur Tafsir-e-Abd bin Humaid waghera mein bhi, ba'az riwayaton mein alfaaz ki kuch kami beshi bhi hai, ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke kya tum ehram nahin bandhte? Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) se sawal hota hai ke kya aap hazraat hajj ke dinon mein tijarat bhi karte thay? Aap ne farmaya aur tijarat ka mausam hi kaunsa tha? Arafat ko munsarif (ya'ni tasarruf kar ke) parha gaya hai halankeh is ke ghair-munsarif hone ke do sabab is mein majood hain ya'ni ism-e-alam aur ta'nees, is liye ke darasal yeh jama hai jaise musalmaat aur mominaat ek khaas jagah ka naam muqarrar kar diya gaya hai is liye asliyat ki ri'ayat ki gayi aur munsarif parha gaya. Arafa woh jagah hai jahan ka theharna hajj ka bunyadi rukn hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad waghera mein hadith hai ke hajj Arafat hai, teen martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi farmaya, jo suraj nikalne se pehle Arafat mein pahunch gaya us ne hajj ko pa liya, Mina ke teen dinon mein jaldi ya der ki ja sakti hai, par koi gunah nahin, theharne ka waqt Arafat ke din suraj dhalne ke baad se le kar Eid ki subh-e-sadiq ke tulu hone tak hai, Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hajjat-ul-Wida mein Zohar ki namaz ke baad suraj ghuroob hone tak yahan thehre rahe aur farmaya tha mujh se hajj ke tareeqe seekh lo, Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H), Imam Abu Hanifa aur Imam Shafi'i ka yahi mazhab hai ke daswin ki fajr se pehle jo shakhs Arafat mein pahunch jaye, us ne hajj pa liya, Hazrat Imam Ahmad farmate hain ke theharne ka waqt Arafat ke din ke shuru se hai, un ki daleel woh hadith hai jis mein marwi hai ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Muzdalifah mein namaz ke liye nikle to ek shakhs hazir-e-khidmat hua aur us ne poocha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main Tay ki pahariyon se aa raha hoon, apni sawari ko main ne thaka diya aur apne nafs par bari mashaqqat uthayi, wallah har har pahar par theharta aaya hoon kya mera hajj ho gaya? Aap ne farmaya jo shakhs hamare yahan ki is namaz mein pahunch jaye aur hamare saath chalte waqt tak thehra rahe aur is se pehle woh Arafat mein bhi thehar chuka ho khwah raat ko khwah din ko us ka hajj poora ho gaya aur woh fareeza se farigh ho gaya. (Musnad-e-Ahmad wa Sunan). Imam Tirmidhi ise sahih kehte hain, Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke paas Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ko bheja aur unhon ne aap ko hajj karaya, jab Arafat mein pahunche to poocha ke (Arafta) kya tum ne pehchan liya? Hazrat Khalilullah ne jawab diya (Araftu) main ne jaan liya, kyunke is se pehle yahan aa chuke thay is liye is jagah ka naam hi Arafa ho gaya, Hazrat Ata, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar aur Hazrat Abu Mijlaz se bhi yahi marwi hai, Wallahu A'alam.

"Mash'ar-ul-Haram", "Mash'ar-ul-Aqsa" aur "Al-Aal" bhi hai, aur is pahar ko bhi Arafat kehte hain jis ke darmiyan Jabal-ur-Rahmah hai, Abu Talib ke ek mashhoor qaside mein bhi ek sher in ma'non ka hai, Ahl-e-Jahiliyat bhi Arafat mein thehrte thay jab pahar ki dhoop chotiyon par aisi baqi reh jati jaise aadmi ke sar par amama hota hai to woh wahan se chal parte lekin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahan se us waqt chale jab suraj bilkul ghuroob ho gaya, phir Muzdalifah mein pahunch kar yahan parao kiya aur sawere andhere hi andhere bilkul awwal waqt mein raat ke andhere aur subah ki roshni ke mile jule waqt mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahin namaz-e-subah ada ki aur jab roshni wazeh ho gayi to subah ki namaz ke aakhri waqt mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne wahan se kooch kiya. Hazrat Miswar bin Makhramah (R.A) farmate hain ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hamein Arafat mein khutba sunaya aur hasb-e-adat hamd-o-sana ke baad amma ba'd keh kar farmaya ke Hajj-e-Akbar aaj hi ka din hai dekho mushrik aur but-parast to yahan se jab dhoop paharon ki chotiyon par is tarah hoti thi jis tarah logon ke saron par amama hota hai to suraj ghuroob hone se peshtar hi laut jate thay lekin hum suraj ghuroob hone ke baad yahan se wapas honge woh Mash'ar-ul-Haram se suraj nikalne ke baad chalte thay jabke itni woh paharon ki chotiyon par dhoop is tarah numayan ho jati jis tarah logon ke saron par amame hote hain lekin hum suraj nikalne se pehle hi chal denge hamara tariqa mushrikeen ke tariqe ke khilaf hai (Ibn Marduyah wa Mustadrak Hakim). Imam Hakim ne ise shart-e-shaikhain par aur bilkul sahih batlaya hai, is se yeh bhi sabit ho gaya ke Hazrat Miswar (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai un logon ka qaul theek nahin jo farmate hain ke Hazrat Miswar ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dekha hai lekin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kuch suna nahin, Hazrat Ma'roor bin Suwaid ka bayan hai ke main ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko Arafat se laut-te hue dekha goya ab tak bhi woh manzar mere samne hai, Aap (R.A) ke sar ke agle hisse par baal na thay apne oont par thay aur farma rahe thay hum wazeh roshni mein laute. Sahih Muslim ki Hazrat Jabir (R.A) wali ek mutawwal hadith jis mein Hajjat-ul-Wida ka poora bayan hai us mein yeh bhi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) suraj ke ghuroob hone tak Arafat mein thehre jab suraj chup gaya aur qadre zardi zahir hone lagi to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne peeche apni sawari par Hazrat Usama (R.A) ko sawar kiya aur oontni ki nakeel taan li yahan tak ke us ka sar paalan ke qareeb pahunch gaya aur dayen hath se logon ko ishara farmate jate thay ke logo ahista ahista chalo narmi itminan-o-sukoon aur diljami ke sath chalo jab koi pahari aayi to nakeel qadre dheeli karte taake janwar ba-aasani oopar charh jaye, Muzdalifah mein aakar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Maghrib aur Isha ki namaz ada ki azan ek hi kehwayi aur dono namazon ki takbeerein alag alag kehwayin Maghrib ke farzon aur Isha ke farzon ke darmiyan sunnat nawafil kuch nahin parhe phir lait gaye, subah-e-sadiq ke tuloo hone ke baad namaz-e-fajr ada ki jis mein azan-o-iqamat hui phir Qaswa nami oontni par sawar ho kar Mash'ar-ul-Haram mein aaye qibla ki taraf mutawajjah ho kar dua mein mashghool ho gaye aur Allahu Akbar aur La ilaha illallah aur Allah ki tauheed bayan karne lage yahan tak ke khoob sawera ho gaya, suraj nikalne se pehle hi pehle Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yahan se rawana ho gaye, Hazrat Usama (R.A) se sawal hota hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab yahan se chale to kaisi chaal chalte thay farmaya aur darmiyani dheemi chaal sawari chala rahe thay haan jab raste mein kushadgi dekhte to zara tez kar lete (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Phir farmaya Arafat se laut-te hue Mash'ar-ul-Haram mein Allah ka zikr karo yani yahan dono namazein jama kar lein, Amr bin Maimoon (R.H) Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se Mash'ar-ul-Haram ke bare mein daryaft farmate hain to Aap (R.A) khamosh rehte hain jab qafila Muzdalifah mein ja kar utarta hai to farmate hain sail kahan hai yeh Mash'ar-ul-Haram, Aap (R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Muzdalifah tamam ka tamam Mash'ar-ul-Haram hai, pahar bhi aur us ke aas paas ki kul jagah, Aap (R.A) ne logon ko dekha ke woh Quzah par bheer-bhaar kar rahe hain to farmaya yeh log kyun bheer-bhaar kar rahe hain? Yahan ki sab jagah Mash'ar-ul-Haram hai, aur bhi bohat se mufassireen ne yahi farmaya hai ke dono paharon ke darmiyan ki kul jagah Mash'ar-ul-Haram hai, Hazrat Ata (R.H) se sawal hota hai ke Muzdalifah kahan hai Aap (R.H) farmate hain jab Arafat se chale aur maidan-e-Arafat ke dono kinare chore phir Muzdalifah shuru ho gaya Wadi-e-Muhassar tak jahan chaho thehro lekin main to Quzah se idhar hi theharna pasand karta hoon taake raste se yaksooyi ho jaye, Masha'ir kehte hain zahiri nishanon ko Muzdalifah ko Mash'ar-ul-Haram is liye kehte hain ke woh Haram mein dakhil hai, Salaf-e-Saliheen ki ek jamaat ka aur ba'z ashab-e-Shafi'i ka maslan Qaffal aur Ibn Khuzaima (R.H) ka khayal hai ke yahan ka theharna Hajj ka rukn hai baghair yahan thehre Hajj sahih nahin hota kyunke ek hadith Hazrat Urwah bin Mudarris (R.A) se is ma'ni ki marwi hai, ba'z kehte hain yeh theharna wajib hai Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka ek qaul yeh bhi hai agar koi yahan na thehra to qurbani deni paregi, Imam sahib ka doosra qaul yeh hai ke mustahab hai agar na bhi thehra to kuch haraj nahin, pas yeh teen qaul hue hum yahan is behas ko zyada tool dena munasib nahin samajhte Wallahu A'lam.

(Quran-e-Kareem ke zahiri alfaaz pehle qaul ki zyada ta'eed karte hain, Wallahu A'lam. Mutarjim) Ek mursal hadith mein hai ke Arafat ka sara maidan theherne ki jagah hai, Arafat se bhi utho aur Muzdalifah ki kul had bhi theherne ki jagah hai, haan Wadi-e-Muhassar nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki is hadith mein is ke baad hai ke Makkah Sharif ki tamam galiyan qurbani ki jagah hain aur Ayyam-e-Tashreeq sab ke sab qurbani ke din hain, lekin yeh hadith bhi munqata hai is liye ke Sulaiman bin Musa Rushdaq ne Jubair bin Mut'im (R.A) ko nahin paya, lekin is ki aur sanadein bhi hain, Wallahu A'lam. Phir irshad-e-Bari Ta'ala hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala ka zikr karo jaise ke us ne tumhein hidayat di hai ke ahkaam-e-hajj wazahat ke sath bayan farma diye aur Khalilullah (A.S) ki is sunnat ko wazeh kar diya. Halankeh is se pehle tum is se be-khabar thay, yani is hidayat se pehle, is Quran se pehle, is Rasool (ﷺ) se pehle, filwaqay in teeno baton se pehle duniya gumrahi mein thi. Falhamdulillah.

Quraish se khitab aur mamool-e-Nabawi (ﷺ): "Summa" yahan par khabar ka khabar par atf daalne ke liye hai taake tarteeb ho jaye, goya ke Arafat mein theherne wale ko hukm mila ke woh yahan se Muzdalifah jaye taake Mash'ar-ul-Haram ke paas Allah Ta'ala ka zikr kar sake, aur yeh bhi farma diya ke woh tamam logon ke sath Arafat mein thehre, jaise ke aam log yahan theherte thay. Albata Quraishiyon ne fakhr-o-takabbur aur nishan-e-imtiaz ke taur par yeh thehra liya tha ke woh hadd-e-haram se bahar nahin jate thay, aur haram ki aakhri hadd par theher jate thay aur kehte thay ke hum Allah wale hain, isi ke shehar ke raees hain aur is ke ghar ke mujawir hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Quraish aur un ke hum-khayal log Muzdalifah mein hi ruk jaya karte thay aur apna naam Hums rakhte thay, baqi kul Arab Arafat mein ja kar theherte thay aur wahin se laut-te thay. Isi liye Islam ne hukm diya ke jahan se aam log laut-te hain tum wahin se lauta karo. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Atta (R.H), Hazrat Qatadah (R.H), Hazrat Suddi (R.H) waghera yahi farmate hain, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi isi tafsir ko pasand karte hain aur isi par ijma batate hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Jubair bin Mut'im (R.A) farmate hain ke mera oont Arafat mein gum ho gaya, main use dhoondne ke liye nikla to main ne Nabi (ﷺ) ko wahan thehre hue dekha, kehne laga yeh kya baat hai ke yeh Hums hain aur phir yahan haram ke bahar aa kar thehre hain. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke ifazah se murad yahan Muzdalifah se Rami-e-Jamar ke liye Mina ko jana hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur "An-Naas" se murad Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) hain, baaz kehte hain murad Imam hai, Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain agar is ke khilaf ijma ki hujjat na hoti to yahi qaul ra'ij rehta. Phir istighfar ka irshad hota hai jo umooman ibadaat ke baad farmaya jata hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) farz namaz se farigh ho kar teen martaba istighfar kiya karte thay (Muslim). Aap logon ko SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar tentis-tentis martaba parhne ka hukm diya karte thay (Bukhari, Muslim). Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Arafah ke din sham ke waqt An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne apni ummat ke liye istighfar kiya (Ibn-e-Jarir). Aap ka yeh irshad bhi marwi hai ke tamam istighfaron ka sardar yeh istighfar hai: Dua (Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana abduka wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'uzu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abuu laka bi-ni'matika alayya wa abuu bi-zanbi faghfirli fa-innahu la yaghfiruz-zunuba illa anta). Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain jo shakhs ise raat ke waqt parh le agar isi raat mar jayega to qatan jannati hoga aur jo shakhs ise din ke waqt parhega aur isi din marega to woh bhi jannati hai (Bukhari). Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne ek martaba kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mujhe koi dua sikhaye ke main namaz mein ise parha karoon, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh parho: Dua (Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kaseeran wa la yaghfiruz-zunuba illa anta faghfirli maghfiratan min indika warhamni innaka antal Ghafoorur-Raheem). (Bukhari wa Muslim). Istighfar ke bare mein aur bhi bohat si hadeesain hain.

Takmeel-e-Hajj ke baad yahan Allah Ta'ala hukum karta hai ke faraghat-e-Hajj ke baad Allah Ta'ala ka ba-kasrat zikr karo, agle jumle ke ek ma'ani toh yeh bayan kiye gaye hain ke is tarah Allah ka zikr karo jis tarah bacha apne maa baap ko yaad karta rehta hai, dusre ma'ani yeh hain ke Ahl-e-Jahiliyat Hajj ke mauqe par theharte waqt koi kehta tha mera baap bada mehman-nawaz tha, koi kehta tha woh logon ke kaam kaaj kar diya karta tha, sakhawat-o-shuja'at mein yakta tha waghera, toh Allah Ta'ala farmata hai yeh fazool baatein chhod do aur Allah Ta'ala ki buzurgiyan, badaiyan, azmatein aur izzatein bayan karo, aksar mufassireen ne yahi bayan kiya hai, garaz yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke zikr ki kasrat karo, isi liye 'au ashadd' par zabar tameez ki bina par layi gayi hai, ya'ni is tarah Allah ki yaad karo jis tarah apne badon par fakhr kiya karte the. 'Au' se yahan khabar ki misliyat ki tehqeeq hai jaise (au ashadd-u qaswatan) mein aur (au ashadd-u khashyatan) mein aur (au yazeedoon) mein aur (au adna) mein, in tamam maqamat mein lafz "au" hargiz hargiz shak ke liye nahin hai balki "fajr-e-anhu" ki tehqeeq ke liye hai, ya'ni woh zikr utna hi ho balki us se bhi zyada. Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah ka zikr bakasrat kar ke duayein mango kyunke yeh mauqa qabooliyat ka hai, saath hi un logon ki burai bhi bayan ho rahi hai jo Allah se sawal karte hue sirf duniya talbi karte hain aur aakhirat ki taraf nazrein nahin uthate, farmaya un ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahin. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke ba'az a'raab yahan thehar kar sirf yahi duayein mangte hain ke Ilahi is saal barishein achi barsa taake ghalle ache paida hon, auladein bakasrat hon waghera.

Lekin mominon ki duayen donon jahan ki bhalaion ki hoti thin is liye un ki tareefen ki gayin, is dua mein tamam bhalaian deen-o-dunya ki jama kar di hain aur tamam buraiyon se bachao hai, is liye ke dunya ki bhalai mein aafiyat, rahat, aasani, tandurusti, ghar baar, biwi bachay, rozi, ilm, amal, achi sawariyan, naukar chaakar, laundi, ghulam, izzat-o-aabru waghera tamam cheezein aa gayin aur aakhirat ki bhalai mein hisab ka aasaan hona ghabrahat se nijaat paana naama-e-aamaal ka dayen haath mein milna surkh-ru hona bil-aakhir izzat ke sath jannat mein dakhil hona sab aa gaya, phir is ke baad azaab-e-jahannam se nijaat chaahna is se yeh matlab hai ke aisay asbaab Allah Ta'ala muhayya kar de maslan haram kariyon se ijtinaab gunah aur badiyon ka tark waghera, Qasim farmatay hain jisay shukar guzaron aur zikr karnay wali zabaan aur sabr karnay wala jism mil gaya usay dunya aur aakhirat ki bhalai mil gayi aur azaab se nijaat pa gaya, Bukhari mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is dua ko bakasrat parha kartay thay is hadith mein hai Rabbana se pehlay Allahumma bhi hai, Hazrat Qatadah ne Hazrat Anas se poocha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) zyada tar kis dua ko parhtay thay to aap ne jawab mein yahi dua batayi (Ahmad) Hazrat Anas (R.A) jab khud bhi kabhi dua maangtay is dua ko na chhortay, chunancha Hazrat Sabit ne aik martaba kaha ke Hazrat aap ke yeh bhai chahtay hain ke aap un ke liye dua karein aap ne yahi dua (Allahumma Aatina Fid-Dunya) ilakh parhi phir kuch der baithay aur baat cheet karnay ke baad jab woh jaanay lagay to phir dua ki darkhwast ki aap ne farmaya kya tum tukray karana chahtay ho is dua mein to tamam bhalaian aa gayin (Ibn Abi Hatim) Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aik musalman beemar ki ayadat ke liye tashreef le gaye dekha ke woh bilkul dubla patla ho raha hai sirf haddiyon ka dhancha reh gaya hai aap ne poocha kya tum koi dua bhi Allah Ta'ala se maanga kartay thay? Us ne kaha haan meri yeh dua thi ke Allah Ta'ala jo azaab tu mujhay aakhirat mein karna chahta hai woh dunya mein hi kar daal aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah kisi mein in ke bardasht ki taqat bhi hai? Tu ne yeh dua Rabbana Aatina (aakhir tak) kyun na parhi? Chunancha beemar ne ab se isi dua ko parhna shuru kiya aur Allah Ta'ala ne usay shifa de di (Ahmad) Rukn-e-Nabi Hajj aur Rukn-e-Aswad ke darmiyan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is dua ko parha kartay thay (Ibn Majah waghera) lekin is ki sanad mein za'f hai Wallahu A'lam, aap farmatay hain ke main jab kabhi rukn ke paas se guzarta hoon to dekhta hoon ke wahan farishta hai aur woh Aameen keh raha hai tum jab kabhi yahan se guzro to dua aayat (Rabbana Aatina) ilakh parha karo (Ibn Marduyah) Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se aik shakhs ne aakar poocha ke main ne aik qafila ki mulazamat kar li hai is ujrat par woh mujhay apnay sath sawari par sawar kar lein aur Hajj ke mauqa par mujhay woh rukhsat de dein ke main Hajj ada kar loon waisay aur dinon mein main un ki khidmat mein laga rahoon to farmaiye kya is tarah mera Hajj ada ho jaye ga aap ne farmaya haan balkay tu to un logon mein se hai jin ke baray mein farman hai aayat (Ulaika Lahum Naseeb) (Mustadrak Hakim)
