Us ne kaha haan meri yeh dua thi ke Allah Ta'ala jo azaab tu mujhay aakhirat mein karna chahta hai woh dunya mein hi kar daal aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah kisi mein in ke bardasht ki taqat bhi hai? Tu ne yeh dua Rabbana Aatina (aakhir tak) kyun na parhi? Chunancha beemar ne ab se isi dua ko parhna shuru kiya aur Allah Ta'ala ne usay shifa de di (Ahmad) Rukn-e-Nabi Hajj aur Rukn-e-Aswad ke darmiyan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is dua ko parha kartay thay (Ibn Majah waghera) lekin is ki sanad mein za'f hai Wallahu A'lam, aap farmatay hain ke main jab kabhi rukn ke paas se guzarta hoon to dekhta hoon ke wahan farishta hai aur woh Aameen keh raha hai tum jab kabhi yahan se guzro to dua aayat (Rabbana Aatina) ilakh parha karo (Ibn Marduyah) Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se aik shakhs ne aakar poocha ke main ne aik qafila ki mulazamat kar li hai is ujrat par woh mujhay apnay sath sawari par sawar kar lein aur Hajj ke mauqa par mujhay woh rukhsat de dein ke main Hajj ada kar loon waisay aur dinon mein main un ki khidmat mein laga rahoon to farmaiye kya is tarah mera Hajj ada ho jaye ga aap ne farmaya haan balkay tu to un logon mein se hai jin ke baray mein farman hai aayat (Ulaika Lahum Naseeb) (Mustadrak Hakim)

Takmeel-e-Hajj ke baad yahan Allah Ta'ala hukum karta hai ke faraghat-e-Hajj ke baad Allah Ta'ala ka ba-kasrat zikr karo, agle jumle ke ek ma'ani toh yeh bayan kiye gaye hain ke is tarah Allah ka zikr karo jis tarah bacha apne maa baap ko yaad karta rehta hai, dusre ma'ani yeh hain ke Ahl-e-Jahiliyat Hajj ke mauqe par theharte waqt koi kehta tha mera baap bada mehman-nawaz tha, koi kehta tha woh logon ke kaam kaaj kar diya karta tha, sakhawat-o-shuja'at mein yakta tha waghera, toh Allah Ta'ala farmata hai yeh fazool baatein chhod do aur Allah Ta'ala ki buzurgiyan, badaiyan, azmatein aur izzatein bayan karo, aksar mufassireen ne yahi bayan kiya hai, garaz yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke zikr ki kasrat karo, isi liye 'au ashadd' par zabar tameez ki bina par layi gayi hai, ya'ni is tarah Allah ki yaad karo jis tarah apne badon par fakhr kiya karte the. 'Au' se yahan khabar ki misliyat ki tehqeeq hai jaise (au ashadd-u qaswatan) mein aur (au ashadd-u khashyatan) mein aur (au yazeedoon) mein aur (au adna) mein, in tamam maqamat mein lafz "au" hargiz hargiz shak ke liye nahin hai balki "fajr-e-anhu" ki tehqeeq ke liye hai, ya'ni woh zikr utna hi ho balki us se bhi zyada. Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah ka zikr bakasrat kar ke duayein mango kyunke yeh mauqa qabooliyat ka hai, saath hi un logon ki burai bhi bayan ho rahi hai jo Allah se sawal karte hue sirf duniya talbi karte hain aur aakhirat ki taraf nazrein nahin uthate, farmaya un ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahin. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke ba'az a'raab yahan thehar kar sirf yahi duayein mangte hain ke Ilahi is saal barishein achi barsa taake ghalle ache paida hon, auladein bakasrat hon waghera.

Lekin mominon ki duayen donon jahan ki bhalaion ki hoti thin is liye un ki tareefen ki gayin, is dua mein tamam bhalaian deen-o-dunya ki jama kar di hain aur tamam buraiyon se bachao hai, is liye ke dunya ki bhalai mein aafiyat, rahat, aasani, tandurusti, ghar baar, biwi bachay, rozi, ilm, amal, achi sawariyan, naukar chaakar, laundi, ghulam, izzat-o-aabru waghera tamam cheezein aa gayin aur aakhirat ki bhalai mein hisab ka aasaan hona ghabrahat se nijaat paana naama-e-aamaal ka dayen haath mein milna surkh-ru hona bil-aakhir izzat ke sath jannat mein dakhil hona sab aa gaya, phir is ke baad azaab-e-jahannam se nijaat chaahna is se yeh matlab hai ke aisay asbaab Allah Ta'ala muhayya kar de maslan haram kariyon se ijtinaab gunah aur badiyon ka tark waghera, Qasim farmatay hain jisay shukar guzaron aur zikr karnay wali zabaan aur sabr karnay wala jism mil gaya usay dunya aur aakhirat ki bhalai mil gayi aur azaab se nijaat pa gaya, Bukhari mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is dua ko bakasrat parha kartay thay is hadith mein hai Rabbana se pehlay Allahumma bhi hai, Hazrat Qatadah ne Hazrat Anas se poocha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) zyada tar kis dua ko parhtay thay to aap ne jawab mein yahi dua batayi (Ahmad) Hazrat Anas (R.A) jab khud bhi kabhi dua maangtay is dua ko na chhortay, chunancha Hazrat Sabit ne aik martaba kaha ke Hazrat aap ke yeh bhai chahtay hain ke aap un ke liye dua karein aap ne yahi dua (Allahumma Aatina Fid-Dunya) ilakh parhi phir kuch der baithay aur baat cheet karnay ke baad jab woh jaanay lagay to phir dua ki darkhwast ki aap ne farmaya kya tum tukray karana chahtay ho is dua mein to tamam bhalaian aa gayin (Ibn Abi Hatim) Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aik musalman beemar ki ayadat ke liye tashreef le gaye dekha ke woh bilkul dubla patla ho raha hai sirf haddiyon ka dhancha reh gaya hai aap ne poocha kya tum koi dua bhi Allah Ta'ala se maanga kartay thay? Us ne kaha haan meri yeh dua thi ke Allah Ta'ala jo azaab tu mujhay aakhirat mein karna chahta hai woh dunya mein hi kar daal aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah kisi mein in ke bardasht ki taqat bhi hai? Tu ne yeh dua Rabbana Aatina (aakhir tak) kyun na parhi? Chunancha beemar ne ab se isi dua ko parhna shuru kiya aur Allah Ta'ala ne usay shifa de di (Ahmad) Rukn-e-Nabi Hajj aur Rukn-e-Aswad ke darmiyan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is dua ko parha kartay thay (Ibn Majah waghera) lekin is ki sanad mein za'f hai Wallahu A'lam, aap farmatay hain ke main jab kabhi rukn ke paas se guzarta hoon to dekhta hoon ke wahan farishta hai aur woh Aameen keh raha hai tum jab kabhi yahan se guzro to dua aayat (Rabbana Aatina) ilakh parha karo (Ibn Marduyah) Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se aik shakhs ne aakar poocha ke main ne aik qafila ki mulazamat kar li hai is ujrat par woh mujhay apnay sath sawari par sawar kar lein aur Hajj ke mauqa par mujhay woh rukhsat de dein ke main Hajj ada kar loon waisay aur dinon mein main un ki khidmat mein laga rahoon to farmaiye kya is tarah mera Hajj ada ho jaye ga aap ne farmaya haan balkay tu to un logon mein se hai jin ke baray mein farman hai aayat (Ulaika Lahum Naseeb) (Mustadrak Hakim)

Ayyam-e-Tashreeq: Ayat (Ayyam-e-Ma'doodat) se murad Ayyam-e-Tashreeq aur Ayyam-e-Ma'loomat se murad Zil-Hajj ke das din hain, Zikr-e-Illahi se murad yeh hai ke Ayyam-e-Tashreeq mein farz namazon ke baad Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar kahein. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Arafah ka din, qurbani ka din aur Ayyam-e-Tashreeq hamare yani Ahl-e-Islam ki Eid ke din hain aur yeh din khane peene ke hain (Ahmad) aur hadith mein hai Ayyam-e-Tashreeq khane peene aur Allah ka zikr karne ke hain (Ahmad). Pehle yeh hadith bhi bayan ho chuki hai ke Arafat kul thaharne ki jagah hai aur Ayyam-e-Tashreeq sab qurbani ke din hain, aur yeh hadith bhi pehle guzar chuki hai ke Mina ke din teen hain, do din mein jaldi ya do der karne wale par koi gunah nahin. Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek hadith mein hai ke Ayyam-e-Tashreeq khane aur Zikr-e-Illahi karne ke din hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Abdullah bin Huzafah (R.A) ko bheja ke woh Mina mein ghoom kar munadi kar dein ke in dinon mein koi roza na rakhein, yeh din khane peene aur Allah ka zikr karne ke hain. Ek aur mursal riwayat mein itna zyada hai ke magar jis par qurbani ke badle rozay hon us ke liye yeh zaid neki hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke munadi Bashir bin Suhaim (R.A) thay aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne in dinon ke rozon ki muman'at farmayi hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke safed khachar par sawar ho kar Sha'b-e-Ansar mein kharay ho kar yeh hukm sunaya tha, ke logo yeh din rozon ke nahin balkay khane peene aur Zikr-e-Illahi karne ke hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Ayyam-e-Ma'doodat Ayyam-e-Tashreeq hain aur yeh chaar din hain, dasween Zil-Hajj ki aur teen din us ke baad ke yani das se terah tak. Ibn-e-Umar, Ibn-e-Zubair, Abu Musa, Ata, Mujahid, Ikrimah, Saeed bin Jubair, Abu Malik, Ibrahim Nakh'i, Yahya bin Abi Kathir, Hasan, Qatadah, Suddi, Zuhri, Rabee bin Anas, Zahhak, Muqatil bin Hayyan, Ata Khurasani, Imam Malik waghera bhi yahi farmate hain. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain yeh teen din hain dasween, gyarhween aur barhween, in mein jab chaho qurbani karo lekin afzal pehla din hai. Magar mashhoor qaul yahi hai aur Ayat-e-Karima ke alfaaz ki zahiri dalalat bhi isi par hai kyunke do din mein jaldi ya der maaf hai to sabit hua ke Eid ke baad teen din honay chahiyein aur in dinon mein Allah ka zikr karna qurbaniyon ke zibah ke waqt hai. Aur yeh bhi pehle bayan ho chuka hai ke rajeh mazhab is mein Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka hai ke qurbani ka waqt Eid ke din se Ayyam-e-Tashreeq ke khatam honay tak hai. Aur is se murad namazon ke baad ka muqarrara zikr bhi hai aur waisay aam taur par yahi Allah ka zikr murad hai, aur is ke muqarrara waqt mein go ulama-e-kiram ka ikhtilaf hai lekin zyada mashhoor qaul jis par amal daramad bhi hai yeh hai ke Arafah ki subah se Ayyam-e-Tashreeq ke aakhri din ki asr ki namaz tak. Is baray mein ek marfoo hadith bhi Dar-e-Qutni mein hai lekin us ka marfoo hona sahih nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Umar (R.A) apne khaime mein takbeer kehte aur Aap (R.A) ki takbeer par bazaar walay log takbeer kehte, yahan tak ke Mina ka maidan goonj uthta. Isi tarah yeh matlab bhi hai ke shaitanon ko kankariyan maarne ke waqt takbeer aur Allah ka zikr kiya jaye jo Ayyam-e-Tashreeq ke har din hoga. Abu Dawood waghera mein hadith hai ke Baitullah ka tawaf, Safa Marwah ki sa'i, shaitanon ko kankariyan marni, yeh sab Allah Ta'ala ke zikr ko qaim karne ke liye hai.

Chunki Allah Ta'ala ne Hajj ki pehli aur dusri wapsi ka zikr kiya aur us ke baad log in pak maqamat ko chhor kar apne apne shehron aur maqamat ko laut jayenge is liye irshad farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala se darte raha karo aur yaqeen rakho ke tumhein us ke samne jama hona hai isi ne tumhein zameen mein phailaya phir wahi samet le ga phir usi ki taraf hashr hoga pas jahan kahin ho us se darte raha karo.

Dil bheriyon ke aur khaal insanon ki. Suddi (Rahimahullah) kehte hain ke yeh aayat Akhnas bin Shariq Saqafi ke baare mein nazil hui hai, yeh munafiq shakhs tha, zahir mein musalman tha aur lekin batin mein mukhalif tha. Ibn Abbas (R.A) kehte hain ke munafiqon ke baare mein nazil hui hai jinhon ne Hazrat Khubaib (R.A) aur unke sathiyon ki buraiyan ki thin jo Raji mein shaheed kiye gaye the, toh un shuhada ki tareef mein (Man Yashri) wali aayat utri aur un munafiqeen ki muzammat ke baare mein aayat (Man Yu'jibuka) al-kh wali aayat nazil hui. Baaz kehte hain ke yeh aayat aam hai tamam munafiqon ke baare mein pehli aur dusri aayat hai aur tamam mominon ki tareef ke baare mein teesri aayat hai, Qatada (R.H) waghera ka qaul yahi hai aur yahi sahih hai. Hazrat Nauf Bakali (R.H) jo Taurat-o-Injeel ke bhi aalim the farmate hain ke main is ummat ke baaz logon ki buraiyan Allah Ta'ala ki nazil karda kitab mein pata hoon, likha hai ke baaz log deen ke heele se duniya kamate hain, unki zabanen toh shehad se zyada meethi hain lekin dil elway (musabbar) se zyada kadwe hain, logon ke liye bakriyon ki khalein pehente hain lekin unke dil bheriyon jaise hain. Allah Ta'ala farmate hain kya woh mujh par jurrat karte hain aur mere sath dhoke baziyan karte hain? Mujhe apni zaat ki qasam ke main un par woh fitna bhejunga ke bardbar log bhi hairan reh jayenge. Qurzi (R.H) kehte hain main ne gaur se dekha toh maloom hua ke yeh munafiqon ka wasf hai aur Quran mein bhi maujood hai, parhiye aayat (Wa minan-nasi man yu'jibuka qauluhu fil-hayatid-dunya wa yush-hidullaha 'ala ma fi qalbihi wa huwa alad-dul khisam) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 204). Hazrat Saeed (R.H) ne bhi jab yeh baat aur kitabon ke hawalon se bayan ki toh Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'ab (R.A) ne yahi farmaya tha ke yeh Quran-e-Sharif mein bhi hai aur isi aayat ki tilawat ki thi. Saeed (R.H) kehne lage main janta hoon ke yeh aayat kis ke baare mein nazil hui hai, aap ne farmaya suniye aayat shaan-e-nuzool ke aitbar se go kisi ke baare mein hi ho lekin hukm ke aitbar se aam hui hai. Ibn Muhaisin (R.H) ki qira'at mein (Yash-hadullahu) hai, ma'ani yeh honge ke go woh apni zaban se kuch hi kahe lekin uske dil ka haal Allah Ta'ala ko khoob maloom hai, jaise aur jagah aayat (Iza ja'akal munafiquna qalu nash-hadu innaka la-rasulullah) (Surah Al-Munafiqun: 1) yani munafiq tere paas aakar teri nabuwwat ki gawahi dete hain, Allah janta hai ke tu uska Rasool hai lekin Allah ki gawahi hai ke yeh munafiq yaqeenan jhoote hain. Lekin jamhoor ki qira'at (Yush-hidullaha) hai toh ma'ani yeh hue ke logon ke samne toh apni khayanat chupate hain lekin Allah ke samne unke dil ka kufr-o-nifaq zahir hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Yastakhfuna minan-nasi wa la yastakhfuna minallahi wa huwa ma'ahum iz yubayyituna ma la yarda minal-qaul) (Surah An-Nisa: 108).

(An-Nisa: 108) Ya'ni logon se chupate hain lekin Allah se nahin chupa sakte, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne yeh ma'ni bayan kiye hain ke logon ke samne Islam zahir karte hain aur unke samne qasmein kha kar bawar karate hain ke jo unki zaban par hai woh hi unke dilon mein hai, sahih ma'ni aayat ke yahi hain ke Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid aur Mujahid (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai, Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. "Alad" ke ma'ni lughat mein hain sakht tedha jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa tunzira bihi qawman ludda) (19. Maryam: 97). Yahi halat munafiq ki hai ke woh apni hujjat mein jhoot bolta hai aur haq se hat jata hai, seedhi baat chhod deta hai aur iftira aur bohtan bazi karta hai aur galiyan bakta hai, sahih hadith mein hai ke munafiq ki teen nishaniyan hain: jab baat kare jhoot bole, jab wada kare bewafai kare, jab jhagda kare galiyan bake. Ek aur hadith mein hai sab se zyada bura shakhs Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek woh hai jo sakht jhagralu ho, iski kayi ek sanadein hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke jis tarah yeh bure aqwal wala hai isi tarah af'aal bhi iske badtareen hain to qaul to yeh hai lekin fe'l iske sarasar khilaf hai, aqeeda bilkul fasid hai. Namaz aur hamari raftar. Sa'i se murad yahan qasd jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Summa adbara yas'a) (79. An-Nazi'at: 22) aur farman hai aayat (Fas'au ila zikrillahi wa zarul-bai') (62. Al-Jumu'ah: 9) ya'ni Jumu'ah ki namaz ka qasd-o-irada karo, yahan sa'i ke ma'ni daudne ke nahin kyunke namaz ke liye daud kar jana mamnoo hai, hadith-e-sharif mein hai jab tum namaz ke liye aao to sukoon-o-waqar ke sath aao. Munafiqon ka mazeed ta'aruf. Gharz yeh ke in munafiqon ka qasd zameen mein fasad phailana, kheti bari, zameen ki paidawar aur haiwanon ki nasl ko barbad karna hi hota hai. Yeh bhi ma'ni Mujahid se marwi hain ke in logon ke nifaq aur inki badkirdariyon ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala barish ko rok leta hai jis se khetiyon ko aur janwaron ko nuqsan pahunchta hai. Allah Ta'ala aise logon ko jo bani-e-fasad hon na-pasand karta hai. In badkirdaron ko jab wa'z-o-nasihat ke zariye samjhaya jaye to yeh aur bhadak uthte hain aur mukhalifat ke josh mein gunahon par amada ho jate hain aayat (Wa iza tutla alaihim aayatuna bayyinatin ta'rifu fi wujuhillazina kafarul-munkara yakaduna yastuna billazina yatluna alaihim aayatina qul afa-unabbi-ukum bisharrim-min zalikum annaru wa'adahal-lahullazina kafaru wa bi'sal-masir) (22. Al-Hajj: 72) ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ke kalam ki aayatein jab inke samne tilawat ki jati hain to in kafiron ke munh chadh jate hain aur padhne walon par jhapatte hain, suno, is se bhi badh kar suno, kafiron ke liye hamara farman jahannam ka hai jo badtareen jagah hai, yahan bhi yahi farmaya ke unhein jahannam kafi hai ya'ni saza mein woh badtareen odhna bichhona hai.

Momin Kaun? Munafiqon ki mazmoom khaslatain bayan farma kar ab mominon ki tareefain ho rahi hain, yeh aayat Hazrat Suhaib bin Sinan Rumi (R.A) ke haq mein nazil hui hai. Yeh Makkah mein musalman huye thay, jab Madina ki taraf hijrat karni chahi toh kafiron ne un se kaha ke hum tumhein maal le kar nahin jaane denge, agar tum maal chhor kar jana chahte ho toh tumhein ikhtiyar hai. Aap ne sab maal se alaidgi kar li aur kuffar ne us par qabza kar liya aur aap ne hijrat ki jis par yeh aayat utri. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) aur Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ki ek bari jamaat aap ke istiqbal ke liye Harra tak aayi aur mubarakbadain dein ke aap ne bara achha byopar kiya, baray nafa ki tijarat ki. Aap yeh sun kar farmane lage Allah Ta'ala aap ki tijaraton ko bhi nuqsan wali na kare, aakhir batao toh yeh mubarakbadain kya hain? In buzurgon ne farmaya aap ke bare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par yeh aayat nazil hui hai, jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paas pohanche toh aap (ﷺ) ne yeh khushkhabri sunayi. Quraish ne un se kaha tha ke jab aap Makkah mein aaye aap ke paas maal na tha, yeh sab maal yahin kamaya, ab is maal ko le kar hum jaane na denge. Chunancha aap ne maal ko chhora aur deen le kar khidmat-e-Rasool (ﷺ) mein hazir ho gaye. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke jab aap hijrat ke iraday se nikle aur kuffar-e-Makkah ko ilm hua toh sab ne aa kar gher liya, aap ne apne tarkash se teer nikal liye aur farmaya: "Ae Makkah walo! Tum khoob jante ho ke main kaisa teer-andaz hoon, mera ek nishana bhi khata nahin jata, jab tak yeh teer khatam na honge main tum ko chhedta rahoon ga, is ke baad talwar se tum se laron ga aur is mein bhi tum mein se kisi se kam nahin hoon, jab talwar ke bhi tukray ho jayenge phir tum mere paas aa sakte ho, phir jo chaho kar lo. Agar yeh tumhein manzoor hai toh Bismillah, warna suno main tumhein apna kul maal diye deta hoon, sab le lo aur mujhe jaane do." Woh maal lene par razamand ho gaye aur is tarah aap ne hijrat ki. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ke paas pohanchne se pehle hi wahan bazariya-e-wahi yeh aayat nazil ho chuki thi, aap ko dekh kar Huzoor (ﷺ) ne mubarak baad di. Aksar mufassireen ka yeh qaul bhi hai ke yeh aayat aam hai, har mujahid fi sabilillah ki shaan hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Innallahashtara minal mu'mineena anfusahum wa amwalahum bi anna lahumul jannah) (9. At-Taubah: 111). Ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ne mominon ki janein aur maal khareed liye hain aur un ke badle jannat de di hai. Yeh Allah ki raah mein jihad karte hain, maarte bhi hain aur shaheed bhi hote hain. Allah Ta'ala ka yeh sacha ahd Taurat, Injeel aur Quran mein majood hai. Allah Ta'ala se zyada sachay ahd wala aur kaun hoga? Tum ae imandaro! Is khareed-farokht aur adlay-badlay se khush ho jao, yahi bari kamyabi hai. Hazrat Hisham bin Aamir ne jabke kuffar ki dono safon mein ghus kar un par yakka-o-tanha be-panah hamla kar diya toh ba'az logon ne ise khilaf-e-shara samjha, lekin Hazrat Umar (R.A) aur Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) waghera ne un ki tardeed ki aur isi aayat (wa minan-nasi man yashri) ki tilawat kar ke suna di.

Dil bheriyon ke aur khaal insanon ki. Suddi (Rahimahullah) kehte hain ke yeh aayat Akhnas bin Shariq Saqafi ke baare mein nazil hui hai, yeh munafiq shakhs tha, zahir mein musalman tha aur lekin batin mein mukhalif tha. Baaz kehte hain ke yeh aayat aam hai tamam munafiqon ke baare mein pehli aur dusri aayat hai aur tamam mominon ki tareef ke baare mein teesri aayat hai, Qatada (R.H) waghera ka qaul yahi hai aur yahi sahih hai. Ibn Muhaisin (R.H) ki qira'at mein (Yash-hadullahu) hai, ma'ani yeh honge ke go woh apni zaban se kuch hi kahe lekin uske dil ka haal Allah Ta'ala ko khoob maloom hai, jaise aur jagah aayat (Iza ja'akal munafiquna qalu nash-hadu innaka la-rasulullah) (Surah Al-Munafiqun: 1) yani munafiq tere paas aakar teri nabuwwat ki gawahi dete hain, Allah janta hai ke tu uska Rasool hai lekin Allah ki gawahi hai ke yeh munafiq yaqeenan jhoote hain. Lekin jamhoor ki qira'at (Yush-hidullaha) hai toh ma'ani yeh hue ke logon ke samne toh apni khayanat chupate hain lekin Allah ke samne unke dil ka kufr-o-nifaq zahir hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Yastakhfuna minan-nasi wa la yastakhfuna minallahi wa huwa ma'ahum iz yubayyituna ma la yarda minal-qaul) (Surah An-Nisa: 108).

(An-Nisa: 108) Ya'ni logon se chupate hain lekin Allah se nahin chupa sakte, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne yeh ma'ni bayan kiye hain ke logon ke samne Islam zahir karte hain aur unke samne qasmein kha kar bawar karate hain ke jo unki zaban par hai woh hi unke dilon mein hai, sahih ma'ni aayat ke yahi hain ke Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid aur Mujahid (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai, Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. "Alad" ke ma'ni lughat mein hain sakht tedha jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa tunzira bihi qawman ludda) (19. Maryam: 97). Yahi halat munafiq ki hai ke woh apni hujjat mein jhoot bolta hai aur haq se hat jata hai, seedhi baat chhod deta hai aur iftira aur bohtan bazi karta hai aur galiyan bakta hai, sahih hadith mein hai ke munafiq ki teen nishaniyan hain: jab baat kare jhoot bole, jab wada kare bewafai kare, jab jhagda kare galiyan bake. Ek aur hadith mein hai sab se zyada bura shakhs Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek woh hai jo sakht jhagralu ho, iski kayi ek sanadein hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke jis tarah yeh bure aqwal wala hai isi tarah af'aal bhi iske badtareen hain to qaul to yeh hai lekin fe'l iske sarasar khilaf hai, aqeeda bilkul fasid hai. Namaz aur hamari raftar. Sa'i se murad yahan qasd jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Summa adbara yas'a) (79. An-Nazi'at: 22) aur farman hai aayat (Fas'au ila zikrillahi wa zarul-bai') (62. Al-Jumu'ah: 9) ya'ni Jumu'ah ki namaz ka qasd-o-irada karo, yahan sa'i ke ma'ni daudne ke nahin kyunke namaz ke liye daud kar jana mamnoo hai, hadith-e-sharif mein hai jab tum namaz ke liye aao to sukoon-o-waqar ke sath aao. Munafiqon ka mazeed ta'aruf. Gharz yeh ke in munafiqon ka qasd zameen mein fasad phailana, kheti bari, zameen ki paidawar aur haiwanon ki nasl ko barbad karna hi hota hai. Yeh bhi ma'ni Mujahid se marwi hain ke in logon ke nifaq aur inki badkirdariyon ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala barish ko rok leta hai jis se khetiyon ko aur janwaron ko nuqsan pahunchta hai. Allah Ta'ala aise logon ko jo bani-e-fasad hon na-pasand karta hai. In badkirdaron ko jab wa'z-o-nasihat ke zariye samjhaya jaye to yeh aur bhadak uthte hain aur mukhalifat ke josh mein gunahon par amada ho jate hain aayat (Wa iza tutla alaihim aayatuna bayyinatin ta'rifu fi wujuhillazina kafarul-munkara yakaduna yastuna billazina yatluna alaihim aayatina qul afa-unabbi-ukum bisharrim-min zalikum annaru wa'adahal-lahullazina kafaru wa bi'sal-masir) (22. Al-Hajj: 72) ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ke kalam ki aayatein jab inke samne tilawat ki jati hain to in kafiron ke munh chadh jate hain aur padhne walon par jhapatte hain, suno, is se bhi badh kar suno, kafiron ke liye hamara farman jahannam ka hai jo badtareen jagah hai, yahan bhi yahi farmaya ke unhein jahannam kafi hai ya'ni saza mein woh badtareen odhna bichhona hai.

Momin Kaun? Munafiqon ki mazmoom khaslatain bayan farma kar ab mominon ki tareefain ho rahi hain, yeh aayat Hazrat Suhaib bin Sinan Rumi (R.A) ke haq mein nazil hui hai. Yeh Makkah mein musalman huye thay, jab Madina ki taraf hijrat karni chahi toh kafiron ne un se kaha ke hum tumhein maal le kar nahin jaane denge, agar tum maal chhor kar jana chahte ho toh tumhein ikhtiyar hai. Aap ne sab maal se alaidgi kar li aur kuffar ne us par qabza kar liya aur aap ne hijrat ki jis par yeh aayat utri. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) aur Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ki ek bari jamaat aap ke istiqbal ke liye Harra tak aayi aur mubarakbadain dein ke aap ne bara achha byopar kiya, baray nafa ki tijarat ki. Aap yeh sun kar farmane lage Allah Ta'ala aap ki tijaraton ko bhi nuqsan wali na kare, aakhir batao toh yeh mubarakbadain kya hain? In buzurgon ne farmaya aap ke bare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par yeh aayat nazil hui hai, jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paas pohanche toh aap (ﷺ) ne yeh khushkhabri sunayi. Quraish ne un se kaha tha ke jab aap Makkah mein aaye aap ke paas maal na tha, yeh sab maal yahin kamaya, ab is maal ko le kar hum jaane na denge. Chunancha aap ne maal ko chhora aur deen le kar khidmat-e-Rasool (ﷺ) mein hazir ho gaye. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke jab aap hijrat ke iraday se nikle aur kuffar-e-Makkah ko ilm hua toh sab ne aa kar gher liya, aap ne apne tarkash se teer nikal liye aur farmaya: "Ae Makkah walo! Tum khoob jante ho ke main kaisa teer-andaz hoon, mera ek nishana bhi khata nahin jata, jab tak yeh teer khatam na honge main tum ko chhedta rahoon ga, is ke baad talwar se tum se laron ga aur is mein bhi tum mein se kisi se kam nahin hoon, jab talwar ke bhi tukray ho jayenge phir tum mere paas aa sakte ho, phir jo chaho kar lo. Agar yeh tumhein manzoor hai toh Bismillah, warna suno main tumhein apna kul maal diye deta hoon, sab le lo aur mujhe jaane do." Woh maal lene par razamand ho gaye aur is tarah aap ne hijrat ki. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ke paas pohanchne se pehle hi wahan bazariya-e-wahi yeh aayat nazil ho chuki thi, aap ko dekh kar Huzoor (ﷺ) ne mubarak baad di. Aksar mufassireen ka yeh qaul bhi hai ke yeh aayat aam hai, har mujahid fi sabilillah ki shaan hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Innallahashtara minal mu'mineena anfusahum wa amwalahum bi anna lahumul jannah) (9. At-Taubah: 111). Ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ne mominon ki janein aur maal khareed liye hain aur un ke badle jannat de di hai. Yeh Allah ki raah mein jihad karte hain, maarte bhi hain aur shaheed bhi hote hain. Allah Ta'ala ka yeh sacha ahd Taurat, Injeel aur Quran mein majood hai. Allah Ta'ala se zyada sachay ahd wala aur kaun hoga? Tum ae imandaro! Is khareed-farokht aur adlay-badlay se khush ho jao, yahi bari kamyabi hai. Hazrat Hisham bin Aamir ne jabke kuffar ki dono safon mein ghus kar un par yakka-o-tanha be-panah hamla kar diya toh ba'az logon ne ise khilaf-e-shara samjha, lekin Hazrat Umar (R.A) aur Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) waghera ne un ki tardeed ki aur isi aayat (wa minan-nasi man yashri) ki tilawat kar ke suna di.

Mukammal itaat hi maqsood hai. Allah Ta'ala apne oopar imaan lane walon aur apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq karne walon se irshad farmata hai ke woh kul ahkaam ko baja layein, kul mamnooaat se bach jayein, kaamil shariat par amal karein. Silm se muraad salam hai, itaat aur sulh joi bhi muraad hai. Kaffatan ke ma'ani sab ke sab, pooray pooray. Ikrama (R.H) ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam, Asad bin Ubaid, Sa'laba waghera jo Yahood se musalman huye thay, unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se guzarish ki: "Hamein hafta ke din ki izzat aur raton ke waqt Taurat par amal karne ki ijazat di jaye," jis par yeh aayat utri ke Islami ahkaam par amal karte raho. Lekin is mein Hazrat Abdullah ka naam kuch theek nahin maloom, woh aala aalim thay aur pooray musalman thay, unhein mukammal taur par maloom tha ke hafta ke din ki izzat mansookh ho chuki hai, is ke bajaye Islami eid jumma ke din ki muqarrar ho chuki hai, phir namumkin hai ke woh aisi khwahish mein auron ka sath dein. Ba'az mufassireen ne kaffatan ko haal kaha hai, ya'ni tum sab ke sab Islam mein daakhil ho jao, lekin pehli baat zyada sahih hai, ya'ni apni taqat bhar Islam ke kul ahkaam ko maano. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke ba'az Ahl-e-Kitab bawajood imaan lane ke Taurat ke ba'az ahkaam par jame huye thay, un se kaha jata hai ke Muhammadi deen mein poori tarah aa jao, is ka koi amal na chhoro, Taurat par sirf imaan rakhna kaafi hai. Phir farmaan hai ke Allah ki itaat karte raho, Shaitan ki na maano, woh to buraiyon aur badkariyon ko aur Allah par bohtan bandhne ko uksata hai. Us ki aur us ke giroh ki to khwahish yeh hai ke tum jahannumi ban jao, woh tumhara khullam khulla dushman hai. Agar tum dalail maloom karne ke baad bhi haq se hat jao to jaan rakho ke Allah bhi badla lene mein Ghalib hai, na us se koi bhaag kar bach sake, na us par koi ghalib hai, apni pakar mein woh Hakeem hai, apne amr mein woh kuffar par ghalaba rakhta hai aur uzr-o-hujjat ko kaat dene mein hikmat rakhta hai.

Tazkira-e-Shafa'at: Is ayat mein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala kuffar ko dhamka raha hai ke kya unhein Qayamat hi ka intezar hai jis din haq ke sath faislay ho jayenge aur har shakhs apne kiye ko bhugat le ga, jaise aur jagah irshad hai ayat (Kalla iza dukkatil-ardu dakkan dakka) (Surah Al-Fajr: 21) yani jab zameen ke reze-reze aur tera Rab khud aa jaye ga aur farishton ki safein ki safein bandh jayengi aur Jahannam bhi la kar khari kar di jaye gi us din yeh log ibrat-o-nasihat hasil karenge lekin is se kya faida? Aur jagah farmaya ayat (Hal yanzuruna illa an ta'tiyahumul-mala'ikatu aw ya'tiya Rabbuka aw ya'tiya ba'du ayati Rabbik) (Surah Al-An'am: 158) yani kya unhein is baat ka intezar hai ke un ke paas farishtay aayen ya khud Allah Ta'ala aaye ya us ki ba'z nishaniyan aa jayen agar yeh ho gaya to phir unhein na iman nafa de na nek a'maal ka waqt rahe, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (Rahimahullah) ne yahan par ek lambi hadith likhi hai jis mein Soor waghera ka mufassal bayan hai jis ke rawi Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) hain, Musnad waghera mein yeh hadith hai is mein hai ke jab log ghabra jayenge to Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) se shafa'at talab karenge, Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) se le kar ek-ek paighambar ke paas jayenge aur wahan se saaf jawab payenge yahan tak ke hamare Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas pahunchenge, Aap (ﷺ) jawab denge main tayyar hoon main hi is ka ahl hoon, phir Aap (ﷺ) jayenge aur Arsh tale sajde mein gir parenge aur Allah Ta'ala se sifarish karenge ke woh bandon ka faisla karne ke liye tashreef laye, Allah Ta'ala Aap (ﷺ) ki shafa'at qabool farmaye ga aur badalon ke saiban mein aaye ga, duniya ka aasman toot jaye ga aur us ke tamam farishtay aa jayenge, phir dusra bhi phat jaye ga aur us ke farishtay bhi aa jayenge, isi tarah saton aasman shaq ho jayenge aur un ke farishtay bhi aa jayenge, phir Allah ka Arsh utre ga aur buzurg-tar farishtay nazil honge aur khud woh Jabbar Allah Jalla Shanuhu tashreef laye ga, farishtay sab ke sab tasbeeh-khwani mein mashghool honge, un ki tasbeeh us waqt yeh hogi: Dua (Subhana zil-mulki wal-malakoot, Subhana zil-izzati wal-jabroot, Subhanal-hayyillazi la yamoot, Subhanallazi yumitul-khala'iqi wa la yamoot, Subboohun Quddusun Rabbul-mala'ikati war-rooh, Subboohun Quddusun, Subhana Rabbinal-A'la, Subhana zis-sultani wal-'azamah, Subhanahu Subhanahu abadan abada).

Hafiz Abu Bakr bin Marduyah bhi is ayat ki tafsir mein bohat si ahadith laye hain jin mein gharab hai wallahu a'lam, un mein se ek yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala aglon pichlon ko us din jama karega jis ka waqt muqarrar hai woh sab ke sab khade honge aankhein pathrayi hui aur upar ko lagi hui hongi har ek ko faisla ka intezar hoga Allah Ta'ala abr ke saiban mein arsh se kursi par nuzool farmayega, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain ke jis waqt woh utrega to makhlooq aur us ke darmiyan sattar hazar parde honge noor ki chaka-chaund ke aur pani ke aur pani se woh aawazein aa rahi hongi jis se dilon ko hila dein, Zubair bin Muhammad farmate hain ke woh badal ka saiban yaqoot ka juda hua aur johar-o-zabarjad wala hoga, Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yeh badal mamooli badal nahin balkay yeh woh badal hai jo Bani Israel ke saron par wadi-e-teeh mein tha, Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) farmate hain farishtay bhi badal ke saye mein aayenge aur Allah Ta'ala jis mein chahe aayega, chunancha ba'az qiraton mein yun bhi hai ayat (Hal yanzuruna illa an ya'tiyahumullahu fi zulalim minal ghamami wal mala'ikatu wa qudiyal amr, wa ilallahi turja'ul umoor) (2. Al-Baqarah: 210) jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa yawma tashaqqaqus sama'u bil ghamami wa nuzzilal mala'ikatu tanzila) (25. Al-Furqan: 25). Ya'ni us din aasman badal samet phatega aur farishtay utar aayenge.

Ehsaan faramosh Israel aur targheeb-e-sadaqat. Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke dekho Bani Israel ko main ne bohat se mojizaat dikhla diye, Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke hathon lakri, un ke hath ki roshni, un ke liye darya ko cheer dena, un par sakht garmiyon mein abr ka saya karna, Mann-o-Salwa utarna waghera waghera, jin se mera khud mukhtar fa'il-e-kul hona saaf zahir tha aur mere Nabi Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki nabuwat ki khuli tasdeeq thi, lekin taham un logon ne meri in nematon ka kufr kiya aur bajaye imaan ke kufr par are rahe aur meri nematon par bajaye shukr ke nashukri ki, phir bhala mere sakht azaab se yeh kaise bach sakte? Yehi khabar kuffar-o-Quraish ke bare mein bhi bayan farmayi, irshad hai aayat: (Alam tara ilallazina baddalu ni'matallahi kufran wa ahallu qawmahum daral-bawar) (Surah Ibrahim: 28). Kya tu ne un logon ko dekha jinhon ne Allah ki nemat ko kufr se badal diya aur apni qoum ko halakat ke ghar yani jahannam jaisi badtareen qarar-gah mein pahuncha diya. Phir bayan hota hai ke yeh kuffar sirf duniya ki zindagi par deewane hue hain, maal jama karna aur Allah ki raah ke kharch mein bukhl karna yehi un ka rang dhang hai, balkay imaan-dar is duniya-e-fani se sair-chashm hain aur Parwardigar ki razamandi mein apne maal lutate rehte hain, yeh un ka mazaq udate hain, halankeh haqeeqi naseeb wale yehi log hain, Qayamat ke din un ke martabe dekh kar un kafiron ki aankhein khul jayengi, us waqt apni badtari aur un ki bartari dekh kar mamla oonch neech samajh mein aa jayega. Duniya ki rozi jise Allah jitni chahe de de, jise chahe be-hisab de, balkay jise chahe yahan bhi de aur phir wahan bhi de. Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai: "Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Tu meri raah mein kharch kar, main tujhe deta chala jaunga." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Bilal (R.A) se farmaya: "Raah-e-Allah mein diye jao aur Arsh wale se tangi ka khauf na karo." Quran mein hai aayat: (Wa ma anfaqtum min shai'in fahuwa yukhlifuhoo wa huwa khairur-raziqeen) (Surah Saba: 39). Tum jo kuch kharch karo Allah us ka badla dega. Sahih hadees mein hai: "Har subh do farishtay utarte hain, ek dua karta hai: Ae Allah! Teri raah mein kharch karne wale ko izzat farma, dusra kehta hai: Bakheel ke maal ko tabah-o-barbad kar." Ek aur hadees mein hai: "Insaan kehta rehta hai mera maal, mera maal, halankeh tera maal woh hai jise tu ne khaya woh to fana ho chuka aur jise pehan liya woh boseeda ho gaya, han jo tu ne sadaqah mein diya use tu ne baqi rakh liya, is ke siwa jo kuch hai use to tu dusron ke liye chhor kar yahan se chal de ga." Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadees mein hai: "Duniya us ka ghar hai jis ka ghar na ho, duniya us ka maal hai jis ka maal na ho, duniya ke liye jama woh karta hai jise aql na ho."

Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Bilal (R.A) se farmaya: "Raah-e-Allah mein diye jao aur Arsh wale se tangi ka khauf na karo." Quran mein hai aayat: (Wa ma anfaqtum min shai'in fahuwa yukhlifuhoo wa huwa khairur-raziqeen) (Surah Saba: 39). Tum jo kuch kharch karo Allah us ka badla dega. Sahih hadees mein hai: "Har subh do farishtay utarte hain, ek dua karta hai: Ae Allah! Teri raah mein kharch karne wale ko izzat farma, dusra kehta hai: Bakheel ke maal ko tabah-o-barbad kar." Ek aur hadees mein hai: "Insaan kehta rehta hai mera maal, mera maal, halankeh tera maal woh hai jise tu ne khaya woh to fana ho chuka aur jise pehan liya woh boseeda ho gaya, han jo tu ne sadaqah mein diya use tu ne baqi rakh liya, is ke siwa jo kuch hai use to tu dusron ke liye chhor kar yahan se chal de ga." Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadees mein hai: "Duniya us ka ghar hai jis ka ghar na ho, duniya us ka maal hai jis ka maal na ho, duniya ke liye jama woh karta hai jise aql na ho."

Adam A.S se Hazrat Nuh A.S tak Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka bayan hai ke Hazrat Nuh aur Hazrat Adam ke darmiyan das zamane thay. In zamonon ke log haq par aur shariat ke paband thay, phir ikhtilaf ho gaya to Allah Ta'ala ne Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ko mab'oos farmaya, balkay aap ki qira'at bhi yun hai aayat (وَمَا كَانَ النَّاسُ اِلَّآ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاخْتَلَفُوْا) 10.

(Yunus: 19) Ubayy bin Ka'ab ki qira'at bhi yahi hai, Qatadah R.A ne is ki tafsir isi tarah ki hai ke jab un mein ikhtilaf paida ho gaya to Allah Ta'ala ne apna pehla paighambar bheja yani Hazrat Nuh A.S, Hazrat Mujahid bhi yahi kehte hain, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se ek riwayat marwi hai ke pehle sab ke sab kafir thay, lekin awwal qaul ma'ani ke aitbar se bhi aur sanad ke aitbar se bhi zyada sahih hai, pas un paighambaron ne iman walon ko khushiyan sunayin aur iman na lane walon ko daraya, un ke sath Allah ki kitab bhi thi taake logon ke har ikhtilaf ka faisla qanoon-e-Ilahi se ho sake, lekin un dalail ke baad bhi sirf aapas ke hasad-o-bughz, ta'assub-o-zid aur nafsaniyat ke bina par phir ittifaq na kar sake, lekin iman dar sambhal gaye aur is ikhtilaf ke chakkar se nikal kar seedhi rah lag gaye, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain hum duniya mein aane ke aitbar se sab se aage honge, Ahl-e-Kitab ko Kitabullah hum se pehle di gayi, hamein us ke baad di gayi lekin unhon ne ikhtilaf kiya aur Allah Pak ne hamari rehbari ki, Jumma ke bare mein bhi na-ittifaqi rahi lekin hamein hidayat naseeb hui, yeh kul ke kul Ahl-e-Kitab is lihaz se bhi hamare peeche hain, Jumma hamara hai, hafta Yahudiyon ka aur itwar Nasraniyon ka, Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain Jumma ke ilawa qibla ke bare mein bhi yahi hua, Nasara ne mashriq ko qibla banaya, Yahud ne bhi, un mein ba'az ki namaz ruku hai aur sajdah nahin, ba'az ke han sajdah hai aur ruku nahin, ba'az namaz mein bolte chalte phirte rehte hain lekin ummat-e-Muhammad ki namaz sukoon-o-waqar wali hai, na yeh bolein na chalein na phirein, rozon mein bhi isi tarah ikhtilaf hua aur is mein bhi Ummat-e-Muhammadiyah ko hidayat naseeb hui, un mein se koi to din ke ba'az hisse ka roza rakhta hai, koi giroh ba'az qism ke khane chhod deta hai lekin hamara roza har tarah kamil hai aur is mein bhi rah-e-haq hamein samjhayi gayi hai, isi tarah Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke bare mein Yahud ne kaha ke woh Yahudi thay, Nasraniyon ne unhein Nasara kaha lekin darasal woh kamsar musalman thay, pas is bare mein bhi hamari rehbari ki gayi aur Khalilullah ki nisbat sahih khayal tak hum ko pahuncha diye gaye, Hazrat Isa A.S ko bhi Yahudiyon ne jhutlaya aur un ki walida-e-majida ki nisbat bad-kalami ki, Nasraniyon ne unhein Allah aur Allah ka beta kaha lekin musalman is ifrat-o-tafrit se bacha liye gaye aur unhein Ruhullah, Kalimatullah aur Nabi-e-Barhaq mana, Rabi bin Anas farmate hain matlab ayat ka yeh hai ke jis tarah ibtida mein sab log Allah Wahid-o-Ahad ki ibadat karne wale, nekiyon ke aamil, buraiyon se mujtannib thay, beech mein ikhtilaf ronuma ho gaya tha, pas is aakhri ummat ko awwal ki tarah ikhtilaf se hata kar sahih rah par laga diya, yeh ummat aur ummaton par gawah hogi yahan tak ke Ummat-e-Nuh par bhi in ki shahadat hogi, qaum-e-Yahud, qaum-e-Saleh, qaum-e-Shuaib aur Aal-e-Firaun ka bhi hisab kitab inhi ki gawahiyon par hoga, yeh kahenge ke un paighambaron ne tabligh ki aur un ummaton ne takzeeb ki, Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab ki qira'at mein ayat (Wallahu yahdi) ilakh, se pehle yeh lafz bhi hain ayat (Wal-yakoonu shuhada'a 'alan-nasi yaumal qiyamah) ilakh, Abu Aliyah farmate hain is ayat mein goya hukm hai ke shuba, gumrahi, aur fitnon se bachna chahiye, yeh hidayat Allah ke ilm aur us ki rehbari se hui, woh jise chahe rah-e-istiqamat sujha deta hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke An-Hazrat ﷺ raat ko jab tahajjud ke liye uthte thay to yeh padhte dua: Allahumma Rabba Jibrila wa Mika'ila wa Israfila, fatiras-samawati wal-ardi, 'alimal ghaibi wash-shahadati, anta tahkumu baina 'ibadika fima kanu fihi yakhtalifuna, ihdini lima-khtulifa fihi minal-haqqi bi-idhnika, innaka tahdi man tasha'u ila siratim-mustaqim.

Ya'ni ae Allah! Ae Jibraeel, o Mikaeel aur Israfeel ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal! Ae aasmanon aur zameenon ke paida karne wale, Ilah-ul-Alameen! Ae chhupe khule ke janne wale Allah Jalla Shanuhu! Tu hi apne bandon ke aapas ke ikhtilafat ka faisla karta hai. Meri dua hai ke jis jis cheez mein yeh ikhtilaf karein, tu mujhe us mein haq baat samjha. Tu jise chahe raah-e-rast dikhla deta hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek dua yeh bhi manqool hai: (Allahumma arinal-haqqa haqqan warzuqnat-tiba'ahu, wa arinal-batila batilan warzuqnaj-tinabahu, wala taj'alhu mutalabbisan 'alaina fanadill, waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama). Ae Allah! Hamein haq ko haq dikha aur us ki tabedari naseeb farma, aur batil ko batil dikha aur us se bacha. Kahin aisa na ho ke haq-o-batil hum par khalt-malt ho jaye aur hum behak jayen. Ae Allah! Hamein nek-o-kar aur parhezgar logon ka imam bana.

Hum sab ko aazmaish se guzarna hai, matlab yeh hai ke aazmaish aur imtehan se pehle jannat ki aarzoein theek nahin. Agli ummaton ka bhi imtehan liya gaya, unhein bhi bimariyan, museebatein pahunchin, ba'sa ke ma'ni faqiri o zura ke ma'ni sakht bimari bhi kiya gaya hai. (Zulzilu) un par dushmanon ka khauf is qadar tari hua ke kaanpne lage. Un tamam sakht imtehanon mein woh kamyab hue aur jannat ke waris bane. Sahih hadith mein hai, ek martaba Hazrat Khabbab bin Arat (R.A) ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aap hamari imdad ki dua nahin karte? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, bas abhi se ghabra uthe? Suno tum se agle muwahidon ko pakad kar un ke saron par aare rakh diye jate the aur cheer kar theek do tukde kar diye jate the lekin taham woh tauheed o sunnat se na hatte the, lohe ki kanghiyon se un ke gosht post noche jate the lekin woh Allah Ta'ala ke deen ko nahin chhodte the. Qasam Allah ki, is mere deen ko toh mera Rab is qadar pura karega ke bila khauf o khatar Sana'a se Hadhramaut tak sawar tanha safar karne lagega, use siwaye Allah ke kisi ka khauf na hoga, albatta dil mein yeh khayal hona aur baat hai ke kahin meri bakriyon par bhediya na pade, lekin afsos tum jaldi karte ho. Quran mein theek yahi mazmoon dusri jagah in alfaaz mein bayan hua hai. Aayat (Alif-Laam-Meem. Ahasiban-naasu ay-yutraku ay-yaqulu amanna wahum la yuftanoon) (29. Al-Ankabut: 1) Kya logon ne yeh samajh rakha hai ke woh mehez imaan ke iqrar se hi chhod diye jayenge aur un ki aazmaish na hogi? Hum ne toh aglon ki bhi aazmaish ki, sachon ko aur jhooton ko yaqeenan hum nikhar kar rahenge. Chunancha isi tarah Sahaba-e-Kiram (Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een) ki puri aazmaish hui, Youm-ul-Ahzab ko yani Jang-e-Khandaq mein hui, jaise khud Quran-e-Pak ne is ka naqsha khencha hai, farman hai: Aayat (Iz ja'ukum min fawqikum wa min asfala minkum wa iz zaghatil-absaru wa balaghatil-qulubul-hanajira wa tazununa billahi-zununa) (33. Al-Ahzab: 10) Yani jabke kafiron ne tumhein upar niche se gher liya, jabke aankhein pathra gayin aur dil halqum tak aa gaye aur Allah Ta'ala ke sath guman hone lage. Is jagah mominon ki puri aazmaish ho gayi aur woh khoob jhanjhod diye gaye, jabke munafiq aur dhal-mal yaqeen log kehne lage ke Allah Rasool ke wade toh ghuroor ke hi the. Heraclius (Harqal) ne jab Abu Sufyan se un ke kufr ki halat mein pucha tha ke tumhari koi ladai bhi is dawedar-e-nabuwat se hui hai? Abu Sufyan ne kaha haan. Pucha phir kya rang raha? Kaha kabhi hum ghalib rahe kabhi woh ghalib rahe. Toh Heraclius ne kaha, ambiya ki aazmaish isi tarah hoti rehti hai lekin anjam-e-kaar khula ghalba unhin ka hota hai. Masl ke ma'ni tareeqa ke hain jaise aur jagah hai: Aayat (Wa mada maslul-awwaleen) (43. Az-Zukhruf: 8).

(Az-Zukhruf: 8), agle mominon ne ma'e nabiyon ke aise waqt mein Allah Ta'ala ki madad talab ki aur sakht aur tangi se nijat chahi jinhein jawab mila ke Allah Ta'ala ki imdad bahut hi nazdeek hai jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Fa-inna ma'al usri yusra, inna ma'al usri yusra) (94. Ash-Sharh: 5-6), yaqeenan sakhti ke sath aasani hai burai ke sath bhalai hai, ek hadith mein hai ke bande jab na-umeed hone lagte hain to Allah Ta'ala ta'ajjub karta hai ke meri faryad-rasi to aa pahunchne ko hai aur yeh na-umeed hota chala ja raha hai pas Allah Ta'ala un ki ujlat aur apni rahmat ke qurb par hans deta hai.

Nafli Khairat: Muqatil farmate hain yeh aayat nafli khairat ke baare mein hai, Suddi kehte hain ise aayat-e-Zakat ne mansookh kar diya. Lekin yeh qaul zara ghaur talab hai, matlab aayat ka yeh hai ke ae Nabi log tum se sawal karte hain ke woh kis tarah kharch karein tum unhein keh do ke un logon se sulook karein jin ka bayan hua. Hadith mein hai ke apni maa se sulook kar aur apne baap aur apni behen se aur apne bhai se phir aur qareebi aur qareebi logon se. Yeh hadith bayan farma kar Hazrat Maimoon bin Mehran (R.H) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya yeh hain jin ke saath maali sulook kiya jaye aur un par maal kharch kiya jaye na ke tablon, bajon, tasweeron aur deewaron par kapra chaspan karne mein. Phir irshad hota hai tum jo bhi nek kaam karo us ka ilm Allah Ta'ala ko hai aur woh us par behtareen badla ata farmaye ga, woh zarre barabar bhi zulm nahin karta.

Jihad baqa-e-millat ka bunyadi usool. Dushmanan-e-Islam se Deen-e-Islam ke bachao ke liye Jihad ki farziyat ka is aayat mein hukum ho raha hai. Zuhri R.H farmate hain Jihad har shakhs par farz hai, khwah ladai mein nikle khwah baitha rahe, sab ka farz hai ke jab un se madad talab ki jaye to woh imdad karein, jab un se faryad ki jaye yeh faryad-rasi karein, jab unhein maidan mein bulaya jaye yeh nikal khade hon. Sahih Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai, jo shakhs mar jaye aur us ne na to Jihad kiya ho na apne dil mein Jihad ki baat-cheet ki ho, woh Jahiliyat ki maut marega. Aur Hadith mein hai, Fatah-e-Makkah ke baad Hijrat to nahin rahi lekin Jihad aur niyat majood hai aur jab tum se Jihad ke liye nikalne ko kaha jaye to nikal khade ho, yeh hukum Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Makkah ki fatah ke din farmaya tha. Phir farmaya hai hukum-e-Jihad go tum par bhari padega aur is mein tumhein mushaqqat aur takleef nazar aayegi, mumkin hai qatl bhi kiye jao, mumkin hai zakhmi ho jao, phir safar ki takleef, dushmanon ki yurish ka muqabla ho, lekin samjho to mumkin hai tum bura jaano aur ho tumhare liye achha, kyunke isi se tumhara ghalba aur dushman ki pamali hai, un ke maal, un ke mulk, balkay un ke baal-bachay tak bhi tumhare qadmon mein gir padein ge. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke tum kisi cheez ko apne liye achha jaano aur woh hi tumhare liye bura ho, umooman aisa hota hai ke insaan ek cheez ko chahta hai lekin fil-waqay na is mein maslahat hoti hai na khair-o-barkat. Isi tarah go tum Jihad na karne mein achhai samjho, darasal woh tumhare liye zabardast burai hai kyunke is se dushman tum par ghalib aa jayega aur duniya mein qadam tikane ko bhi tumhein jagah na milegi. Tamam kaamon ke anjaam ka ilm mahaz Parwardigar-e-Aalam hi ko hai, woh jaanta hai ke kaunsa kaam tumhare liye anjaam ke lihaz se achha hai aur kaunsa bura hai, woh isi kaam ka hukum deta hai jis mein tumhare liye donon jahan ki behtari ho. Tum us ke ahkaam dil-o-jaan se qabool kar liya karo aur us ke har har hukum ko kushada peshani se maan liya karo, isi mein tumhari bhalai aur umdagi hai.

Hazrami ka qatl: Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek jamaat ko bheja aur us ka ameer Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) ko banaya. Jab woh jaane lage toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se judai ke sadme se ro diye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein rok liya aur un ke badle Hazrat Abdullah bin Jahsh (R.A) ko sardar-e-lashkar muqarrar kiya aur unhein ek khat likh kar diya aur farmaya ke jab tak Batn-e-Nakhla na pahuncho is khat ko na parhna aur wahan pahunch kar jab is mazmoon ko dekho toh sathiyon mein se kisi ko apne sath chalne par majboor na karna. Chunancha Hazrat Abdullah is mukhtasar si jamaat ko le kar chale. Jab is maqam par pahunche toh farman-e-Nabi parha aur kaha main farmanbardari ke liye tayyar hoon, phir apne sathiyon ko parh kar sunaya aur waqia bayan kiya. Do shakhs toh laut gaye lekin aur sab sath chalne ke liye amada ho gaye. Aage chal kar Ibn-ul-Hazrami kafir ko unhon ne paya. Chunki yeh ilm na tha ke Jamadi-ul-Akhra ka yeh aakhri din hai ya Rajab ka pehla din hai, unhon ne is lashkar par hamla kar diya. Ibn-ul-Hazrami mara gaya aur Sahaba ki yeh jamaat wahan wapas hui. Ab mushrikeen ne musalmanon par aitraz karna shuru kiya ke dekho unhon ne hurmat wale mahinon mein larai ki aur qatl bhi kiya. Is bare mein yeh aayat utri (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke is jamaat mein Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir, Hazrat Abu Huzaifa bin Utba bin Rabia, Hazrat Saad bin Abi Waqqas, Hazrat Utba bin Ghazwan Sulami, Hazrat Suhail bin Baiza, Hazrat Aamir bin Fuhaira aur Hazrat Waqid bin Abdullah Yarbu'i (R.A) thay. Batn-e-Nakhla pahunch kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Jahsh ne saaf farma diya tha ke jo shakhs shahadat ka aarzoo-mand ho wahi aage barhe. Yahan se wapas jaane wale Hazrat Saad bin Abi Waqqas aur Utba (R.A) thay. Un ke sath na jaane ki wajah yeh hui thi ke un ka oont gum ho gaya tha jis ke dhoondne mein woh reh gaye. Mushrikeen mein Hakam bin Kaisan, Usman bin Abdullah waghera thay. Hazrat Waqid ke hathon Amr qatl hua aur yeh jamaat maal-e-ghaneemat le kar lauti.

Yeh pehli ghanimat thi jo Musalman Sahaba (R.A) ko mili aur yeh janbaz jamaat do qaidiyon ko aur maal-e-ghanimat le kar wapas aayi. Mushrikeen-e-Makkah ne qaidiyon ka fidiya ada karna chaha (yahan asal Arabi mein kuch ibarat chhoot gayi hai) aur unhon ne aitraazan kaha ke dekho Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka dawa yeh hai ke woh Allah ke itaat guzar hain lekin hurmat wale mahinon ki koi hurmat nahin karte aur mah-e-Rajab mein jidal-o-qital karte hain. Musalman kehte the ke hum ne Rajab mein qatl nahin kiya balkay Jamadi-ul-Akhra mein ladai hui hai. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke woh Rajab ki pehli raat aur Jamadi-ul-Akhra ki aakhri shab thi, Rajab shuru hote hi Musalmanon ki talwarein miyan mein ho gayi thin. Mushrikeen ke is aitraz ka jawab is aayat mein diya ja raha hai ke yeh sach hai ke in mahinon mein jang haram hai lekin ae mushrikon! tumhari badaamaliyan toh burai mein is se bhi badh kar hain. Tum Allah ka inkar karte ho, tum mere Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur un ke sathiyon ko meri masjid se rokte ho, tum ne unhein wahan se nikal diya, pas apni in siyah kariyon par nazar daalo ke yeh kis qadar badtareen kaam hain. Inhi hurmat wale mahinon mein hi mushrikeen ne Musalmanon ko Baitullah Sharif se roka tha aur woh majbooran wapas hue the, agle saal Allah Ta'ala ne hurmat wale mahinon mein hi Makkah ko apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hath fath karwaya.

Inhein in aayaton mein lajawab kiya gaya. Amr-e-ibn-ul-Hazrami jo qatl kiya gaya, yeh Taif se Makkah ko aa raha tha, go Rajab ka chand charh chuka tha lekin Sahaba ko maloom na tha, woh is raat ko Jamadi-ul-Akhra ki aakhri raat jaante thay. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Jahsh ke sath aath aadmi thay, saat toh wahi jin ke naam oopar bayan hue, aathwein Hazrat Rabab Asadi (R.A) thay. Inhein Badr-e-Ula se wapsi ke waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bheja tha. Yeh sab Muhajir Sahaba thay, in mein ek bhi Ansari na tha. Do din chal kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is nama-e-mubarak ko parha jis mein tahrir tha ke mere is hukm-nama ko parh kar Makkah aur Taif ke darmiyan Nakhla mein jao, wahan thahro aur Quraish ke qafila ka intezar karo aur un ki khabrein maloom kar ke mujhe pahunchao. Yeh buzurg yahan se chale toh sab hi chale thay, do Sahabi jo oont ko dhoondne ke liye reh gaye thay woh bhi yahan se sath hi thay lekin Faragh ke oopar Ma'dan par pahunch kar Najran mein unhein oonton ki talash mein ruk jana para. Quraishiyon ke is qafila mein zaitoon waghera tijarati maal tha. Mushrikeen mein alawa un logon ke jin ke naam oopar bayan hue hain, Naufal bin Abdullah waghera bhi thay. Musalman awwal toh unhein dekh kar ghabraye lekin phir mashwara kar ke Musalmanon ne hamla yeh soch kar kiya ke agar inhein chor diya toh is raat ke baad hurmat ka mahina aa jayega toh hum phir kuch bhi na kar sakenge. Unhon ne shuja'at-o-mardangi ke sath hamla kiya. Hazrat Waqid bin Abdullah Tamimi (R.A) ne Amr-e-ibn-e-Hazrami ko aisa taak kar teer lagaya ke us ka toh faisla hi ho gaya, Usman aur Hakam ko qaid kar liya aur maal waghera le kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein pahunche. Rasta mein hi sardar-e-lashkar ne keh diya tha ke is maal mein se panchwan hissa toh Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka hai, chunancha yeh hissa toh alag kar ke rakh diya gaya aur baqi maal Sahaba mein taqseem kar diya aur ab tak yeh hukm nazil nahin hua tha ke maal-e-ghaneemat mein se panchwan hissa nikalna chahiye. Jab yeh lashkar Sarkar-e-Nabwi mein pahuncha toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne waqea sun kar narazgi zahir farmayi aur farmaya ke main ne tumhein hurmat wale mahinon mein larai karne ko kab kaha tha? Na toh qafila ka kuch maal Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne liya na qaidiyon ko qabza mein kiya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is qaul-o-fe'l se yeh Musalman sakht nadim hue aur apni gunahgari ka unhein yaqeen ho gaya. Phir aur Musalmanon ne bhi unhein kuch kehna sunna shuru kiya. Idhar Quraishiyon ne ta'ana dena shuru kiya ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Aap ke Sahaba hurmat wale mahinon mein bhi jidal-o-qital se baaz nahin rehte. Doosri janib Yahudiyon ne ek bad-fali nikali, chunke Amr-e-qatl kiya gaya tha unhon ne kaha "Amrat-ul-Harb" (larai par raunaq aur khoob zor-o-shor se lambi muddat tak hogi). Is ke baap ka naam Hazrami tha is se unhon ne faal li ke "Hazrat-ul-Harb" (waqt-e-larai aa pahuncha). Qatil ka naam Waqid tha jis se unhon ne kaha "Waqadat-ul-Harb" (larai ki aag bhark uthi) lekin Qudrat ne ise bar-aks kar diya aur natija tamam-tar mushrikeen ke khilaf raha aur un ke aitraz ke jawab mein yeh aayat nazil hui ke agar bilfarz jang hurmat wale mahina mein hui bhi ho toh is se bhi badtareen tumhari siyah-kariyaan majood hain. Tumhara yeh fitna ke tum deen-e-Allah se Musalmanon ko murtad karne ki apni tamam-tar imkani koshishein kar rahe ho, yeh is qatl se bhi barh kar hai aur tum na toh apne in kamon se rukte ho na tauba karte ho na is par nadim hote ho. In aayaton ke nazil hone ke baad Musalman is ranj-o-afsos se nijat paye.

Aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qafila aur qaidiyon ko apne qabza mein liya, Quraishiyon ne phir aap ke paas qasid bheja ke in dono qaidiyon ka fidiya le lijiye magar aap ne farmaya ke mere dono sahabi Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas aur Utba bin Ghazwan (R.A) jab aajayen tab aao mujhe dar hai ke tum unhein eeza na pahunchao chunancha jab woh aagaye to aap ne fidiya le liya aur dono qaidiyon ko raha kardiya. Hakam bin Kaisan (R.A) to musalman hogaye aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hi reh gaye aakhir Be'r Ma'una ki ladai mein shaheed hue (R.A). Haan Usman bin Abdullah Makkah wapas gaya aur wahin kufr mein hi mara, in ghaziyon ko yeh aayat sun kar badi khushi hasil hui aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki narazgi ki wajah se hurmat wale mahinon ki be-adabi ke sabab se dusre sahabi ki chashmak ki bina par kuffar ke ta'ana ke ba'is jo ranj-o-gham un ke dilon par tha sab door hogaya lekin ab yeh fikr padi ke hamain ukhrawi ajr bhi milega ya nahin hum ghaziyon mein bhi shumar honge ya nahin jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh sawalat kiye gaye to is ke jawab mein yeh aayat (Innal-lazina amanu) ilakh, nazil hui aur un ki badi badi ummeeden bandh gayin (R.A) ajma'in. Islam aur kufr ke muqabla mein kafiron mein sab se pehle yahi Ibn-ul-Hadrami mara gaya, kuffar ka wafd Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur sawal kiya ke kya hurmat wale mahinon mein qatl karna jaiz hai aur is par yeh aayat (Yas'alunaka) ilakh, nazil hui. Yahi maal-e-ghanimat tha jo sab se pehle musalmanon ke haath laga aur sab se pehle panchwan hissa Hazrat Abdullah bin Jahsh ne hi nikala jo Islam mein baqi raha aur hukm-e-Ilahi bhi is tarah nazil hua aur yahi do qaidi thay jo sab se pehle musalmanon ke hathon aseer hue, is waqea ko ek nazm mein bhi ada kiya gaya hai ba'az to kehte hain ke yeh ashaar Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ke hain lekin yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh ashaar Abdullah bin Jahsh ke hain jo is mukhtasar se lashkar ke sardar thay Allah un se khush ho.

Hazrami ka qatl: Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek jamaat ko bheja aur us ka ameer Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) ko banaya. Jab woh jaane lage toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se judai ke sadme se ro diye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein rok liya aur un ke badle Hazrat Abdullah bin Jahsh (R.A) ko sardar-e-lashkar muqarrar kiya aur unhein ek khat likh kar diya aur farmaya ke jab tak Batn-e-Nakhla na pahuncho is khat ko na parhna aur wahan pahunch kar jab is mazmoon ko dekho toh sathiyon mein se kisi ko apne sath chalne par majboor na karna. Chunancha Hazrat Abdullah is mukhtasar si jamaat ko le kar chale. Jab is maqam par pahunche toh farman-e-Nabi parha aur kaha main farmanbardari ke liye tayyar hoon, phir apne sathiyon ko parh kar sunaya aur waqia bayan kiya. Do shakhs toh laut gaye lekin aur sab sath chalne ke liye amada ho gaye. Aage chal kar Ibn-ul-Hazrami kafir ko unhon ne paya. Chunki yeh ilm na tha ke Jamadi-ul-Akhra ka yeh aakhri din hai ya Rajab ka pehla din hai, unhon ne is lashkar par hamla kar diya. Ibn-ul-Hazrami mara gaya aur Sahaba ki yeh jamaat wahan wapas hui. Ab mushrikeen ne musalmanon par aitraz karna shuru kiya ke dekho unhon ne hurmat wale mahinon mein larai ki aur qatl bhi kiya. Is bare mein yeh aayat utri (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke is jamaat mein Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir, Hazrat Abu Huzaifa bin Utba bin Rabia, Hazrat Saad bin Abi Waqqas, Hazrat Utba bin Ghazwan Sulami, Hazrat Suhail bin Baiza, Hazrat Aamir bin Fuhaira aur Hazrat Waqid bin Abdullah Yarbu'i (R.A) thay. Batn-e-Nakhla pahunch kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Jahsh ne saaf farma diya tha ke jo shakhs shahadat ka aarzoo-mand ho wahi aage barhe. Yahan se wapas jaane wale Hazrat Saad bin Abi Waqqas aur Utba (R.A) thay. Un ke sath na jaane ki wajah yeh hui thi ke un ka oont gum ho gaya tha jis ke dhoondne mein woh reh gaye. Mushrikeen mein Hakam bin Kaisan, Usman bin Abdullah waghera thay. Hazrat Waqid ke hathon Amr qatl hua aur yeh jamaat maal-e-ghaneemat le kar lauti.

Yeh pehli ghanimat thi jo Musalman Sahaba (R.A) ko mili aur yeh janbaz jamaat do qaidiyon ko aur maal-e-ghanimat le kar wapas aayi. Mushrikeen-e-Makkah ne qaidiyon ka fidiya ada karna chaha (yahan asal Arabi mein kuch ibarat chhoot gayi hai) aur unhon ne aitraazan kaha ke dekho Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka dawa yeh hai ke woh Allah ke itaat guzar hain lekin hurmat wale mahinon ki koi hurmat nahin karte aur mah-e-Rajab mein jidal-o-qital karte hain. Musalman kehte the ke hum ne Rajab mein qatl nahin kiya balkay Jamadi-ul-Akhra mein ladai hui hai. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke woh Rajab ki pehli raat aur Jamadi-ul-Akhra ki aakhri shab thi, Rajab shuru hote hi Musalmanon ki talwarein miyan mein ho gayi thin. Mushrikeen ke is aitraz ka jawab is aayat mein diya ja raha hai ke yeh sach hai ke in mahinon mein jang haram hai lekin ae mushrikon! tumhari badaamaliyan toh burai mein is se bhi badh kar hain. Tum Allah ka inkar karte ho, tum mere Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur un ke sathiyon ko meri masjid se rokte ho, tum ne unhein wahan se nikal diya, pas apni in siyah kariyon par nazar daalo ke yeh kis qadar badtareen kaam hain. Inhi hurmat wale mahinon mein hi mushrikeen ne Musalmanon ko Baitullah Sharif se roka tha aur woh majbooran wapas hue the, agle saal Allah Ta'ala ne hurmat wale mahinon mein hi Makkah ko apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hath fath karwaya.

Inhein in aayaton mein lajawab kiya gaya. Amr-e-ibn-ul-Hazrami jo qatl kiya gaya, yeh Taif se Makkah ko aa raha tha, go Rajab ka chand charh chuka tha lekin Sahaba ko maloom na tha, woh is raat ko Jamadi-ul-Akhra ki aakhri raat jaante thay. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Jahsh ke sath aath aadmi thay, saat toh wahi jin ke naam oopar bayan hue, aathwein Hazrat Rabab Asadi (R.A) thay. Inhein Badr-e-Ula se wapsi ke waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bheja tha. Yeh sab Muhajir Sahaba thay, in mein ek bhi Ansari na tha. Do din chal kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is nama-e-mubarak ko parha jis mein tahrir tha ke mere is hukm-nama ko parh kar Makkah aur Taif ke darmiyan Nakhla mein jao, wahan thahro aur Quraish ke qafila ka intezar karo aur un ki khabrein maloom kar ke mujhe pahunchao. Yeh buzurg yahan se chale toh sab hi chale thay, do Sahabi jo oont ko dhoondne ke liye reh gaye thay woh bhi yahan se sath hi thay lekin Faragh ke oopar Ma'dan par pahunch kar Najran mein unhein oonton ki talash mein ruk jana para. Quraishiyon ke is qafila mein zaitoon waghera tijarati maal tha. Mushrikeen mein alawa un logon ke jin ke naam oopar bayan hue hain, Naufal bin Abdullah waghera bhi thay. Musalman awwal toh unhein dekh kar ghabraye lekin phir mashwara kar ke Musalmanon ne hamla yeh soch kar kiya ke agar inhein chor diya toh is raat ke baad hurmat ka mahina aa jayega toh hum phir kuch bhi na kar sakenge. Unhon ne shuja'at-o-mardangi ke sath hamla kiya. Hazrat Waqid bin Abdullah Tamimi (R.A) ne Amr-e-ibn-e-Hazrami ko aisa taak kar teer lagaya ke us ka toh faisla hi ho gaya, Usman aur Hakam ko qaid kar liya aur maal waghera le kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein pahunche. Rasta mein hi sardar-e-lashkar ne keh diya tha ke is maal mein se panchwan hissa toh Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka hai, chunancha yeh hissa toh alag kar ke rakh diya gaya aur baqi maal Sahaba mein taqseem kar diya aur ab tak yeh hukm nazil nahin hua tha ke maal-e-ghaneemat mein se panchwan hissa nikalna chahiye. Jab yeh lashkar Sarkar-e-Nabwi mein pahuncha toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne waqea sun kar narazgi zahir farmayi aur farmaya ke main ne tumhein hurmat wale mahinon mein larai karne ko kab kaha tha? Na toh qafila ka kuch maal Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne liya na qaidiyon ko qabza mein kiya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is qaul-o-fe'l se yeh Musalman sakht nadim hue aur apni gunahgari ka unhein yaqeen ho gaya. Phir aur Musalmanon ne bhi unhein kuch kehna sunna shuru kiya. Idhar Quraishiyon ne ta'ana dena shuru kiya ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Aap ke Sahaba hurmat wale mahinon mein bhi jidal-o-qital se baaz nahin rehte. Doosri janib Yahudiyon ne ek bad-fali nikali, chunke Amr-e-qatl kiya gaya tha unhon ne kaha "Amrat-ul-Harb" (larai par raunaq aur khoob zor-o-shor se lambi muddat tak hogi). Is ke baap ka naam Hazrami tha is se unhon ne faal li ke "Hazrat-ul-Harb" (waqt-e-larai aa pahuncha). Qatil ka naam Waqid tha jis se unhon ne kaha "Waqadat-ul-Harb" (larai ki aag bhark uthi) lekin Qudrat ne ise bar-aks kar diya aur natija tamam-tar mushrikeen ke khilaf raha aur un ke aitraz ke jawab mein yeh aayat nazil hui ke agar bilfarz jang hurmat wale mahina mein hui bhi ho toh is se bhi badtareen tumhari siyah-kariyaan majood hain. Tumhara yeh fitna ke tum deen-e-Allah se Musalmanon ko murtad karne ki apni tamam-tar imkani koshishein kar rahe ho, yeh is qatl se bhi barh kar hai aur tum na toh apne in kamon se rukte ho na tauba karte ho na is par nadim hote ho. In aayaton ke nazil hone ke baad Musalman is ranj-o-afsos se nijat paye.

Hurmat-e-Sharab Kyun? Jab sharab ki hurmat ki aayat nazil hui toh Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne kaha ya Allah tu is ka wazeh bayan farma. In par Surah Al-Baqarah ki yeh aayat (يَسْــَٔـلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الْخَــمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ) (2-Al-Baqarah: 219) nazil hui. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur unhein yeh aayat parh kar sunayi gayi lekin Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne phir bhi yahi dua ki ke ya Allah ise hamare liye aur zyada saaf bayan farma. Is par Surah An-Nisa ki aayat (يٰٓاَيُّھَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاَنْتُمْ سُكٰرٰى حَتّٰى تَعْلَمُوْا مَا تَقُوْلُوْنَ وَلَا جُنُبًا اِلَّا عَابِرِيْ سَبِيْلٍ حَتّٰى تَغْتَسِلُوْا) (4-An-Nisa: 43) nazil hui aur har namaz ke waqt pukara jane laga ke nashe wale log namaz ke qareeb bhi na aayen. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur un ke samne is aayat ki bhi tilawat ki gayi, aap ne phir bhi yahi dua ki ya Allah hamare liye is ka bayan aur wazeh kar. Is par Surah Al-Ma'idah ki aayat (Innama al-khamru... al-kh) utri. Jab Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ko bula kar yeh aayat bhi sunayi gayi aur jab un ke kaan mein aayat ke aakhri alfaaz (فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ مُّنْتَهُوْنَ) (5-Al-Ma'idah: 91) pare toh aap bol uthay, "Antahaina, antahaina" (hum ruk gaye, hum baaz aaye). Mulahiza ho Musnad Ahmad, Tirmidhi aur Nasai waghera, Ibn Abi Hatim aur Ibn Marduyah mein bhi riwayat hai lekin is ka rawi Abu Maisarah hai jin ka naam Umar bin Sharjeel Hamdani Kufi hai, Abu Zur'ah farmate hain ke un ka sama' Hazrat Umar (R.A) se sabit nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Imam Ali bin Madini farmate hain is ki asnaad saleh aur sahih hai, Imam Tirmidhi bhi ise sahih kehte hain. Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke (Antahaina, antahaina) ke qaul ke baad yeh bhi hai ke sharab maal ko barbad karne wali aur aql ko khabt karne wali cheez hai. Yeh riwayat aur isi ke sath Musnad ki Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) wali aur riwayatein Surah Al-Ma'idah ki aayat (Innama al-khamru) ki tafsir mein mufassal bayan hongi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) farmate hain khamr har woh cheez hai jo aql ko dhanp le, is ka poora bayan bhi Surah Al-Ma'idah mein hi aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Maisir kehte hain juay bazi ko. Gunah is ka wabaal-e-ukhrawi hai aur faida sirf dunyawi hai ke badan ko kuch nafa pahunche ya ghiza hazam ho ya fazlay baramad hon ya ba'az zehan tez ho jayen ya ek tarah ka suroor hasil ho, jaise ke Hassan bin Thabit ka jahiliyat ke zamane ka sher hai: "Sharab pee kar hum badshah aur daleer ban jate hain." Isi tarah is ki khareedo-farokht aur kasheed mein bhi tijarati nafa mumkin hai ho jaye.

Isi tarah ju'e bazi mein mumkin hai jeet ho jaye, lekin in fawaid ke muqable mein nuqsanat in ke bakasrat hain kyunke is se aql ka mara jana, hosh-o-hawas ka bekar hona zaroori hai, sath hi deen ka barbad hona bhi hai, yeh ayat goya sharab ki hurmat ka pesh-e-khaima thi magar is mein saaf saaf hurmat bayan nahin hui thi isi liye Hazrat Umar (R.A) ki chahat thi ke khule lafzon mein sharab ki hurmat nazil ho, chunancha aakhir-kar Surah Ma'idah ki ayat mein saaf farma diya gaya ke sharab aur ju'a aur panse aur teer se faal lena sab haram aur shaitani kaam hain, aye musalmano agar nijat ke talib ho to in sab se baaz aa jao, shaitan ki tamanna hai ke sharab aur ju'e ke ba'is tum mein aapas mein adawat-o-bughz daal de aur tumhein Allah ke zikr aur namaz se rok de kya ab tum in shaitani kamon se ruk jane wale ban jao ge? Is ka poora bayan Insha'Allah Surah Ma'idah mein aaye ga, mufassireen-e-tabi'een farmate hain ke sharab ke bare mein pehle yahi ayat nazil hui, phir Surah Nisa ki ayat nazil hui phir Surah Ma'idah ki ayat utri aur sharab mukammal tor par haram ho gayi.

Afw aur is ki wazahatein: (Qul-il-Afw) ki ek qira'at Qul-il-Afw bhi hai aur dono qira'atein theek hain ma'ani qareeb qareeb aur ek ho sakte hain aur bandhi baith sakte hain, Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal aur Hazrat Sa'laba (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas aaye aur daryaft kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ)! Hamare ghulam bhi hain baal bache bhi hain aur hum maal-dar bhi hain kya kuch Allah ki rah mein dein? Jis ke jawab mein ayat (Qul-il-Afw) kaha gaya ya'ni jo apne baal bachon ke kharch ke baad bache, bohat se sahaba aur tabi'een se is ki yahi tafseer marwi hai, Hazrat Ta'oos kehte hain har cheez mein thoda thoda Allah ki rah bhi dete raha karo, Rabee' kehte hain afzal aur behtar maal Allah ki rah mein do, sab aqwal ka khulasa yeh hai ke haajat se za'id cheez Allah ki rah mein kharch karo, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain aisa na karo ke sab de daalo aur phir khud sawal ke liye baith jao, chunancha Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kaha Huzoor! Mere paas ek dinar hai aap ne farmaya apne kaam mein lao, kaha mere paas ek aur hai farmaya apni biwi par kharch karo kaha Hazrat ek aur hai farmaya apne bachon ki zarooriyaat par lagao kaha ek aur bhi hai farmaya ise to apni aql se khud bhi kar sakta hai.

Sahih Muslim Sharif ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek shakhs se farmaya apne nafs se shuru kar pehle isi par sadaqa kar phir tu apne baal bachon par phir bache to apne rishtedaron par phir tu aur aur haajat mandon par, isi kitab mein ek aur hadith mein hai ke sab se afzal khairat woh hai jo insaan apne kharch ke mutabiq baqi rakh kar bachi hui cheez ko Allah ki rah mein de upar wala hath neeche wale hath se afzal hai, pehle unhein de jin ka kharch tere zimma hai ek aur hadith mein hai ae Ibn-e-Adam jo tere paas apni zaroorat se zaid ho use Allah ki rah mein de dalna hi tere liye behtar hai is ka rok rakhna tere liye bura hai han apni zaroorat ke mutabiq kharch karne mein tujh par koi malamat nahin Ibn-e-Abbas ka ek qaul yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh hukm zakat ke hukm se mansookh ho gaya, Hazrat Mujahid kehte hain ke zakat ki ayat goya is ayat ki tafseer hai aur is ka wazeh bayan hai, theek qaul yahi hai. Phir irshad hai ke jis tarah yeh ahkaam wazeh kar ke khol khol kar hum ne bayan farmaye isi tarah hum baqi ahkaam bhi wazahat aur tashreeh ke sath bayan farmayenge, waade wa'eed bhi saaf taur par khol diye jayenge taake tum duniya-e-fani ki taraf be-raghbat ho kar aakhirat ki taraf mutawajjeh ho jao hamesha baqi rehne wali hai, Hazrat Hasan ne is ayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya Wallah jo ghaur-o-tadabbur karega jaan lega ke duniya bala ka ghar hai aur is ka anjam fana hai aur aakhirat jaza aur baqa ka ghar hai Hazrat Qatada farmate hain fikr karne se saaf maloom ho sakta hai ke duniya par aakhirat ko kis qadr fazeelat hai pas aqalmand ko chahiye ke aakhirat ki bhalai ke jama karne ki koshish mein lag jaye. Yateem ka maal aur hamari zimmedari. Phir yateem ke bare mein ahkaam nazil hote hain Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain pehle yeh hukm hua tha ke ayat (WALA TAQRABU MALAL YATEEMI ILLA BILLATI HIYA AHSANU HATTA YABLUGA ASHUDDAHU) (6. Al-An'am: 152) yani yateem ke maal ke qareeb bhi na jao magar is tareeqa se jo behtareen tareeqa ho aur farmaya gaya tha ayat (INNALLAZINA YAKULUNA AMWALAL YATAMA ZULMAN INNAMA YAKULUNA FI BUTUNIHIM NARA, WA SAYASLAWNA SA'IRA) (4. An-Nisa: 10). Yani jo log zulm se yateemon ka maal kha jate hain woh apne pet mein aag bhar rahe hain aur woh bhadakti hui jahannam mein anqareeb dakhil honge to in aayaton ko sun kar un logon ne jo yateemon ke wali the yateemon ka khana aur un ka pani apne ghar ke khane aur ghar ke pani se bilkul juda kar diya ab agar un ka paka hua khana bach jata to use ya to woh khud hi dusre waqt khaye ya kharab ho jaye to yun ek taraf to in yateemon ka nuqsan hone laga dusri janib waliyan-e-yateem bhi tang aa gaye ke kab tak ek hi ghar mein is tarah rakh rakhao kya karen to in logon ne aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se arz ki jis par yeh ayat (QUL ISLAHUN LAHUM KHAIR, WA IN TUKHALITUHUM FA IKHWANUKUM) (2. Al-Baqarah: 220) nazil hui aur nek niyati aur diyanat dari ke sath un ke maal ko apne maal mein mila lene ki rukhsat di gayi, Abu Dawood-o-Nasa'i waghera mein yeh riwayatein majood hain aur salaf-o-khalaf ki ek bahut badi jamaat ne is ka shaan-e-nuzool yahi bayan farmaya hai, Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain yateem ke maal ki is tarah dekh bhaal sakht mushkil hai ke us ka khana peena mila jula rakhne ki ijazat di gayi is liye ke woh bhi deeni bhai hain ya niyat nek honi chahiye, qasd aur irada agar yateem ki nuqsan rasani ka hai to woh bhi Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala se posheeda nahin aur agar maqsood yateem ki bhalai aur us ke maal ki nigahbani hai to use bhi woh Allam-ul-Ghuyub bakhoobi jaanta hai. Phir farmaya ke Allah tumhein takleef-o-mashaqqat mein mubtala rakhna nahin chahta jo tangi aur haraj tum par yateem ka khana peena bilkul juda rakhne mein tha woh Allah Ta'ala ne door farma diya aur tum par takhfeef kar di aur ek handiya rakhna aur mila jula kaam karna tumhare liye mubah qarar diya, balkeh yateem ka nigran agar tang dast maskeen mohtaj ho to dastoor ke mutabiq apne kharch mein la sakta hai, aur agar kisi maal-dar ne apne ba-waqt-e-zaroorat us ki cheez kaam mein le li to phir ada kar de, yeh masail Insha'Allah wazahat ke sath Surah Nisa ki tafsir mein bayan hon ge.

Hurmat-e-Sharab Kyun? Jab sharab ki hurmat ki aayat nazil hui toh Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne kaha ya Allah tu is ka wazeh bayan farma. In par Surah Al-Baqarah ki yeh aayat (يَسْــَٔـلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الْخَــمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ) (2-Al-Baqarah: 219) nazil hui. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur unhein yeh aayat parh kar sunayi gayi lekin Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne phir bhi yahi dua ki ke ya Allah ise hamare liye aur zyada saaf bayan farma. Is par Surah An-Nisa ki aayat (يٰٓاَيُّھَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاَنْتُمْ سُكٰرٰى حَتّٰى تَعْلَمُوْا مَا تَقُوْلُوْنَ وَلَا جُنُبًا اِلَّا عَابِرِيْ سَبِيْلٍ حَتّٰى تَغْتَسِلُوْا) (4-An-Nisa: 43) nazil hui aur har namaz ke waqt pukara jane laga ke nashe wale log namaz ke qareeb bhi na aayen. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur un ke samne is aayat ki bhi tilawat ki gayi, aap ne phir bhi yahi dua ki ya Allah hamare liye is ka bayan aur wazeh kar. Is par Surah Al-Ma'idah ki aayat (Innama al-khamru... al-kh) utri. Jab Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ko bula kar yeh aayat bhi sunayi gayi aur jab un ke kaan mein aayat ke aakhri alfaaz (فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ مُّنْتَهُوْنَ) (5-Al-Ma'idah: 91) pare toh aap bol uthay, "Antahaina, antahaina" (hum ruk gaye, hum baaz aaye). Mulahiza ho Musnad Ahmad, Tirmidhi aur Nasai waghera, Ibn Abi Hatim aur Ibn Marduyah mein bhi riwayat hai lekin is ka rawi Abu Maisarah hai jin ka naam Umar bin Sharjeel Hamdani Kufi hai, Abu Zur'ah farmate hain ke un ka sama' Hazrat Umar (R.A) se sabit nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Imam Ali bin Madini farmate hain is ki asnaad saleh aur sahih hai, Imam Tirmidhi bhi ise sahih kehte hain. Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke (Antahaina, antahaina) ke qaul ke baad yeh bhi hai ke sharab maal ko barbad karne wali aur aql ko khabt karne wali cheez hai. Yeh riwayat aur isi ke sath Musnad ki Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) wali aur riwayatein Surah Al-Ma'idah ki aayat (Innama al-khamru) ki tafsir mein mufassal bayan hongi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) farmate hain khamr har woh cheez hai jo aql ko dhanp le, is ka poora bayan bhi Surah Al-Ma'idah mein hi aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Maisir kehte hain juay bazi ko. Gunah is ka wabaal-e-ukhrawi hai aur faida sirf dunyawi hai ke badan ko kuch nafa pahunche ya ghiza hazam ho ya fazlay baramad hon ya ba'az zehan tez ho jayen ya ek tarah ka suroor hasil ho, jaise ke Hassan bin Thabit ka jahiliyat ke zamane ka sher hai: "Sharab pee kar hum badshah aur daleer ban jate hain." Isi tarah is ki khareedo-farokht aur kasheed mein bhi tijarati nafa mumkin hai ho jaye.

Isi tarah ju'e bazi mein mumkin hai jeet ho jaye, lekin in fawaid ke muqable mein nuqsanat in ke bakasrat hain kyunke is se aql ka mara jana, hosh-o-hawas ka bekar hona zaroori hai, sath hi deen ka barbad hona bhi hai, yeh ayat goya sharab ki hurmat ka pesh-e-khaima thi magar is mein saaf saaf hurmat bayan nahin hui thi isi liye Hazrat Umar (R.A) ki chahat thi ke khule lafzon mein sharab ki hurmat nazil ho, chunancha aakhir-kar Surah Ma'idah ki ayat mein saaf farma diya gaya ke sharab aur ju'a aur panse aur teer se faal lena sab haram aur shaitani kaam hain, aye musalmano agar nijat ke talib ho to in sab se baaz aa jao, shaitan ki tamanna hai ke sharab aur ju'e ke ba'is tum mein aapas mein adawat-o-bughz daal de aur tumhein Allah ke zikr aur namaz se rok de kya ab tum in shaitani kamon se ruk jane wale ban jao ge? Is ka poora bayan Insha'Allah Surah Ma'idah mein aaye ga, mufassireen-e-tabi'een farmate hain ke sharab ke bare mein pehle yahi ayat nazil hui, phir Surah Nisa ki ayat nazil hui phir Surah Ma'idah ki ayat utri aur sharab mukammal tor par haram ho gayi.

Afw aur is ki wazahatein: (Qul-il-Afw) ki ek qira'at Qul-il-Afw bhi hai aur dono qira'atein theek hain ma'ani qareeb qareeb aur ek ho sakte hain aur bandhi baith sakte hain, Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal aur Hazrat Sa'laba (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas aaye aur daryaft kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ)! Hamare ghulam bhi hain baal bache bhi hain aur hum maal-dar bhi hain kya kuch Allah ki rah mein dein? Jis ke jawab mein ayat (Qul-il-Afw) kaha gaya ya'ni jo apne baal bachon ke kharch ke baad bache, bohat se sahaba aur tabi'een se is ki yahi tafseer marwi hai, Hazrat Ta'oos kehte hain har cheez mein thoda thoda Allah ki rah bhi dete raha karo, Rabee' kehte hain afzal aur behtar maal Allah ki rah mein do, sab aqwal ka khulasa yeh hai ke haajat se za'id cheez Allah ki rah mein kharch karo, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain aisa na karo ke sab de daalo aur phir khud sawal ke liye baith jao, chunancha Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kaha Huzoor! Mere paas ek dinar hai aap ne farmaya apne kaam mein lao, kaha mere paas ek aur hai farmaya apni biwi par kharch karo kaha Hazrat ek aur hai farmaya apne bachon ki zarooriyaat par lagao kaha ek aur bhi hai farmaya ise to apni aql se khud bhi kar sakta hai.

Sahih Muslim Sharif ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek shakhs se farmaya apne nafs se shuru kar pehle isi par sadaqa kar phir tu apne baal bachon par phir bache to apne rishtedaron par phir tu aur aur haajat mandon par, isi kitab mein ek aur hadith mein hai ke sab se afzal khairat woh hai jo insaan apne kharch ke mutabiq baqi rakh kar bachi hui cheez ko Allah ki rah mein de upar wala hath neeche wale hath se afzal hai, pehle unhein de jin ka kharch tere zimma hai ek aur hadith mein hai ae Ibn-e-Adam jo tere paas apni zaroorat se zaid ho use Allah ki rah mein de dalna hi tere liye behtar hai is ka rok rakhna tere liye bura hai han apni zaroorat ke mutabiq kharch karne mein tujh par koi malamat nahin Ibn-e-Abbas ka ek qaul yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh hukm zakat ke hukm se mansookh ho gaya, Hazrat Mujahid kehte hain ke zakat ki ayat goya is ayat ki tafseer hai aur is ka wazeh bayan hai, theek qaul yahi hai. Phir irshad hai ke jis tarah yeh ahkaam wazeh kar ke khol khol kar hum ne bayan farmaye isi tarah hum baqi ahkaam bhi wazahat aur tashreeh ke sath bayan farmayenge, waade wa'eed bhi saaf taur par khol diye jayenge taake tum duniya-e-fani ki taraf be-raghbat ho kar aakhirat ki taraf mutawajjeh ho jao hamesha baqi rehne wali hai, Hazrat Hasan ne is ayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya Wallah jo ghaur-o-tadabbur karega jaan lega ke duniya bala ka ghar hai aur is ka anjam fana hai aur aakhirat jaza aur baqa ka ghar hai Hazrat Qatada farmate hain fikr karne se saaf maloom ho sakta hai ke duniya par aakhirat ko kis qadr fazeelat hai pas aqalmand ko chahiye ke aakhirat ki bhalai ke jama karne ki koshish mein lag jaye. Yateem ka maal aur hamari zimmedari. Phir yateem ke bare mein ahkaam nazil hote hain Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain pehle yeh hukm hua tha ke ayat (WALA TAQRABU MALAL YATEEMI ILLA BILLATI HIYA AHSANU HATTA YABLUGA ASHUDDAHU) (6. Al-An'am: 152) yani yateem ke maal ke qareeb bhi na jao magar is tareeqa se jo behtareen tareeqa ho aur farmaya gaya tha ayat (INNALLAZINA YAKULUNA AMWALAL YATAMA ZULMAN INNAMA YAKULUNA FI BUTUNIHIM NARA, WA SAYASLAWNA SA'IRA) (4. An-Nisa: 10). Yani jo log zulm se yateemon ka maal kha jate hain woh apne pet mein aag bhar rahe hain aur woh bhadakti hui jahannam mein anqareeb dakhil honge to in aayaton ko sun kar un logon ne jo yateemon ke wali the yateemon ka khana aur un ka pani apne ghar ke khane aur ghar ke pani se bilkul juda kar diya ab agar un ka paka hua khana bach jata to use ya to woh khud hi dusre waqt khaye ya kharab ho jaye to yun ek taraf to in yateemon ka nuqsan hone laga dusri janib waliyan-e-yateem bhi tang aa gaye ke kab tak ek hi ghar mein is tarah rakh rakhao kya karen to in logon ne aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se arz ki jis par yeh ayat (QUL ISLAHUN LAHUM KHAIR, WA IN TUKHALITUHUM FA IKHWANUKUM) (2. Al-Baqarah: 220) nazil hui aur nek niyati aur diyanat dari ke sath un ke maal ko apne maal mein mila lene ki rukhsat di gayi, Abu Dawood-o-Nasa'i waghera mein yeh riwayatein majood hain aur salaf-o-khalaf ki ek bahut badi jamaat ne is ka shaan-e-nuzool yahi bayan farmaya hai, Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain yateem ke maal ki is tarah dekh bhaal sakht mushkil hai ke us ka khana peena mila jula rakhne ki ijazat di gayi is liye ke woh bhi deeni bhai hain ya niyat nek honi chahiye, qasd aur irada agar yateem ki nuqsan rasani ka hai to woh bhi Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala se posheeda nahin aur agar maqsood yateem ki bhalai aur us ke maal ki nigahbani hai to use bhi woh Allam-ul-Ghuyub bakhoobi jaanta hai.
