Phir farmaya ke Allah tumhein takleef-o-mashaqqat mein mubtala rakhna nahin chahta jo tangi aur haraj tum par yateem ka khana peena bilkul juda rakhne mein tha woh Allah Ta'ala ne door farma diya aur tum par takhfeef kar di aur ek handiya rakhna aur mila jula kaam karna tumhare liye mubah qarar diya, balkeh yateem ka nigran agar tang dast maskeen mohtaj ho to dastoor ke mutabiq apne kharch mein la sakta hai, aur agar kisi maal-dar ne apne ba-waqt-e-zaroorat us ki cheez kaam mein le li to phir ada kar de, yeh masail Insha'Allah wazahat ke sath Surah Nisa ki tafsir mein bayan hon ge.

Pak daman auratein, but parast mushrika auraton se nikah ki hurmat bayan ho rahi hai, go aayat ka umoom toh har ek mushrika aurat se nikah karne ki mumanat par hi dalalat karta hai lekin dusri jagah farman hai aayat (وَالْمُحْصَنٰتُ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْكِتٰبَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ اِذَآ اٰتَيْتُمُوْهُنَّ اُجُوْرَهُنَّ مُحْصِنِيْنَ غَيْرَ مُسٰفِحِيْنَ وَلَا مُتَّخِذِيْٓ اَخْدَانٍ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 5) yani tum se pehle jo log Kitabullah diye gaye hain un ki pakdaman auraton se bhi jo zina kari se bachne wali hon un ke mehar ada kar ke un se nikah karna tumhare liye halal hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka qaul bhi yahi hai ke in mushrika auraton mein se Ahl-e-Kitab auratein makhsoos hain, Mujahid, Ikrimah, Saeed bin Jubair, Makhool, Hasan, Zahhak, Qatadah, Zaid bin Aslam aur Rabee bin Anas (Rahimahumullah) ka bhi yahi farman hai, baaz kehte hain yeh aayat sirf but parast mushrika auraton hi ke liye nazil hui hai yun keh lo ya wun matlab dono ka ek hi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne kai qisam ki auraton se nikah karne ko najayaz qarar diya siwaye imandar, hijrat kar ke aane wali auraton ke khusoosan un auraton se jo kisi dusre mazhab ki paband hon. Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah hai aayat (وَمَنْ يَّكْفُرْ بالْاِيْمَانِ فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهٗ ۡ وَهُوَ فِي الْاٰخِرَةِ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 5).

(Surah Al-Ma'idah: 5) Ya'ni kafiron ke a'maal barbad hain. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Talha bin Ubaidullah (R.A) sakht naraz hue yahan tak ke qareeb tha ke unhein kore lagayein, un dono buzurgon ne kaha ae Ameer-ul-Momineen aap naraz na hon hum unhein talaq de dete hain. Aap ne farmaya agar talaq deni halal hai to phir nikah bhi halal hona chahiye, main unhein tum se chheen loon ga aur is zillat ke sath unhein alag karoon ga, lekin yeh hadith nihayat ghareeb hai aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) se bilkul hi ghareeb hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ne Ahl-e-Kitab aurton se nikah kar ke halal hone par ijma naqal kiya hai aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke is asar ke bare mein tahrir kiya hai ke yeh sirf siyasi maslahat ki bina par tha taake musalman aurton se beraghibti na karein ya aur koi hikmat-e-amli is farman mein thi. Chunancha is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ko yeh farman mila to unhon ne jawab mein likha ke kya aap ise haram kehte hain? Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen ne jawab diya ke haram to nahin kehta magar mujhe khauf hai kahin tum momin aurton se nikah na karo? Is riwayat ki asnad bhi sahih hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne farmaya ke musalman mard nasrani aurat se nikah kar sakta hai lekin nasrani mard ka nikah musalman aurat se nahin ho sakta, is riwayat ki sanad pehli riwayat se zyada sahih hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein to ek marfoo hadith bhi ba-isnad marwi hai ke hum Ahl-e-Kitab ki aurton se nikah kar lein lekin Ahl-e-Kitab mard musalman aurton se nikah nahin kar sakte, lekin is ki sanad mein kuch kamzori hai magar ummat ka ijma isi par hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim (R.H) ki riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Farooq (R.A) ne Ahl-e-Kitab ke nikah ko na-pasand kiya aur is ayat ki tilawat farma di. Imam Bukhari (R.H) Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka yeh qaul bhi naqal farmate hain ke main kisi shirk ko is shirk se barh kar nahin pata ke woh aurat kehti hai ke Isa (A.S) us ke Allah hain. Hazrat Imam Ahmad (R.H) se is ayat ka matlab poocha jata hai to aap farmate hain murad is se Arab ki woh mushrika aurtein hain jo but-parast thin. Phir irshad hota hai ke iman wali londi shirk karne wali azad aurat se achi hai. Yeh farman Abdullah bin Rawaha (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hota hai, un ki ek siyah rang londi thi, ek martaba gussa mein aa kar use thappar maar diya tha, phir ghabraye hue An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur waqiya arz kiya. Aap ne poocha is ka kya khayal? Kaha huzoor! Woh rozay rakhti hai, namaz parhti hai, achi tarah wuzu karti hai, Allah ki wahdaniyat aur aap ki risalat ki gawahi deti hai.

Aap ne farmaya ae Abu Abdullah phir toh woh imandar hai, kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Qasam us Allah ki jis ne aap ko haq ke sath bheja hai main use azad kar dunga aur itna hi nahin balkeh us se nikah bhi kar lunga, chunancha yahi kiya jis par baaz musalmanon ne unhein ta'ana diya, woh chahte thay keh mushrikon mein un ka nikah kara dein aur unhein apni ladkiyan bhi dein taake sharafat-e-nasab qaim rahe, is par yeh farman nazil hua keh mushrik azad aurton se toh musalman londi hazarha darja behtar hai aur isi tarah mushrik azad mard se muslim ghulam bhi badh chadh kar hai. Musnad-e-Abd bin Humaid mein hai keh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya aurton ke mehez husn par farefta ho kar un se nikah na kar liya karo, mumkin hai un ka husn unhein maghroor kar de, aurton ke maal ke peeche un se nikah na kar liya karo mumkin hai maal unhein sarkash kar de, nikah karo toh deendari dekha karo, badsurat siyah-faam londi bhi agar deendar ho toh bahut afzal hai, lekin is hadith ke rawiyon mein Afriqi za'eef hai. Bukhari, Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se riwayat hai keh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya char baatein dekh kar aurton se nikah kiya jata hai, ek toh maal, dusre hasb-o-nasab, teesre jamal-o-khubsurti, chauthe deen, tum deendari tatolo. Muslim Sharif mein hai duniya kul ki kul ek mata'a hai, mata'a-e-duniya mein sab se afzal cheez nek-bakht aurat hai. Phir farman hai keh mushrik mardon ke nikah mein musalman aurtein bhi na do jaise aur jagah hai: Ayat (La hunna hillul lahum wa la hum yahilluna lahunna) (Surah Al-Mumtahanah: 10) na kafir aurtein musalman mardon ke liye halal, na musalman mard kafir aurton ke liye halal. Phir farman hai keh momin mard go chahe habshi ghulam ho phir bhi raees aur sardar azad kafir se behtar hai. In logon ka mel-jol, un ki sohbat, mohabbat-e-duniya, hifaz-e-duniya aur duniya talbi aur duniya ko akhirat par tarjeeh deni sikhati hain jis ka anjam jahannam hai aur Allah Ta'ala ke farman ki pabandi, us ke hukumon ki ta'meel jannat ki rehbari karti hai, gunahon ki maghfirat ka ba'is banti hai. Allah Ta'ala ne logon ke wa'z-o-nasihat aur pand-o-ibrat ke liye apni ayatein wazeh taur par bayan farma dein.

Ayyam-e-Haiz aur Jama' se mutaliqa masail: Hazrat Anas R.A farmate hain ke Yahudi log haiza aurton ko na apne sath khilate the aur na apne sath rakhte the, Sahaba ne is bare mein Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya jis ke jawab mein yeh aayat utri, aur Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya siwaye jama' ke aur sab kuch halal hai. Yahudi yeh sun kar kehne lage ke inhe to hamari mukhalifat hi se garz hai, Hazrat Usaid bin Huzair R.A aur Hazrat Abbad bin Bishr R.A ne Yahudiyon ka yeh kalam naqal kar ke kaha ke Huzoor ﷺ phir hamein jama' ki bhi rukhsat di jaye, Aap ﷺ ka chehra yeh sun kar mutaghayyar ho gaya yahan tak ke aur Sahaba ne khayal kiya ke Aap ﷺ un par naraz ho gaye. Jab yeh buzurg jane lage to An-Hazrat ﷺ ke paas koi buzurg tuhfatan doodh le kar aaye, Aap ﷺ ne un ke peeche aadmi bhej kar unhein bulaya aur woh doodh unhein pilaya, ab maloom hua ke woh gussa jata raha. (Muslim) Pas is farman ka ke haiz ki halat mein aurton se alag raho yeh matlab hua ke jama' na karo is liye ke aur sab halal hai. Aksar ulama ka mazhab hai ke siwaye jama' ke mubashirat jaiz hai, ahadees mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ bhi aisi halat mein azwaj-e-mutahharat se milte julte lekin woh tehband bandhe hue hoti thin (Abu Dawood). Hazrat Amara ki phuphi sahiba Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa R.A se sawal karti hain ke agar aurat haiz ki halat mein ho aur ghar mein miyan biwi ka ek hi bistar ho to woh kya kare? Yani is halat mein us ke sath us ka khawand so sakta hai ya nahin? Aap ne farmaya, suno ek martaba Rasool Allah ﷺ ghar mein tashreef laye, aate hi namaz ki jagah tashreef le gaye aur namaz mein mashghool ho gaye, der zyada lag gayi aur is arsa mein mujhe neend aa gayi, Aap ko jada lagne laga to Aap ﷺ ne mujh se farmaya idhar aao, main ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ main to haiz se hoon, Aap ﷺ ne mere ghutnon ke upar se kapda hatane ka hukum diya aur phir meri raan par rukhsar aur seena rakh kar let gaye, main bhi Aap ﷺ par jhuk gayi to sardi kuch kam hui aur is garmi se Aap ﷺ ko neend aa gayi. Hazrat Masroq R.H ek martaba Hazrat Ayesha R.A ke paas aaye aur kaha Assalamu alan-nabi wa ala ahlihi, Hazrat Ayesha R.A ne jawab de kar marhaba marhaba kaha aur andar aane ki ijazat di, Aap ne kaha Umm-ul-Momineen ek masala poochta hoon lekin sharm maloom hoti hai. Aap ne farmaya, sun main teri maa aur tu qaim maqam mere bete ke hai, jo poochna ho pooch, kaha farmaye aadmi ke liye apni haiza biwi halal hai? Farmaya siwaye sharmgah ke aur sab jaiz hai. (Ibn-e-Jarir) Aur sanadon se bhi mukhtalif alfaz ke sath Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen ka yeh qaul marwi hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A, Mujahid R.H, Hasan R.H aur Ikrama R.H ka fatwa bhi yahi hai, maqsad yeh hai ke haiza aurat ke sath letna baithna us ke sath khana peena wagaira umoor bil-ittifaq jaiz hain.

Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se manqool hai, main haiz se hoti thi, main haddi chusti thi aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi usi haddi ko wahin munh laga kar chuste thay, main pani peeti thi phir glass Aap (ﷺ) ko deti, Aap (ﷺ) bhi wahin munh laga kar usi glass se pani peete aur main us waqt haiza hoti thi. Abu Dawood mein riwayat hai ke mere haiz ke shuru dino mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) mere sath hi lihaf mein sote thay. Agar Aap (ﷺ) ka kapra kahin se kharab ho jata to Aap (ﷺ) utni hi jagah ko dho daalte. Agar jism-e-mubarak par kuch lag jata to use bhi dho daalte aur phir unhi kapron mein namaz parhte. Haan Abu Dawood ki ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain main jab haiz se hoti to bistar se utar jati aur boriye par aa jati. Nabi (ﷺ) mere qareeb bhi na aate jab tak main pak na ho jaun. To yeh riwayat mahmool hai ke Aap (ﷺ) parhez aur ehtiyat karte thay na yeh ke mahmool ho hurmat aur muman'at par. Ba'az hazrat yeh bhi farmate hain ke tehband hote hue faida uthaye. Hazrat Maimoona bint-e-Haris Hilaliya (R.A) farmati hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) jab apni kisi ahliya se unki haiz ki halat mein milna chahte thay to unhein hukum dete thay ke tehband bandh lein (Bukhari). Is tarah Bukhari Muslim mein bhi yeh hadith Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se marwi hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) se ek shakhs sawal karta hai ke meri biwi se mujhe uske haiz ki halat mein kya kuch halal hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tehband se oopar ka kul (Abu Dawood waghaira). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke is se bhi bachna behtar hai. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) aur Hazrat Shuraih (R.H) ka mazhab bhi yahi hai. Imam Shafi (R.H) ke is bare mein do qaul hain jin mein ek yeh bhi hai ke aksar Iraqiyon waghaira ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Yeh hazrat farmate hain ke yeh to muttafiqa faisla hai ke jima haram hai is liye iske aas-paas se bhi bachna chahiye taake hurmat mein waqay hone ka khatra na rahe. Halat-e-haiz mein jima ki hurmat aur is kaam ke karne wale ka gunahgar hona to yaqini amr hai jise tauba istighfar karna lazmi hai lekin ise kaffara bhi dena parega ya nahin is mein ulama-e-kiram ke do qaul hain. Ek to yeh ke kaffara bhi hai chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmed aur Sunan mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya jo shakhs apni haiza biwi se jima kare woh ek dinar ya aadha dinar sadqa de. Tirmidhi mein hai ke khoon agar surkh ho to ek dinar aur agar zard rang ka ho to aadha dinar. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke agar khoon peeche hat gaya aur abhi us aurat ne ghusal na kiya ho aur is halat mein uska khawand us se mile to aadha dinar warna poora dinar. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke kaffara kuch bhi nahin sirf Allah Azza-wa-Jal se istighfar kare. Imam Shafi (R.H) ka bhi aakhri aur zyada sahih yahi mazhab hai aur jamhoor ulama bhi isi ke qail hain. Jo hadithein oopar bayan huin unki nisbat yeh hazrat farmate hain ke unka marfoo hona sahih nahin balkay sahih baat yahi hai ke yeh mauqoof hai. Yeh farman ke jab tak auratein pak na ho jayen unke qareeb na jao.

Yeh tafsir hai us farman ki ke aurton se un ki haiz ki halat mein juda raho, is se maloom hota hai ke jis waqt haiz khatam ho jaye phir nazdiki halal hai. Hazrat Imam Abu Abdullah Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) farmate hain tuhr yani paki dalalat karti hai ke ab is se nazdiki jaiz hai. Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) aur Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ka yeh farmana ke hum mein se jab koi haiz se hoti to tehband bandh leti aur Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki chadar mein soti, is baat ko sabit karta hai ke jis nazdiki se mana kiya gaya hai woh jima hai, waise sona baithna waghera sab jaiz hai. Is ke baad yeh farman un ke pak ho jane ke baad un ke paas aao. Is mein irshad hai ke us ke ghusal kar lene ke baad un se jima karo. Imam Ibn Hazm (R.H) farmate hain ke har haiz ki pakizgi ke baad jima karna wajib hai, is ki daleel ayat (Fa'tu-hunna) hai jis mein hukm hai lekin yeh daleel koi pukhta nahin. Yeh amr to sirf hurmat ko hata dene ka elaan hai aur is ke siwa is ki koi daleel un ke paas nahin, ulama-e-usool mein se baaz to kehte hain ke amr yani hukm mutlaqan wujub ke liye hota hai un logon ko Imam Ibn Hazm (R.H) ka jawab bahut garan hai, baaz kehte hain yeh amr sirf ibahat ke liye hai aur chunke is se pehle muman'at warid ho chuki hai yeh qareena hai jo amr ko wujub se hata deta hai lekin yeh ghaur talab baat hai, daleel se jo baat sabit hai woh yeh hai ke aise mauqe par yani pehle mana ho phir "hukm" ho to hukm apni asal par rehta hai yani jo baat mana se pehle jaisi thi waisi hi ab ho jaye gi yani agar mana se pehle woh kaam wajib tha to ab bhi wajib hi rahe ga, jaise Quran-e-Karim mein hai ayat (Fa-idhan-salakhal-ashhurul-hurumu faqtulul-mushrikina haithu wajattumuhum wa khudhuhum wahsuruhum waq'udu lahum kulla marsad) (Surah At-Tawbah: 5) yani jab hurmat wale mahine guzar jayen to mushrikon se jihad karo. Aur agar yeh kaam muman'at se pehle mubah tha to ab bhi woh mubah rahe ga jaise ayat (Wa-idha halaltum fastadu) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 2) jab tum ehram khol do to shikar khelo, aur jagah hai ayat (Fa-idha qudiyatissalatu fantashiru fil-ardi wabtaghu min fadlillahi wadhkurullaha kathiran la'allakum tuflihun) (Surah Al-Jumu'ah: 10) yani jab namaz puri ho jaye to zameen mein phail jao. In ulama-e-kiram ka yeh faisla in mukhtalif aqwal ko jama bhi kar deta hai jo amr ke wujub waghera ke bare mein hain. Ghazali (R.H) waghera ne bhi ise bayan kiya hai aur baaz aimma-e-mutakhireen ne bhi ise pasand farmaya hai aur yahi sahih bhi hai. Yeh masla bhi yaad rahe ke tamam ulama-e-ummat ka ittefaq hai ke jab khoon-e-haiz ka aana ruk jaye, muddat-e-haiz guzar jaye phir bhi us ke khawand ko apni biwi se mujamat karni halal nahin jab tak woh ghusal na kar le, han agar woh mazoor ho aur ghusal ke ewaz tayammum karna use jaiz ho to tayammum kar le. Is ke baad us ke paas us ka khawand aa sakta hai.

Haan Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) in tamam ulama ke mukhalif hain, woh farmate hain ke jab haiz zyada se zyada dino tak aakhri mi'aad yani das din tak reh kar band hogaya toh uske khawand par us se sohbat karna halal hai, go usne ghusl na kiya ho, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke ek martaba toh lafz (Yatahharna) ka is se murad khoon-e-haiz ka band hona hai aur (Tatatharna) se murad ghusl karna hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Hasan (R.H), Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayat (R.H), Hazrat Lais bin Sa'ad (R.H) waghera bhi yahi farmate hain. Phir irshad hota hai us jagah se aao jahan se aane ka hukum Allah ne tumhein diya hai, murad is se aage ki jagah hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) waghera bahut se mufassireen ne is ke yahi ma'ani bayan kiye hain ke murad is se bachon ke tawallud hone ki jagah hai, is ke siwa aur jagah yani pakhana ki jagah jana haram hai, aisa karne se had se tajawuz karne wale hain. Sahaba aur Tabi'een se bhi yahi marwi hai ke matlab yeh hai ke jis jagah se halat-e-haiz mein tum roke gaye thay ab woh jagah tumhare liye halal hai, is se saaf zahir hai ke pakhana ki jagah wati karna haram hai. Is ka mufassal bayan bhi aata hai Insha'Allah. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke pakeezgi ki halat mein aao jabke haiz se nikal aayen, is liye is ke baad ke jumla mein hai ke gunahon se tauba karne walon, is halat mein jima se baaz rehne walon, gandgiyon aur napakiyon se bachne walon, haiz ki halat mein apni biwi se na milne walon ko Allah Ta'ala pasand farmata hai. Isi tarah dusri jagah se mehfooz rehne walon ko bhi Parwardigar apna mehboob bana leta hai.

Phir farmaya ke tumhari auratein tumhari khetiyan hain yani aulad hone ki jagah tum apni kheti mein jaise bhi chaho aao yani jagah toh wahi ek ho, tariqa khwah koi bhi ho, samne kar ke ya uske khilaf. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Yahood kehte thay ke jab aurat se mujamat samne rukh kar ke na ki jaye aur hamal thehar jaye toh bacha bhenga paida hota hai. Unki tardeed mein yeh jumla nazil hua ke mard ko ikhtiyar hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Yahudiyon ne yahi baat Musalmanon se bhi kahi thi, Ibn Juraij farmate hain ke aayat ke nazil hone ke baad Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ikhtiyar diya ke khwah samne se aaye khwah peeche se lekin ek hi rahe. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek shakhs ne poocha ke hum apni auraton ke paas kaise aayen aur kya chhoden? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh teri kheti hai jis tarah chaho aao, haan uske munh par na maar, zyada bura na keh, us se rooth kar alag na ho ja, ek hi ghar mein reh (Ahmad o Sunan). Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Humair ke qabeela ke ek aadmi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke mujhe apni biwiyon se zyada mohabbat hai toh uske bare mein ahkaam mujhe bataye, is par yeh hukm nazil hua. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke chand Ansariyon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh sawal kiya tha, Tahawi ki kitab Mushkil-ul-Hadith mein hai ek shakhs ne apni biwi se ulta kar ke mubashirat ki thi, logon ne use bura bhala kaha is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Sabit Hazrat Hafsa bint Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr ke paas aaye aur kaha main ek masla poochna chahta hoon lekin sharm aati hai, farmaya bhatije tum na sharmao aur jo poochna ho pooch lo, kaha farmayiye auraton ke peeche ki taraf se jama karna jaiz hai? Farmaya suno mujh se Hazrat Umme Salama ne farmaya hai ke Ansar auraton ko ulta litaya karte thay aur Yahood kehte thay ke is tarah se bacha bhenga hota hai, jab Muhajir Madina Sharif aaye aur yahan ki auraton se unka nikah hua aur unhon ne bhi yahi karna chaha toh ek aurat ne apne khawand ki baat na mani aur kaha jab tak main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein yeh waqia bayan na kar loon teri baat na manungi chunancha woh bargah-e-nabuwat mein hazir hui, Umme Salama ne bithaya aur kaha abhi An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aa jayenge, jab An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye toh Ansariya aurat sharmindagi ki wajah se na pooch saki aur wapas chali gayi lekin Umm-ul-Momineen ne Aap se poocha, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ansariya aurat ko bula lo, phir yeh aayat padh kar sunayi aur farmaya jagah ek hi ho, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Umar bin Khattab ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main toh halak ho gaya, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne poocha kya baat hai? Kaha, main ne raat ko apni sawari ulti kar di, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuch jawab na diya. Isi waqt yeh aayat nazil hui aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya samne se aa, peeche se aa, ikhtiyar hai lekin haiz ki halat mein na aa aur pakhana ki jagah na aa.

Ansar wala waqia qadray tafseel ke sath bhi marwi hai aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ko Allah bakhshay, unhein kuch wahm sa ho gaya. Baat yeh hai ke Ansariyon ki jamaat pehle but-parast thi aur Yahudi Ahl-e-Kitab thay. But-parast log un ki fazeelat aur ilmiyat ke qail thay aur aksar afaal mein un ki baat mana karte thay. Yahudi ek hi tarah par apni biwiyon se milte thay. Yehi aadat un Ansar ki bhi thi. Un ke bar-khilaf Makka walay kisi khaas tareeqay ke paband na thay, woh jis tarah jee chahta miltay. Islam ke baad Makka walay Muhajir ban kar Madina mein Ansar ke haan jab utray to ek Makki mujahid mard ne ek Madani Ansariya aurat se nikah kiya aur apne man-bhatay tareeqay baratnay chahay, aurat ne inkar kar diya aur saaf keh diya ke isi ek muqarrara tareeqay ke ilawa ijazat nahin deti. Baat barhtay barhtay Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tak pohanchi aur yeh farman nazil hua. Pas samnay se peechay ki taraf se aur jis tarah chahay ikhtiyar hai haan jagah ek hi ho. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmatay hain main ne Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se Quran Sharif seekha awwal se aakhir tak unhein sunaya, ek aayat ki tafseer aur matlab poocha. Is aayat par pohanch kar jab main ne is ka matlab poocha to unhon ne yehi bayan kiya (jo oopar guzra). Ibn Umar (R.A) ka wahm yeh tha ke baaz riwayaton mein hai ke aap Quran parhtay huay kisi se boltay chaltay na thay lekin ek din tilawat karte huay jab is aayat tak pohanchay to apne shagird Hazrat Nafi (R.H) se farmaya jantay ho yeh aayat kis baray mein nazil hui? Unhon ne kaha nahin, farmaya yeh auraton ki dusri jagah ki wati ke baray mein utri hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke aap ne farmaya ek shakhs ne apni biwi se peechay se kiya tha jis par is aayat mein rukhsat nazil hui lekin ek to is mein muhaddiseen ne kuch illat bhi bayan ki hai, dusre is ke ma'ani bhi yehi ho saktay hain ke peechay ki taraf se aagay ki jagah mein kiya aur oopar ki jo riwayatein hain woh bhi sanadan sahih nahin balkay unhein Hazrat Nafi (R.H) se marwi hai ke un se kaha gaya ke kya aap yeh kehtay hain ke Hazrat Ibn Umar (R.A) ne wati-e-dubar ko jaiz kiya hai? To farmaya log jhoot kehtay hain. Phir wohi Ansariya aurat aur Muhajir wala waqia bayan kiya aur farmaya Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) to is aayat ka yeh matlab irshad farmatay thay, is riwayat ki asnaad bhi bilkul sahih hai aur is ke khilaf sanad sahih nahin, ma'ani matlab bhi aur ho sakta hai aur khud Hazrat Ibn Umar (R.A) se is ke khilaf bhi marwi hai. Woh riwayatein anqareeb bayan hon gi Insha'Allah jin mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn Umar (R.A) farmatay hain ke na yeh mubah hai na halal balkay haram hai, to yeh qaul yani jawaz ka baaz ka baaz fuqaha-e-Madina waghera ki taraf bhi mansoob hai aur baaz logon ne to isay Imam ki taraf bhi mansoob kiya hai lekin aksar log is ka inkar karte hain aur farmatay hain ke Imam sahab ka qaul hargiz yeh nahin, sahih hadeesein bakasrat is fe'l ki hurmat par warid hain. Ek riwayat mein hai logo! sharm-o-haya karo Allah Ta'ala haq baat farmanay se sharm nahin karta. Aurat ke pakhana ki jagah wati na karo.

Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne is harkat se logon ko mana farmaya (Musnad-e-Ahmad) aur riwayat mein hai ke jo shakhs kisi aurat ya mard ke sath yeh kaam kare us ki taraf Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat se nahin dekhe ga (Tirmidhi). Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se ek shakhs yeh masla poochta hai to Aap farmate hain ke kya tu kufr karne ki babat sawal karta hai? Ek shakhs ne Aap se aakar kaha ke main ne aayat (Anna shi'tum) ka yeh matlab samjha aur main ne is par amal kiya to Aap naraz hue aur use bura bhala kaha aur farmaya ke matlab yeh hai ke khwah khade ho kar, khwah baith kar, chit khwah pat lekin jagah wahi ek ho. Ek aur marfoo hadith mein hai ke jo shakhs apni biwi se pakhana ki jagah wati kare woh chota loti hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Abu Darda (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh kuffar ka kaam hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Aas (R.A) ka yeh farman bhi manqool hai aur yahi zyada sahih hai, Wallahu A'lam. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain saat qisam ke log hain jin ki taraf Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din nazar-e-rahmat se nahin dekhe ga aur na unhein pak kare ga aur un se farmaye ga ke jahannumiyon ke sath jahannum mein chale jao. Ek to aghlam bazi karne wala khwah woh oopar wala ho khwah neeche wala ho, aur apne hath se musht-e-zani karne wala, aur chopaye janwar se yeh kaam karne wala aur aurat ki dubur mein wati karne wala aur aurat aur us ki beti dono se nikah karne wala aur apne padosi ki biwi se zina karne wala aur hamsaya ko satane wala, yahan tak ke woh us par la'nat kare, lekin is ki sanad mein Ibn-e-Lahi'ah aur un ke ustad dono za'eef hain. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke jo shakhs apni biwi se dusre raste wati kare use Allah Ta'ala nazar-e-rahmat se nahin dekhe ga (Musnad). Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Sunan mein marwi hai ke jo shakhs ha'iza aurat se jima kare ya ghair jagah kare ya kahin (jadu-gar/kahin) ke paas jaye aur use sacha samjhe, us ne us cheez ke sath kufr kiya jo Muhammad (ﷺ) ke oopar utri hai. Imam Tirmidhi farmate hain ke Imam Bukhari is hadith ko za'eef batate hain, Tirmidhi mein riwayat hai ke Abu Salamah bhi dubur ki wati ko haram batate the, Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain logon ka apni biwi se yeh kaam karna kufr hai (Nasa'i). Ek marfoo hadith mein is ma'ni ki marwi hai lekin zyada sahih is ka mauqoof hona hi hai, aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh jagah haram hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) bhi yahi farmate hain, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se jab yeh baat poochhi gayi to Aap ne farmaya bada kamina woh shakhs hai, dekho Quran mein hai ke lotiyon se kaha gaya tum woh badkari karte ho jis ki taraf kisi ne tum se pehle tawajjo nahin ki, pas sahih ahadith aur Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) se bahut si riwayaton aur sanadon se is fe'l ki hurmat marwi hai. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) bhi ise haram kehte hain.

Chunancha Darimi mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) se ek martaba yeh sawal hua toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya kya Musalman bhi aisa kar sakta hai? Is ki asnaad sahih hai aur hukm bhi hurmat ka saaf hai, pas ghair sahih aur mukhtalif ma'ani wali riwayaton mein par kar itne jaleel-ul-qadr Sahabi ki taraf ek aisa ganda mas'ala mansoob karna theek nahin. Go ke riwayatein is qisam ki bhi milti hain, Imam Malik (R.H) so un ki taraf bhi is mas'ala ki nisbat sahih nahin balkay Mu'ammar bin Isa farmate hain ke Imam Sahab isay haram jante thay, Israil bin Rooh ne Aap (R.H) se ek martaba yahi sawal kiya toh Aap (R.H) ne farmaya tum be-samajh ho, buwai khet mein hi hoti hai, khabardar sharm-gah ke siwa aur jagah se bacho. Sail ne kaha Hazrat log toh kehte hain ke Aap is fe'l ko jaiz kehte hain. Aap (R.H) ne farmaya jhootay hain mujh par tohmat bandhte hain. Imam Malik (R.H) se is ki hurmat sabit hai. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H), Shafi'i (R.H), Ahmad (R.H) aur un ke tamam shagirdon aur sathiyon, Sa'eed bin Musayyab (R.H), Abu Salama (R.H), Ikrama (R.H), Ata (R.H), Sa'eed bin Jubair (R.H), Urwa bin Zubair (R.H), Mujahid (R.H), Hasan (R.H) waghera salaf-e-saliheen sab ke sab isay haram kehte hain aur is baray mein sakht tashaddud karte hain balkay ba'az toh isay kufr kehte hain, jamhoor ulama-e-kiram ka bhi is ki hurmat par ijma hai, go ba'az logon ne fuqaha-e-Madina balkay Imam Malik (R.H) se bhi is ki hillat naqal ki hai lekin yeh sahih nahin. Abdur Rahman bin Qasim (R.H) ka qaul hai ke kisi deendar shakhs ko main ne toh is ki hurmat mein shak karne wala nahin paya, phir aayat (Nisa'ukum harsul lakum) parh kar farmaya khud yeh lafz hars hi is ki hurmat zahir karne ke liye kafi hai kyunke woh dusri jagah kheti ki jagah nahin, kheti mein jane ke tariqa ka ikhtiyar hai na ke jagah badalne ka. Go Imam Malik (R.H) se is ke mubah hone ki riwayatein bhi manqool hain lekin un ki asnadon mein sakht za'f hai. Wallahu A'lam. Theek is tarah Imam Shafi'i (R.H) se bhi ek riwayat logon ne ghar li hai halankeh unhon ne apni chhay kitabon mein khulay lafzon isay haram likha hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala farmata hai apne liye kuch aagay bhi bhejo ya'ni mamnoo'aat se bacho nekiyan karo taake sawab aagay jaye, Allah Ta'ala se daro us se milna hai woh hisab kitab lega, imandar har haal mein khushiyan manayen, Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh bhi matlab hai ke jab jima ka irada kare. Yeh dua (Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-shaitana wa jannibish-shaitana ma razaqtana) parhay ya'ni Aye Allah tu hamain aur hamari aulad ko shaitan se bacha le. Nabi (ﷺ) farmate hain agar is jima se nutfa qarar pakar gaya toh is bachay ko shaitan hargiz koi zarar na pohancha sake ga.

Qasam aur Kaffara: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke neki aur sila-rehmi ke chhorne ka zariya Allah ki qasmon ko na banao, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wala ya'tal ulul-fadli minkum was-sa'ati ay yu'tu ulil-qurba wal-masakini wal-muhajirina fi sabilillah) (24. An-Nur: 22) yani woh log jo kushada-haal aur farigh-ul-baal hain woh qarabat-daron, maskinon aur Allah ki raah mein hijrat karne walon ko kuch na dene par qasmein na kha baithein, unhein chahiye ke maaf karne aur darguzar karne ki aadat dalein, kya tumhari khud khwahish nahin Allah Ta'ala tumhein bakhshe, agar koi aisi qasam kha baithe toh use chahiye ke use tor de aur kaffara ada kar de, Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke hum piche aane wale hain lekin Qayamat ke din sab se aage barhne wale hain, farmate hain ke tum mein se koi aisi qasam kha le aur kaffara ada na kare aur us par ara rahe woh bara gunahgar hai, yeh hadith aur bhi bahut si sanadon aur bahut si kitabon mein marwi hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A bhi is aayat ki tafsir mein yahi farmate hain. Hazrat Masruq R.H waghera bahut se mufassirin se bhi yahi marwi hai, jumhoor ke in aqwal ki ta'eed is hadith se bhi hoti hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke Allah ki qasam Insha'Allah mein agar koi qasam kha baithunga aur us ke torne mein mujhe bhalai nazar aayegi toh mein qatan use tor dunga aur us qasam ka kaffara ada karunga, Huzoor ﷺ ne ek martaba Hazrat Abdur-Rahman bin Samura R.A se farmaya ae Abdur-Rahman sardari imarat aur imamat ko talab na kar agar baghair mange tujhe diya jayega toh Allah ki janib se teri madad ki jayegi aur agar tu ne aap mang kar li hai toh tujhe us ki taraf sonp diya jayega toh agar koi qasam kha le aur us ke khilaf bhi bhalai dekh le toh apni qasam ka kaffara de de aur us nek kaam ko kar le (Bukhari o Muslim). Sahih Muslim mein hadith hai ke jo shakhs koi qasam kha le phir us ke siwa khubi nazar aaye toh use chahiye ke us khubi wale kaam ko kar le aur apni is qasam ko tor de us ka kaffara de de, Musnad Ahmad ki ek riwayat mein hai ke us ka chhor dena hi us ka kaffara hai. Abu Dawood mein hai nazr aur qasam us cheez mein nahin jo insaan ki malkiyat mein na ho aur na Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani mein hi hai na rishton naton ko torti hai jo shakhs koi qasam kha le aur neki us ke karne mein ho toh woh qasam ko chhor de aur neki ka kaam kare, is qasam ko chhor dena hi us ka kaffara hai. Imam Abu Dawood R.H farmate hain kul ki kul sahih ahadith mein yeh lafz hain ke apni aisi qasam ka kaffara de, ek za'eef hadith mein hai ke aisi qasam ka pura karna yahi hai ke use tor de aur us se ruju kare, Ibn Abbas R.A, Sa'eed bin Musayyab R.H, Masruq R.H aur Sha'bi R.H bhi isi ke qail hain ke aise shakhs ke zimma kaffara nahin.

Phir farmata hai jo qasmein tumhare munh se baghair qasdan aur iraday ke aadatan nikal jayen un par pakar nahin. Muslim Bukhari ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs Laat aur Uzza ki qasam kha baithay woh aayat (La ilaha illallah) parh le. Yeh irshad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka un logon ko hua tha jo abhi abhi Islam laye thay aur jahiliyat ke zamana ki yeh qasmein un ki zabanon par charhi hui thin toh un se farmaya ke agar aadatan kabhi aisay shirkiya alfaaz nikal jayen toh foran kalma-e-tauheed parh liya karo taake badla ho jaye. Phir farmaya haan jo qasmein pukhtagi ke sath dil ki iradat ke sath qasdan khai jayen un par pakar hai. Dusri aayat ke lafz (لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللّٰهُ باللَّغْوِ فِيْٓ اَيْمَانِكُمْ وَلٰكِنْ يُّؤَاخِذُكُمْ بِمَا عَقَّدْتُّمُ الْاَيْمَانَ) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 89) hain, Abu Dawood mein barwayat Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ek marfoo hadith marwi hai jo aur riwayaton mein mauqoof warid hui hai ke yeh laghw qasmein woh hain jo insaan apne ghar baar mein baal bachon mein keh diya karta hai ke haan Allah ki qasam aur nahin Allah ki qasam, gharz bator takiya-e-kalam ke yeh lafz nikal jatay hain dil mein is ki pukhtagi ka khayal bhi nahin hota, Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh woh qasmein hain jo hansi hansi mein insaan ke munh se nikal jati hain, un par kaffara nahin, haan jo iraday ke sath qasam ho phir us ka khilaf kare toh kaffara ada karna paray ga, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ilawa aur bhi baaz Sahaba (R.A) aur Tabi'een (R.H) ne yahi tafseer is aayat ki bayan ki hai, yeh bhi marwi hai ke ek aadmi apni tehqeeq par bharosa kar ke kisi mamla ki nisbat qasam kha baithay aur haqeeqat mein woh mamla yun na ho toh yeh qasmein laghw hain, yeh ma'ani bhi deegar bohat se hazraat se marwi hain, ek Hasan hadith mein hai jo mursal hai ke ek martaba Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) teer andazon ki ek jamaat ke paas ja kharay huay, woh teer andazi kar rahay thay aur ek shakhs kabhi kehta Allah ki qasam is ka teer nishanay par lagay ga, kabhi kehta Allah ki qasam yeh khata karay ga, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Sahabi (R.A) ne kaha dekhiye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar is ki qasam ke khilaf ho? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh do qasmein laghw hain un par kaffara nahin aur na koi saza ya azaab hai, baaz buzurgon ne farmaya hai yeh woh qasmein hain jo insaan kha leta hai phir khayal nahin rehta, ya koi shakhs apne kisi kaam ke na karne par koi bad-dua ke kalmaat apni zaban se nikal deta hai, woh bhi laghw mein dakhil hain ya gussay aur ghazab ki halat mein besakhta zaban se qasam nikal jaye ya halal ko haram ya haram ko halal kar le toh usay chahiye ke in qasmon ki parwah na kare aur Allah ke ahkaam ke khilaf na kare, Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) se marwi hai ke Ansar ke do shakhs jo aapas mein bhai bhai thay un ke darmiyan kuch meeras ka maal tha toh ek ne dusray se kaha ab is maal ko taqseem kar do, dusray ne kaha agar ab tu ne taqseem karne ke liye kaha toh mera maal Ka'aba ka khazana hai.

Hazrat Umar R.A ne yeh waqia sun kar farmaya ke Kaaba aise maal se ghani hai, apni qasam ka kaffara de aur apne bhai se bol chaal rakh, main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani, rishte naaton ke todne aur jis cheez ki malkiyat na ho un ke baare mein qasam aur nazr nahin. Phir farmata hai tumhare dil jo karein us par giraft hai yani apne jhoot ka ilm ho aur phir qasam khaye jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa lakin yu-akhizukum bima aqadtumul-aiman) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 89) yani jo tum mazboot aur takeed wali qasmein kha lo. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko bakhshne wala hai aur un par ilm-o-karam karne wala hai.

Ila aur uski wazahat: Ila kehte hain qasam ko. Agar koi shakhs apni biwi se mujamat na karne ki ek muddat tak ke liye qasam khale to do suratein, ya woh muddat chaar mahine se kam hogi ya zyada hogi, agar kam hogi to woh muddat poori kare aur is darmiyan aurat bhi sabr kare, is se mutalba aur sawal nahin kar sakti, phir miyan biwi aapas mein milein julein ge, jaise ke Bukhari Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek mah ke liye qasam kha li thi aur untees din poore alag rahe aur farmaya ke mahina untees ka bhi hota hai aur agar chaar mahine se zaid ki muddat ke liye qasam khai ho to chaar mah baad aurat ko haq hasil hai ke woh taqaza aur mutalba kare ke ya to woh mel milap karle ya talaq de de, aur is khawand ka hukum in do baton mein se ek ke karne par majboor kare ga taake aurat ko zarar na pohanche. Yehi bayan yahan ho raha hai ke jo log apni biwiyon se Ila karein yani un se mujamat na karne ki qasam khayein, is se maloom hua ke yeh "Ila" khaas biwiyon ke liye hai, londiyon ke liye nahin. Yehi mazhab jumhoor ulama-e-karam ka hai, yeh log chaar mahina tak azaad hain, is ke baad unhein majboor kiya jaye ga ke ya to woh apni biwiyon se mil lein ya talaq de dein, yeh nahin ke ab bhi woh isi tarah chhore rahein, phir agar woh laut aayein yeh ishara jama karne ka hai to Allah Ta'ala bhi bakhash de ga aur jo taqseer aurat ke haq mein un se hui hai use apni meherbani se maaf farma de ga, is mein daleel hai un ulama ki jo kehte hain ke is surat mein khawand ke zimma kaffara kuch bhi nahin. Imam Shafi (R.H) ka bhi pehla qaul yehi hai, is ki tayeed is hadith se bhi hoti hai jo agli aayat ki tafsir mein guzar chuki ke qasam khane wala agar apni qasam tod dalne mein neki dekhta ho to tod dale, yehi is ka kaffara hai, aur ulama-e-karam ki ek dusri jamaat ka yeh mazhab hai ke use qasam ka kaffara dena pade ga. Is ki hadithein bhi oopar guzar chuki hain aur jumhoor ka mazhab bhi yehi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Phir farman hai ke agar chaar mahine guzar jaane ke baad woh talaq dene ka qasd kare, is se sabit hota hai ke chaar mahine guzarte hi talaq nahin hogi. Jamhoor-e-mutakhireen ka yahi mazhab hai, go ek dusri jamaat yeh bhi kehti hai ke bila jima' chaar mah guzarne ke baad talaq ho jayegi. Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Usman (R.A), Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A), Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit (R.A) aur ba'az tabieen se bhi yahi marwi hai lekin yaad rahe ke rajeh qaul aur Quran-e-Kareem ke alfaaz aur sahih hadith se sabit shuda qaul yahi hai ke talaq waqay na hogi (Mutarjim). Phir ba'az toh yeh kehte hain bain hogi, jo log talaq padne ke qail hain woh farmate hain ke is ke baad use iddat bhi guzarni padegi. Haan Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) aur Abu-Shasa farmate hain ke agar in chaar mahino mein is aurat ko teen haiz aa gaye hain toh is par iddat bhi nahin. Imam Shafi (R.H) ka bhi qaul yahi hai lekin jamhoor-e-mutakhireen ulama ka farman yahi hai ke is muddat ke guzarte hi talaq waqay na hogi balkay ab Eela karne wale ko majboor kiya jayega ke ya toh woh apni qasam ko tode ya talaq de. Muwatta Imam Malik mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se yahi marwi hai. Sahih Bukhari mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai, Imam Shafi (R.H) apni sanad se Hazrat Sulaiman bin Yasar se riwayat karte hain ke main ne das se oopar sahabiyon se suna ke woh kehte the chaar mah ke baad Eela karne wale ko khada kiya gaya toh kam se kam yeh terah sahabi ho gaye. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bhi yahi manqool hai. Imam Shafi (R.H) farmate hain yahi hamara mazhab hai aur yahi Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A), Hazrat Usman (R.A), Zaid bin Sabit (R.A) aur das se oopar oopar dusre Sahaba-e-Kiram se marwi hai, Darqutni mein hai Hazrat Abu Saleh farmate hain main ne barah sahabiyon se is masla ko poocha, sab ne yahi jawab inayat farmaya, Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Usman (R.A), Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A), Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen Aisha Siddiqa (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) bhi yahi farmate hain aur tabieen mein se Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyib (R.H), Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Taoos (R.H), Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'ab (R.H), Hazrat Qasim (R.H) ajmaeen ka bhi yahi qaul hai aur Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H), Hazrat Imam Shafi (R.H), Hazrat Imam Ahmed (R.H) aur un ke sathiyon ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) bhi isi qaul ko pasand karte hain. Lais, Ishaq bin Rahwiya, Abu Ubaid, Abu Saur, Dawood waghera bhi yahi farmate hain. Yeh sab hazrat farmate hain ke agar chaar mah ke baad rujoo na kare toh use talaq dene par majboor kiya jayega. Agar talaq na de toh hakim khud is ki taraf se talaq de dega magar yeh talaq-e-raj'i hogi, iddat ke andar ruj'at ka haq khawand ko hasil hai, haan sirf Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain ke use ruj'at jaiz nahin yahan tak ke iddat mein jima' kare lekin yeh qaul nihayat ghareeb hai.

Yahan jo chaar mahine ki takheer ki ijazat di hai us ki munasibat mein Muwatta Imam Malik mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Dinar ki riwayat se Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka ek waqia umooman fuqaha-e-kiram zikr karte hain, jo yeh hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) raaton ko Madina Sharif ki galiyon mein gasht lagate rehte. Ek raat ko nikle to aap ne suna ke ek aurat apne safar mein gaye hue khawand ki yaad mein kuch ashaar parh rahi hai jin ka tarjuma yeh hai "Afsos in kaali kaali aur lambi raaton mein mera khawand nahin hai jis se main hanson, boloon. Qasam Allah ki agar Allah ka khauf na hota to is waqt is palang ke paaye harkat mein hote." Aap apni sahibzadi Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Hafsa (R.A) ke paas aaye aur farmaya batao zyada se zyada aurat apne khawand ki judai par kitni muddat sabr kar sakti hai? Farmaya chhe mahine ya chaar mahine. Aap ne farmaya ab main hukum jaari kar doonga ke musalman mujahid safar mein is se zyada na thehrein. Baaz riwayaton mein kuch zyadati bhi hai aur is ki bohat si sanadein hain aur yeh waqia mashhoor hai.

Talaq ke masail: In aurton ko jo khawandon se mil chuki hon aur baligha hon, hukm ho raha hai ke talaq ke baad teen haiz tak ruki rahein phir agar chahein to apna nikah dusra kar sakti hain, haan charon imamon ne is mein londi ko makhsoos kardiya hai woh do haiz iddat guzarey kyunke londi in mamlaat mein azad aurat se aadhey par hai lekin haiz ki muddat ka adhoora theek nahin baithta, is liye woh do haiz guzarey. Ek hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke londi ki talaqein bhi do hain aur us ki iddat bhi do haiz hain. (Ibn-e-Jarir) lekin is ke rawi Hazrat Mazahir zaeef hain, yeh hadith Tirmidhi, Abu Dawood aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai. Imam Hafiz Darqutni farmate hain go is ki nisbat bhi Imam Darqutni yahi farmate hain ke yeh Hazrat Abdullah ka apna qaul hi hai. Isi tarah khud Khalifatul Muslimeen Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam se marwi hai, balkay sahaba mein is masla mein ikhtilaf hi na tha, haan baaz salaf se yeh bhi marwi hai ke iddat ke barey mein azad aur londi barabar hai, kyunke ayat apni umoomiyat ke lihaz se dono ko shamil hai aur is liye bhi ke yeh fitri amr hai londi aur azad aurat is mein yaksan hain. Muhammad bin Sirin aur baaz ahl-e-zahir ka yahi qaul hai lekin yeh zaeef hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek ghareeb sanad wali riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Asma bint-e-Yazid bin Sakan Ansariyah ke barey mein yeh ayat nazil hui hai, is se pehle talaq ki iddat na thi. Sab se pehle iddat ka hukm un hi ki talaq ke baad nazil hua. Quroo ke ma'ani mein salaf-o-khalaf ka barabar ikhtilaf raha hai. Ek qaul to yeh hai ke is se murad tuhr yani paki hai. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka yahi farman hai chunancha unhon ne apni bhatiji Hazrat Abdur Rahman ki beti Hafsa ko jabke woh teen tuhr guzar chukein aur teesra haiz shuru hua to hukm diya ke woh makan badal lein. Hazrat Urwah ne jab yeh riwayat bayan ki to Hazrat Umrah ne jo Siddiqa (R.A) ki dusri bhatiji hain, is waqia ki tasdeeq ki aur farmaya ke logon ne Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) par aitraz bhi kiya to aap ne farmaya Iqra se murad tuhr hain (Muwatta Imam Malik) balkay Muwatta mein Abu Bakr bin Abdur Rahman ka to yeh qaul bhi marwi hai ke main ne samajhdar ulama fuqaha ko Quroo ki tafseer tuhr se hi karte suna hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) bhi yahi farmate hain ke jab teesra haiz shuru hua to yeh apne khawand se bari hogi aur khawand is se alag hua (Muwatta). Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain hamare nazdeek bhi mustahiq-e-amr yahi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas, Zaid bin Thabit, Salim, Qasim, Urwah, Sulaiman bin Yasar, Abu Bakr bin Abdur Rahman, Aban bin Usman, Ata, Qatadah, Zuhri aur baqi saton fuqaha ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Imam Malik, Imam Shafi'i ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Dawood aur Abu Thaur bhi yahi farmate hain.

Imam Ahmad R.H se bhi ek riwayat isi tarah ki marwi hai. Iski daleel in buzurgon ne Quran ki is aayat se bhi nikali hai ke aayat (Fattaliquhunna li-iddatihinna) yani unhein iddat mein yani tuhr mein pakeezgi ki halat mein talaq do, chunke jis tuhr mein talaq di jati hai woh bhi ginti mein aata hai, is se maloom hua ke aayat-e-mundarja-e-bala mein bhi quru se murad haiz ke siwa ki yani paki ki halat hai. Isi liye yeh hazrat farmate hain ke jahan teesra haiz shuru ho aur aurat apne khawand ki iddat se bahar ho gayi aur is ki kam se kam muddat jis mein agar aurat kahe ke use teesra haiz shuru ho gaya hai to use sacha samjha jaye, battees din aur do lahza hain. Arab shairon ke sher mein bhi yeh lafz tuhr ke ma'ani mein musta'mal hua hai.

Dusra qaul yeh hai ke is se murad teen haiz hain, aur jab tak teesre haiz se pak na ho le tab tak woh iddat hi mein hai. Baaz ne ghusal kar lene tak kaha hai aur is ki kam se kam muddat taintis din aur ek lahza hai. Is ki daleel mein ek to Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ka yeh faisla hai ke un ke paas ek mutallaqa aurat aayi aur kaha ke mere khawand ne mujhe ek ya do talaqein di thin, phir woh mere paas us waqt aaya jabke main apne kapde utar kar darwaza band kiye hue thi (yani teesre haiz se nahane ki tayari mein thi to farmaye kya hukum hai yani ruju ho jayega ya nahin?) Aap ne farmaya mera khayal to yahi hai ruju ho gaya. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ne is ki ta'eed ki.

Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A, Hazrat Umar R.A, Hazrat Usman R.A, Hazrat Ali R.A, Hazrat Abu Darda R.A, Hazrat Ubada bin Samit R.A, Hazrat Anas bin Malik R.A, Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A, Hazrat Mu'az R.A, Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A, Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari R.A, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se bhi yahi marwi hai. Saeed bin Musayyab R.H, Alqama R.H, Aswad R.H, Ibrahim R.H, Mujahid R.H, Ata R.H, Ta'oos R.H, Saeed bin Jubair R.H, Ikrama R.H, Muhammad bin Sirin R.H, Hasan R.H, Qatada R.H, Sha'bi R.H, Rabi R.H, Muqatil bin Hayat R.H, Suddi R.H, Makhool R.H, Zahhak R.H, Ata Khurasani R.H bhi yahi farmate hain. Imam Abu Hanifa R.H aur un ke ashab ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Imam Ahmad R.H se bhi zyada sahih riwayat mein yahi marwi hai, aap farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke bade bade Sahaba-e-Kiram R.A se yahi marwi hai. Thauri R.H, Auza'i R.H, Ibn-e-Abi Laila R.H, Ibn-e-Shirma R.H, Hasan bin Saleh R.H, Abu Ubaid R.H aur Ishaq bin Rahwaih R.H ka qaul bhi yahi hai.

Ek hadith mein bhi hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Fatima bint-e-Abi Jubaish R.A se farmaya tha namaz ko aqra ke dinon mein chhod do. Pas maloom hua ke quru se murad haiz hai, lekin is hadith ka ek rawi Munzir majhool hai jo mashhoor nahin. Haan Ibn-e-Hibban R.H ise siqa batate hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain lughatan qura kehte hain har us cheez ke aane aur jaane ke waqt ko jis ke aane jaane ka waqt muqarrar ho. Is se maloom hota hai ke is lafz ke dono ma'ani hain haiz ke bhi aur tuhr ke bhi aur baaz usooli hazrat ka yahi maslak hai, Wallahu A'lam. Asma'i R.H bhi farmate hain ke qura kehte hain waqt ko. Abu Umar bin Ala R.H kehte hain Arab mein haiz ko aur tuhr ko dono ko qura kehte hain.

Abu Umar bin Abdul Barr R.H ka qaul hai ke zaban-e-Arab ke mahir aur fuqaha ka is mein ikhtilaf hi nahin ke tuhr aur haiz dono ke ma'ani qura ke hain, albatta is ayat ke ma'ani muqarrar karne mein ek jamaat is taraf gayi aur dusri is taraf. (Mutarjim ki tahqeeq mein bhi qura se murad yahan haiz lena hi behtar hai). Phir farmaya un ke raham mein jo hua us ka chupana halal nahin, hamal ho to aur haiz aaye to. Phir farmaya agar unhein Allah aur Qayamat par iman ho, is mein dhamkaya ja raha hai ke haq ke khilaf na kahein aur is se maloom hota hai ke is khabar mein un ki baat ka aitbar kiya jaye ga kyunke is par koi bairooni shahadat qaim nahin ki ja sakti, is liye unhein khabardar kar diya gaya ke iddat se jald nikal jane ke liye (haiz na aaya ho) aur keh na dein ke unhein haiz aa gaya ya iddat ko barhane ke liye (haiz) aaya magar use chupa na lein, isi tarah hamal ki bhi khabar kar dein. Phir farmaya ke iddat ke andar us shohar ko jis ne talaq di hai, lota lene ka poora haq hasil hai jabke talaq-e-raj'i ho yani ek talaq ke baad aur do talaqon ke baad. Baqi rahi talaq-e-ba'in yani teen talaqein jab ho jayen to yaad rahe ke jab yeh ayat utri hai tab tak talaq-e-ba'in thi hi nahin balkay us waqt tak jab chahe talaq ho jaye sab raj'i thin, talaq-e-ba'in to phir Islam ke ahkam mein aayi ke teen agar ho jayen to ab raj'at ka haq nahin rahe ga. Jab yeh baat khayal mein rahe gi to ulama-e-usool ke is qa'ide ka zu'f bhi maloom ho jaye ga ke zameer lotane se pehle ke aam lafz ki khusoosiyat hoti hai ya nahin, is liye ke is ayat ke waqt dusri shakal thi hi nahin, talaq ki ek hi soorat thi, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai ke jaise un aurton par mardon ke haqooq hain waise hi un aurton ke mardon par bhi haqooq hain. Har ek ko dusre ka paas-o-lihaz umdagi se rakhna chahiye. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein Hazrat Jabir R.A se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida ke apne khutba mein farmaya: Logo! Aurton ke bare mein Allah se darte raho, tum ne Allah ki amanat keh kar unhein liya hai aur Allah ke kalma se un ki sharmgahon ko apne liye halal kiya hai. Aurton par tumhara yeh haq hai ke woh tumhare farsh par kisi aise ko na aane dein jis se tum naraz ho, agar woh aisa karein to unhein maro lekin maar aisi na ho ke zahir ho. Un ka tum par yeh haq hai ke unhein apni bisat ke mutabiq khilao pilao, pehnao orhao. Ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke hamari aurton ke hum par kya haq hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Jab tum khao to use bhi khilao, jab tum pehno to use bhi pehnao, us ke munh par na maro, use galiyan na do, us se rooth kar aur kahin na bhej do, han ghar mein rakho. Isi ayat ko parh kar Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmaya karte the ke main pasand karta hoon ke apni biwi ko khush karne ke liye bhi apni zeenat karoon jis tarah woh mujhe khush karne ke liye apna banao singar karti hai.

Phir farmaya ke mardon ko un par fazeelat hai, jismani haisiyat se bhi, akhlaqi haisiyat se bhi, martaba ki haisiyat se bhi, hukmrani ki haisiyat se bhi, kharch-o-akhrajat ki haisiyat se bhi, dekh bhaal aur nigrani ki haisiyat se bhi, gharz dunyawi aur ukhrawi fazeelat ke har aitbar se, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Ar-rijalu qawwamuna 'alan-nisa'i bima faddalallahu ba'dahum 'ala ba'din wa bima anfaqu min amwalihim) (Surah An-Nisa: 34) yani mard aurton ke sardar hain, Allah Ta'ala ne ek ko ek par fazeelat de rakhi hai aur is liye bhi ke yeh maal kharch karte hain. Phir farmaya Allah Ta'ala apne nafarmanon se badla lene par ghalib hai aur apne ahkaam mein hikmat wala.

Rasm-e-Talaq mein Aini Islahat aur Khula: Islam se pehle yeh dastoor tha ke khawand jitni chahe talaqein deta chala jaye aur iddat mein ruju karta jaye. Is se auraton ki jaan ghazab mein thi ke talaq di, iddat guzrne ke qareeb aayi ruju kar liya, phir talaq de di. Is tarah auraton ko tang karte rehte the, pas Islam ne had-bandi kar di ke is tarah ki talaqein sirf do hi de sakte hain. Teesri talaq ke baad lota lene ka koi haq na rahe ga. Sunan Abu Dawood mein baab hai ke teen talaqon ke baad muraja'at mansookh hai, phir yeh riwayat laye hain ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yahi farmate hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek shakhs ne apni biwi se kaha ke na toh main tujhe basaunga na chhodunga. Us ne kaha yeh kis tarah? Kaha talaq de dunga aur jahan iddat khatam hone ka waqt aaya toh ruju kar lunga, phir talaq de dunga, phir iddat khatam hone se pehle ruju kar lunga aur yunhi karta chala jaunga. Woh aurat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aayi aur apna yeh dukh rone lagi, is par yeh Ayat-e-Mubaraka nazil hui. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke is ayat ke nazil hone ke baad logon ne naye sire se talaqon ka khayal rakhna shuru kiya aur woh sambhal gaye, aur teesri talaq ke baad us khawand ko lota lene ka koi haq hasil na raha aur farma diya gaya ke do talaqon tak toh tumhein ikhtiyar hai ke islah ki niyat se apni biwi ko lota lo agar woh iddat ke andar hai aur yeh bhi ikhtiyar hai ke na lotao aur iddat guzar jane do taake woh dusre se nikah karne ke qabil ho jaye aur agar teesri talaq dena chahte ho toh bhi ehsan-o-sulook ke sath warna us ka koi haq na maro, is par koi zulm na karo, use zarar-o-nuqsan na pahunchao. Ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke do talaqein toh is ayat mein bayan ho chuki hain teesri ka zikr kahan hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ayat (Au Tasreehun Bi-Ehsan) mein. Jab teesri talaq ka irada kare toh aurat ko tang karna, us par sakhti karna taake woh apna haq chhod kar talaq par amadgi zahir kare, yeh mardon par haram hai. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wala Ta'duluhunna Litazhabu Bi-Ba'di Ma Ataytumu-hunna Illa An Ya'tina Bi-Fahishatin Mubayyinah) (Surah An-Nisa: 19) yani auraton ko tang na karo taake unhein diye hue mein se kuch le lo, han yeh aur baat hai ke aurat apni khushi se kuch de kar talaq talab kare jaise farmaya ayat (Fa-in Tibna Lakum An Shay'in Minhu Nafsan Fakulu-hu Hani'an Mari'a) (Surah An-Nisa: 4) yani agar auratein apni raazi khushi se kuch chhod dein toh beshak woh tumhare liye halal-e-tayyab hai aur jab miyan-biwi mein na-ittifaqi barh jaye, aurat us se khush na ho aur us ke haq ko na baja lati ho, aisi surat mein woh kuch le de kar apne khawand se talaq hasil kar le toh use dene mein aur use lene mein koi gunah nahin.

Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke agar aurat bila-wajah apne khawand se khula talab karti hai toh woh sakht gunehgar hai. Chunancha Tirmidhi waghera mein hadith hai ke jo aurat apne khawand se be-sabab talaq talab kare us par jannat ki khushbu bhi haram hai, aur riwayat mein hai ke halankeh jannat ki khushbu chalees saal ki doori se aati hai, aur riwayat mein hai ke aisi auratein munafiq hain. Aima-e-Salaf-o-Khalaf ki ek badi jamaat ka farman hai ke khula sirf usi surat mein hai ke nafarmani aur sarkashi aurat ki taraf se ho, us waqt mard fidiya le kar us aurat ko alag kar sakta hai jaise Quran-e-Pak ki is aayat mein hai, is ke siwa ki surat mein yeh sab jaiz nahin. Balkeh Hazrat Imam Malik toh farmate hain ke agar aurat ko takleef pohancha kar us ke haq mein kami kar ke agar use majboor kiya gaya aur us se kuch maal wapas liya gaya toh us ka lauta dena wajib hai. Imam Shafi farmate hain ke jab halat-e-ikhtilaf mein jaiz hai toh halat-e-ittefaq mein bator-e-aula jaiz thehre ga. Bakr bin Abdullah kehte hain ke sire se khula mansookh hai kyunke Quran mein hai aayat (Wa aataytum ihdahunna qintaran fala ta'khuzu minhu shai'an) (Surah An-Nisa: 20) yani agar tum ne apni biwiyon ko ek khazana bhi de rakha ho, toh bhi us mein se kuch bhi na lo, lekin yeh qaul zaeef hai aur mardood hai.

Ab aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool suniye, Muwatta Imam Malik mein hai ke Habiba bint-e-Sahl Ansariyah Hazrat Thabit bin Qais Shammas ki biwi thin. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek din subah ki namaz ke liye andhere-andhere nikle toh dekha ke darwaze par Hazrat Habiba khadi hain, Aap (ﷺ) ne poocha kaun hai? Kaha main Habiba bint-e-Sahl hoon. Farmaya kya baat hai? Kaha Huzoor (ﷺ)! Main Thabit bin Qais ke ghar mein nahin reh sakti, ya woh nahin ya main nahin. Aap (ﷺ) sun kar khamosh rahe. Jab Thabit aaye toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tumhari biwi sahiba kuch keh rahi hain. Hazrat Habiba ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ)! Mere khawand ne mujhe jo diya hai woh sab mere paas hai aur main use wapas karne par aamada hoon. Aap (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Thabit ko farmaya sab le lo, chunancha unhon ne le liya aur Hazrat Habiba azaad ho gayin. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Thabit ne unhein mara tha aur us maar se koi haddi toot gayi thi. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne jab unhein yeh farmaya us waqt unhon ne daryaft kiya ke kya main yeh maal le sakta hoon? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan. Kaha main ne use do baagh diye hain, yeh sab wapas dilwa dijiye. Woh mehar ke dono baagh wapas kiye gaye aur judai ho gayi. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Habiba ne yeh bhi farmaya tha ke main us ke akhlaq aur deen mein aib-geeri nahin karti lekin main Islam mein kufr ko na-pasand karti hoon, chunancha maal le kar Hazrat Thabit ne talaq de di. Baaz riwayaat mein un ka naam Jamila bhi aaya hai. Baaz riwayaat mein yeh bhi hai ke mujhe ab gaiz-o-ghazab ke bardasht ki taqat nahin rahi. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jo diya hai le lo, zyada na lena. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Habiba ne farmaya tha woh surat ke aitbar se bhi kuch haseen nahin.

Ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh Hazrat Abdullah bin Ubay ki behen thin aur sab se pehla khula tha jo Islam mein hua. Ek wajah yeh bhi bayan ki thi ke Hazrat ﷺ ne ek martaba khaime ke parda ko jo uthaya toh dekha ke mere khawand chand aadmiyon ke sath aa rahe hain, in tamam mein yeh siyah-faam chote qad wale aur badsurat thay. Huzoor ﷺ ke is farman par ke is ka bagh wapas karo, Habiba ne kaha tha ke aap farmayein toh main is ke munh par thook diya karti, jamhoor ka mazhab toh yeh hai ke khula aurat apne se diye hue se zyada le toh bhi jaiz hai kyunke Quran ne aayat (فَلَاجُنَاحَ عَلَيْھِمَا فِـيْمَا افْتَدَتْ بِهٖ) (2. Al-Baqarah: 229) farmaya hai, Hazrat Umar R.A ke paas ek aurat apne khawand se bigdi hui aayi, aap ne farmaya ise gandagi wale ghar mein qaid kar do phir qaid-khana se ise bulwaya aur kaha kya haal hai? Us ne kaha aaram ki raatein mujh par meri zindagi mein yahi guzri hain. Aap ne is ke khawand se farmaya is se khula kar le. Agarche goshwara ke badle hi ho, ek riwayat mein hai ise teen din wahan qaid rakha tha, ek aur riwayat mein hai ke aap ne farmaya agar yeh apni chotiya ki dhaji bhi de toh le le aur ise alag kar de. Hazrat Usman R.A farmate hain is ke siwa sab kuch le kar bhi khula ho sakta hai. Rabia bint Muawwaz bin Afra farmati hain mere khawand agar maujood hote toh bhi mere sath sulook karne mein kami karte aur kahin chale jaate toh bilkul hi mehroom kar dete. Ek martaba jhagde ke mauqe par main ne keh diya ke meri malkiyat mein jo kuch hai le lo aur mujhe khula do. Us ne kaha aur yeh mamla faisal ho gaya lekin mere chacha Muaz bin Afra is qissa ko le kar Hazrat Usman R.A ke paas gaye. Usman R.A ne bhi ise barqarar rakha aur farmaya ke choti ki dhaji chhod kar sab kuch le lo, baaz riwayaton mein hai yeh bhi aur is (sees) choti cheez bhi garz sab kuch le lo, pas matlab in waqiat ka yeh hai ke yeh daleel hai is par ke aurat ke paas jo kuch hai de kar woh khula kara sakti hai aur khawand apni di hui cheez se zaid le kar bhi khula kar sakta hai. Ibn-e-Umar, Ibn-e-Abbas, Mujahid, Ikrama, Ibrahim, Nakhai, Qaisa bin Zawib, Hasan bin Saleh, Usman R.H ajmaeen bhi yahi farmate hain. Imam Malik, Lais, Imam Shafi aur Abu Saur ka mazhab bhi yahi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain aur as-hab-e-Abu Hanifa ka qaul hai ke agar qasoor aur zarar-rasani aurat ki taraf se ho toh khawand ko jaiz hai ke jo us ne diya hai wapas le le, lekin is se zyada lena jaiz nahin. Go zyada le le toh bhi qaza ke waqt jaiz hoga aur agar khawand ki apni janib se zyadati ho toh use kuch bhi lena jaiz nahin. Go, le le toh qaza jaiz hoga. Imam Ahmad, Abu Ubaid aur Ishaq bin Rahwiya farmate hain ke khawand ko apne diye hue se zyada lena jaiz hi nahin. Saeed bin Musayyab, Atta, Amr bin Shuaib, Zuhri, Taous, Hasan, Shabi, Hammad bin Abu Sulaiman aur Rabia bin Anas ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Umar aur Hakim kehte hain Hazrat Ali R.A ka bhi yeh faisla hai.

Auza'i ka farman hai ke qaziyon ka faisla hai ke diye hue se zyada ko jaiz nahin jante. Is mazhab ki daleel woh hadith bhi hai jo upar bayan ho chuki hai jis mein hai ke apna bagh le lo aur is se zyada na lo. Musnad-e-Abd bin Humaid mein bhi ek marfoo hadith hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khula lene wali aurat se apne diye hue se zyada lena makrooh rakha, aur is surat mein jo kuch fidiya woh de le ga, ka lafz Quran mein hai. Is ke ma'ani yeh honge ke diye hue mein se jo kuch de, kyunke is se pehle yeh farman majood hai ke tum ne jo unhein diya hai is mein se kuch na lo, Rabi ki qirat mein ba ke baad min ka lafz bhi hai. Phir farmaya ke yeh hudood-e-Allah hain in se tajawuz na karo warna gunahgar honge. (Fasl) Khula ko ba'az hazrat talaq mein shumar nahin karte. Woh farmate hain ke agar ek shakhs ne apni biwi ko do talaqein de di hain phir us aurat ne khula kara liya hai to agar khawand chahe to is se phir bhi nikah kar sakta hai aur is par daleel yahi ayat warid karte hain. Yeh qaul Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka hai, Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) bhi farmate hain ke yeh talaq nahin, dekho ayat ke awwal-o-akhir talaq ka zikr hai pehle do talaqon ka phir akhir mein teesri talaq ka aur darmiyan mein jo khula ka zikr hai, pas maloom hua ke khula talaq nahin balkay faskh hai. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) aur Hazrat Umar (R.A), Ta'oos, Ikrama, Ahmad bin Hanbal, Ishaq bin Rahuyah, Abu Saur, Dawood bin Ali Zahiri ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka bhi qadeem qaul yahi hai aur ayat ke zahiri alfaz bhi yahi hain. Ba'az deegar buzurg farmate hain ke khula talaq-e-ba'in hai aur agar ek se zyada ki niyat hogi to woh bhi motabar hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Umm-e-Bakr Aslamiyah ne apne khawand Abdullah bin Khalid se khula liya aur Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne use ek talaq hone ka fatwa diya aur sath hi farma diya ke agar kuch saman liya ho to jitna saman liya ho woh hai, lekin yeh asar za'eef hai wallahu a'alam. Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A), Saeed bin Musayyab, Hasan, Ata, Shuraih, Sha'bi, Ibrahim, Jabir bin Zaid, Malik, Abu Hanifa aur un ke sathi Thauri, Auza'i, Abu Usman Batti ka yahi qaul hai ke khula talaq hai. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka bhi jadeed qaul yahi hai, han Abu Hanifa (R.H) kehte hain ke agar do talaq ki niyat khula dene wale ki hai to do ho jayengi. Agar kuch kuch lafz na kahe aur mutlaq khula ho to ek talaq-e-ba'in hogi agar teen ki niyat hai to teen ho jayengi. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka ek aur qaul bhi hai ke agar talaq ka lafz nahin aur koi daleel-o-shahadat bhi nahin to woh bilkul koi cheez nahin. Masla: Imam Abu Hanifa, Shafi'i, Ahmad, Ishaq bin Rahuyah (Rahimahumullah) ka maslak hai ke khula ki iddat talaq ki iddat hai. Umar (R.A), Ali (R.A), Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) aur Saeed bin Musayyab, Salman bin Yasar, Amrah, Salim, Abu Salama, Umar bin Abdul Aziz, Ibn-e-Shihab, Hasan, Sha'bi, Ibrahim Nakh'i, Abu Ayaz, Khallas bin Amr, Qatada, Sufyan Thauri, Auza'i, Laith bin Sa'd aur Abu Ubaid (Rahimahumullah Ajma'een) ka bhi yahi farman hai.

Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) farmate hain aksar Ahl-e-Ilm isi taraf gaye hain woh kehte hain ke chunke khula talaq hai lehaza iddat is ki iddat-e-talaq ke misl hai, dusra qaul yeh hai ke sirf ek haiz is ki iddat hai. Hazrat Usman (R.A) ka yahi faisla hai, Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) go teen haiz ka fatwa dete thay lekin sath hi farma diya karte thay ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) hum se behtar hain aur hum se bade aalim hain, aur Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se ek haiz ki muddat bhi marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Ikrama (R.H), Aban bin Usman (R.H) aur tamam woh log jin ke naam upar aaye hain jo khula ko faskh kehte hain zaroori hai ke un sab ka qaul bhi yahi ho, Abu Dawood (R.H) aur Tirmidhi (R.H) ki hadith mein bhi yahi hai ke Thabit bin Qais (R.A) ki biwi sahiba ko Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is surat mein ek haiz iddat guzarne ka hukum diya tha, Tirmidhi (R.H) mein hai ke Rubai bint-e-Muawwaz (R.A) ko bhi khula ke baad ek hi haiz iddat guzarne ka Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman sadir hua tha. Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne khula wali aurat se farmaya tha ke tujh par iddat hi nahin. Haan agar qareeb ke zamana mein hi khawand se mili ho to ek haiz aa jane tak us ke paas thehri raho. Maryam Mughalba ke bare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka jo faisla tha us ki mutaba'at Hazrat Amir-ul-Momineen (R.A) ne ki. Masla: Jamhoor ulama-e-kiram aur charon imamon ke nazdeek khula wali aurat se ruju karne ka haq khawand ko hasil nahin, is liye ke us ne maal de kar apne tain azad kara liya hai. Abdullah bin Abi Aufa (R.A), Mahan Hanafi (R.H), Saeed (R.H) aur Zuhri (R.H) ka qaul hai ke agar wapas kiya pher de to haq-e-ruj'at hasil hai baghair aurat ki razamandi ke bhi ruju kar sakta hai. Sufyan Thauri (R.H) farmate hain ke agar khula mein talaq ka lafz nahin to woh sirf judai hai aur ruju karne ka haq nahin aur agar talaq ka naam liya hai to beshak woh ruj'at ka pura pura haqdar hai, Dawood Zahiri (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain, haan sab ka ittefaq hai ke agar dono razamand hon to naya nikah iddat ke andar andar kar sakte hain. Abdul Bar (R.H) ek firqa ka yeh qaul bhi hikayat karte hain ke iddat ke andar jis tarah dusra koi us se nikah nahin kar sakta, isi tarah khula dene wala khawand bhi nikah nahin kar sakta, lekin yeh qaul shaz aur mardood hai. Masla: Is aurat par iddat ke andar andar dusri talaq bhi waqay ho sakti hai ya nahin? Is mein ulama ke teen qaul hain. Ek yeh ke nahin, kyunke woh aurat apne nafs ki malika hai aur is khawand se alag ho gayi hai, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A), Ikrama (R.H), Jabir bin Zaid (R.H), Hasan Basri (R.H), Shafi'i (R.H), Ahmad (R.H), Ishaq (R.H), Abu Thaur (R.H) ka yahi qaul hai. Dusra qaul Imam Malik (R.H) ka hai ke agar khula ke sath hi baghair khamosh rahe talaq de de to waqay ho jayegi warna nahin, yeh misl us ke hai jo Hazrat Usman (R.A) se marwi hai. Teesra qaul yeh hai ke iddat mein talaq waqay ho jayegi. Abu Hanifa (R.H), un ke as-haab, Thauri (R.H), Auza'i (R.H), Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H), Shuraih (R.H), Ta'oos (R.H), Ibrahim (R.H), Zuhri (R.H), Hakim (R.H), Hakam (R.H) aur Hammad (R.H) ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) aur Abu Darda (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi to hai lekin sabit nahin. Phir farmaya hai ke yeh Allah ki haddein hain.

Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala ki hadon se aage na barho, faraiz ko zaya na karo, maharim ki behurmati na karo, jin cheezon ka zikr shariat mein nahin tum bhi un se khamosh raho kyunke Allah ki zaat bhool chook se pak hai. Is aayat se istidlal hai un logon ka jo kehte hain ke teenon talaqein ek martaba hi dena haram hain. Malkiya aur un ke muwafiqeen ka yahi mazhab hai, un ke nazdeek sunnat tareeqa yahi hai ke talaq ek ek di jaye kyunke aayat (Al-Talaqu marratan) kaha phir farmaya ke yeh hadein hain Allah ki, in se tajawuz na karo, is ki taqwiyat is hadith se bhi hoti hai jo Sunan Nasai mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ek martaba yeh maloom hua ke kisi shakhs ne apni biwi ko teenon talaqein ek sath di hain. Aap sakht ghazabnak ho kar khade ho gaye aur farmane lage kya meri maujoodgi mein Kitabullah ke sath khela jane laga. Yahan tak ke ek shakhs ne khade ho kar kaha agar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ijazat dein to main is shakhs ko qatl karoon, lekin is riwayat ki sanad mein inqita hai.

Phir irshad hai ke jab koi shakhs apni biwi ko do talaqein de chukne ke baad teesri bhi de de to woh us par haram ho jayegi yahan tak ke dusre se baqaida nikah ho, hum-bistari ho, phir woh mar jaye ya talaq de de. Pas agar nikah ke maslan laundi bana kar wati bhi kar le to bhi agle khawand ke liye halal nahin ho sakti. Isi tarah go nikah baqaida ho lekin is dusre khawand ne mujama'at na ki ho to bhi pehle shohar ke liye halal nahin. Aksar fuqaha mein mashhoor hai ke Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) mujarrad (sirf) waza-e-aqd se halal kehte hain go mel na hua ho, lekin yeh baat un se sabit nahin. Ek hadith mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) se sawal kiya gaya ke ek shakhs ek aurat se nikah karta hai aur dukhool se pehle hi talaq de deta hai, woh dusra nikah karti hai woh bhi dukhool se pehle hi talaq de deta hai, to kya agle khawand ko ab us se nikah karna halal hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya nahin nahin, jab tak ke yeh is se aur woh is se lutf-andoz na ho lein (Musnad Ahmad, Ibn Majah waghera). Is riwayat ke rawi Hazrat Ibn Umar (R.A) se khud Imam bin Musayyab (R.H) hain, pas kaise mumkin hai ke woh riwayat bhi karein aur phir mukhalifat bhi karein aur phir woh bhi bila-daleel. Ek riwayat yeh bhi hai ke aurat rukhsat ho kar jati hai, ek makan mein miyan-biwi jate hain, parda daal diya jata hai lekin aapas mein sohbat nahin hoti, jab bhi yahi hukum hai. Khud Aap (ﷺ) ke zamane mein aisa waqiya hua, Aap (ﷺ) se pucha gaya magar Aap (ﷺ) ne pehle khawand ki ijazat na di (Bukhari, Muslim). Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Rifa'a Qurzi (R.A) ki biwi Sahiba Tamima bint Wahb ko jab unhon ne aakhri teesri talaq de di to un ka nikah Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Zubair (R.A) se hua lekin yeh shikayat le kar darbar-e-risalat-ma'ab mein aayin aur kaha woh aurat ke matlab ke nahin, mujhe ijazat ho ke main agle khawand ke ghar chali jaaun. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh nahin ho sakta jab tak ke tumhari kisi aur khawand se mujama'at na ho, in ahadith ki bahut si sanadein hain aur mukhtalif alfaaz se marwi hain.

(Fasl): Yeh yaad rahe ke maqsood dusre khawand se yeh hai ke khud use raghbat ho aur hamesha biwi bana kar rakhne ka khwahish-mand ho, kyunke nikah se maqsood yahi hai, yeh nahin ke agle khawand ke liye mehez halal ho jaye aur bas, balki Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain ke yeh bhi shart hai ke yeh mujama'at bhi mubah aur jaiz tareeq par ho maslan aurat rozay se na ho, ehram ki halat mein na ho, aitikaf ki halat mein na ho, haiz ya nifas ki halat mein na ho, isi tarah khawand bhi rozay se na ho, muharram ya mu'takif na ho, agar tarafain mein se kisi ki yeh halat ho aur phir chahe wati bhi ho jaye phir bhi pehle shohar par halal na hogi. Isi tarah agar dusra khawand zimmi ho to bhi agle khawand ke liye halal na hogi kyunke Imam sahib ke nazdeek kuffar ke aapas ke nikah batil hain.

Imam Hasan Basri R.H toh yeh bhi shart lagate hain ke inzal bhi ho kyunke Huzoor ﷺ ke alfaaz se bazahir yahi maloom hota hai ke jab tak ke woh tera aur tu us ka maza na chakhe, aur agar yahi hadith un ke pesh-e-nazar ho jaye toh chahiye ke aurat ki taraf se yeh bhi yeh shart motabar ho lekin hadith ke lafz 'aseela' se mani murad nahin, yeh yaad rahe, kyunke Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Nasai mein hadith hai ke "aseela" se murad jima hai. Agar dusre khawand ka irada is se nikah se yeh hai ke yeh aurat pehle khawand ke liye halal ho jaye toh aise logon ki muzammat balkay maloon hone ki tasreeh ahadith mein aa chuki hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai godne wali, gudwane wali, baal milane wali, milwane wali auratein maloon, halal karne wali aur jis ke liye halala kiya jata hai un par bhi Allah ki phitkar hai. Sood khor aur sood khilane wale bhi la'nati hain. Imam Tirmidhi farmate hain sahaba ka amal isi par hai. Umar R.A, Usman R.A aur Ibn-e-Umar R.A ka yahi mazhab tabieen fuqaha bhi yahi kehte hain, Ali R.A, Ibn-e-Masood R.A aur Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka bhi yahi farman hai aur riwayat mein hai ke byaj ki gawahi dene walon aur us ke likhne par bhi la'nat hai. Zakat ke na dene walon aur lene mein ziyadati karne walon par bhi la'nat hai, hijrat ke baad laut kar a'rabi banne wale par bhi phitkar hai nauha karna bhi mamnoo hai, ek hadith mein hai main tumhein yeh bataoon ke udhar liya hua saand kaun sa hai? Logon ne kaha haan. Farmaya jo "halala kare" yani talaq wali aurat se is liye nikah kare ke woh agle khawand ke liye halal ho jaye, is par Allah ki la'nat hai aur jo apne liye aisa karaye woh bhi maloon hai (Ibn-e-Majah). Ek riwayat mein hai ke aise nikah ki babat Huzoor ﷺ se pucha gaya toh aap ne farmaya yeh nikah hi nahin jis mein maqsood aur ho aur zahir aur ho, jis mein Allah ki kitab ke sath mazaq aur hansi ho, nikah sirf wahi hai jo raghbat ke sath ho, Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A se sawal kiya ke ek shakhs ne apni biwi ko teesri talaq de di, us ke baad us ke bhai ne baghair apne bhai ke kahe az-khud us se is irade se nikah kar liya ke yeh mere bhai ke liye halal ho jaye, toh aaya na nikah sahi ho gaya. Aap ne farmaya hargiz nahin, hum toh ise Nabi ﷺ ke zamana mein zina shumar karte thay. Nikah wahi hai jis mein raghbat ho, is hadith ke pichle jumle ne go ise mauqoof se hukm mein marfoo kar diya, balkay ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ne aise nikah mein tafreeq kar di, isi tarah Hazrat Ali R.A aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera bohat se sahaba-e-kiram se bhi yahi marwi hai. Phir farman hai ke agar dusra khawand nikah aur wati ke baad talaq de toh pehle khawand par phir isi aurat se nikah kar lene mein koi gunah nahin jabke yeh achi tarah guzar-auqat kar lein aur yeh bhi jaan lein ke woh dusra nikah sirf dhoka aur makr-o-fareb ka na tha balkay haqeeqat thi.

Yeh hain ahkam-e-shar'i jinhein ilm walon ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne wazeh kar diya, aimma ka is mein bhi ikhtilaf hai ke ek shakhs ne apni biwi ko do ya ek talaq de di, phir chhore raha yahan tak ke woh iddat se nikal gayi, phir us ne dusre se ghar basa liya, us se hum-bistari bhi hui, phir us ne bhi talaq de di aur us ki iddat khatam ho chuki, phir agle khawand ne us se nikah kar li to use teen mein se jo talaqein yani ek ya do jo baqi hain sirf unhi ka ikhtiyar rahega ya pehle ki tarah talaqein ginti se saqit ho jayengi aur use az-sar-e-nau teenon talaqon ka haq hasil ho jayega, pehla mazhab to hai Imam Malik, Imam Shafi'i aur Imam Ahmad (R.H) ka aur sahaba ki ek jama'at ka, dusra mazhab hai Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) aur un ke sathiyon ka aur un ki daleel yeh hai ke jab is tarah teesri talaq ho, ginti mein nahin aayi to pehli dusri kya aayegi, Wallahu A'lam.

Aeen-e-Talaq ki wazahat: Mardon ko hukum ho raha hai ke jab woh apni biwiyon ko talaq dein jin halaton mein lota lene ka haq unhein hasil hai aur iddat khatam hone ke qareeb pahunch jaye ya umdagi ke sath lotaye yani raj'at par gawah muqarrar kare aur achhai se basane ki niyat rakhe ya use umdagi se chhor de aur iddat khatam hone ke baad apne han baghair ikhtilaf jhagray dushmani aur bad-zabani ke nikal de, jahiliyat ke is dastoor ko Islam ne khatam kardiya ke talaq de di, iddat khatam hone ke qareeb ruju karliya, phir talaq de di phir ruju karliya, yunhi is dukhiya aurat ki umar barbad kardete thay ke na woh suhagan hi rahe na bewa, toh is se Allah ne roka aur farmaya ke aisa karne wala zalim hai. Phir farmaya Allah ki ayaton ko hansi na banao. Ek martaba Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Ash'ari qabeela par naraz hue toh Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) hazir-e-khidmat ho kar (in islahat-e-talaq ke bare mein) sabab daryaft kiya, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kyunke yeh log keh diya karte hain ke main ne talaq di, main ne ruju kiya. Yaad rakho musalmanon ki yeh talaqein nahin. Auraton ki iddat ke mutabiq talaqein do. Is hukum ka yeh bhi matlab liya gaya hai ke ek shakhs hai jo bila-wajah talaq deta hai aur aurat ko zarar pahunchane ke liye aur uski iddat lambi karne ke liye ruju hi karta chala jata hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke ek shakhs hai jo talaq de ya azad kare ya nikah kare phir keh de ke main ne toh hansi hansi mein yeh kiya. Aisi suraton mein yeh teeno kaam fil-haqeeqat wazeh ho jayenge. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke ek shakhs ne apni biwi ko talaq di phir keh diya ke main ne toh mazaq kiya tha, is par yeh ayat utri aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh talaq ho gayi (Ibn-e-Marduyah). Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain ke log talaq de dete, azad kardete, nikah karlete aur phir keh dete ke hum ne bator-e-dil-lagi ke yeh kiya tha, is par yeh ayat utri aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo talaq ya ghulam azad kare ya nikah kara de khwah pukhtagi ke sath khwah hansi mazaq mein woh sab ho gaya (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Yeh hadith mursal aur mauqoof kayi sanadon se marwi hai. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hadith hai ke teen cheezein hain ke pakke irade se hon, dil-lagi se hon toh teenon par itlaq ho jayega. Nikah, talaq aur raj'at. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan Ghareeb kehte hain. Allah ki ne'mat yaad karo ke us ne Rasool bheje hidayat aur daleelein nazil farmayin, kitab aur sunnat sikhayi hukum bhi kiye, mana bhi kiye waghaira waghaira. Jo kaam karo aur jo kaam na karo har ek mein Allah Jalla Shanuhu se darte raha karo aur jaan rakho ke Allah Ta'ala har posheeda aur har zahir ko bakhoobi janta hai.

Wurasa ke liye talaq ki mazeed aini wazahat: Is ayat mein aurton ke wali warison ko mumanat ho rahi hai ke jab kisi aurat ko talaq ho jaye aur iddat bhi guzar jaye phir miyan biwi apni razamandi se nikah karna chahein to woh unhein na rokein. Is ayat mein is amr ki bhi daleel hai ke aurat khud apna nikah nahin kar sakti aur nikah baghair wali ke nahin ho sakta chunancha Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Jarir ne is ayat ki tafsir mein yeh hadith warid ki hai ke aurat aurat ka nikah nahin kar sakti na aurat apna nikah aap kar sakti hai. Woh auratein zina-kar hain jo apna nikah aap kar lein. Dusri hadith mein hai nikah baghair rah-yafta ke aur do adil gawahon ke nahin, go is masle mein bhi ikhtilaf hai lekin is ke bayan ki jagah tafsir nahin. Hum is ka bayan Kitab-ul-Ahkam mein kar chuke hain, falhamdulillah. Yeh ayat Hazrat Ma'qal bin Yasar (R.A) aur un ki hamshira sahiba ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is ayat ki tafsir ke bayan mein hai ke Hazrat Ma'qal bin Yasar (R.A) farmate hain meri behan ka mangetar mere paas aata tha. Maine nikah kar diya. Us ne kuch dinon baad talaq de di. Phir iddat guzar jane ke baad nikah ki darkhwast ki, maine inkar kar diya. Is par yeh ayat utri jise sun kar Hazrat Ma'qal (R.A) ne bawajood yeh ke qasam kha rakhi thi ke main tere nikah mein na dunga, nikah par amada ho gaye aur kehne lage maine Allah ka farman suna aur maine maan liya aur apne behnoi ko bula kar dobara nikah kar diya aur apni qasam ka kaffara ada kiya. Un ka naam Jamil bint-e-Yasar tha. Un ke khawand ka naam Abu-ul-Baddah tha. Baaz ne un ka naam Fatima bint-e-Yasar bataya hai. Suddi farmate hain ke yeh ayat Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) aur un ke chacha ki beti ke bare mein nazil hui hai lekin pehli baat hi zyada sahih hai. Phir yeh farmaya yeh nasihat-o-wa'z ke liye hai jinhein shariat par iman ho, Allah ka dar ho, Qayamat ka khauf ho, unhein chahiye ke apni wilayat mein jo auratein hon unhein aisi halat mein nikah se na rokein, shariat ki itteba kar ke aisi aurton ko un ke khawandon ke nikah mein de dena aur apni hamiyat-o-ghairat ko jo khilaf-e-shara ho, shariat ke matehat kar dena hi tumhare liye behtari aur pakeezgi ka ba'is hai. In maslahaton ka ilm Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ko hi hai, tumhein maloom nahin ke kis kaam ke karne mein bhalai hai aur kis ke chhorne mein. Yeh ilm haqiqat mein Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat hi ko hai.

Mas'ala-e-Raza'at: Yahan Allah Ta'ala bachon waliyon ko irshad farmata hai ke poori poori muddat doodh pilane ki do saal hai. Is ke baad doodh pilane ka koi aitbar nahin. Is se doodh bhai pana sabit nahin hota aur na hurmat hoti hai. Aksar aimma-e-kiram ka yahi mazhab hai. Tirmidhi mein baab hai ke raza'at jo hurmat sabit karti hai woh wahi hai jo do saal pehle ki ho. Phir hadith laye hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain wahi raza'at haram karti hai jo aanton ko pur kar de aur doodh chhootne se pehle ho. Yeh hadith Hasan Sahih hai aur aksar ahl-e-ilm sahaba wagaira ka isi par amal hai ke do saal se pehle ki raza'at to motabar hai, is ke baad ki nahin. Is hadith ke rawi shart-e-Bukhari-o-Muslim par hain. Hadith mein 'fi al-thadi' ka jo lafz hai is ke ma'ani bhi mahall-e-raza'at ke yani do saal se pehle ke hain, yahi lafz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us waqt bhi farmaya tha jab aap ke sahibzade Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ka inteqal hua tha ke woh doodh pilai ki muddat mein inteqal kar gaye hain aur unhein doodh pilane wali jannat mein muqarrar hai. Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) ki umr us waqt ek saal aur das mahine ki thi. Dar Qutni mein bhi ek hadith do saal ki muddat ke baad ki raza'at ke motabar na hone ki hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) bhi farmate hain ke is ke baad koi cheez nahin. Abu Dawood Tayalisi ki riwayat mein hai ke doodh chhoot jane ke baad raza'at nahin aur balughat ke baad yateemi ka hukm nahin. Khud Quran-e-Karim mein aur jagah hai aayat (Wa fisaluhu fi 'amaini ani-shkur li wa liwalidayk) (31. Luqman: 14) doodh chhootne ki muddat do saal mein hai. Aur jagah hai aayat (Wa hamluhu wa fisaluhu thalathuna shahra) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 15) yani haml aur doodh (donon ki muddat) tees mahine hain. Yeh qaul ke do saal ke baad doodh pilane aur peene se raza'at ki hurmat sabit nahin hoti, in tamam hazrat ka hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Ibn Mas'ud (R.A), Hazrat Jabir (R.A), Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A), Hazrat Ibn Umar (R.A), Hazrat Umme Salama (R.A) Rizwanullahi Alaihim Ajma'in, Hazrat Saeed bin al-Musayyib (R.H), Hazrat Ata (R.H) aur jamhoor ka yahi mazhab hai.
