Imam Shafi'i (R.H), Imam Ahmad (R.H), Imam Ishaq (R.H), Imam Thawri (R.H), Imam Abu Yusuf (R.H), Imam Muhammad (R.H), Imam Malik (R.H) ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Go ek riwayat mein Imam Malik (R.H) se do saal do mah bhi marwi hain aur ek riwayat mein do saal teen mah bhi marwi hain. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) dhai saal ki muddat batlate hain. Zufar (R.H) kehte hain jab tak doodh nahin chhoota to teen saalon tak ki muddat hai, Imam Awza'i (R.H) se bhi yeh riwayat hai. Agar kisi bacha ka do saal se pehle doodh chhudwa liya jaye phir is ke baad kisi aurat ka doodh woh piye to bhi hurmat sabit na hogi is liye ke ab qaim-maqam-e-khorak ke ho gaya. Imam Awza'i (R.H) se ek riwayat yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke doodh chhudwa lene ke baad raza'at nahin. Is qaul ke donon matlab ho sakte hain yani ya to yeh ke do saal ke baad ya yeh ke jab bhi is se pehle doodh chhoot gaya.

Is ke baad jaise Imam Malik R.H ka farman hai, Wallahu A'lam, haan Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Ayesha R.A se marwi hai ke woh is ke baad ke, balkay baray aadmi ki raza'at ko hurmat mein mu'assir jaanti hain. Ata R.H aur Lais R.H ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Hazrat Ayesha R.A jis shakhs ka kisi ke ghar zyada aana jana jaantin to wahan hukum detin ke woh auratein usay apna doodh pilayen aur is hadith se daleel pakarti thin ke Hazrat Salim R.A ko jo Hazrat Abu Huzaifa R.A ke maula thay, An-Hazrat ﷺ ne hukum diya tha ke woh un ki biwi sahiba ka doodh pee lein, halankeh woh bari umar ke thay aur is raza'at ki wajah se phir woh barabar aatay jatay rehtay thay lekin Huzoor ﷺ ki dusri azwaj-e-mutahharat R.A is ka inkar karti thin aur kehti thin ke yeh waqia khaas un hi ke liye tha har shakhs ke liye yeh hukum nahin, yahi mazhab jumhoor ka hai yani charon imamon, saton faqihon, kul ke kul baray Sahaba-e-Kiram R.A aur tamam Ummahat-ul-Momineen R.A ka siwaye Hazrat Ayesha R.A ke aur un ki daleel woh hadith hai jo Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne farmaya dekh liya karo ke tumhare bhai kaun hain, raza'at us waqt hai jab doodh bhook mita sakta ho, baqi raza'at ka poora masla ayat (Wa Ummahatukumullati arza'nakum) ki tafsir mein aayega Insha'Allah, phir farman hai ke bachon ki maa ka naan-o-nafaqa bachon ke walid par hai. Apne apne shehron ki aadat aur dastoor ke mutabiq ada karein, na to zyada ho na kam balkay hasb-e-taqat-o-wus'at darmiyani kharch de diya karo jaise farmaya ayat (Wa Ummahatukumullati arza'nakum) (Surah An-Nisa: 23) yani kushadgi walay apni kushadgi ke mutabiq aur tangi walay apni taqat ke mutabiq dein, Allah Ta'ala taqat se zyada takleef nahin deta, anqareeb Allah Ta'ala sakhti ke baad aasani kar de ga. Zahhak R.H farmatay hain ke jis shakhs ne apni biwi ko talaq di aur us ke sath bacha bhi hai to us ki doodh pilayi ke zamana tak ka kharch us mard par wajib hai. Phir irshad-e-bari hai ke aurat apne bachay ko doodh pilane se inkar kar ke us ke walid ko tangi mein na daal de balkay bachay ko doodh pilati rahe is liye ke yahi us ki guzran ka sabab hai. Doodh se jab bacha be-niyaz ho jaye to beshak bacha ko de de lekin phir bhi nuqsan rasani ka irada na ho. Isi tarah khawand us se jabran bachay ko alag na kare jis se ghareeb dukh mein paray. Waris ko bhi yahi chahiye ke bachay ki walida ko kharch se tang na kare, us ke huqooq ki nigahdasht kare aur usay zarar na pohanchaye. Hanfiya aur Hanbliya mein se jo log is ke qail hain ke rishtedaron mein se ba'az ka nafaqa ba'az par wajib hai unhon ne isi ayat se istidlal kiya hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A aur jumhoor salaf-e-saliheen R.H se yahi marwi hai. Samurah wali marfoo hadith se bhi yahi mutarash-shah hota hai jis mein hai ke jo shakhs apne kisi mehram rishtedar ka malik ho jaye to woh azaad ho jaye ga. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke do saal ke baad doodh pilana umooman bacha ko nuqsan deta hai, ya to jismani ya dimaghi. Hazrat Alqama R.H ne ek aurat ko do saal se baray bachay ko doodh pilatay huay dekh kar mana farmaya.

Phir farmaya gaya hai agar yeh razamandi aur mashwara se do saal ke andar andar jab kabhi doodh chhurana chahein toh un par koi haraj nahin. Haan ek ki chahat dusre ki razamandi ke baghair nakafi hogi aur yeh bachche ke bachao ki aur uski nigrani ki tarkeeb hai. Khayal farmaiye ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon par kis qadar Raheem-o-Kareem hai ke chhote bachchon ke walidain ko un kamon se rok diya jismein bachche ki barbadi ka khauf tha, aur woh hukum diya jisse ek taraf bachche ka bachao hai dusri janib maa baap ki islah hai. Surah Talaq mein farmaya aayat (Fa-in arda'na lakum fa-atuhunna ujurahunna) (65. At-Talaq: 6) agar auratein bachche ko doodh pilaya karein toh tum unki ujrat bhi diya karo aur aapas mein umdagi ke sath mamla rakho. Yeh aur baat hai ke tangi ke waqt kisi aur se doodh pilwa do, chunancha yahan bhi farmaya agar walida aur walid muttafiq ho kar kisi uzr ki bina par kisi aur se doodh shuru karayein aur pehle ki ijazat kamil taur par walid walida ko de de toh bhi donon par koi gunah nahin, ab dusri kisi daya se ujrat chuka kar doodh pilwa dein. Logo Allah Ta'ala se har amr mein darte raha karo aur yaad rakho ke tumhare aqwal-o-af'aal ko woh bakhoobi jaanta hai.

Khawand ke inteqal ke baad: Is ayat mein hukum ho raha hai ke aurat apne khawand ke inteqal ke baad chaar mahine das din iddat guzarein khwah us se mujamat ho ya na hui ho, is par ijma hai. Daleel is ki ek toh is ayat ka umoom dusre yeh hadith jo Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Sunan mein hai jise Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) sahih kehte hain ke us se mujamat nahin ki thi na mehar muqarrar hua tha ke us ka inteqal ho gaya, farmaiye is ki nisbat kya fatwa hai? Jab woh kayi martaba aaye gaye toh aap ne farmaya main apni raye se fatwa deta hoon, agar theek ho toh Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se jaano aur agar khata ho toh meri aur shaitan ki taraf se samjho, Allah aur Rasool (ﷺ) is se bari hain. Mera fatwa yeh hai ke is aurat ko poora mehar milega jo us ke khandan ka dastoor ho, is mein koi kami beshi na ho aur is aurat ko poori iddat guzarni chahiye aur use virsa bhi milega. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ma'qal bin Yasar Ashja'i (R.A) khade ho gaye aur farmane lage Barwa' bint-e-Washiq ke bare mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne yahi faisla kiya tha. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) yeh sun kar bahut khush hue. Ba'az riwayaton mein hai ke Ashja' ke bahut se logon ne yeh riwayat bayan ki. Haan jo aurat apne khawand ki wafat ke waqt hamal se ho us ke liye yeh iddat nahin, us ki iddat waza-e-hamal hai. Go, inteqal ki ek sa'at ke baad hi ho jaye. Quran mein hai ayat (Wa-ulatu-l-ahmali ajaluhunna an-yada'na hamlahunna) (Surah At-Talaq: 4) hamal waliyon ki iddat waza-e-hamal hai. Haan Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke waza-e-hamal aur chaar mahine das din mein jo der ki iddat ho woh hamila ki iddat hai, yeh qaul toh bahut achha hai aur dono ayaton mein is se tatbeeq bhi umda taur par ho jati hai lekin is ke khilaf Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek saaf aur sarih hadith majood hai jis mein hai ke Hazrat Subai'ah Aslamiyah (R.A) ke khawand ka jab inteqal hua, us waqt aap hamal se thin aur chand ratein guzar payi thin toh bacha tawallud hua, jab naha dho chukein toh libas waghera achha pehan liya, Hazrat Abu-us-Sanabil bin Ba'lak ne yeh dekh kar farmaya kya tum nikah karna chahti ho? Allah ki qasam jab tak chaar mahine das din na guzar jayein tum nikah nahin kar sakteen. Hazrat Subai'ah (R.A) yeh sun kar khamosh ho gayin aur shaam ko khidmat-e-Nabawi (ﷺ) mein hazir huin aur masla poocha toh aap ne farmaya ke jab bacha ho gaya usi waqt tum iddat se nikal gayin, ab agar tum chaho toh beshak nikah kar sakti ho. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke jab Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ko is hadith ka ilm hua toh aap ne bhi apne qaul se ruju kar liya, is ki ta'eed is se bhi hoti hai ke Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ke sathi shagird bhi isi hadith ke mutabiq fatwa diya karte the. Isi tarah laundi ki iddat bhi itni nahin, us ki iddat is se aadhi hai yani do mahine aur paanch ratein, jamhoor ka mazhab yahi hai jis tarah laundi ki had ba-nisbat azad aurat ke aadhi hai isi tarah iddat bhi. Muhammad bin Sirin (R.H) aur ba'az ulama-e-zahiriyah laundi ki aur azad aurat ki iddat mein barabari ke qail hain.

Un ki daleel ek toh is aayat ka umoom hai, dusre yeh ke iddat ek jali amr hai jis mein tamam auratein yaksan hain. Hazrat Saeed ibn-e-Musayyab, Abul Aaliyah waghera farmate hain is iddat mein hikmat yeh hai ke agar aurat ko hamal hoga toh is muddat mein bilkul zahir ho jayega. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki Bukhari-o-Muslim wali marfoo hadith mein hai ke insaan ki paidaish ka yeh haal hai ke chalees din tak toh raham-e-madar mein nutfa ki shakal mein hota hai, phir khoon-e-basta ki shakal chalees din tak rehti hai, phir chalees din tak gosht ka lothra rehta hai, phir Allah Ta'ala farishte ko bhejta hai aur woh is mein rooh phoonkta hai. Toh yeh ek sau bees din huye jis ke chaar mahine huye, das din ehtiyatan aur rakh de kyunke baaz mahine untees din ke bhi hote hain aur jab rooh phoonk di gayi toh ab bacha ki harkat mehsoos hone lagti hai aur hamal bilkul zahir ho jata hai. Is liye itni iddat muqarrar ki gayi, Wallahu A'alam. Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) farmate hain das din is liye hain ke rooh inhi das dinon mein phoonki jati hai. Rabee bin Anas bhi yahi farmate hain. Hazrat Imam Ahmad (R.H) se ek riwayat mein yeh bhi marvi hai taake jis laundi se bacha ho jaye us ki iddat bhi azaad aurat ke barabar hai is liye ke woh farash ban gayi aur is liye bhi ke Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai. Hazrat Amr bin Aas (R.A) ne farmaya logo sunnat-e-nabvi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hum par khalt-malt na karo. Aulaad wali laundi ki iddat jabke us ka sardar faut ho jaye chaar mahine aur das din hain. Yeh hadith ek aur tareeq se bhi Abu Dawood mein marvi hai. Imam Ahmad (R.H) is hadith ko munkar batate hain aur kehte hain ke is ke ek rawi Qabeesa ne apne ustad Umar se yeh riwayat nahin suni. Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab, Mujahid, Saeed bin Jubair, Hasan bin Sireen, Ibn-e-Ayyaz, Zuhri aur Amr bin Abdul Aziz ka yahi qaul hai. Yazeed bin Abdul Malik bin Marwan jo Ameer-ul-Momineen thay, yahi hukum dete thay. Auza'i, Ishaq bin Rahwaih aur Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) bhi ek riwayat mein yahi farmate hain lekin Taoos aur Qatada is ki iddat bhi aadhi batlate hain yani do mah paanch raatein. Abu Hanifa (R.H) un ke saath Hasan bin Saleh bin Hayy farmate hain main haiz iddat guzare, Hazrat Ali (R.A), Ibn-e-Masood (R.A), Atta aur Ibrahim Nakh'i ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Imam Malik (R.H), Imam Shafi'i (R.H) aur Imam Ahmad (R.H) ki mashhoor riwayat yeh hai ke is ki iddat ek haiz hi hai. Ibn-e-Umar (R.A), Sha'bi, Makhool, Lais, Abu Ubaid, Abu Saur aur jamhoor ka yahi mazhab hai. Hazrat Lais (R.H) farmate hain ke agar haiz ki halat mein us ka sayyad faut hua hai toh isi haiz ka khatam ho jana us ki iddat ka khatam ho jana hai. Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain agar haiz na aata ho toh teen mahine iddat guzare. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) aur jamhoor farmate hain ek mahina aur teen din mujhe zyada pasand hain Wallahu A'alam (Mutarjim ke nazdeek qawi qaul pehla hai yani misl-e-azaad aurat ke poori iddat guzare. Wallahu A'alam). Baad azan jo irshad farmaya us se maloom hota hai ke yeh sog wajib hai.

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hadith hai ke jo aurat Allah par aur Qayamat par iman rakhti ho use teen din se zyada kisi mayyat par sogwari karna haram hai, haan khawand par chaar mahine das din sogwar hai. Ek aurat ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke meri beti ka miyan mar gaya hai aur uski aankhein dukh rahi hain, kya main uske surma laga doon? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya nahin, do teen martaba usne apna sawal doohraya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi jawab diya, aakhri baar farmaya yeh toh chaar mahine aur das din hi hain, jahiliyat mein toh tum saal saal bhar baithi raha karti thin. Hazrat Zainab bint-e-Umm-e-Salma (R.A) farmati hain ke pehle jab kisi aurat ka khawand mar jata tha toh use kisi jhonpde mein daal dete the, woh badtareen kapde pehanti, khushbu waghera se alag rehti aur saal bhar tak aisi hi sari bhasi rehti thi, saal bhar ke baad nikalti aur oontni ki mengni le kar phenkti aur kisi janwar maslan gadha ya bakri ya parinday ke jism ke sath apne jism ko ragadti, basa auqat woh mar hi jata, yeh thi jahiliyat ki rasm. Pas yeh aayat uske baad ki aayat ki nasikh hai jis mein hai ke aisi auratein saal bhar tak ruki rahein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghera yahi farmate hain ke is mein ikhtilaf hai aur tafseel iski anqareeb aayegi Insha'Allah, matlab yeh ke is zamana mein bewa aurat ko zeenat aur khushbu aur bahut bhadkeele kapde aur zevar waghera pehanna mana hai aur yeh sogwari wajib hai. Haan ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke talaq-e-raj'i ki iddat mein yeh wajib nahin, aur jab talaq-e-ba'in ho toh wujoob aur adam-e-wujoob ke dono qaul hain, faut shuda khawandon ki zinda biwiyon par toh sab par yeh sogwari wajib hai, khwah woh nabaligha hon khwah woh auratein hon jo haiz waghera se utar chuki hon, khwah azaad auratein hon khwah londiyan hon, khwah musalman hon khwah kafira hon kyunke aayat mein aam hukum hai, haan Thauri aur Abu Hanifa (R.H) kafira aurat ki sogwari ke qail nahin, Shahab aur Ibn-e-Nafi ka qaul bhi yahi hai unki daleel woh hadith hai jis mein hai ke jo aurat Allah aur Qayamat ke din par iman rakhti ho. Pas maloom hua ke yeh hukum ta'abudi hai, Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) aur Thauri (R.H) kamsin nabaligha aurat ke liye bhi yahi farmate hain kyunke woh ghair mukallafa hai. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) aur unke as-haab musalman londi ko is mein milate hain lekin is masail ki tasfiya ka yeh mauqa nahin Wallahu-ul-Muwaffiq-bis-Sawab. Phir farmaya jab inki iddat guzar chuke toh inke auliya par koi gunah nahin ke woh auratein apne banao singhar karein ya nikah karein, yeh sab inke liye halal-e-tayyab hai. Hasan, Zuhri aur Suddi se bhi isi tarah marwi hai.

Paigham-e-Nikah: Matlab yeh ke sarahat ke baghair nikah ki chahat ka izhar kisi achhay tareeq par iddat ke andar karne mein gunah nahin, maslan yun kehna ke main nikah karna chahta hoon, main aisi aisi aurat ko pasand karta hoon, main chahta hoon ke Allah mera jora bhi mila de, Insha'Allah main tere siwa dusri aurat se nikah ka irada nahin karunga, main kisi nek deendar aurat se nikah karna chahta hoon, isi tarah us aurat se jise talaq-e-ba'in mil chuki ho iddat ke andar aisay mubham alfaaz kehna bhi jaiz hain. Jaisa ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Fatima bint-e-Qais se farmaya tha jabke un ke khawand Abu Amr bin Hafs ne unhein aakhri teesri talaq de di thi ke jab tum iddat khatam karo to mujhe khabar kar dena, iddat ka zamana Hazrat Ibn-e-Maktum ke yahan guzaro, jab Hazrat Fatima ne iddat nikal jaane ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ittila di to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Usama bin Zaid se, jin ka manga tha, nikah kara diya, han raj'i talaq ki iddat ke zamana mein bajuz us ke khawand ke kisi ko bhi yeh haq nahin ke woh isharatan kinaya bhi apni raghbat zahir kare, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh farman ke tum apne nafs mein chupao yani mangni ki khwahish, ek jagah irshad hai tera Rab un ke seenon mein posheeda ko aur zahir baaton ko jaanta hai. Dusri jagah tumhare batin-o-zahir ka jaanne wala hoon. Pas Allah Ta'ala bakhoobi jaanta tha ke tum apne dilon mein zaroor zikr karoge is wastay us ne tangi hata di, lekin un auraton se posheeda waaday na karo, yani zinakari se bacho, un se yun na kaho ke main tum par aashiq hoon, tum bhi waada karo ke mere siwa kisi aur se nikah na karogi waghera. Iddat mein aisay alfaaz ka kehna halal nahin, na yeh jaiz hai ke posheeda tor par iddat mein nikah karle aur iddat guzar jaane ke baad us nikah ka izhar kare, pas yeh sab aqwal is aayat ke umoom mein aa sakte hain isi liye farman hua ke magar yeh ke tum un se achi baat karo maslan wali se keh diya ke jaldi na karna, iddat guzar jaane ki mujhe bhi khabar karna waghera. Jab tak iddat khatam na ho jaye tab tak nikah mun'aqid na kiya karo, ulama ka ijma hai ke iddat ke andar nikah sahih nahin.

Agar kisi ne kar liya aur dukhool bhi ho gaya toh bhi un mein judai kara di jayegi, ab aaya yeh aurat us par hamesha ke liye haram ho jayegi ya phir iddat guzar jane ke baad nikah kar sakta hai? Is mein ikhtilaf hai. Jamhoor toh kehte hain ke kar sakta hai lekin Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain ke woh hamesha ke liye haram ho gayi, is ki daleel yeh hai ke Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) farmate hain ke jab aurat ka nikah iddat ke andar kar diya jayega agar uska khawand us se nahin mila toh un dono mein judai kara di jayegi aur jab us ke pehle khawand ki iddat guzar jaye toh yeh shakhs manjumla aur logon ke us ke nikah ka paigham daal sakta hai aur agar dono mein milaap bhi ho gaya hai jab bhi judai kara di jayegi aur pehle khawand ki iddat guzar kar phir is dusre khawand ki iddat guzaregi aur phir yeh shakhs us se hargiz nikah nahin kar sakta. Is faisla ka makhaz yeh maloom hota hai ke jab is shakhs ne jaldi kar ke Allah Ta'ala ke muqarrar karda waqt ka lihaz na kiya toh use is ki khilaf saza di gayi ke woh aurat us par hamesha ke liye haram kar di gayi, jaisa ke qatil apne maqtool ke virsa se mehroom kar diya jata hai. Imam Shafi (R.H) ne Imam Malik (R.H) se bhi yeh asar riwayat kiya hai, Imam Baihaqi (R.H) farmate hain ke pehla qaul toh Imam sahab ka yahi tha lekin jadeed qaul aap ka yeh hai ke use bhi nikah karna halal hai kyunke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka yahi fatwa hai. Hazrat Umar (R.A) wala yeh asar sanadan munqata hai balkay Hazrat Masrooq (R.H) farmate hain ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne is baat se ruju kar liya hai aur farmaya hai ke mehar ada kar de aur iddat ke baad yeh dono aapas mein agar chahein toh nikah kar sakte hain. Phir farmaya jaan lo ke Allah Ta'ala tumhare dilon ki posheeda baton ko janta hai, is ka lihaz aur khauf rakho apne dil mein auraton ke mutaliq farman-e-bari ke khilaf khayal bhi na aane do. Hamesha dil ko saaf rakho, bure khayalat se use paak rakho. Darr, khauf ke hukum ke sath hi apni rahmat ki tama aur lalach bhi dilayi aur farmaya ke Allah-ul-Aalameen khataon ko bakhshne wala aur hilm-o-karam wala hai.

Haq-e-Mehar kab aur kitna: Aqd-e-Nikah ke baad dukhool se bhi pehle talaq ka dena mubah ho raha hai. Mufassireen ne farmaya hai ke yahan murad "mass" se nikah hai, dukhool se pehle talaq de dena, balkeh mehar ka bhi abhi taqarrur nahin hua aur talaq de dena bhi jaiz hai, go is mein aurat ki behad dil shikni hai, isi liye hukm hai ke apne maqdoor bhar is surat mein mard ko aurat ke sath sulook karna chahiye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is ka aala hissa khadim hai aur is se kam chandi hai aur is se kam kapra hai, yani agar maldar hai to ghulam waghera de aur agar muflis hai to kam se kam teen kapre de. Hazrat Sha'bi farmate hain darmiyana darja is faida pohanchane ka yeh hai ke kurta, dupatta, lihaf aur chadar de de. Tashreeh farmate hain paanch sau dirham de, Ibn-e-Sirin (R.H) farmate hain ghulam de ya khorak de ya kapre latte de, Hazrat Hasan bin Ali (R.A) ne das hazar diye thay lekin phir bhi woh biwi sahiba farmati thin ke is mehboob-e-maqbool ki judai ke muqabla mein yeh haqeer cheez kuch bhi nahin. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) ka qaul hai ke agar dono is faida ki miqdar mein tanaza'a karein to us ke khandan ke mehar se aadhi raqam dilwa di jaye, Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka farman hai ke kisi cheez par khawand ko majboor nahin kiya ja sakta balkeh kam se kam jis cheez ko muta'a yani faida aur asbaab kaha ja sakta hai woh kafi hoga. Mere nazdeek itna kapra muta'a hai jitne mein namaz parh leni jaiz ho jaye, go pehla qaul Hazrat-e-Imam ka yeh tha ke mujhe is ka koi sahih andaza maloom nahin lekin mere nazdeek behtar yeh hai ke kam se kam tees dirham hone chahiye jaisa ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se marwi hai, is bare mein bohat se aqwal hain ke har talaq wali aurat ko kuch na kuch asbaab dena chahiye ya sirf usi surat ko jis se mel milap na hua ho, ba'az to sab ke liye kehte hain kyunke Quran-e-Kareem mein hai ke ayat (وَلِلْمُطَلَّقٰتِ مَتَاعٌۢ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ ۭحَقًّا عَلَي الْمُتَّقِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 241) pas is ayat ke umoom se sab ke liye woh sabit karte hain. Is tarah un ki daleel yeh bhi hai ayat (فَتَعَالَيْنَ اُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَاُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيْلًا) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 28) yani ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni biwiyon se kaho ke agar tumhari chahat duniya ki zindagi aur isi ki zeenat ki hai to aao main tumhein kuch asbaab bhi doon aur tumhein achhai ke sath chor doon, pas yeh tamam azwaj-e-mutahharat woh thin jin ka mehar bhi muqarrar tha aur jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein bhi aa chuki thin, Sa'eed bin Jubair (R.H), Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H), Hasan Basri (R.H) ka qaul yahi hai. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka bhi ek qaul yahi hai aur ba'az to kehte hain ke un ka naya aur sahih qaul yahi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Ba'az kehte hain asbab ka dena us talaq wali ko zaroori hai jis se khalwat na hui ho go mehar muqarrar ho chuka ho kyunke Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (Yaa Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Iza Nakahtumul Mu'minati Summa Tallaqtumoohunna Min Qabli An Tamassoohunna Famaa Lakum Alaihinna Min Iddatin Ta'tadoonahaa, Famatti'oohunna Wa Sarrihoohunna Sarahan Jameela) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 49) yani ae imaan walo tum jab imaan wali aurat se nikah kar lo phir unhein haath lagane se pehle hi talaq de do to un par tumhari taraf se koi iddat nahin jo iddat woh guzarein tum unhein kuch maal asbab de do aur husn-e-kirdar se chhor do, Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) ka qaul hai ke Surah Ahzab ki yeh aayat Surah Baqarah ki aayat se mansookh ho chuki hai. Hazrat Sahl bin Sa'ad (R.A) aur Abu Usaid (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Umaimah bint Sharjeel se nikah kiya jab woh rukhsat ho kar aayin aur Aap (ﷺ) ne apna haath barhaya to goya us ne bura mana, Aap (ﷺ) ne Abu Usaid (R.A) se farmaya ise do rangeen kapre de kar rukhsat karo, teesra qaul yeh hai ke sirf isi surat mein bator-e-faida ke asbab-o-mata' ka dena zaroori hai jabke aurat ki wida' na hui ho aur mehar bhi muqarrar na hua ho aur agar dukhool ho gaya ho to mehar-e-misl yani khandan ke dastoor ke mutabiq dena parega agar muqarrar na hua ho aur agar muqarrar ho chuka ho aur rukhsat se pehle talaq de de to aadha mehar dena parega aur agar rukhsati bhi ho chuki hai to poora mehar dena parega aur yahi mata' ka ewaz hoga. Haan is museebat zada aurat ke liye mata' hai jis se na milaap hua na mehar muqarrar hua aur talaq mil gayi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) aur Mujahid (R.H) ka yahi qaul hai, go ba'az ulama isi ko mustahab batlate hain ke har talaq wali aurat ko kuch na kuch de dena chahiye un ke siwa jo mehar muqarrar kiye hue na hon aur na khawand biwi ka mel hua ho, yahi matlab Surah Ahzab ki is aayat-e-takhayyur ka hai jo is se pehle isi aayat ki tafseer mein bayan ho chuki hai aur isi liye yahan is khaas surat ke liye farmaya gaya hai ke ameer apni wus'at ke mutabiq dein aur ghareeb apni taqat ke mutabiq. Hazrat Sha'bi (R.H) se sawal hota hai ke yeh asbab na dene wala kya giraftar kiya jayega? To Aap (R.H) farmate hain apni taqat ke barabar de de, Allah ki qasam is bare mein kisi ko giraftar nahin kiya gaya agar yeh wajib hota to qazi log zaroor aise shakhs ko qaid kar lete.

Mazeed wazahat: Is ayat mein saaf dalalat hai is amr par ke pehli ayat mein jin aurton ke liye muta'a muqarrar kiya gaya tha woh sirf wohi aurtein hain jin ka zikr is ayat mein tha kyunke is ayat mein yeh bayan hua hai ke dukhool se pehle jabke talaq de di gayi ho aur mehar muqarrar ho chuka ho to aadha mehar dena parega. Agar yahan bhi is ke siwa koi aur muta'a wajib hota to woh zaroor zikr kiya jata kyunke dono ayaton ki dono suraton mein ek ke baad ek bayan ho rahi hain wallahu a'alam, is surat mein jo yahan bayan ho rahi hai aadhe mehar par ulama ka ijma hai, lekin teen ke nazdeek poora mehar us waqt wajib ho jata hai jabke khalwat ho gayi yani miyan biwi tanhai ki halat mein kisi makan mein jama ho gaye, go hum-bistari na hui ho. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka bhi pehla qaul yahi hai aur khulafa-e-rashideen ka faisla bhi yahi hai, lekin Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ki riwayat se Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke is surat mein bhi sirf nisf mehar muqarrara hi dena parega, Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain main bhi yahi kehta hoon aur zahir alfaz-e-Kitabullah ke bhi yahi kehte hain. Imam Baihaqi (R.H) farmate hain ke is riwayat ke ek rawi Laith bin Abi Sulaim agarche sanad pakre jane ke qabil nahin lekin Ibn-e-Abi Talha se Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki yeh riwayat marwi hai jis se maloom hota hai ke aap ka farman yahi hai, phir farmata hai ke agar aurtein khud aisi halat mein apna aadha mehar bhi khawand ko maaf kar dein to yeh aur baat hai is surat mein khawand ko sab maaf ho jayega. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke thayyiba aurat agar apna haq chhor de to use ikhtiyar hai. Bohat se mufassireen-e-taba'een ka yahi qaul hai, Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi (R.H) kehte hain ke is se murad aurton ka maaf karna nahin balkay mardon ka maaf karna hai. Yani mard apna aadha hissa chhor de aur poora mehar de de lekin yeh qaul shaz hai koi aur is qaul ka qail nahin, phir farmata hai ke woh maaf kar de jis ke hath mein nikah ki girah hai. Ek hadith mein hai is se murad khawand hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se sawal hua ke is se murad kya aurat ke awliya hain, farmaya nahin balkay is se murad khawand hai. Aur bhi bohat se mufassireen se yahi marwi hai. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka jadeed qaul bhi yahi hai. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) waghera ka bhi yahi mazhab hai, is liye ke haqeeqatan nikah ko baqi rakhna tor dena waghera yeh sab khawand ke hi ikhtiyar mein hai aur jis tarah wali ko us ki taraf se jis ka wali hai, us ke maal ka de dena jaiz nahin isi tarah us ke mehar ke maaf kar dene ka bhi ikhtiyar nahin. Dusra qaul is bare mein yeh hai ke is se murad aurat ke baap bhai aur woh log hain jin ki ijazat baghair aurat nikah nahin kar sakti. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Alqama (R.H), Hasan (R.H), Ata (R.H), Ta'oos (R.H), Zuhri (R.H), Rabee'a (R.H), Zaid bin Aslam (R.H), Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H), Ikrama (R.H), Muhammad bin Sireen (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai ke in dono buzurgon ka bhi ek qaul yahi hai.

Imam Malik R.H ka aur Imam Shafi R.H ka qaul-e-qadeem bhi yahi hai, is ki daleel yeh hai ke wali ne hi is haq ka haqdar use kiya tha to is mein tasarruf karne ka bhi use ikhtiyar hai, go aur maal mein her-pher karne ka ikhtiyar na ho, Ikrama R.H farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne maaf kar dene ki rukhsat aurat ko di aur agar woh bakhili aur tang-dili kare to is ka wali bhi maaf kar sakta hai. Go woh aurat samajhdar ho, Hazrat Shuraih R.H bhi yahi farmate hain lekin jab Sha'bi R.H ne inkar kiya to aap ne is se ruju kar liya aur farmane lage ke is se murad khawand hi hai balkeh woh is baat par mubahila ko tayyar rehte thay. Phir farmata hai tumhara khoon maaf karna hi taqwa se zyada qareeb hai, is se murad auratein dono hi hain yani dono mein se achha wahi hai jo apna haq chhod de, yani aurat ya to apna aadha hissa bhi apne khawand ko maaf kar de ya khawand hi use bajaye aadhe ke poora mehar de de. Aapas ki fazeelat yani ehsan ko na bhoolo, ise bekar na chhodo balkeh ise kaam mein lao. Ibn Marduyah R.H ki ek riwayat mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya logon par ek kaat khane wala zamana aayega, momin bhi apne hathon ki cheez ko danton se pakad lega aur fazeelat-o-buzurgi ko bhool jayega, halankeh Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai apne aapas ke fazl ko na bhoolo, bure hain woh log jo ek musalman ki bekasi aur tang-dasti ke waqt us se saste damon us ki cheez khareedte hain. Halankeh Rasool Allah ﷺ ne is bai se mana farma diya hai. Agar tere paas bhalai ho to apne bhai ko bhi woh bhalai pahuncha us ki halakat mein hissa na le. Ek musalman dusre musalman ka bhai hai, na use ranj-o-gham pahunche na use bhalaiyon se mehroom rakhe, Hazrat Aun R.H hadeesein bayan karte jate hain rote jate yahan tak ke dadhi se tapakte rehte aur farmate main maldaron ki sohbat mein baitha aur dekha ke har waqt dil malool rehta hai kyunke jidhar nazar uthti har ek ko apne se achhe kapdon mein achhi khushbuon mein aur achhi sawariyon mein dekhta, han maskeenon ki mehfil mein main ne badi rahat payi, Rabb-ul-Aalameen yahi farmata hai ek dusre ki fazeelat faramosh na karo, kisi ke paas jab bhi koi sail aaye aur us ke paas kuch na ho to woh is ke liye dua-e-khair hi kar de. Allah Ta'ala tumhare aamal se khabardar hai, is par tumhare kaam aur tumhara haal bilkul roshan hai aur anqareeb woh har ek aamil ko is ke amal ka badla dega.

Salat-e-Wusta kaun si hai? : Allah Ta'ala ka hukum ho raha hai ke namazon ke waqt ki hifazat karo, is ki hudood ki nigrani rakho aur awwal waqt ada karte raho. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) sawal karte hain ke kaun sa amal afzal hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya namaz ko waqt par padhna, phir poocha kaun sa? Farmaya Allah ki raah mein jihad karna, phir kaun sa? Maa baap se bhalai karna. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain agar main kuch aur bhi poochta to aap (ﷺ) aur bhi jawab dete (Bukhari o Muslim). Hazrat Umme Farwah (R.A) jo bai'at karne wali aurton mein se hain, farmati hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se main ne suna aap (ﷺ) a'maal ka zikr farma rahe thay. Isi mein aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya sab se zyada pasandida amal Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek namaz ko awwal waqt ada karne ki jaldi karna hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Imam Tirmidhi is hadith ke ek rawi Umari ko ghair qawi batate hain, phir Salat-e-Wusta ki mazeed takeed ho rahi hai. Salaf o Khalaf ka is mein ikhtilaf hai ke Salat-e-Wusta kis namaz ka naam hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghera ka qaul hai ke is se murad subah ki namaz hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ek martaba namaz padhte hain jis mein haath utha kar qunoot bhi padhte hain, phir farmate hain yahi woh namaz-e-wusta hai jis mein qunoot ka hukum hua hai. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke yeh waqia Basre ki masjid ka hai aur qunoot apne rukoo se pehle padhi thi. Abu Aliyah farmate hain Basre mein main ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Qais (R.A) ke peeche subah ki namaz ada ki, phir main ne ek sahabi se poocha ke Salat-e-Wusta kaun si hai, aap ne farmaya yahi subah ki namaz hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke bahut se as-haab is majmay mein thay aur sab ne yahi jawab diya. Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) bhi yahi farmate hain aur bhi bahut se sahaba o tabieen ka yahi maslak hai. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain is liye ke un ke nazdeek subah ki namaz mein hi qunoot hai. Baaz kehte hain ke is se murad Maghrib ki namaz hai is liye ke is se pehle bhi chaar rakat wali namaz hai aur is ke baad bhi chaar rakat wali namaz hai aur safar mein dono qasr ki jati hain lekin Maghrib poori hi rehti hai. Yeh wajah bhi ho sakti hai ke is ke baad do namazein raat ki Isha aur Fajr woh hain jin mein oonchi aawaz se qira'at padhi jati hai aur do namazein is se pehli din ki woh hain ke jin mein aahista qira'at padhi jati hai yani Zuhr, Asr. Baaz kehte hain yeh namaz Zuhr ki hai. Ek martaba chand log Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A) ki majlis mein baithe hue thay, wahan yahi masla chida, logon ne ek aadmi bhej kar Hazrat Usama (R.A) se daryaft kiya, aap ne farmaya yeh Zuhr ki namaz hai jise Huzoor (ﷺ) awwal waqt padha karte thay (Tayalisi). Zaid bin Thabit (R.A) farmate hain is se zyada bhari namaz sahaba par aur koi na thi is liye yeh aayat nazil hui aur is se pehle bhi do namazein hain aur is ke baad do hain.

Aap hi se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Quraishiyon ki ek jamaat ke bheje hue do shakhson ne aap se yahi sawal kiya jis ke jawab mein aap ne farmaya woh Asr hai, phir do aur shakhson ne poocha aap ne farmaya woh Zuhr hai, phir un dono ne Hazrat Usama se poocha, aap ne farmaya yeh Zuhr hai. Aap ise aaftab dhalte hi padha karte the, bamushkil ek do saf ke log aate the, koi neend mein hota koi karobar mein mashghool hota jis par yeh aayat utri aur aap ne farmaya to yeh log is harkat se baaz aayen ya main un ke gharon ko jala doon ga, lekin is ke rawi Zabarqan ne sahabi se mulaqat nahin ki lekin Hazrat Zaid se aur riwayaton se bhi yeh sabit hai ke aap is se murad Zuhr ki namaz hi batate the, ek marfoo hadith mein bhi yeh hai ke Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Abu Saeed, Hazrat Ayesha waghera se bhi yahi marwi hai. Imam Abu Hanifa se bhi ek riwayat isi ki hai, baaz kehte hain is se murad Asr ki namaz hai. Aksar ulama-e-sahaba waghera ka yahi qaul hai, jumhoor tabieen ka bhi yahi qaul hai aur aksar ahl-e-asar ka bhi, balkeh jumhoor logon ka, Hafiz Abu Muhammad Abdul Momin Dimyati ne is bare mein ek mustaqil risala tasneef farmaya hai jis ka naam Kashf-ul-Ghita fi Tabyin-is-Salat-il-Wusta hai is mein un ka faisla bhi yahi hai ke Salat-e-Wusta Asr ki namaz hai. Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Ali, Ibn Masood, Abu Ayyub, Abdullah bin Amr, Samurah bin Jundab, Abu Huraira, Abu Saeed, Hafsa, Umme Habiba, Umme Salma, Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Ayesha (Rizwanullahi Alaihim Ajmaeen) waghera ka farman bhi yahi hai aur un hazrat se yahi marwi hai aur bahut se tabieen se yeh manqool hai. Imam Ahmad aur Imam Shafi ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Imam Abu Hanifa ka bhi sahih mazhab yahi hai. Abu Yusuf, Muhammad se bhi yahi marwi hai. Ibn Habib Maliki bhi yahi farmate hain. Is qaul ki daleel suniye, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Jang-e-Ahzab mein farmaya Allah Ta'ala in mushrikon ke dilon ko aur ghar ko aag se bhar de ke unhon ne hamain Salat-e-Wusta yani namaz-e-Asr se rok diya (Musnad Ahmad). Hazrat Ali farmate hain ke hum is se murad subah ya Asr ki namaz lete hain yahan tak ke Jang-e-Ahzab mein main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh suna, is mein qabron ko bhi aag se bharna warid hua hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya yeh Asr ki namaz hai. Is hadith ke bahut se turuq hain aur bahut si kitabon mein marwi hai.

Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se ek martaba is bare mein sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya hum ne bhi ek martaba is mein ikhtilaf kiya toh Abu Hashim bin Utba majlis mein se uth kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke makan par gaye, ijazat mang kar andar dakhil hue aur aap se maloom kar ke bahar aa kar hamein farmaya yeh namaz-e-Asr hai (Ibn-e-Jarir). Abdul Aziz bin Marwan ki majlis mein bhi ek martaba yahi masla pesh aaya, aap ne farmaya jao falan sahabi se pooch aao, toh ek shakhs ne kaha ke mujh se suniye mujhe Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne mere bachpan mein yahi masla poochne ke liye Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas bheja tha, aap ne meri chhungliya yani sab se chhoti ungli pakad kar farmaya dekh yeh toh hai Fajr ki namaz, phir us ke paas wali ungli tham kar farmaya yeh hui Zuhr ki, phir angootha pakad kar farmaya yeh hai Maghrib ki namaz, phir shahadat ki ungli pakad kar farmaya yeh Isha ki namaz, phir mujh se kaha ab tumhari kaun si ungli baqi rahi, main ne kaha beech ki, farmaya aur namaz kaun si baqi rahi, main ne kaha Asr ki, farmaya yahi Salat-e-Wusta hai (Ibn-e-Jarir). Lekin yeh riwayat bahut hi ghareeb hai, gharz Salat-e-Wusta se namaz-e-Asr murad hona bahut si ahadees mein warid hai jin mein se koi hasan hai koi sahih hai koi zaeef hai. Tirmidhi, Muslim wagaira mein bhi yeh hadeesein hain, phir is namaz ke bare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki takeedein aur sakhti ke sath muhafizat bhi sabit hai chunancha ek hadees mein hai jis se Asr ki namaz faut ho jaye goya us ka gharana tabah ho gaya aur maal-o-asbab barbad ho gaya aur hadees mein hai abr wale din namaz awwal waqt padho, suno jis shakhs ne Asr ki namaz chhod di us ke aamal gharat ho jate hain.

Ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Asr ki namaz qabeela-e-Ghaffar ki ek wadi mein jis ka naam Hamees tha, ada ki phir farmaya yehi namaz tum se agle logon par bhi pesh ki gayi thi lekin unhon ne ise zaya kar diya, suno ise parhne wale ko dohra ajar milta hai is ke baad koi namaz nahin jab tak ke tum tare na dekh lo (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) apne azad karda ghulam Abu Yunus se farmati hain ke mere liye ek Quran Shareef likho aur jab is ayat (Hafizu) tak pahuncho to mujhe ittila karna, chunancha jab aap ko ittila di gayi to aap ne ayat (Was-salatil-wusta) ke baad ayat (Was-salatil-Asr) likhwaya aur farmaya main ne khud ise Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek riwayat mein ayat (Wahiya salatul-Asr) ka lafz bhi hai (Ibn-e-Jareer). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dusri biwi sahiba Hazrat Hafsa (R.A) ne Amr bin Rafe ko jab aap ke Quran ke katib thay, isi tarah ye ayat likhwayi (Muwatta Imam Malik). Is hadees ke bhi bohat se tareeqay hain aur kayi kitabon mein marwi hai ke Umm-ul-Momineen (R.A) ne farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yehi alfaaz sunay hain, Hazrat Nafe farmatay hain main ne ye Quran Shareef apni aankhon se dekha, yehi ibarat Wao ke sath thi, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) aur Ubaid bin Umair ki qirat bhi yunhi hai, in riwayaton ko madd-e-nazar rakh kar baaz hazrat kehtay hain ke chunke Wao atf ke liye hota hai ke Salatul-Wusta aur hai aur Salatul-Asr aur hai lekin is ka jawab ye hai ke agar ise bator-e-hadees ke mana jaye to Hazrat Ali (R.A) wali hadees bohat zyada sahih hai aur is mein sarahat majood hai, raha Wao, so mumkin hai ke zaida ho atifa na ho jaise ayat (Wa kazalika nufassilul-ayati wa litastabina sabeelul-mujrimeen) (6. Al-An'am: 55) mein aur (Wa kazalika nuri Ibrahima malakootas-samawati wal-ardi wa liyakoona minal-muqineen) (6. Al-An'am: 75) mein ya ye Wao atf-e-sifat ke liye ho atf-e-zaat ke liye na ho jaise ayat (Wa lakin Rasoolallahi wa khataman-nabiyyeen) (33. Al-Ahzab: 40) mein aur jaise ayat (Sabbihisma rabbikal-a'lal-lazi khalaqa fasawwa. Wallazi qaddara fahada. Wallazi akhrajal-mar'a) (87. Al-A'la: 1-4) mein. Is ki misalein aur bhi bohat si hain, shairon ke sheron mein bhi ye baat payi jati hai. Sibawayh jo nahwiyon ke imam hain, farmatay hain ke "Marartu bi-akhika wa sahibika" kehna durust hai halankeh Sahib aur Akh se murad ek hi shakhs hai, Wallahu A'lam aur agar is qirat ke alfaaz ko bator-e-Qurani alfaaz ke mana jaye to zahir hai ke is khabar-e-wahid se qirat-e-Qurani sabit nahin hoti jab tak ke tawatur sabit na ho, isi liye Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne apne murattab karda Quran mein is qirat ko nahin liya, aur na saton qariyon ki qirat mein ye alfaaz hain balkeh na kisi aur aisay motabar qari ki ye qirat payi gayi hai, alawa azeen ek hadees aur hai jis se is qirat ka mansookh hona sabit ho raha hai.

Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke yeh aayat utri (Hafizu 'alas-salawati was-salatil wusta wa salatil 'asr) hum ek muddat tak isi tarah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne is aayat ko parhte rahe phir yeh tilawat mansookh ho gayi aur aayat yun hi rahi aayat (Hafizu 'alas-salawati was-salatil wusta) (2. Al-Baqarah: 238). Ek shakhs ne rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Shaqiq se kaha ke phir kya yeh namaz-e-'asr ki namaz hi hai, farmaya main toh suna chuka ke kis tarah aayat utri aur kis tarah mansookh hui, pas is bina par yeh qira'at Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) aur Hazrat Hafsa (R.A) ki riwayat wali ya toh lafzan mansookh ki jayegi aur agar waw ko mughayarat ke liye mana jaye toh lafz-o-ma'ani dono ke aitebar se mansookh ki jayegi. Ba'az kehte hain is se murad Maghrib ki namaz hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi hai lekin is ki sanad mein kalam hai, ba'az aur hazrat ka qaul bhi yahi hai. Is ki ek wajah toh yeh bayan ki jati hai ke aur farz namazein ya toh char rakat wali hain ya do rakat wali, aur is ki teen rakatein hain pas yeh darmiyana namaz thehri. Dusri wajah yeh bhi ho sakti hai ke farz namazon ki yeh witr hai aur is liye bhi ke is ki fazeelat mein bhi bohat kuch hadeesein warid hui hain. Ba'az log is se murad 'Isha ki namaz bhi batlate hain. Ba'az kehte hain paanch waqton mein se ek waqt ki namaz hai lekin hum mu'ayyan nahin kar sakte yeh mubham hai jis tarah Lailatul Qadr pure saal mein ya pure mahine mein ya pichle das dinon mein mubham hai. Ba'az hazrat farmate hain paanchon namazon ka majmu'a murad hai aur ba'az kehte hain yeh 'Isha aur Subh hai. Ba'az ka qaul hai yeh jama'at ki namaz hai, ba'az kehte hain Jum'a ki namaz hai, koi kehta hai salat-e-khauf murad hai, koi kehta hai namaz-e-'Eid murad hai, koi kehta hai salat-e-Duha murad hai, ba'az kehte hain hum tawaqquf karte hain aur kisi qaul ke qail nahin bante, is liye ke daleelein mukhtalif hain, wajah-e-tarjeeh maloom nahin, kisi qaul par ijma' hua nahin balkay zamana-e-Sahaba se le kar aaj tak jhagda jaari raha, jis tarah Hazrat Sa'eed bin Musayyib (R.H) farmate hain ke Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) is bare mein is tarah mukhtalif the phir ungliyon mein ungliyan daal kar dikhayin, lekin yeh yaad rahe ke yeh pichle aqwal sab ke sab za'eef hain, jhagda sirf Subh aur 'Asr ki namaz mein hai aur sahih ahadees se 'Asr ki namaz ka salat-e-wusta hona sabit hai pas lazim ho gaya ke hum sab aqwal ko chhor kar yahi aqeeda rakhein ke salat-e-wusta namaz-e-'Asr hai.

Imam Abu Muhammad Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Hatim Razi (Rahimahumullah) ne apni kitab Faza'il-e-Shafi'i mein riwayat ki hai ke Hazrat Imam Sahab farmaya karte thay hadith: (Kullu ma qultu fakana 'anin-Nabi ﷺ bikhilafi qawli mimma yashihhu fahidithun-Nabi ﷺ awla wa la tuqalliduni) yani mere jis kisi qaul ke khilaf koi hadith sahih sharif marwi ho to hadith hi awla hai, khabardar meri taqlid na karna. Imam Shafi'i ke is farman ko Imam Rabi', Imam Za'farani aur Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal bhi riwayat karte hain, aur Musa Abu al-Walid Jarud Imam Shafi'i se naqal karte hain ke aap ne farmaya: (Idha sahhal-hadithu wa qultu qawlan fa-ana raji'un 'an qawli wa qa'ilun bidhalika) yani meri jo baat hadith-e-sharif ke khilaf ho, main apni is baat se ruju' karta hoon aur saaf kehta hoon ke mera mazhab wahi hai jo hadith mein ho. Yeh Imam Sahab ki amanat aur sardari hai aur aap jaise a'imma-e-kiram mein se bhi har ek ne yahi farmaya hai ke un ke aqwal ko deen na samjha jaye. Rahimahumullah wa Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'in. Isi liye Qazi Mawardi farmate hain ke Imam Sahab ka Salat-e-Wusta ke bare mein yahi mazhab samajhna chahiye ke woh Asr hai, go Imam Sahab ka apna qaul yeh hai ke woh Asr nahin hai magar aap ke is farman ke mutabiq hadith-e-sahih ke khilaf is qaul ko pa kar hum ne chhor diya. Shafi'i mazhab ke aur bhi bahut se muhaddithin ne yahi farmaya hai, falhamdulillah. Ba'z fuqaha-e-Shafi'i to kehte hain ke Imam Sahab ka sirf ek hi qaul hai ke woh Subh ki namaz hai lekin yeh sab baatein tay karne ke liye tafsir munasib nahin, alaihida is ka bayan main ne kar diya hai, falhamdulillah. Phir farmaya Allah Ta'ala ke samne khushu-o-khuzu, zillat aur maskini ke sath khade hua karo jis ko yeh lazim hai ke insani baat-cheet na ho. Isi liye Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ud ke salam ka jawab Huzoor ﷺ ne namaz mein na diya aur baad mein faraghat farmaya ke namaz mashghuliyat ki cheez hai aur Hazrat Mu'awiyah bin Hakam se jabke unhon ne namaz parhte hue baat ki to farmaya namaz mein insani baat-cheet na karni chahiye, yeh to sirf tasbih aur zikr-e-Allah hai (Muslim).

Musnad-e-Ahmad waghera mein hai ke is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle log zaroori baat-cheet bhi namaz mein kar liya karte thay, jab yeh aayat utri toh chup rehne ka hukum de diya gaya, lekin is hadith mein ek ishkal yeh hai ke ulama-e-kiram ki ek jamaat ke nazdeek namaz mein baat-cheet karne ki hurmat Habsha ki hijrat ke baad aur Madina Sharif ki hijrat se pehle hi Makka Sharif mein nazil ho chuki thi. Chunancha Sahih Muslim mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) farmate hain ke Habsha ki hijrat se pehle hum Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko salam karte thay, aap namaz mein hote phir bhi jawab dete, jab Habsha se hum wapas aaye toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko main ne aap ki namaz ki halat mein hi salam kiya, aap ne jawab na diya. Ab mere ranj-o-gham ka kuch na poochiye, namaz se farigh ho kar aap ne mujhe farmaya, "Abdullah! Aur koi baat nahin, main namaz mein tha is wajah se main ne jawab na diya, Allah jo chahe naya hukum utare, us ne yeh naya hukum nazil farmaya hai ke namaz mein na bola karo." Pas yeh waqia hijrat-e-Madina se pehle ka hai aur yeh aayat Madina mein nazil hui hai. Ab baaz toh kehte hain ke Zaid bin Arqam (R.A) ke qaul ka matlab jins-e-kalam se hai aur is ki hurmat par is aayat se istidlal bhi khud un ka fehm hai, wallahu aalam. Baaz kehte hain mumkin hai do dafa halal hua ho aur do dafa mumanat hui ho, lekin pehla qaul zyada zahir hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) wali riwayat jo Abu Ya'la mein hai us mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke jawab na dene se mujhe yeh khauf hua ke shayad mere bare mein koi wahi nazil hui hai. Aap ne mujh se farigh ho kar hadith (Wa alaikas salam ayyuhal muslim wa rahmatullah) namaz mein jab tum ho toh khamosh raha karo. Chunke namazon ki poori hifazat karne ka farman sadir ho chuka tha is liye ab is halat ko bayan farmaya jata jis mein tamam adab-o-aadab ki poori riayat umooman nahin reh sakti, yani maidan-e-jang mein jabke dushman sar par ho toh farmaya ke jis tarah mumkin ho sawar, paidal qibla ki taraf munh kar ke namaz ada kar liya karo. Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) is aayat ka yahi matlab bayan karte hain, balkay Nafi farmate hain main toh janta hoon yeh marfoo hai. Muslim Sharif mein hai sakht khauf ke waqt ishare se hi namaz parh liya karo, go sawari par sawar ho. Abdullah bin Anees (R.A) ko jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Khalid bin Sufyan ke qatl ke liye bheja tha toh aap ne isi tarah namaz-e-asr ishare se ada ki thi (Abu Dawood). Pas is mein Janab-e-Bari ne apne bandon par bohat aasani kar di aur bojh ko halka kar diya, Salat-e-Khauf ek rakat parhni bhi aayi hai.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare Nabi ﷺ ki zabani hazar ki halat mein chaar raka'atein farz ki hain aur safar ki halat mein do aur khauf ki halat mein ek (Muslim). Imam Ahmad farmate hain yeh us waqt hai jab bahut zyada khauf ho, Jabir bin Abdullah R.A aur bahut se aur buzurg Salat-e-Khauf ek raka'at batate hain, Imam Bukhari R.H ne Sahih Bukhari mein baab bandha hai ke futuhat-e-qila ke mauqe par aur dushman ke mudbher ke mauqe par namaz ada karna. Auza'i R.H farmate hain agar fatah qareeb aa gayi ho aur namaz padhne par qudrat na ho to har shakhs apne taur par ishare se namaz padh le, agar itna waqt bhi na mile to takheer karein yahan tak ke ladai khatam ho jaye aur chain naseeb ho to do raka'atein ada kar lein warna ek raka'at kafi hai lekin sirf takbeer keh lena kafi nahin balkeh takheer kar dein yahan tak ke aman mile, Makhool R.H bhi yahi kehte hain. Hazrat Anas bin Malik R.A farmate hain ke Tustar qila ki ladai mein main bhi fauj mein tha, subh-e-sadiq ke waqt ghamsan ki ladai ho rahi thi, hamein waqt hi na mila ke namaz ada karte, khoob din chadhe us din hum ne subh ki namaz padhi, agar namaz ke liye badle mein mujhe duniya aur jo kuch is mein hai mil jaye taham main khush nahin hoon. Baad azan Hazrat Imam-ul-Muhaddiseen ne is hadith se istidlal kiya hai jis mein hai ke jang-e-khandaq mein suraj ghuroob ho jane tak An-Hazrat ﷺ asr ki namaz na padh sake, phir dusri hadith mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne jab apne sahaba ko Bani Quraiza ki taraf bheja to un se farma diya tha ke tum mein se koi bhi Bani Quraiza se pare namaz-e-asr na padhe, ab jabke namaz-e-asr ka waqt aa gaya to ba'az ne to wahin padhi yahan tak ke suraj ghuroob ho gaya, wahin ja kar namaz padhi, Huzoor ﷺ ko jab is ka ilm hua to Aap ﷺ ne unhein na danta. Pas is se Hazrat Imam Bukhari R.H yeh masla sabit karte hain go jamhoor is ke mukhalif hain woh kehte hain Surah Nisa mein jo namaz-e-khauf ka hukum hai aur jis namaz ki mashru'iyat aur tariqa ahadith mein warid hua hai woh jang-e-khandaq ke baad ka hai jaisa ke Abu Saeed R.A waghera ki riwayat mein sarahatan bayan hai, lekin Imam Bukhari, Imam Makhool aur Imam Auza'i Rahimahumullah ka jawab yeh hai ke is ki mashru'iyat baad mein hona is jawaz ke khilaf nahin, ho sakta hai ke yeh bhi jaiz ho aur woh bhi tariqa ho, kyunke aisi halat mein shaaz-o-nadir kabhi hi hoti hai aur khud sahaba ne Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ke zamane mein fatah Tustar mein is par amal kiya aur kisi ne inkar nahin kiya wallahu a'alam. Phir farman hai ke aman ki halat mein baja-awari ka poora khayal rakho, jis tarah main ne tumhein iman ki raah dikhai aur jahl ke baad ilm diya to tumhein bhi chahiye ke is ke shukriya mein zikr-e-Allah batminan kiya karo, jaisa ke namaz-e-khauf ka bayan kar ke farmaya jab itminan ho jaye to namazon ko achi tarah qaim karo, namaz mominon par waqt-e-muqarrara par farz hai, Salat-e-Khauf ka poora bayan Surah Nisa ki ayat (Wa iza kunta feehim) ki tafsir mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala.

Bewagan ke qayam ka masla: Aksar mufassireen ka qaul hai ke yeh aayat is se pehle ki aayat yani chaar mahine das raat ki iddat wali aayat se mansookh ho chuki hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Zubair (R.A) ne Hazrat Usman (R.A) se kaha ke jab yeh aayat mansookh ho chuki hai to phir aap ise Quran-e-Karim mein kyun likhwa rahe hain, aap ne farmaya bhatije jis tarah agle Quran mein yeh maujood hai yahan bhi maujood hi rahegi, hum koi taghayyur-o-tabdeel nahin kar sakte, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain pehle to yahi hukum tha ke saal bhar tak naan-o-nafaqa is bewa aurat ko mayyat ke maal se diya jaye aur isi ke makaan mein yeh rahe, phir aayat-e-meeras ne ise mansookh kar diya aur khawand ko aulad hone ki surat mein maal-e-matrooka ka aathwan hissa aur aulad na hone ke waqt chauthai maal-e-wirsa ka muqarrar kiya gaya aur iddat chaar maah das din muqarrar hui. Aksar Sahaba aur Tabi'een se marwi hai ke yeh aayat mansookh hai, Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) kehte hain Surah Ahzab ki aayat (Yaa ayyuhallazina aamanu iza nakah tumul mu'minati summa tallaqtumuhunna min qabli an tamassuhunna famaa lakum alaihinna min iddatin ta'taddunaha, famatti'uhunna wa sarrihuhunna sarahan jamila) (33. Al-Ahzab: 49) ne ise mansookh kar diya, Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain saat mahine bees din jo asli iddat chaar mahine das din ke siwa ke hain is aayat mein is muddat ka hukum ho raha hai, iddat to wajib hai lekin yeh ziyadati ki muddat ka aurat ko ikhtiyar hai khwah wahin baith kar yeh zamana guzar de khwah na guzare aur chali jaye, meeras ki aayat ne rehne sehne ke makaan ko bhi mansookh kar diya, woh jahan chahe iddat guzare makaan ka kharch khawand ke zimme hai, pas in aqwal se maloom hota hai ke is aayat ne saal bhar tak ki iddat ko wajib hi nahin kiya phir mansookh hone ke kya ma'ni? Yeh to sirf khawand ki wasiyat hai aur ise bhi aurat pura karna chahe to kare warna is par jabr nahin, wasiyyatan se murad yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala tumhein wasiyat karta hai jaise aayat (Yusikumullahu fi auladikum, lizzakari mislu hazzil unsayain) (4. An-Nisa: 11) is ka nasb fal-tawasul-hunna ko mehzoof maan kar hai.

Wasiyatahu ki qira'at yehi hai yaani ayat (Kutiba Alaikum Wasiyatahu). Pas agar auratein saal bhar tak apne faut shuda khawandon ke makanon mein rahein to unhein na nikala jaye aur agar woh iddat guzar kar jana chahein to un par koi jabr nahin, Imam Ibn Taimiyyah (Rahimahullah / R.H) bhi isi qaul ko pasand farmate hain aur bhi bahut se log isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain aur baqi ki jama'at ise mansookh batati hai, pas agar un ka irada asli iddat ke baad ke zamane ke mansookh hone ka hai to khair warna is bare mein aimma ka ikhtilaf hai, woh kehte hain khawand ke ghar mein iddat guzarni zaroori hai aur is ki daleel Muwatta Malik ki hadith hai ke Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki hamshira sahiba Furaia bin Malik Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaein aur kaha hamare ghulam bhag gaye thay jinhein dhoondne ke liye mere khawand gaye Qadoom mein un ghulamon se mulaqat hui lekin unhon ne aap ko qatl kar diya un ka koi makan nahin jis mein iddat guzaron aur na kuch khane peene ko hai agar aap ijazat dein to apne maike chali jaun aur wahin iddat poori karun, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ijazat hai, mein lauti abhi to mein hujre mein hi thi ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe bulwaya ya khud bulaya aur farmaya tum ne kya kaha, mein ne phir qissa bayan kiya, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya isi ghar mein hi thehri raho yahan tak ke iddat guzar jaye, chunanche mein ne wahin iddat ka zamana poora kiya yaani chaar mahine das din. Hazrat Usman (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ke zamane mein aap ne mujhe bulwaya aur mujh se yehi masla poocha, mein ne apna yeh waqia Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke faisle samet sunaya, Hazrat Usman (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne bhi isi ki pairwi ki aur yehi faisla diya, is hadith ko Imam Tirmidhi (Rahimahullah / R.H) Hasan Sahih kehte hain.

Mutallaqa aurat ko faida dene ke bare mein log kehte the ke agar hum chahein dein, chahein na dein, is par yeh aayat utri. Isi aayat se baaz logon ne har talaq wali ko kuch na kuch dena wajib qarar diya, aur baaz dusre buzurgon ne ise un aurton ke sath makhsoos mana hai jin ka bayan pehle guzar chuka hai yani jin aurton se sohbat na hui aur mehar bhi na muqarrar hua ho aur talaq de di jaye. Lekin pehli jamaat ka jawab yeh hai ke aam mein se ek khas surat ka zikr karna isi surat ke sath is hukm ko makhsoos nahin karta jaisa ke mashhoor aur mansoos mazhab hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Phir farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala isi tarah apni aayatein halal-o-haram aur faraiz-o-hudood aur amr-o-nahi ke bare mein wazeh aur mufassar bayan karta hai taake kisi qisam ka ibham aur ijmāl baqi na rahe ke zaroorat ke waqt atak baitho balkay is qadar saaf bayan hota hai ke har shakhs samajh sake.

Maut aur Zindagi: Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain yeh log chaar hazaar thay aur riwayat mein hai ke aath hazaar thay, baaz nau hazaar kehte hain, baaz chalees hazaar batate hain, baaz tees hazaar se kuch oopar batate hain, yeh log Zar-o-Rawaan naami basti ke thay jo Wasit ki taraf hai, baaz kehte hain is basti ka naam Azra'aat tha, yeh log ta'oon ke maare apne shehar ko chhod kar bhaage thay, ek basti mein jab pohanche wahin Allah ke hukum se sab mar gaye, ittefaq se ek Nabi Allah ka wahan se guzra, un ki dua se Allah Ta'ala ne unhein phir dobara zinda kar diya, baaz log kehte hain ek chatyal saaf hawa-daar khule pur-faza maidan mein thehre thay aur do farishton ki cheekh se halak kiye gaye thay jab ek lambi muddat guzar chuki un ki haddiyon ka bhi choona ho gaya, isi jagah basti bas gayi tab Kharqeel naami ek Nabi wahan se nikle unhon ne dua ki aur Allah Ta'ala ne qabool farmayi aur hukum diya ke tum kaho ke ae boseeda haddiyo! Allah Ta'ala tumhein hukum deta hai ke tum sab jama ho jao, chunancha har har jism ki haddiyon ka dhancha khada ho gaya phir Allah ka hukum hua nida karo ke ae haddiyo Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke tum gosht post ragein patthe bhi jod lo, chunancha us Nabi ke dekhte hue yeh bhi ho gaya, phir aawaz aayi ke ae rooho Allah Ta'ala ka tumhein hukum ho raha hai ke har rooh apne apne qadeem jism mein aa jaye chunancha yeh sab jis tarah ek saath mare thay usi tarah ek saath jee uthe aur besakhta unki zaban se nikla (Subhanaka la ilaha illa anta) ae Allah tu paak hai tere siwa koi mabood nahin, yeh daleel hai Qayamat ke din isi jism ke saath dobara jee uthne ki. Phir farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala ka logon par bada bhaari fazl-o-karam hai ke woh zabardast thos nishaniyan apni qudrat-e-qahira ki dikha raha hai lekin bawajood is ke bhi aksar log na-qadre aur be-shukre hain, is se maloom hua ke Allah Ta'ala ke siwa kisi jagah bachao aur panah nahin yeh log waba se bhaage thay aur zindagi ke harees thay to is ke khilaf azab aaya aur foran halak ho gaye, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki is hadith mein hai ke jab Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A Shaam ki taraf chale aur Saragh mein pohanche to Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah R.A waghaira sardaran-e-lashkar mile aur khabar di ke Shaam mein aaj kal waba hai chunancha is mein ikhtilaf hua ke ab wahan jayen ya na jayen, bil-akhir Abdur Rahman bin Auf R.A jab aaye aur farmaya ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke jab waba kisi jagah aaye aur tum wahan ho to wahan se is ke darr se mat bhago, aur jab tum kisi jagah waba ki khabar sun lo to wahan mat jao. Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ne yeh sun kar Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana ki phir wahan se wapas chale gaye (Bukhari Muslim) ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh Allah ka azab hai jo agli ummaton par dala gaya tha.

Phir farmaya ke jis tarah in logon ka bhagna unhein maut se na bacha saka isi tarah jihad se munh morna bhi bekar hai. Ajal aur rizq dono qismat mein muqarrar ho chuke hain, rizq na barhe na ghate, maut na pehle aaye na peeche hate, aur jagah irshad hai ke jo log Allah ki rah mein atak baithe hain aur apne sathiyon se bhi kehte hain ke yeh mujahid shuhada bhi agar hamari tarah rehte to mare na jate, in se kaho agar tum sache ho to zara apni janon se bhi maut ko hata do aur jagah hai ke yeh log kehte hain ke, Allah hum par larai kyun likh di kyun na hamein ek waqt tak fursat di, jis ke jawab mein farmaya ke mazboot burj bhi maut ke samne hech hain, is mauqe par islami lashkaron ke jiyoat sardar aur bahaduron ke peshwa Allah ki talwar islam ke pusht panah Abu Sulaiman Khalid bin Walid (R.A) ka woh farman warid karna bilkul munasib waqt hoga jab aap ne ain apne inteqal ke waqt farmaya tha ke kahan hain maut se darne wale, larai se ji churane wale namard, woh dekhein ke mera jor jor Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein zakhmi ho chuka hai, sare jism mein koi jagah aisi nahin jahan talwar neza barcha na laga ho lekin dekho ke aaj main bistar mein faut ho raha hoon, maidan-e-jang mein na raha.

Allah ki rah mein kharch karo: Phir Parwardigar apne bandon ko apni rah mein kharch karne ki targheeb de raha hai jo jagah ba-jagah di jati hai, Hadith-e-Nuzool mein bhi hai kaun hai jo aise Allah ko qarz de jo na muflis hai na zalim, is ayat ko sun kar Hazrat Abu Al-Addah Ansari R.A ne kaha tha ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ kya Allah Ta'ala hum se qarz talab farmata hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya haan. Farmaya apna hath dijiye, phir hath mein hath le kar kaha Huzoor ﷺ main apna bagh jis mein chhay khajoor ke darakht hain Allah ko qarz diya aur wahan se seedhay apne bagh mein aaye aur bahar hi kharay reh kar apni biwi sahiba ko awaz di ke bachon ko le kar bahar aa jao main ne yeh bagh Allah ki rah mein de diya hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Qarz-e-Hasan se murad fi sabilillah kharch hai aur baal bachon ka kharch bhi hai aur tasbeeh-o-taqdees bhi hai. Phir farmaya ke Allah isay doguna chauguna kar ke de ga jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Mithlul-lazina yunfiquna amwalahum fi sabilillahi kamathali habbatin anbatat sab'a sanabila fi kulli sumbulatin mi'atu habbah) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 261) yani Allah ki rah ke kharch ki misal us dana jaisi hai jis ki saat baalein niklein aur har baal mein saat daanay hon aur Allah is se bhi zyada jisay chahay deta hai. Is ayat ki tafsir bhi anqareeb aaye gi Insha'Allah Ta'ala, Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se Abu Usman Nahdi R.H poochte hain main ne suna hai ke aap farmate hain ke ek ek neki ka badla ek ek lakh nekiyon ka milta hai, aap ne farmaya is mein ta'ajjub kya karte ho, main ne Nabi Kareem ﷺ se suna hai ke ek neki ka badla do lakh ke barabar milta hai (Musnad Ahmad) lekin yeh hadith ghareeb hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Usman Nahdi R.H farmate hain mujh se zyada Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ki khidmat mein koi nahin rehta tha, aap hajj ko gaye phir peeche se main bhi gaya, Basray pahunch kar main ne suna ke woh log Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ki riwayat se mandraja bala hadith bayan karte hain main ne un se kaha Allah ki qasam sab se zyada aap ka sohbat yafta main hoon main ne to kabhi bhi aap se yeh hadith nahin suni, phir mere jee mein aayi ke chalo chal kar khud Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se pooch loon, chunancha main wahan se chala yahan aaya to maloom hua ke woh hajj ko gaye hain, main sirf is ek hadith ki khatir Makkah ko chal khara hua, wahan aap se mulaqat hui main ne kaha Hazrat yeh Basra walay aap se kaisi riwayat karte hain, aap ne farmaya wah is mein ta'ajjub ki kaun si baat hai, phir yehi ayat parhi aur farmaya ke sath hi yeh qaul-e-bari bhi parho ayat (Fama mata'ul-hayatid-dunya fil-akhirati illa qaleel) (Surah At-Tawbah: 38) yani sari dunya ka asbab bhi akhirat ke muqablay mein haqeer cheez hai. Allah ki qasam main ne to Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai ke ek neki ke badlay Allah Ta'ala do lakh nekiyan ata farmata hai.

Isi mazmoon ki Tirmidhi ki yeh hadith bhi hai ke jo shakhs bazaar mein jaye aur wahan dua (La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shai'in qadeer) parhay, Allah Ta'ala us ke liye ek laakh nekiyan likhta hai aur ek laakh gunah maaf farmata hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai aayat (Masalul ladheena) ilakh, ki aayat utri aap ne phir bhi yahi dua ki toh aayat (Innama yuwaffas sabiruna ajrahum bighairi hisab) ki aayat utri, Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar R.A se ek shakhs ne kaha main ne ek shakhs se yeh suna hai ke jo shakhs Surah aayat (Qul huwallahu) ilakh, ko ek dafa parhay us ke liye moti aur yaqoot ke das laakh mahal jannat mein bante hain, kya main ise sach maan loon, aap ne farmaya is mein ta'ajjub ki kaun si baat hai, balkay bees aur bhi aur bees laakh aur bhi aur is qadar ke un ki ginti bajuz Janab-e-Bari ke kisi ko maloom hi na ho, phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya jab Allah Ta'ala aayat (Ad'afan katheeran) farmata hai toh phir makhlooq is ki ginti ki taqat kaise rakhe gi? Phir farmaya rizq ki kami beshi Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hai, Allah ki raah mein kharch karte hue bakhili na karo, woh jise de us mein bhi hikmat hai aur na de us mein bhi maslahat hai, tum sab Qayamat ke din usi ki taraf lautaye jaoge.

Bani Israel par ek aur ehsan. Jis Nabi ka yahan zikr hai un ka naam Hazrat Qatada ne Hazrat Yusha bin Noon bin Afraim bin Yusuf bin Yaqub bataya hai, lekin yeh qaul theek maloom nahin hota is liye ke yeh waqia Hazrat Musa A.S ke baad ka Hazrat Dawood A.S ke zamane ka hai, jaisa ke sarahatan warid hua hai, aur Hazrat Dawood A.S aur Hazrat Musa A.S ke darmiyan ek hazar saal se zyada ka fasla hai, Wallahu A'lam. Suddi ka qaul hai ke yeh paighambar Hazrat Shamoon hain, Mujahid kehte hain yeh Shamweel bin Yali bin Alqama bin Safiya bin Alqama ya Abu Hashif bin Qaroon bin Yas-har bin Fahis bin Lawi bin Yaqub bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim Khalilullah A.S hain. Waqia yeh hai ke Hazrat Musa A.S ke baad kuch zamana tak toh Bani Israel rah-e-haq par rahe, phir shirk-o-bid'at mein pad gaye magar taham un mein pai dar pai ambiya mab'oos hote rahe yahan tak ke Bani Israel ki bebakiyan had se guzar gayin, ab Allah Ta'ala ne un ke dushmanon ko un par ghalib kar diya, khoob pite kate, aur ujad gaye. Pehle toh Taurat ki maujoodgi, Taboot-e-Sakina ki maujoodgi jo Hazrat Musa A.S se moroosi chali aa rahi thi un ke liye ba'is-e-ghalba hoti thi, magar un ki sarkashi aur badtareen gunahon ki wajah se Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki yeh ne'mat bhi un ke hathon se chhin gayi aur nabuwwat bhi un ke gharane mein khatam hui. Lawi jin ki aulad mein paighambari ki nasl chal rahi thi, woh sare ke sare ladaiyon mein mar khap gaye, un mein se sirf ek hamila aurat reh gayi thi, un ke khawand bhi qatl ho chuke the. Ab Bani Israel ki nazrein is aurat par thin, unhein umeed thi ke Allah isay ladka de ga aur woh ladka Nabi bane, khud un bibi sahiba ki bhi din raat yahi dua thi jo Allah ne qabool farmayi aur unhein ladka diya jin ka naam Shamweel ya Shamoon rakha, is ke lafzi ma'ni hain ke Allah ne meri dua qabool farma li. Nabuwwat ki umar ko pahunch kar unhein bhi nabuwwat mili, jab aap ne da'wat-e-nabuwwat di toh qaum ne darkhwast ki ke aap hamara badshah muqarrar kar dijiye taake hum us ki matahuti mein jihad karein, badshah toh zahir ho hi gaya tha lekin paighambar ne apna khatka bayan kiya ke tum phir jihad se ji na churana? Qaum ne jawab diya ke Hazrat hamare mulk hum se chheen liye gaye, hamare baal bachay giraftar kiye gaye aur phir bhi kya hum aise be-hamiyat hain ke marne maarne se darein? Ab jihad farz kar diya gaya aur hukm hua ke badshah ke sath utho, bas sunte hi sun ho gaye aur siwaye ma'dood-e-chand ke baqi sab ne munh mod liya, un se yeh koi nayi baat nahin thi, jis ka Allah ko ilm na ho.

Khu-e-bad ra bahana-e-bisyar. Matlab yeh hai ke jab unhon ne kisi ko apna badshah bana dene ki khwahish apne paighambar se ki to paighambar ne bahukm-e-Ilahi Hazrat Talut ko pesh kiya jo shahi khandan se na thay, ek lashkari thay, shahi khandan Yahud ki aulad thi aur yeh un mein se na thay to qoum ne aitraz kiya ke haqdar-e-badshahat ke to is se bahut zyada hum hain phir dusri baat yeh ke is ke paas maal bhi nahin, muflis shakhs hai, baaz kehte hain yeh saqqay thay kisi ne kaha yeh dabbagh thay, pas pehli sarkashi to aitraz ki surat mein ahkam-e-nabvi ke samne un se yeh hui, paighambar ne unhein jawab diya ke yeh ta'ayyun meri raye se nahin jis mein main dobara gaur kar sakun, yeh to Allah Jalla Shanuhu ka hukm hai jis ki baja-awari zaroori hai, phir zahiran bhi woh tum mein bade aalim hain aur qawi aur taqatwar shakeel-o-jameel shuja-o-bahadur aur ladai ke funoon se pooray waqif-e-kar hain. Yahan se yeh bhi sabit hua ke badshah zi-ilm shakeel qawi taqatwar bade dil-o-dimagh wala hona chahiye. Phir farmaya ke asli aur haqeeqi hakim Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Mulk ka malik fi-alwaqay wohi hai jise chahe mulk de woh ilm-o-hikmat wala rafat-o-rehmat wala hai. Is se kis ki majal ke sawal kare? Jo chahe kare sab se sawal karne wala koi na koi hai lekin Parwardigar is se mustasna hai, woh wasee fazl wala apni na'amaton se jise chahe makhsoos kare, woh ilm wala khoob janta hai kaun kis cheez ka mustahiq hai aur kise kis cheez ka istihqaq nahin.

Taboot-e-Sakina aur Jang-e-Talut-o-Jalut. Nabi farma rahe hain ke Talut ki badshahat ki pehli alamat-e-barakat yeh hai ke khoya hua Taboot-e-Sakina unhein phir mil jaye ga, jis mein waqar-o-izzat dil-jam'ee aur jalalat rafat-o-rahmat hai jis mein Allah ki nishaniyan hain jinhein tum bakhubi jaante ho, baaz ka qaul hai ke Sakina ek sone ka tasht tha jis mein Ambiya ke dil dhoye jaate thay jo Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko mila tha aur jis mein Aap ne Taurat ki takhtiyan rakkhi theen, kisi ne kaha hai is ka munh bhi tha jaise insan ka munh hota hai aur rooh bhi thi, hath bhi tha, do sar thay, do par thay aur dum bhi thi, Wahab kehte hain murda billi ka sar tha jab woh Taboot mein bolta to unhein nusrat ka yaqeen ho jata aur ladayi fatah ho jati, yeh qaul bhi hai ke yeh ek rooh thi Allah ki taraf se jab kabhi Bani Israel mein koi ikhtilaf padta ya kisi baat ki ittela na hoti to woh keh diya karti thi. Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur Hazrat Harun (A.S) ke wirse ke baqi hisse se murad lakdi aur Taurat ki takhtiyan, oon aur kuch un ke kapde aur jooti hain. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke farishte aasman-o-zamin ke darmiyan is Taboot ko uthaye huye sab logon ke samne laye aur Hazrat Talut badshah ke samne la rakkha, is Taboot ko un ke haan dekh kar unhein Nabi ki nubuwwat aur Talut ki badshahat ka yaqeen ho gaya, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh gaye ke upar laya gaya, baaz kehte hain ke kuffar ne jab Yahudiyon par ghalba paya to Taboot-e-Sakina ko un se chheen liya aur Ariha mein le gaye aur apne bade butt ke neeche rakh diya jab Allah ko ise wapas Bani Israel tak pahunchana tha, tab woh kuffar subh ko jab butt-khane mein gaye to dekha butt neeche hai aur Taboot upar hai, unhon ne phir butt ko upar kar diya lekin doosri subh dekha ke phir wahi muamla hai unhon ne phir butt ko upar kar diya, subh jo gaye to dekha butt ek taraf toota-phoota pada hai, to yaqeen ho gaya ke yeh qudrat ke karishme hain chunanche unhon ne Taboot ko yahan se le ja kar kisi aur chhoti si basti mein rakh diya, wahan ek wabayi bimari phaili, aakhir Bani Israel ki ek aurat ne jo wahan qaid thi, us ne kaha ke ise wapas Bani Israel pahuncha do to tumhein is se najaat mile gi, un logon ne do gaiyon par Taboot ko rakh kar Bani Israel ke shehar ki taraf bhej diya, shehar ke qareeb pahunch kar gaiyen to rasiyan tudwa kar bhaag gayin aur Taboot wahin raha jise Bani Israel le aaye, baaz kehte hain do naujawan ise pahuncha gaye Wallahu A'lam, (lekin alfaz-e-Quran mein yeh maujood hain ke ise farishte utha layein ge) (Mutarjim) yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Palestine ki bastiyon mein se ek basti mein tha jis ka naam Azdoh tha. Phir farmata hai meri nubuwwat ki daleel aur Talut ki badshahat ki daleel yeh bhi hai ke Taboot farishte pahuncha jayein ge, agar tumhein Allah Azzawajal aur Qayamat par iman ho.

Nahr-e-Shariah

Ab waqia bayan ho raha hai ke jab un logon ne Talut ki badshahat tasleem karli aur woh unhein le kar jihad ko chale, Hazrat Suddi ke qaul ke mutabiq un ki tadaad assi hazar thi, raaste mein Talut ne kaha ke Allah Ta'ala tumhein ek nehar ke sath aazmane wala hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ke qaul ke mutabiq yeh nehar Urdun aur Filisteen ke darmiyan thi is ka naam Nahr-e-Shariah tha, Talut ne unhein hoshiyar kardiya ke koi is nehar ka pani na piye, agar pi lega to mere sath na chale, ek aadh ghont agar kisi ne pi li to kuch harj nahin, lekin jab wahan pohanche pyas ki shiddat thi, nehar par jhuk pade aur khoob pet bhar kar pani pi liya magar kuch log aise pukhta iman wale bhi the ke jinhon ne na piya ek chullu pi liya, baqol Ibn-e-Abbas ke ek chullu peene walon ki to pyas bhi bujh gayi aur woh jihad mein bhi shamil rahe lekin puri pyas peene walon ki na to pyas bujhi na woh qabil-e-jihad rahe, Suddi farmate hain assi hazar mein se chheh-hattar hazar ne pani pi liya sirf char hazar aadmi haqeeqi farmanbardar nikle. Hazrat Bara bin Aazib farmate hain ke Ashab-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aksar farmaya karte the ke Badr ki ladai wale din hamari tadaad utni hi thi jitni tadaad Hazrat Talut badshah ke is farmanbardar lashkar ki thi, jo aap ke sath nehar se paar hua tha yani teen sau tera. Yahan se paar hote hi nafarmanon ke chhakke chhoot gaye aur nihayat buzdilana pan se unhon ne jihad se inkar kardiya aur dushmanon ki ziyadati ne un ke hosle tod diye, saaf jawab de baithe ke aaj to hum Jalut ke lashkar se ladne ki taqat apne mein nahin paate, go sarfarosh mujahid ulama-e-kiram ne unhein har tarah himmat bandhwai, wa'z kahe, farmaya ke qillat-o-kasrat par fatah mauqoof nahin sabr aur nek niyati par zaroor Allah ki imdad hoti hai. Barha aisa hua hai ke mutthi bhar logon ne badi badi jamaton ko neecha dikha diya hai, tum sabr karo, tabiyat mein istiqal aur azm rakho, Allah ke wadon par nazrein rakho, is sabr ke badle Allah tumhara sath dega lekin taham un ke sard dil na garmaye aur un ki buzdili door na hui.

Jalut mara gaya yani jis waqt musalmanon ki is mukhtasar jamaat ne kuffar ke tiddi dal lashkar dekhe toh Janab-e-Bari mein gidgida kar duayein karni shuru keen ke aye Allah hamein sabr-o-sabat ka pahad bana de. Ladai ke waqt hamare qadam jama de, munh modne aur bhagne se hamein bacha le aur in dushmanon par hamein ghalib kar, chunancha un ki aajizana aur mukhlisana duayein qabool hoti hain, Allah ki madad nazil hoti hai aur yeh mutthi bhar jamaat is tiddi dal lashkar ko tehas-nehas kar deti hai aur Hazrat Dawood A.S ke hathon mukhalifeen ka sardar aur sartaj Jalut mara jata hai, Israeli riwayaton mein yeh bhi marwi hai ke Hazrat Talut ne un se wada kiya tha ke agar tum Jalut ko qatl karoge toh main apni beti tumhare nikah mein doonga aur apna aadha maal bhi tumhein de doonga aur hukumat mein bhi barabar shareek kar loonga, chunancha Hazrat Dawood A.S ne patthar ko falakhan mein rakh kar Jalut par chalaya aur isi se woh mara gaya, Hazrat Talut ne apna wada poora kiya, bil-akhir saltanat ke mustaqil sultan aap hi ho gaye aur Parwardigar-e-Aalam ki taraf se bhi nabuwwat jaisi zabardast nemat ata hui aur Hazrat Shamweel A.S ke baad yeh paighambar bhi bane aur badshah bhi, hikmat se murad nabuwwat hai aur bahut se makhsoos ilm bhi jo Allah Azzawajal ne chahe apne is Nabi ko sikhaye. Phir irshad-e-Bari Ta'ala hota hai ke agar Allah Ta'ala yun past logon ki pasti na badalta jis tarah Bani Israel ko Talut jaise mudabbir badshah aur Dawood A.S jaise daleer sipah-salar ata farma kar hukumat tabdeel na karta toh log halak ho jate jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa lawla daf'u Allahin-nasa ba'dahum bi ba'din la-huddimat sawami'u wa biya'un wa salawatun wa masajidu yuzkaru fiha ismu Allahi kathira) yani yun agar ek dusre ke dafi'a na ho toh ibadat khane aur woh masajid jin mein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka naam ba-kasrat zikr kiya jata hai tod di jayen, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ek nek bakht imandar ki wajah se us ke aas paas ke sau sau gharanon se Allah Ta'ala balaon ko door kar deta hai. Phir rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A ne isi ayat ki tilawat ki (Ibn-e-Jarir) lekin is hadith ki sanad za'eef hai, Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek aur ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ek sache musalman ki salahiyat ki wajah se us ki aulad ki aulad ko us ke ghar walon ko aur sanwar deta hai aur us ki maujoodgi tak woh sab Allah ki hifazat mein rehte hain, Ibn-e-Marduyah ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke Qayamat tak har zamane mein sath shakhs tum mein zaroor aise rahenge jin ki wajah se tumhari madad ki jayegi aur tum par barish barsai jayegi aur tumhein rozi di jayegi. Ibn-e-Marduyah ki dusri hadith mein hai meri ummat mein tees abdal honge jin ki wajah se tum roziyan diye jaoge, tum par barish barsai jayegi aur tumhari madad ki jayegi. Is hadith ke rawi Hazrat Qatadah R.H farmate hain ke mera khayal hai Hazrat Hasan R.H bhi unhein abdal mein se the.

Phir farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ki yeh ne'mat aur uska ehsan hai ke woh ek ko dusre se dafa' karta hai, wohi saccha hakim hai, uske tamam kaam hikmat se pur hote hain, woh apni daleelein apne bandon par wazeh farma raha hai. Woh tamam makhlooq par fazl-o-karam karta hai.
