Ibn-e-Marduyah ki dusri hadith mein hai meri ummat mein tees abdal honge jin ki wajah se tum roziyan diye jaoge, tum par barish barsai jayegi aur tumhari madad ki jayegi. Is hadith ke rawi Hazrat Qatadah R.H farmate hain ke mera khayal hai Hazrat Hasan R.H bhi unhein abdal mein se the.

Phir farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ki yeh ne'mat aur uska ehsan hai ke woh ek ko dusre se dafa' karta hai, wohi saccha hakim hai, uske tamam kaam hikmat se pur hote hain, woh apni daleelein apne bandon par wazeh farma raha hai. Woh tamam makhlooq par fazl-o-karam karta hai.

Yeh waqiat aur yeh tamam haq ki baatein ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamari sachi wahi se tumhein maloom huin, tum mere sache Rasool ho, meri in baaton ki aur khud aap ki nabuwwat ki sachai ka ilm un logon ko bhi hai jin ke hathon mein kitab hai. Yahan Allah Ta'ala ne zordar pur-takeed alfaz mein qasam kha kar apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat ki tasdeeq ki. Falhamdulillah.

Zikr-e-Madarij-ul-Anbiya yahan yeh wazahat ho rahi hai ke Rasoolon mein bhi maratib hain, jaisa aur jagah farmaya: "Walaqad faddalna ba'dan-nabiyyina 'ala ba'din wa ataina Dawuda Zabura" (Hum ne ba'z nabiyon ko ba'z par fazeelat di aur Hazrat Dawud ko hum ne Zaboor di). Yahan bhi isi ka zikr karke farmata hai in mein se ba'z ko sharaf-e-hum-kalami bhi naseeb hua jaisa Hazrat Musa aur Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) aur Hazrat Adam (A.S). Sahih Ibn-e-Hibban mein hadith hai jis mein Me'raj ke bayan ke sath yeh bhi warid hua hai ke kisi nabi ko Aap (ﷺ) ne alag alag kis aasman mein paya jo un ke martabon ke kam-o-besh hone ki daleel hai. Haan, ek hadith mein hai ke ek Musalman aur Yahudi ki kuch baat-cheet ho gayi toh Yahudiyon ne kaha: Qasam hai us Allah ki jis ne Musa (A.S) ki tamam jahan walon par fazeelat di. Toh Musalman se zabt na ho saka, us ne utha kar ek thappar mara aur kaha: Khabees! Kya hamare Nabi Muhammad (ﷺ) se bhi woh afzal hain? Yahudi ne Sarkar-e-Nabawi (ﷺ) mein aa kar is ki shikayat ki. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Mujhe nabiyon par fazeelat na do, Qayamat ke din sab behosh honge, sab se pehle main hosh mein aaunga toh dekhunga ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) Allah Ta'ala ke Arsh ka paya thame hue honge, mujhe nahin maloom ke woh mujh se pehle hosh mein aa gaye ya saray se behosh hi nahin hue thay? Aur Toor ki behoshi ke badle yahan ki behoshi se bacha liye gaye, pas mujhe nabiyon par fazeelat na do. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke paighambaron ke darmiyan fazeelat na do. Pas yeh hadith bazahir Quran-e-Kareem ki is aayat ke khilaf maloom hoti hai lekin darasal koi ta'aruz nahin. Mumkin hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ka yeh farman is se pehle ho ke Aap (ﷺ) ko fazeelat ka ilm na hua ho, lekin yeh qaul zara gaur talab hai. Dusra jawab yeh hai ke yeh Aap (ﷺ) ne mehez tawazu aur farotani ke taur par farmaya hai na ke haqeeqat ke taur par. Teesra jawab yeh hai ke aise jhagray aur ikhtilaf ke waqt ek ko ek par fazeelat dena dusre ki shaan ghatana hai is liye Aap (ﷺ) ne mana farma diya. Chautha jawab yeh hai ke tum fazeelat na do yani sirf apni raye, apne khayal aur apne zehni ta'assub se apne Nabi ko dusre nabi par fazeelat na do. Panchwan jawab yeh hai ke fazeelat-o-takreem ka faisla tumhare bas ka nahin balkeh yeh Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hai, woh jise fazeelat de tum maan lo, tumhara kaam tasleem karna aur imaan lana hai. Phir farmata hai ke hum ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko wazeh daleelein aur phir aisi hujjatein ata farmayi thin jin se Bani Israel par saaf wazeh ho gaya ke Aap (ﷺ) ki risalat bilkul sachi hai aur sath hi Aap (ﷺ) ki yeh haisiyat bhi wazeh ho gayi ke misl aur bandon ke Aap (ﷺ) bhi Allah Ta'ala ke aajiz bande aur bekas ghulam hain, aur Rooh-ul-Qudus yani Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se hum ne un ki ta'eed ki. Phir farmaya ke baad walon ke ikhtilaf bhi hamare qaza-o-qadar ka namuna hain, hamari shaan yeh hai ke jo chahein karein, hamare kisi iraday se murad juda nahin.

Aaj ke sadaqat Qayamat ke din shareek-e-gham honge. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko hukum karta hai ke woh bhalai ki raah mein apna maal kharch karein taake Allah Ta'ala ke paas unka sawab jama rahe, aur phir farmata hai ke apni zindagi mein hi khairat-o-sadaqat karlo, Qayamat ke din na toh khareedo-farokht hogi na zameen bhar kar sona dene se jaan chhoot sakti hai, na kisi ka nasab aur dosti-o-mohabbat kuch kaam aa sakti hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Fa-iza nufikha fis-soori fala ansaba bainahum yauma-izin wala yatasa'aloon) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 101) yani jab soor phoonka jayega us din na toh nasab rahega na koi kisi ka pursan-e-haal hoga, aur us din sifarishiyon ki sifarish bhi kuch nafa na degi. Phir farmaya kafir hi zalim hain yani pooray aur pakkay zalim hain woh jo kufr ki halat hi mein Allah se milein, Ata bin Dinar kehte hain shukar hai Allah ne kafiron ko zalim farmaya lekin zalimon ko kafir nahin farmaya.

Azeem-tar Ayat Ta'aruf-e-Allah bazuban-e-Allah yeh Ayat, Ayat-ul-Kursi hai, jo bari azmat wali Ayat hai. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) daryaft farmate hain ke Kitabullah mein sab se zyada azmat wali Ayat kaun si hai? Aap jawab dete hain Allah aur us ke Rasool hi ko is ka sab se zyada ilm hai. Aap phir yahi sawal karte hain, baar baar ke sawal par jawab dete hain ke Ayat-ul-Kursi, Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain Abu-ul-Munzir Allah Ta'ala tujhe tera ilm mubarak kare, us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai is ki zaban hogi aur hont honge aur yeh Badshah-e-Haqiqi ki taqdees bayan karegi aur Arsh ke paya se lagi hui hogi (Musnad-e-Ahmed). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein bhi yeh Hadith hai lekin yeh pichla qasmiya jumla is mein nahin, Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain mere haan ek khajoor ki bori thi. Main ne dekha ke is mein se khajoorein roz-ba-roz ghat rahi hain, ek raat main jaagta raha is ki nigahbani karta raha, main ne dekha ek janwar misl jawan larke ke aaya, main ne use salam kiya us ne mere salam ka jawab diya, main ne kaha tu insaan hai ya Jinn? Us ne kaha main Jinn hoon, main ne kaha zara apna haath to de, us ne haath barha diya, main ne apne haath mein liya to kutte jaisa haath tha aur is par kutte jaise hi baal thay, main ne kaha kya Jinnon ki paidaish aisi hi hai? Us ne kaha tamam jinnat mein sab se zyada quwwat taqat wala main hi hoon, main ne kaha bhala tu meri cheez churane par kaise daleer ho gaya? Us ne kaha mujhe maloom hai ke tu sadqa ko pasand karta hai, hum ne kaha phir hum kyun mehroom rahein? Main ne kaha tumhare shar se bachane wali kaun si cheez hai? Us ne kaha Ayat-ul-Kursi. Subah ko jab main Sarkar-e-Muhammadi (ﷺ) mein hazir hua to main ne raat ka sara waqea bayan kiya, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya khabeeth ne yeh baat to bilkul sach kahi (Abu Ya'la). Ek baar Muhajireen ke paas Aap (ﷺ) gaye to ek shakhs ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) Quran ki Ayat kaun si bari hai, Aap ne yahi Ayat-ul-Kursi parh kar sunayi (Tabrani). Aap (ﷺ) ne ek martaba Sahaba mein se ek se poocha tum ne nikah kar liya? Us ne kaha Hazrat mere paas maal nahin, is liye nikah nahin kiya, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Qul Huwallahu yaad nahin? Us ne kaha woh to yaad hai, farmaya chauthayi Quran to yeh ho gaya, kya Qul ya Ayyuhal Kafirun yaad nahin, kaha haan woh bhi yaad hai, farmaya chauthayi Quran yeh hua, phir poocha kya Iza Zulzilat bhi yaad hai? Kaha haan, farmaya chauthayi Quran yeh hua, kya Iza Ja'a Nasrullahi bhi yaad hai? Kaha haan, farmaya chauthayi yeh, kaha Ayat-ul-Kursi yaad hai? Kaha haan, farmaya chauthayi Quran yeh hua (Musnad-e-Ahmed). Hazrat Abu-Zar (R.A) farmate hain main Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua, Aap (ﷺ) us waqt masjid mein tashreef farma thay, main aa kar baith gaya, Aap (ﷺ) ne poocha kya tum ne namaz parh li? Main ne kaha nahin, farmaya utho namaz ada kar lo.

Main ne namaz parhi phir aa kar baitha toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Abu Zar! Shaitan insano aur jinno se panah maang, main ne kaha Huzoor! kya insani shaitan bhi hote hain? Farmaya haan, main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki namaz ki nisbat kya irshad hai? Farmaya woh sarasar khair hai jo chahe kam hissa le jo chahe zyada, main ne kaha Huzoor! Roza? Farmaya kifayat karne wala farz hai aur Allah ke nazdeek zyadati hi, main ne kaha sadqa? Farmaya bahut zyada aur barh charh kar badla dilwane wala, main ne kaha sab se afzal sadqa kaun sa hai? Farmaya kam maal wale ka himmat karna ya poshidgi se mohtaj ki ehtiyaj puri karna, main ne sawal kiya sab se pehle Nabi kaun hain? Farmaya Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam), main ne kaha woh Nabi thay? Farmaya Nabi aur Allah se hamkalam hone wale, main ne pucha rasoolon ki tadaad kya hai? Farmaya teen sau aur kuch oopar das bahut bari jamaat, ek riwayat mein teen sau pandrah ka lafz hai, main ne pucha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap par sab se zyada buzurgi wali ayat kaun si utri? Farmaya Ayat-ul-Kursi Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum, (Musnad Ahmad). Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hain ke mere khazana mein se jinnat chura kar le jaya karte thay, main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se shikayat ki, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jab tu use dekhe toh kehna Bismillah ajeebi Rasoolullah, jab woh aaya main ne yahi kaha, phir use chor diya. Main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh phir bhi aayega, main ne use isi tarah do teen baar pakra aur iqrar le le kar chor diya, main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne har dafa yahi farmaya ke woh phir bhi aayega, aakhir martaba main ne kaha ab main tujhe na chorunga, us ne kaha chor de main tujhe ek aisi cheez bataunga ke koi jin aur shaitan tere paas hi na aa sake, main ne kaha achha batao, kaha woh Ayat-ul-Kursi hai. Main ne aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya us ne sach kaha, go woh jhoota hai (Musnad Ahmad). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Kitab Faza'il-ul-Quran aur Kitab-ul-Wakala aur Sifat-e-Iblees ke bayan mein bhi yeh hadith Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) se marwi hai is mein hai ke Zakat-e-Ramzan ke maal par main pehra de raha tha jo yeh shaitan aaya aur samet samet kar apni chadar mein jama karne laga, teesri martaba us ne bataya ke agar tu raat bistar par ja kar is ayat ko parh le ga toh Allah ki taraf se tujh par hafiz muqarrar hoga aur subh tak shaitan tere qareeb bhi na aa sake ga (Bukhari). Dusri riwayat mein hai ke yeh khajoorein thin aur mutthi bhar woh le gaya tha aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tha ke agar ise pakarna chahe toh jab woh darwaze khole kehna Subhan man sakh-khara-ka Muhammad, shaitan ne uzr yeh bataya tha ke ek faqeer jin ke baal bachon ke liye main yeh le ja raha tha (Ibn Marduyah). Pas yeh waqea teen sahaba ka hua, Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ka, Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ka aur Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ka.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A farmate hain ke ek insaan ki ek jinn se mulaqat hui, jinn ne kaha mujh se kushti karega? Agar mujhe gira dega toh main tujhe ek aisi aayat sikhaunga ke jab tu apne ghar jaye aur use parh le toh shaitan us mein na aa sake. Kushti hui aur us aadmi ne jinn ko gira diya, us shakhs ne jinn se kaha tu toh na'eef aur darpok hai aur tere haath misl kutte ke hain, kya jinnaat aise hi hote hain ya sirf tu hi aisa hai? Kaha main toh un sab mein se qawi hoon, phir dobara kushti hui aur dusri martaba bhi us shakhs ne gira diya toh jinn ne kaha jo aayat main ne sikhane ke liye kaha tha woh Aayat-ul-Kursi hai, jo shakhs apne ghar mein jaate hue use parh le toh shaitan us ghar se gadhe ki tarah cheekhta hua bhaag jaata hai. Jis shakhs se kushti hui thi woh shakhs Umar R.A thay (Kitab-ul-Ghareeb). Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Surah Baqarah mein ek aayat hai jo Quran-e-Kareem ki tamam aayaton ki sardar hai, jis ghar mein woh parhi jaye wahan se shaitan bhaag jaata hai. Woh aayat Aayat-ul-Kursi hai (Mustadrak Hakim). Tirmidhi mein hai har cheez ki kohan aur bulandi hai aur Quran ki bulandi Surah Baqarah hai aur us mein bhi Aayat-ul-Kursi tamam aayaton ki sardar hai. Hazrat Umar R.A ke is sawal par ke saare Quran mein sab se zyada buzurg aayat kaun si hai? Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A ne farmaya mujhe khoob maloom hai, main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai ke woh aayat Aayat-ul-Kursi hai (Ibn Marduyah). Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain in dono aayaton mein Allah Ta'ala ka Ism-e-Azam hai. Ek toh Aayat-ul-Kursi, dusri aayat Alif-Laam-Meem, Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur hadith mein hai ke woh Ism-e-Azam jis naam ki barkat se jo dua Allah Ta'ala se mangi jaye woh qabool farmata hai. Woh teen suraton mein hai, Surah Baqarah, Surah Aal-e-Imran aur Surah Taha (Ibn Marduyah). Hisham bin Ammar khatib-e-Damishq farmate hain Surah Baqarah ki aayat Aayat-ul-Kursi hai aur Aal-e-Imran ki pehli hi aayat aur Taha ki aayat Wa 'anatil wujoohu lil hayyil qayyum hai aur hadith mein hai jo shakhs har farz namaz ke baad Aayat-ul-Kursi parh le use jannat mein jaane se koi cheez nahin roke gi siwaye maut ke (Ibn Marduyah). Is hadith ko Imam Nasai R.H ne bhi apni kitab 'Amal-ul-Yaum-wal-Lailah' mein warid kiya hai aur Ibn Hibban R.H ne bhi ise apni Sahih mein warid kiya hai, is hadith ki sanad shart-e-Bukhari par hai lekin Abu-ul-Faraj bin Jauzi R.H ise mauzoo kehte hain, Wallahu A'lam, Tafsir Ibn Marduyah mein bhi yeh hadith hai lekin is ki asnaad bhi za'eef hain. Ibn Marduyah mein ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa bin Imran A.S ki taraf wahi ki ke har farz namaz ke baad Aayat-ul-Kursi parh liya karo, jo shakhs yeh karega main use shukarguzar dil aur zikr karne wali zaban dunga. Aur use nabiyon ka sawab aur siddiqon ka amal dunga. Jis amal ki pabandi sirf ambiya aur siddiqeen se hi hoti hai ya us bande se jis ka dil main ne imaan ke liye aazma liya ho ya use apni raah mein shaheed karna tay kar liya ho, lekin yeh hadith bahut munkar hai.

Tirmidhi ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs Surah Ha-Mim Al-Mu'min ko Ilaihil Masir tak aur Ayatul Kursi ko subah ke waqt parh le ga woh sham tak Allah ki hifazat mein rahe ga aur sham ko parhne wale ki subah tak hifazat hogi lekin yeh hadith bhi ghareeb hai. Is ayat ki fazeelat mein aur bhi bohat si hadeesein hain lekin ek toh is liye ke un ki sanadein za'eef hain aur dusre is liye bhi ke hamein ikhtisar mad-e-nazar hai, hum ne unhein warid nahin kiya. Is mubarak ayat mein das mustaqil jumle, pehle jumle mein Allah Ta'ala ki wahdaniyat ka bayan hai ke kul makhlooq ka wohi ek Allah hai. Dusre jumle mein hai ke woh khud zinda hai jis par kabhi maut nahin aayegi, dusron ko qaim rakhne wala hai. Qayyum ki dusri nishani qira'at-e-qiyam bhi hai pas tamam maujoodat us ki mohtaj hain aur woh sab se be-niyaz hai, koi bhi baghair us ki ijazat ke kisi cheez ka sambhalne wala nahin, jaise aur jagah hai (Wa min ayatihi an taqumas-samau wal-ardu bi-amrihi) (Surah Ar-Rum: 25) yani us ki nishaniyon mein se ek yeh hai ke aasman-o-zameen usi ke hukm se qaim hain, phir farmaya na toh us par koi nuqsan aaye na kabhi woh apni makhlooq se ghafil aur be-khabar ho, balkeh har shakhs ke a'maal par woh hazir, har shakhs ke ahwal par woh nazir, dil ke har khatre se woh waqif, makhlooq ka koi zarra bhi us ki hifazat aur ilm se kabhi bahar nahin, yahi poori "Qayyumiyat" hai. Oongh, ghaflat, neend aur be-khabari se us ki zaat mukammal pak hai.

Sahih hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba khade ho kar Sahaba-e-Kiram ko chaar baatein batayin, farmaya Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala sota nahin, na neend uski zaat ke laiq hai, woh tarazu ka haafiz hai jis ke liye chahe jhuka de, jis ke liye chahe na jhukaye, din ke a'maal raat se pehle aur raat ke a'maal din se pehle uski taraf le jaye jate hain, uske samne noor ya aag ke parde hain agar woh hat jayen to uske chehre ki tajalliyan un tamam cheezon ko jala dein jin tak uski nigah pahunche, Abdur Razzaq mein Hazrat Ikrama se riwayat hai ke Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne farishton se poocha ke kya Allah Ta'ala sota bhi hai? To Allah Ta'ala ne farishton ki taraf wahi bheji ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko teen raaton tak bedaar rakhein, unhon ne yahi kiya, teen raaton tak sone na diya, is ke baad do botlein un ke hathon mein de di gayin aur keh diya ke inhe thame raho khabardar yeh girne aur tootne na payein, Aap (A.S) ne inhe tham liya lekin jaga hua tha, neend ka ghalba hua, oongh aane lagi, aankh band ho jati lekin phir hoshiyar ho jate magar kab tak? Aakhir ek martaba aisa jhakola aaya ke botlein toot gayin, goya unhe bataya gaya ke jab ek oonghne aur sone wala do botlon ko nahin sambhal sakta to Allah Ta'ala agar oonghe ya soye to zameen-o-aasman ki hifazat kis tarah ho sake? Lekin yeh Bani Israel ki baat hai aur kuch dil ko lagti bhi nahin is liye ke yeh namumkin hai ke Musa (A.S) jaise jaleel-ul-qadr Aarif Billah Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki is sifat se na-waqif hon aur unhe is mein taraddud ho ke Allah Zul-Jalal-wal-Ikram jagta hi rehta hai ya so bhi jata hai aur is se bhi bahut zyada gharabat wali woh hadith hai jo Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne is waqiye ko mimbar par bayan farmaya. Yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai aur bazahir maloom hota hai ke is ka farman-e-paighambar hona sabit nahin balki Bani Israel ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) se yeh sawal kiya tha aur phir Aap (A.S) ko botlein pakdwayi gayin aur woh ba-wajah-e-neend ke na sambhal sake, aur Huzoor (ﷺ) par yeh aayat nazil hui, aasman-o-zameen ki tamam cheezein uski ghulami mein aur uski mahtati mein aur uski saltanat mein hain jaise farmaya Kullu man fis-samawati wal-ard, ya'ni zameen-o-aasman ki kul cheezein Rahman ki ghulami mein hazir hone wali hain, un sab ko Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne ek ek kar ke gin rakha hai.

Saari makhlooq tanha tanha us ke paas hazir hogi, koi nahin jo us ki ijazat ke baghair us ke samne sifarish ya shafa'at kar sake, jaise irshad hai "Wa kam min malakin fis-samawati..." (53:26), yani aasmanon mein bohat se farishtay hain lekin un ki shafa'at bhi kuch faida nahin de sakti, haan yeh aur baat hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki mansha aur marzi se ho, aur jagah hai "Wa la yashfa'una illa limanirtada" (21:28) kisi ki woh shafa'at nahin karte magar us ki jis se Allah khush ho, pas yahan bhi Allah Ta'ala ki azmat, us ka jalal aur us ki kibriyai bayan ho rahi hai, ke baghair us ki ijazat aur razamandi ke kisi ki jurrat nahin ke us ke samne kisi ki sifarish mein zaban khole, Hadith-e-Shafa'at mein bhi hai ke main Allah ke Arsh ke neeche jaunga aur sajde mein gir padunga, Allah Ta'ala mujhe sajde mein hi chhod dega jab tak chahe, phir kaha jayega ke apna sar uthao, kaho, suna jayega, shafa'at karo, manzoor ki jayegi, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain phir mere liye had muqarrar kar di jayegi aur main unhein Jannat mein le jaunga, woh Allah tamam guzashta, maujooda aur aayinda ka aalim hai, us ka ilm tamam makhlooq ka ihata kiye hue hai, jaise aur jagah farishton ka qaul hai ke "Ma natanzalu illa bi-amri Rabbik..." (19:64), hum tere Rabb ke hukum ke baghair utar nahin sakte, hamare aage peeche aur samne sab ki cheezein usi ki malkiyat hain aur tera Rabb bhool chook se paak hai.

Kursi se murad Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se ilm manqool hai, dusre buzurgon se dono paon rakhne ki jagah manqool hai, ek marfoo hadith mein bhi yahi marwi hai, Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se bhi marfoo'an yahi marwi hai lekin raf'a sabit nahin, Abu Malik farmate hain Kursi Arsh ke niche hai, Suddi kehte hain aasman-o-zameen Kursi ke jauf mein aur Kursi Arsh ke samne, Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain saaton zameenein aur saaton aasman agar phaila diye jayen aur sab ko mila kar baseet kar diya jaye toh bhi Kursi ke muqable mein aise honge jaise ek halqa kisi chatyal maidan mein, Ibn Jareer ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke saaton aasman Kursi mein aise hi hain jaise saat dirham dhaal mein aur hadith mein Kursi Arsh ke muqable mein aisi hai jaise ek lohay ka halqa chatyal maidan mein, Abu Zar Ghifari R.A ne ek martaba Kursi ke bare mein sawal kiya toh Huzoor ﷺ ne qasam kha kar yahi farmaya aur farmaya ke phir Arsh ki fazeelat Kursi par bhi aisi hi hai, ek aurat ne aa kar Huzoor ﷺ se darkhwast ki ke mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah mujhe jannat mein le jaye, Aap ﷺ ne Allah Ta'ala ki azmat bayan karte hue farmaya ke us ki Kursi ne aasman-o-zameen ko gher rakha hai magar jis tarah naya paalan charchrata hai woh Kursi azmat-e-Parwardigar se charchra rahi hai, go yeh hadith bahut si sanadon se bahut si kitabon mein marwi hai lekin kisi sanad mein koi raawi ghair mashhoor hai kisi mein irsaal hai, koi mauqoof hai, kisi mein bahut kuch ghareeb ziyadati hai, kisi mein hazf hai aur in sab se zyada ghareeb Hazrat Juseer wali hadith hai jo Abu Dawood mein marwi hai. Aur woh riwayat bhi hain jin mein Qayamat ke roz Kursi ka faislon ke liye rakha jana marwi hai. Zahir yeh hai ke is aayat mein yeh zikr nahin wallahu a'lam, musalmanon ke hai'at daan mutakallimeen kehte hain ke Kursi aathwan aasman hai jise falak-e-thawabit kehte hain aur jis par nawwan aasman hai aur jise falak-e-aseer kehte hain aur atlas bhi, lekin dusre logon ne is ki tardeed ki hai, Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain Kursi hi Arsh hai lekin sahih baat yeh hai ke Kursi aur hai aur Arsh aur hai, jo is se bada hai jaisa ke aasar-e-ahadees mein warid hua hai, Allama Ibn Jareer toh is bare mein Hazrat Umar R.A wali riwayat par aitimaad kiye hue hain lekin mere nazdeek is ki sehat mein kalaam hai wallahu a'lam, phir farmaya ke Allah par un ki hifazat bojhal aur garan nahin balkay sahal aur aasaan hai.

Woh sari makhlooq ke a'maal par khabardar, tamam cheezon par nigahban, koi cheez us se posheeda aur anjaan nahin, balkay sahl aur aasaan hai. Tamam makhlooq us ke samne haqeer, mutawazi, zaleel, past, mohtaj aur faqeer. Woh Ghani, woh Hameed, woh jo kuch chahe kar guzarne wala, koi us par haakim nahin, baazpurs karne wala. Har cheez par woh ghalib, har cheez ka haafiz aur maalik. Woh ulu, bulandi aur rif'at wala, woh azmat, badai aur kibriyai wala. Us ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laiq nahin, na us ke siwa koi khabargiri karne wala, na paalne posne wala. Woh kibriyai wala aur fakhr wala hai. Isi liye farmaya: "Wa Huwal Aliyul Azeem" (bulandi aur azmat wala wahi hai). Yeh aayatein aur in jaisi aur aayatein aur sahih hadeesein jitni kuch zaat-o-sifaat-e-Bari mein waarid hui hain, un sab par imaan lana baghair kaifiyat maloom kiye aur baghair tashbeeh diye, jin alfaaz mein woh waarid hui hain, zaroori hai aur yahi tareeqa hamare Salaf-e-Saliheen (Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een) ka tha.

Jabr aur Dawat-e-Islam: Yahan yeh bayan ho raha hai ke kisi ko jabran Islam mein dakhil na kar, Islam ki haqaniyat wazeh aur roshan ho chuki, is ke dalail-o-barahin bayan ho chuke hain phir kisi aur jabr aur zabardasti karne ki kya zaroorat hai? Jise Allah Rabbul Izzat hidayat de ga, jis ka seena khula hua, dil roshan aur aankhein beena hongi woh to khud-ba-khud is ka wala-o-shaida ho jaye ga, han andhay dil walay, behray kanon walay, phooti aankhon walay is se door rahen ge, phir unhein agar jabran Islam mein dakhil bhi kiya to kya faida? Kisi par Islam ke qabool karane ke liye jabr aur zabardasti na karo. Is ayat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke Madina ki mushrika auratein jab unhein aulad na hoti thi to nazr manti thin ke agar hamaray han aulad hui to hum usay Yahood bana den ge, Yahudiyon ke supurd kar den ge, isi tarah un ke bohat se bachay Yahudiyon ke paas thay, jab yeh log musalman huye aur Allah ke deen ke ansar banay, Yahudiyon se jang hui aur un ki androoni sazishon aur fareb kariyon se nijat panay ke liye Sarwar-e-Rusul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh hukm jari farmaya ke Bani Nazeer ke Yahudiyon ko jala-watan kar diya jaye, us waqt ansariyon ne apne bachay jo un ke paas thay un se talab kiye taake unhein apne asar se musalman bana lein, is par yeh ayat nazil hui ke jabr aur zabardasti na karo. Ek riwayat yeh bhi hai ke Ansar ke qabeelay Banu Salim bin Auf ka ek shakhs Haseeni nami tha jis ke do larkay Nasrani thay aur khud musalman tha, us ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein ek baar arz kiya ke mujhe ijazat di jaye ke main un larkon ko jabran musalman bana loon, waisay to woh Isaiyat se hat-tay nahin, is par yeh ayat utri aur mumanat kar di, aur riwayat mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke Nasraniyon ka ek qafila mulk-e-Sham se tijarat ke liye kishmish le kar aaya tha jin ke hathon par dono larkay Nasrani ho gaye thay, jab woh qafila janay laga to yeh bhi janay par tayyar ho gaye, un ke baap ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh zikr kiya aur kaha ke agar aap ijazat dein to main unhein Islam lanay ke liye kuch takleef doon aur jabran musalman bana loon, warna phir aap ko unhein wapas lanay ke liye apne aadmi bhejne paren ge, is par yeh ayat nazil hui. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka ghulam Asbaq Nasrani tha, aap us par Islam pesh karte woh inkar karta, aap keh dete ke khair teri marzi, Islam jabr se rokta hai. Ulama ki ek bari jamaat ka yeh khayal hai ke yeh ayat un Ahl-e-Kitab ke haq mein hai jo faskh-o-tabdeel-e-Torat-o-Injeel ke pehlay deen-e-Masihi ikhtiyar kar chuke thay aur ab woh jizya par razamand ho jayen, baaz aur kehte hain ayat-e-qital ne isay mansookh kar diya, tamam insanon ko is pak deen ki dawat dena zaroori hai, agar koi inkar kare to beshak musalman us se jihad karein, jaisay aur jagah hai ayat (Satud'auna ila qaumin uli ba'sin shadeedin tuqatilunahum au yuslimun) (48:16).

(Al-Fath: 16) Anqareeb tumhein us qoum ki taraf bulaya jaye ga jo bari laraka hai ya toh tum us se laro ge ya woh Islam layein ge, aur jagah hai aye Nabi kafiron aur munafiqon se jihad kar aur un par sakhti kar, aur jagah hai imandaro! Apne aas paas ke kuffar se jihad karo, tum mein woh ghar jayein aur yaqeen rakho ke Allah muttaqiyon ke saath hai, sahih hadith mein hai, tere Rab ko un logon par ta'ajjub aata hai jo zanjeeron mein jakre hue jannat ki taraf ghaseete jate hain, ya'ni woh kuffar jo maidan-e-jang mein qaidi ho kar tauq-o-salasil pehna kar yahan laye jate hain phir woh Islam qabool kar lete hain aur un ka zahir batin achha ho jata hai aur woh jannat ke laiq ban jate hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kaha musalman ho jao, us ne kaha Hazrat mera dil nahin manta, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya go dil na chahta ho, yeh hadith sulasi hai ya'ni Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tak is mein teen rawi hain lekin is se yeh na samajhna chahiye ke Aap ne use majboor kiya, matlab yeh hai ke tu kalma parh le, phir ek din woh bhi aayega Allah tere dil ko khol de aur tu dil se bhi Islam ka dildada ho jaye ga, husn-e-niyat aur ikhlas-e-amal tujhe naseeb ho, jo shakhs but aur ausan aur maboodan-e-batil aur shaitani kalam ki qabooliyat ko chor de Allah ki tauheed ka iqrari aur aamil ban jaye woh seedha aur sahih rah par hai. Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) farmate hain jibt se murad jadoo hai aur taghoot se murad shaitan hai, daleri aur namwari dono oont ke dono taraf ke barabar bojh hain jo logon mein hote hain. Ek daleer aadmi toh anjaan shakhs ki himayat mein bhi jaan dene par tul jata hai lekin ek buzdil aur darpok apni sagi maa ki khatir bhi qadam aage nahin barhata. Insaan ka haqeeqi karam us ka deen hai, insaan ka sacha nasab husn-e-khulq hai go woh Farsi ho ya Nabti, Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka taghoot ko shaitan ke ma'ani mein lena bohat hi achha hai is liye ke yeh har us burai ko shamil hai jo ahl-e-jahiliyat mein thi, but ki pooja karna, un ki taraf hajatein le jana un se sakhti ke waqt talab-e-imdad karna waghera. Phir farmaya us shakhs ne mazboot kara tham liya, ya'ni deen ke a'ala aur qawi sabab ko le liya jo na toote na phoote, khoob mazboot mustahkam qawi aur gara hua, urwatul wusqa se murad iman, Islam, tauheed-e-bari, Quran aur Allah ki rah ki mohabbat aur isi ke liye dushmani karna hai, yeh kara kabhi na tootega ya'ni is ke jannat mein pahunchne tak, aur jagah hai aayat (Innal-laha la yughayyiru ma bi-qaumin hatta yughayyiru ma bi-anfusihim) 13.

(Ar-Ra'd: 11) Allah Ta'ala kisi qoum ki halat nahin bigarta jab tak woh khud apni halat na bigar le. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek hadith mein hai Hazrat Qais bin 'Ibadah farmate hain main Masjid-e-Nabvi mein tha jo ek shakhs aaya jis ka chehra Allah se khaif tha, namaz ki do halki rak'atein us ne ada keen, log unhein dekh kar kehne lage yeh jannati hain, jab woh bahar nikle to main bhi un ke peeche gaya, baatein karne laga jab woh mutawajja hue to main ne kaha jab aap tashreef laye the tab logon ne aap ki nisbat yun kaha tha, kaha SubhanAllah kisi ko woh na kehna chahiye jis ka ilm use na ho, han albatta itni baat to hai ke main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maujoodgi mein ek khwab dekha tha ke goya main ek lehlate hue sarsabz gulshan mein hoon us ke ek darmiyan lohe ka sutoon hai jo zameen se aasman tak chala gaya hai us ki choti par ek kara hai mujh se kaha gaya is par charh jao, main ne kaha main to nahin charh sakta, chunancha ek shakhs ne mujhe thama aur main ba-aasani charh gaya aur us kare ko tham liya, us ne kaha dekho mazboot pakre rakhna, bas isi halat mein meri aankh khul gayi ke woh kara mere hath mein tha, main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh apna khwab bayan kiya to aap ne farmaya gulshan bagh-e-Islam hai aur sutoon deen hai aur kara 'Urwatul Wuthqa hai to mere dam tak Islam par qaim rahega, yeh shakhs Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A) hain, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim dono mein marwi hai. Musnad ki isi hadith mein hai ke us waqt aap boorhe the aur lakri par tek lagaye hue Masjid-e-Nabvi mein aaye the aur ek sutoon ke peeche namaz parhi thi aur sawal ke jawab mein farmaya tha ke jannat Allah ki cheez hai jise chahe is mein le jaye, khwab ke zikr mein farmaya ke ek shakhs aaya mujhe le kar chala gaya jab hum ek lambe chaure saaf shaffaf maidan mein pohanche to main ne bayin taraf jana chaha to us ne kaha tu aisa nahin, main dayin janib chalne laga to achanak ek phisalta pahar nazar aaya us ne mera hath pakra aur oopar charha liya aur main us ki choti tak pohanch gaya, wahan main ne ek ooncha sutoon lohe ka dekha jis ke sire par ek sone ka kara tha mujhe us ne is sutoon par charha diya yahan tak ke main ne is kare ko tham liya us ne poocha khoob mazboot maloom tham liya hai, main ne kaha han, us ne zor se sutoon par apna paon mara, woh nikal gaya aur kara mere hath mein reh gaya, jab yeh khwab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko main ne sunaya to aap ne farmaya bohat nek khwab hai, maidan-e-mahshar hai, bayin taraf ka rasta jahannam ka rasta hai to logon mein nahin, dayin janib ka rasta jannatiyon ki rah hai, phisalta pahar shuhada ki manzil hai, kara Islam ka kara hai marte dam tak ise mazboot tham rakho, is ke baad Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne farmaya umeed to mujhe yahi hai ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe jannat mein le jaye ga.

Andhere se ujale ki taraf Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke uski razamandi ke talabgar ko woh salamti ki rahnumai karta hai aur shak-o-shubha ke kufr-o-shak ke andheron se nikal kar noor-e-haq ki saaf roshni mein la khara karta hai, kuffar ke wali shayateen hain jo jahalat-o-zalalat ko kufr-o-shirk ko muzayyan karke unhein iman se aur tauheed se rokte hain aur yun noor-e-haq se hata kar na-haq ke andheron mein jhonk dete hain, yehi kafir hain aur hamesha yeh dozakh mein hi pare rahenge, lafz-e-noor ko wahid lana aur zulumaat ko jama lana is liye hai ke haq aur iman aur saccha rasta ek hi hai aur kufr ki kayi qismein hain, kafiron ki bahut si shakhein hain jo sab ki sab baatil aur na-haq hain jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Waa anna haaza siraati mustaqeeman fattabi'ooh) (Surah Al-An'am: 153) meri seedhi raah yehi hai tum isi ki tabedari karo aur, aur raston par na chalo warna is raah se bhatak jaoge. Yeh wasiyat tumhein tumhare bachao ke liye kardi aur jagah hai ayat (Wa ja'alaz zulumaati wannoor) (Surah Al-An'am: 1) aur bhi is qisam ki bahut si ayatein hain jin se sabit hota hai ke haq ek hi hai, aur baatil mein tafaruq-o-intishar hai, Hazrat Ayyub bin Khalid R.H farmate hain, ahl-e-hawa ya ahl-e-fitna khare kiye jayenge jis ki chahat sirf iman hi ki ho woh to roshan saaf aur noorani hoga aur jis ki khwahish kufr ki ho woh siyah aur andheron wala hoga, phir aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat farmayi.

Ibrahim A.S aur Namrood ka aamna samna. Is badshah ka naam Namrood bin Kan'an bin Sam bin Nooh tha. Is ka paya-e-takht Babul tha. Is ke nasab mein kuch ikhtilaf bhi hai. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain duniya ki mashriq-o-maghrib ki saltanat rakhne wale chaar hue jin mein se do momin aur do kafir, Hazrat Sulaiman bin Dawood A.S aur Hazrat Zulqarnain A.S, aur kafiron mein Namrood aur Bakht-e-Nasr. Farman hota hai ke ae Nabi ﷺ tum ne use nahin dekha, jo Hazrat Ibrahim A.S se wujood-e-Bari Ta'ala mein mubahisa karne laga. Yeh shakhs khud Allah hone ka mudda'i tha, jaisa is ke baad Firaun ne bhi apne walon mein da'wa kiya tha ke main apne siwa kisi ko tumhara Rab nahin janta. Chunke ek muddat-e-madeed aur arsa-e-ba'eed se yeh badshah chala aata tha is liye dimagh mein ra'oonat aur ananiyat aa gayi thi, sarkashi aur takabbur, nakhwat aur ghuroor tabiyat mein sama gaya tha. Ba'z log kehte hain chaar sau saal tak hukumat karta raha tha. Hazrat Ibrahim A.S se jab us ne wujood-e-Bari Ta'ala par daleel mangi to aap ne neest se hast aur hast se neest karne ki daleel di jo ek badeehi aur misl-e-aftab roshan daleel thi ke maujoodaat ka pehle kuch na hona phir hona phir mit jana khuli daleel hai.

Maujid aur paida karne wale ke maujood hone ki aur wahi Allah hai, Namrood ne jawaban kaha ke yeh toh main bhi karta hoon, yeh keh kar do shakhson ko usne bulwaya jo wajib-ul-qatl thay, ek ko qatl kar diya aur dusre ko riha kar diya, darasal yeh jawab aur dawa kis qadar lachar aur be-mani hai is ke bayan ki bhi zaroorat nahin, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne toh sifaat-e-bari mein se ek sifat paida karna aur phir neest kar dena bayan ki thi aur usne na toh unhein paida kiya aur na un ki ya apni maut-o-hayat par use qudrat, lekin juhala ko bharkane ke liye aur apni ilmiyat jatane ke liye bawajood apni ghalti aur mubahisa ke usool se tareeqa-e-farar ko jante hue sirf ek baat bana li, Ibrahim (A.S) bhi is ko samajh gaye aur aap ne kund-zehan ke samne aisi daleel pesh kar di ke sooratan bhi is ki mushabahat na kar sake, chunancha farmaya ke jab tu paidaish aur maut tak ka ikhtiyar rakhta hai toh makhlooq par tasarruf tera poora hona chahiye, mere Allah ne toh yeh tasarruf kiya ke suraj ko hukum de diya hai ke woh mashriq ki taraf se nikla kare chunancha woh nikal raha hai, ab tu use hukum de ke woh maghrib ki taraf se nikle is ka koi zahiri toota phoota jawab bhi na us se ban para aur be-zaban ho kar apni aajizi ka mo'tarif ho gaya aur Allah ki hujjat us par poori ho gayi lekin chunke hidayat naseeb na thi rah-yafta na ho saka, aise bad-waza logon ko Allah koi daleel nahin samjhata aur woh haq ke muqable mein baghlein jhankte hi nazar aate hain, un par Allah ka ghazab-o-ghussa aur narazgi hoti hai aur is ke liye is jahan mein bhi sakht azab hote hain, baaz mantiqiyon ne kaha hai ke Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne yahan ek wazeh daleel ke baad dusri is se bhi zyada wazeh daleel pesh kar di, lekin darhaqeeqat yun nahin balkay pehli daleel dusri ka muqaddama thi aur un dono mein se Namrood ke dawa ka butlan bilkul wazeh ho gaya, asal daleel paidaish-o-maut hi hai chunke is ka dawa is nasamajh musht-e-khaak ne bhi kiya toh lazim tha ke jo banane bigadne par na sirf qadir ho balkay banao bigad ka bhi khaliq ho us ki malkiyat poori tarah usi ke qabze mein honi chahiye aur jis tarah maut-o-hayat ke ahkaam us ke jari ho jate hain isi tarah dusre ahkaam bhi jari ho jayen, phir kya wajah hai ke suraj jo ke ek makhlooq hai is ki farmanbardari aur itaat-guzari na kare aur is ke kehne se mashriq ki bajaye maghrib se na nikle? Pas Ibrahim (A.S) ne is par is mubahisa mein khula ghalba paya aur use bilkul lajawab kar diya falhamdulillah.

Hazrat Suddi R.H farmate hain yeh munazra Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke aag se nikal aane ke baad hua tha is se pehle aap ki is zalim badshah se koi mulaqat nahin hui thi, Zaid bin Aslam R.H ka qaul hai ke qahat sali thi, log Namrood ke paas jaate the aur ghalla le aate the, Hazrat Khalilullah A.S bhi gaye, wahan yeh munazra ho gaya badbakht ne aap ko ghalla na diya, aap khali haath wapas aaye, ghar ke qareeb pahunch kar aap ne dono boriyon mein rait bhar li ke ghar wale samjhein kuch le aaye, ghar aate hi boriyan rakh kar so gaye, aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Sarah R.A uthin boriyon ko khola to dekha ke umda anaaj se dono pur hain, khana paka kar tayyar kiya, aap ki bhi aankh khuli dekha ke khana tayyar hai, poocha anaaj kahan se aaya, kaha do boriyan jo aap bhar kar laye hain, unhin mein se yeh anaaj nikala tha, aap samajh gaye ke yeh Allah Jalla Shanahu ki taraf se barkat aur us ki rahmat hai, is nahanjaar badshah ke paas Allah ne ek farishta bheja us ne aakar use tauheed ki dawat di lekin us ne qabool na ki, dobara dawat di lekin inkar kiya teesri martaba Allah ki taraf bulaya lekin phir bhi yeh munkir hi raha. Is baar baar ke inkar ke baad farishtay ne us se kaha achha to apna lashkar tayyar kar main bhi apna lashkar le aata hoon, Namrood ne bada bhari lashkar tayyar kiya aur zabardast fauj ko le kar suraj nikalne ke maidan mein aa data, idhar Allah Ta'ala ne machharon ka ek darwaza khol diya, bade bade machhar is kasrat se aaye ke logon ko suraj bhi nazar na aata tha, Allah ki yeh fauj Namroodiyon par giri aur thodi der mein un ka khoon to kya un ka gosht post sab kha gayi aur saare ke saare yahin halak ho gaye, haddiyon ka dhancha baqi reh gaya, unhin machharon mein se ek Namrood ke nathne mein ghus gaya aur char sau saal tak us ka dimagh chaatta raha aise azab mein woh raha ke us se maut hazaron darje behtar thi apna sar deewaron aur pattharon par maarta phirta tha, hathoron se kuchlwata tha, yunhi reng reng kar badnaseeb ne halakat payi. A'azana Allah.

Sau saal baad oopar jo waqia Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke mubahisa ka guzra, us par is ka atf yeh hai. Yeh guzarne wale ya toh Hazrat Uzair A.S thay jaisa ke mashhoor hai, ya Irmiya bin Khalqiya thay aur yeh naam Hazrat Khizr A.S ka hai, ya Kharqeel bin Buwar thay, ya Bani Israel mein ka ek shakhs tha. Yeh basti Bait-ul-Muqaddas thi aur yahi qaul mashhoor hai. Bakht-e-Nasr ne jab isay ujara, yahan ke bashindon ko teh-e-tegh kiya, makanat gira diye aur is abad basti ko bilkul veeran kar diya. Is ke baad yeh buzurg yahan se guzray, unhon ne dekha ke sari basti teh-o-bala ho gayi hai, na makan hai na makeen, toh wahan thehar kar sochne lagay ke bhala aisa bada pur-ronaq shehar jo is tarah ujra hai yeh phir kaise abad hoga? Allah Ta'ala ne khud un par maut nazil farmayi, toh isi halat mein rahay aur wahan sau saal ke baad Bait-ul-Muqaddas phir abad ho gaya, bhagay huay Bani Israel bhi phir aa pohanchay aur shehar khacha-khach bhar gaya, wahi agli si ronaq aur chehal-pehal ho gayi. Ab sau saal-e-kamil ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne unhein zinda kiya aur sab se pehle rooh aankhon mein aayi taake apna jee uthna khud dekh sakein. Jab saray badan mein rooh phoonk di gayi toh Allah Ta'ala ne farishtay ke zariye poochwaya ke kitni muddat tak tum murda rahay? Jis ke jawab mein kaha ke abhi tak ek din bhi poora na hua, wajah yeh hui ke subh ke waqt un ki rooh nikli thi aur sau saal ke baad jab jiye hain toh shaam ka waqt tha, khayal kiya ke yeh wahi din hai toh Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke tum ek sau saal-e-kamil tak murda rahay, ab hamari qudrat dekho ke tumhara tosha-bhata jo tumhare sath tha, bawajood sau saal guzar jaane ke bhi waisa hi hai, na sara na kharab hua hai.

Yeh tosha angoor aur anjeer aur aseer tha na toh yeh sheera bigra tha na anjeer khatte hue thay na angoor kharab hue thay balkay theek apni asli halat par thay, ab farmaya yeh tera gadha jis ki boseeda haddiyan tere samne pari hain, inhe dekh tere dekhte hue hum isay zinda karte hain, hum khud teri zaat ko logon ke liye daleel banane wale hain ke inhe Qayamat ke din apne dobara jee uthne par yaqeen-e-kamil ho jaye, chunancha un ke dekhte hue haddiyan uthin aur ek ek ke sath juri, Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qirat nunshizuha ze ke sath hai aur nunshiruha re ke sath bhi parha gaya hai yani zinda karenge, Mujahid ki qirat yahi hai, Suddi waghera kehte hain yeh haddiyan un ke dayen bayen phail pari thin aur boseeda hone ki wajah se un ki safedi chamak rahi thi, hawa se yeh sab yakjaan ho gayin, phir ek ek haddi apni apni jagah jur gayi aur haddiyon ka poora dhancha qaim ho gaya jis par gosht mutlaq na tha, phir Allah Ta'ala ne isay gosht, ragein, pathay, aur khaal pehna di, phir farishtay ko bheja jis ne is ke nathne mein phoonk mari, bas Allah ke hukum se usi waqt zinda ho gaya aur awaz nikalne laga, in tamam baton ko dekh kar Hazrat Uzair (A.S) dekhte rahe aur muddat ki yeh sari karigari un ki ankhon ke samne hi hui, jab yeh sab kuch dekh chuke toh kehne lage is baat ka ilm toh mujhe tha hi ke Allah har cheez par qadir hai lekin ab main ne apni ankhon se bhi dekh liya, toh main apne zamane ke tamam logon se zyada ilm-o-yaqeen wala hoon, baaz logon ne a'lam ko a'lam bhi parha hai, yani Allah Muqtadir ne farmaya ke jaan le ke Allah Ta'ala ko har cheez par qudrat hai.

Mu'amma-e-Hayat-o-Maut: Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke is sawal ki bahut si wajoohaat thin, ek toh yeh ke chunke yahi daleel aap ne Namrood mardood ke samne pesh ki thi toh aap ne chaha ke ilm-ul-yaqeen se ain-ul-yaqeen hasil ho jaye, jaanta toh hoon hi lekin dekh bhi lein, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is aayat ke mauqe ki ek hadith hai jis mein hai ke hum shak ke haqdar ba-nisbat Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke zyada hain jabke unhon ne kaha aayat (Wa iz qala Ibrahimu rabbi arini kaifa tuhyil mawta) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 260), toh is se koi jahil yeh na samjhe ke Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ko Allah Ta'ala ki is sifat mein shak tha, is hadith ke bahut se jawab hain jin mein se ek yeh hai.

(Shayad yeh hoga ke hum Khalilullah se kamzor iman wale hone ke bawajood Khaliq-e-Alam ki is sifat mein shak nahin karte toh Khalilullah ko shak kyun hoga? Mutarjim) Ab Rabb-ul-Alameen Khaliq-e-Kul farmata hai ke chaar parinday le lo, mufassireen ke is baare mein kayi qaul hain ke kaun kaun se parinday Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne liye thay? Lekin zahir hai ke is ka ilm hamein koi fayda nahin pahuncha sakta aur is ka na jaanna hamein koi nuqsan nahin pahunchata, koi kehta hai woh kulang aur mor aur murgh aur kabootar thay, koi kehta hai woh murghabi aur seemurgh ka bacha aur murgh aur mor thay, koi kehta hai kabootar, murgh, mor aur kauwa thay, phir unhein kaat kar un ke tukray tukray kar daalo, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yahi farmate hain aur riwayat mein hai apne paas rakh liya, jab hil gaye unhein zibah kar diya, phir tukray tukray alag alag kar diye, pas aap ne chaar parind liye, zibah karke un ke tukray kiye phir akher diye aur saare mukhtalif tukray aapas mein mila diye, phir chaaron paharon par woh tukray rakh diye aur sab parindon ke sar apne haath mein rakhe, phir ba-hukm-e-Ilahi unhein bulaane lage jis janwar ko aawaz dete us ke bikhre hue par idhar udhar se urte aur aapas mein jurte isi tarah khoon khoon ke saath milta aur baqi ajza bhi jis jis pahar par hote aapas mein mil jaate aur parinda urta hua aap ke paas aata, aap use dusre parind ka sar dete toh woh qabool na karta, khud us ka sar dete toh woh bhi jur jaata, yahan tak ke ek ek karke yeh chaaron parind zinda ho kar ur gaye aur Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat ka aur murdon ke zinda hone ka yeh iman-afroz nazara Khalilullah (A.S) ne apni aankhon dekh liya, phir farmata hai ke jaan le Allah ghalib hai koi cheez use aajiz nahin kar sakti, jis kaam ko chahe be-rok ho jaata hai, har cheez us ke qabze mein hai, woh apne aqwal-o-af'aal mein Hakeem hai isi tarah apne intezam mein aur shariat ke muqarrar karne mein bhi, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmaya karte thay ke Ibrahim (A.S) se Janab-e-Bari ka yeh sawal karna ke kya tu iman nahin laya aur Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ka yeh jawab dena ke haan iman toh hai lekin dili itminan chahta hoon, yeh aayat mujhe toh aur tamam aayaton se zyada umeed dilaane wali maloom hoti hai, matlab yeh hai ke ek imandar ke dil mein agar koi khatra waswasa-e-shaitani paida ho toh us par pakar nahin, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Aas (R.A) ki mulaqat hoti hai toh poochte hain ke Quran mein sab se zyada umeed paida karne wali aayat kaun si hai? Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain aayat (Qul ya ibadiyallazina asrafu ala anfusihim la taqnatou mir rahmatillah) (Surah Az-Zumar: 53) wali aayat jis mein irshad hai ke ae mere gunahgar bando meri rahmat se na-umeed na hona main sab gunahon ko bakhash deta hoon, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya mere nazdeek toh is ummat ke liye sab se zyada dharas bandhane wali aayat Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ka yeh qaul, phir Rabb-e-Do-Alam ka sawal aur aap ka jawab hai (Abdur Razzaq wa Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera).

Sau guna zyada sawab. Is ayat mein bayan ho raha hai ke jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki razamandi ki talab mein apne maal ko kharch kare, use badi barkatein aur bahut bade sawab milte hain aur nekiyan saat sau guna karke di jati hain, toh farmaya yeh woh log hain jo Allah ki rah mein yani Allah ki farmanbardari mein jihad ke ghoron ko palne mein, hathiyar kharidne mein, hajj karne karane mein kharch karte hain. Allah ke naam diye hue ki misaal kis pakeezgi se bayan ho rahi hai jo aankhon mein khap jaye aur dil mein ghar kar jaye, ek dam yun farma deta hai ke ek ke badle saat sau milenge is se bahut zyada latafat is kalam aur is ki misaal mein hai aur phir is mein ishara hai ke aamal-e-saliha Allah ke paas barhte rehte hain jis tarah tumhare boye hue beej khet mein barhte rehte hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai ke Rasoolullah Ahmad-e-Mujtaba Muhammad (ﷺ) farmate hain jo shakhs apni bachi hui cheez fi sabilillah deta hai use saat sau ka sawab milta hai aur jo shakhs jaan par aur apne ahl-o-ayal par kharch kare use das guna milta hai aur bimar ki ayadat ka sawab bhi das guna milta hai. Roza dhal hai, jab tak ke use kharab na kare, jis shakhs par koi jismani bala musibat dukh dard bimari aaye woh is ke gunahon ko jhar deti hai. Yeh hadith Hazrat Abu Ubaida (R.A) ne us waqt bayan farmayi thi jab ke aap sakht bimar the aur log ayadat ke liye gaye the, aap ki biwi sahiba sarhane baithi thin, un se pucha ke raat kaisi guzri? Unhon ne kaha nihayat sakhti se, aap ka munh us waqt deewar ki janib tha, yeh sunte hi logon ki taraf munh kiya aur farmaya meri yeh raat sakhti ki nahin guzri, is liye ke main ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se yeh suna hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aur hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs ne nakeel wali untni khairat ki, An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh Qayamat ke din saat sau nakeel wali untniyan payega, Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Ibn-e-Adam ki ek neki ko das nekiyon ke barabar kar diya hai aur woh barhti rehti hain, saat sau tak, magar roza, ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai woh khas mere liye hai aur main aap ko is ka ajar-o-sawab dunga, rozedar ko do khushiyan hain ek iftar ke waqt, dusri Qayamat ke din rozedar ke munh ki bu Allah Ta'ala ko mushk ki khushbu se zyada pasand hai, dusri hadith mein itni ziyadati aur hai ke rozedar apne khane peene ko sirf meri wajah se chorta hai, aakhir mein hai roza dhal hai roza dhal hai. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai namaz roza Allah ka zikr Allah ki rah ke kharch par saat sau guna barh jate hain, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki hadith mein hai ke jo shakhs jihad mein kuch mali madad de, go khud na jaye taham use ek ke badle saat sau ke kharch karne ka sawab milta hai aur khud bhi shareek hua toh ek dirham ke badle saat lakh dirham ke kharch ka sawab milta hai, phir aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat ki (Wallahu yuda'ifu liman yasha'u, wallahu Wasi'un 'Alim) (2:261).

(Al-Baqarah: 261) Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A wali hadith (Man zallazi yuqrizullaha qardan hasanan fayuda'ifahu lahu ad'afan kaseera) (Al-Baqarah: 245) ki tafseer mein pehle guzar chuki hai jis mein hai ke ek ke badle mein do crore ka sawab milta hai, Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke jab yeh ayat nazil hui toh Nabi Alaihis Salam ne dua ki ke aye Allah meri ummat ko kuch aur ziyadati ata farma toh (Man zallazi yuqrizullaha qardan hasanan fayuda'ifahu lahu ad'afan kaseera) (Al-Baqarah: 245) wali ayat utri aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir bhi yahi dua ki toh ayat (Innama yuwaffas sabiroona ajrahum bighairi hisab) (Az-Zumar: 10) utri, pas sabit hua ke jab qadr-e-ikhlas-e-amal mein ho usi qadr sawab mein ziyadati hoti hai, Allah Ta'ala bade wasee fazl-o-karam wala hai, woh jaanta bhi hai ke kaun kis qadr mustahiq hai aur kise istihqaq nahin, SubhanAllah walhamdulillah.

Mukhayyir hazrat ki tareef aur hidayaat. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne un bandon ki madh-o-tareef karta hai jo khairaat-o-sadaqaat karte hain aur phir jise dete hain us par ehsaan nahin jatate aur na apni zaban se ya apne kisi fe'l se us shakhs ko koi nuqsan pahunchate hain, un se aise jazaye khair ka wada farmata hai ke un ka ajar-o-sawab Rabb-e-Do-Alam ke zimme hai. Un par Qayamat ke din koi haul aur khauf-o-khatar na hoga aur na duniya aur baal-bachche chhoot jaane ka unhein koi gham-o-ranj hoga, is liye ke wahan pahunch kar us se behtar cheezein unhein mil chuki hain. Phir farmata hai ke kalma-e-khair zaban se nikalna, kisi Musalman bhai ke liye dua karna, darguzar karna, khatawar ko maaf kar dena us sadqe se behtar hai jis ki teh mein eeza-dahi ho, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool-e-Akram Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain koi sadaqa nek kaam se afzal nahin. Kya tum ne farman-e-Bari (Qaul-un-ma'roofun...) nahin suna? Allah Ta'ala apni tamam makhlooq se beniyaaz hai aur saari makhlooq us ki mohtaj hai, woh Haleem aur bardbar hai, gunahon ko dekhta hai aur hilm-o-karam karta hai balkeh maaf farma deta hai, tajawuz kar leta hai aur bakhsh deta hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke teen qisam ke logon se Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din baat-cheet na karega na un ki taraf nazar-e-rahmat se dekhe ga na unhein paak kare ga balkeh un ke liye dardnaak azaab hain, ek to de kar ehsaan jatane wala, doosra takhnon se neeche pajama aur tehband latkane wala, teesra apne saude ko jhooti qasam kha kar bechne wala. Ibn-e-Majah waghera ki hadith mein hai ke maa-baap ka nafarman, khairaat-o-sadaqa kar ke ehsaan jatane wala, sharabi aur taqdeer ko jhutlane wala Jannat mein dakhil na hoga, Nasai mein hai teen shakhson ki taraf Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din dekhe ga bhi nahin, maa-baap ka nafarman, sharab ka aadi aur de kar ehsaan jatane wala, Nasai ki aur hadith mein hai yeh teeno shakhs Jannat mein dakhil na honge, isi liye is aayat mein bhi irshad hota hai ke apne sadaqaat-o-khairaat ko minnat-samajat-o-ehsaan rakh kar aur takleef pahuncha kar barbad na karo, is ehsaan ke jatane aur takleef ke pahunchane ka gunah sadaqa aur khairaat ka sawab baqi nahin rakhta. Phir misaal di ke ehsaan aur takleef-dahi ke sadqe ke ghaarat ho jaane ki misaal us sadaqa jaisi hai jo riyakari ke taur par logon ko dikhawe ke liye diya jaaye.

Apni sakhawat aur fayyazi aur neki ki shohrat madd-e-nazar ho, logon mein tareef-o-sataish ki chahat ho sirf Allah Ta'ala ki razamandi ki talab na ho na uske sawab par nazar ho, isi liye is jumle ke baad farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala par aur Qayamat ke din par iman na ho to is riyakarana sadqe ki aur is ehsan jatane aur takleef pahunchane ke sadqe ki misaal aisi hai jaise koi saaf chatil patthar ki chattan ho jis par mitti bhi padi hui ho, phir sakht shiddat ki barish ho to jis tarah us patthar ki tamam mitti dhul jati hai aur kuch bhi baqi nahin rehti, isi tarah in dono qisam ke logon ke kharch ki kaifiyat hai ke go log samajhte hon ke uske sadqe ki neki uske paas hai jis tarah bazahir patthar par mitti nazar aati hai lekin jaise ke barish se woh mitti jati rahi isi tarah uske ehsan jatane ya takleef pahunchane ya riyakari karne se woh sawab bhi jata raha aur Allah Ta'ala ke paas pahunchega to kuch bhi jaza na payega, apne aamal mein se kisi cheez par qudrat na rakhega, Allah Ta'ala kafir giroh ki rah-e-rast ki taraf rehbari nahin karta.

Sadabahar amal yeh misaal mominon ke sadaqat ki di jin ki niyatein Allah Ta'ala ko khush karne ki hoti hain aur jazaye khair milne ka bhi poora yaqeen hota hai, jaise hadith mein hai jis shakhs ne Ramzan ke rozay imandari ke sath sawab milne ke yaqeen par rakhay.. Rabwah kehte hain oonchi zameen ko jahan nehrein chalti hain is lafz ko birwah aur burwah bhi parha gaya hai. Wabil ke ma'ani sakht barish ke hain, woh dugna phal lati hai yani ba-nisbat dusre baghon ki zameen ke, yeh bagh aisa hai aur aisi jagah waqay hai ke bilfarz barish na bhi ho taham sirf shabnam se hi phalta phoolta hai yeh namumkin hai ke mausam khali jaye, isi tarah imandaron ke a'maal kabhi bhi be-ajr nahin rehte. Woh zaroor badla dilwate hain, haan is jaza mein farq hota hai jo har imandar ke khuloos aur ikhlas aur nek kaam ki ahmiyat ke a'tibar se barhta hai. Allah Ta'ala par apne bandon mein se kisi banday ka koi amal makhfi aur posheeda nahin.

Kufr aur burhapa. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne ek din Sahaba se pucha jaante ho ke yeh aayat kis ke baare mein nazil hui? Unhon ne kaha Allah zyada jaanne wala hai, aap ne naraz ho kar farmaya tum jaante ho ya nahin? Is ka saaf jawab do, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya Amir-ul-Momineen mere dil mein ek baat hai, aap ne farmaya bhatije kaho aur apne nafs ko itna haqeer na karo, farmaya ek amal ki misaal di gayi hai, pucha kaun sa amal? Kaha ek maal-dar shakhs jo Allah Ta'ala ki farmanbardari ke kaam karta hai phir Shaitan use behkata hai aur woh gunahon mein mashghool ho jata hai aur apne nek aamal ko kho deta hai, pas yeh riwayat is aayat ki poori tafsir hai is mein bayan ho raha hai ke ek shakhs ne ibtida mein achhe amal kiye phir us ke baad us ki halat badal gayi aur buraiyon mein phans gaya aur pehle ki nekiyon ka zakheera barbad kar diya, aur aakhri waqt jabke nekiyon ki bahut zyada zaroorat thi yeh khali hath reh gaya, jis tarah ek shakhs hai jis ne bagh lagaya phal utarta ho, lekin jab burhape ke zamane ko pahuncha chhote bachche bhi hain aur aap kisi kaam kaaj ke qabil bhi nahin raha, ab madar-e-zindagi sirf woh ek bagh hai ittefaqan aandhi chali phir buraiyon par utar aaya aur khatma achha na hua to jab un nekiyon ke badle ka waqt aaya to khali hath reh gaya, kafir shakhs bhi jab Allah ke haan jata hai to wahan to kuch karne ki taqat nahin jis tarah us budhe ko, aur jo kiya hai woh kufr ki aag wali aandhi ne barbad kar diya, ab peeche se bhi koi use faida nahin pahuncha sakta jis tarah us budhe ki kam-sin aulad use koi kaam nahin de sakti, Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ek dua yeh bhi thi (Allahumma-j'al ausa'a rizqika 'alayya 'inda kibari sinni wa inqida'i 'umri) Aye Allah apni rozi ko sab se zyada mujhe us waqt inayat farma jab meri umr badi ho jaye aur khatam hone ko aaye. Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare samne yeh misalein bayan farma di, tum bhi gaur-o-fikr tadabbur-o-tafakkur karo, socho samjho aur ibrat-o-nasihat hasil karo jaise farmaya (Aayat: Wa tilkal-amthalu nadribuha linnasi wa ma ya'qiluha illal-'alimun) In misalon ko hum ne logon ke liye bayan farma diya. Inhein ulama hi khoob samajh sakte hain.

Kharab aur haram maal ki khairat mustarad. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko sadqa karne ka hukum deta hai ke maal-e-tijarat jo Allah Jalla Shanuhu ne tumhein diya hai sona chandi aur phal anaaj waghera jo usne tumhein zameen se nikal kar diye hain, us mein se behtareen marghoob-e-tab'a aur pasand-e-khatir umda umda cheezein Allah ki raah mein do. Raddi, wahiyat, sari gali, giri padi, bekar, fazool aur kharab cheezein raah-e-Allah na do, Allah khud Tayyib hai woh khabees ko qabool nahin karta, hum uske naam par yani goya use woh kharab cheez dena chahte ho jise agar tumhein di jaati toh na qabool karte phir Allah kaise le lega? Haan maal jaata dekh kar apne haq ke badle koi giri padi cheez bhi majboor ho kar le lo toh aur koi baat hai lekin Allah aisa majboor bhi nahin woh kisi halat mein aisi cheez ko qabool nahin farmata, yeh bhi matlab hai ke halal cheez ko chhod haram cheez ya haram maal se khairat na karo, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne jis tarah tumhari roziyan tum mein taqseem ki hain tumhare akhlaq bhi tum mein baant diye hain, duniya toh Allah Ta'ala apne doston ko bhi deta hai dushmanon ko bhi, haan deen sirf doston ko hi ata farmata hai aur jise deen mil jaye woh Allah ka mehboob hai. Ek toh raddi cheezein dusra haram maal. Is aayat mein pehla qaul murad lena hi achha maloom hota hai, Hazrat Bara bin Aazib (R.A) farmate hain khajooron ke mausam mein Ansar apni apni wus'at ke mutabiq khajooron ke khushe la kar doston ke darmiyan ek rassi ke sath latka dete, jise Ashab-e-Suffa aur maskeen muhajir bhook ke waqt kha lete, kisi ne jise sadqa ki raghbat kam thi us mein raddi khajoor ka ek khusha latka diya, jis par yeh aayat nazil hui ke agar tumhein aisi hi cheezein hadiya mein di jayein toh hargiz na loge.

Haan agar sharm-o-lihaz se badil-e-nakhwasta le lo toh aur baat hai, is ke nazil hone ke baad hum mein ka har shakhs behtar se behtar cheez lata tha (Ibn-e-Jarir). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke halki qisam ki khajoorein aur wahi phal log khairat mein nikalte jis par yeh aayat utri aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne in cheezon se sadqa dena mana farmaya. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mughaffal (R.A) farmate hain momin ki kamai kabhi khabeeth nahin hoti, murad yeh hai ke bekar cheez sadqe mein na do. Musnad mein hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne goh ka gosht laya gaya, aap ne na khaya na kisi ko khane se mana farmaya toh Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne kaha kisi maskeen ko de dein? Aap ne farmaya jo tumhein pasand nahin aur jise tum khana pasand nahin kartin use kisi aur ko kya dogi? Hazrat Bara (R.A) farmate hain jab tumhara haq kisi par ho aur woh tumhein woh cheez de jo be-qadr-o-qeemat ho toh tum use na loge magar us waqt jab tumhein apne haq ki barbadi dikhai deti ho toh tum chashm-poshi karke usi ko loge. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke tum ne kisi ko achha maal diya aur adaigi ke waqt woh naqis maal lekar aaya toh tum hargiz na loge aur agar loge bhi toh us ki qeemat ghata kar, toh tum jis cheez ko apne haq mein lena pasand nahin karte use Allah ke haq ke ewaz kyun dete ho? Pas behtareen aur marghoob maal us ki raah mein kharch karo aur yahi ma'ani hain aayat (لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتّٰى تُنْفِقُوْا مِمَّا تُحِبُّوْنَ) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 92) ke bhi. Phir farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein apni raah mein kharch karne ka hukum diya aur umda cheez dene ka. Kahin is se yeh na samajh lena ke woh mohtaj hai, nahin nahin woh toh be-niyaz hai aur tum sab us ke mohtaj ho, yeh hukum sirf is liye hai ke ghurba bhi duniya ki nematon se mehroom na rahen, jaise aur jagah qurbani ke hukum ke baad farmaya aayat (لَنْ يَّنَال اللّٰهَ لُحُوْمُهَا وَلَا دِمَاۗؤُهَا وَلٰكِنْ يَّنَالُهُ التَّقْوٰي مِنْكُمْ) (22. Al-Hajj: 37) Allah Ta'ala na is ka khoon le na gosht, woh toh tumhare taqwe ki aazmaish karta hai. Woh kushada fazl wala hai, us ke khazane mein koi kami nahin, sadqa apne chehite halal maal se nikal kar Allah ke fazl, us ki bakhshish, us ke karam aur us ki sakhawat par nazrein rakho, woh is ka badla is se bahut barh charh kar tumhein ata farmaye ga woh muflis nahin woh zalim nahin, woh Hameed hai tamam aqwal-o-af'aal, taqdeer, shariat sab mein us ki tareefein hi ki jati hain, us ke siwa koi ibadat ke qabil nahin, wohi tamam jahanon ka palne wala hai, us ke siwa koi kisi ki parwarish nahin karta. Hadith mein hai ke ek choka shaitan marta hai aur ek taufeeq ki rehbari farishta karta hai.

Shaitan toh shararat par amada karta hai aur haq ke jhutlane par aur farishta neki par aur haq ki tasdeeq par. Jis ke dil mein yeh khayal aaye woh Allah Ta'ala ka shukar ada kare aur jaan le ke yeh Allah ki taraf se hai aur jis ke dil mein woh waswasa paida ho woh A'oozu padhe, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne (Ayat-ush-Shaitan-il-Ayah) ki tilawat farmayi (Tirmidhi). Yeh hadith Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) se mauqoof bhi marwi hai, matlab ayat-e-sharifa ka yeh hai ke Allah ki rah mein kharch karne se Shaitan rokta hai aur dil mein waswasa dalta hai ke is tarah hum faqeer ho jayenge, is nek kaam se rok kar phir behayaiyon aur badkariyon ki raghbat dilata hai, gunahon par nafarmaniyon par haram kariyon par aur mukhalifat par uksata hai aur Allah Ta'ala tumhein is ke bar-khilaf hukum deta hai ke kharch fi sabil-illah ke hath na roko aur Shaitan ki dhamki ke khilaf woh farmata hai ke is sadma ke ba'is mein tumhari khataon ko bhi maaf kar doonga aur woh jo tumhein faqiri se darata hai mein is ke muqabla mein tumhein apne fazl ka yaqeen dilata hoon, mujh se badh kar raham-o-karam, fazl-o-lutf kis ka zyada wasee hoga? Aur anjam-e-kar ka ilm bhi mujh se zyada achha kise hasil ho sakta hai? Hazrat Bara (R.A) farmate hain jab tumhara haq kisi par ho aur woh tumhein woh cheez de jo be-qadr-o-qeemat ho toh tum use na loge magar us waqt jab tumhein apne haq ki barbadi dikhai deti ho toh tum chashm-poshi karke usi ko loge. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke tum ne kisi ko achha maal diya aur adaigi ke waqt woh naqis maal lekar aaya toh tum hargiz na loge aur agar loge bhi toh us ki qeemat ghata kar, toh tum jis cheez ko apne haq mein lena pasand nahin karte use Allah ke haq ke ewaz kyun dete ho? Pas behtareen aur marghoob maal us ki raah mein kharch karo aur yahi ma'ani hain aayat (لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتّٰى تُنْفِقُوْا مِمَّا تُحِبُّوْنَ) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 92) ke bhi. Phir farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein apni raah mein kharch karne ka hukum diya aur umda cheez dene ka. Kahin is se yeh na samajh lena ke woh mohtaj hai, nahin nahin woh toh be-niyaz hai aur tum sab us ke mohtaj ho, yeh hukum sirf is liye hai ke ghurba bhi duniya ki nematon se mehroom na rahen, jaise aur jagah qurbani ke hukum ke baad farmaya aayat (لَنْ يَّنَال اللّٰهَ لُحُوْمُهَا وَلَا دِمَاۗؤُهَا وَلٰكِنْ يَّنَالُهُ التَّقْوٰي مِنْكُمْ) (22. Al-Hajj: 37) Allah Ta'ala na is ka khoon le na gosht, woh toh tumhare taqwe ki aazmaish karta hai. Woh kushada fazl wala hai, us ke khazane mein koi kami nahin, sadqa apne chehite halal maal se nikal kar Allah ke fazl, us ki bakhshish, us ke karam aur us ki sakhawat par nazrein rakho, woh is ka badla is se bahut barh charh kar tumhein ata farmaye ga woh muflis nahin woh zalim nahin, woh Hameed hai tamam aqwal-o-af'aal, taqdeer, shariat sab mein us ki tareefein hi ki jati hain, us ke siwa koi ibadat ke qabil nahin, wohi tamam jahanon ka palne wala hai, us ke siwa koi kisi ki parwarish nahin karta. Hadith mein hai ke ek choka shaitan marta hai aur ek taufeeq ki rehbari farishta karta hai.

Shaitan toh shararat par amada karta hai aur haq ke jhutlane par aur farishta neki par aur haq ki tasdeeq par. Jis ke dil mein yeh khayal aaye woh Allah Ta'ala ka shukar ada kare aur jaan le ke yeh Allah ki taraf se hai aur jis ke dil mein woh waswasa paida ho woh A'oozu padhe, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne (Ayat-ush-Shaitan-il-Ayah) ki tilawat farmayi (Tirmidhi). Yeh hadith Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) se mauqoof bhi marwi hai, matlab ayat-e-sharifa ka yeh hai ke Allah ki rah mein kharch karne se Shaitan rokta hai aur dil mein waswasa dalta hai ke is tarah hum faqeer ho jayenge, is nek kaam se rok kar phir behayaiyon aur badkariyon ki raghbat dilata hai, gunahon par nafarmaniyon par haram kariyon par aur mukhalifat par uksata hai aur Allah Ta'ala tumhein is ke bar-khilaf hukum deta hai ke kharch fi sabil-illah ke hath na roko aur Shaitan ki dhamki ke khilaf woh farmata hai ke is sadma ke ba'is mein tumhari khataon ko bhi maaf kar doonga aur woh jo tumhein faqiri se darata hai mein is ke muqabla mein tumhein apne fazl ka yaqeen dilata hoon, mujh se badh kar raham-o-karam, fazl-o-lutf kis ka zyada wasee hoga? Aur anjam-e-kar ka ilm bhi mujh se zyada achha kise hasil ho sakta hai? Hikmat se murad yahan par Quran-e-Kareem aur Hadith-e-Sharif ki poori maharat hai jis se nasikh mansookh, muhkam mutashabih, muqaddam mu'akhkhar, halal haram ki aur misalon ki ma'rifat hasil ho jaye, padhne ko toh ise har bhala bura padhta hai lekin is ki tafseer aur is ki samajh woh hikmat hai jise Allah chahe inayat farmata hai ke woh asal matlab ko pa le aur baat ki teh tak pahunch jaye aur zaban se is ke sahih matlab ada hon, sacha ilm sahih samajh ise ata ho, Allah ka dar is ke dil mein ho, chunancha ek marfoo hadith bhi hai ke hikmat ka raaz Allah ka dar hai, aise log bhi duniya mein hain jo duniya ke ilm ke bade mahir hain, har amr-e-duniyawi ko aqalmandi samajh lete hain lekin deen mein bilkul andhe hain, aur aise log bhi hain ke duniyawi ilm mein kamzor hon lekin uloom-e-shar'i mein bade mahir hain. Pas yeh hai woh hikmat jise Allah ne use di aur use is se mehroom rakha, Suddi kehte hain yahan hikmat se murad nabuwwat hai, lekin sahih yeh hai ke hikmat ka lafz in tamam cheezon par mushtamil hai aur nabuwwat bhi is ka a'la aur behtareen hissa hai aur is se bilkul khas cheez hai jo ambiya ke siwa aur kisi ko hasil nahin, un ke tabe-e-farman logon ko Allah ki taraf se mehroomi nahin, sachi aur achhi samajh ki daulat yeh bhi mala-maal hote hain, ba'az ahadees mein hai jis ne Quran-e-Kareem ko hifz kar liya us ke dono bazoo'on ke darmiyan nabuwwat chadh gayi, woh sahib-e-wahi nahin, lekin dusre tareeq se ke woh za'eef hai manqool hai ke yeh Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) ka apna qaul hai, Musnad ki hadith mein hai ke qabil-e-rashk sirf do shakhs hain jise Allah ne maal diya aur apni rah mein kharch karne ki taufeeq bhi di aur jise Allah ne hikmat di aur sath hi is ke faisle karne aur is ki ta'leem dene ki taufeeq bhi ata farmayi.

Wa'z-o-nasihat usi ko nafa pahunchati hai jo aql se kaam le, samajh rakhta ho, baat ko yaad rakhe aur matlab par nazrein rakhe.

Nek aur bad log zahir aur dar-parda haqeeqat Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke har ek kharch aur nazr ko aur har bhale amal ko Allah Ta'ala khoob jaanta hai woh apne nek bandon ko jo uska hukm baja laate hain us se sawab ki umeed rakhte hain, uske wadon ko saccha jaante hain, uske farman par iman rakhte hain, behtareen badla ata farmaye ga aur unke khilaf jo log uski hukm-bardari se jee churate hain gunah ka kaam karte hain, uski khabron ko jhutlate hain uske saath dusron ki ibadat karte hain, yeh zalim hain qayamat ke din qisam qisam ke sakht badtareen aur alamnak azab unhein honge aur koi na hoga jo unhein chhuraye ya unki madad mein uthay. Phir farmaya ke zahir karke sadqa dena bhi accha hai aur chhupa kar fuqra-o-masakeen ko dena bahut hi behtar hai, is liye ke yeh riyakari se koson door hai, han yeh aur baat hai ke zahir karne mein koi deeni maslahat ya deeni faida ho maslan is liye ke aur log bhi dein waghera. Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai ke sadqa ka zahir karne wala misl buland awaz se Quran parhne wale ke hai aur use chhupane wala ahista parhne wale ki tarah hai, pas is ayat se sadqa jo posheeda diya jaye uski afzaliyat sabit hoti hai, Bukhari Muslim mein barwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya saat shakhson ko qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala apne saye mein jagah de ga jis din uske saye ke siwa aur koi saya na hoga, adil badshah, woh naujawan jo apni jawani Allah ki ibadat aur shariat ki farman-bardari mein guzare. Woh do shakhs jo Allah Ta'ala ke liye aapas mein mohabbat rakhein, isi par jama hon aur isi par juda hon, woh shakhs jis ka dil masjid mein laga rahe nikalne ke waqt se jaane ke waqt tak woh shakhs jo khalwat mein Allah ka zikr karke ro de, woh shakhs jise koi mansab-o-jamal wali aurat badkari ki taraf bulaye aur woh keh de ke main to Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen se darta hoon aur woh shakhs jo apna sadqa is qadar chhupa kar de ke bayein haath ko dayein haath ke kharch ki khabar tak na ho, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadees mein hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne zameen ko paida kiya to woh hilne lagi, Allah Ta'ala ne pahar paida karke unhein gaar diya jis se zameen ka hilna mauqoof ho gaya, farishton ko paharon ki aisi sangeen paidaish par ta'ajjub hua unhon ne daryaft kiya ke Bari Ta'ala kya teri makhlooq mein pahar se zyada sakht cheez bhi koi hai? Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya han loha, poocha is se bhi sakht koi cheez hai? Farmaya han aag, poocha is se zyada sakht cheez koi aur bhi hai? Farmaya han pani, poocha kya is se bhi zyada sakhti wali koi cheez hai? Farmaya han hawa, daryaft kiya is se bhi zyada sakht? Farmaya Ibn-e-Adam jo sadqa karta hai ke bayein haath ko dayein haath ke kharch ki khabar na hoti, Ayat-ul-Kursi ki tafseer mein woh hadees guzar chuki hai jis mein hai ke afzal sadqa woh hai jo posheedgi se kisi haajat-mand ko de diya jaye.

Ba-wajood maal ki qillat ke, phir bhi Allah ki raah mein kharch kiya jaye, phir isi aayat ki tilawat ki (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ek aur hadith mein hai poshida-gi ka sadqa Allah ke ghazab ko bujha deta hai. Hazrat Sha'bi farmate hain yeh aayat Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq aur Hazrat Umar Farooq ke baare mein utri. Hazrat Umar apna aadha maal Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas laye aur Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar jo kuch tha la kar rakh diya. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne poocha apne ghar walon ke liye kya chhod aaye ho? Farooq ne jawab diya utna hi, Siddiq go zahir karna nahin chahte the aur chupke se sab ke sab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hawale kar chuke the, lekin jab un se poocha gaya to kehna pada ke Allah Ta'ala ka wada aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki farmanbardari kaafi hai. Hazrat Umar Farooq yeh sun kar ro diye aur farmane lage Allah ki qasam jis kisi neki ke kaam ki taraf hum lapke hain us mein ae Siddiq aap ko aage hi aage paate hain. Aayat ke alfaaz aam hain sadqa khwah farz ho ya khwah nafl, zakat ho ya khairat, is ki poshida-gi izhaar se afzal hai, lekin Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se marwi hai ke nafli sadqa to poshida dena sattar guni fazeelat hai lekin farzi zakat ko alaniya ada karna pachis guni fazeelat rakhta hai. Phir farmaya sadqe ke badle Allah Ta'ala tumhari khataon aur buraiyon ko door kar de ga bil-khusoos us waqt jabke woh chhupa kar diya jaye, tumhein bahut si bhalai milegi, darjaat badhenge, gunahon ka kaffara hoga. Yukaffiru ko yakfiru bhi padha gaya hai is mein sooratan yeh jawab-e-shart ke mahal par atf hoga jo fa-ni'imma hi hai, jaise (aayat fa-saddaq wa akun) mein wa-akun. Allah Ta'ala par tumhari koi neki, badi, sakhawat, bakhili, poshida-gi aur izhaar, nek-niyati aur duniya talbi poshida nahin, woh poora poora badla de ga.

Mustahiq-e-Sadaqat kaun hain? Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Musalman Sahaba apne mushrik rishtedaron ke sath sulook karna napasand karte thay, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua aur yeh aayat utri aur unhein rukhsat di. Farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate thay ke sadaqa sirf Musalmanon ko diya jaye, jab yeh aayat utri toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farma diya har sail ko do, go woh kisi mazhab ka ho (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Asma (R.A) wali riwayat aayat (La yanhakumullahu...) ki tafsir mein aayegi Insha'Allah. Yahan farmaya tum jo neki karoge apne liye hi karoge, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Man amila salihan falinafsihi, wa man asa'a fa'alaiha) (45. Al-Jasiyah: 15) aur is jaisi aur aayatein bhi bahut hain. Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain imandar ka har kharch Allah hi ke liye hota hai go woh khud khaye piye. Ata Khorasan is ka yeh matlab bayan karte hain ke jab tum ne apni marzi se Maula aur raza-e-Rab ke liye diya toh lene wala khwah koi bhi ho aur kaise hi aamal ka karne wala ho, yeh matlab bhi bahut achha hai. Hasil yeh hai ke nek niyati se dene wale ka ajar toh Allah ke zimme sabit ho gaya hai. Ab khwah woh maal kisi nek ke hath lage ya bad ke ya ghair mustahiq ke, use apne qasd aur apni nek niyati ka sawab mil gaya. Jabke us ne dekh bhaal kar li phir ghalti hui toh sawab zaya nahin jata, isi liye aayat ke aakhir mein badla milne ki basharat di gayi. Aur Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein aaya ke ek shakhs ne qasd kiya ke aaj raat mein sadaqa doonga, le kar nikla aur chupke se ek aurat ko de kar chala aaya, subah logon mein baatein hone lagin ke aaj raat ko koi shakhs ek badkar aurat ko khairat de gaya, us ne bhi suna aur Allah ka shukr ada kiya, phir apne ji mein kaha aaj raat aur sadaqa doonga, le kar chala aur ek shakhs ki mutthi mein rakh kar chala aaya, subah sunta hai ke logon mein charcha ho raha hai ke aaj shab ek maldar ko koi sadaqa de gaya, us ne phir Allah ki hamd ki aur irada kiya ke aaj raat ko teesra sadaqa doonga, de aaya, din ko phir maloom hua ke woh chor tha toh kehne laga, Allah teri tareef hai zaniya aurat ke diye jaane par bhi, maldar shakhs ko diye jaane par bhi aur chor ko dene par bhi. Khwab mein dekhta hai ke farishta aaya aur keh raha hai tere teenon sadaqe qabool ho gaye. Shayad badkar aurat maal pa kar apni haram kari se ruk jaye aur shayad maldar ko ibrat hasil ho aur woh bhi sadaqe ki aadat daal le aur shayad chor maal pa kar chori se baaz rahe. Phir farmaya sadaqa un Muhajireen ka haq hai jo dunyawi taluqat kaat kar hijratein kar ke watan chhod kar kunbe qabile se munh mod kar Allah ki razamandi ke liye Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein aa gaye hain, jin ke ma'ash ka koi aisa zariya nahin jo unhein kafi ho aur woh safar kar sakte hain ke chal phir kar apni rozi hasil karein. Zarb-e-fil-ard ke ma'ani musafirat ke hain jaise aayat (In antum darabtum fil-ard) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 106) aur (Yadribuna fil-ard) (73. Al-Muzzammil: 20).

(Al-Muzzammil: 20) mein un ke haal se jo log nawaqif hain woh un ke libas aur zahiri haal aur guftagu se unhein maaldar samajhte hain. Ek hadith mein hai miskeen wohi nahin jo dar-ba-dar jaate hain kahin se do ek khajoorein mil gayin kahin se do ek luqme mil gaye, kahin se do ek waqt ka khana mil gaya balkeh woh bhi miskeen hai jis ke paas itna nahin jis se woh be-parwah ho jaye aur us ne apni halat bhi aisi nahin banayi jis se har shakhs us ki zaroorat ka ehsas kare aur kuch ehsan kare aur na woh sawal ke aadi hain to unhein un ki is halat se jaan le ga jo sahib-e-baseerat par makhfi nahin rehtin, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (سِيْمَاهُمْ فِيْ وُجُوْهِهِمْ مِّنْ اَثَرِ السُّجُوْدِ) (48. Al-Fath: 29) un ki nishaniyan un ke chehron par hain aur farmaya (وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِيْ لَحْنِ الْـقَوْلِ) (47. Muhammad: 30) un ke lab-o-lehja se tum unhein pehchan lo ge, Sunan ki ek hadith mein hai momin ki danai se bacho, woh Allah ke noor se dekhta hai, suno Quran ka farman hai aayat (اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِيْنَ) (15. Al-Hijr: 75) bil-yaqeen is mein ahl-e-baseerat ke liye nishaniyan hain, yeh log kisi par bojhal nahin hain, kisi se dhitai ke sath sawal nahin karte na apne paas hote hue kisi se kuch talab karte hain, jis ke paas zaroorat ke mutabiq ho aur phir bhi woh sawal kare woh chipak kar mangne wala kehlata hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ek do khajoorein aur ek do luqme le kar chale jaane wale hi miskeen nahin balkeh haqeeqatan miskeen woh hain jo bawajood-e-hajat ke khud-dari bartein aur sawal se bachein, dekho Quran kehta hai aayat (لَا يَسْــَٔـلُوْنَ النَّاسَ اِلْحَافًا) (2.
