Chalees dirham ke taqreeban das rupaye hote hain.

Ek hadith mein hai ke jis ke paas be-parwahi ke laiq ho phir bhi woh sawal kare, Qayamat ke din us ke chehra par us ka sawal zakhm na hoga us ka munh nucha hua hoga, logon ne kaha Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kitna paas ho to? Farmaya pachaas dirham ya us ki qeemat ka sona, yeh hadith za'eef hai, Shaam mein ek Quraishi thay jinhein maloom hua ke Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) zaroorat mand hain to teen sau ganiyan unhein bhijwayein, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khafa ho kar farmane lage us Allah ke banday ko koi maskeen hi nahin mila? Jo mere paas yeh bhejein, main ne to Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke chalees dirham jis ke paas hon aur phir woh sawal kare woh chimat kar sawal karne wala hai aur Abu Zar (R.A) ke gharane walon ke paas to chalees dirham bhi hain, chalees bakriyan bhi hain aur ghulam bhi hain. Ek riwayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke yeh alfaaz bhi hain ke chalees dirham hotay huay sawal karne wala ilhaaf karne wala aur misl reit ke hai. Phir farmaya tumhare tamam sadaqat ka Allah ko ilm hai aur jabke tum pooray mohtaj ho gaye, Allah Pak us waqt tumhein us ka badla de ga, us par koi cheez makhfi nahin. Phir un logon ki tareefein ho rahi hain jo har waqt Allah ke farman ke mutabiq kharch karte rehte hain, unhein ajar mile ga aur har khauf se aman payein ge, baal bachon ke khilane par bhi unhein sawab mile ga, jaise Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Fatah-e-Makkah walay saal jabke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) ki ayadat ko gaye to farmaya ek riwayat mein hai ke Hajjat-ul-Wida walay saal farmaya to jo kuch Allah ki khushi ke liye kharch kare ga Allah Ta'ala us ke badle tere darjaat barhaye ga, yahan tak ke tu jo apni biwi ko khilaye pilaye us ke badle bhi, Musnad mein hai ke musalman talab-e-sawab ki niyat se apne baal bachon par bhi jo kharch karta hai woh bhi sadaqa hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool musalman mujahideen ka woh kharch hai jo woh apne ghoron par karte hain, Ibn Abbas (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai, Hazrat Jabeer (R.A) farmate hain Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke paas chaar dirham thay jin mein se ek rah-e-Allah raat ko diya, ek din ko ek posheeda ek zahir to yeh aayat utri, yeh riwayat za'eef hai. Doosri sanad se yahi marwi hai, ita'at-e-Ilahi mein jo maal un logon ne kharch kiya us ka badla Qayamat ke din apne Parwardigar se lein ge, yeh log nidar aur be-gham hain.

Tijarat aur sood ko hum-mani kehne wale kaj-bahas log. Chunke pehle un logon ka zikr hua hai jo nek ka (sadqa khairat karne wale, zakatein dene wale, haajat-mandon aur rishtedaron ki madad karne wale, garz har haal mein aur har waqt dusron ke kaam aane wale) the, toh un ka bayan ho raha hai jo kisi ko dena toh ek taraf raha, dusron se cheenne, zulm karne aur na-haq apne parayon ka maal hazam karne wale hain. Toh farmaya ke yeh sood-khor log apni qabron se un ke bare mein deewanon aur pagalon, khabtiyon aur behoshon ki tarah uthenge, pagal honge, khade bhi na ho sakte honge. Ek qirat mein 'min-al-mass' ke baad 'yaum-ul-qiyamah' ka lafz bhi hai. Un se kaha jayega ke lo ab hathiyar tham lo aur apne Rabb se ladne ke liye amada ho jao. Shab-e-Meraj mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuch logon ko dekha jin ke pet bade bade gharon ki manind the, pucha yeh kaun log hain? Bataya gaya sood aur byaj lene wale hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke un ke peton mein saanp bhare hue the jo daste rehte the. Aur ek mutawwal hadith mein hai ke hum jab ek surkh rang nehar par pahunche jis ka pani misl khoon ke surkh tha toh main ne dekha us mein kuch log ba-mushkil tamam kinare par aate hain toh ek farishta bahut se patthar liye baitha hai, woh un ka munh phaad kar ek patthar un ke munh mein utaar deta hai, woh phir bhagte hain phir yahi hota hai, pucha toh maloom hua yeh sood-khoron ka giroh hai. Un par yeh wabaal is baais hai ke yeh kehte the ke tijarat bhi toh sood hi hai. Un ka yeh aitraz shariat aur ahkam-e-Ilahi par tha, woh sood ko tijarat ki tarah halal jante the, jabke bai par sood ka qiyas karna hi ghalat hai. Haqiqat toh yeh hai ke mushrikeen toh tijarat ka shar'an jaiz hone ke qail nahin warna yun kehte ke sood misl-e-bai hai, un ka kehna yeh tha ke tijarat aur sood dono ek jaisi cheezein hain.

Phir kya wajah hai ke ek ko halal kaha jaye aur dusri ko haram? Phir unhein jawab diya jata hai ke hillat-o-hurmat Allah ke hukm ki bina par hai aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke yeh jumla bhi kafiron ka qaul hi ho, toh bhi intehai achay andaz se jawaban kaha gaya is mein maslahat-e-Ilahiya ke ek ko Allah ne haram thehraya aur dusre ko halal phir aitraz kaisa? Alim-o-Hakim Allah ke hukmon par aitraz karne wale tum kaun? Kis ki hasti hai? Is se bazpurs karne ki, tamam kamon ki haqeeqat ko manne wala toh wahi hai woh khoob janta hai ke mere bandon ka haqeeqi nafa kis cheez mein aur filwaqay nuqsan kis cheez mein hai, toh nafa wali cheezein halal karta hai aur nuqsan pohanchane wali cheezein haram karta hai, koi maa apne doodh peete bache par itni meharban na hogi jitna Allah apne bandon par hai, woh rokta hai toh bhi maslahat se aur hukm deta hai toh maslahat se, apne Rab ki nasihat sun kar jo baz aajaye us ke pehle kiye huye tamam gunah maaf hain, jaisa farmaya "Afallahu amma salaf" aur jaise Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Fatah-e-Makkah wale din farmaya tha jahiliyat ke tamam sood aaj mere in qadmon talay dafan kar diye gaye hain, chunancha sab se pehla sood jis se main dast-bardar hota hoon woh Abbas (R.A) ka sood hai, pas jahiliyat mein jo sood le chuke thay un ko lautane ka hukm nahin hua, ek riwayat mein hai ke Umm-e-Buhna Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam (R.A) ki umm-e-walad thin, Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas aayin aur kaha ke main ne ek ghulam Hazrat Zaid (R.A) ke hathon aath sau ka is shart par becha ke jab un ke paas raqam aaye toh woh ada kar dein, is ke baad unhein naqdi ki zaroorat padi toh waqt se pehle hi woh use farokht karne ko tayyar ho gaye, main ne chhe sau ka khareed liya, Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ne farmaya tu ne bhi aur us ne bhi bilkul khilaf-e-shara kiya, bohat bura kiya, jao Zaid se keh do agar woh tauba na kare ga toh us ka jihad bhi gharat jaye ga jo us ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath kiya hai, main ne kaha agar woh do sau jo mujhe us se lene hain chhor doon aur sirf chhe sau wasool kar loon taake mujhe meri poori raqam aath sau ki mil jaye, Aap (R.A) ne farmaya phir koi haraj nahin, phir Aap (R.A) ne "Faman ja'a mau'izatun" wali aayat parh kar sunayi (Ibn Abi Hatim) yeh asar bhi mashhoor hai aur un logon ki daleel hai jo 'Aina ke maslay ko haram batate hain is ki tafseel Kitab-ul-Ahkam mein hai aur ahadees bhi hain, Walhamdulillah.

Phir farmaya ke hurmat ka masla kanon mein padne ke baad bhi sood le toh woh saza ka mustahiq hai hamesha ke liye jahannami hai, jab yeh aayat utri toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo mukhabara ko ab bhi na chode woh Allah ke Rasool se ladne ke liye taiyar ho jaye (Abu Dawood). "Mukhabara" use kehte hain ke ek shakhs dusron ki zameen mein kheti boye aur us se yeh tay ho ke zameen ke is mehdood tukde se jitna anaaj nikle woh mera baqi tera aur "muzabana" use kehte hain ke darakht mein jo khajoorein hain woh meri hain aur main us ke badle apne paas se tujhe itni itni khajoorein taiyar deta hoon, aur "muhaqala" use kehte hain ke khet mein jo anaaj khushon mein hai use apne paas se kuch anaaj de kar khareedna, in tamam suraton ko shariat ne haram qarar diya taake sood ki jadein kat jayen, is liye ke in suraton mein sahih taur par kaifiyat-e-tabadla ka andaza nahin ho sakta, pas baaz ulama ne is ki kuch illat nikali, baaz ne kuch, ek jamaat ne isi qayas par aise tamam karobar ko mana kiya, dusri jamaat ne bar-aks kiya, lekin dusri illat ki bina par, haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh masla zara mushkil hai. Yahan tak ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate hain afsos ke teen masle puri tarah meri samajh mein nahin aaye dada ki meeras ka, kalala aur sood ki suraton ka yani baaz karobar ki aisi suratein jin par sood ka shuba hota hai, aur woh zaraye jo sood ki mumasilat tak le jate hon jab yeh haram hain toh woh bhi haram hi thehrenge, jaisa ke woh cheez wajib ho jati hai jis ke baghair koi wajib pura na hota ho, Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke jis tarah halal zahir hai, isi tarah haram bhi zahir hai lekin kuch kaam darmiyani shuba wale bhi hain, in shubhat wale kamon se bachne wale ne apne deen aur apni izzat ko bacha liya aur jo in mushtaba cheezon mein pada woh haram mein bhi mubtala ho sakta hai. Is charwahe ki tarah jo kisi ki charagah ke aas paas apne janwar charata ho, toh mumkin hai koi janwar us charagah mein bhi munh maar le, Sunan mein hadith hai ke jo cheez tujhe shak mein dale use chhod do aur use le lo jo shak-o-shuba se paak hai, dusri hadith mein hai gunah woh hai jo dil mein khatke tabiyat mein taraddud ho aur us ke bare mein logon ka waqif hona use bura lagta ho, ek aur riwayat mein hai apne dil se fatwa puch lo log chahe kuch bhi fatwe dete hon, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain sood ki hurmat sab se aakhir mein nazil hui (Bukhari). Hazrat Umar (R.A) yeh farma kar kehte hain afsos ke is ki puri tafseer bhi mujh tak na pahunch saki aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka inteqal ho gaya.

Logo sood ko bhi chhoro aur har us cheez ko bhi jis mein sood ka bhi shaiba ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne ek khutba mein farmaya, "Shayad main tumhein ba'az un cheezon se rok doon jo tumhare liye nafa wali hon aur mumkin hai main tumhein kuch aise ahkaam bhi doon jo tumhari maslahat ke khilaf hon, suno! Quran mein sab se aakhir sood ki hurmat ki aayat utri, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka inteqal ho gaya aur afsos ke use khol kar hamare samne bayan na farmaya, pas tum har us cheez ko chhoro jo tumhein shak mein dalti ho" (Ibn-e-Majah). Ek hadith mein hai ke sood ke tehattar gunah hain jin mein sab se halka gunah yeh hai ke insaan apni maa se badkari kare, sab se bada sood musalman ki hatk-e-izzat karna hai (Mustadrak Hakim). Farmate hain aisa zamana bhi aayega ke log sood khayenge, sahaba ne poocha kya sab ke sab? Farmaya jo na khayega use bhi ghubar to pahunchega hi (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Pas ghubar se bachne ke liye un asbaab ke paas bhi na phatakna chahiye jo in haram kamon ki taraf pahunchane wale hon. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se marvi hai ke jab Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri aayat hurmat-e-sood mein nazil hui to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne masjid mein aakar us ki tilawat ki aur soodi karobar aur soodi tijarat ko haram qarar diya. Ba'az aimma farmate hain ke isi tarah sharab aur is tarah ki tamam khareedo-farokht waghera woh wasail (zaraye) hain jo is tak pahunchane wale hain, sab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne haram kiye hain. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala ne yahudiyon par la'anat is liye ki ke jab un par charbi haram hui to unhon ne heela-sazi karke halal banane ki koshish ki, chunancha yeh koshish karna bhi haram hai aur mujib-e-la'anat hai. Isi tarah pehle woh hadith bhi bayan ho chuki hai jis mein kaha gaya hai ke jo shakhs dusre ki teen talaq wali aurat se is liye nikah kare ke pehle khawand ke liye halal ho jaye, us par aur us khawand par Allah ki phitkar aur us ki la'anat hai, aayat "Hatta tankiha zaujan ghairahu" ki tafsir mein dekh lijiye. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai sood khane wale par, khilane wale par, shahadat dene walon par, gawah banne walon par, likhne wale par, sab par Allah ki la'anat hai. Zahir hai katib-o-shahid ko kya zaroorat padi hai jo woh khwah-makhwah Allah ki la'anat apne upar le, isi tarah bazahir aqd-e-shar'i ki surat ka izhar aur niyat mein fasad rakhne walon par bhi Allah ki la'anat hai. Hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala tumhari suraton ko nahin balkay tumhare dilon aur niyaton ko dekhte hain. Hazrat Allama Imam Ibn-e-Taimiyah (R.H) ne in heelon hawalon ke radd mein ek mustaqil kitab "Ibtal-ut-Tahlil" likhi hai jo is mauzoo mein behtareen kitab hai, Allah un par apni rahmaten nazil farmaye aur un se khush ho.

Sood ka karobar barkat se mehroom hota hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke woh sood ko barbad karta hai yani ya toh use bilkul gharat kar deta hai ya soodi karobar se khair-o-barkat hata deta hai. Alawa azeen duniya mein bhi woh tabahi ka ba'is banta hai aur aakhirat mein azab ka sabab, jaise hai aayat Qul la yastawil khabeesu wat tayyibu, yani napak aur pak barabar nahin hota go tumhein napak ki ziyadati ta'ajjub mein dale. Irshad farmaya aayat: Wa yaj'alul khabeesa ba'dahu 'ala ba'din fayarkumahu fayaj'alahu fee jahannam. Al-aayah. Khabasat wali cheezon ko teh-o-bala karke woh jahannam mein jhonk dega aur jagah hai aayat (Wa maa aataytum mir ribal liyarbuwa fee amwalin naasi falaa yarboo 'indallaah) (Surah Ar-Rum: 39) yani sood dekar jo maal tum barhana chahte ho woh darasal barhta nahin, isi waste Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A wali riwayat mein hai ke sood se agar maal mein izafa ho bhi jaye lekin anjam-e-kaar kami hoti hai (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A masjid se nikle aur anaaj phaila hua dekh kar poocha yeh ghalla kahan se aaya? Logon ne kaha bikne ke liye aaya hai, aap ne dua ki ke Allah is mein barkat de, logon ne kaha yeh ghalla garan bhao bechne ke liye pehle hi jama kar liya tha, poocha kis ne jama kiya tha, logon ne kaha ek toh Farrukh ne jo Hazrat Usman R.A ke maula hain aur dusre aap ke azaad karda ghulam ne, aap ne dono ko bulwaya aur farmaya tum ne aisa kyun kiya? Jawab diya ke hum apne maalon se khareedte hain aur jab chahein bechein, hamein ikhtiyar hai, aap ne farmaya suno main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai ke jo shakhs musalmanon mein mehnga bechne ke khayal se ghalla rok rakhe use Allah muflis kar dega, yeh sun kar Hazrat Farrukh toh farmane lage ke meri tauba hai main Allah se aur phir aap se ahd karta hoon ke phir yeh kaam na karunga lekin Hazrat Umar R.A ke ghulam ne phir bhi yahi kaha ke hum apne maal se khareedte hain aur nafa utha kar bechte hain, is mein kya haraj hai? Rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Abu Yahya farmate hain main ne phir dekha ke use juzam ho gaya aur juzami (korh) bana phirta tha, Ibn-e-Majah mein hai jo shakhs musalmanon ka ghalla garan bhao bechne ke liye rok rakhe Allah Ta'ala use muflis kar dega ya juzami. Phir farmata hai woh sadaqa ko barhata hai.

Yurbi ki dusri qira'at yurabbi bhi hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs apni pak kamai se ek khajoor bhi khairat kare use Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala apne dahne hath leta hai phir use pal kar bada karta hai (jis tarah tum log apne bachhron ko palte ho) aur uska sawab pahad ke barabar bana deta hai aur pak cheez ke siwa woh napak cheez ko qabool nahin farmata, ek aur riwayat mein hai ke ek khajoor ka sawab had pahad ke barabar milta hai, aur riwayat mein hai ke ek luqma misl-e-Uhad ke ho kar milta hai, pas tum sadaqa khairat kiya karo, phir farmaya napasandida kafiron, nafarman zaban zor aur nafarman fe'l walon ko Allah pasand nahin karta, matlab yeh hai ke jo log sadaqa khairat na karein aur Allah ki taraf se sadaqa khairat ke sabab maal mein izafa ke wa'da ki parwah kiye baghair duniya ka maal-o-dinar jama karte phirein aur badtareen aur khilaf-e-shar' tariqon se kamaiyan karein logon ke maal batil aur na-haq tariqon se kha jayein, yeh Allah ke dushman hain in nashukron aur gunahgaron se Allah ka pyar mumkin nahin. Phir un bandon ki tareef ho rahi hai jo apne Rab ke ahkam ki baja awari karein, makhlooq ke sath sulook-o-ehsan qaim karein, namazein qaim karein, zakat dete rahein, yeh Qayamat ke din tamam dukh dard se aman mein rahenge koi khatka bhi un ke dil par na guzrega balkay Rabbul Aalameen apne in'am-o-ikram se unhein sarfaraz farmaye ga.

Sood khor qabil-e-gardan zani hain aur qarz ke masail. In aayat mein Allah Ta'ala imandar bandon ko taqway ka hukum de raha hai aur aisay kamon se rok raha hai jin se woh naraz ho aur log us ki qurbat se mehroom hojayen to farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ka lihaz karo aur apne tamam mamlaat mein Allah Ta'ala se dartay raho aur tumhara sood jin musalmanon par baqi hai khabardar us se ab na lo jabke woh haram hogaya, yeh aayat qabeela Saqeef bin Amr bin Umair aur Banu Makhzoom ke qabeelay Banu Mugheera ke baray mein nazil hui hai, jahiliyat ke zamana mein un ka soodi karobar tha, Islam ke baad Banu Umrah ne Banu Mugheera se apna sood talab kiya aur unhon ne kaha ke ab hum isay Islam lanay ke baad ada na karenge aakhir jhagda barha Hazrat Attab bin Aseed jo Makkah Shareef ke naib thay unhon ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh likha is par yeh aayat nazil hui aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh likhwa kar bhej di aur unhein qabil-e-wasool sood lena haram qarar diya chunancha woh taib huay aur apna sood bilkul chhor diya, is aayat mein hai un logon par jo sood ki hurmat ka ilm honay ke bawajood bhi is par jamay rahein, zabardast wa'eed hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain sood khor se Qayamat ke din kaha jaye ga, le apne hathyar le le aur Allah se larnay ke liye amada hoja, aap farmatay hain Imam-e-Waqt par farz hai ke sood khor log jo isay na chhorein un se tauba karaye aur agar na karein to un ki gardan maar de, Hasan aur Ibn-e-Sireen (R.H) ka farman bhi yahi hai, Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmatay hain dekho Allah ne unhein halakat ki dhamki di unhein zaleel kiye janay ke qabil thehraya, khabardar sood se aur soodi len den se bachtay raho halal cheezon aur halal khareedo farokht bohat kuch hai, faqay guzartay hon taham Allah ki masiyat se ruko, woh riwayat bhi yaad hogi jo pehlay guzar chuki ke Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne aik aisay mamla ki nisbat jis mein sood tha, Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam (R.A) ke baray mein farmaya tha ke un ka jihad bhi barbad hogaya is liye ke jihad Allah ke dushmanon se muqabla karnay ka naam hai aur sood khori khud Allah se muqabla karna hai lekin is ki asnaad kamzor hai, phir irshad hota hai agar tauba karlo to asal maal jo kisi par farz hai beshak le lo. Na tum tol mein zyada le kar us par zulm karo na kam de kar ya na de kar woh tum par zulm karay, Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida ke khutbay mein farmaya jahiliyat ka tamam sood mein barbad karta hoon. Asli raqam le lo, sood le kar na kisi par zulm karo na koi tumhara maal maar kar tum par zyadati karay, Hazrat Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (R.A) ka tamam sood mein khatam karta hoon.

Phir irshad hota hai ke agar tangi wala shakhs aur us ke paas tumhare qarz ki adaigi ke qabil maal na ho to usay muhlat do ke kuch aur muddat ke baad ada karde. Yeh na karo ke sood dar sood lagaye chale jao ke muddat guzar gayi, ab itna itna sood lenge, balkay behtar to yeh baat hai ke aisay ghurba ko apna qarz maaf kardo. Tabrani ki hadith mein hai ke jo shakhs Qayamat ke din Allah ke Arsh ka saya chahta hai woh ya to aisay tangi wale shakhs ko muhlat de ya maaf karde. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs muflis aadmi par apna qarz wasool karne mein narmi kare aur usay dheel de us ko jitne din woh qarz ki raqam ada na karsake utne dinon tak har din utni raqam khairat karne ka sawab milta hai, aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya har din us se dugni raqam ke sadqa karne ka sawab milega. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Buraidah (R.A) ne farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) pehle to aap ne har din us ke misl sawab milne ka farmaya tha aaj do misl farmate hain, farmaya haan jab tak miyad khatam nahin hui misl ka sawab aur miyad guzarne ke baad do misl ka. Hazrat Abu Qatadah (R.A) ka qarz ek shakhs ke zimma tha woh taqaza karne ko aate lekin yeh chup rehte aur na milte, ek din aaye ghar se ek bacha nikla, aap ne us se poocha us ne kaha haan ghar mein majood hain khana kha rahe hain, ab Hazrat Abu Qatadah (R.A) ne oonchi aawaz se unhein pukara aur farmaya mujhe maloom hogaya ke tum ghar mein majood ho, aao bahar aao, jawab do.

Woh bechare bahar nahin nikle, Aap (ﷺ) ne kaha kyun chup rahe ho? Kaha Hazrat baat yeh hai ke main muflis hoon, is waqt mere paas raqam nahin, wajah-e-sharmindagi ke aap se nahin milta. Aap ne kaha qasam khao, usne qasam kha li. Aap roye aur farmane lage main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai, jo shakhs naadar qarz-dar ko dheel de ya apna qarza maaf karde woh Qayamat ke din Allah ke Arsh ke saaye tale hoga (Sahih Muslim). Abu Laila ne ek hadith riwayat ki hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain Qayamat ke din ek banda Allah ke samne laya jayega, Allah Ta'ala us se sawal karega ke bata mere liye tu ne kya neki ki hai? Woh kahega ae Allah ek zarre ke barabar bhi koi aisi neki mujh se nahin hui jo aaj main is ki jaza talab kar sakoon. Allah us se phir puchega woh phir yahi jawab dega, phir puchega phir yahi kahega. Parwardigar ek chhoti si baat albatta yaad padti hai ke tu ne apne fazl se kuch maal bhi mujhe de rakha tha, main tijarat pesha shakhs tha, log udhaar sudhaar le jate the, main agar dekhta ke yeh ghareeb shakhs hai aur waade par qarz na ada kar saka to main use aur kuch muddat ki mohlat de deta, ayal-daron par sakhti na karta, zyada tangi wala agar kisi ko pata to maaf bhi kar deta. Allah Ta'ala farmayega phir main tujh par aasani kyun na karoon, main to sab se zyada aasani karne wala hoon, ja main ne tujhe bakhsha Jannat mein dakhil ho ja. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs yeh chahta ho ke us ki duayein qabool ki jayein aur us ki takleef-o-museebat door ho jaye use chahiye ke tangi walon par kushadgi kare, Ibad bin Waleed farmate hain ke main aur mere walid talab-e-ilm mein nikle aur hum ne kaha ke ansariyon se hadeesein padhein, sab se pehle hamari mulaqat Hazrat Abu-ul-Yasar (R.A) se hui, un ke sath un ke ghulam thay jin ke hath mein ek daftar tha aur ghulam-o-aaqa ka ek hi libas tha, mere baap ne kaha chacha aap toh is waqt gussa mein nazar aate hain, farmaya haan suno falan shakhs par mera kuch qarz tha, muddat khatam ho chuki thi, main qarz mangne gaya, salam kiya aur poocha ke kya woh makan par hain, ghar mein se jawab mila ke nahin, ittefaqan ek chota bacha bahar aaya main ne us se poocha tumhare walid kahan hain? Us ne kaha aap ki aawaz sun kar charpai tale ja chhupe hain, main ne phir aawaz di aur kaha tumhara andar hona mujhe maloom ho gaya hai ab chhupo nahin bahar aao jawab do, woh aaye main ne kaha kyun chhup rahe ho, kaha mehez is liye ke mere paas rupiya toh is waqt hai nahin, aap se milunga toh koi jhoota uzr heela bayan karunga ya ghalat wada karunga, is liye samne hone se jhijhakta tha, aap Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahabi hain, aap se jhoot kya kahun? Main ne kaha sach kehte ho, Allah ki qasam tumhare paas rupiya nahin, us ne kaha haan sach kehta hun Allah ki qasam kuch nahin, teen martaba main ne qasam khilayi aur unhon ne khayi, main ne apne daftar mein se un ka naam kaat diya aur raqam jama karli aur keh diya ke jao main ne tumhare naam se yeh raqam kaat di hai, ab agar tumhein mil jaye toh de dena warna maaf. Suno meri dono aankhon ne dekha aur mere in dono kanon ne suna aur mere is dil ne ise khoob yaad rakha hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs kisi sakhti wale ko dheel de ya maaf kar de, Allah Ta'ala use apne saya mein jagah de ga, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek riwayat mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne masjid aate hue zameen ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya jo shakhs kisi nadar par aasani kar de ya use maaf kar de Allah Ta'ala use jahannam ki garmi se bacha le ga, suno jannat ke kaam mushaqqat wale hain aur khwahish ke khilaf hain, aur jahannam ke kaam aasani wale aur khwahish-e-nafs ke mutabiq hain, nek bakht woh log hain jo fitnon se bach jayein, woh insaan jo gusse ka ghont pee le us ko Allah Ta'ala imaan se nawazta hai, Tabrani mein hai jo shakhs kisi muflis shakhs par reham kar ke apne qarz ki wasooli mein us par sakhti na kare Allah bhi us ke gunahon par us ko nahin pakadta yahan tak ke woh tauba kare.

Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko nasihat karta hai, unhein duniya ke zawal, maal ke fana, aakhirat ka aana, Allah ki taraf lautna, Allah ko apne a'maal ka hisab dena aur in tamam a'maal par jaza-o-saza ka milna yaad dilata hai aur apne azabon se darata hai, yeh bhi marwi hai ke Quran-e-Kareem ki sab se aakhri aayat yahi hai, is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sirf nau raton tak zinda rahe aur Rabi-ul-Awwal ki dusri tareekh ko peer ke din aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka inteqal ho gaya. Al-gharaz Quran-e-Kareem mein sab se aakhir yahi aayat nazil hui hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs yeh chahta ho ke us ki duayein qabool ki jayein aur us ki takleef-o-museebat door ho jaye use chahiye ke tangi walon par kushadgi kare, Ibad bin Waleed farmate hain ke main aur mere walid talab-e-ilm mein nikle aur hum ne kaha ke ansariyon se hadeesein padhein, sab se pehle hamari mulaqat Hazrat Abu-ul-Yasar (R.A) se hui, un ke sath un ke ghulam thay jin ke hath mein ek daftar tha aur ghulam-o-aaqa ka ek hi libas tha, mere baap ne kaha chacha aap toh is waqt gussa mein nazar aate hain, farmaya haan suno falan shakhs par mera kuch qarz tha, muddat khatam ho chuki thi, main qarz mangne gaya, salam kiya aur poocha ke kya woh makan par hain, ghar mein se jawab mila ke nahin, ittefaqan ek chota bacha bahar aaya main ne us se poocha tumhare walid kahan hain? Us ne kaha aap ki aawaz sun kar charpai tale ja chhupe hain, main ne phir aawaz di aur kaha tumhara andar hona mujhe maloom ho gaya hai ab chhupo nahin bahar aao jawab do, woh aaye main ne kaha kyun chhup rahe ho, kaha mehez is liye ke mere paas rupiya toh is waqt hai nahin, aap se milunga toh koi jhoota uzr heela bayan karunga ya ghalat wada karunga, is liye samne hone se jhijhakta tha, aap Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahabi hain, aap se jhoot kya kahun? Main ne kaha sach kehte ho, Allah ki qasam tumhare paas rupiya nahin, us ne kaha haan sach kehta hun Allah ki qasam kuch nahin, teen martaba main ne qasam khilayi aur unhon ne khayi, main ne apne daftar mein se un ka naam kaat diya aur raqam jama karli aur keh diya ke jao main ne tumhare naam se yeh raqam kaat di hai, ab agar tumhein mil jaye toh de dena warna maaf. Suno meri dono aankhon ne dekha aur mere in dono kanon ne suna aur mere is dil ne ise khoob yaad rakha hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs kisi sakhti wale ko dheel de ya maaf kar de, Allah Ta'ala use apne saya mein jagah de ga, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek riwayat mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne masjid aate hue zameen ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya jo shakhs kisi nadar par aasani kar de ya use maaf kar de Allah Ta'ala use jahannam ki garmi se bacha le ga, suno jannat ke kaam mushaqqat wale hain aur khwahish ke khilaf hain, aur jahannam ke kaam aasani wale aur khwahish-e-nafs ke mutabiq hain, nek bakht woh log hain jo fitnon se bach jayein, woh insaan jo gusse ka ghont pee le us ko Allah Ta'ala imaan se nawazta hai, Tabrani mein hai jo shakhs kisi muflis shakhs par reham kar ke apne qarz ki wasooli mein us par sakhti na kare Allah bhi us ke gunahon par us ko nahin pakadta yahan tak ke woh tauba kare.

Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko nasihat karta hai, unhein duniya ke zawal, maal ke fana, aakhirat ka aana, Allah ki taraf lautna, Allah ko apne a'maal ka hisab dena aur in tamam a'maal par jaza-o-saza ka milna yaad dilata hai aur apne azabon se darata hai, yeh bhi marwi hai ke Quran-e-Kareem ki sab se aakhri aayat yahi hai, is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sirf nau raton tak zinda rahe aur Rabi-ul-Awwal ki dusri tareekh ko peer ke din aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka inteqal ho gaya. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se ek riwayat mein is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zindagi iktees din ki bhi marwi hai, Ibn-e-Juraih (R.H) farmate hain ke salaf ka qaul hai ke is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nau raat zinda rahe hafta ke din se ibtida hui aur peer wale din inteqal hua. Al-gharaz Quran-e-Kareem mein sab se aakhir yahi aayat nazil hui hai.

Sood khor qabil-e-gardan zani hain aur qarz ke masail. In aayat mein Allah Ta'ala imandar bandon ko taqway ka hukum de raha hai aur aisay kamon se rok raha hai jin se woh naraz ho aur log us ki qurbat se mehroom hojayen to farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ka lihaz karo aur apne tamam mamlaat mein Allah Ta'ala se dartay raho aur tumhara sood jin musalmanon par baqi hai khabardar us se ab na lo jabke woh haram hogaya, yeh aayat qabeela Saqeef bin Amr bin Umair yeh aayat nazil hui aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh likhwa kar bhej di aur unhein qabil-e-wasool sood lena haram qarar diya chunancha woh taib huay aur apna sood bilkul chhor diya, is aayat mein hai un logon par jo sood ki hurmat ka ilm honay ke bawajood bhi is par jamay rahein, zabardast wa'eed hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain sood khor se Qayamat ke din kaha jaye ga, de, Hasan aur Ibn-e-Sireen (R.H) ka farman bhi yahi hai, Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmatay hain dekho Allah ne unhein halakat ki dhamki di unhein zaleel kiye janay ke qabil thehraya, khabardar sood se aur soodi len den se bachtay raho halal cheezon aur halal khareedo farokht bohat kuch hai, faqay guzartay hon taham Allah ki masiyat se ruko, woh riwayat bhi yaad hogi jo pehlay guzar chuki ke Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne aik aisay mamla ki nisbat jis mein sood tha, Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam (R.A) ke baray mein farmaya tha ke un ka jihad bhi barbad hogaya is liye ke jihad Allah ke dushmanon se muqabla Allah Ta'ala farmayega phir main tujh par aasani kyun na karoon, main to sab se zyada aasani karne wala hoon, ja main ne tujhe bakhsha Jannat mein dakhil ho ja. Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein jihad karne wale ghazi ki madad kare ya qarz-dar be-maal ki iaanat kare ya ghulam jis ne likh kar diya ho ke itni raqam de doon to azaad hoon, us ki madad kare Allah Ta'ala use us din saaya dega jis din us ke saaye ke siwa aur koi saaya na hoga.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs yeh chahta ho ke us ki duayein qabool ki jayein aur us ki takleef-o-museebat door ho jaye use chahiye ke tangi walon par kushadgi kare, Ibad bin Waleed farmate hain ke main aur mere walid talab-e-ilm mein nikle aur hum ne kaha ke ansariyon se hadeesein padhein, sab se pehle hamari mulaqat Hazrat Abu-ul-Yasar (R.A) se hui, un ke sath un ke ghulam thay jin ke hath mein ek daftar tha aur ghulam-o-aaqa ka ek hi libas tha, mere baap ne kaha chacha aap toh is waqt gussa mein nazar aate hain, farmaya haan suno falan shakhs par mera kuch qarz tha, muddat khatam ho chuki thi, main qarz mangne gaya, salam kiya aur poocha ke kya woh makan par hain, ghar mein se jawab mila ke nahin, ittefaqan ek chota bacha bahar aaya main ne us se poocha tumhare walid kahan hain? Us ne kaha aap ki aawaz sun kar charpai tale ja chhupe hain, main ne phir aawaz di aur kaha tumhara andar hona mujhe maloom ho gaya hai ab chhupo nahin bahar aao jawab do, woh aaye main ne kaha kyun chhup rahe ho, kaha mehez is liye ke mere paas rupiya toh is waqt hai nahin, aap se milunga toh koi jhoota uzr heela bayan karunga ya ghalat wada karunga, is liye samne hone se jhijhakta tha, aap Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahabi hain, aap se jhoot kya kahun? Main ne kaha sach kehte ho, Allah ki qasam tumhare paas rupiya nahin, us ne kaha haan sach kehta hun Allah ki qasam kuch nahin, teen martaba main ne qasam khilayi aur unhon ne khayi, main ne apne daftar mein se un ka naam kaat diya aur raqam jama karli aur keh diya ke jao main ne tumhare naam se yeh raqam kaat di hai, ab agar tumhein mil jaye toh de dena warna maaf. Suno meri dono aankhon ne dekha aur mere in dono kanon ne suna aur mere is dil ne ise khoob yaad rakha hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs kisi sakhti wale ko dheel de ya maaf kar de, Allah Ta'ala use apne saya mein jagah de ga, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek riwayat mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne masjid aate hue zameen ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya jo shakhs kisi nadar par aasani kar de ya use maaf kar de Allah Ta'ala use jahannam ki garmi se bacha le ga, suno jannat ke kaam mushaqqat wale hain aur khwahish ke khilaf hain, aur jahannam ke kaam aasani wale aur khwahish-e-nafs ke mutabiq hain, nek bakht woh log hain jo fitnon se bach jayein, woh insaan jo gusse ka ghont pee le us ko Allah Ta'ala imaan se nawazta hai, Tabrani mein hai jo shakhs kisi muflis shakhs par reham kar ke apne qarz ki wasooli mein us par sakhti na kare Allah bhi us ke gunahon par us ko nahin pakadta yahan tak ke woh tauba kare.

Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko nasihat karta hai, unhein duniya ke zawal, maal ke fana, aakhirat ka aana, Allah ki taraf lautna, Allah ko apne a'maal ka hisab dena aur in tamam a'maal par jaza-o-saza ka milna yaad dilata hai aur apne azabon se darata hai, yeh bhi marwi hai ke Quran-e-Kareem ki sab se aakhri aayat yahi hai, is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sirf nau raton tak zinda rahe aur Rabi-ul-Awwal ki dusri tareekh ko peer ke din aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka inteqal ho gaya. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se ek riwayat mein is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zindagi iktees din ki bhi marwi hai, Ibn-e-Juraih (R.H) farmate hain ke salaf ka qaul hai ke is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nau raat zinda rahe hafta ke din se ibtida hui aur peer wale din inteqal hua. Al-gharaz Quran-e-Kareem mein sab se aakhir yahi aayat nazil hui hai.

Hifz-e-Quran aur len-den mein gawah aur likhne ki takeed. Yeh aayat Quran-e-Kareem ki tamam aayaton se badi hai, Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) farmate hain ke mujhe yeh baat pahunchi hai ke Quran ki sab se badi aayat yahi Aayat-e-Deen hai. Yeh aayat jab nazil hui toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya sab se pehle inkar karne wale Hazrat Adam (A.S) hain. Allah Ta'ala ne jab Hazrat Adam (A.S) ko paida kiya, unki peeth par haath phera aur Qayamat tak ki unki tamam aulad nikali, Aap (A.S) ne apni aulad ko dekha, ek shakhs ko khoob taro-taza aur noorani dekh kar poocha ke Ilahi inka kya naam hai? Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya yeh tumhare Dawood (A.S) hain, poocha Allah inki umar kya hai? Farmaya saath saal, kaha ae Allah iski umar kuch aur badha, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya nahin, haan agar tum apni umar mein se inhe kuch dena chaho toh de do, kaha ae Allah meri umar mein se chalees saal ise diye jayen, chunancha de diye gaye, Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki asli umar ek hazar saal ki thi, is len-den ko likha gaya aur farishton ko is par gawah kiya gaya. Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki maut jab aayi, kehne lage ae Allah meri umar mein se toh abhi chalees saal baqi hain, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya woh tumne apne ladke Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ko de diye hain, toh Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne inkar kiya jis par woh likha hua dikhaya gaya aur farishton ki gawahi guzri. Doosri riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki umar phir Allah Ta'ala ne ek hazar poori ki aur Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ki ek sau saal ki (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Lekin yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai iske rawi Ali bin Zein bin Jud'an ki hadeesain munkar hoti hain, Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne apne imandar bandon ko irshad farmaya hai ke woh udhaar ke mamlaat likh liya karein taake raqam aur miyad khoob yaad rahe, gawah ko bhi ghalti na ho, is se ek waqt-e-muqarrara ke liye udhaar dene ka jawaz bhi sabit hua. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmaya karte the ke miyad muqarrar karke qarz ke len-den ki ijazat is aayat se bakhoobi sabit hoti hai. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Madine walon ka udhaar len-den dekh kar Aan-Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya naap-tol ya wazan muqarrar kar liya karo, bhao-tao chuka liya karo aur muddat ka bhi faisla kar liya karo. Quran-e-Hakeem kehta hai ke likh liya karo aur hadith-e-shareef mein hai ke hum an-padh ummat hain, na likhna janen na hisab, in donon mein tatbiq is tarah hai ke deeni masail aur shar'i umoor ke likhne ki toh mutlaq zaroorat hi nahin khud Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se yeh behad aasaan aur bilkul sahal kar diya gaya. Quran ka hifz aur ahadees ka hifz qudratan logon par sahal hai, lekin dunyawi chhoti badi len-den ki baatein aur woh mamlaat jo udhaar-sudhaar hon, unki babat beshak likh lene ka hukum hua aur yeh bhi yaad rahe ke yeh hukum bhi wajooban nahin pas na likhna deeni umoor ka hai aur likh lena dunyawi kaam ka hai.

Baaz log is ke wujoob ki taraf bhi gaye hain, Ibn-e-Jurayj farmate hain jo udhaar de woh likh le aur jo beche woh gawah kar le, Abu Sulaiman Mar'ashi jinhon ne Hazrat Ka'ab (R.A) ki sohbat bahut uthayi thi unhon ne ek din apne paas walon se kaha is mazloom ko bhi jaante ho jo Allah Ta'ala ko pukarta hai aur us ki dua qabool nahin hoti? Logon ne kaha yeh kis tarah? Farmaya yeh woh shakhs hai jo ek muddat ke liye udhaar deta hai aur na gawah rakhta hai na likhat-parhat karta hai phir muddat guzarne par taqaza karta hai aur doosra shakhs inkaar kar jaata hai, ab yeh Allah se dua karta hai lekin Parwardigar qabool nahin karta is liye ke us ne kaam us ke farman ke khilaf kiya hai aur apne Rab ka nafarman hua hai, Hazrat Abu Saeed, Sha'bi, Rabi' bin Anas, Hasan, Ibn-e-Jurayj, Ibn-e-Zaid waghera ka qaul hai ke pehle toh yeh wajib tha phir wujoob mansookh ho gaya aur farmaya gaya ke agar ek doosre par itminan ho toh jise amanat di gayi hai use chahiye ke ada kar de, aur is ki daleel yeh hadith hai, go yeh waqia agli ummat ka hai lekin taham un ki shariat hamari shariat hai.

Jab tak hamari shariat par isay inkar na ho is waqia mein jisay ab hum bayan karte hain likhat parhat ke na hone aur gawah muqarrar na kiye jaane par Shari' (Alaihis Salam) ne inkar nahin kiya, dekhiye Musnad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Bani Israel ke ek shakhs ne dusre shakhs se ek hazar dinar udhar maange, usne kaha gawah lao, jawab diya ke Allah ki gawahi kafi hai, kaha zamanat lao, jawab diya Allah ki zamanat kafi hai, kaha tu ne sach kaha, adaigi ki miyad muqarrar ho gayi aur usne usay ek hazar dinar gin diye, usne tari ka safar kiya aur apne kaam se farigh hua, jab miyad puri hone ko aayi to yeh samundar ke qareeb aaya ke koi jahaz kashti mile to is mein baith jaon aur raqam ada kar aaon, lekin koi jahaz na mila, jab dekha ke waqt par nahin pahunch sakta to usne ek lakdi li, usay beech se khokhli kar li aur is mein ek hazar dinar rakh diye aur ek parcha bhi rakh diya, phir munh ko band kar diya aur Allah se dua ki ke Parwardigar tujhe khoob ilm hai ke main ne falan shakhs se ek hazar dinar qarz liye usne mujh se zamanat talab ki, main ne tujhe zamin kiya aur woh is par khush ho gaya, gawah manga, main ne gawah bhi tujhi ko rakha, woh is par bhi khush ho gaya, ab jabke apna qarz ada kar aaon lekin koi kashti nahin mili, ab main is raqam ko tujhe sonpta hon aur samundar mein daal deta hon aur dua karta hon ke yeh raqam usay pahuncha de, phir us lakdi ko samundar mein daal diya aur khud chala gaya lekin phir bhi kashti ki talash mein raha ke mil jaye to jaon, yahan to yeh hua, wahan jis shakhs ne usay qarz diya tha, jab usne dekha ke waqt pura hua aur aaj usay aajana chahiye tha, to woh bhi darya kinare aan khada hua ke woh aayega aur meri raqam mujhe de de ga ya kisi ke hath bhijwayega, magar jab shaam hone ko aayi aur koi kashti us ki taraf se nahin aayi to yeh wapas lota, kinare par ek lakdi dekhi to yeh samajh kar ke khali hath to ja hi raha hon, is lakdi ko bhi le chalun, phaar kar sukha lon ga jalane ke kaam aayegi, ghar pahunch kar jab usay chirta hai to khana khan bajti hui ashrafiyan nikalti hain, ginta hai to puri ek hazar hain, wahin parcha par nazar padti hai, usay bhi utha kar parh leta hai, phir ek din wahi shakhs aata hai aur ek hazar dinar pesh karke kehta hai yeh lijiye aap ki raqam, maaf kijiye ga main ne harchand koshish ki ke wada khilafi na ho lekin kashti ke na milne ki wajah se majboor ho gaya aur der lag gayi, aaj kashti mili, aap ki raqam le kar hazir hua, usne pucha kya meri raqam aap ne bhijwayi bhi hai? Usne kaha main keh chuka hon ke mujhe kashti na mili thi, usne kaha aap apni raqam le kar khush ho kar chale jao, aap ne jo raqam lakdi mein daal kar usay tawakkul alAllah daali thi, usay Allah ne mujh tak pahuncha diya aur main ne apni raqam puri wasool pa li. Is hadith ki sanad bilkul sahi hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein saat jagah yeh hadith aayi hai.

Phir farman hai ke likhne wala adl-o-haq ke sath likhe, kitabat mein kisi fareeq par zulm na kare, idhar udhar kuch kami beshi na kare balkeh len den wale dono muttafiq ho kar jo likhwayein wahi likhe, likha parha shakhs mamla ko likhne se inkar na kare, jab use likhne ko kaha jaye likh de, jis tarah Allah Ta'ala ka yeh ehsan us par hai ke us ne use likhna sikhaya isi tarah jo likhna na jante hon un par yeh ehsan kare aur un ke mamla ko likh diya kare. Hadith mein hai yeh bhi sadqa hai ke kisi kaam karne wale ka hath bata do, kisi gire pare ka kaam kar do, aur hadith mein hai jo ilm ko jaan kar phir use chupaye, Qayamat ke din use aag ki lagam pehnayi jaye gi, Hazrat Mujahid aur Hazrat Ata farmate hain katib par likh dena is ayat ki ro se wajib hai. Jis ke zimma haq ho woh likhwaye aur Allah Ta'ala se dare, na kami beshi kare na khayanat kare. Agar yeh shakhs be-samjh hai asraaf waghera ki wajah se rok diya gaya hai ya kamzor hai yani bacha hai ya hawas durust nahin ya jahalat aur kund-zehni ki wajah se likhwana bhi nahin janta to jo us ka wali aur bada ho, woh likhwaye. Phir farmaya kitabat ke sath shahadat bhi honi chahiye taake mamla khoob mazboot aur bilkul saaf ho jaye. Do aurton ko ek aurat ke qaim maqam karna aurat ke nuqsan ke sabab hai, jaise Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ae aurton sadqa karo aur bakasrat istighfar karti raho, main ne dekha hai ke jahannam mein tum bahut zyada tadad mein jao gi, ek aurat ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kyun? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum la'nat zyada bheja karti ho aur apne khawandon ki nashukri karti ho, main ne nahin dekha ke bawajood aql-o-deen ki kami ke, mardon ki aql marne wali tum se zyada koi ho, us ne phir poocha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum mein deen ki aql ki kami kaise hai? Farmaya aql ki kami to is se zahir hai ke do aurton ki gawahi ek mard ki gawahi ke barabar hai aur deen ki kami yeh hai ke ayyam-e-haiz mein na namaz hai na roza. Gawahon ki nisbat farmaya ke yeh shart hai ke woh adalat wale hon. Imam Shafi (R.H) ka mazhab hai ke jahan kahin Quran Sharif mein gawah ka zikr hai wahan adalat ki shart zaroori hai, go wahan lafzon mein na ho aur jin logon ne un ki gawahi rad kar di hai jin ka adil hona maloom na ho un ki daleel bhi yahi ayat hai. Woh kehte hain ke gawah adil aur pasandida hona chahiye. Do aurtein muqarrar hone ki hikmat bhi bayan kar di gayi hai ke agar ek gawahi ko bhool jaye to dusri yaad dila de, ki fatuzakkira ki dusri qirat fatuzakkira bhi hai, jo log kehte hain ke is ki shahadat us ke sath mil kar shahadat-e-mard ke kar de gi unhon ne mukallaf kiya hai, sahih baat pehli hi hai wallahu a'lam.

Gawahon ko chahiye ke jab woh bulaye jayen inkar na karein yani jab un se kaha jaye ke aao is mamla par gawah raho toh unhein inkar na karna chahiye jaise katib ki babat bhi yahi farmaya gaya hai, yahan se yeh bhi faida hasil kiya gaya hai ke gawah rehna bhi farz-e-kifaya hai, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke jamhoor ka mazhab yahi hai aur yeh ma'ani bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke jab gawah gawahi dene ke liye talab kiya jaye yani jab us se waqia poocha jaye toh woh khamosh na rahe, chunancha Hazrat Abu Mijlaz, Mujahid wagaira farmate hain ke jab gawah banne ke liye bulaye jao toh tumhein ikhtiyar hai khwah gawah banna pasand karo ya na karo ya na jao lekin jab gawah ho chuko phir gawahi dene ke liye jab bulaya jaye toh zaroor jana padega, Sahih Muslim aur Sunan ki hadith mein hai achhe gawah woh hain jo be-pooche hi gawahi de diya karein, Bukhari-o-Muslim ki dusri hadith mein jo aaya hai ke badtareen gawah woh hain jin se gawahi talab na ki jaye aur woh gawahi dene baith jayen aur woh hadith jis mein hai ke phir aise log aayenge jin ki qasmein gawahi-on par aur gawahiyaan qasmon par pesh pesh rahengi, aur riwayat mein aaya hai ke un se gawahi na li jaye gi taham woh gawahi denge toh yaad rahe (mazammat jhooti gawahi dene walon ki aur tareef sachi gawahi dene walon ki hai) aur yahi in mukhtalif ahadith mein tatbiq hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A wagaira farmate hain ayat dono halaton par shamil hai, yani gawahi dene ke liye bhi aur gawah rehne ke liye bhi inkar na karna chahiye. Phir farmaya chota mamla ho ya bada likhne se kamsao nahin balkay muddat wagaira bhi likh liya karo. Hamara yeh hukm pooray adl wala aur baghair shak-o-shuba faisla ho sakta hai.

Phir farmaya jabke naqd khareedo farokht ho rahi ho toh chunke baqi kuch nahin rehta is liye agar na likha jaye toh kisi jhagray ka ehtemal nahin, lehaza kitabat ki shart toh hata di gayi, ab rahi shahadat toh Saeed bin Musayyib toh farmatay hain ke udhaar ho ya na ho, har haal mein apne haq par gawah kar liya karo, deegar buzurgon se marwi hai ke (Aayat: Fa-in amina ba'dukum ba'dan...) farma kar is hukum ko bhi hata diya, yeh bhi zehan nasheen rahe ke jumhoor ke nazdeek yeh hukum wajib nahin balkay istihbab ke tor par achhai ke liye hai aur is ki daleel yeh hadith hai jis se saaf sabit hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khareedo farokht ki jabke aur koi gawah shahid na tha, chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek a'rabi se ek ghoda khareeda aur a'rabi Aap ke peechay peechay Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke daulat khanay ki taraf raqam lene ke liye chala, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toh zara jald nikal aaye aur woh aahista aahista aa raha tha, logon ko yeh maloom na tha ke yeh ghoda bik gaya hai, unhon ne qeemat lagani shuru ki yahan tak ke jitne daamon us ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke haath becha tha us se zyada daam lag gaye, a'rabi ki niyat palti aur us ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aawaz de kar kaha Hazrat ya toh ghoda isi waqt naqd de kar le lo ya main aur ke haath bech deta hoon, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh sun kar rukay aur farmanay lage tu toh isay mere haath bech chuka hai phir yeh kya keh raha hai? Us ne kaha Allah ki qasam main ne toh nahin becha, Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghalat kehta hai, mere tere darmiyan mamla tay ho chuka hai, ab log idhar udhar se beech mein bolne lage, us ganwar ne kaha achha toh gawah laiye ke main ne Aap ke haath bech diya, musalmanon ne har chand kaha ke badbakht Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toh Allah ke paighambar hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaban se toh haq hi nikalta hai, lekin woh yahi kehay chala jaye ke lao gawah pesh karo, itnay mein Hazrat Khuzaima (R.A) aa gaye aur a'rabi ke is qaul ko sun kar farmanay lage main gawahi deta hoon ke tu ne bech diya hai aur Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke haath toh farokht kar chuka hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tu kaise shahadat de raha hai, Hazrat Khuzaima (R.A) ne farmaya Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq aur sachai ki bunyad par yeh shahadat di. Chunancha Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke aaj se Hazrat Khuzaima (R.A) ki gawahi do gawahon ke barabar hai. Pas is hadith se khareedo farokht par gawahi do gawahon ki zaroori na rahi, lekin ehtiyat isi mein hai ke tijarat par bhi do gawah hon, kyunke Ibn Marduyah aur Hakim mein hai ke teen shakhs hain jo Allah Ta'ala se dua karte hain lekin qabool nahin ki jati, ek toh woh ke jis ke ghar bad-akhlaq aurat ho aur woh usay talaq na de, doosra woh shakhs jo kisi yateem ka maal us ki balughat ke pehlay usay sonp de, teesra woh shakhs jo kisi ko maal qarz de aur gawah na rakhay, Imam Hakim isay shart-e-Bukhari-o-Muslim par sahih batlatay hain, Bukhari Muslim is liye nahin laye ke Shu'bah ke shagird is riwayat ko Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) par mauqoof batatay hain.

Phir farmata hai ke katib ko chahiye ke jo likha gaya wahi likhe aur gawah ko chahiye ke waqia ke khilaf gawahi na de aur na gawahi ko chupaye, Hasan, Qatada wagaira ka yahi qaul hai. Ibn Abbas R.A yeh matlab bayan karte hain ke in dono ko zarar na pahunchaya jaye maslan unhein bulane ke liye gaye, woh kisi apne kaam mein mashghool hon to yeh kehne lage ke tum par yeh farz hai, apna harj karo aur chalo, yeh haq nahin hain. Aur bahut se buzurgon se bhi yahi marwi hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke main jis se rokoun us ka karna aur jo kaam karne ko kahoon us se ruk jana badkari hai jis ka wabaal tum se chhutega nahin. Phir farmaya Allah se daro us ka lihaz rakho, us ki farmanbardari karo, us ke roke hue kamon se ruk jao, Allah Ta'ala tumhein samjha raha hai jaise aur jagah farmaya ayat (Yaa ayyuhallazina aamanu in tattaqullaha yaj'al lakum furqanan wa yukaffir 'ankum sayyi'atikum wa yaghfir lakum) (Surah Al-Anfal: 29). Ae iman walo agar tum Allah se darte rahoge to woh tumhein daleel de de ga, aur jagah hai iman lao! Allah se darte raho us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par iman rakho woh tumhein dohari rahmatain de ga aur tumhein noor ata farmaye ga jis ki roshni mein tum chalte rahoge. Phir farmaya tamam kamon ka anjam aur haqeeqat se un ki maslahaton aur door-andeshiyon se Allah aagah hai us se koi cheez makhfi nahin, us ka ilm tamam kainat ko ghere hue hai aur har cheez ka use haqeeqi ilm hai.

Mas'ala-e-Rahn, Tehreer aur Gawahi yani bahalat-e-safar agar udhaar ka len-den ho aur koi likhne wala na mile ya mile magar qalam-o-dawat ya kaghaz na ho to rahn rakh liya karo aur jis cheez ko rahn rakhna ho use haqdar ke qabze mein de do. Maqboozah ke lafz se istidlal kiya gaya hai ke rahn jab tak qabze mein na aajaye lazim nahin hota, jaisa ke Imam Shafi'i aur jamhoor ka mazhab hai aur dusri jamaat ne istidlal kiya hai ke rahn ka murtahin ke hath mein maqbooz hona zaroori hai. Imam Ahmad aur ek dusri jamaat mein yahi manqool hai, ek aur jamaat ka qaul hai ke rahn sirf safar mein hi mashroo hai, jaise Hazrat Mujahid waghera lekin Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Shafi'i mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jis waqt faut hue us waqt aap ki zirah Madine ke ek Yahudi Abu-sh-Shahm ke paas tees wasq jau ke badle garwi thi jo aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne ghar walon ke khane ke liye liye the. In masail ke bast-o-tafseel ki jagah tafsir nahin balkay ahkam ki badi badi kitabein hain, Wallahul Hamdu wal-Minna wa bihil Musta'an. Is se baad ke jumle (Aayat: Fa-in amina) se Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) farmate hain ke is ke pehle ka hukm mansookh ho gaya hai, Sha'bi farmate hain jab na dene ka khauf ho to na likhne aur na gawah rakhne mein koi haraj nahin. Jise amanat di jaye use khud Allah rakhna chahiye, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ada karne ki zimmedari us hath par hai jis ne kuch liya. Irshad hai shahadat ko na chupao na is mein khayanat karo na is ke izhar karne se ruko, Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera farmate hain jhooti shahadat deni ya shahadat ko chupana gunah-e-kabeera hai, yahan bhi farmaya is ka chupane wala khata-kar dil wala hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wala naktumu shahadatallahi inna izan laminal athimeen) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 106) yani hum Allah ki shahadat ko nahin chupate, agar hum aisa karenge to yaqeenan hum gunahgaron mein se hain, aur jagah farmaya iman walo adl-o-insaf ke sath Allah ke hukm ki tameel yani gawahi-on par sabit qadam raho, go is ki burai khud tumhein pahunche ya tumhare maa baap ko ya rishte kunbe walon ko agar woh maldar ho to aur faqeer ho to Allah Ta'ala un dono se awla hai, khwahishon ke peeche pad kar adl se na hato aur agar tum zaban dabaoge ya pehlu tahi karoge to samajh lo ke Allah Ta'ala bhi tumhare a'amal se khabardar hai, isi tarah yahan bhi farmaya ke gawahi ko na chupao is ka chupane wala gunahgar dil wala hai aur Allah Ta'ala tumhare a'amal ko khoob janta hai.

Insaan ke zameer se khitab, yani aasman-o-zameen ka malik Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Chhoti badi chhupi ya khuli har baat ko woh jaanta hai. Har posheeda aur zahir amal ka woh hisab lene wala hai, jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Qul in tukhfu ma fi sudurikum au tubduhu ya'lamuhullah) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 29) keh de ke tumhare seenon mein jo kuch hai use khwah tum chhupao ya zahir karo Allah Ta'ala ko is ka bakhoobi ilm hai, woh aasman-o-zameen ki har cheez ka ilm rakhta hai aur har cheez par qadir hai aur farmaya woh har chhupi hui aur alaniya baat ko khoob jaanta hai, mazeed is ma'ni ki bahut si aayatein hain, yahan is ke sath hi yeh bhi farmaya ke woh is par hisab lega, jab yeh aayat utri to Sahaba bahut pareshan hue ke chhoti badi tamam cheezon ka hisab hoga, apne imaan ki ziyadati aur yaqeen ki mazbooti ki wajah se woh kaanp uthe to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aakar ghutnon ke bal gir pade aur kehne lage Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) namaz, roza, jihad, sadqa waghera ka hamein hukm hua, woh hamari taqat mein tha hum ne hatta-ul-maqdoor kiya lekin ab jo yeh aayat utri hai ise bardasht karne ki taqat hum mein nahin, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya tum Yahood-o-Nasara ki tarah yeh kehna chahte ho ke hum ne suna aur nahin maana, tumhein chahiye ke yun kaho hum ne suna aur maana, Ae Allah hum teri bakhshish chahte hain. Hamare Rabb hamein to teri hi taraf lautna hai. Chunancha Sahaba-e-Kiram ne ise tasleem kar liya aur zabanon par yeh kalmaat jaari ho gaye to aayat (Aamanar-Rasulu bima unzila ilaihi mir-Rabbihi wal-mu'minun) (2. Al-Baqarah: 285) utri aur Allah Ta'ala ne is takleef ko door kar diya aur aayat La-yukallifullah nazil hui (Musnad-e-Ahmed). Sahih Muslim mein bhi yeh hadith hai is mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne is takleef ko hata kar aayat La-yukallifullah ilakh, utari aur jab Musalmanon ne kaha ke Ae Allah hamari bhool chook aur hamari khata par hamein na pakad to Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya Na'am, yani main yahi karunga. Unhon ne kaha aayat Rabbana wala tahmil alaina ilakh, Allah hum par woh bojh na daal jo hum se aglon par dala. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya yeh bhi qabool, phir kaha Rabbana wala tuhammilna Ae Allah hum par hamari taqat se zyada bojh na daal, ise bhi qabool kiya gaya. Phir dua mangi Ae Allah hamein maaf farma de, hamare gunah bakhsh aur kafiron par hamari madad kar, Allah Ta'ala ne ise bhi qabool farmaya, yeh hadith aur bhi bahut se andaaz se marwi hai. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) kehte hain main ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke paas ja kar waqia bayan kiya ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ne is aayat Wa-in tubdu ki tilawat farmayi aur bahut roye, Aap ne farmaya is aayat ke utarte yahi haal Sahaba ka hua tha, woh sakht ghamgeen ho gaye aur kaha dilon ke malik to hum nahin. Dil ke khayalat par bhi pakde gaye to yeh to badi mushkil hai.

Aap ne farmaya Sami'na wa Ata'na kaho, chunancha Sahaba ne kaha aur baad wali ayatein utrin aur amal par toh pakad tay hui lekin dil ke khatrat aur nafs ke waswasay se pakad mansookh ho gayi, dusray tareeq se yeh riwayat Ibn-e-Marjana se bhi isi tarah marwi hai aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke Quran ne faisla kar diya ke tum apne nek-o-bad a'maal par pakray jao ge khwah zabani hon khwah dusray a'za ke gunah hon, lekin dili waswasay maaf hain aur bhi bohat se Sahaba aur Tabi'een se is ka mansookh hona marwi hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala ne meri ummat ke dili khayalat se darguzar farma liya, giraft isi par hogi jo kahein ya karein, Bukhari Muslim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jab mera banda burai ka irada kare toh usay na likho jab tak us se burai sarzad na ho, agar kar guzray toh ek burai likho aur jab neki ka irada kare toh sirf iraday se hi neki likh lo aur agar neki kar bhi le toh ek ke badlay das nekiyan likho (Muslim) aur riwayat mein hai ke ek neki ke badlay saat sau tak likhi jati hain, aur riwayat mein hai ke jab banda burai ka irada karta hai toh farishtay Janab-e-Bari mein arz karte hain ke Allah tera yeh banda badi karna chahta hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai rukay raho jab tak kar na le, us ke namah-e-a'maal mein na likho agar likho ge toh ek likhna aur agar chhor de toh ek neki likh lena kyunke mujh se dar kar chhorta hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain jo pukhta aur pura Musalman ban jaye us ki ek ek neki ka sawab das se le kar saat sau tak barhta jata hai aur burai nahin barhti, aur riwayat mein hai ke saat sau se bhi kabhi kabhi neki barha di jati hai, ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke bara bardbar honay wala woh hai jo bawajood is rahm-o-karam ke bhi barbad ho, ek martaba as-hab ne aa kar arz kiya Hazrat kabhi kabhi toh hamaray dil mein aisay waswasay uthtay hain ke zaban se un ka bayan karna bhi hum par garan guzarta hai. Aap ne farmaya aisa honay laga? Unhon ne arz kiya haan, Aap ne farmaya yeh sareeh iman hai (Muslim waghera). Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh ayat mansookh nahin balkay matlab yeh hai ke Qayamat walay din jab tamam makhlooq ko Allah Ta'ala jama kare ga toh farmaye ga ke main tumhein tumharay dilon ke aisay bhed batata hoon jis se meray farishtay bhi aagah nahin, mominon ko toh batanay ke baad phir maaf farma diya jaye ga lekin munafiq aur shak-o-shuba karnay walay logon ko un ke kufr ki dar-parda ittila de kar bhi un ki pakad hogi. Irshad hai (ayat: Wa lakin yu-akhizukum bima kasabat qulubukum) yani Allah Ta'ala tumhein tumharay dilon ki kamai par zaroor pakray ga yani dili shak aur dili nifaq ki bina par, Hasan Basri bhi isay mansookh nahin kehtay, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi riwayat se muttafiq hain aur farmatay hain ke hisab aur cheez hai azab aur cheez hai.

Hisab liye jaane aur azab kiya jana lazim nahin, mumkin hai hisab ke baad maaf kardiya jaye aur mumkin hai saza ho, chunancha ek hadith mein hai ke hum tawaf kar rahe thay ek shakhs ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se pucha ke tum ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Allah Ta'ala ki sargoshi ke mutaliq kya suna hai? Aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala iman wale ko apne paas bulaye ga yahan tak ke apna bazu us par rakh de ga phir us se kahe ga bata tu ne fulan fulan gunah kiya? Fulan fulan gunah kiya? Woh gareeb iqrar karta jaye ga, jab bahut se gunah hone ka iqrar kar le ga to Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga sun duniya mein bhi main ne tere in gunahon ki parda poshi ki, aur ab aaj ke din bhi main in tamam gunahon ko maaf farma deta hoon, ab use us ki nekiyon ka sahifa us ke dahine hath mein de diya jaye ga, han albatta kuffar-o-munafiq ko tamam majmay ke samne ruswa kiya jaye ga aur un ke gunah zahir kiye jayenge aur pukara jaye ga ke yeh log hain jinhon ne apne Rab par tohmat lagayi, in zalimon par Allah ki phitkar hai. Hazrat Zaid (R.A) ne ek martaba is ayat ke bare mein Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya jab se main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is bare mein pucha hai tab se le kar aaj tak mujh se kisi shakhs ne nahin pucha, magar aaj tu ne pucha to sun is se murad bande ko dunyawi takleefen maslan bukhar wagaira takleefen pahunchana hai, yahan tak ke maslan ek jaib mein naqdi rakhi aur bhool gaya, thodi pareshani hui magar dusri jaib mein hath dala wahan se naqdi mil gayi, is par bhi us ke gunah maaf hote hain, yahan tak ke marne ke waqt woh gunahon se is tarah pak ho jata hai jis tarah khalis surkh sona ho. Tirmidhi wagaira, yeh hadith ghareeb hai.

Baqarah ki aakhri aayat aur un ki fazeelat. In dono aayaton ki hadeesein suniye, Sahih Bukhari mein hai jo shakhs in dono aayaton ko raat ko parh le use yeh dono kaafi hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya Surah Baqarah ki aakhri aayatein Arsh-e-taley ke khazane se diya gaya hoon, mujh se pehle kisi Nabi ko yeh nahin di gayin. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ko Me'raj karayi gayi aur aap Sidratul Muntaha tak pahunche jo saatwein aasman mein hai, jo cheez aasman ki taraf charhti hai woh yahin tak hi pahunchti hai aur yahan se hi le jayi jaati hai aur jo cheez oopar se nazil hoti hai woh bhi yahin tak pahunchti hai, phir yahan se aage le jayi jaati hai aur ise sone ki tiddiyan dhake hue thin, wahan Huzoor (ﷺ) ko teen cheezein di gayin. Paanch waqt ki namazein, Surah Baqarah ke khatma ki aayatein aur Tauheed walon ke tamam gunahon ki bakhshish. Musnad mein hai ke Hazrat Uqba bin Aamir (R.A) se Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ) ne farmaya Surah Baqarah ki in dono aakhri aayaton ko parhte raha karo, main inhe Arsh ke neeche ke khazanon se diya gaya hoon, Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke hamein logon par teen fazeelatein di gayi hain, main Surah Baqarah ki yeh aakhri aayatein Arsh-e-taley ke khazanon se diya gaya hoon jo na mere pehle kisi ko di gayin na mere baad kisi ko di jayengi, Ibn Marduyah mein hai Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain main nahin jaanta ke Islam ke jaanne walon mein se koi shakhs Ayat-ul-Kursi aur Surah Baqarah ki aakhri aayatein parhe baghair so jaye, yeh woh khazana hai jo tumhare Nabi (ﷺ) Arsh-e-taley ke khazane se diye gaye hain, aur Hadees-e-Tirmidhi mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen ke paida karne se do hazaar baras pehle tak ek kitab likhi jis mein se do aayatein utaar kar Surah Baqarah khatam ki, jis ghar mein yeh teen raaton tak parhi jayein us ghar ke qareeb bhi Shaitan nahin ja sakta. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise ghareeb batate hain lekin Hakim (R.H) apni Mustadrak mein ise Sahih kehte hain, Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ) Surah Baqarah ka khatma aur Ayat-ul-Kursi parhte to hans dete aur farmate yeh dono Rahman ke Arsh-e-taley ka khazana hain aur jab aayat (Wa man ya'mal soo'an au yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafooran Raheema) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) aur aayat (Wa an laisa lil-insani illa ma sa'a. Wa anna sa'yahu saufa yura. Thumma yujzahu-l-jaza-al-aufa) (Surah An-Najm: 39-41) parhte to zabaan se Inna lillahi nikal jaata aur sust ho jaate, Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke mujhe Surah Fatiha aur Surah Baqarah ki aakhri aayatein Arsh ke neeche se di gayi hain, aur mazeed mufassal ki suratein bhi wahan se hi di gayi hain.

Ek aur hadith mein hai ke hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas baithe hue thay jahan Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) bhi thay ke achanak ek dehshat-naak bahut bade dhamake ki aawaz ke saath aasman ka woh darwaza khula jo aaj tak kabhi nahin khula tha, us se ek farishta utra, us ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha aap ko khushi mubarak ho, aap ko woh do noor diye jaate hain jo aap se pehle kisi Nabi ko nahin diye gaye, Surah Fatiha aur Surah Baqarah ki aakhri aayatein. In ke ek-ek harf par aap ko noor diya jayega (Muslim). Pas yeh das hadeesein in mubarak aayaton ki fazeelat hain. Matlab aayat ka yeh hai ke Rasool yani Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is par imaan laye jo un ki taraf se un ke Rabb ki janib se nazil hua, ise sun kar aap ne farmaya woh imaan lane ka poora mustahiq hai, aur dusre imaan-dar bhi imaan laye, in sab ne maan liya ke Allah ek hai, woh wahdaniyat ka maalik hai, woh tanha hai, woh be-niyaz hai, us ke siwa koi ibadat ke laiq nahin, na us ke siwa koi paalne wala hai, yeh (imaan wale) tamam Anbiya ki tasdeeq karte hain, tamam Rasoolon par imaan rakhte hain, aasmani kitabon ko Anbiya-e-Kiram par jo utri hain sachi jaante hain. Woh Nabiyon mein farq nahin samajhte ke ek ko maanein dusre ko na maanein balkay sab ko sacha jaante hain aur imaan rakhte hain ke woh paak-baaz tabqa rushd-o-hidayat wala aur logon ki khair ki taraf rahbari karne wala hai, go baaz ahkaam har Nabi ke zamane mein tabdeel hote rahe yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shariat sab ki nasikh thehri, Khatam-ul-Anbiya-o-Mursaleen aap thay, Qayamat tak aap ki shariat baqi rahegi aur ek jamaat is ki itteba bhi karti rahegi. Unhon ne iqrar bhi kiya ke hum ne Allah ka kalaam suna aur ahkaam-e-Ilahi hamein tasleem hain, unhon ne kaha ke hamare Rabb hamein maghfirat, rahmat aur lutf inayat farma, teri hi taraf hamein lautna hai yani hisab wale din. Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne farmaya ae Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ki aur aap ki tabe-dar ummat ki yahan sana-o-sifat bayan ho rahi hai, aap is mauqe par dua kijiye qubool ki jayegi, mangiye ke Allah kisi ko is ki taqat se zyada takleef na de. Phir farmaya Allah kisi ko is ki taqat se zyada takleef nahin deta yeh is ka lutf-o-karam aur ehsan-o-inaam hai. Sahaba ko jo khatka hua tha aur un par jo yeh farman garan guzra tha ke dil ke khatraat par bhi hisab liya jayega woh dhadka is aayat se uth gaya. Matlab yeh ke go hisab ho, sawal ho lekin jo cheez taqat se bahar hai us par azab nahin kyunke dil mein kisi khayal ka dafatan aa jana roke ruk nahin sakta balkay hadith se yeh bhi maloom ho chuka hai ke aise waswason ko bura jaanna daleel-e-imaan hai, balkay apni apni karni apni apni bharni, aamal-e-saliha karoge jaza paoge, bure aamal karoge to saza bhugtoge.

Phir dua ki taleem di aur us ki qabooliyat ka wada farmaya, ke aye Allah bhoole chooke jo ahkaam hum se chhoot gaye hon ya jo bure kaam ho gaye hon ya shar'i ahkaam mein ghalti kar ke jo khilaf-e-shar' kaam hum se hue hon woh maaf farma, pehle Sahih Muslim ke hawaley se hadees guzar chuki hai ke is dua ke jawab mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya, main ne ise qabool farmaya, hadees mein bhi hai ke main yaksooi wala aur aasaan deen de kar bheja gaya hoon. Aye Allah takleefain, balayein aur mushaqqatein hum par na daal jin ki bardasht ki taqat hum mein na ho, Hazrat Makhool R.H farmate hain is se murad fareb aur ghalba-e-shahwat hai, is ke jawab mein bhi qabooliyat ka elaan Rabb-e-Aalam ki taraf se kiya gaya. Aur hamari taqseeron ko maaf farma jo teri nafarmani ka koi kaam na ho, is liye buzurgon ka qaul hai ke gunahgar ko teen baaton ki zaroorat hai. Ek to Allah ki maafi taake azab se nijaat paye, dusre parda poshi taake ruswai se bache, teesre ismat ki taake dusri baar gunah mein mubtala na ho, is par bhi Janab-e-Bari ne qabooliyat ka elaan kiya. Tu hamara wali-o-nasir hai, tujhi par bharosa hai, tujhi se hum madad talab karte hain, tu hi hamara sahara hai, teri madad ke siwa na to hum kisi nafa ke hasil karne par qadir hain na kisi burai se bach sakte hain, tu hamari un logon par madad farma jo tere deen ke munkir hain teri wahdaniyat ko nahin maante, tere Nabi ki risalat ko tasleem nahin karte, tere saath dusron ki ibadat karte hain, mushrik hain aye Allah tu hamain un par ghalib kar dena aur deen mein hum hi un par faateh rahein, Allah Ta'ala ne is ke jawab mein bhi farmaya haan main ne yeh bhi dua qabool farmai. Hazrat Mu'az R.A jab is aayat ko khatam karte Aameen kehte. (Ibn-e-Jarir)

Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise ghareeb batate hain lekin Hakim (R.H) apni Mustadrak mein ise Sahih kehte hain, Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ) Surah Baqarah ka khatma aur Ayat-ul-Kursi parhte to hans dete aur farmate yeh dono Rahman ke Arsh-e-taley ka khazana hain aur jab aayat (Wa man ya'mal soo'an au yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafooran Raheema) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) aur aayat (Wa an laisa lil-insani illa ma sa'a. Wa anna sa'yahu saufa yura. Thumma yujzahu-l-jaza-al-aufa) (Surah An-Najm: 39-41) parhte to zabaan se Inna lillahi nikal jaata aur sust ho jaate, Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke mujhe Surah Fatiha aur Surah Baqarah ki aakhri aayatein Arsh ke neeche se di gayi hain, aur mazeed mufassal ki suratein bhi wahan se hi di gayi hain.

Ek aur hadith mein hai ke hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas baithe hue thay jahan Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) bhi thay ke achanak ek dehshat-naak bahut bade dhamake ki aawaz ke saath aasman ka woh darwaza khula jo aaj tak kabhi nahin khula tha, us se ek farishta utra, us ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha aap ko khushi mubarak ho, aap ko woh do noor diye jaate hain jo aap se pehle kisi Nabi ko nahin diye gaye, Surah Fatiha aur Surah Baqarah ki aakhri aayatein. In ke ek-ek harf par aap ko noor diya jayega (Muslim). Pas yeh das hadeesein in mubarak aayaton ki fazeelat hain. Matlab aayat ka yeh hai ke Rasool yani Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is par imaan laye jo un ki taraf se un ke Rabb ki janib se nazil hua, ise sun kar aap ne farmaya woh imaan lane ka poora mustahiq hai, aur dusre imaan-dar bhi imaan laye, in sab ne maan liya ke Allah ek hai, woh wahdaniyat ka maalik hai, woh tanha hai, woh be-niyaz hai, us ke siwa koi ibadat ke laiq nahin, na us ke siwa koi paalne wala hai, yeh (imaan wale) tamam Anbiya ki tasdeeq karte hain, tamam Rasoolon par imaan rakhte hain, aasmani kitabon ko Anbiya-e-Kiram par jo utri hain sachi jaante hain. Woh Nabiyon mein farq nahin samajhte ke ek ko maanein dusre ko na maanein balkay sab ko sacha jaante hain aur imaan rakhte hain ke woh paak-baaz tabqa rushd-o-hidayat wala aur logon ki khair ki taraf rahbari karne wala hai, go baaz ahkaam har Nabi ke zamane mein tabdeel hote rahe yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shariat sab ki nasikh thehri, Khatam-ul-Anbiya-o-Mursaleen aap thay, Qayamat tak aap ki shariat baqi rahegi aur ek jamaat is ki itteba bhi karti rahegi. Unhon ne iqrar bhi kiya ke hum ne Allah ka kalaam suna aur ahkaam-e-Ilahi hamein tasleem hain, unhon ne kaha ke hamare Rabb hamein maghfirat, rahmat aur lutf inayat farma, teri hi taraf hamein lautna hai yani hisab wale din. Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne farmaya ae Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ki aur aap ki tabe-dar ummat ki yahan sana-o-sifat bayan ho rahi hai, aap is mauqe par dua kijiye qubool ki jayegi, mangiye ke Allah kisi ko is ki taqat se zyada takleef na de. Phir farmaya Allah kisi ko is ki taqat se zyada takleef nahin deta yeh is ka lutf-o-karam aur ehsan-o-inaam hai. Sahaba ko jo khatka hua tha aur un par jo yeh farman garan guzra tha ke dil ke khatraat par bhi hisab liya jayega woh dhadka is aayat se uth gaya. Matlab yeh ke go hisab ho, sawal ho lekin jo cheez taqat se bahar hai us par azab nahin kyunke dil mein kisi khayal ka dafatan aa jana roke ruk nahin sakta balkay hadith se yeh bhi maloom ho chuka hai ke aise waswason ko bura jaanna daleel-e-imaan hai, balkay apni apni karni apni apni bharni, aamal-e-saliha karoge jaza paoge, bure aamal karoge to saza bhugtoge.

Phir dua ki taleem di aur us ki qabooliyat ka wada farmaya, ke aye Allah bhoole chooke jo ahkaam hum se chhoot gaye hon ya jo bure kaam ho gaye hon ya shar'i ahkaam mein ghalti kar ke jo khilaf-e-shar' kaam hum se hue hon woh maaf farma, pehle Sahih Muslim ke hawaley se hadees guzar chuki hai ke is dua ke jawab mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya, main ne ise qabool farmaya, hadees mein bhi hai ke main yaksooi wala aur aasaan deen de kar bheja gaya hoon. Aye Allah takleefain, balayein aur mushaqqatein hum par na daal jin ki bardasht ki taqat hum mein na ho, Hazrat Makhool R.H farmate hain is se murad fareb aur ghalba-e-shahwat hai, is ke jawab mein bhi qabooliyat ka elaan Rabb-e-Aalam ki taraf se kiya gaya. Aur hamari taqseeron ko maaf farma jo teri nafarmani ka koi kaam na ho, is liye buzurgon ka qaul hai ke gunahgar ko teen baaton ki zaroorat hai. Ek to Allah ki maafi taake azab se nijaat paye, dusre parda poshi taake ruswai se bache, teesre ismat ki taake dusri baar gunah mein mubtala na ho, is par bhi Janab-e-Bari ne qabooliyat ka elaan kiya. Tu hamara wali-o-nasir hai, tujhi par bharosa hai, tujhi se hum madad talab karte hain, tu hi hamara sahara hai, teri madad ke siwa na to hum kisi nafa ke hasil karne par qadir hain na kisi burai se bach sakte hain, tu hamari un logon par madad farma jo tere deen ke munkir hain teri wahdaniyat ko nahin maante, tere Nabi ki risalat ko tasleem nahin karte, tere saath dusron ki ibadat karte hain, mushrik hain aye Allah tu hamain un par ghalib kar dena aur deen mein hum hi un par faateh rahein, Allah Ta'ala ne is ke jawab mein bhi farmaya haan main ne yeh bhi dua qabool farmai. Hazrat Mu'az R.A jab is aayat ko khatam karte Aameen kehte. (Ibn-e-Jarir)
